_note: Original Reelscore synopses, written in our own words. The build adds each one to its title only when the database has no synopsis, so an admin edit always wins. Keys are title ids.
nanhey: Raghu, the bright son of a Mumbai dhobi, gets a seat at an elite school when its principal (Suniel Shetty) bets on his potential. Surrounded by children from wealthy homes, he has to get past his own fear of not belonging, and finds his footing through six unlikely friendships. A children's drama about equal chances.
pratap: Pratap (Amit Sadh), a decorated encounter specialist, finds himself framed for murder by the very system he served. On the run from his former colleagues, he tries to expose the conspiracy behind his arrest while his wife Poonam (Esha Deol) holds the family together.
ranabaali: Set during the famine of the 1870s, this period action drama follows Ranabaali (Vijay Deverakonda), a rebel from a starving village who rises against British colonial rule. Rashmika Mandanna plays Jayamma, and Arnold Vosloo the British officer he must face, in a story inspired by forgotten history.
avaraachan-and-sons: Avaraachan (Biju Menon) is a widowed, hard-drinking father whose antics have embarrassed his grown children for years. When one of his misadventures blows up at home, his sons take him off to a hill-country hideout, where romance, village scuffles and an overdue growing-up await. A family comedy.
sigma: Guru (Sundeep Kishan), buried in debt and betrayed by people he trusted, throws himself into a high-stakes heist tied to a huge drugs-and-gambling racket. Jason Sanjay's first film as director mixes treasure-hunt adventure, action and comedy.
baththa: North Chennai, 1986. Baththa (Vijay Sethupathi), a feared local thug, ends up locked inside a deserted school toilet by an eight-year-old boy. Stuck there, the tough man's image starts to come apart, in a warm comedy-drama about rage, kindness and change.
dorothy: In a village in early-1990s Tamil Nadu, childhood friends Karthi and Subbu grow up inside a world of rigid ideas about manhood. When Subbu's elder brother returns home with a wife, Dorothy (Keerthy Suresh), her arrival unsettles the household and the friendship. Karthik Subbaraj's drama is based on real events, with music by Ilaiyaraaja.
meesaya-murukku-2: Hiphop Tamizha Adhi continues his semi-autobiographical story, playing three roles across two timelines, 1980s Madras and the present. Three generations of a North Chennai family fight for a place for their independent and gaana music against a closed, classical-minded establishment.
the-paradise: In 1980s Secunderabad, a man (Nani) returns from prison to a settlement called Paradise and is drawn into his mother's fight for their oppressed community's dignity and land. Srikanth Odela's violent period action drama reunites the Dasara team.
daayra: A police officer is hailed as a hero after four men accused of a rape and murder are killed in an encounter. Daayra follows two officers on opposite sides of what happened next, DCP Raman Kumar (Prithviraj Sukumaran) and DCP Ajooni Kohli (Kareena Kapoor Khan), asking where justice ends and vigilantism begins.
vibe: Best friends Hardik (Kunal Kemmu) and Bugs (Sparsh Shrivastava) go from a disastrous date to an accidental undercover mission for the mysterious Madam H (Preity Zinta), one that takes them from Mumbai to Bangkok. Kunal Kemmu writes and directs this spy comedy.
aasha: Aasha (Urvashi), an anxious single mother of two daughters, gets into a late-night road accident with a volatile pickup driver (Joju George). What starts as a roadside scuffle becomes a bitter legal fight that pulls in her daughter (Aishwarya Lekshmi) and keeps shifting who seems to be in the right.
pradhama-drishtiya-kutta: A young constable, Aleena (Parvathy Thiruvothu), who joined the force after her husband's death, and three junior colleagues find themselves on the wrong side of a crime. As a seasoned investigator (Vijayaraghavan) closes in, the officers try to cover their tracks in a police procedural told from the cops' side.
mandaadi: On the Tamil Nadu coast, Muthukaali (Soori), a gifted sailboat racer who walked away from the sport and his past, is pulled back into the traditional sea races, and into a bitter rivalry with his former friend Sattapuli (Suhas).
sardar-2: RAW agent Vijay Prakash (Karthi) takes on a mission tied to his father Chandra Bose, the legendary spy Sardar, and to an old operation. The trail leads to a villain (S. J. Suryah) whose scheme turns on medicines and biological warfare. Karthi plays both father and son.
i-m-game: Dan John (Dulquer Salmaan) is a businessman and compulsive gambler who trusts luck over everything else. After a severe accident, an unexpected supernatural twist turns his life into something closer to a fantasy action ride. From Nahas Hidhayath, the director of RDX.
romanchakam: Anvesh (Sumanth Prabhas), an aspiring start-up founder in Hyderabad, builds a dating app with his friends and falls for Mythili (Ananthika Sanilkumar) from Chennai. When she suddenly goes missing, the friends land in a mess of comic and tense trouble.
modha-rathri: Maruthanayagam and Muthuselvi (Rishikanth and Anishma Anilkumar) want nothing to do with marriage, but family pressure gets them married anyway. Their eventful wedding night, and the conversations it forces, drive this rural comedy about two reluctant strangers.
khalifa: Aamir Ali (Prithviraj Sukumaran), heir to a family with a long history in gold smuggling, lives in the UK with revenue intelligence officers on his trail. Pulled into the family business, he has to live up to the legend of his grandfather in Vysakh's action thriller, which also features a Mohanlal appearance.
vishwanath-and-sons: Sanjay Vishwanath (Suriya), a wealthy industrialist and Olympic shooter in his forties, is determined to stay single, but wants to give his mother (Radikaa Sarathkumar) an heir, so he turns to surrogacy. Things get complicated when he has to find the young surrogate (Mamitha Baiju) again.
sholay-1975: A retired police officer (Sanjeev Kumar) hires two small-time crooks, Jai (Amitabh Bachchan) and Veeru (Dharmendra), to capture the bandit Gabbar Singh (Amjad Khan), who destroyed his family. In the village of Ramgarh, the pair find friendship, love and a fight bigger than they bargained for.
dilwale-dulhania-le-jayenge-19: Raj (Shah Rukh Khan) and Simran (Kajol), two young Indians raised in London, fall in love on a trip across Europe. When Simran's strict father takes her to Punjab for an arranged marriage, Raj follows, determined to win her family's blessing rather than elope.
lagaan-2001: In a drought-hit village in 1893, farmer Bhuvan (Aamir Khan) accepts a British officer's challenge: beat his men at cricket and the village is spared its crushing tax for three years; lose and it pays triple. The villagers have to learn a game they have never played.
3-idiots-2009: Two friends set out to find Rancho (Aamir Khan), their brilliant, rule-breaking roommate from engineering college, who vanished after graduation. Through flashbacks of their years under a tyrannical director, the film takes aim at rote learning and pressure to succeed.
dangal-2016: Mahavir Singh Phogat (Aamir Khan), a former wrestler who never won gold for India, trains his daughters Geeta and Babita in a sport reserved for men, against the mockery of their village. Based on the true story of the Phogat sisters.
pk-2014: An alien (Aamir Khan) lands in Rajasthan and loses the remote he needs to go home. Searching for it, he runs into the business of religion, and with a journalist's help (Anushka Sharma) asks the questions no one else will.
baahubali-the-beginning-2015: Raised by villagers below a giant waterfall, Shivudu (Prabhas) climbs it and discovers the kingdom of Mahishmati, a captive queen, and the truth about his own birth. The first part of S. S. Rajamouli's epic.
baahubali-2-the-conclusion-201: The story of Amarendra Baahubali (Prabhas), his love for princess Devasena (Anushka Shetty) and the betrayal that cost him the throne, before his son rises to reclaim Mahishmati from Bhallaladeva (Rana Daggubati). The conclusion of Rajamouli's two-part epic.
k-g-f-chapter-1-2018: Rocky (Yash), raised on the streets of Bombay with a promise to his dying mother to become rich and powerful, is sent into the Kolar Gold Fields to kill its ruler, and finds thousands of enslaved workers there. The first part of Prashanth Neel's saga.
k-g-f-chapter-2-2022: Now master of the Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky (Yash) has to hold his empire against the brutal Adheera (Sanjay Dutt) and a determined prime minister (Raveena Tandon). The second chapter of Prashanth Neel's saga.
rrr-2022: In 1920s India, the tribal guardian Bheem (N. T. Rama Rao Jr.) comes to Delhi to rescue a girl taken by a British governor, and the police officer Ram (Ram Charan) is assigned to catch him. Unaware of each other's missions, the two become close friends. A fictional story built around two real revolutionaries.
jailer-2023: Muthuvel Pandian (Rajinikanth), a mild retired jailer living quietly with his family, is drawn back into violence when his police-officer son crosses an idol-smuggling gang. The grandfather everyone underestimates turns out to have a dangerous past.
vikram-2022: Officer Amar (Fahadh Faasil) investigates a string of killings by masked men targeting a drug network, and the trail leads to an elderly man everyone thought dead (Kamal Haasan). Lokesh Kanagaraj's action thriller ties into the world of his earlier film Kaithi.
drishyam-2013: Georgekutty (Mohanlal), a cable-TV operator obsessed with films, uses everything he has learned from cinema to protect his family when his wife and daughter are caught up in a death. A police inspector who is also the victim's mother will not let it go.
drishyam-2015: Vijay Salgaonkar (Ajay Devgn), a cable operator in Goa who has learned everything from films, protects his wife and daughter after a young man's death, while a determined senior police officer (Tabu), the boy's mother, hunts for the truth. Remake of the Malayalam original.
pushpa-the-rise-2021: Pushpa Raj (Allu Arjun), a daily-wage labourer in the forests of the Seshachalam hills, rises fast through the syndicate that smuggles red sanders, making powerful enemies on the way. Part one of Sukumar's saga.
pushpa-2-the-rule-2024: Now at the top of the red sandalwood smuggling trade, Pushpa (Allu Arjun) expands his empire and takes on political power, while the vengeful officer Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat (Fahadh Faasil) waits for his chance. The second part of Sukumar's saga.
deewaar-1975: Two brothers grow up on opposite sides of the law: Vijay (Amitabh Bachchan) becomes a powerful smuggler, while Ravi (Shashi Kapoor) joins the police. Their mother is caught between them in Yash Chopra's crime drama.
zanjeer-1973: Inspector Vijay (Amitabh Bachchan), haunted by the murder of his parents, takes on a powerful crime boss with the help of a street-smart knife sharpener (Jaya Bhaduri) and a Pathan with a code of honour (Pran). The film that made Amitabh Bachchan the 'angry young man'.
kabhi-khushi-kabhie-gham-2001: Rahul (Shah Rukh Khan), the adopted son of a wealthy patriarch (Amitabh Bachchan), is cast out when he marries Anjali (Kajol) against his father's wishes. Years later his younger brother (Hrithik Roshan) sets out to bring him home. Karan Johar's family drama.
kuch-kuch-hota-hai-1998: Before she died, Tina left letters for her eight-year-old daughter, asking her to reunite Rahul (Shah Rukh Khan) with Anjali (Kajol), his tomboyish best friend from college who loved him in silence. Karan Johar's first film.
chak-de-india-2007: Kabir Khan (Shah Rukh Khan), a disgraced former hockey captain, takes on the Indian women's hockey team, a squad divided by region and ego, and sets out to make them a team that can win the World Cup.
swades-2004: Mohan, an Indian scientist at NASA, returns to India to bring his childhood nanny back to the US with him. In her village, he is moved by the people and their struggles, and begins to wonder where he truly belongs. Ashutosh Gowariker's drama stars Shah Rukh Khan and Gayatri Joshi.
taare-zameen-par-2007: Eight-year-old Ishaan struggles at school and is sent to boarding school, where he grows withdrawn. A new art teacher (Aamir Khan) recognises that he has dyslexia and helps him find his gift.
rang-de-basanti-2006: A British filmmaker casts a group of carefree Delhi students in a film about India's freedom fighters. When a friend dies because of official corruption, the roles they are playing start to shape what they do next.
andaz-apna-apna-1994: Two small-time dreamers, Amar (Aamir Khan) and Prem (Salman Khan), compete to marry a rich heiress, only to stumble into a kidnapping plot and a gallery of oddball villains. A cult comedy.
hum-aapke-hain-koun-1994: When Prem (Salman Khan) falls for Nisha (Madhuri Dixit), the younger sister of his brother's wife, their romance unfolds through a string of family celebrations, until tragedy tests how far each is willing to sacrifice for the family.
devdas-2002: Devdas (Shah Rukh Khan) returns from London to his childhood love Paro (Aishwarya Rai), but his family refuses the match. Heartbroken, he turns to drink and to the courtesan Chandramukhi (Madhuri Dixit). Sanjay Leela Bhansali's lavish take on the classic novel.
jodhaa-akbar-2008: The Mughal emperor Akbar (Hrithik Roshan) enters a political marriage with the Rajput princess Jodhaa (Aishwarya Rai), and has to earn her love and respect as he tries to unite an empire.
zindagi-na-milegi-dobara-2011: Three childhood friends (Hrithik Roshan, Farhan Akhtar and Abhay Deol) take a bachelor road trip across Spain, each picking one adventure the others must face. Along the way they confront what is holding them back.
gully-boy-2019: Murad (Ranveer Singh), a young man from Mumbai's Dharavi, finds his voice in street rap. Pulled between his family's expectations and his music, he writes his way out with the help of the rapper MC Sher (Siddhant Chaturvedi).
nayakan-1987: Velu (Kamal Haasan) arrives in Bombay as a boy and grows up to become a gangster and protector of the slum where he lives. Mani Ratnam's crime saga follows his rise and the cost to his family.
anbe-sivam-2003: Stranded together after a flood, a self-absorbed advertising man (R. Madhavan) and a scarred, kind-hearted social worker (Kamal Haasan) make a long journey back to Chennai, and the older man's past slowly comes to light.
enthiran-2010: Scientist Vaseegaran (Rajinikanth) builds an advanced humanoid robot, Chitti, in his own image. When Chitti develops emotions and falls for his creator's fiancée Sana (Aishwarya Rai), things go badly wrong.
bombay-1995: A Hindu journalist (Arvind Swamy) and a Muslim woman (Manisha Koirala) marry against their families' wishes and build a life in Bombay, until the riots of 1992–93 tear the city apart. Mani Ratnam's drama.
manichitrathazhu-1993: When a young couple moves into an old family mansion said to be haunted, strange events follow, and a psychiatrist (Mohanlal) is called in to find the truth behind them. A Malayalam classic of psychological suspense.
om-shanti-om-2007: Om Prakash (Shah Rukh Khan), a junior artist in 1970s Bombay, dies trying to save the star he adores. Reborn thirty years later as a film star himself, he sets out to avenge her. A tribute to Hindi cinema by Farah Khan.
bajrangi-bhaijaan-2015: Pawan (Salman Khan), a devout and simple man, finds a mute six-year-old girl who has been separated from her mother and turns out to be from Pakistan. With no papers, he sets out to take her home himself.
sultan-2016: Sultan (Salman Khan), a once-great wrestler from Haryana who lost everything, including his wife Aarfa (Anushka Sharma), returns to the ring for a mixed martial arts league to fight for his self-respect.
munna-bhai-m-b-b-s-2003: To satisfy his father, Mumbai gangster Munna Bhai (Sanjay Dutt) and his sidekick Circuit (Arshad Warsi) muscle their way into medical college, where Munna's unorthodox kindness turns the place upside down.
lage-raho-munna-bhai-2006: Trying to impress a radio host, Munna Bhai (Sanjay Dutt) starts studying Mahatma Gandhi, and soon sees Gandhi in person, giving him advice. With Circuit's help, he begins solving people's problems the Gandhian way.
rangeela-1995: Mili (Urmila Matondkar), a chorus dancer dreaming of stardom, is caught between her loyal street-smart friend Munna (Aamir Khan) and the film star Raj (Jackie Shroff) who gives her a break.
kaho-naa-pyaar-hai-2000: Rohit (Hrithik Roshan), a struggling singer, and Sonia (Ameesha Patel) fall in love, until he witnesses a murder and is killed. In New Zealand, Sonia meets a man who looks exactly like him. The film that launched Hrithik Roshan.
koi-mil-gaya-2003: Rohit (Hrithik Roshan), a young man with a developmental disability, accidentally summons an alien with his late father's computer. The creature, Jaadu, gives him extraordinary abilities and changes his life.
krrish-2006: Krishna (Hrithik Roshan), who inherited extraordinary powers from his father, follows the woman he loves (Priyanka Chopra) to Singapore, where he takes on a masked identity to stop a scientist with dangerous plans.
dhoom-2-2006: A master thief (Hrithik Roshan) pulls off spectacular heists across the world, with ACP Jai Dixit (Abhishek Bachchan) and Ali (Uday Chopra) on his tail. A thief (Aishwarya Rai) joins the chase on both sides.
war-2019: Khalid (Tiger Shroff), an Indian agent, is sent to hunt down his mentor Kabir (Hrithik Roshan), who appears to have gone rogue. The chase spans continents as Khalid tries to understand what Kabir is really doing.
raazi-2018: In 1971, Sehmat (Alia Bhatt), a young Kashmiri woman, is married into a Pakistani military family to spy for India. Based on a novel inspired by real events, it follows what the mission costs her.
highway-2014: On the eve of her wedding, Veera, the sheltered daughter of a rich Delhi businessman, is kidnapped from a highway petrol station by a gang led by the hardened Mahabir. As they drive her across north India, she finds a strange sense of freedom in captivity. Imtiaz Ali's road drama stars Alia Bhatt and Randeep Hooda.
kapoor-and-sons-2016: Two estranged brothers (Sidharth Malhotra and Fawad Khan) return home when their grandfather falls ill, and their family's quarrels, secrets and old wounds come to the surface.
pathaan-2023: Pathaan (Shah Rukh Khan), an Indian spy brought back from exile, races to stop a former agent (John Abraham) who is plotting a devastating attack on India. Part of the YRF spy universe.
jawan-2023: Azad (Shah Rukh Khan), a jailer leading a team of women on a mission, hijacks a Mumbai metro train to force the government to act against corruption and a ruthless arms dealer (Vijay Sethupathi).
animal-2023: Ranvijay (Ranbir Kapoor), desperate for his distant father's love, turns to violent revenge after an attempt on his father's life. A dark family drama by Sandeep Reddy Vanga.
eega-2012: Nani loves his neighbour Bindu, a miniature artist who runs an NGO. When a wealthy, ruthless industrialist who wants Bindu kills Nani, he is reborn as a housefly and sets out to get revenge and protect her. S. S. Rajamouli's fantasy action film stars Nani, Samantha and Sudeep.
pokiri-2006: Pandu (Mahesh Babu), a brash Hyderabad goon who will take any job for money, gets caught between two crime gangs and a corrupt cop, while falling for a fitness trainer (Ileana D'Cruz). Puri Jagannadh's action hit.
athadu-2005: Nandu (Mahesh Babu), a hired assassin framed for a politician's murder, escapes and takes refuge in a village by posing as a family's long-lost son. Trivikram Srinivas's action thriller.
ghilli-2004: Velu (Vijay), a kabaddi player from Chennai, rescues a girl (Trisha) from a violent factionist who wants to marry her by force, and has to hide her in his own home. A remake of the Telugu film Okkadu.
mersal-2017: A doctor famous for treating patients for five rupees becomes the suspect in a string of disappearances of medical professionals. Vijay plays multiple roles in Atlee's drama about the business of healthcare.
leo-2023: Parthiban (Vijay), a café owner in Himachal Pradesh, becomes a local hero after fighting off gangsters, but the attention brings a crime family who believe he is someone else. Part of Lokesh Kanagaraj's cinematic universe.
asuran-2019: Sivasaamy (Dhanush), a farmer in a caste-divided village, tries to protect his young son after the boy kills a powerful landlord, and his own violent past comes back. Vetrimaaran's drama, adapted from the novel Vekkai.
super-deluxe-2019: Four stories intersect over a single day in Chennai: a couple with a dead body, a father who returns home as a trans woman, teenagers with a stolen TV, and a woman who survived a tsunami and found faith.
vada-chennai-2018: Anbu, a skilled carrom player from North Chennai, dreams of representing India. A fateful act lands him in prison, where he is drawn into the bloody power struggle between the area's gangs and the story of a feared leader called Rajan. Vetrimaaran's crime drama stars Dhanush, Ameer, Andrea Jeremiah and Aishwarya Rajesh.
lucifer-2019: After the death of a powerful Kerala politician, a struggle for control of his party begins, and the mysterious Stephen Nedumpally (Mohanlal) moves to protect it from his enemies. Prithviraj Sukumaran's first film as director.
agneepath-1990: Vijay Deenanath Chauhan (Amitabh Bachchan) grows up vowing revenge on the gangster who lynched his father, a village schoolteacher, and becomes a feared don in Bombay to get it.
agneepath-2012: Twelve-year-old Vijay watches the drug lord Kancha (Sanjay Dutt) kill his father in their island village. Years later in Mumbai, he rises in the underworld (Hrithik Roshan) to take his revenge. A remake of the 1990 film.
anand-1971: Anand (Rajesh Khanna), a cheerful man with a terminal illness, decides to live his remaining days to the full, and changes the life of his reserved doctor (Amitabh Bachchan) along the way. Hrishikesh Mukherjee's classic.
don-1978: When the gangster Don (Amitabh Bachchan) dies, the police replace him with Vijay, a lookalike street performer, to bring down the gang from inside, but the plan goes wrong when the only person who knows the truth is killed.
amar-akbar-anthony-1977: Three brothers separated as children are raised in three different faiths: Amar (Vinod Khanna) becomes a police officer, Akbar (Rishi Kapoor) a qawwali singer and Anthony (Amitabh Bachchan) a bootlegger. Manmohan Desai's family entertainer.
silsila-1981: Amit (Amitabh Bachchan) and Chandni (Rekha) are in love, but fate pushes both into marriages with other people. Years later their paths cross again. Yash Chopra's romantic drama.
kabhi-kabhie-1976: A poet (Amitabh Bachchan) and the woman he loves (Raakhee) are married to others, and their lives cross again years later, through their children. Yash Chopra's drama of love across two generations.
black-2005: Michelle (Rani Mukerji), deaf and blind since childhood, lives in darkness until an eccentric teacher (Amitabh Bachchan) breaks through to her. Years later she returns the favour when he is losing his memory.
paa-2009: Auro, a bright 12-year-old with progeria, a rare condition that makes him look far older, lives with his mother Vidya, a doctor. When he meets Amol, a young politician, at a school event, the two strike up a friendship, unaware that Amol is his father. R. Balki's comedy drama stars Amitabh Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan and Vidya Balan.
piku-2015: Piku (Deepika Padukone), an architect in Delhi, looks after her cantankerous, health-obsessed father (Amitabh Bachchan). A road trip to their family home in Kolkata with a reluctant taxi-company owner (Irrfan Khan) tests all three.
andhadhun-2018: Akash (Ayushmann Khurrana), a pianist pretending to be blind, walks into a private performance at an apartment and finds himself the 'blind' witness to a murder. Sriram Raghavan's dark thriller.
gangs-of-wasseypur-2012: In the coal belt of Dhanbad, a feud begins when a mine owner, Ramadhir Singh, betrays and kills Shahid Khan. Shahid's son Sardar grows up vowing revenge, and over the decades the rivalry turns into a bloody war for coal and power. Anurag Kashyap's crime epic stars Manoj Bajpayee, Richa Chadha, Tigmanshu Dhulia and Nawazuddin Siddiqui.
dil-chahta-hai-2001: Three close friends just out of college (Aamir Khan, Saif Ali Khan and Akshaye Khanna) drift apart as love and growing up pull them in different directions. Farhan Akhtar's first film.
dil-se-1998: A radio journalist (Shah Rukh Khan) becomes obsessed with a mysterious woman (Manisha Koirala) he meets in Assam, unaware that she is part of a militant group. Mani Ratnam's romantic drama.
kal-ho-naa-ho-2003: Aman (Shah Rukh Khan), a cheerful newcomer to New York, transforms the life of his gloomy neighbour Naina (Preity Zinta) and her family, even as he hides a secret that keeps him from loving her back.
chennai-express-2013: Rahul (Shah Rukh Khan) boards a train to carry his grandfather's ashes south, and helps Meena (Deepika Padukone), the daughter of a powerful don, escape a forced marriage. An action comedy by Rohit Shetty.
my-name-is-khan-2010: Rizvan Khan, a Muslim man with Asperger's syndrome, moves to San Francisco and marries Mandira, a single mother. After the 9/11 attacks, prejudice tears their life apart, and Rizvan sets out across America to meet the President and tell him he is not a terrorist. Karan Johar's drama stars Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol.
rab-ne-bana-di-jodi-2008: Surinder (Shah Rukh Khan), a shy Punjab clerk, marries the lively Taani (Anushka Sharma) after a tragedy. Unable to win her heart as himself, he reinvents himself as the flamboyant Raj.
gadar-ek-prem-katha-2001: During the bloody Partition of 1947, Tara Singh, a Sikh truck driver, rescues Sakina, a Muslim girl separated from her family, and the two fall in love and marry. Years later, Sakina's father, now a politician in Pakistan, takes her away, and Tara crosses the border to bring her home. Anil Sharma's period drama stars Sunny Deol and Ameesha Patel.
border-1997: Based on the 1971 Battle of Longewala, a small company of Indian soldiers holds a border post in Rajasthan through the night against a Pakistani tank attack. J. P. Dutta's war film.
sita-ramam-2022: In 1964, Ram (Dulquer Salmaan), an army officer, receives letters from a woman named Sita (Mrunal Thakur). Twenty years later, a student is asked to deliver a letter he left behind, and uncovers their love story.
stree-2-2024: Chanderi is safe from Stree, but a new headless terror is taking women from the town. Vicky (Rajkummar Rao) and his friends team up again to stop it. A horror comedy sequel.
fighter-2024: Squadron Leader Shamsher Pathania (Hrithik Roshan) joins an elite air force unit set up to respond to terror attacks. The team, led by Rakesh Jai Singh (Anil Kapoor), faces its biggest test after an attack in Kashmir.
vikram-vedha-2022: Vikram (Saif Ali Khan), an encounter specialist, hunts the gangster Vedha (Hrithik Roshan), who surrenders and tells him stories that make him question right and wrong. Remake of the 2017 Tamil film.
cheekati-rajyam-2015: In Telugu. A narcotics officer seizes a big cocaine shipment, and the drug lord who owned it kidnaps his son in return. Over one long night inside a crowded nightclub, he has to trade the drugs for the boy while an internal-affairs officer closes in on him.
thoonga-vanam-2015: In Tamil. A narcotics officer seizes a big cocaine shipment, and the drug lord who owned it kidnaps his son in return. Over one long night inside a crowded nightclub, he has to trade the drugs for the boy while an internal-affairs officer closes in on him.
vasool-raja-mbbs-2004: A Chennai strongman who has spent years pretending to be a doctor for his parents' sake finally enrols in medical college. His warmth and rule-breaking shake up the hospital and put him at odds with its stern dean.
iruvar-1997: Two friends, a rising film star and a gifted screenwriter, enter Tamil Nadu politics together and slowly become rivals. Mani Ratnam's drama, loosely drawn from real lives, follows friendship, power and loss across decades.
entertainment-2014: A broke young man discovers he is the son of a millionaire, only to learn the entire fortune has been left to a dog. His plans to get rid of the animal fall apart as the two grow attached.
odiyan-2018: Manikyan, the last of the Odiyans, shape-shifters of Kerala folklore, returns to his village after fifteen years in exile. He sets out to settle old scores with the man who drove him away and to protect Prabha, the woman he has always loved. V. A. Shrikumar Menon's fantasy drama stars Mohanlal, Manju Warrier and Prakash Raj.
aran-2006: An Indian Army officer leads his unit through a dangerous counter-terror operation in Kashmir, where the bonds between the soldiers and their families' fears are tested under fire. Mohanlal stars with Jiiva in this Tamil war drama, a version of the Malayalam film Keerthi Chakra.
dabangg-2-2012: Inspector Chulbul Pandey moves to Kanpur with his wife Rajjo and family. There he runs into Bachcha Singh, a powerful gangster-politician, and his brothers, and Chulbul's swagger soon turns into an all-out war. Arbaaz Khan's sequel stars Salman Khan, Sonakshi Sinha and Prakash Raj.
wanted-2009: Radhe is a hired gun who will take any job for money. As he falls for a fitness instructor and rises in the underworld, he collides with the ruthless don Gani Bhai and a secret about his own identity comes out.
dhamarukam-2012: Mallikarjuna, an orphan devoted to Lord Shiva, falls for Maheswari, unaware that a powerful sorcerer has marked her for a sacrifice. His faith and the god himself are drawn into the fight to save her.
gaganam-2011: Five armed men hijack a flight from Chennai to Delhi, and the damaged plane is forced to land at Tirupati. They demand a huge ransom and the release of their jailed leader, and a commando officer must find a way to save the passengers. Radha Mohan's thriller, made in Telugu and Tamil, stars Nagarjuna and Prakash Raj.
payanam-2011: Five armed men hijack a Chennai–Delhi flight, and the damaged plane is forced to land at Tirupati. They demand a fortune and the release of their jailed leader, and an NSG commander must find a way to save the passengers. Radha Mohan's thriller, made in Tamil and Telugu, stars Nagarjuna and Prakash Raj.
oosaravelli-2011: Tony, a smooth con man who will do anything for money, agrees to help a woman avenge the men who destroyed her family, and the job turns out to be more personal than either expected.
elektra-2010: In a wealthy Kerala family, Elektra is fiercely devoted to her father and resents her mother. When her father dies and her brother returns home, buried tensions and long-hidden secrets come to the surface. Shyamaprasad's psychological drama, a retelling of the Greek tragedy, stars Nayanthara, Manisha Koirala and Prakash Raj.
konchem-ishtam-konchem-kashtam: Siddu and Geetha fall in love, but her father, who values family above all, will agree to their marriage only if Siddu's estranged parents first get back together. Siddu sets out to reunite them. Kishore Kumar Pardasani's romantic drama stars Siddharth, Tamannaah, Prakash Raj and Nassar.
badrinath-2011: Badri, a shepherd's son trained by a guru as a warrior to protect the Badrinath temple, meets Alakananda, an atheist woman who once blew out a temple lamp. As he helps her rediscover her faith, he must also protect her from relatives who want her inheritance.
cameraman-gangatho-rambabu-201: Rambabu, a hot-headed mechanic who cannot stand injustice, is hired as a TV journalist by Ganga, a news-channel camerawoman. When a former chief minister and his violent son plot to grab power, Rambabu uses the camera and his fists to take them on. Puri Jagannadh's political action comedy stars Pawan Kalyan, Tamannaah and Prakash Raj.
viyabari-2007: Suryaprakash, a businessman obsessed with becoming richer than Bill Gates, has a scientist clone him so the clone can handle his family while he focuses on work. But the clone develops a mind of its own. Sakthi Chidambaram's science fiction comedy stars S. J. Suryah in a dual role, with Tamannaah, Namitha and Prakash Raj.
singham-2011: Bajirao Singham, an honest police inspector who keeps the peace in his village, crosses Jaikant Shikre, a powerful gangster-politician from Goa. When Singham is transferred to Goa, Shikre sets out to break him, and Singham fights back. Rohit Shetty's remake of Singam stars Ajay Devgn, Kajal Aggarwal and Prakash Raj.
villu-2009: Pugazh, a highly educated young man, falls for Janavi and travels with her to Europe. But he has a secret mission: to clear the name of his father, an army officer who was falsely branded a traitor, and to punish the men who betrayed him. Prabhu Deva's action comedy stars Vijay in a dual role, with Nayanthara and Prakash Raj.
dookudu-2011: Ajay, a tough cop, discovers that his father, a former MLA, has woken from a long coma. To protect his fragile health, Ajay stages an elaborate pretence that nothing has changed while he hunts down the gang behind the attack.
policegiri-2013: DCP Rudra, an unconventional cop, poses as a hitman to bust a criminal gang. His methods put him on a collision course with Nagori Subramaniam, a powerful businessman with criminal ties. K. S. Ravikumar's action film, a remake of the Tamil film Saamy, stars Sanjay Dutt, Prachi Desai and Prakash Raj.
thiruvilaiyaadal-aarambam-2006: Thiru, a jobless young man with big ideas, falls for the sister of a rich and arrogant businessman, then outwits the brother at every turn to win her and make his fortune.
sainikudu-2006: Siddharth, a socially conscious young man from Warangal, and his friends expose a corrupt politician who diverts relief meant for flood victims. When they field their own candidate against him in the elections, the conflict turns violent and becomes personal.
shaakuntalam-2023: A retelling of Kalidasa's classic: the sage's daughter Shakuntala falls in love with King Dushyanta in the forest, is forgotten by him through a curse, and fights for recognition for herself and their son.
singam-2010: Durai Singam, an honest and much-loved police inspector in his home village, clashes with Mayil Vaaganam, a powerful Chennai gangster, over a small case. Transferred to Chennai, he takes on the gangster on his own turf. Hari's action thriller stars Suriya, Anushka Shetty and Prakash Raj.
khaleja-2010: Raju, a Hyderabad cab driver, travels to Rajasthan to deliver insurance money and gets caught up in danger. A remote village plagued by a deadly illness comes to believe he is the god-sent saviour they have been waiting for. Trivikram Srinivas's fantasy action comedy stars Mahesh Babu, Anushka Shetty and Prakash Raj.
okkadu-2003: Ajay, a kabaddi player from Hyderabad, rescues a young woman from a violent factionist who wants to marry her by force, and has to hide her while the whole city searches.
businessman-2012: Just as Mumbai's police chief declares the city free of the mafia, Surya arrives from the south with a plan to build his own empire. Ruthless and calculating, he wins over slum dwellers and politicians alike while taking on the commissioner himself. Puri Jagannadh's crime action film stars Mahesh Babu, Kajal Aggarwal and Prakash Raj.
murari-2001: A wealthy family has been under a goddess's curse for generations, losing a son every 48 years. The next one marked is Murari, carefree and in love, as his family races to break the curse.
bharat-ane-nenu-2018: Bharath, a bright young man studying abroad, returns home when his father, the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, suddenly dies. Thrust into the top job with no political experience, he sets out to keep his promises, clean up governance and take on entrenched interests. Koratala Siva directs Mahesh Babu and Kiara Advani.
aathi-2006: In Rameswaram, a young woman named Anjali kills a retired police officer, saying she has waited years for that moment. Meanwhile Aathi, a young man from Delhi, enrols in a Chennai college against his parents' wishes, and the link between him, Anjali and a powerful gangster slowly emerges. A remake of Athanokkade.
bodyguard-2012: Venkatadri, a tough bodyguard, is hired to protect Keerthi, the college-going daughter of a powerful man. Fed up with his watch, Keerthi calls him from a private number posing as an admirer, and both end up falling for each other. Gopichand Malineni's Telugu remake of the Malayalam hit stars Venkatesh, Trisha and Prakash Raj.
boologam-2015: In North Chennai, two boxing clans have nursed a bitter rivalry for a generation. Bhooloham, a fiery young boxer, wants to settle an old family score in the ring, but a TV channel boss starts using the feud to sell a commercial boxing league. N. Kalyanakrishnan's sports action film stars Jayam Ravi, Trisha and Prakash Raj.
singh-saab-the-great-2013: Singh Saab, an honest and principled government officer, refuses to bow to a powerful local tyrant. When he is jailed on false charges, he comes out determined to change the system rather than take revenge. Anil Sharma's action drama stars Sunny Deol, Amrita Rao, Urvashi Rautela and Prakash Raj.
ram-gopal-varma-ki-aag-2007: In a small town, two young men, Heero and Raj, are hired by an honest police inspector to help bring down Babban, a ruthless gangster who has terrorised the area for years. Ram Gopal Varma's reworking of Sholay stars Amitabh Bachchan, Ajay Devgn, Mohanlal, Prashant Raj and Sushmita Sen.
bheemaa-2008: Two rival gangs fight for control of Chennai. When the young and fearless Sekar saves gang leader Chinna during an attack, he joins the crew, having idolised Chinna since childhood. As the two grow close, loyalty and violence pull them in hard directions. N. Lingusamy directs Vikram, Trisha and Prakash Raj in this crime actioner.
nijam-2003: A naive young man whose father, an honest officer, is killed by a corrupt cop and his political allies sets out to bring them down.
vikramarkudu-2006: Sathi Babu, a small-time con man in Hyderabad, discovers he is the exact double of Vikram Rathore, a fearless police officer. Taking care of Rathore's young daughter, he is drawn into the officer's battle against a brutal gang in a lawless town. S. S. Rajamouli's action comedy stars Ravi Teja in a dual role, with Anushka Shetty.
abhiyum-naanum-2008: Raghu, an estate manager in Ooty, dotes on his daughter Abhi and finds it hard to let her grow up. When she comes home from Delhi announcing that she wants to marry a Punjabi man, Raghu has to come to terms with his little girl's choices.
naa-autograph-2004: Before his wedding, a man travels to hand invitations to the women he once loved, and relives his first love, his college romance and a friendship that saved him.
tagore-2003: A quiet college professor secretly runs a network of former students who abduct and punish the most corrupt officials, until the police start closing in.
venky-mama-2019: Venkataratnam raises his orphaned nephew Karthik as his own son, despite a horoscope warning that the two of them living together would bring tragedy.
kalki-2898-ad-2024: In the ruined future city of Kasi, the bounty hunter Bhairava takes a job to capture a pregnant woman whose child is prophesied to end the rule of the tyrant Supreme Yaskin. The immortal Ashwatthama, from the Mahabharata, stands in his way.
pokkiri-2007: Tamizh, a hired goon in Chennai, works for one of two rival gangs fighting over the city's land deals. He falls for Shruthi, a fitness instructor, even as the new police commissioner launches a crackdown on the mafia. Prabhu Deva's remake of the Telugu film Pokiri stars Vijay, Asin and Prakash Raj.
temper-2015: Daya, a corrupt police officer who joined the force for easy money, works hand in glove with a local don in Vizag. When a horrifying crime touches his conscience, he turns against his partners and takes them on. Puri Jagannadh's action drama stars Jr NTR, Kajal Aggarwal and Prakash Raj.
inji-iduppazhagi-2015: Sweety, a cheerful young woman who is overweight, is rejected by a prospective groom. Determined to lose weight, she joins a fancy slimming clinic, only to discover that its methods are a scam endangering its clients. Prakash Kovelamudi's comedy drama, made in Tamil and Telugu as Size Zero, stars Anushka Shetty and Arya.
size-zero-2015: Sweety, a cheerful young woman who is overweight, falls for Abhishek, a former prospective groom, only to find he loves someone else. Determined to lose weight, she joins a fancy slimming clinic and discovers its methods are dangerous. Prakash Kovelamudi's comedy drama, made in Telugu and Tamil, stars Anushka Shetty and Arya.
dev-2019: Dev, a young man who lives for adventure, falls for Meghna, a driven entrepreneur who doesn't believe in love, and sets out to change her mind.
mozhi-2007: Karthik, a music composer, falls in love with Archana, who is deaf and cannot speak. A gentle drama about love that has to find its own language.
rangamarthanda-2023: A celebrated stage actor retires and hands his property to his children, then finds that he and his wife are no longer wanted in their homes.
raja-the-great-2017: Raja, who has been blind since birth but is fearless and fiercely confident, insists on joining a police mission to protect Lucky, a young woman being hunted by a ruthless gangster. Relying on his other senses, he takes on her enemies in this action comedy starring Ravi Teja.
un-samayal-arayil-2014: Kalidas, an archaeologist in his forties who loves food, and Gowri, a dubbing artist, are connected by a wrong phone call about a recipe. Their talk about cooking turns into a warm friendship, but both are afraid to meet in person. Prakash Raj directs and stars with Sneha in this Tamil remake of Salt N' Pepper.
khadgam-2002: The lives of a police officer, an aspiring actress, a struggling actor and a young Muslim man cross in Hyderabad as terrorism forces each of them to show where they stand.
ntr-kathanayakudu-2019: In 1947, N. T. Rama Rao quits his government job to try his luck in films. The film follows his rise to become one of Telugu cinema's greatest stars, through landmark mythological roles and his life with his wife Basavatarakam. Krish's biopic stars Nandamuri Balakrishna as his father NTR, with Vidya Balan.
munna-2007: Munna, a college student, is set on killing Kaka, the gangster he blames for his mother's death, and the truth about their bond changes everything.
o-kadhal-kanmani-2015: Aditya, a video game developer, and Tara, an architect, meet in Mumbai and fall for each other, though neither believes in marriage. They decide to live together in the house of an elderly couple, whose own lasting bond makes them rethink their ideas about love. Mani Ratnam's romance stars Dulquer Salmaan, Nithya Menen, Prakash Raj and Leela Samson.
16-vayathinile-1977: Mayil, a sixteen-year-old village girl, dreams of becoming a teacher. Chappani, a simple young man devoted to her, the scheming Parattai and a visiting veterinarian change the course of her life.
anwar-2010: A year after the 1998 Coimbatore bombings, Anwar, a young man arrested for carrying hawala money, befriends Babu Sait, a community leader jailed as a suspect. Anwar becomes Babu's most trusted lieutenant and rises in a terror network, but he has his own reasons for getting so close to them.
moondru-mudichu-1976: Two friends love the same woman. When one lets the other drown, she takes a startling step to make him pay.
santosh-subramaniam-2008: Santosh has grown up with a loving but overbearing father who decides everything for his family. When Santosh falls for Hasini, a free-spirited girl, his father agrees to let her stay with them for a week to see if she fits in. M. Raja's remake of Bommarillu stars Jayam Ravi, Genelia and Prakash Raj.
bommarillu-2006: Siddhu's father plans every detail of his life. When Siddhu falls for a free-spirited girl, he brings her home to stay for a week, hoping his family will see why he loves her.
idiot-2002: Chanti, a carefree young man with no plans, falls for the daughter of the city police commissioner, and her father will stop at nothing to keep them apart.
kotigobba-2-2016: Sathya, a mild real-estate agent, is suspected of being the mastermind behind a string of huge thefts from corrupt businessmen. He insists the robber is Shiva, his lookalike twin brother. Kannada star Sudeep plays both roles in K. S. Ravikumar's action film, made in Kannada and Tamil, with Nithya Menen.
mudinja-ivana-pudi-2016: A man is accused of being behind a series of daring thefts of black money from wealthy businessmen, but insists the culprit is his lookalike twin brother. A determined police officer sets out to find the truth. The Tamil version of K. S. Ravikumar's Kotigobba 2 stars Sudeep in a dual role, with Nithya Menen.
hitler-1997: An elder brother raises his five sisters with an iron hand after their mother's death, and his strictness tests the family when the sisters fall in love.
race-gurram-2014: Lucky, a carefree younger brother, and Ram, his strait-laced cop brother, can't stand each other, until a dangerous politician-gangster targets their family.
vanamagan-2017: Kavya, a young heiress, injures a tribal man in an accident while partying in the Andaman Islands and brings him back to Chennai for treatment. Unable to adjust to city life, he forms a bond with her, while her scheming guardian eyes her fortune. Vijay's adventure drama stars Jayam Ravi and Sayyeshaa in her Tamil debut.
nuvvu-naaku-nachav-2001: Venky, an easygoing graduate from a small town, moves to Hyderabad and stays with his father's old friend. He and his host's daughter Nandu bicker constantly, but slowly fall in love, just as her wedding to another man approaches. K. Vijaya Bhaskar's romantic comedy, written by Trivikram Srinivas, stars Venkatesh and Aarthi Agarwal in her debut.
orange-2010: Ram, a graffiti artist in Sydney who has fallen in and out of love nine times, believes love never lasts. When he falls for Jaanu, he promises to be completely honest with her, which leads to a hard look at what love really means. Bhaskar's romantic drama stars Ram Charan, Genelia D'Souza and Shazahn Padamsee.
engeyum-kaadhal-2011: In Paris, Kamal is a carefree young executive who swears he will never fall in love. Kayal, a lively young woman living in the city, sets out to win his heart anyway. Prabhu Deva directs Jayam Ravi and Hansika Motwani in this light romantic comedy, with music by Harris Jayaraj.
nuvve-nuvve-2002: Anjali, the daughter of a rich and protective businessman, falls for Rishi, a carefree young man her father considers useless.
srinivasa-kalyanam-2018: Srinivas and Sri plan a traditional wedding to bring their families together, while her businessman father sees marriage as one more contract.
heropanti-2014: Bablu helps a friend elope with a girl from a strict Haryanvi family, and is held captive by her brothers, who don't know he has fallen for her younger sister.
shatamanam-bhavati-2017: Raghavaraju, a village landlord, misses his children, who have settled abroad and rarely visit. His wife's plan to bring them home for Sankranti brings the whole family together, along with old tensions and a young romance. Satish Vegesna's family drama, which won the National Award for Best Popular Film, stars Sharwanand, Anupama Parameswaran, Prakash Raj and Jayasudha.
viruman-2022: Viruman, a fierce young man from a village near Theni, grows up hating his cruel father for driving his mother to her death, and sets out to bring him down.
saguni-2012: Kamal comes to Chennai to save his ancestral home from being demolished for a project, and takes on a corrupt politician with cunning instead of force.
bhaag-milkha-bhaag-2013: The life of the sprinter Milkha Singh: a boy orphaned by Partition who becomes one of India's greatest athletes, and the past that still chases him on the track.
yuvarathnaa-2021: A new lecturer arrives at a government college that is about to be shut down and sold, and rallies the students to save it.
anniyan-2005: Ambi is a mild-mannered, rule-abiding lawyer in Chennai whose efforts to fight everyday corruption keep failing. His repressed rage gives rise to two other personalities: Remo, a flamboyant model who woos the woman he loves, and Anniyan, a vigilante who punishes wrongdoers using methods from the Garuda Purana.
ranna-2015: Bhargav, the grandson of a wealthy businessman in Zurich, comes to India in disguise as a driver to win back his estranged aunt and bring her family home before his grandfather's 80th birthday. Nanda Kishore's Kannada remake of Attarintiki Daredi stars Sudeep, Rachita Ram, Haripriya and Madhoo.
anthapuram-1999: A young wife escapes her husband's feudal family in a lawless corner of Andhra Pradesh to save her son, with only a stranger willing to help.
bhadra-2005: Bhadra goes to his friend's village and finds himself in the middle of a bloody factional feud. When his friend's family is killed, he vows to protect the sister who survived.
richie-2017: Megha, a Chennai journalist, travels to a coastal town to write about the mysterious death of Richie, a local gangster she knew as a child. Through the townsfolk's accounts, she pieces together several overlapping stories of crime and loyalty. Gautham Ramachandran's remake of Ulidavaru Kandanthe stars Nivin Pauly, Natty and Shraddha Srinath.
bimbisara-2022: Bimbisara, a tyrant king of an ancient kingdom, is thrown through a time portal into the present day, where he has to protect his descendants and confront the man he used to be.
goodachari-2018: Gopi, who grew up wanting to be a spy like his father, joins a secret Indian agency, and is framed for a series of killings almost as soon as he starts.
oggarane-2014: Kalidasa, a middle-aged archaeologist, and Gowri, a dubbing artist, are both single and set in their ways. A wrong phone call about a recipe sparks a long-distance friendship over food, but both are afraid to meet in person. Prakash Raj directs and stars with Sneha in this Kannada remake of Salt N' Pepper.
ulavacharu-biriyani-2014: Kalidas, a 45-year-old archaeologist who loves food, and Gowri, a dubbing artist, get connected by a wrong phone call about a recipe. Their conversations about cooking grow into a warm friendship, but both are afraid to meet in person. Prakash Raj's Telugu remake of Salt N' Pepper stars Prakash Raj and Sneha.
raajakumara-2017: Siddharth, the adopted son of a kind tycoon in Melbourne, loses his family in a plane crash. Returning to the Bangalore orphanage where he was raised, he finds it turned into an old-age home under threat, and fights for the elderly residents and their dignity. Santhosh Ananddram's family drama stars Puneeth Rajkumar and Priya Anand.
bunny-2005: Bunny, a college student, falls for the daughter of a powerful businessman, but his real reason for getting close to the family is a debt he wants repaid.
chirutha-2007: Young Charan takes the blame for a crime he did not commit to pay for his mother's surgery and spends twelve years in prison. Released, he sets out to rebuild his life, falls for the spoilt daughter of a rich man, and finally confronts the gangsters who wrecked his family. Puri Jagannadh's action comedy marked Ram Charan's debut, with Neha Sharma.
gangotri-2003: Gangotri, the long-awaited daughter of a powerful factionist, is believed to carry a curse linked to water, so she is taken to the Himalayan shrine of Gangotri for years of rituals. She grows up close to the son of her father's loyal servant, and their bond turns to love her father opposes. K. Raghavendra Rao's 100th film introduced Allu Arjun, opposite Aditi Agarwal.
gouravam-2013: Arjun, a rich young man, stops at the village of his college friend Shanmugam and learns that Shanmugam has been missing for six months after eloping with the daughter of a powerful landlord obsessed with family honour. Determined to find him, Arjun takes on the village's code of honour. Radha Mohan's social thriller marks Allu Sirish's debut, with Prakash Raj.
srirastu-subhamastu-2016: Sirish, the son of a rich businessman, falls for Ananya, a middle-class girl. To prove love is not about money, he hides his wealth and tries to win her as an ordinary man, but her father has his own ideas. Parasuram's romantic comedy stars Allu Sirish, Lavanya Tripathi and Prakash Raj.
bagheera-2024: An idealistic police officer who grew up dreaming of superheroes takes on a secret masked identity to fight crime the law can't touch.
clap-2022: A sprinter who lost a leg in an accident finds new purpose coaching a gifted village girl and fighting the politics that keep her off the track.
mayabazar-2016-2020: On the night of the 2016 demonetisation announcement, a small-time thief, a desperate cop and a man in debt are drawn into the same plan to make a fortune from old notes.
dil-2003: Seenu, a middle-class college student, falls in love with Nandini, the only daughter of a powerful land mafia don. When her father threatens his family, Seenu refuses to back down and openly challenges the don, vowing to marry Nandini whatever it takes.
pandipada-2005: Bhuvanachandran, a good-natured young man drowning in debt, travels to a Tamil Nadu village to claim land he has inherited. There he stumbles into a feud between two rival strongmen and a romance with a local woman, along with plenty of comic trouble. Rafi Mecartin's comedy stars Dileep, Navya Nair and Prakash Raj.
jagadam-2007: Seenu has admired violence since childhood and wants to grow up to be a feared goon like local don Manikyam. He joins Manikyam's gang and starts rising fast, until his ambition puts him on a collision course with his boss. Sukumar's action film stars Ram Pothineni, Isha Sahani and Prakash Raj.
60-vayadu-maaniram-2018: Govindarajan, a 60-year-old man with Alzheimer's, goes missing. His son Shiva, who had little time for him, searches for him with Archana, a doctor, while the old man crosses paths with Ranga, a criminal on the run, and the two form an unlikely bond.
sometimes-2018: Seven strangers wait together at a clinic for their HIV test results. As the hours pass, each one reluctantly shares the story of how they came to fear the worst. Priyadarshan's psychological drama, made in Tamil, stars Prakash Raj, Sriya Reddy and Ashok Selvan, with music by Ilaiyaraaja.
shekar-2022: A retired police investigator with an unmatched eye for detail is drawn back into a case when a death strikes close to him.
azhagiya-theeye-2004: A struggling young filmmaker agrees to pose as a woman's lover to break off her arranged marriage, and the pretence gets complicated.
athanokkade-2005: Anjali, a young woman out to avenge her family's murder, kills a retired police chief with her uncle's help. At the same time Ram, a young man from Delhi, enrols at a Hyderabad college and begins taking on a local gangster, and the hidden link between Ram and Anjali's mission emerges.
ponnar-shankar-2011: Ponnar and Shankar, twin brothers born to a royal family in old Tamil Nadu, are raised away from home to protect them. They grow up to become warriors who must reclaim their family's lands and honour from rival kings. Thiagarajan's historical action film, based on M. Karunanidhi's novel, stars Prashanth in a dual role, with Prakash Raj.
kotha-bangaru-lokam-2008: A teenage boy and girl fall in love in their last year of school, and their families and future plans pull them apart.
kanchivaram-2008: In 1948, Vengadam, a silk weaver in Kanchipuram, is taken home from prison on a two-day parole. On the bus journey, he recalls his life: his promise to dress his daughter in a silk sari, and his work organising weavers against their exploitation. Priyadarshan's period drama won Prakash Raj the National Award for Best Actor, with Shriya Reddy.
nagamandala-1997: Based on Girish Karnad's play: a young bride neglected by her husband is visited at night by a cobra that takes her husband's form, and their secret love changes her life.
aval-appadithan-1978: A documentary filmmaker meets a fiercely independent woman whose past has made her distrust men, and tries to understand her.
khakee-2004: A police team is ordered to escort a suspected terrorist from a small town to Mumbai, and the journey turns into a deadly fight against the men trying to stop them.
waqt-the-race-against-time-200: Ishwar, a successful toy maker, has spoiled his son Aditya, who dreams only of becoming a film star. When Ishwar learns he has little time left, he decides to throw Aditya out and toughen him up so he can stand on his own. Vipul Amrutlal Shah's family drama stars Amitabh Bachchan, Akshay Kumar, Priyanka Chopra and Shefali Shah.
god-tussi-great-ho-2008: Arun, a struggling TV anchor who blames God for all his bad luck, gets the chance to swap places with him for ten days. Granted divine powers, he sets out to fix his life and win over his colleague Alia, with messy results. Rumi Jaffery's fantasy comedy, inspired by Bruce Almighty, stars Salman Khan, Priyanka Chopra and Amitabh Bachchan.
vettaiyan-2024: SP Athiyan, a celebrated encounter specialist, kills a suspect in a teacher's murder, then discovers the man may have been innocent and goes after the real culprits.
thappu-thalangal-1978: In Tamil. A thug and a woman forced into sex work fall in love and try to leave their lives behind.
thappida-thala-1978: In Kannada. A thug and a woman forced into sex work fall in love and try to leave their lives behind.
avargal-1977: A woman escapes an abusive marriage and starts again in Chennai, but her cruel ex-husband comes back into her life.
apoorva-raagangal-1975: A young man falls for an older woman while her daughter falls for his father, and the tangled relationships test both families.
unnaipol-oruvan-2009: A common man plants bombs across Chennai and calls the police commissioner, demanding the release of four terrorists. As the deadline approaches, the city's police race to track him down. Chakri Toleti's thriller, a remake of A Wednesday made alongside the Telugu Eenadu, stars Kamal Haasan and Mohanlal.
kandahar-2010: Suryanath, an unemployed young man, is inspired by Major Mahadevan to join the army and becomes a commando. When a flight is hijacked and taken to Kandahar, Mahadevan's team is called in, and the crisis puts Suryanath and his family to the test. Major Ravi's war film stars Mohanlal, with Amitabh Bachchan in a special role and Ganesh Venkatraman.
baabul-2006: A father-in-law encourages his widowed daughter-in-law to remarry, defying a family and society that want her to stay in mourning.
family-ties-of-blood-2006: Viren, a Bangkok-based crime lord, comes to India to avenge an attack on his brother. Along the way, he crosses Shekhar, a kind canteen owner, and their clash spirals into a bitter feud between the two families. Rajkumar Santoshi's action thriller stars Amitabh Bachchan, Akshay Kumar and Bhumika Chawla.

raksha-bandhan-2022: A man who runs a sweet shop in Delhi promised his late mother he would marry off his four sisters before marrying himself.
kaathuvaakula-rendu-kaadhal-20: A man who believes he brings bad luck finds himself in love with two women at once.
drishyam-2-2022: Seven years later, the police reopen the case of the missing young man, and Vijay Salgaonkar has to protect his family again.
rocketry-the-nambi-effect-2022: The life of ISRO scientist Nambi Narayanan, who was falsely accused of espionage and fought for years to clear his name.
the-ghost-2022: An Interpol officer comes out of retirement to protect his sister's family from a powerful gang.
laal-singh-chaddha-2022: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ recounts how he stumbled through decades of Indian history while loving the same woman.
gangubai-kathiawadi-2022: The rise of Gangubai, sold into a brothel in Mumbai as a teenager, who becomes a powerful figure in Kamathipura.
shamshera-2022: In the 1870s, a warrior tribe is enslaved by a brutal British officer, and its leader's son rises to free them.
thank-god-2022: A man who dies in an accident wakes up in the afterlife and has to play a game of life to return to earth.
ghani-2022: Ghani is a young boxer determined to prove himself in the ring after his father's career was destroyed by a scandal. Varun Tej plays the title role in Kiran Korrapati's Telugu sports drama, with Upendra, Suniel Shetty, Jagapathi Babu and Saiee Manjrekar.
connect-2022: During the COVID-19 lockdown, a mother tries to save her daughter, who seems to be possessed.
godfather-2022: After a powerful political leader dies, his loyal adoptive son fights to protect the party and his family from the leader's ambitious son-in-law.
salaam-venky-2022: A mother fights for her terminally ill son's wish to donate his organs.
o2-2022: A mother and her son, who needs an oxygen supply to survive, are trapped in a bus buried by a landslide.
ponniyin-selvan-i-2022: In the 10th century, as the Chola emperor falls ill, his sons and a scheming queen are drawn into a plot to seize the throne.
thiruchitrambalam-2022: A food delivery boy who has a strained relationship with his father finds comfort in his best friend while he searches for love.
dasvi-2022: A corrupt and uneducated chief minister, sent to jail, decides to sit for his Class 10 exams.
yashoda-2022: A poor young woman agrees to be a surrogate mother at a luxury facility and uncovers a dangerous secret.
maaran-2022: An investigative journalist follows in his father's footsteps, exposing corruption at great personal cost.
chup-revenge-of-the-artist-202: Mumbai is shaken by a serial killer who targets film critics who give bad reviews.
naane-varuvean-2022: A man's daughter is possessed by a spirit linked to his estranged twin brother.
vaashi-2022: Two young lawyers, lovers and rivals, are on opposite sides of the same case.
gehraiyaan-2022: A yoga instructor falls in love with her cousin's fiancé, and the affair pulls them into a dark spiral.
sarkaru-vaari-paata-2022: A moneylender in the US comes to India to recover a debt from a powerful businessman.
attack-part-1-2022: A soldier paralysed in a terror attack is given a microchip that turns him into a super soldier.
thallumaala-2022: A young man known for picking fights has a series of brawls that become social media legend.
doctor-g-2022: A male medical student who wanted to be an orthopaedic surgeon ends up as the only man in a gynaecology course.
etharkkum-thunindhavan-2022: A lawyer in a village fights against a powerful man who preys on women.
jana-gana-mana-2022: The murder of a college professor sparks a student protest, and the police officer who investigates is drawn into a political storm.
cirkus-2022: Two sets of twins separated at birth grow up in different cities, and their lives collide.
darlings-2022: A woman trapped in an abusive marriage decides to take revenge on her husband with her mother's help.
an-action-hero-2022: A Bollywood action star accidentally kills a man and flees to London, pursued by the dead man's brother.
anek-2022: An undercover agent is sent to India's Northeast to broker peace, and is torn between his mission and the people he meets.
sherdil-the-pilibhit-saga-2022: A village head decides to sacrifice himself to a tiger so that his village can get government compensation.
pada-2022: Four men take a district collector hostage in his office to protest a law that harms tribal communities.
major-2022: The life of Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan, who died fighting terrorists during the 2008 Mumbai attacks.
marakkar-lion-of-the-arabian-s: Kunjali Marakkar IV, a 16th-century naval chieftain, fights against the Portuguese colonisers.
drishyam-2-2021: Six years later, the police reopen the case of the missing young man, and Georgekutty has to protect his family again.
atrangi-re-2021: A young woman who is forcibly married to a Tamil doctor is still in love with a magician who keeps disappearing.
bhuj-the-pride-of-india-2021: During the 1971 war, an Indian Air Force officer rebuilds a destroyed airstrip in Bhuj with the help of local women.
sooryavanshi-2021: An ATS chief races to stop a terror attack in Mumbai by a sleeper cell of Lashkar operatives.
bell-bottom-2021: A RAW agent leads a secret mission to rescue passengers from a hijacked plane in 1984.
radhe-2021: An undercover cop is brought in to rid Mumbai of a drug lord.
antim-the-final-truth-2021: A Sikh police officer and a young man who has become a gangster are on a collision course in Pune.
wild-dog-2021: An NIA agent leads a team to capture a terrorist responsible for bomb blasts in Pune.
maestro-2021: A pianist who pretends to be blind witnesses a murder, and is drawn into a deadly web.
the-white-tiger-2021: Balram, a poor villager who becomes a chauffeur for a rich family, plots his way out of servitude.
nizhal-2021: A magistrate becomes obsessed with a story a young boy tells about a murder.
netrikann-2021: A visually impaired former CBI officer helps catch a serial killer who targets women.
the-big-bull-2021: A stockbroker from a Mumbai chawl rises to become a market legend through a massive securities scam in the 1990s.
jagame-thandhiram-2021: A gangster from Madurai is hired by a London crime boss to take down a rival, and finds himself on the wrong side of the war.
karnan-2021: In 1990s Tamil Nadu, a young man from an oppressed community rises against the police and a dominant caste.
83-2021: The story of India's first Cricket World Cup win in 1983, led by captain Kapil Dev.
bob-biswas-2021: A contract killer who wakes from a coma with no memory tries to rebuild his life, and is drawn back into killing.
jai-bhim-2021: A lawyer fights for a tribal woman whose husband went missing after being taken into police custody.
minnal-murali-2021: A tailor in a small village is struck by lightning and gains superpowers, as does another man who becomes his rival.
kala-2021: A man and his wife are drawn into a brutal fight with a stranger on their estate.
sulthan-2021: A man raised by a gangster's crew tries to reform them after his father dies.
chandigarh-kare-aashiqui-2021: A gym owner falls in love with a Zumba instructor, and learns she is a trans woman.
pogaru-2021: A boy who grows up with a violent streak becomes a feared rowdy, and falls in love with a teacher.
mimi-2021: A young woman agrees to be a surrogate mother for a foreign couple, who back out midway through the pregnancy.
the-great-indian-kitchen-2021: A newly married woman's life is consumed by household chores and patriarchal rules in her husband's home.
enemy-2021: Two childhood friends trained by the same father turn into enemies.
kaagaz-2021: A man who has been declared dead in government records spends years fighting to prove he is alive.
vakeel-saab-2021: A lawyer who has stopped practising takes up the case of three young women accused of attempted murder.
laxmii-2020: A man who doesn't believe in ghosts is possessed by the spirit of a transgender woman.
tanhaji-2020: Tanaji Malusare, a Maratha commander, leads an attack on the Kondhana fort to win it back from the Mughals.
sadak-2-2020: A young woman fighting a fake godman hires a suicidal taxi driver to take her to Kailash.
mookuthi-amman-2020: A goddess appears to a struggling reporter and helps him expose a fraudulent godman.
ludo-2020: Four stories linked by chance, coincidence and a gangster, in which characters' fates are decided like a game of ludo.
sarileru-neekevvaru-2020: An army major travels to Kurnool to deliver news to his fallen comrade's family, and takes on a corrupt minister.
pattas-2020: A petty thief learns that his father was a martial arts master killed by a rival, and sets out for revenge.
soorarai-pottru-2020: Nedumaaran, a former air force officer from a village, sets out to start a low-cost airline for ordinary people.
jaanu-2020: Two former classmates who were in love in school meet at a reunion after many years.
forensic-2020: A forensic expert and a police officer investigate a series of murders of young girls in Thiruvananthapuram.
chhapaak-2020: A young woman survives an acid attack and fights for justice and a ban on the sale of acid.
kilometers-and-kilometers-2020: A young man from Kerala takes an American tourist on a road trip across India.
bheeshma-2020: A young man who is still single is made the CEO of an organic farming company.
shubh-mangal-zyada-saavdhan-20: A young gay man and his partner try to win over the partner's conservative family.
gunjan-saxena-the-kargil-girl: The story of Gunjan Saxena, one of the first women to fly in combat for the Indian Air Force, during the Kargil war.
petta-2019: Kaali, an older man with a mysterious past, takes a job as a hostel warden at a college in Ooty and quickly sorts out its bullies. But his arrival has a purpose, and an old feud from his days in Madurai soon catches up with him. Karthik Subbaraj's action drama stars Rajinikanth, Vijay Sethupathi, Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Simran and Trisha.
bharat-2019: On his 70th birthday, Delhi shopkeeper Bharat looks back on a life shaped by a promise. Separated from his father and sister during Partition as a boy, he took charge of his family and spent decades working in a circus, in the Gulf and at sea, always hoping to reunite with them.
housefull-4-2019: Three brothers in London plan to marry three wealthy sisters to settle a debt with gangsters, but they fall for the wrong ones. When the wedding moves to the town of Sitamgarh, they discover that all six of them were reincarnated from a tangled royal love story set 600 years earlier.
good-newwz-2019: Varun and Deepti, a Mumbai couple, are trying to have a baby through IVF. Their plans are thrown into chaos when the clinic reveals a mix-up with another couple who share their surname, the loud and lovable Honey and Monika from Punjab.
mission-mangal-2019: After a failed rocket launch, ISRO scientists Rakesh Dhawan and Tara Shinde are moved to the Mars Orbiter Mission, a project most of their colleagues consider impossible on its tiny budget. With a team of overlooked scientists, they set out to send India's first spacecraft to Mars.
dabangg-3-2019: Chulbul Pandey, the brash but beloved police officer, faces a ruthless criminal named Bali while trying to stop a human trafficking racket. The confrontation forces him to revisit his past, including the young love he lost and the event that first made him a cop.
kesari-2019: In 1897, Havildar Ishar Singh is posted to Saragarhi, a small signalling outpost on the frontier with Afghanistan. When thousands of tribesmen attack, Ishar Singh and his 20 Sikh soldiers of the 36th Sikhs decide to hold their ground and fight to the last man.
notebook-2019: A teacher at a school in Kashmir finds the notebook of the previous teacher and falls in love with her.
total-dhamaal-2019: A group of people race to find a hidden stash of money in a zoo.
de-de-pyaar-de-2019: Ashish, a 50-year-old businessman in London, falls in love with Ayesha, who is half his age. When he takes her home to Manali to meet the wife he separated from years ago and his grown-up children, the visit quickly turns into a comedy of awkward lies and old feelings.
f2-fun-and-frustration-2019: Two brothers-in-law, frustrated with their wives, go to Europe to take a break.
bigil-2019: Michael is a gangster from a Chennai slum who once dreamt of playing football. When his friend, the coach of the Tamil Nadu women's team, is badly injured, Michael reluctantly takes over the squad, facing hostile players, old enemies and his own past as he prepares them for the national championship.
panipat-2019: The Maratha army fights against the forces of Ahmad Shah Abdali at the Third Battle of Panipat in 1761.
the-sky-is-pink-2019: The story of a couple whose daughter was born with a severe immune deficiency.
viswasam-2019: Thookudurai, a respected village chieftain in Theni, travels to Mumbai to see the wife and daughter he has not met in ten years. When he finds his daughter in danger from a ruthless killer, he becomes her secret protector. Siva's action drama stars Ajith Kumar, Nayanthara, Jagapathi Babu and Anikha Surendran.
mr-local-2019: A young man falls in love with a businesswoman who is his boss.
majili-2019: A failed cricketer who has become an alcoholic after losing his girlfriend marries a woman who has loved him for years.
enai-noki-paayum-thota-2019: A young man and an actress fall in love, but she disappears.
virus-2019: The story of Kerala's fight against the Nipah virus outbreak in 2018.
uyare-2019: Pallavi has dreamed of becoming a pilot since childhood. Just as she starts her training, her possessive boyfriend attacks her with acid, leaving her disfigured. Refusing to give up, she fights her way back into the skies. Manu Ashokan's drama stars Parvathy Thiruvothu, Asif Ali and Tovino Thomas.
maharshi-2019: Rishi, the newly appointed CEO of a powerful American company, looks back on his college days in Visakhapatnam and the friend who changed his life. Learning that this friend is now fighting a corporate giant to save his village, Rishi returns to India to stand with him and the farmers.
super-30-2019: Anand Kumar, a mathematics teacher, trains 30 underprivileged students for the IIT entrance exam.
kalank-2019: In pre-independence Punjab, a dying woman persuades Roop to marry her husband Dev, a newspaper editor, so that he will not be alone. Trapped in a loveless marriage, Roop takes up music lessons in the town's old quarter and falls for Zafar, a charming blacksmith with a hidden grudge against Dev's family.
and-the-oscar-goes-to-2019: Issak Ebraham is a young man determined to become a film director. He mortgages his land to make a film about a man from his home town, struggles through a shoestring production, and then sets his sights on taking his debut all the way to the Academy Awards.
luca-2019: Luca is a talented but volatile scrap artist in Kochi who clashes with Niharika over remarks about his work at the Kochi Biennale. She later moves into his home as a paying guest and they fall deeply in love. When an unexpected event occurs, a police officer pieces together their story from a diary.
bala-2019: A young man who is losing his hair struggles with his self-esteem.
dear-comrade-2019: Bobby is a fiery student union leader with an uncontrollable temper who falls in love with Lilly, a state-level cricketer. Their relationship is tested by his violent streak, and years later he must find a way to stand by her when she faces a battle of her own.
driving-licence-2019: A superstar actor needs a driving licence for his next film, and clashes with a vehicle inspector who is his biggest fan.
article-15-2019: Ayan Ranjan, an idealistic young police officer, is posted to a village in Uttar Pradesh. When three Dalit girls go missing and two are found dead, his investigation runs into entrenched caste prejudice, a reluctant police force and powerful people determined to bury the truth.
dream-girl-2019: A young man who can mimic a woman's voice gets a job at a call centre and becomes a sensation.
finals-2019: Alice, a national cycling champion from Kerala, trains for the Olympics with her strict but loving father, Varghese, and her childhood friend Manuel. Her path to the top is tested by setbacks and by the system around Indian sport. Arun P. R.'s sports drama, inspired by real-life athletes, stars Rajisha Vijayan, Suraj Venjaramoodu and Niranj Maniyanpilla Raju.
android-kunjappan-version-5-25: A man leaves his elderly father with a robot when he takes a job abroad.
vikrithi-2019: A man with a disability is mistaken for a drunk and humiliated on social media.
kaala-2018: Karikaalan, known as Kaala, is the respected patriarch of the Tamil community in Mumbai's Dharavi. When Hari Dada, a powerful politician, launches a redevelopment plan to clear the slum, Kaala leads his people in a fight to keep their land. Pa. Ranjith's political drama stars Rajinikanth, Nana Patekar, Huma Qureshi and Eswari Rao.
kayamkulam-kochunni-2018: In 19th-century Travancore, Kochunni, a poor young man, learns the ways of the martial arts and, after being wronged by the powerful, becomes an outlaw who robs the rich to help the poor. Rosshan Andrrews's period action film, based on the legendary bandit, stars Nivin Pauly, with Mohanlal as Ithikkara Pakki and Priya Anand.
race-3-2018: A family of arms dealers fight among themselves for control of the business.
pad-man-2018: A man in a village sets out to make low-cost sanitary pads for women.
devadas-2018: A gangster befriends a doctor, and the two become close friends.
gold-2018: Tapan Das, a hockey team manager, works to build India's first hockey team after independence to win the Olympic gold in 1948.
zero-2018: A man of short stature falls in love with a scientist who has cerebral palsy.
raid-2018: An income tax officer leads a raid on a powerful politician's home in Lucknow.
kolamaavu-kokila-2018: Kokila, a quiet young woman from a middle-class family, learns her mother needs expensive treatment. With nowhere else to turn, she takes a job smuggling drugs, and proves surprisingly good at it, drawing in her whole family. Nelson Dilipkumar's dark comedy stars Nayanthara and Yogi Babu.
imaikkaa-nodigal-2018: A CBI officer chases a serial killer who targets the children of the wealthy.
thaanaa-serndha-koottam-2018: In 1980s Tamil Nadu, Iniyan, a young man denied a job because he cannot pay bribes, gathers a small team and poses as CBI officers. Their fake raids target corrupt businessmen and politicians, but a real investigator is soon on their trail. Vignesh Shivan's crime comedy, a remake of Special 26, stars Suriya, Keerthy Suresh and Ramya Krishnan.
mahanati-2018: Told through a young journalist piecing together her story, this biopic traces the life of actress Savitri, from her childhood and rise as one of the biggest stars of Telugu and Tamil cinema to her marriage with Gemini Ganesan and her later struggles.
irumbu-thirai-2018: An army officer takes on a hacker who is stealing people's bank data.
u-turn-2018: Rachana, a young journalist, investigates a series of accidents on a flyover where motorists illegally move concrete blocks to take a U-turn. When one of the people she tracks down is found dead, she becomes the prime suspect and is drawn into a supernatural mystery. Pawan Kumar's thriller, made in Tamil and Telugu, stars Samantha, Aadhi Pinisetty and Bhumika Chawla.
manmarziyaan-2018: In Amritsar, the fiery Rumi is in love with Vicky, a part-time DJ who keeps getting cold feet about marriage. Fed up, she agrees to an arranged match with Robbie, a calm, steady banker, but her feelings for Vicky do not go away.
padmaavat-2018: In 13th-century India, Rani Padmavati, wife of the Rajput ruler Ratan Singh of Mewar, is famed for her beauty and courage. The ambitious Sultan Alauddin Khilji becomes obsessed with her and lays siege to Chittor, setting the kingdom on a path to a desperate last stand.
rangasthalam-2018: In 1980s rural Andhra Pradesh, Chittibabu, a partially deaf villager, works irrigating fields. When his elder brother Kumar decides to challenge the village's tyrannical president in an election, the family is drawn into a deadly fight against feudal power. Sukumar's period drama stars Ram Charan, Samantha, Aadhi Pinisetty and Jagapathi Babu.
sanju-2018: A biopic of the actor Sanjay Dutt, from his drug addiction to his arrest in connection with the 1993 Mumbai blasts.
theevandi-2018: A young man who is a chain smoker tries to quit.
geetha-govindam-2018: A young lecturer tries to win back the trust of a woman who misunderstood him.
