chalo-2018: A young man who loves to fight moves to a village on the border of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.
stree-2018: In the small town of Chanderi, people believe a female spirit called Stree abducts men at night during an annual festival, leaving only their clothes behind. Vicky, a gifted local tailor, falls for a mysterious woman who appears only at festival time, and when his friend vanishes he sets out to uncover the truth about the legend.
badhaai-ho-2018: A young man is embarrassed when his middle-aged mother becomes pregnant.
chekka-chivantha-vaanam-2018: When Chennai crime boss Senapathi survives an assassination attempt, his three sons rush home from Chennai, Dubai and Serbia, each eyeing the empire. As they hunt for whoever ordered the hit, suspicion and ambition turn the brothers against one another. Mani Ratnam's crime drama stars Arvind Swamy, Silambarasan, Arun Vijay and Vijay Sethupathi.
tubelight-2017: Tubelight is a 2017 Hindi war drama written and directed by Kabir Khan, set during the 1962 Sino-Indian War and starring Salman Khan and Sohail Khan. Laxman, a simple-hearted man from a small Kumaon town teased as Tubelight, has always leaned on his younger brother Bharat, and when Bharat goes off to war, Laxman holds fast to the belief that he will return.
villain-2017: Villain is a 2017 Malayalam neo-noir psychological thriller written and directed by B. Unnikrishnan, starring Mohanlal with Vishal, Srikanth and Manju Warrier. On what should be his last day at work, Mathew Manjooran, a senior police officer quietly carrying a personal loss, reluctantly agrees to investigate a series of unusual murders of three men.
tiger-zinda-hai-2017: Five years after going into hiding, former Indian agent Tiger and his wife Zoya, an ex-Pakistani agent, are drawn back into action. A terrorist group in Iraq is holding Indian and Pakistani nurses hostage in a hospital, and Tiger has just seven days to rescue them before an airstrike.
jolly-llb-2-2017: Jolly Mishra, a street-smart lawyer in Lucknow stuck working as an assistant to a famous advocate, dreams of a chamber of his own. A desperate shortcut to raise money goes terribly wrong, and to make amends he takes on a case against a powerful police officer over a fake encounter. Akshay Kumar, Huma Qureshi and Annu Kapoor star.
toilet-ek-prem-katha-2017: A man in a village fights to build a toilet in his house after his wife leaves him.
jai-lava-kusa-2017: Identical triplets Jai, Lava and Kusa are separated as children after Jai, who stammers and is shunned, sets fire to a stage during his brothers' performance. Twenty years later Lava is a timid bank manager, Kusa is a petty thief, and Jai has become a feared gangster with plans for both of them.
golmaal-again-2017: Gopal, Madhav, Lucky and the two Laxmans grew up together in an orphanage in Ooty. Years later, the old rivals return to the town for their guardian's funeral and end up staying at a bungalow that turns out to be haunted by a ghost with unfinished business.
raees-2017: In Gujarat, Raees, who learnt the illegal liquor trade as a boy, builds a bootlegging empire and becomes a hero to the poor in his neighbourhood. An honest, determined police officer makes it his mission to bring him down, and their cat-and-mouse game escalates.
jab-harry-met-sejal-2017: Harry, a charming but lonely tour guide in Europe who left Punjab long ago, is persuaded by Sejal, a tourist from Gujarat, to help her search for her lost engagement ring across the continent. As they retrace her trip, an unlikely bond grows. Shah Rukh Khan and Anushka Sharma star in this Hindi romantic comedy by Imtiaz Ali.
baadshaho-2017: During the Emergency in 1975, the government seizes the hidden gold of a Rajasthani princess and sends it to Delhi in an armoured truck. Her loyal bodyguard assembles a crew of misfits to rob the convoy as it crosses the desert, while an army officer is determined to see the treasure delivered.
velaikkaran-2017: Arivu, a young man from a Chennai slum, runs a community radio station and wants to free his neighbourhood from a local gangster. When he takes a sales job at a big food company, he discovers the firm's harmful practices and leads the workers in a fight against them. Mohan Raja's action drama stars Sivakarthikeyan, Fahadh Faasil and Nayanthara.
mom-2017: Devki, a warm and popular biology teacher, struggles to win over her stepdaughter Arya, who still misses her own mother. When Arya is brutally attacked after a party and the men responsible walk free, Devki sets out to get justice herself. Sridevi stars, with Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Akshaye Khanna, in this Hindi thriller directed by Ravi Udyawar.
bhoomi-2017: Bhoomi, a designer in Agra, shares a loving bond with her father Arun, a shoemaker, and is about to marry her best friend. When a man obsessed with her and his friends carry out a brutal attack on her, her father sets out to seek justice himself. Sanjay Dutt and Aditi Rao Hydari star in this Hindi revenge drama by Omung Kumar.
aramm-2017: District collector Madhivadhani explains to her superior why she defied orders during a crisis in a parched village near Chennai. When a four-year-old girl falls into an abandoned borewell, Madhivadhani leads a desperate rescue effort while exposing the official apathy that left the villagers without water.
secret-superstar-2017: A teenage girl who dreams of becoming a singer posts her songs on YouTube wearing a burqa to hide her identity.
spyder-2017: Shiva, an intelligence officer, has built software to monitor phone calls so he can help people before trouble strikes. When a distress call leads him to a gruesome murder, he finds himself pitted against a psychopath who takes pleasure in causing mass death.
godha-2017: In a Kerala village, wrestling is fading as the young turn to cricket. Aanjaneya Das, a reluctant youth, meets Aditi, a Punjab wrestling champion who has escaped a restrictive home, and she becomes the spark that brings the old sport back to life. Basil Joseph's sports comedy stars Tovino Thomas, Wamiqa Gabbi and Renji Panicker.
ittefaq-2017: On the night of his book launch in Mumbai, writer Vikram Sethi finds his wife dead in their hotel room and runs. Hiding in an apartment, he meets Maya, a young woman whose husband is soon found dead too. With two suspects and two different stories, a police officer must find the truth. Sidharth Malhotra, Sonakshi Sinha and Akshaye Khanna star.
kaabil-2017: Rohan, a kind young voice artist who has been blind since birth, meets and marries Supriya, who is also blind and proudly independent. When a local politician's brother and his friends target Supriya and the system fails them, Rohan sets out to take matters into his own hands. Hrithik Roshan and Yami Gautam star in this Hindi revenge thriller.
jagga-jasoos-2017: Jagga, a shy boy with a stammer who speaks in songs, grows up into a curious teenage detective. When his adoptive father mysteriously disappears, Jagga sets out to find him, and his search draws him into a real-life arms drop case. Ranbir Kapoor and Katrina Kaif star in this Hindi musical adventure written and directed by Anurag Basu.
bareilly-ki-barfi-2017: A young woman falls in love with the author of a book, unaware that it was written by someone else.
mayaanadhi-2017: Maathan, a small-time crook on the run from the police after a deal goes wrong, tries to win back Aparna, his former girlfriend, who is now an aspiring actress. As he hides in Kochi, their old love flickers back to life. Aashiq Abu's romantic thriller stars Tovino Thomas and Aishwarya Lekshmi.
badrinath-ki-dulhania-2017: Badri is the youngest son of a wealthy, old-fashioned family in Jhansi, where his father controls every decision. At a wedding he falls for Vaidehi, an educated, independent woman with ambitions of her own, who has no intention of becoming a dutiful wife in a household like his.
judwaa-2-2017: Twin brothers are separated at birth when a criminal kidnaps one of them. Years later, Prem lives a polished life in London while Raja grows up as a street-smart rogue in Mumbai, and because their reflexes are linked, their meeting causes chaos. Varun Dhawan, Jacqueline Fernandez and Taapsee Pannu star in David Dhawan's Hindi comedy.
oopiri-2016: Vikramaditya, a wealthy businessman left paralysed after a paragliding accident, hires Seenu, a cheerful ex-convict, as his caregiver. The unlikely pair form a deep friendship that brings joy back into both their lives. Vamshi Paidipally's remake of The Intouchables, made in Telugu and Tamil, stars Nagarjuna, Karthi and Tamannaah.
thozha-2016: Vikramaditya, a wealthy man left paralysed from the neck down after an accident, hires Seenu, a cheerful, broke ex-convict, as his caregiver. The unlikely pair form a deep friendship that changes both their lives. The Tamil version of Vamshi Paidipally's remake of The Intouchables stars Nagarjuna, Karthi and Tamannaah.
housefull-3-2016: Batuk Patel, a rich businessman in London, believes his three daughters are cursed and refuses to let them marry. The sisters secretly have three boyfriends who are only after their money, and to win his approval the boys pretend to be disabled, triggering a series of comic mix-ups.
pulimurugan-2016: Murugan, a truck driver in a forest village, is famous for hunting the man-eating tigers that prey on his people. When he gets mixed up in the schemes of a businessman with dark dealings, he must fight a different kind of predator. Vysakh's action thriller stars Mohanlal, Kamalinee Mukherjee and Jagapathi Babu.
kabali-2016: Kabali, a Malaysian Tamil gang leader, is released after 25 years in prison on a false charge. He sets out to take down Gang 43, the rival drug syndicate that framed him, while also searching for answers about the wife he lost. Pa. Ranjith's action drama stars Rajinikanth, Radhika Apte, Winston Chao and Dhansika.
oppam-2016: Jayaraman, a blind lift operator in Kochi with sharpened senses and martial-arts skills, is devoted to a retired judge living in his building. When the judge is murdered and Jayaraman becomes a suspect, he sets out to track down the killer himself. Priyadarshan's thriller stars Mohanlal and Samuthirakani.
rustom-2016: In 1959 Bombay, naval commander Rustom Pavri returns home early from duty and discovers that his wife has been having an affair with his friend. He shoots the man dead and then surrenders to the police, and the trial that follows grips the entire country.
soggade-chinni-nayana-2016: Ramu, a workaholic cardiologist in America, and his wife Seetha return to his mother's village intending to divorce. To save their marriage, the soul of Ramu's late father Bangarraju, a charming and flirtatious landlord, is sent back to earth, where he can be seen only by his widow.
airlift-2016: In 1990, Ranjit Katyal is a wealthy Indian businessman in Kuwait who considers himself more Kuwaiti than Indian. When Iraq invades and the country falls overnight, he finds himself responsible for thousands of stranded Indians and sets out to organise one of the largest civilian evacuations in history.
dear-zindagi-2016: Kaira is a talented but restless young cinematographer in Mumbai whose career and relationships keep falling apart. Forced to move back in with her parents in Goa and unable to sleep, she begins seeing an unconventional therapist who helps her face the issues she has been running from.
brahmotsavam-2016: After his father's death, a young man travels across India in search of his family's roots and the relatives his father lost touch with.
24-2016: In 1990, scientist Sethuraman invents a watch that can travel through time, but his evil twin Athreya kills his wife to steal it. Twenty-six years later, Sethuraman's son Mani, now a watch mechanic, discovers the device, and Athreya, crippled but still alive, comes looking for it. Suriya plays three roles.
iru-mugan-2016: A string of attacks fuelled by a mysterious drug brings retired agent Akilan back into action. The trail leads to Malaysia and to Love, a flamboyant scientist he once failed to catch, and the mission is tied to Akilan's own painful past. Anand Shankar's sci-fi action thriller stars Vikram in a dual role, with Nayanthara and Nithya Menen.
fan-2016: A young Delhi man who looks like a film superstar is obsessed with him, and when the star rejects him, his devotion turns dangerous.
kaashmora-2016: Kaashmora and his family make a living by faking black magic and conning people. When he takes money from a corrupt minister and tries to escape, he is lured to a haunted palace where the spirit of a cruel general from centuries ago is waiting. Gokul's horror fantasy stars Karthi in a dual role, with Nayanthara and Sri Divya.
kodi-2016: Kodi and Anbu are twin brothers: Kodi is a fiery political worker with big ambitions, Anbu a gentle college lecturer. Kodi is in love with Rudhra, a rival party member who is just as ambitious, and their politics and romance collide. R. S. Durai Senthilkumar's political drama stars Dhanush in a dual role, with Trisha and Anupama Parameswaran.
shivaay-2016: Shivaay is a skilled mountaineer in the Himalayas who raises his mute daughter alone. When she learns that her mother is alive in Bulgaria, he takes her there to find her, but the girl is kidnapped by a child-trafficking gang, and Shivaay launches a relentless hunt.
ae-dil-hai-mushkil-2016: In London, aspiring singer Ayan meets the free-spirited Alizeh, and the two become close friends after their relationships fall apart. Ayan falls deeply in love, but Alizeh sees him only as a friend, and his heartbreak leads him into an intense bond with an older poet named Saba.
jai-gangaajal-2016: Abha Mathur, a fearless IPS officer, is posted as SP of Bankipur, where a local MLA and his brother rule through terror and grab land from farmers. As she takes them on, she finds an unlikely ally in a corrupt police officer who has a change of heart. Prakash Jha's sequel stars Priyanka Chopra, with Jha himself and Manav Kaul.
theri-2016: A baker in Kerala who is raising his daughter alone is revealed to be a feared former cop who faked his death.
thodari-2016: Poochi, a pantry worker on the Delhi–Chennai express, falls for Saroja, a make-up artist travelling on the train. When the train loses control and races towards disaster, he must find a way to save her and the passengers. Prabhu Solomon's action romance stars Dhanush and Keerthy Suresh.
dishoom-2016: Two days before an India–Pakistan cricket final in the Middle East, India's star batsman disappears. A tough special task force officer is sent from India and teams up with a bumbling local Indian-origin cop for a 36-hour race against time to find him.
mohenjo-daro-2016: In 2016 BC, Sarman, a young indigo farmer from a small village, travels to the great city of Mohenjo Daro to trade. There he falls for Chaani, the daughter of the city's priest, and clashes with the tyrannical Senate Chief Maham, uncovering a link between the city and his own past.
udta-punjab-2016: Four lives collide in a Punjab ravaged by drugs: a cocaine-addicted pop star whose songs glorify drugs, a police officer who wakes up to the trade after his brother overdoses, a doctor running a rehab centre, and a Bihari migrant worker who stumbles on a packet of heroin.
bangalore-naatkal-2016: Three cousins who grew up together end up in Bangalore at the same time: Kutty, a homesick software engineer; Ajju, a free-spirited bike mechanic; and Ammu, who has been pushed into marrying a workaholic. Their new lives in the city test their bonds. A Tamil remake of Bangalore Days.
baby-2015: After the 26/11 attacks, a secret task force codenamed Baby is set up to hunt down terrorists planning strikes on India. Ajay Singh Rajput, one of its sharpest agents, uncovers a series of planned attacks and races across countries to capture the mastermind before he can strike again.
brothers-2015: Gary Fernandes, a former fighter and recovering alcoholic, is released from prison to find his two sons estranged from him and from each other. When a new mixed martial arts league offers a huge prize, the brothers enter for very different reasons and are set on a collision course in the ring.
gabbar-is-back-2015: Corrupt government officials across Maharashtra are being kidnapped, and one of them is found hanged. A mysterious vigilante calling himself Gabbar claims responsibility, while a sharp police driver becomes convinced he can uncover the man behind the campaign against corruption.
prem-ratan-dhan-payo-2015: A simple theatre actor is asked to pose as his lookalike, a prince who is in hiding after an attack, and reunites the royal family.
singh-is-bliing-2015: A carefree young man from Punjab is sent to Goa, where he is hired to protect a woman from a gangster.
bajirao-mastani-2015: The Maratha general Peshwa Bajirao falls in love with the warrior princess Mastani, and his family and society reject her.
dilwale-2015: Raj runs a car modification garage in Goa and dotes on his younger brother Veer. When Veer falls for Ishita, Raj meets her older sister Meera, and an old wound reopens: fifteen years earlier, Raj and Meera were lovers torn apart by a bitter feud between their families.
masss-2015: Masss, a small-time con man, survives a car accident that kills his friend Jettu, and finds he can now see and talk to ghosts. He starts using the spirits to pull off scams, until one ghost with a familiar face asks for his help. Venkat Prabhu's horror comedy stars Suriya in a dual role, with Nayanthara and Pranitha.
dil-dhadakne-do-2015: The wealthy Mehra family invites friends on a Mediterranean cruise to mark the parents' 30th anniversary. Behind the glamour, the business is failing, the marriage is hollow, the daughter is trapped in an unhappy marriage and the son is pushed toward a career he does not want. Zoya Akhtar directs Anil Kapoor, Priyanka Chopra and Ranveer Singh.
thani-oruvan-2015: Mithran, an idealistic young IPS officer, sets out to bring down the one man he believes is behind much of the organised crime in the city. That man is Siddharth Abhimanyu, a brilliant and ruthless scientist with powerful connections, and the two engage in a battle of wits. Mohan Raja's action thriller stars Jayam Ravi, Arvind Swamy and Nayanthara.
all-is-well-2015: A young man returns home to his estranged father and they go on a road trip to escape a loan shark.
naanum-rowdy-dhaan-2015: Pandi, a police officer's son who wants to be a rowdy, falls for Kadhambari, a hearing-impaired young woman. She agrees to be with him only if he helps her kill the gangster who murdered her parents, a job well beyond this wannabe tough guy. Vignesh Shivan's romantic action comedy stars Vijay Sethupathi and Nayanthara.
maya-2015: A single mother takes part in a challenge to watch a horror film alone in a theatre, and is drawn into a supernatural mystery.
s-o-satyamurthy-2015: Viraj Anand, the son of a principled businessman, gives up his family's fortune after his father dies to clear the old man's debts. Working as a wedding planner to support his family, he sets out to recover a property from a ruthless landlord. Trivikram Srinivas's action comedy stars Allu Arjun, Samantha, Upendra and Nithya Menen.
maari-2015: Maari is a swaggering local rowdy in a Chennai neighbourhood who runs a racket and loves racing pigeons. Feared by everyone, he meets his match when a new police officer arrives, and when he falls for Sridevi, who opens a boutique nearby. Dhanush and Kajal Aggarwal star in this Tamil action comedy written and directed by Balaji Mohan.
tamasha-2015: A man and a woman meet in Corsica and agree to pretend to be other people, then meet again years later.
srimanthudu-2015: Harsha, the heir to a huge business empire, feels his wealth means little. Inspired by Charuseela, a student of rural development, he adopts her family's neglected village and works to rebuild it, taking on the local thugs who exploit it. Koratala Siva's action drama stars Mahesh Babu, Shruti Haasan and Jagapathi Babu.
ennu-ninte-moideen-2015: In 1960s Mukkam, Kerala, Moideen, from a prominent Muslim family, and Kanchanamala, from a wealthy Hindu family, fall in love. Their families forbid it, so the two keep their bond alive through letters and a secret language of their own for years. R. S. Vimal's drama, based on a true story, stars Prithviraj Sukumaran and Parvathy.
anegan-2015: Set across four different time periods, from 1960s Burma to the present day, this Tamil romantic thriller follows two souls who meet and fall in love again and again across lifetimes, facing danger each time. Dhanush and Amyra Dastur star, with Karthik, in this film co-written and directed by K. V. Anand.
shaandaar-2015: Alia, an insomniac adopted daughter, travels with her family to her sister's lavish destination wedding in England, which is a business deal to save the family fortunes. There she meets JJ, the wedding planner who also cannot sleep, and the two fall for each other.
rudhramadevi-2015: Born as a girl to the Kakatiya king, Rudramadevi is raised as a boy to secure the throne. When the truth comes out, she must fight rebel nobles and foreign enemies to rule as one of India's few queens. Gunasekhar's 3D historical film stars Anushka Shetty, Allu Arjun and Rana Daggubati.
bombay-velvet-2015: In 1960s Bombay, Balraj is a street fighter in love with the jazz singer Rosie, and he is desperate to become rich enough to win her. A powerful businessman renames him Johnny and hands him a nightclub, drawing him into the city's world of blackmail, politics and organised crime.
kochadaiiyaan-2014: In this motion-capture epic, the warrior Rana sets out to avenge his father, a celebrated commander who was betrayed and executed by a jealous king.
lingaa-2014: A thief learns about his grandfather, a king who built a dam for his people, and works to save it.
jilla-2014: Shakthi, the adopted son of Madurai crime boss Sivan, hates the police because a cop killed his father. When Sivan needs someone inside the force, he makes Shakthi join the police, and the young man begins to see his godfather's world differently. R. T. Neason's action drama stars Vijay, Mohanlal and Kajal Aggarwal.
happy-new-year-2014: Charlie, a street fighter seeking revenge on the tycoon who framed his father, plans to steal a fortune in diamonds from a Dubai vault. He recruits a team of misfits and disguises them as a dance troupe entering a world dance championship at the hotel above the vault. Farah Khan's heist comedy stars Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone and Abhishek Bachchan.
kick-2014: Devi is a brilliant young man who lives only for the thrill, or kick, he gets from risky adventures. After a break-up with his girlfriend Shaina, a mysterious masked thief begins robbing the rich in Warsaw, and a police officer sets out to catch him. Sajid Nadiadwala's remake of the Telugu film Kick stars Salman Khan, Jacqueline Fernandez, Randeep Hooda and Nawazuddin Siddiqui.
holiday-a-soldier-is-never-off: Virat, an army intelligence officer, comes home to Mumbai on leave and gets pulled into an arranged romance with boxer Saiba. When a bomb goes off on a city bus, he discovers a network of sleeper cells planning more attacks and sets out to stop them while on holiday. A. R. Murugadoss's thriller stars Akshay Kumar and Sonakshi Sinha.
manam-2014: A wealthy businessman and a carefree college student each meet people who look exactly like loved ones they lost long ago. As past lives and the present cross paths, three generations of one family try to bring their stories full circle. Vikram Kumar's fantasy drama stars Akkineni Nageswara Rao in his final film, with Nagarjuna, Naga Chaitanya, Samantha and Shriya Saran.
singham-returns-2014: Now a DCP in Mumbai, Bajirao Singham investigates the death of a colleague found with bags of cash. The trail leads to a fake godman with powerful political friends, and Singham must fight a corrupt system to clean up elections. Rohit Shetty's sequel stars Ajay Devgn, Kareena Kapoor and Amole Gupte.
veeram-2014: Vinayagam, a tough man in Oddanchatram, lives with his four younger brothers and refuses to marry, fearing a wife would split the family. His brothers, all secretly in love, set him up with a young woman, and for her sake he goes to her village, where trouble awaits. Siva's action comedy stars Ajith Kumar and Tamannaah.
gunday-2014: Bikram and Bala, two orphans who fled the 1971 Bangladesh war, grow up to become Calcutta's most powerful coal smugglers. Their unbreakable friendship is tested when both fall for Nandita, a cabaret dancer, and a determined police officer sets out to bring them down.
mary-kom-2014: Mary Kom, the daughter of a rice farmer in Manipur, becomes fascinated with boxing as a girl despite her father's disapproval. Trained by a demanding coach, she rises to become a world champion, then fights to return to the ring after marriage and motherhood.
anaamika-2014: Anaamika, a software professional, arrives in Hyderabad from the US to search for her missing husband, Ajay. Brushed off by the police, she finds an ally in one officer, Sarathy, and follows every clue he left behind. Nayanthara stars in Sekhar Kammula's remake of the Hindi thriller Kahaani, shot in Telugu and Tamil.
kaththi-2014: A con man who escapes from jail takes the place of his lookalike, a social activist fighting for farmers against a corporation.
bang-bang-2014: Harleen, a bank receptionist in Shimla who longs for adventure, is mistaken for someone else on a blind date and meets Rajveer, a charming stranger. He turns out to be on the run with the stolen Koh-i-Noor diamond, and she is swept into a dangerous chase across the world.
1-nenokkadine-2014: Gautham is a rock musician living with schizophrenia who cannot remember his parents. Haunted by hallucinations, he believes he is hunting down the three men who killed them, and a journalist named Sameera is drawn into his search. Sukumar directs this Telugu psychological thriller starring Mahesh Babu and Kriti Sanon.
govindudu-andarivadele-2014: Abhiram, a young man raised in London, learns that his father once left his village home after a falling-out with his own father. He travels to the village under a false identity to win back the grandfather and reunite the family. Krishna Vamsi's family drama stars Ram Charan, Kajal Aggarwal, Prakash Raj and Srikanth.
special-26-2013: Special 26 is a 2013 Hindi heist thriller written and directed by Neeraj Pandey, inspired by the 1987 Opera House heist and starring Akshay Kumar, Manoj Bajpayee, Anupam Kher and Jimmy Shergill. A gang of con artists posing as CBI officers stage convincing fake raids on corrupt politicians and businessmen, and plan one last, audacious job.
dhoom-3-2013: Sahir, a gifted circus performer in Chicago, seeks revenge on the bank whose demands drove his father to suicide when he was a child. As he robs its branches in spectacular heists, Mumbai police officers Jai and Ali are called in to help catch him.
krrish-3-2013: Krishna, who secretly fights crime as Krrish, lives with his scientist father Rohit and his wife Priya in Mumbai. When a powerful villain unleashes a deadly virus and an army of mutants, Krrish faces his biggest test. Rakesh Roshan's superhero film stars Hrithik Roshan, Priyanka Chopra, Vivek Oberoi and Kangana Ranaut.
seethamma-vakitlo-sirimalle-ch: Two brothers, one short-tempered and one easygoing, try to hold their large, loving family together through money troubles and their own romances.
raja-rani-2013: John and Regina, pushed into an arranged marriage, live like strangers under one roof. When Regina falls ill, John learns about the painful love she lost, and he too has a past he has not let go of. Atlee's debut romantic drama stars Arya, Nayanthara, Jai and Nazriya Nazim.
yeh-jawaani-hai-deewani-2013: Naina, a shy, studious medical student, joins her old classmates on a hiking trip to Manali and falls for Bunny, a free-spirited young man who dreams of travelling the world. Years later, they meet again at a friend's wedding. Ayan Mukerji's coming-of-age romance stars Ranbir Kapoor, Deepika Padukone, Aditya Roy Kapur and Kalki Koechlin.
attarintiki-daredi-2013: Gautham, the grandson of a rich Milan-based tycoon, travels to Hyderabad to bring his estranged aunt Sunanda back to the family before his grandfather's 80th birthday. Posing as a driver named Siddhartha, he works his way into her household and tries to win over her and her daughters.
singam-ii-2013: Singam II is a 2013 Tamil action thriller written and directed by Hari, the second film in the Singam series, starring Suriya with Anushka Shetty and Hansika Motwani. Having apparently quit the force, Durai Singam goes undercover as an NCC instructor at a school in Thoothukudi, secretly tracking a smuggling racket with the knowledge of only two ministers.
raanjhanaa-2013: Raanjhanaa is a 2013 Hindi romantic drama directed by Aanand L. Rai and written by Himanshu Sharma, starring Dhanush, Sonam Kapoor and Abhay Deol. Kundan, the son of a Tamil Brahmin family in Varanasi, has loved Zoya, a Muslim girl, since childhood, and his devotion only grows when she returns home years later in love with someone else.
goliyon-ki-raasleela-ram-leela: A retelling of Romeo and Juliet in Gujarat: Ram and Leela fall in love across two clans who have been killing each other for centuries.
maryan-2013: Maryan, a proud fisherman from a coastal Tamil village, finally returns the love of the devoted Panimalar. To earn money for their future, he takes a job in Sudan, where he and his fellow workers are kidnapped by militants. Bharat Bala's survival drama stars Dhanush and Parvathy, with music by A. R. Rahman.
shootout-at-wadala-2013: Mortally wounded in a police encounter, gangster Manya Surve tells his life story to the officer who shot him. Once an honest college student in 1970s Bombay, Manya was jailed after defending his brother, and he emerged to build a ruthless gang that took on the city's most powerful dons.
abcd-american-born-confused-de: Johns and Korah are spoilt cousins born in New York who live for fast cars and partying. When Johns' father sends them to Kerala and cuts off their credit cards, the two are forced to survive on their own, and they stumble into local student politics.
housefull-2-2012: Two rich, feuding Kapoor brothers each want a wealthy groom for their daughters. Their friends try to pass off two old college rivals and two buddies as rich men's sons, leading to a farcical tangle of fake identities. Sajid Khan's ensemble comedy stars Akshay Kumar, John Abraham, Ritesh Deshmukh, Shreyas Talpade, Asin and Jacqueline Fernandez.
son-of-sardaar-2012: Son of Sardaar is a 2012 Hindi action comedy directed by Ashwni Dhir, a remake of the Telugu film Maryada Ramanna, starring Ajay Devgn, Sanjay Dutt, Sonakshi Sinha and Juhi Chawla. Jassi, raised in London after a deadly family feud, returns to Punjab to sell his land and unknowingly takes shelter with the very family sworn to kill him.
omg-oh-my-god-2012: Kanji Lalji Mehta, an atheist who sells idols of gods in Mumbai, loses his shop in an earthquake, and his insurer refuses to pay, calling it an act of God. So he sues God, taking on religious leaders in court, and a mysterious stranger turns up to help him. Umesh Shukla's satire stars Paresh Rawal and Akshay Kumar.
ek-tha-tiger-2012: Tiger, India's top spy, is sent to watch a scientist in Dublin and falls for the man's caretaker, who turns out to be a Pakistani agent.
rowdy-rathore-2012: A thief takes the place of his lookalike, a police officer, to protect his daughter.
jab-tak-hai-jaan-2012: An army bomb-disposal expert who makes a promise to God meets a young woman who wants to make a documentary about him.
talaash-the-answer-lies-within: Inspector Surjan investigates a film star's mysterious car crash, while grieving the recent drowning of his son and drifting apart from his wife. As the case leads him into Mumbai's red-light district and to a sex worker named Rosie, it becomes more personal than he expected. Reema Kagti's thriller stars Aamir Khan, Rani Mukerji and Kareena Kapoor.
barfi-2012: In 1970s Darjeeling, Barfi, a charming young man born deaf and mute, spends his days playing pranks and outrunning the local police. His life changes when he meets Shruti, a newcomer engaged to someone else, and later Jhilmil, a young woman with autism. Ranbir Kapoor, Priyanka Chopra and Ileana D'Cruz star in Anurag Basu's Hindi romantic comedy.
cocktail-2012: In London, carefree playboy Gautam and free-spirited Veronica start a casual relationship and take in Meera, a shy young woman abandoned by her husband. The three become close friends, until Gautam starts falling for Meera and their easy arrangement begins to crack. Homi Adajania's romantic drama stars Saif Ali Khan, Deepika Padukone and Diana Penty.
3-2012: Ram and Janani fall in love as schoolchildren and marry against their families' wishes. After Ram's sudden death, Janani tries to understand what happened, and discovers that her husband was battling a mental illness that he had hidden from her.
naan-ee-2012: Nani, a fireworks maker, adores his neighbour Bindu, who runs a small charity. After a powerful, narcissistic businessman obsessed with Bindu murders him, Nani is reborn as a housefly and sets out to protect her and take revenge. The Tamil version of S. S. Rajamouli's Eega stars Nani, Samantha and Sudeep.
maattrraan-2012: Conjoined twins, one serious and one carefree, uncover dangerous secrets about the health drink made by their scientist father's company.
don-2-2011: Five years after taking over the Asian underworld, Don sets his sights on Europe. With the European cartels plotting to kill him and the police hot on his trail, he plans an audacious heist at a bank in Berlin. Shah Rukh Khan and Priyanka Chopra star in this Hindi action thriller written and directed by Farhan Akhtar.
desi-boyz-2011: Best friends Jerry and Nick lose their jobs in London during the recession. Desperate for money, they take jobs as male escorts and must hide their new careers from Nick's fiancée and from the social workers watching Jerry's nephew. Rohit Dhawan's comedy stars Akshay Kumar, John Abraham, Deepika Padukone and Chitrangada Singh.
bodyguard-2011: Lovely Singh is assigned to guard Divya, daughter of a powerful man who once saved his mother. Tired of his constant shadow, Divya poses as an anonymous admirer named Chhaya on the phone, and soon her prank becomes real love. Siddique's Hindi remake of his own Malayalam hit stars Salman Khan and Kareena Kapoor.
patiala-house-2011: Gattu, a gifted fast bowler from Southall in London, gave up his dream of playing cricket for England because of his father's hostility to the country. Years later, a chance to play for England comes his way, and he must hide it from his father. Nikkhil Advani's sports drama stars Akshay Kumar, Rishi Kapoor, Dimple Kapadia and Anushka Sharma.
ra-one-2011: Shekhar, a game designer in London, creates Ra.One, a nearly unbeatable villain, to impress his gamer son. When the character escapes into the real world and comes after his family, the hero of the game, G.One, comes to life to stop him. Anubhav Sinha's superhero film stars Shah Rukh Khan, Kareena Kapoor and Arjun Rampal.
siruthai-2011: Rocket Raja, a small-time thief, discovers he is the exact double of Rathnavel Pandian, an honest police officer feared by gangsters. When he learns that Rathnavel's young daughter needs a father, he is drawn into the officer's fight. Siva's remake of Vikramarkudu stars Karthi in a dual role, with Tamannaah.
7-khoon-maaf-2011: Susanna, a wealthy Anglo-Indian woman, keeps searching for love, but each of her husbands turns out to be deeply flawed, and each meets a fatal end. Her story is told by Arun, a forensic doctor who has known and admired her since childhood. Priyanka Chopra stars in Vishal Bhardwaj's dark comedy.
aadukalam-2011: In Madurai, Karuppu is a gifted rooster trainer working under Pettaikaaran, a respected veteran of cockfighting. When Karuppu wins a crucial fight against a police inspector's bird, his success stirs jealousy and suspicion in his mentor, setting off a chain of betrayals.
mayakkam-enna-2011: Karthik, a gifted but introverted photographer who dreams of wildlife photography, falls for Yamini, his best friend's girlfriend. Their love leads to marriage, but his struggle for recognition and a crushing setback push him towards a breakdown. Selvaraghavan's psychological drama stars Dhanush and Richa Gangopadhyay.
7aum-arivu-2011: The film opens in the 5th century with Bodhidharma, a Pallava prince and martial arts master who travels to China. In the present, a genetics student believes his skills can be revived in a circus performer descended from him, just as a Chinese agent arrives in India to spread a deadly virus.
rockstar-2011: Rockstar is a 2011 Hindi musical drama written and directed by Imtiaz Ali, starring Ranbir Kapoor and Nargis Fakhri, with music by A. R. Rahman. Janardhan, a Delhi college student mocked for dreaming of becoming a rock star, is told that great artists are born of heartbreak, and sets out to find his own by chasing the college's most popular girl.
action-replayy-2010: Bunty refuses to marry because his parents' marriage has been loveless for as long as he can remember. When his girlfriend's grandfather builds a time machine, Bunty travels back to the 1970s to make his young parents fall in love. Akshay Kumar, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Aditya Roy Kapur star in this Hindi comedy by Vipul Amrutlal Shah.
dabangg-2010: Chulbul Pandey, a cocky, fearless and not entirely honest police officer in Uttar Pradesh, calls himself Robin Hood Pandey. He has an uneasy relationship with his stepfather and half-brother, falls for a potter's daughter named Rajjo, and takes on a scheming local politician. Salman Khan and Sonakshi Sinha star in Abhinav Kashyap's Hindi action comedy.
raajneeti-2010: A struggle for power inside a political family, loosely inspired by the Mahabharata, turns brothers and cousins into deadly enemies.
atithi-tum-kab-jaoge-2010: Puneet, a struggling screenwriter in Mumbai, and his wife Munmun lead a busy but happy life with their young son. Their world is turned upside down when Lambodar Chacha, a distant and eccentric uncle, arrives unannounced and shows no sign of leaving, and the couple try every trick to get rid of him.
paiyaa-2010: Paiyaa is a 2010 Tamil romantic action film directed by N. Lingusamy, starring Karthi and Tamannaah. Shiva, a carefree young man job-hunting in Bangalore, is smitten with a woman he keeps spotting around the city, and when chance puts her in the car he is driving, an impromptu road trip turns into a chase with gangsters on their trail.
anjaana-anjaani-2010: Akash, whose New York business has collapsed, and Kiara, heartbroken after her fiance's betrayal, are two strangers who meet at their lowest point. Both ready to give up, they make a pact to spend twenty days together first, setting off on an unexpected journey. Ranbir Kapoor and Priyanka Chopra star in this Hindi romantic comedy by Siddharth Anand.
once-upon-a-time-in-mumbaai-20: In 1970s Bombay, Sultan Mirza, a smuggler who rules the docks with a code of honour, takes young Shoaib Khan under his wing. But Shoaib's ambition and ruthlessness know no limits, and he sets out to become king of the city. Milan Luthria's gangster drama stars Ajay Devgn, Emraan Hashmi, Kangana Ranaut, Prachi Desai and Randeep Hooda.
khelein-hum-jee-jaan-sey-2010: In 1930 Chittagong, schoolteacher Surya Sen gathers a band of teenage boys and young women to take on the British, planning raids on armouries and the telegraph office. Ashutosh Gowariker's historical drama, based on Manini Chatterjee's book Do and Die, stars Abhishek Bachchan, Deepika Padukone and Sikandar Kher.
guzaarish-2010: Ethan, a former magician, has lived with paralysis for fourteen years. He brings hope and laughter to listeners through his radio show, cared for by his devoted nurse Sofia. Then he files a petition in court asking for the right to end his life. Hrithik Roshan and Aishwarya Rai Bachchan star in this Hindi drama by Sanjay Leela Bhansali.
break-ke-baad-2010: Abhay and Aaliya have been friends since childhood and are now dating, but she wants a career in acting and is wary of marriage. When she leaves for drama school in Australia, Abhay follows her, testing a relationship that needs room to grow. Danish Aslam's romantic comedy stars Imran Khan and Deepika Padukone.
karthik-calling-karthik-2010: Karthik, a shy, put-upon Mumbai engineer, hits rock bottom when he gets a phone call from a man who sounds exactly like him and offers to fix his life. Following the caller's advice, Karthik turns successful and wins the girl, but the calls come with rules. Vijay Lalwani's psychological thriller stars Farhan Akhtar and Deepika Padukone.
ishqiya-2010: Two small-time crooks, Khalujaan and Babban, flee their boss and take shelter with Krishna, the widow of an old associate in rural Uttar Pradesh. Both fall for her, but Krishna has plans of her own and soon involves them in a risky kidnapping scheme. Abhishek Chaubey's debut black comedy stars Vidya Balan, Naseeruddin Shah and Arshad Warsi.
418: A medical college building in a frightened village has been locked for fifteen years. When it is reopened against the villagers' wishes, strange and sinister things start happening, and only an 18-year-old student who can sense the supernatural sees what is coming.
alpha: After the Kargil war, two army officers start a secret programme to build super-soldiers. When one officer's pregnant wife is found to have a serious heart condition, he takes a desperate risk with the project to save her and their child.
aadu-3: Shaji Pappan and his gang are pulled into a wild adventure that jumps between three timelines, the 18th century, the present day and the far future, over a mysterious substance that can rewrite time.
anbil-avan: Suriya and Iyal, a young couple who married against their families' wishes, quit their gruelling hotel jobs to chase her dream of running a vintage homestay full of plants, and learn what it takes.
ashakal-aayiram: A warm family comedy about a father and son, their everyday struggles, clashing dreams, misunderstandings and the ways they find their way back to each other.
anaganaga-oka-raju: Raju has inherited nothing from his zamindar grandfather except a famous surname, but keeps up the act of being rich. Humiliated at a friend's wedding, he decides to marry into money, and sets his sights on a woman he meets at a village fair.
athiradi: Years after a stampede at a college fest killed three students, including his girlfriend, the coordinator who opened the gates that day carries the guilt, until the fest returns and old wounds reopen.
assi: A schoolteacher in Delhi is abducted and brutally assaulted by five young men and left for dead. She survives, and with her husband's support begins a long fight for justice through the courts.
baby-do-die-do: Two teenage twin sisters, one of them mute, grow up poor after their alcoholic father's death and their mother's breakdown. The elder sister, who has always protected the younger, tells their story from the ruins of an abandoned hotel.
backrooms: When a researcher vanishes inside 'the Backrooms', an endless maze of yellow rooms and humming lights, scientists who recover his footage try to understand the place and the creature that lives there.
bail: A cheerful retired police commissioner grows furious as legal loopholes let violent criminals walk free on bail, and quietly becomes a vigilante who targets them as soon as they leave custody.
balan-the-boy: A mother released from prison keeps moving with her young son under different names to hide their past, until a woman who knew her inside finds them, and her secrets turn deadly.
band-melam: In a village in rural Telangana, cousins Giri and Raaji grow up side by side and their families hope they will marry, but growing up pulls their lives in different directions.
batwara-1947: In Lahore during the Partition of India, displaced and grieving refugees struggle to survive the camps and find a way across the new border, in a story of loss and human connection.
bharathanatyam-2-mohiniy: After the death of Bharathan Nair, his family visits a relative's new home in another town, and a revelation from an old friend of his sends the family's secrets spinning into fresh chaos.
bharat-bhhagya-viddhaata: Set during the 26/11 Mumbai attacks, the film follows the nurses and health workers of Cama Hospital, inspired by the nurse who helped save 20 pregnant women that night.
bhartha-mahasayulaku-wig: Ram, a winemaker from Hyderabad, travels to Spain to change the mind of the company head who rejected his wine, hiding who he is as romance and mix-ups follow.
biker: A former motocross racer who now runs a workshop, estranged from his own racing father, is pulled back to the track when his father is publicly humiliated by a company chief.
blast: In a family where everyone is trained in karate, a daughter who keeps standing up to bullies is pushed to fight for real when trouble comes to their door.
chennai-love-story: Dumped on her wedding day, Nivi moves to Chennai to start over and sinks into depression, until she crosses paths with Steven, a struggling filmmaker chasing his first break.
chand-mera-dil: On his first day of engineering college, Aarav is captivated by Chandni dancing on stage at orientation, and his admiration grows into a deep and complicated love.
comrade-kalyan: In 1994, near the Andhra-Odisha border, a cinema operator who dreams of owning a theatre gets caught between a vengeful police officer and the Naxalites who killed his family.
clayface: A Hollywood actor whose face is slashed by a crime lord turns to a desperate experimental treatment, which gives him the power to reshape his body, and a hunger for revenge.
cocktail-2: A couple who have dated since college take a trip to Sicily to escape questions about marriage, and an old friend of hers joins them, unsettling everything.
couple-friendly: Siva, a bike-taxi rider in Chennai, and Mithra, a software engineer looking for work and a place to live, end up sharing a flat, and grow close.
cult: Three friends crash a party thrown by a politician's son and find themselves trapped in a night of terror.
dacoit: During the COVID lockdown, a convict escapes from jail to take revenge on the ex-girlfriend who betrayed him to the police, with a determined sub-inspector on his trail.
daadi-ki-shaadi: A Facebook autocorrect error convinces a lonely 72-year-old widow's family that she is about to remarry, and they all rush to her house in Shimla.
deool-band-2: A struggling farmer woman, in despair, throws a stone at a shrine and has a vision of Swami Samarth, which sets her life on a new course.
dc: Devadas, an outlaw with his own code of justice who turned to crime as a boy to avenge his mother, leads a small gang that robs a police weapons convoy.
do-deewane-seher-mein: Shashank, who stammers through presentations, and Roshni, who struggles with how she looks, are perfect on the outside but insecure within, and slowly find confidence together.
drishyam-3: Five years on, Georgekutty has turned his story into a hit film, but two journalists start digging into what really inspired it, and the old case threatens to surface again.
disclosure-day: With the world on the brink of nuclear war, a cybersecurity specialist steals proof of extraterrestrial contact from a secretive government contractor and goes on the run.
garividi-lakshmi: A musical biopic of Reddy Vijaya Lakshmi, the burra katha folk performer from Andhra Pradesh, and her rise as an artist.
funky: A producer watching the unfinished cut of his expensive new film discovers how far over budget it has run, and what his own assistant sold to keep the shoot going.
evil-dead-burn: At their family vacation house, the Price siblings find their late grandfather's research into the Necronomicon, and accidentally unleash the flesh-possessing Deadites.
ghabadkund: A dry well near a village is said to hold a gang's hidden loot and a deadly curse. Years later, a simple villager stumbles into its secret.
gatta-kusthi-2: Veera has become a stay-at-home dad so his wife Keerthi can focus on her wrestling career, but parenting their daughter becomes a new battleground.
godari-gattupaina: In the villages along the Godavari, a kind-hearted auto driver and a spirited college girl fall in love, but her father has other expectations.
governor: Inspired by events around India's 1990 economic crisis, this financial thriller follows the work of the institutions that tried to steer the country through its foreign exchange emergency. Manoj Bajpayee leads the cast with Adah Sharma, in a film directed by Chinmay D. Mandlekar and produced by Vipul Amrutlal Shah.
haiwaan: A visually impaired man becomes the only witness to a murder, and the prime suspect, in Priyadarshan's Hindi remake of his own Malayalam thriller Oppam.
happy-patel-khatarnak-ja: Happy Patel, raised in Britain by two secret-agent dads and rejected by their spy agency, discovers he is of Indian origin and is sent to Goa on a clumsy mission to rescue a woman held captive by a local gang.
haunted-3d-echoes-of-the: Vikram Bhatt's supernatural horror, a spiritual sequel to Haunted 3D, in which a haunting rooted in the past returns to torment the living.
happy-raj: Happy grows up as the target of a town's joke: his miserly schoolteacher father's body-shaming nickname has passed down to him, and he sets out to escape it.
hey-balwanth: Krishna idolises his father Balwanth, who refuses to let him join the family business. When Balwanth has a heart attack, Krishna takes over, and discovers what his father had been hiding.
hi: Turned down by his cousin and best friend for being timid, Mayil runs away to Chennai to avoid an arranged marriage, and a year later his story crosses with that of a lonely village girl.
heart-of-the-beast: A retired special-forces soldier and his combat dog, both haunted by PTSD, camp beside a remote Alaskan lake, and a friendly stranger turns their trip into a fight for survival.
i-nobody: Rajeevan, a government employee whose marriage is already under strain, is trapped inside a bank during a robbery in which ₹17 crore is stolen, and finds himself under suspicion.
idhayam-murali: On a flight home to India for a wedding, Idhaya swaps phones with a stranger and tells him the story of his life: falling in love again and again, without ever confessing his feelings.
ikkis: The story of Second Lieutenant Arun Khetarpal, who was killed in the Battle of Basantar in the 1971 war at the age of 21, and of his father's visit to Pakistan thirty years later.
immortal: A supernatural evil born to a tribal couple a thousand years ago is still bound to events in the present day.
hoppers: In this Pixar animation, a nature-loving young woman uses new technology to transfer her mind into a robot beaver, and finds herself in the middle of the animal world.
insidious-out-of-the-fur: Twenty years after watching her mother die in a seemingly supernatural tragedy, a single mother in Pittsburgh is pulled back into the Further when her daughter is threatened.
jayanti-2: A tribal student facing discrimination at a Pune college is suspended after standing up to her classmates, and a former student takes up her fight for reinstatement and dignity.
kara: In 1990, a thief who wants to give up crime and live peacefully with his wife sets out on what he swears is his last robbery, at a local MLA's house, and it goes badly wrong.
karavali: An action drama set against the rough coastal culture of Karnataka, starring Prajwal Devaraj and Raj B. Shetty.
kattalan: A standalone action thriller in the world of Mikhael and Marco, following a man shaped by the forest and violence.
korean-kanakaraju: Kanakaraju's ordinary life takes a strange supernatural turn when he is possessed, after a drunken night at a bar, by the spirit of a dead Korean man.
kd-the-devil: In 1980s Bengaluru, a foreign crime lord targets police officers and their families, and a former police chief tells the story of KD, a notorious kingpin, to explain why.
krantijyoti-vidyalay-mar: A Marathi-medium school is about to close as parents turn to English-medium education, and former students and teachers reunite to save it.
krishnavataram-part-1-th: A sceptical young man at the Jagannath Temple in Puri is told the life of Krishna by a priest, focused on love through his bonds with Radha, Rukmini and Satyabhama.
landlord: In 1980s rural Karnataka, Rachayya, a quiet labourer who dreams of owning a small piece of land, stands up to the powerful landlord who controls the village.
leader: Sakthivel, a widowed car mechanic in Thoothukudi, is drawn into a fight with a powerful smuggler at the harbour and his international boss.
lee-cronin-s-the-mummy: A family in Egypt unearths a black sarcophagus beneath their home, and the mummified remains inside begin to move, setting off a terrifying curse.
lenin: In a village in 1976, the start of an eighteen-day festival during which no blood may be shed is shaken by a feud between upper and lower castes.
love-mocktail-3: Years after the second film, Adi is now a single father to his adopted daughter Nidhi, and their quiet, warm life is tested by new challenges.
maa-inti-bangaaram: Swarna, a woman with a violent past, marries into a traditional family and tries to live a quiet life as a devoted wife, until her past comes looking for her.
main-vaapas-aaunga: A 95-year-old man on his deathbed keeps talking about returning to his ancestral home in Sargodha, now in Pakistan, and his grandson tries to understand what he is trying to say.
mardaani-3: SSP Shivani Shivaji Roy investigates the abduction of a diplomat's daughter and her friend, uncovering a much larger trafficking network.
mankatha: A suspended Mumbai police officer joins a gang planning to steal a huge sum of IPL betting money, and double-crosses everyone.
minions-and-monsters: Thousands of years ago, a tribe of Minions searching for the greatest villain to serve sets out on a prehistoric adventure.
michael: A biopic of Michael Jackson, from his childhood as the lead singer of the Jackson 5 to his rise as the King of Pop.
mollywood-times: The son of a celebrated horror novelist discovers that his father's literary legacy is built on stolen manuscripts and ghostwriters, and is drawn into the same world.
mortal-kombat-ii: Twenty years after Shao Kahn conquered the realm of Edenia, the tenth Mortal Kombat tournament approaches. Lord Raiden and Sonya Blade assemble Earthrealm's champions, including the washed-up actor Johnny Cage, to face Outworld's fighters, while Princess Kitana questions her loyalty to the emperor.
moana: A live-action remake: a young Polynesian woman sets sail across the ocean with the demigod Maui to return the heart of the island goddess Te Fiti and save her people.
mrithyunjay: Jay, a journalist who collects obituary ads but dreams of investigating crime, promises a grieving daughter he will solve her father's murder, and crosses paths with a police officer hunting a killer.
nagabandham-the-secret-t: A mystery adventure around Nagabandham, an ancient ritual believed to seal sacred treasures inside Vishnu temples, as a warrior protects the legacy from greedy forces.
nayyi-navelli: At a family wedding in Meerut, a group of relatives tries to deal with a spirit, a woman named Mohini, while the celebrations carry on.
nooru-saami: Selvi, a young widow in a conservative village, works the fields to give her two sons a better future, while facing harassment and stigma.
nari-nari-naduma-murari: Two architects in love want to marry, but the bride's father, a divorce lawyer, doesn't believe in a love that has never been tested by a fight.
o-romeo: In 1995 Bombay, a feared razor-wielding hitman working secretly for an intelligence officer is given a contract that changes his life.
ohh-my-dog: Two boys, one in Patna and one in Assam, each set out to rescue a dog.
pallichattambi: In the 1930s, on the Malabar border, a boy whose family was murdered by a ruthless landlord's men grows up to challenge the landlord.
obsession: A young man in love with his friend buys a novelty toy that grants a wish, and wishes she would love him, with disturbing results.
parimala-and-co: A dysfunctional family half-jokes about getting rid of a rowdy who is harassing their daughters, and then he turns up dead.
pati-patni-aur-woh-do: A forest official's life in Prayagraj is thrown into chaos when his journalist wife reports a scandal involving a politician's son.
parasakthi: In 1959 Tamil Nadu, during the protests against the imposition of Hindi, an intelligence officer hunts a radical student group.
patriot: A government spyware tool called Periscope is being used to surveil and blackmail citizens, and a minister's attempt to expose it sets off a deadly conspiracy.
premada-oorali: A widowed farmer searches for an educated bride for his son, who falls for a young woman who has returned to the village from the US after a broken heart.
prathichaya: A tech entrepreneur tries to save the reputation of his father, a Chief Minister caught in a scandal, and uncovers a conspiracy of politics, media and corporate interests.
raakaasa: Villagers believe a demon called Raakaasa lives in the castle outside their village and demands a human sacrifice every 500 years, and the time has come again.
rahu-ketu: Rahu and Ketu, two bumbling characters who spring to life from a writer's magical notebook, set out to get the notebook back, and stumble into a drug mafia and the truth about where they came from.
project-hail-mary: A schoolteacher and former biologist wakes from a coma aboard a spacecraft light-years from Earth, the only survivor of his crew, with no memory of why he is there or how he can save humanity.
raja-shivaji: The life of Chhatrapati Shivaji, from his birth in 1630 amid the rivalries of the Deccan sultanates and the Mughals to his rise as the founder of the Maratha kingdom.
rao-bahadur: An ageing, alcoholic aristocrat dying of liver cancer in his ancestral manor outlives every prediction, kept alive by a single, consuming obsession.
resident-evil: A medical courier making a late delivery to a hospital in Raccoon City hits a woman on the road, and is plunged into a nightmare as the city falls to a deadly outbreak.
sambhavam-adhyayam-onnu: A curse hidden in a forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border links a decades-old killing to a police investigation in 1994 and to the present day.
saptadingar-guptodhon: Treasure hunter Sonada is approached by a historian whose ancestor cared for the dying King Pratapaditya of Jessore, setting off a hunt for a lost royal treasure.
sing-geetham: Pratap, a former convict, comes to an arid mining village to claim his late father's share of the gold mines, and finds his father's partner and his daughter have taken them over.
srinivasa-mangapuram: In Tirupati, Srinu falls for Manga, the daughter of a powerful faction leader, but she tells him her marriage has already been decided.
supergirl: Kara Zor-El, Superman's cousin, who survived the destruction of Krypton in a separate city, sets out across space on a mission of her own.
thaai-kizhavi: A feared old moneylender in a Madurai village lies on her deathbed making the same hand gesture again and again, and her family scrambles to work out what she wants.
the-devil-wears-prada-2: Twenty years after leaving Runway, Andy Sachs is a respected journalist who suddenly loses her job, while Miranda Priestly faces a crisis of her own, and their paths cross again.
thalaivar-thambi-thalaim: A respected village panchayat president is put in charge of making sure a family wedding goes smoothly, until a neighbour's death throws everything into chaos.
the-sheep-detectives: When the shepherd who reads them murder mysteries is found dead, his flock of sheep set out to solve the crime themselves.
the-super-mario-galaxy-m: Bowser Jr. captures Rosalina, the guardian of the cosmic Lumas, planning to use her powers to free his defeated father. Mario, Luigi and their new friend Yoshi, along with Princess Peach and Toad, head into outer space on an adventure across the galaxy to stop him.
toy-story-5: Woody, Buzz and the gang face a new rival when Bonnie gets a frog-shaped tablet named Lilypad, as toys go up against technology.
tu-yaa-main: Two social media influencers are trapped in a drained swimming pool with a crocodile, and have to survive the night.
tumbadchi-manjula: Humiliated in public by the village's self-appointed authority, a young man spreads a lie to get symbolic revenge, and it spirals out of control.
vaa-vaathiyaar: A man raised to follow his grandfather's hero, the actor-politician MGR, keeps clashing with his grandfather's expectations of who he should be.
vishnu-vinyasam: Manisha, a 27-year-old lecturer no one wants to marry, meets Vishnu, a fellow lecturer who follows astrology in everything.
verity: A struggling writer is hired to finish a bestselling series for an injured author, and finds an unpublished manuscript in the author's home that reveals disturbing secrets.
welcome-to-the-jungle: A businessman trying to dodge taxes sets out to make a ₹2,000-crore film designed to flop, with a failed actor and an inexperienced director.
with-love: Sathya, a designer who avoids marriage proposals, is pushed into meeting Monisha, and the awkward meeting turns out to be with someone from his past.
a-very-jonas-christmas-movie-2: After their European tour, the Jonas Brothers are desperate to get home for Christmas, but Santa puts a curse on them to keep the band together.
youth: Praveen, a carefree 16-year-old, sets out to find the love of his life before school ends, to his parents' dismay.
be-happy-2025: A single father raises his daughter, who dreams of winning a national dance competition, and faces a hard choice when tragedy strikes.
baaghi-4-2025: A naval officer who survives a car crash and a suicide attempt sinks into a world where reality blurs, haunted by a woman no one else believes existed.
champion-2025: A talented footballer from Secunderabad who dreams of playing in London is drawn into the Bhairanpally revolt during India's struggle for independence.
dude-2025: Agan and his cousin Kural run a surprise-event company. When Kural confesses she loves him, he rejects her, and only realises what he has lost later.
de-de-pyaar-de-2-2025: Ashish, a 51-year-old London investor, meets his 27-year-old girlfriend Ayesha's family to get their approval, and they are not pleased.
dragon-2025: A model student who turns rebel after being rejected by his crush lands in trouble years later when a lie about his degree catches up with him.
heads-of-state-2025: The US President and the British Prime Minister, who can't stand each other, have to work together when they are targeted by a powerful enemy.
identity-2025: A sketch artist with a gift for faces is drawn into a murder investigation in which the only witness cannot recognise faces.
hridayapoorvam-2025: A wealthy, irritable hotelier who has had a heart transplant is drawn into the family of his donor.
jack-2025: Jack, a young man who gives up on every job, has a secret plan to become a spy, and stumbles into a real terror plot.
jolly-llb-3-2025: Two lawyers named Jolly face off in court over a farmer's land seized through forged documents by a powerful developer.
idli-kadai-2025: Murugan, who left his father's beloved idli shop in a Theni village for a corporate life, returns home and has to decide what he owes his father's legacy.
kaalidhar-laapata-2025: A middle-aged man with memory loss, overhearing his family's plan to abandon him, leaves on his own and befriends an eight-year-old orphan on the road.
metro-in-dino-2025: Eight people in different cities and stages of life deal with love, infidelity and loneliness in a series of interconnected stories.
kingston-2025: Fishing has been banned off a coastal village because the sea is said to be cursed. A young fisherman decides to venture out and find the truth.
narivetta-2025: Varghese, a young man who keeps failing government exams, reluctantly joins the police and is sent to a tribal land protest that turns violent.
odela-2-2025: In a Telangana village, the spirit of a beheaded serial killer returns to terrorise the villagers, and a devotee of Lord Shiva stands against it.
single-2025: Vijay, a bank employee, falls for Purva at first sight, while another woman, Harini, has secretly fallen for him.
subham-2025: The wives of a town become possessed every night to watch a TV serial, and three friends who run the town's cable TV set out to solve it.
son-of-sardaar-2-2025: Jassi finally gets a visa to join his wife in Scotland, only to learn she wants a divorce, and gets caught up in a chaotic family wedding.
they-call-him-og-2025: Ojas Gambheera, the sole survivor of a massacre at a samurai dojo in Japan, arrives in Bombay and becomes a legend in its underworld.
the-girlfriend-2025: A literature student falls into a relationship with a charismatic classmate, and slowly realises it is controlling her.
aranmanai-4-2024: A shape-shifting demon released from a river in Assam takes the form of a young woman and finds its way into a family in Tamil Nadu.
boat-2024: During World War II, a group of people fleeing a Japanese air raid on Madras end up stranded together on a small boat at sea.
barroz-2024: Barroz, the ghost of a loyal servant, has guarded a treasure for four centuries, waiting for the true descendant of his master.
fakt-purusho-maate-2024: During the days of Shraadh, a grandfather returns from the afterlife to break up his grandson's wedding.
double-ismart-2024: Big Bull, a notorious assassin, tries to achieve immortality by transferring his memories into iSmart Shankar.
grrr-2024: A heartbroken drunk climbs into a lion's enclosure at a zoo, and a security guard has to get him out.
laapataa-ladies-2024: In 2001, two veiled brides are accidentally swapped on a crowded train. While one husband searches frantically for his wife, the other bride, stranded in a strange village, quietly begins to take charge of her own life.
kalvan-2024: A petty thief in a village on the edge of the Sathyamangalam forest falls for a nursing student who can't stand him, and schemes his way into a forest department job.
mothers-instinct-2024: In 1960s suburban America, two close neighbours and mothers turn on each other after a tragedy involving one of their sons.
naa-saami-ranga-2024: In 1960s Ambajipeta, an orphan is taken in by a family and grows up fiercely loyal to his adopted brother, until a feud with a powerful local family tests that loyalty.
mura-2024: A group of young men from Thiruvananthapuram take on a dangerous job: breaking into a vault full of black money.
om-bheem-bush-2024: Three friends hunting for treasure in a haunted mansion pose as magicians in a village to win its people over.
paani-2024: An ordinary man in a drought-hit village in Nanded sets out to make his village independent of water tankers, while dealing with local goons and a budding romance.
satyabhama-2024: ACP Satyabhama, who leads Hyderabad's SHE Teams against crimes against women, takes on a case that becomes personal.
sikandar-ka-muqaddar-2024: Five red diamonds vanish during a botched heist at a Mumbai expo, and an obsessive officer pursues three suspects for years.
the-idea-of-you-2024: A divorced art gallery owner about to turn 40 falls into a romance with the much younger lead singer of a world-famous boy band.
utsavam-2024: A man passionate about theatre sets out to revive the old tradition of Surabhi stage plays in modern times.
adiyae-2023: A man who has loved a famous singer since school days is transported to a parallel universe where his life is very different.
bommai-nayagi-2023: A simple tea-stall worker whose world revolves around his family fights for justice after his young daughter is assaulted.
ganapath-2023: In 2070, in a world divided by a wall between the rich and the poor, a young fighter rises to become the saviour of the oppressed.
eileen-2023: In 1964 Massachusetts, a lonely secretary at a juvenile prison is drawn into a dark secret by a glamorous new colleague.
heart-of-stone-2023: An intelligence operative in a secret peacekeeping group races to protect its most valuable asset, a powerful AI, from a hacker.
love-again-2023: Grieving her fiancé, a woman keeps texting his old number, which now belongs to a journalist who falls for her through her messages.
rebel-2024: A young Tamil man from Munnar joins a college in Palakkad and is drawn into the conflict between Tamil and Malayali students.
madanolsavam-2023: A poor man who makes a living painting chickens is put up as a dummy candidate in an election because he shares a name with a rival candidate.
samajavaragamana-2023: A young man who hates romance and works as a ticket clerk falls in love, and learns that her family and his family are about to be related through another marriage.
neelavelicham-2023: A writer moves into an abandoned mansion believed to be haunted by the ghost of a young woman, and tries to discover her story.
aaraattu-2022: A mysterious man arrives in a Palakkad village recovering from the 2018 floods, claiming to want to buy land, but with a hidden mission.
aadavallu-meeku-johaarlu-2022: A man raised by five strong-willed women keeps having his marriage proposals rejected by them, and has to win their approval for the woman he loves.
armageddon-time-2022: In 1980 Queens, a Jewish-American boy befriends a Black classmate, and their friendship exposes the privilege and racism around them.
bhala-thandanana-2022: An accountant at an orphanage helps an investigative journalist who is looking into a series of murders.

gold-2022: A man who has bought a new car finds someone has parked a pickup truck in front of his house, and tries to find out who.
fakt-mahilao-maate-2022: After praying at a temple, a young man can suddenly hear what every woman is thinking, and decides to use his power to help people with their relationships.
monster-2022: A mysterious Sikh taxi driver becomes involved with a family, and a dangerous secret about his identity comes out.
gurthunda-seethakalam-2022: A middle-aged software engineer looks back on the women he has loved, in a remake of the Kannada film Love Mocktail.
pathonpatham-noottandu-2022: The life of Arattupuzha Velayudha Panicker, a 19th-century social reformer in Travancore who fought caste oppression.
panni-kutty-2022: A man trying to end his life is rescued by two men who joke that killing a piglet would cure his bad luck.
the-gray-man-2022: A CIA operative recruited out of prison goes on the run after uncovering the agency's secrets, with a ruthless former colleague hunting him.
super-sharanya-2022: An anxious young woman from a small town starts engineering college in Thrissur and tries to find her place among new friends.
bachelor-2021: A reckless young man who moves from Coimbatore to Bengaluru gets into a relationship that turns complicated when his girlfriend becomes pregnant.
jail-2021: Three childhood friends whose families are thrown out of their village in the name of resettlement struggle to survive and fight for their rights.
chehre-2021: A businessman stuck in a snowstorm takes shelter in a house where retired legal professionals play a game of mock trials, and he becomes the accused.
kho-kho-2021: A coach at a girls' school forms a kho kho team and trains them for a state competition.
locked-down-2021: A couple on the verge of breaking up during the London lockdown plan a diamond heist at a department store.
mandela-2021: A village split into two caste factions is on the verge of an election, and the deciding vote belongs to a barber who has never been counted.
operation-java-2021: Two unemployed engineering graduates help a cyber cell in Kochi solve real cases of online fraud, piracy and murder.
raja-raja-chora-2021: A small-time thief who lies to his girlfriend about being a software engineer struggles to keep his double life together.
seetimaarr-2021: A bank manager coaches a women's kabaddi team to fulfil his father's dream of opening a sports academy.
the-matrix-resurrections-2021: Neo, living as a video game designer with no memory of the past, is drawn back into the Matrix to find Trinity.
ghoomketu-2020: An aspiring writer from a village in Uttar Pradesh runs away to Mumbai to become a screenwriter.
evil-eye-2020: A mother in New Delhi becomes convinced that her daughter's new boyfriend in New Orleans is the reincarnation of a man from her own past.
the-witches-2020: An orphaned boy and his grandmother check into a grand Alabama hotel and stumble onto a convention of witches plotting to turn the world's children into mice.
we-can-be-heroes-2020: When aliens capture the world's superheroes, their children team up and use their own odd powers to save their parents and the planet.
1st-rank-raju-2019: Raju, raised by his father to value book knowledge above all else, tops every exam, and then has to face a world where marks aren't enough.
airaa-2019: A journalist who runs away from an arranged marriage stays with her grandmother, while a young man investigates a series of mysterious deaths linked to her.
dark-waters-2019: A corporate lawyer takes on a case against chemical giant DuPont after a farmer's cattle die mysteriously, and spends years exposing its toxic pollution.
brochevarevarura-2019: A struggling filmmaker pitches his script to an actress, and his story becomes entangled with three friends trying to help a girl in trouble.
devi-2-2019: Krishna, still haunted by spirits, travels to Mauritius with his wife Devi, who has to save him once again when two ghosts possess him.
blank-2019: A suicide bomber loses his memory in a road accident on the day of a planned attack in Mumbai, and the police race to find his targets.
firebrand-2019: A feminist divorce lawyer who fights for women in court struggles with the trauma of her own past and its effect on her marriage.
gurkha-2019: Bahadur Babu fails to become a police officer and ends up as a security guard at a shopping mall. When a gang of former soldiers seizes the mall and takes shoppers hostage, the clumsy guard becomes their unlikely hope. Sam Anton's action comedy stars Yogi Babu, Elyssa Erhardt and Anandaraj.
kaappaan-2019: Kathir is an organic farmer from Thanjavur who secretly works for military intelligence. Recruited into the Special Protection Group to guard the Prime Minister, he uncovers a plot that reaches far beyond a single assassination attempt.
ittymaani-made-in-china-2019: Ittymaani, raised in China until he was ten, runs a Chinese restaurant in Kunnamkulam, and his mother's wish for him to marry sets off a series of comic events.
isn-t-it-romantic-2019: Natalie, an architect in New York, has spent her life believing that romantic comedies are nothing but lies. After she is knocked out during a mugging, she wakes up in a world that behaves exactly like a cheesy romcom, complete with a handsome suitor and a gay best friend.
khamoshi-2019: A deaf and mute woman is left alone in a vast mansion in the countryside for a night, where a serial killer is on the loose. She must find a way to survive the hours until morning. Tamannaah Bhatia and Prabhu Deva star in Chakri Toleti's slasher thriller.
kanne-kalaimaane-2019: An organic farmer who helps poor villagers get loans falls for the new bank manager who comes to recover them.
love-action-drama-2019: Dinesh, a lazy and overconfident bachelor, sets out to win over Shobha, a successful businesswoman, with his best friend's help.
manmadhudu-2-2019: Sam, a middle-aged playboy living in Portugal, is pressured by his family to settle down and marry. To escape their demands, he hires a young woman to pose as his girlfriend, but the plan soon goes awry. Nagarjuna and Rakul Preet Singh star in Rahul Ravindran's Telugu romantic comedy.
petromax-2019: Saravanan returns from Malaysia after his parents die in the Kerala floods and wants to sell their old house, but its ghostly residents scare away every buyer. Four broke men take on the job of staying in the house to prove it is not haunted. Rohin Venkatesan's horror comedy, a remake of Anando Brahma, stars Tamannaah and Yogi Babu.
section-375-2019: A well-known film director is convicted of raping a junior costume designer. In the High Court, Tarun, a sharp defence lawyer, takes on his former trainee Hiral, who represents the woman, and the trial tests the gap between law and justice. Ajay Bahl's courtroom drama stars Akshaye Khanna, Richa Chadha, Meera Chopra and Rahul Bhat.
serenity-2019: A fishing boat captain on a tropical island is approached by his ex-wife, who asks him to kill her abusive husband, and nothing is what it seems.
sarvam-thaala-mayam-2019: Peter, the carefree son of a mridangam maker, discovers a passion for playing the drum and wants to learn from a famed maestro, Vembu Iyer. He must fight his own past and the prejudice of the classical music world to prove himself. Rajiv Menon's musical drama stars G. V. Prakash Kumar, Aparna Balamurali and Nedumudi Venu.
the-accidental-prime-minister: Sanjaya Baru, a policy analyst, becomes media adviser to Prime Minister Manmohan Singh. The film, based on Baru's memoir, depicts Singh's first term and his relationship with the leadership of the Congress party, as seen through Baru's eyes. Vijay Ratnakar Gutte's political drama stars Anupam Kher as Singh and Akshaye Khanna as Baru.
student-of-the-year-2-2019: A middle-class student joins an elite college to be with his childhood sweetheart, and competes for the Student of the Year trophy.
sivappu-manjal-pachai-2019: Madhan, a street racer, and his sister Raji are orphans who have only each other. When strict traffic police officer Rajasekar humiliates Madhan publicly and then falls for Raji, the brother and his future brother-in-law become bitter enemies. Sasi's action drama stars Siddharth, G. V. Prakash Kumar, Lijomol Jose and Kashmira Pardeshi.
watchman-2019: Bala, a young man desperate to repay a debt, breaks into a big villa one night to rob it. Inside, he finds a guard dog and a dangerous situation far bigger than he expected, and the night turns into a fight for survival. Vijay's thriller stars G. V. Prakash Kumar, who also composed the music.
the-hustle-2019: Penny, a scrappy Australian small-time con artist, and Josephine, a sophisticated British swindler who targets the world's richest men, cross paths on the French Riviera. After a rocky start, they make a bet: whoever first cons a young tech millionaire out of his money wins.
aa-bb-kk-2018: A girl branded a curse by society after her mother dies in childbirth struggles through daily life with her brother.
a-kid-like-jake-2018: Alex and Greg are loving parents in Brooklyn trying to get their four-year-old son Jake into a competitive private kindergarten. As the application process pushes them to define what makes Jake unique, including his love of dresses and princesses, they struggle to support him without drifting apart.
fanney-khan-2018: A part-time singer who never achieved his dreams kidnaps a famous singer to get his daughter a chance to sing.
hello-guru-prema-kosame-2018: Sanju, a carefree young man from Kakinada, moves to Hyderabad for an IT job and stays with a family friend, whose daughter Anu he has already annoyed on the train. As they slowly become friends, Sanju must win over not just Anu but her protective father.
