maradona-2018: Maradona, a hired goon, flees to Bengaluru after a job goes wrong and lies low in a flat belonging to a friend's relative. Stuck there, he starts to connect with the people around him, including a lonely old man and a young nurse in the building, while the men hunting him close in. Vishnu Narayan's thriller stars Tovino Thomas.
bbuddah-hoga-terra-baap-2011: Vijju, an ageing but swaggering hitman, returns to Mumbai from Paris for one last job: killing an honest police officer who has vowed to wipe out the city's gangsters. As Vijju closes in, his connection to the officer and the officer's mother turns out to be very different from what it seems.
china-town-2011: Three men who lost their fathers in a brutal attack on a Goa casino the fathers had bought together grow up separately, one as a local don. Twenty-six years later, they find their way back to Goa, where the powerful man behind the killings is still in charge. Rafi Mecartin's action comedy stars Mohanlal, Jayaram, Dileep and Kavya Madhavan.
christian-brothers-2011: Retired army captain Varghese holds a valuable land document his family must protect. When a dangerous gangster comes after them, his estranged son Christy, the black sheep of the family, returns to defend those who shut him out. Joshiy's action thriller stars Mohanlal with Suresh Gopi, Dileep and Sarathkumar.
dhool-2011: Guru, a carefree unemployed youth, falls for Priya after seeing her at a temple. Her rich and fiercely possessive brother Nanda throws him out when he asks for her hand, and uses all his power to keep them apart. Dharani's Kannada romantic action film stars Yogesh, Aindrita Ray and Prakash Raj.
dongala-mutha-2011: Sudheer and Rani, driving to a friend's wedding, take a shortcut and end up stranded at a shabby, half-empty resort with a strange staff. A gang of crooks is hiding out there too, and the couple are drawn into a deadly game. Ram Gopal Varma's quickly shot thriller stars Ravi Teja, Charmy and Prakash Raj.
delhi-belly-2011: Three broke roommates in a grimy Delhi flat, a journalist, a photographer and a cartoonist, agree to deliver a package for one of their girlfriends, not knowing it belongs to a gangster. One mix-up later, the gang is after them, and things go spectacularly wrong. Abhinay Deo's raucous comedy stars Imran Khan, Vir Das and Kunaal Roy Kapur.
dum-maaro-dum-2011: In Goa, a young man desperate for money is caught smuggling drugs, and tough cop Vishnu Kamath offers him a deal to help bring down the state's drug cartel. As Kamath hunts the mysterious drug lord, a DJ, a model and others get pulled in. Rohan Sippy's thriller stars Abhishek Bachchan, Bipasha Basu, Rana Daggubati and Prateik Babbar.
double-dhamaal-2011: The four broke friends from Dhamaal are back to their old cons. When they spot their old rival Kabir living a life of luxury, they muscle into his business, not realising Kabir and his partners have a scheme of their own. Indra Kumar's comedy sequel stars Sanjay Dutt, Riteish Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi, Javed Jaffrey, Aashish Chaudhary and Mallika Sherawat.
love-breakups-zindagi-2011: Jai and Naina, both seemingly settled in their relationships, meet at a wedding and feel an instant connection. As they and their friends go through love, break-ups and second chances, they wonder whether they have settled too soon. Sahil Sangha's romantic comedy stars Zayed Khan and Dia Mirza.
ko-2011: Ashwin, a daring photojournalist, captures a bank robbery by Naxalites on camera. As his reporting starts to shake up state politics, he backs a young idealist running for office against corrupt veterans, and finds the battle more dangerous than he expected. K. V. Anand's political thriller stars Jiiva, Ajmal Ameer, Karthika Nair and Piaa Bajpai.
mr-perfect-2011: Prabhas plays a carefree young man who refuses to change himself for love, until he meets someone who accepts him as he is, with Kajal Aggarwal.
nadunisi-naaygal-2011: Veera, rescued as a boy from a deeply abusive home by a kind neighbour, grows into a disturbed young man who abducts women. When he kidnaps Sukanya, a young doctor, she must find a way to survive. Gautham Vasudev Menon's dark psychological thriller, made without songs or a background score, stars Veera and Sameera Reddy.
one-day-2011: Emma and Dexter meet on the night of their graduation on 15 July 1988. The film revisits them on that same date every year for two decades as their friendship, careers and romances rise and fall. Lone Scherfig's romantic drama, based on David Nicholls's novel, stars Anne Hathaway and Jim Sturgess.
pillaiyar-theru-kadaisi-veedu: Ganesan, a carefree village youth and fan of T. Rajendar, falls for Sandhya, his sister's friend visiting for the holidays. Just as he gathers courage to tell her, his cousin Valli, whose father wants her married off, turns up with problems of her own. Kishore Tirumala's drama stars Jithan Ramesh and Sanchita Padukone.
puttakkana-highway-2011: Puttakka, a poor farm worker, learns that her family's small plot of land will be taken over for a new highway. She travels to the city to plead with ministers and officials, and finds herself up against a land-grab racket. B. Suresha's Kannada drama stars Shruti and Prakash Raj, and won the National Award for Best Kannada Film.
rajadhani-2011: Raja and his friends, a group of jobless young men in Bangalore, drift through life until a contractor offers them easy money for crime. As they slip deeper into the underworld, their families and futures are put at risk. Sowmya Sathyan's Kannada crime drama stars Yash, Prakash Raj and Sheena Shahabadi.
pranayam-2011: Achutha Menon, recovering from a heart attack, moves in with his son's family and discovers that his former wife, Grace, lives in the same building with her husband Mathews. The meeting stirs up old feelings and tests the people around them. Blessy's romantic drama stars Anupam Kher, Jaya Prada and Mohanlal.
rajanna-2011: In the early 1950s, under feudal rule in a Telangana village, Mallamma, a young girl gifted with a beautiful voice, sets out to meet the Prime Minister. Her journey brings to light the story of Rajanna, a folk singer and rebel who fought the oppressive rulers. V. Vijayendra Prasad's period drama stars Nagarjuna, Sneha and Baby Annie.
ready-2011: Prem, the cheerful son of a big Delhi family, is thrown into chaos when Sanjana, a runaway bride, poses as the girl his family has chosen for him. As he falls for her, he must outwit her greedy uncles, who want her married off for her fortune. Anees Bazmee's remake of the Telugu hit stars Salman Khan and Asin.
rascals-2011: Chetan and Bhagat, two con men, rob the same rich target, Anthony, and then end up in Bangkok competing to swindle him again and win over Khushi, a philanthropist they both fancy. Their rivalry spirals into chaos. David Dhawan's comedy stars Sanjay Dutt, Ajay Devgn, Arjun Rampal and Kangana Ranaut.
rowthiram-2011: Shiva, trained in martial arts by his grandfather to stand up against evil, cannot stop himself from fighting injustice. When he clashes with a gang led by a notorious don, his parents' hopes for a quiet life are put at risk. Gokul's action drama stars Jiiva and Shriya Saran.
rio-2011: Blu, a pampered macaw who cannot fly, lives happily with his owner in snowy Minnesota. When he is taken to Rio de Janeiro to meet the last female of his species, the two birds are kidnapped by smugglers and must escape through the city. Carlos Saldanha's animated adventure features the voices of Jesse Eisenberg and Anne Hathaway.
snehaveedu-2011: Ajayan Menon, a bachelor who returns from Dubai to live with his ageing mother in his village, is surprised when a college student from Tamil Nadu arrives claiming to be his son. Sathyan Anthikad's family drama, Mohanlal's 300th film, also stars Sheela and Rahul Pillai.
solo-2011: Gautham, an orphan who longs for a big, loving family, falls for Vaishnavi, whose father wants her to marry into a large household. To win her, Gautham must find a way to prove he can give her the family life her father wants. Parasuram's Telugu romantic drama stars Nara Rohit and Nisha Agarwal, with music by Mani Sharma.
sri-rama-rajyam-2011: After his victory over Ravana, Rama rules Ayodhya in peace, until gossip about Sita's captivity forces him to send her into exile. In the forest, Sita raises their twin sons, Lava and Kusa, in the ashram of the sage Valmiki. Bapu's devotional film stars Nandamuri Balakrishna, Nayanthara and Akkineni Nageswara Rao.
thank-you-2011: Three best friends in Toronto, all serial philanderers, are fooling their wives until one wife hires Kishan, a private detective who specialises in catching cheating husbands. Kishan sets out to teach the men a lesson in his own unusual way. Anees Bazmee's comedy stars Akshay Kumar, Bobby Deol, Suniel Shetty, Irrfan Khan and Sonam Kapoor.
vaanam-2011: Five strangers from very different worlds, a slum cable operator, a struggling rock musician, a sex worker, a poor weaver and a Muslim man facing suspicion, head towards the same hospital in Chennai on New Year's Eve. Krish's hyperlink drama, a remake of his Telugu film Vedam, stars Silambarasan, Bharath, Anushka Shetty and Prakash Raj.
tell-me-o-kkhuda-2011: Tanya learns she was adopted after being rescued as a baby from a fire. She sets out to find her biological parents, visiting three men who could be her father. Hema Malini's comedy drama stars Esha Deol, Dharmendra, Rishi Kapoor, Vinod Khanna and Farooq Shaikh.
venghai-2011: Selvam, the son of a respected village leader, clashes with the corrupt local MLA his father once helped elect. When the politician turns on the family, Selvam takes him on, while falling in love along the way. Hari's action comedy stars Dhanush, Tamannaah, Rajkiran and Prakash Raj.
wanted-2011: Ram Babu, a carefree young man who has never had to work, falls for Nandini, a doctor who saved his mother's life. When her family and his own past drag him into a fight with a powerful don, he must prove himself. B. V. S. Ravi's action comedy stars Gopichand, Deeksha Seth and Prakash Raj.
vastadu-naa-raju-2011: Venky, a carefree young man who wants to be a kickboxer, falls for Pooja, the sister of Narasimha, a violent goon with political ambitions. To win her, Venky must take on her powerful brother. Hemant Madhukar's action comedy stars Vishnu Manchu, Taapsee and Prakash Raj.
yeh-dooriyan-2011: Simi, a divorced dance teacher raising two children on her own, faces pressure from society to remarry. She decides she will marry only a man who truly accepts her children, and meets Raj, who may be the one. Deepshikha Nagpal writes, directs and stars in this romantic drama, with Keshav Arora and Inder Kumar.
yamla-pagla-deewana-2011: Paramvir, an NRI in Canada, learns that his father Dharam, who left home years ago with his younger brother Gajodhar, is now a con man in Banaras. He travels to India to bring his father home, and gets caught up in their schemes and a romance with a Punjabi family. Samir Karnik's comedy stars Dharmendra, Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol.
aakrosh-2010: Three medical students from Delhi go missing in a small north Indian village, and two CBI officers are sent to investigate. They run into a wall of silence, a corrupt police force and a powerful caste militia, and slowly uncover a story of honour killing that the whole village is hiding.
alexander-the-great-2010: A wealthy businessman leaves his fortune to Alexander, a son born of an affair, setting off a scramble among greedy relatives who want him dead. His other son Manu goes to find Alexander to secure the inheritance, and an unlikely bond forms between the two half-brothers. Mohanlal stars.
adhurs-2010: Twin brothers are separated at birth when one is secretly swapped with a dead baby. One grows up streetwise and works undercover for the police, while the other is raised as a timid priest. Years later, their lives become entangled in a hunt for a dangerous criminal. NTR Jr plays both roles.
baana-kaathadi-2010: Ramesh, a carefree young man who loves flying kites, accidentally ends up with Priya's pendrive containing her entire college project. After a series of clashes, the two fall in love, but Ramesh soon gets caught up in the dangerous world of a local gangster.
alice-in-wonderland-2010: Alice, now 19 and facing an unwanted marriage proposal, follows a white rabbit down a hole and returns to Underland, the fantastical world she visited as a child but has forgotten. Its inhabitants believe she is destined to slay the Jabberwocky and end the tyrannical rule of the Red Queen.
boss-engira-bhaskaran-2010: Bhaskaran, a carefree Kumbakonam youth still failing his degree exams, falls for Chandrika, a college lecturer. When she turns out to be the younger sister of his brother's wife and her family demands he get a job, he and his barber friend set out to make something of themselves. M. Rajesh directs Arya, Nayanthara and Santhanam.
collector-gari-bharya-2010: Prakash Raj and Bhumika Chawla star as husband and wife in Tekula Kripakar Reddy's Telugu family drama, whose title means 'The Collector's Wife'. Released on 5 November 2010, it was dubbed into Tamil as Penn Adimai Illai, meaning 'A woman is not a slave'.
dulha-mil-gaya-2010: Donsai, a playboy heir who hates the idea of marriage, can only claim his late father's fortune by marrying a Punjabi village girl, Samarpreet. He weds her and promptly abandons her, but she follows him to the Caribbean, transformed and with the help of a supermodel. Mudassar Aziz's romantic comedy stars Fardeen Khan, Sushmita Sen and Ishita Sharma.
dhobi-ghat-2010: Four lives cross in Mumbai: a reclusive painter, an American banker exploring the city through photography, a washerman who dreams of acting, and a young newlywed whose video diaries the painter finds in his new flat. Kiran Rao's quiet debut stars Aamir Khan, Prateik Babbar, Monica Dogra and Kriti Malhotra.
four-friends-2010: Four strangers, a millionaire, a small-time goon who idolises Kamal Haasan, an MBA student and a medical student, meet at a hospital where they are all being treated for cancer. They become friends and decide to live their remaining time to the fullest. Saji Surendran's drama stars Jayaram, Kunchacko Boban, Jayasurya and Meera Jasmine.
golimaar-2010: Gangaram, an orphan who becomes an honest police officer, is made an encounter specialist and starts taking down the city's gangsters. His success makes enemies inside the force, and he soon finds himself betrayed and fighting alone. Puri Jagannadh's action film stars Gopichand and Priyamani.
golmaal-3-2010: Two families of tricksters, the brothers Madhav, Lakshman and Lucky, and the duo Gopal and Laxman, are constant rivals. When their widowed parents turn out to be old sweethearts who decide to marry, the bickering siblings become one chaotic family. Rohit Shetty's comedy stars Ajay Devgn, Kareena Kapoor, Arshad Warsi and Mithun Chakraborty.
housefull-2010: Aarush is so unlucky that a Macau casino hires him to jinx winning tables. Hoping to change his luck, he heads to London, where his friend Bob helps him find a bride, but a string of lies and mix-ups soon land them both in trouble. Sajid Khan's comedy stars Akshay Kumar, Ritesh Deshmukh, Deepika Padukone, Lara Dutta and Arjun Rampal.
hoo-2010: V. Ravichandran directs and stars in a Kannada romance with Meera Jasmine and Namitha, a remake of Vikraman's Priyamana Thozhi.
isi-life-mein-2010: Rajnandini, a state topper from a conservative family in Ajmer, is sent to Mumbai on the pretext of learning cooking but secretly enrols in college. There she joins a theatre group and falls for a confident fellow student, while hiding her new life from her father. Vidhi Kasliwal's drama stars debutants Akshay Oberoi and Sandeepa Dhar.
jaane-kahan-se-aayi-hai-2010: Rajesh, a clapper boy who has been rejected by women all his life, has a woman literally fall from the sky into his arms. She is Tara, from Venus, who has come to Earth looking for love. Milap Zaveri's science fiction romantic comedy stars Riteish Deshmukh and Jacqueline Fernandez.
janakan-2010: Vishwanathan, a grieving father, is arrested for killing three men who he holds responsible for destroying his daughter's life. Advocate Suryanarayanan, one of the country's best lawyers, takes up his defence and digs into what really happened. N. R. Sanjeev's crime thriller, written by S. N. Swami, stars Mohanlal and Suresh Gopi.
kadhalagi-2010: Four friends meet a short-tempered stranger on a train who claims young people today are useless. As they travel, flashbacks reveal their college friendships, ambitions and romances, and they set out to prove him wrong. K. R. Vishwaa's coming-of-age film stars a cast of newcomers, with Prakash Raj.
kedi-2010: Rummy, a gambler who wants to become rich to marry his childhood love, plans a big score in Goa. Teaming up with a pub owner who runs illegal gambling, he gets pulled into a dangerous scheme. Kiran Kumar's action comedy stars Nagarjuna, Mamta Mohandas and Ankur Vikal.
kites-2010: J, a dance teacher in Las Vegas who makes money through sham marriages, falls for Natasha, a Mexican woman about to marry the violent son of a casino owner. When they run away together, the family's henchmen chase them across the American Southwest. Anurag Basu's romantic thriller stars Hrithik Roshan, Barbara Mori and Kangana Ranaut.
khatta-meetha-2010: Sachin Tichkule, a small-time road contractor in Maharashtra, dreams big but cannot afford the bribes needed to win contracts. When his ex-girlfriend becomes the new municipal commissioner and corruption runs through his own family, he is caught in the middle. Priyadarshan's political satire stars Akshay Kumar, Trisha and Rajpal Yadav.
kutty-2010: Kutty, a free-spirited college student, falls for Geetha and declares his love at once, but she is already in a relationship with Arjun, a possessive rich boy. Kutty keeps showing up in their lives with cheerful persistence. Mithran Jawahar's remake of Arya stars Dhanush, Shriya Saran and Sameer Dattani.
lamhaa-2010: Vikram, an Indian intelligence officer, goes undercover in Kashmir as a journalist to find who is behind a fresh wave of violence. Working with a local fixer, he meets a separatist leader's daughter, her mentor and a rising politician, and slowly uncovers who profits from the conflict. Rahul Dholakia's thriller stars Sanjay Dutt, Bipasha Basu, Kunal Kapoor and Anupam Kher.
lafangey-parindey-2010: A street fighter in Mumbai helps a dancer who has lost her sight train for a skating competition, with Neil Nitin Mukesh and Deepika Padukone.
moscowin-kavery-2010: Moscow and Kavery, two IT professionals in Chennai, fall in love and move in together, but soon find themselves drifting apart. Then a wanted criminal comes across their house and plans to harm them. Cinematographer Ravi Varman's directorial debut stars Rahul and Samantha in her first film, with music by Thaman.
magizhchi-2010: A devoted brother arranges a good marriage for his sister, only for her husband to send her back home a few months later. Heartbroken but determined, the brother sets out to mend her marriage and restore her happiness. V. Gowthaman's drama, based on Neela Padmanabhan's novel Thalaimuraigal, stars Gowthaman, Anjali, Karthika, Seeman and Prakash Raj.
love-and-other-drugs-2010: In the 1990s, Jamie, a smooth-talking pharmaceutical salesman, meets Maggie, a free-spirited artist with early-onset Parkinson's disease. They agree to keep things casual, but find themselves falling in love as his career takes off with a new drug. Edward Zwick's romantic comedy drama stars Jake Gyllenhaal and Anne Hathaway.
naanu-nanna-kanasu-2010: Prakash Raj plays a doting father who struggles to accept his daughter's choice of husband, in a Kannada remake of Abhiyum Naanum.
prem-kaa-game-2010: Prem, a married man with a young daughter, finds his comfortable family life shaken when a glamorous model moves in next door. As his attraction to her grows, his marriage starts to suffer, setting off a chain of comic lies. Ashok Kheny's romantic comedy stars Arbaaz Khan, Tara Sharma and Madhuri Bhattacharya, with Salman Khan as narrator.
peepli-live-2010: Natha, a debt-ridden farmer about to lose his land, is talked into announcing he will end his life so his family can collect government compensation. With elections near, his village is swamped by TV crews and politicians, all turning his plight into a circus. Anusha Rizvi's satire stars Omkar Das Manikpuri, Raghubir Yadav and Naseeruddin Shah.
pyaar-impossible-2010: A geeky programmer (Uday Chopra) falls for a beautiful college classmate (Priyanka Chopra) and gets a second chance years later.
raavanan-2010: Veera, a tribal leader the police call an outlaw, kidnaps Raagini, the wife of the officer who has been hunting him. As her husband leads a manhunt through the forests, Raagini begins to see another side of her captor. Mani Ratnam's Tamil take on the Ramayana stars Vikram, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Prithviraj.
raavan-2010: Beera, a tribal leader seen as an outlaw by the police, kidnaps Raagini, the wife of the officer who has been hunting him. As her husband leads a manhunt through the forests, Raagini begins to see a different side of her captor. Mani Ratnam's retelling of the Ramayana stars Abhishek Bachchan, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Vikram.
ragada-2010: Satya, a sharp and money-minded young man, gets drawn into a power struggle between two rival gangsters in Hyderabad. Playing both sides with cunning, he rises fast, but his real aim is far more personal. Veeru Potla's action comedy stars Nagarjuna, Anushka Shetty and Priyamani.
shahrukh-bola-khoobsurat-hai-t: Laali, a flower seller in Mumbai, is a devoted Shah Rukh Khan fan who dreams of meeting him. One day, she sells flowers to the star himself, and he tells her she is beautiful, which changes how she sees herself and her life. Makrand Deshpande's drama stars Preetika Chawla and Afzaal Khan, with Shah Rukh Khan as himself.
simha-2010: Srimannarayana, a hot-headed university lecturer in Hyderabad, cannot tolerate injustice. When he accidentally wakes a man from a 28-year coma, a hidden family history comes to light involving a respected doctor and the ruthless men who wronged him. Boyapati Srinu's action drama stars Nandamuri Balakrishna in a dual role, with Nayanthara and Namitha.
super-2010: Subhash Chandra Gandhi, a London billionaire, falls for Indira, who challenges him to live as an ordinary citizen in India. Shaken by what he sees in Bangalore, he dreams of transforming the country into a utopia. Upendra's dystopian political satire, its title shown only by a symbol, stars Upendra and Nayanthara.
teen-patti-2010: Venkat, a maths professor, discovers a formula for predicting card games. Testing it in underground poker games with a young colleague and some students, they win big, but the game soon turns dangerous. Leena Yadav's thriller stars Amitabh Bachchan, Ben Kingsley, R. Madhavan and Shraddha Kapoor in her debut.
sura-2010: Sura, a brave fisherman in a coastal village, protects his people from a corrupt minister who wants to take over their land for a commercial project. Along the way he falls for Poornima, a young woman who has just arrived in the village. S. P. Rajkumar's action comedy, Vijay's 50th film, stars Vijay, Tamannaah and Vadivelu.
thakita-thakita-2010: A close-knit group of college friends navigate love, rivalry and ambition as their student years throw up tests of loyalty. Sreehari Nanu's Telugu coming-of-age film, produced by choreographer Bharat Thakur, stars Harshvardhan Rane in his debut, with Haripriya and Aditi Chengappa.
theeradha-vilaiyattu-pillai-20: Karthik, a jobless young man who always wants the best of everything, decides to choose a wife the same way, dating three women at once to find the perfect match. His plan runs into trouble when one of them is tied to a dangerous gangster. Thiru's romantic action comedy stars Vishal, Sarah-Jane Dias, Tanushree Dutta and Neetu Chandra.
tees-maar-khan-2010: Tabrez Mirza Khan, a flamboyant con man, is hired to steal a priceless treasure from a moving train. His plan: pretend to shoot a film in a small village near the tracks and use the villagers and a vain movie star to pull off the heist. Farah Khan's comedy stars Akshay Kumar, Katrina Kaif and Akshaye Khanna.
uthama-puthiran-2010: Siva, a cheerful young man from a large family, helps his cousin elope and is cast out by his elders. He then accidentally kidnaps Pooja, a runaway bride escaping her greedy uncles, and hides her in his own family's house. Mithran Jawahar's remake of the Telugu film Ready stars Dhanush and Genelia.
thillalangadi-2010: Krishna, a carefree young man who lives for the thrill, or kick, of risky situations, falls for Nisha, who finds his recklessness maddening. Later, a mysterious thief starts robbing the rich, and a determined police officer sets out to catch him, pulling Nisha back into Krishna's orbit. M. Raja's remake of Kick stars Jayam Ravi, Tamannaah and Shaam.
8-x-10-tasveer-2009: Jai, a forest ranger in Canada, can enter a photograph and relive events through the eyes of anyone in it. After his father dies in a boating accident, a detective persuades him that it was murder, and Jai uses his gift to work out who was responsible.
aga-aga-sunbai-kay-mhant: Kedar Shinde's Marathi family drama about a mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, led by Nirmiti Sawant and Prarthana Behere. It opened in January 2026 and did well at the box office.
ayogya-2: Sathish Ninasam and Rachita Ram return in S. Mahesh Kumar's Kannada action comedy, a sequel to his 2018 hit Ayogya with most of the original cast back.
desu7: Dev directs for the first time and also stars in this Bengali romantic action thriller, opposite Subhashree Ganguly, with Anirban Bhattacharya in a key role.
hai-jawani-toh-ishq-hona: David Dhawan's Hindi romantic comedy pairs his son Varun Dhawan with Mrunal Thakur, produced by Ramesh Taurani's Tips Films.
prakambanam: A Malayalam horror comedy from Vijesh Panathur, with Ganapathi, Sagar Surya and Al Ameen as young men caught up in spooky goings-on.
the-drama: An engaged couple, played by Zendaya and Robert Pattinson, see their relationship shaken by a revelation in the week before their wedding. A dark romantic comedy from Kristoffer Borgli for A24.
the-end-of-oak-street: David Robert Mitchell's science-fiction survival story follows a family whose suburban street is suddenly cut off from the world, with Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor as the parents.
thudakkam: Jude Anthany Joseph's Malayalam martial arts drama marks the screen debut of Vismaya Mohanlal, daughter of actor Mohanlal, in the lead. Produced by Antony Perumbavoor under Aashirvad Cinemas, the film also stars Ashish Joe Antony, Bobby Kurian, Sai Kumar, Manoj K. Jayan and K. B. Ganesh Kumar.
ustaad-bhagat-singh: Pawan Kalyan plays the title role in Harish Shankar's Telugu action comedy, with Sreeleela and Raashii Khanna, produced by Mythri Movie Makers.
tere-ishk-mein-2025: Aanand L. Rai's intense romance, billed as a spiritual follow-up to Raanjhanaa, follows Shankar (Dhanush) and his volatile bond with Mukti (Kriti Sanon).
nadikar-2024: Tovino Thomas plays a fading superstar whose arrogance has begun to cost him his career, in Lal Jr.'s Malayalam comedy drama about the film industry.
purushothamudu-2024: Raj Tarun plays the heir to a wealthy family who must live among ordinary villagers before he can claim his place, in this Telugu action drama.
swag-2024: Sree Vishnu plays five different roles across generations in Hasith Goli's Telugu black comedy about a family feud over gender and inheritance.
adrishya-jalakangal-2023: Dr. Biju's anti-war Malayalam film follows a nameless man drifting through a land under military threat, with Tovino Thomas and Nimisha Sajayan.
alone-2023: Mohanlal is the only actor on screen in Shaji Kailas's lockdown thriller, as a man in an isolated flat who starts hearing voices and suspects a crime.
bandra-2023: Dileep plays a gangster who falls for a film actress, played by Tamannaah Bhatia in her Malayalam debut, in Arun Gopy's romantic crime drama.
kunjamminis-hospital-2023: A Malayalam comic fantasy with a dash of horror from first-time director Sanal V. Devan, with Indrajith Sukumaran, Nyla Usha and Prakash Raj.
khufiya-2023: Tabu plays an R&AW operative tracking a mole who is leaking state secrets, in Vishal Bhardwaj's spy thriller based on Amar Bhushan's novel Escape to Nowhere.
lucky-man-2023: Yogi Babu plays a hard-up man whose luck seems to turn when he wins a car, in Balaji Venugopal's Tamil comedy drama.
lust-stories-2-2023: A second anthology of four short films about desire and relationships, directed by R. Balki, Konkona Sen Sharma, Amit Ravindernath Sharma and Sujoy Ghosh.
pranaya-vilasam-2023: A Malayalam family drama about young love and an older love story coming to light, with Anaswara Rajan, Arjun Ashokan and Mamitha Baiju.
alluri-2022: Sree Vishnu plays an honest police officer named Alluri Sita Ramaraju, whose career is retold through the eyes of a constable's son.
dear-friend-2022: A group of friends in Bengaluru have their lives turned upside down when one of them disappears, in Vineeth Kumar's Malayalam thriller with Tovino Thomas.
godavari-2022: Jitendra Joshi plays a man from an old Nashik family whose relationship with his father and the Godavari river shapes his life, in Nikhil Mahajan's Marathi drama.
rashtra-kavach-om-2022: Aditya Roy Kapur plays a commando who loses his memory and must piece his past together to stop a national threat.
plan-a-plan-b-2022: Riteish Deshmukh plays a divorce lawyer and Tamannaah Bhatia a matchmaker who cross paths in this Netflix romantic comedy.
selfie-2022: G. V. Prakash Kumar plays an engineering student who gets drawn into a corrupt college admissions racket, with Gautham Vasudev Menon as the man behind it.
varaal-2022: Anoop Menon wrote and stars in this Malayalam political drama about power struggles behind an election, with Prakash Raj and Sunny Wayne.
alludu-adhurs-2021: Bellamkonda Sreenivas plays a young man caught in a love triangle, with Sonu Sood and Prakash Raj, in this Sankranthi action comedy.
arjuna-phalguna-2021: A group of village friends are unwittingly pulled into cannabis smuggling and then have to take on the system, with Sree Vishnu and Amritha Aiyer.
koi-jaane-na-2021: Kunal Kapoor plays a novelist who gets drawn into a string of murders that seem to follow his own book, with Amyra Dastur.
ab-aani-cd-2020: Vikram Gokhale plays an elderly man who tries to meet a superstar, in a Marathi comedy with a cameo by Amitabh Bachchan.
big-brother-2020: Mohanlal plays a man released after years in prison who sets out to protect his family from a criminal gang, in Siddique's last film.
100-kadhal-2019: G. V. Prakash Kumar and Shalini Pandey play cousins and rivals whose competition turns into romance, in this Tamil remake of 100% Love.
action-2019: Vishal plays an army officer chasing a terrorist across countries after an attack kills his family, with Tamannaah Bhatia, in Sundar C's action thriller.
azhiyatha-kolangal-2-2019: Two former lovers meet again late in life and look back on what might have been, with Prakash Raj, Revathi and Archana.
edakkad-battalion-06-2019: Shafeek's father wanted him to become a chef, but he chose to join the Indian Army instead. When he comes home on annual leave, the young soldier has to deal with his family, his bride-to-be and a local gang involved in illegal activities.
fraud-saiyaan-2019: Bhola is a smooth con man who marries wealthy women in different towns and lives off them. When his wife's uncle, a detective hired by the police to catch him, discovers his scams, he hides his identity and becomes Bhola's partner while following his trail of marriages.
kalki-2019: Nanjenkotta, a fictional town on the Kerala–Tamil Nadu border, lives in fear of Amarnath, leader of a political party whose goons control everything from elections to illegal gun factories. A fearless new police officer arrives in town determined to break the gang's hold. Tovino Thomas stars in Praveen Prabharam's action thriller.
kuppathu-raja-2019: G. V. Prakash Kumar and Parthiban play feuding neighbours in a Chennai slum, in this comedy drama from choreographer Baba Bhaskar.
prassthanam-2019: Baldev Pratap Singh, a powerful four-time MLA in Uttar Pradesh, has raised his stepson Ayushman as his political heir, while his own wayward son Vivaan resents it. As an election nears, family rivalries and ambition tear the household apart. Deva Katta's Hindi remake of his Telugu film stars Sanjay Dutt, Ali Fazal, Manisha Koirala and Jackie Shroff.
ruler-2019: Nandamuri Balakrishna plays a man with two lives, an industrialist and a tough police officer, in K. S. Ravikumar's action drama.
yajamana-2019: Krishna watches over Hulidurga, a village whose oil mill is run by Hulikar Nayaka, the father of Kaveri, the woman he loves. When a ruthless oil baron sets out to take over the village's trade, Krishna fights to protect its farmers and their livelihood. V. Harikrishna and Pon Kumaran's Kannada action drama stars Darshan, Rashmika Mandanna and Tanya Hope.
ente-ummante-peru-2018: After his father's death, Hamid, a young man in northern Kerala, believes he has no family left. Then he learns his mother may be alive, and sets out on a search that brings him to Aishumma, a sharp-tongued older woman, and leads them all the way to Lucknow. Jose Sebastian's road comedy drama stars Tovino Thomas and Urvashi.
drama-2018: Rosamma, a widowed mother from Kerala, dies in her sleep soon after moving to London. Her children scattered across the world must arrange her funeral, and they hire a pair of funeral organisers who turn the occasion into an unpredictable show. Ranjith's comedy drama stars Mohanlal, Arundathi Nag and Asha Sharath.
jai-simha-2018: Narasimha, a quiet man raising a young child on his own, settles in the temple town of Kumbakonam and tries to live peacefully. When trouble flares in the town, the violent past he has been running from catches up with him. K. S. Ravikumar's action drama stars Nandamuri Balakrishna, Nayanthara, Haripriya and Natasha Doshi.
loveyatri-2018: During the Navratri festival in Vadodara, Sushrut, a local boy who dreams of opening a garba academy, falls for Michelle, a wealthy NRI student visiting from London. Their romance blossoms over nine nights of dance, until her disapproving father decides to take her back.
naa-nuvve-2018: Meera, a cheerful radio jockey who believes in destiny, falls for Varun, a confident young man who believes only in himself. As fate and coincidence keep bringing them together, their love is put to the test. Jayendra Panchapakesan's romantic drama stars Nandamuri Kalyan Ram and Tamannaah.
naachiyaar-2018: Naachiyaar, a tough assistant commissioner in Chennai, takes up the case of Arasi, an underage girl who is pregnant, and Kaathu, the boy accused. As she digs into the case, she finds a harder truth. Bala's crime drama stars Jyothika, G. V. Prakash Kumar and Ivana.
mohalla-assi-2018: Dharmanath Pandey, an orthodox priest and Sanskrit teacher in Varanasi, refuses to let foreign tourists stay in the homes of his Assi Ghat neighbourhood. As poverty and commerce close in, his principles are put to the test. Chandraprakash Dwivedi's satire, based on Kashinath Singh's novel Kashi Ka Assi, stars Sunny Deol and Sakshi Tanwar.
needi-naadi-oke-katha-2018: Sree Vishnu plays a young man who keeps failing exams and struggles under his father's expectations, in Venu Udugula's satire on the education system.
neerali-2018: Sunny, a gemologist, is racing to the hospital where his wife is about to give birth when his jeep plunges off a mountain road and hangs over a gorge. Trapped inside with his driver, he must find a way to survive. Ajoy Varma's survival thriller stars Mohanlal, Suraj Venjaramoodu and Nadhiya.
next-enti-2018: Tamannaah Bhatia and Sundeep Kishan play two people who keep meeting over the years, in Kunal Kohli's Telugu take on his own Hum Tum.
ocean-s-8-2018: Debbie Ocean (Sandra Bullock) gathers an all-women crew to steal a diamond necklace at the Met Gala, in this spin-off of the Ocean's films.
officer-2018: Sivaji Rao, an honest IPS officer from Hyderabad, is sent to Mumbai as part of a special team to investigate a celebrated encounter specialist accused of wrongdoing. His probe makes him a target, and danger soon reaches his young daughter. Ram Gopal Varma's action film stars Nagarjuna and Myra Sareen.
oru-kuprasidha-payyan-2018: Ajayan, a timid young hotel worker, often visits an elderly woman who treats him like a son. When she is found murdered, the police, under pressure to close the case, pin it on him, and a young lawyer takes up his defence. Madhupal's crime drama stars Tovino Thomas, Nimisha Sajayan, Anu Sithara and Saranya Ponvannan.
pahuna-the-little-visitors-201: Fleeing the Maoist conflict in Nepal, three young siblings are separated from their parents and end up in a village in Sikkim. Wary of the adults around them, they set up home on their own and try to survive. Pakhi Tyrewala's Nepali-language children's film was produced by Priyanka Chopra and Madhu Chopra.
parahuna-2018: Janta is obsessed with the 1980s film actress Preeti Sapru and wants to marry a woman who looks just like her. When a friend says his sister-in-law is her double, Janta goes to a family wedding to woo her, and ends up solving other people's romantic troubles along the way. This Punjabi comedy stars Kulwinder Billa and Wamiqa Gabbi.
prema-baraha-2018: Sanjay and Madhu are journalists working for rival news channels who cannot stand each other. When both are sent to cover the Kargil War, the danger they share draws them closer. Arjun Sarja's romantic drama, made in Kannada and Tamil, stars Chandan Kumar and Aishwarya Arjun.
seemaraja-2018: Seemaraja, the easygoing heir of a zamindar family in Tirunelveli, falls for Selvi, a school sports teacher. When a ruthless rival tries to seize the village's land and Selvi's family is caught in the feud, he must live up to his legendary ancestor. Ponram's action comedy stars Sivakarthikeyan, Samantha and Simran.
saheb-biwi-aur-gangster-3-2018: The fading royal Aditya Pratap Singh crosses paths with a gangster-turned-gambler played by Sanjay Dutt, in the third film of Tigmanshu Dhulia's series.
sei-2018: A carefree young man who dreams of becoming an actor, is drawn into a dangerous mystery after a fire at a mental asylum uncovers an organ-trafficking racket. As powerful people try to bury the truth, he finds himself caught in their web. Raj Babu's action comedy stars Nakkhul, Aanchal Munjal and Prakash Raj.
seizer-2018: Seizer, an employee of a private finance company who repossesses vehicles from defaulters, seizes a car belonging to a powerful gangster. The confrontation sparks a bitter, violent feud between the two. Vinay Krishna's Kannada action film stars Chiranjeevi Sarja, Parul Yadav, V. Ravichandran and Prakash Raj.
sketch-2018: Vikram plays a man who repossesses vehicles for a moneylender in north Chennai, until a string of murders puts his gang in danger. Tamannaah Bhatia co-stars.
summer-holidays-2018: Four children and their dog Bheema set out on a summer trip to the hills of Chikkamagaluru. What starts as a fun holiday turns into an eerie adventure. Kavitha Lankesh's children's film, made in English and Kannada, stars Esha Lankesh, Samarjit Lankesh, Sonia Hegde and Anish Angre, with Prakash Raj.
traffic-ramasamy-2018: Ramasamy, an elderly social activist, has spent years filing public interest cases against illegal hoardings, corruption and road safety violations. His relentless fight makes him powerful enemies. Vicky's biographical drama, based on the real-life activist, stars S. A. Chandrasekhar, Rohini and Prakash Raj, with Vijay Sethupathi in a cameo.
welcome-to-new-york-2018: Teji, a recovery agent who dreams of acting, and Jeenal, a fashion designer, win trips to a big Bollywood awards show in New York. They find themselves pulled into its backstage chaos, a kidnapping plot and a lookalike of the show's host. Chakri Toleti's 3D comedy stars Diljit Dosanjh, Sonakshi Sinha and Karan Johar.
yamla-pagla-deewana-phir-se-20: Dharmendra, Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol reunite for the third Yamla Pagla Deewana, a comedy about a family's herbal remedy and the people trying to steal it.
1971-beyond-borders-2017: While serving with UN peacekeepers, Colonel Mahadevan meets a Pakistani officer whose father was killed in the 1971 war. The story then returns to 1971, when Mahadevan's father, Major Sahadevan, led Indian tanks on the western front against a Pakistani commander who was an honourable soldier too. Mohanlal plays both roles.
achayans-2017: Four friends who get drunk the night before one of their weddings are sent to a de-addiction centre, but are thrown out. On a road trip they are joined by two women escaping trouble, and when one of them is found dead the morning after New Year's Eve, the friends must find out who killed her.
aaradugula-bullet-2017: Gopichand plays an idle young man who becomes the protector of his family, with Nayanthara, in B. Gopal's long-delayed Telugu action comedy.
anbanavan-asaradhavan-adangadh: In Dubai, a police officer hunting a notorious don hears the story of Madurai Michael, a feared 1990s thug who promised the woman he loved that he would give up crime. When he is betrayed and jailed, his life takes a very different turn. Silambarasan plays dual roles.
baywatch-2017: Lifeguard Mitch Buchannon (Dwayne Johnson) and a cocky new recruit (Zac Efron) stumble onto a drug-smuggling plot, in this comedy version of the TV series.
anjani-putra-2017: Raja, disowned by his mother, the matriarch of a wealthy family, after a misunderstanding, now works as a moneylender and falls for a rich girl, Geetha. When he saves a police officer from hired killers, he is drawn into a fight with Bhairava, a businessman trying to grab land his late father gave to a village temple.
chamak-2017: Kush, a gynaecologist who prizes his freedom, marries Kushi because she seems quiet and traditional. Soon he discovers she is just as free-spirited as he is, and married him for exactly the same reason. They decide to split, but must keep up appearances for their families. Suni's Kannada romantic comedy stars Ganesh and Rashmika Mandanna.
bruce-lee-2017: Bruce Lee, a timid young man, and his friend Abbas drift through life until Lee accidentally photographs a ruthless don murdering a minister. With the gangster, crooked officials and even the police hunting for the camera, the hapless pair are forced to fight back. Prasanth Pandiyaraj's action comedy stars G. V. Prakash Kumar and Kriti Kharbanda.
dora-2017: Nayanthara plays a woman who buys an old car for her travel business, only to discover it is possessed and out for revenge.
gowdru-hotel-2017: A young man who dreams of becoming a chef abroad ends up working at his grandfather's old roadside eatery. Through cooking for ordinary people, the old man teaches him that food can feed the soul as well as the stomach. Pon Kumaran's Kannada remake of the Malayalam hit Ustad Hotel stars Rachan Chandra, Vedhika and Prakash Raj.
hanuman-da-damdaar-2017: An animated adventure about the boyhood of Hanuman, made to be fun for children, with Salman Khan voicing the grown-up Hanuman.
hrudayantar-2017: Subodh Bhave and Mukta Barve play a couple whose drifting marriage is tested when their daughter falls ill, in fashion designer Vikram Phadnis's debut.
meri-pyaari-bindu-2017: Abhimanyu, a bestselling writer of pulp horror suffering from writer's block, returns to his old neighbourhood in Kolkata and begins writing about Bindu, the free-spirited girl next door he has loved since childhood, and their on-again, off-again relationship over the years.
mental-madhilo-2017: Aravind, a Hyderabad man who has always struggled to make decisions, finally gets engaged to the clear-headed Swetcha. When work takes him to Mumbai, he meets another young woman, and his old indecision returns. Vivek Athreya's debut romantic comedy stars Sree Vishnu, Nivetha Pethuraj and Amrutha Srinivasan.
nakshatram-2017: Rama Rao, born into a family of police officers, dreams of becoming a sub-inspector but keeps failing to qualify. Determined to serve anyway, he acts like a cop without a uniform and gets pulled into a dangerous case. Krishna Vamsi's action drama stars Sundeep Kishan, Regina Cassandra, Pragya Jaiswal and Sai Dharam Tej.
newton-2017: Newton, an honest and rule-bound government clerk, is sent on election duty to a remote, Maoist-affected village in the jungles of Chhattisgarh. Facing a cynical security officer and voters who have never seen a ballot, he is determined to hold a fair vote. Amit Masurkar's dark comedy stars Rajkummar Rao, Pankaj Tripathi and Anjali Patil.
nikka-zaildar-2-2017: Nikka loves Saawan, but family circumstances force him to marry his childhood friend Roop. When his family is led to believe Roop cannot have children, a second marriage with Saawan is arranged, and Nikka must sort out where his heart really lies. Simerjit Singh's Punjabi romantic comedy stars Ammy Virk, Sonam Bajwa and Wamiqa Gabbi.
om-namo-venkatesaya-2017: Nagarjuna plays Hathiram Bhavaji, a devotee of Lord Venkateswara at Tirumala, in K. Raghavendra Rao's devotional biopic with Anushka Shetty.
oru-mexican-aparatha-2017: A political drama about rival student groups on a Kerala college campus, with Tovino Thomas in the role that made him a star.
munthirivallikal-thalirkkumbol: Ulahannan, a bored panchayat secretary, has drifted far from his wife and spends his evenings drinking with neighbours. When an old friend nudges him to take his marriage seriously, he tries to rekindle the romance, while his neighbourhood offers lessons of its own. Jibu Jacob's family drama stars Mohanlal and Meena.
raabta-2017: Sushant Singh Rajput and Kriti Sanon play two strangers drawn together by a love story from a past life, in Dinesh Vijan's fantasy romance.
raju-gari-gadhi-2-2017: Three friends who buy a resort find it haunted by the spirit of a young woman. They call in Rudra, a mentalist, who digs into the ghost's past to find out what happened to her. Ohmkar's horror comedy, a remake of the Malayalam film Pretham, stars Nagarjuna, Samantha and Seerat Kapoor.
sarkar-3-2017: Amitabh Bachchan returns as Subhash Nagre, now facing threats from within his own circle, in the third Sarkar film from Ram Gopal Varma.
sarvann-2017: Sarvann is a 2017 Punjabi drama directed by Karan Guliani and written by Amberdeep Singh, produced by Priyanka Chopra's Purple Pebble Pictures as its first Punjabi film. Amrinder Gill plays the title role, with Simi Chahal and singer Ranjit Bawa.
shubh-mangal-saavdhan-2017: Mudit, a shy Delhi boy, finally wins over Sugandha and the two families arrange their wedding. But just before the big day, Mudit faces an intimate problem in the bedroom, and the families' attempts to fix it turn into a comedy of embarrassment and miscommunication.
si3-2017: Durai Singam, now a senior police officer, is sent from Tamil Nadu to Andhra Pradesh to solve the murder of the Visakhapatnam police commissioner. His trail leads to a powerful businessman running an international racket in toxic medical waste. Hari's action sequel stars Suriya, Anushka Shetty and Shruti Haasan.
ungarala-rambabu-2017: Rambabu, a rich man who loses everything, turns to a self-styled godman, Badam Baba, and becomes a firm believer in astrology after a lucky find of gold. When his fortunes dip again, the baba's advice sends him to a village and into love and trouble. Kranthi Madhav's comedy drama stars Sunil, Miya and Prakash Raj.
thondimuthalum-driksakshiyum-2: Sreeja and Prasad, a young couple who married against her family's wishes, are travelling by bus when a thief snatches her gold chain and swallows it. At the police station, the case becomes a long, absurd wait for the evidence, as the thief, the couple and the police play mind games. Dileesh Pothan's drama stars Fahadh Faasil, Suraj Venjaramoodu and Nimisha Sajayan.
velaiilla-pattadhari-2-2017: Raghuvaran, now a successful civil engineer married to Shalini, clashes with Vasundhara, the head of a powerful construction company, when he refuses to join her firm. As she sets out to crush him, he and his team of young engineers must fight back. Soundarya Rajinikanth's sequel stars Dhanush, Kajol and Amala Paul.
yaakkai-2017: Two college students fall in love, but their romance is shaken when a murder occurs and a police investigation draws them in. As the case unfolds, hidden secrets come to light and their future is thrown into doubt. Kuzhandhai Velappan's romantic crime thriller stars Krishna and Swathi Reddy, with music by Yuvan Shankar Raja.
xxx-return-of-xander-cage-2017: Xander Cage, an extreme-sports star turned secret agent, comes out of hiding to recover Pandora's Box, a device that can turn satellites into weapons. He assembles a team of thrill-seekers to take on a group of rival agents. D. J. Caruso's action film stars Vin Diesel, Deepika Padukone in her Hollywood debut and Donnie Yen.
a-aa-2016: A sheltered rich girl (Samantha) escapes her strict mother and spends time with her cousin's family in a village, where she grows close to her cousin (Nithiin).
velipadinte-pusthakam-2017: Michael Idikkula, a new vice principal, arrives at a coastal college torn by rivalry between student gangs. To bring them together, he decides to make a film about a local man's mysterious death, which leads to an old crime coming back to the surface. Lal Jose's action comedy stars Mohanlal, Anoop Menon and Anna Rajan.
appatlo-okadundevadu-2016: A journalist in Hyderabad researching the story of Railway Raju, a promising 1990s cricketer who became a gangster, learns how his life fell apart. When his sister joined a Naxalite group, Raju's career was wrecked by a police officer's investigation, and the two men became bitter enemies.
alice-through-the-looking-glas: Returning to London after years at sea, Alice finds her family's future at risk. Passing through a mirror back into Underland, she learns that the Mad Hatter is in despair over his lost family, and she must borrow a device from Time himself to travel into the past and save them.
attack-2016: After a rival gang murders their father, three brothers are drawn into a violent cycle of revenge in Ram Gopal Varma's Telugu action thriller. Manchu Manoj leads the cast with Jagapati Babu, Prakash Raj, Vadde Naveen and Surbhi, as loyalties are tested and the feud escalates.
babu-bangaram-2016: Venkatesh plays a soft-hearted police officer who falls for a woman in trouble and secretly protects her family, with Nayanthara.
colossal-2016: Gloria, an unemployed writer whose drinking has wrecked her life in New York, moves back to her small hometown and works at her childhood friend Oscar's bar. Then she discovers she is somehow linked to a giant monster attacking Seoul. Nacho Vigalondo's offbeat dark comedy stars Anne Hathaway and Jason Sudeikis.
devi-2016: Krishna, a Mumbai professional who wants a modern wife, is pushed by his family into marrying Devi, a shy village girl. Back in Mumbai, they move into a new flat where Devi suddenly turns into a glamorous, confident woman, possessed by the spirit of a would-be actress. Vijay's trilingual horror comedy stars Prabhu Deva, Tamannaah and Sonu Sood.
dharma-durai-2016: Dharmadurai, a trained doctor, has become the village drunk and an embarrassment to his brothers. When they plot against him, his mother helps him escape, and his journey brings back memories of three women who shaped his life. Seenu Ramasamy's drama stars Vijay Sethupathi, Tamannaah, Aishwarya Rajesh and Radhika Sarathkumar.
enakku-innoru-per-irukku-2016: G. V. Prakash Kumar plays a young man in north Chennai who gets pulled into a war between two local gangs, in this Tamil mafia comedy.
ghayal-once-again-2016: Sunny Deol returns as Ajay Mehra, now running an anti-corruption paper, who must protect a group of teenagers who witness a crime.
guppy-2016: Michael, known as Guppy, is a schoolboy who sells ornamental fish to support his mother and dreams of buying her a motorised wheelchair. When Thejus, an engineer building a rail overbridge, comes to their village, a small clash grows into a battle of egos. Johnpaul George's drama stars Chethan Jayalal and Tovino Thomas.
jaguar-2016: A masked vigilante called Jaguar murders a judge and broadcasts the killing on a leading news channel. Meanwhile, Krishna, a carefree new student at a medical college, falls for a fellow student, while a CBI officer begins hunting the killer, whose targets point to a hidden motive.
idolle-ramayana-2016: Bhujanga, a short-tempered businessman back from the Gulf, is a respected man in his small town. One night during the Rama Navami festival, a chance mishap leaves him locked inside his own vacant shop with a stranger, and the long night tests his pride and image. Prakash Raj directs and stars in this comedy drama, made in Kannada and Telugu.
kirik-party-2016: Karna, a rowdy first-year engineering student, falls for Saanvi, a kind and popular senior. His years at college, with its pranks, friendships and fights, shape him in ways he does not expect. Rishab Shetty's Kannada coming-of-age comedy stars Rakshit Shetty, Rashmika Mandanna in her debut and Samyuktha Hegde.
kadavul-irukaan-kumaru-2016: G. V. Prakash Kumar plays a young man caught between two women on a trip to Pondicherry, in M. Rajesh's Tamil romantic comedy.
kaththi-sandai-2016: Tamizh, a charming young man, falls for Dhivya, the sister of a tough police officer. While trying to win her family over, he becomes linked to a case involving a huge stash of money, and his hidden motives begin to surface. Suraj's action comedy stars Vishal, Tamannaah, Jagapathi Babu and Vadivelu.
ko-2-2016: Kumaran, an ordinary man, kidnaps the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, and the state machinery scrambles to find them. As the police dig into his motives, a long list of public grievances begins to surface. Sarath's political thriller, a remake of the Telugu film Prathinidhi, stars Bobby Simha, Nikki Galrani and Prakash Raj.
meen-kuzhambum-mann-paanaiyum: Annamalai, a widower who runs an Indian restaurant in Malaysia, feels his carefree son Karthik is drifting away from him. A magical twist leaves father and son swapped in each other's bodies, and each must see life from the other side. Amudheshwar's fantasy comedy stars Prabhu, Kalidas Jayaram and Ashna Zaveri.
naanu-mattu-varalakshmi-2016: Preetham Gubbi's Kannada action romance introduces Prithvi, grandson of the composer G. K. Venkatesh, in his debut lead, opposite Malavika Mohanan in her first Kannada film. Prakash Raj and Madhoo play key roles, in a story of young love caught up in family conflict.
nil-battey-sannata-2016: A housemaid in Agra (Swara Bhasker) enrols in her daughter's school class to push the girl, who has given up on studying, to take her future seriously.
nirmala-convent-2016: A village boy falls for the daughter of a rich landlord, and Nagarjuna, playing himself, comes into their story. It marked Roshan Meka's debut.
premam-2016: Naga Chaitanya follows one man through three loves, from school to college to adulthood, in this Telugu remake of the Malayalam hit Premam.
pencil-2016: Shiva, the top student at a Chennai school, is constantly bullied by Nithin, the spoilt son of a film star. When Nithin is found dead in a classroom and Shiva becomes the prime suspect, he has very little time to find the real killer. Mani Nagaraj's teen thriller, based on a Korean film, stars G. V. Prakash Kumar and Sri Divya.
puthiya-niyamam-2016: Louis, a divorce lawyer and TV film critic, lives happily with his wife Vasuki, a Kathakali artist, and their daughter. When Vasuki suddenly becomes withdrawn and distant, Louis struggles to understand what has happened to her. A. K. Sajan's thriller stars Mammootty and Nayanthara.
priyanka-2016: Based on a real case in Bengaluru, Priyanka Upendra plays a woman caught in a crime, with Prakash Raj as the investigating officer.
santhu-straight-forward-2016: Santhu, a straightforward young man, falls for Ananya, an architecture student. But Ananya is engaged to Deva, a dangerous gangster, because of her late parents' wishes, and Santhu must take on Deva to win her. Mahesh Rao's Kannada action romance stars Yash and Radhika Pandit.
shourya-2016: Shourya and Netra are in love and plan to elope to the UK. When someone tries to kill Netra at a village temple the night before they leave, Shourya is arrested for the crime, and he must find out who is really behind it. Dasaradh's romantic thriller stars Manchu Manoj and Regina Cassandra.
speedunnodu-2016: Sobhan, the son of a village president, will go to any length to help his friends. When he tries to help a friend woo Vasanthi, she falls for Sobhan instead, and her family's troubles drag him into conflict. Bhimaneni Srinivasa Rao's remake of Sundarapandian stars Bellamkonda Sreenivas, Sonarika Bhadoria and Prakash Raj.
sarbjit-2016: Randeep Hooda plays Sarabjit Singh, an Indian farmer jailed in Pakistan as a spy, and Aishwarya Rai Bachchan his sister Dalbir, who fought for his release for years.
10-endrathukulla-2015: A nameless getaway driver who calls himself by a string of famous names is hired to deliver a young woman, Shakeela, from Chennai to a village in the north. Irritated by her antics on the long road trip, he slowly falls for her, then discovers why she is being handed over.
ventilator-2016: When the eldest member of the Kamerkar family is put on a ventilator, the whole extended clan gathers at the hospital, in Rajesh Mapuskar's Marathi comedy drama.
bengal-tiger-2015: Akash, an unemployed young man from a village, throws a stone at a minister to become famous after being rejected by a girl. Impressed by his wit, the minister hires him, and Akash rises fast in political circles, but his ambitions have a hidden purpose.
darling-2015: A group of friends retreat to a house to end their lives and find it already haunted, in G. V. Prakash Kumar's acting debut, remade from the Telugu Prema Katha Chitram.
dongaata-2015: Three small-time crooks kidnap a film actress and hide her in an empty apartment owned by one gang member's boss. Then the boss unexpectedly returns from the US as a private detective hired to crack the case, and the kidnappers must play his servants. Vamsy Krishna's crime comedy stars Lakshmi Manchu, Adivi Sesh and Brahmanandam.
ennum-eppozhum-2015: Vineeth, a lazy senior reporter at a women's magazine, is told to land an interview with Deepa, a busy family-court lawyer, or lose his job. His clumsy attempts to win her over bring the two together in unexpected ways. Sathyan Anthikad's comedy drama stars Mohanlal and Manju Warrier.
guddu-rangeela-2015: Two cousins who run an orchestra party take on a kidnapping job that ties back to an honour killing, with Arshad Warsi, Amit Sadh and Ronit Roy.
dum-laga-ke-haisha-2015: In 1990s Haridwar, a school dropout (Ayushmann Khurrana) is pushed into marrying an overweight, educated woman (Bhumi Pednekar), and the pair slowly learn to respect each other.
hey-bro-2015: Gopi, a simple villager, travels to Mumbai to find his mother and his long-lost twin brother. When he finally finds his brother, he discovers the two have completely opposite personalities, and trouble follows. Ajay Chandhok's action comedy stars choreographer Ganesh Acharya, Maninder Singh and Nupur Sharma, with several stars in cameos.
hawaizaada-2015: In 1890s Bombay, Shivkar Talpade, a restless young dreamer, teams up with an eccentric scientist to build a flying machine years before the Wright brothers. As they chase the dream, they must face doubters and colonial authorities. Vibhu Puri's period drama stars Ayushmann Khurrana, Mithun Chakraborty and Pallavi Sharda.
hero-2015: A gangster's son falls for the daughter of the police officer he has been told to kidnap, in Salman Khan's remake of the 1983 Hero, launching Sooraj Pancholi and Athiya Shetty.
jazbaa-2015: A top lawyer (Aishwarya Rai Bachchan) is forced to defend a convicted criminal after her daughter is kidnapped, with Irrfan Khan as her policeman friend.
kanal-2015: During the global recession, two strangers, John David and Ananda Raman, meet on a train journey and begin talking. As their stories unfold, links to the Gulf crisis and a past wrong come to light. M. Padmakumar's drama thriller stars Mohanlal and Anoop Menon, with Atul Kulkarni, Pratap Pothen and Honey Rose.
kathai-thiraikathai-vasanam-iy: A young crew of aspiring filmmakers keep trying to put a story together for their first film, and the film follows their discussions, distractions and lives instead. R. Parthiepan's independent satire on Tamil filmmaking features a cast of newcomers, with several established actors in cameo roles.
jk-enum-nanbanin-vaazhkai-2015: JK, a carefree young man obsessed with parties and social media, suddenly becomes serious about building a business and taking care of his family. His friends cannot understand why he has changed so much. Cheran's drama stars Sharwanand and Nithya Menen, with Prakash Raj and Santhanam.
lion-2015: Bose wakes up from a long coma to find that no one, not even his own parents, recognises him, and another man is living as him. Determined to prove who he is, he uncovers a conspiracy reaching powerful people. Satyadev's action thriller, loosely based on the film Unknown, stars Nandamuri Balakrishna, Trisha and Radhika Apte.
loham-2015: A shipment of smuggled gold hidden in a coffin flown from Dubai to Kerala goes missing. Raju, a taxi driver with a mysterious past, helps Jayanthi, a woman searching for her missing husband, and the trail leads both into the gold-smuggling world. Ranjith's action thriller stars Mohanlal, Andrea Jeremiah, Renji Panicker and Ajmal Ameer.
masterpiece-2015: Yuva, a rowdy young man, has turned out the opposite of the freedom fighters his mother hoped he would become. When she publicly criticises his ways, he decides to prove himself, and ends up taking on some powerful enemies. Manju Mandavya's Kannada action comedy stars Yash, Shanvi Srivastava and Suhasini Maniratnam.
mr-airavata-2015: Airavata, an honest and tough police officer, joins the Bangalore police as an ACP and quickly takes on the city's criminals. His work and his personal life collide when danger reaches the people close to him. A. P. Arjun's Kannada action film stars Darshan, Urvashi Rautela, Prakash Raj and Anant Nag.
perariyathavar-2015: A widowed sanitation worker in Kollam and his young son clear the city's garbage every day and live on the margins of society. Through their daily routine, the film looks at people who keep cities running yet remain nameless. Dr. Biju's drama stars Suraj Venjaramoodu, who won the National Award for Best Actor, and Indrans.
pulan-visaranai-2-2015: Sabarathinam, an honest police officer, investigates the killing of workers at a petroleum plant and finds powerful business and political forces behind it. As he digs deeper, his own family is targeted. R. K. Selvamani's action thriller, a sequel to his 1990 film, stars Prashanth and Karthika.
thanga-magan-2015: Tamizh, a young man struggling to find work, is weighed down by a family tragedy that has left a stain on his name. Flashbacks reveal his college romance with Hema, his marriage to Yamuna, and the betrayal that turned his life upside down. R. Velraj's family drama stars Dhanush, Samantha and Amy Jackson.
the-intern-2015: Ben, a 70-year-old widower bored with retirement, becomes a senior intern at a fast-growing online fashion startup. He wins over his young colleagues and its founder, Jules, a driven CEO juggling business pressure and family life. Nancy Meyers's comedy drama stars Robert De Niro and Anne Hathaway.
trisha-illana-nayanthara-2015: Jeeva, born on the same day as two girls, Aditi and Ramya, grows up with both and falls in love first with one, then the other. As his romances fall apart, he heads off on a journey that leads him to unexpected answers about love. Adhik Ravichandran's adult comedy stars G. V. Prakash Kumar, Anandhi and Manisha Yadav.
vasuvum-saravananum-onna-padic: Vasu and Saravanan have been best friends since school. When Vasu marries Seema, Saravanan's constant interference annoys her so much that she insists Vasu end the friendship, and the two friends try to win her over. M. Rajesh's romantic comedy stars Arya, Santhanam and Tamannaah.
2-states-2014: Krish, a Punjabi boy from Delhi, and Ananya, a Tamil girl from Chennai, fall in love while studying at IIM Ahmedabad. They decide to marry only with both families' blessing, and set out to win over parents who are deeply suspicious of each other's culture.
aagadu-2014: Shankar, an orphan raised by an honest police officer, grows up to become a fearless encounter specialist. Posted to a small town ruled by the crime boss Damodar, he sets out to dismantle the gangster's empire using his wits as much as his fists.
action-jackson-2014: Ajay Devgn plays a double role, a small-time crook and a hitman with a dangerous past, in Prabhu Deva's action comedy.
autonagar-surya-2014: Orphaned as a child after witnessing his parents' murder on a train, Surya grows up in Vijayawada's Autonagar, a hub of mechanics' workshops, under the care of a kind engineer. As a talented young mechanic, he comes up against the corrupt union leaders and politicians who control the area and its workers.
alludu-seenu-2014: Seenu and his uncle Narasimha, drowning in debt in their village, run away hoping to reach Dubai but end up in Hyderabad. When Seenu realises that the city's feared don looks exactly like his uncle, he cashes in on the resemblance, and soon finds himself in the middle of the don's empire.
anjaan-2014: Krishna, a soft-spoken man with a limp, arrives in Mumbai from Kanyakumari searching for his missing elder brother Raju. Asking around the city's underworld, he learns that Raju was once a feared gangster who ruled Mumbai with his close friend Chandru, until a betrayal tore everything apart.
bewakoofiyaan-2014: A young couple's plans to marry are thrown off when he loses his job and has to hide it from her strict father, played by Rishi Kapoor.
bhoothnath-returns-2014: Mocked in the afterlife for failing to scare children, the ghost Bhoothnath returns to Earth to prove himself. He befriends Akhrot, a sharp slum boy who can see him, and the pair end up taking on a corrupt local politician by entering an election. Nitesh Tiwari's satirical comedy stars Amitabh Bachchan and Boman Irani.
crazy-star-2014: V. Ravichandran directs, edits, scores and stars in Crazy Star, a 2014 Kannada romantic thriller produced by his home studio, Eshwari Dreams. The ensemble cast includes Priyanka Upendra, Prakash Rai, Bhavana Rao and Raghu Ram, with Ravichandran handling nearly every key job behind the camera as well.
dr-cabbie-2014: An immigrant doctor in Canada who can't get a medical job becomes a taxi driver and starts treating patients in his cab.
dedh-ishqiya-2014: Con men Khalujaan and Babban are back. Khalujaan poses as a nawab to woo Begum Para, a widow hosting a poetry contest to choose her next husband, while Babban falls for her companion Muniya. But the two women have plans of their own. Abhishek Chaubey's sequel stars Naseeruddin Shah, Arshad Warsi, Madhuri Dixit and Huma Qureshi.
finding-fanny-2014: Ferdie, an elderly postman in a sleepy Goan village, learns that a love letter he wrote decades ago never reached Fanny. His young friend Angie, her grumpy mother-in-law, a moody young man and an eccentric painter set off on a road trip to find her. Homi Adajania's English-language comedy stars Naseeruddin Shah, Deepika Padukone and Arjun Kapoor.
heart-attack-2014: Varun, a carefree wanderer who does not believe in commitment, meets Hayathi in Spain and kisses her before vanishing. Back in Goa, she falls for him, but a drug lord tied to her past puts both of them in danger. Puri Jagannadh's romantic action comedy stars Nithiin and Adah Sharma.
gajakesari-2014: A young man who works with elephants near a forest reserve, is drawn into a fight against a local don who wants to grab the elephant land. Flashbacks link his story to a royal past in old Mysore. S. Krishna's Kannada action fantasy stars Yash in a dual role, with Amulya, Anant Nag and an elephant named Arjuna.
fugly-2014: Four friends in Delhi, including the son of a powerful politician, get into trouble with a corrupt and vicious police officer. Trapped in his web of blackmail, the young friends must find a way to fight back. Kabir Sadanand's drama stars Jimmy Sheirgill, Mohit Marwah, boxer Vijender Singh and Kiara Advani in her debut.
humshakals-2014: Three sets of lookalikes cause chaos in a London asylum, in Sajid Khan's comedy with Saif Ali Khan, Riteish Deshmukh and Ram Kapoor.
humpty-sharma-ki-dulhania-2014: A Delhi slacker (Varun Dhawan) falls for a girl from Ambala (Alia Bhatt) who is already engaged, and tries to win over her strict father.
idhu-kathirvelan-kadhal-2014: Kathirvelan, a devout minibus owner in Madurai, has never paid attention to women. That changes when he meets Pavithra, his new neighbour, and helps her out of a tricky situation. S. R. Prabhakaran's romantic comedy drama stars Udhayanidhi Stalin and Nayanthara, with Santhanam and Saranya Ponvannan.
jai-ho-2014: Jai, a suspended army officer, is shaken by a tragedy that could have been prevented if someone had helped. He starts a campaign urging everyone to help three people, and each of them to help three more, but it soon brings him up against a powerful political family. Sohail Khan's remake of Stalin stars Salman Khan and Daisy Shah.
interstellar-2014: As dust storms and crop failures push humanity towards extinction, former NASA pilot Cooper is recruited for a mission through a wormhole near Saturn to find a new home for mankind. Leaving his children behind, he and his crew race against time across distant worlds. Christopher Nolan's science fiction epic stars Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway and Jessica Chastain.
lai-bhaari-2014: Pratap Singh and Sumitra Devi, a respected and generous couple, vow their first son to the god Vithoba after years of waiting. Decades later, a cunning relative eyes their wealth, and a rough-edged young man from a temple town arrives to protect the family. Nishikant Kamat's Marathi action drama stars Riteish Deshmukh, with Salman Khan in a cameo.
main-tera-hero-2014: Seenu, a charming troublemaker, moves to Bangalore for college and falls for Sunaina at first sight. To win her, he must take on a jealous police inspector who wants to marry her, and soon a gangster's daughter who has fallen for Seenu adds to the chaos. David Dhawan's comedy stars Varun Dhawan, Ileana D'Cruz and Nargis Fakhri.
mukunda-2014: Mukunda, a college student who will go to any length for his friends, takes on a powerful municipal chairman after his best friend falls for the chairman's niece. As he stands up to the man's influence, he wins over the town and the chairman's own daughter. Srikanth Addala's drama marks Varun Tej's debut, with Pooja Hegde and Prakash Raj.
mr-fraud-2014: Mohanlal plays a con man who joins a group planning to rob a royal family's treasure, in B. Unnikrishnan's heist thriller.
o-teri-2014: PP and AIDS, two bumbling journalists, find a dead CBI officer in their car, but no one believes them when the body disappears. Their hunt for the truth leads them into a big construction scam involving powerful people. Umesh Bisht's comedy stars Pulkit Samrat, Bilal Amrohi and Sarah-Jane Dias.
peruchazhi-2014: Jagannathan, a crafty Kerala politician who speaks no English, is flown to California to rescue the campaign of a struggling candidate for governor. He applies his home-grown political tricks to American politics, with chaotic results. Arun Vaidyanathan's political satire stars Mohanlal, Mukesh and Aju Varghese.
pilla-nuvvu-leni-jeevitham-201: Srinu, an engineering student, discovers that his girlfriend Siri is being targeted by a hired killer working for a powerful politician. He sets out to protect her and outwit both the politician and the assassin. A. S. Ravi Kumar Chowdary's romantic action comedy marks the debut of Sai Dharam Tej, with Regina Cassandra and Jagapathi Babu.
power-2014: Tirupathi, a carefree young man in Hyderabad, looks exactly like Baldev, a corrupt Kolkata police officer who died helping a gangster escape. He is persuaded to take Baldev's place, and in doing so learns the truth about the man and the crime. K. S. Ravindra's action comedy stars Ravi Teja in a dual role, with Hansika Motwani and Regina Cassandra.
rabhasa-2014: Karthik, back in India after studying in the US, sets out to marry his cousin Indu after her arrogant father insults his family. But a mix-up leads him to woo the wrong girl, Bhagyam, and the chaos only grows from there. Santosh Srinivas's action comedy stars Jr NTR, Samantha and Pranitha Subhash.
ugly-2014: A struggling actor's young daughter goes missing from his car, and the search exposes the selfishness of everyone around her, in Anurag Kashyap's bleak thriller.
balupu-2013: Ravi, a bank collection agent in Bangalore, sets out to teach a lesson to Shruti and her uncle, who trick young men into falling in love with them for money. As Ravi plays them at their own game, a link to his own past and a powerful gangster begins to surface.
besharam-2013: Babli, a charming car thief who grew up in an orphanage, falls for Tara, who wants nothing to do with him. When he realises he has stolen and sold her car to a hawala kingpin, he takes her to Chandigarh to get it back, with a bumbling police couple on his trail.
arrambam-2013: AK, a mysterious man who sets off bombs across Mumbai, forces Arjun, a gifted hacker, to help him break into computer systems. As Arjun turns him in to the police, the reasons behind AK's mission emerge: a scandal of corrupt officials and substandard bulletproof jackets that cost a friend his life.
chennaiyil-oru-naal-2013: On one day in Chennai, a young man is fatally injured in a road accident, and his heart must reach a sick girl in Vellore within hours. A disgraced traffic constable volunteers to drive it through the crowded city against the clock. Shaheed Kader's thriller, a remake of the Malayalam film Traffic, stars Sarathkumar, Cheran, Prasanna and Prakash Raj.
bhai-2013: Bhai, the most trusted enforcer of a Hong Kong-based mafia don, is sent to Hyderabad to kill an undercover police officer disrupting the gang's business. There he discovers that the officer is his own brother, and he must choose between his loyalty to the don and his family.
duniyadari-2013: In 1970s Pune, Shreyas, a well-off boy from Mumbai, joins college and falls in with a crowd of rebels, rivals and lovers. Friendship, first love and campus politics teach him the ways of the world. Sanjay Jadhav's Marathi coming-of-age drama, based on Suhas Shirvalkar's novel, stars Swapnil Joshi, Ankush Chaudhari and Sai Tamhankar.
boss-2013: Disowned by his strict schoolteacher father as a boy, Surya grows up under a gangster's wing and becomes the swaggering enforcer known as Boss. When his younger brother falls foul of a corrupt cop, Boss returns to defend the family that rejected him. Anthony D'Souza's remake of Pokkiri Raja stars Akshay Kumar and Mithun Chakraborty.
googly-2013: Sharath, a wealthy young man, falls for Swathi, a medical student from Mysore he meets at an economics forum in a Bangalore college. Their romance runs into misunderstandings and egos that keep pulling them apart. Pavan Wadeyar's Kannada romantic comedy stars Yash and Kriti Kharbanda, with Ananth Nag and Sadhu Kokila.
deewana-main-deewana-2013: Basant is a charming schemer who always gets what he wants by any trick. When he falls head over heels for Priya, he stops at nothing to win her, even if it means deceiving his own friend Vasant. K. C. Bokadia's romantic crime thriller, shot in 2003 and released a decade later, stars Govinda and Priyanka Chopra.
greeku-veerudu-2013: Chandu, a ruthless event manager in New York who dismisses family ties, is forced to visit his family's home in India to save his business. There he meets Sandhya, a kind-hearted doctor, and his outlook slowly begins to change. Dasaradh's romantic comedy stars Nagarjuna and Nayanthara.
geethaanjali-2013: Anjali travels to her family's house in Kerala with her fiancé, only to be tormented by visions of her dead twin sister, Geetha. When the haunting grows violent, psychiatrist Dr. Sunny Joseph is called in to find out what is going on. Priyadarshan's horror film, a spin-off of Manichitrathazhu, stars Mohanlal and Keerthy Suresh in her debut lead.
himmatwala-2013: Ajay Devgn plays a brave young man who comes to his village to stand up to a tyrant who wronged his family, in a remake of the 1983 Himmatwala.
ishkq-in-paris-2013: Ishkq, a free-spirited young woman in Paris who avoids commitment, spends one magical night with a stranger, Akash, after they meet on a train. The night stirs up feelings she has long avoided, along with questions about her family's past. Prem Raj's romance stars Preity Zinta, Rhehan Malliek and Isabelle Adjani.
jabardasth-2013: Bairraju, a carefree rogue, and Shreya, a city girl who dreams of becoming a wedding planner, team up to start an event management company. She falls for him, but his only goal is getting rich, and they split, until they must plan one last wedding together. Nandini Reddy's romantic comedy stars Siddharth, Samantha and Nithya Menen.
jagadguru-adi-shankara-2013: Born in Kalady, Kerala, a gifted boy named Shankara masters the scriptures at a young age and renounces the world to become a monk. He travels across India, debating scholars and spreading his philosophy. J. K. Bharavi's biographical film stars Kaushik Babu in the title role, with Nagarjuna, Mohan Babu and Suman.
ladies-and-gentleman-2013: Chandrabose, a businessman lost to drink since his wife's death, comes to Kochi and saves a young IT professional from despair. Joining his struggling start-up, Chandrabose's offbeat philosophy turns the firm around and touches the lives of the women around him. Siddique's family drama stars Mohanlal, Meera Jasmine, Mamta Mohandas and Padmapriya.
jolly-llb-2013: Jolly, a struggling small-town lawyer in Delhi, decides to make a name for himself by reopening a hit-and-run case in which a rich man's son ran over pavement dwellers. He finds himself up against Rajpal, the city's most powerful defence lawyer. Subhash Kapoor's courtroom comedy stars Arshad Warsi, Boman Irani, Amrita Rao and Saurabh Shukla.
lokpal-2013: Nandagopal runs a popular food court in Kochi, but secretly he is Lokpal, a masked vigilante who takes on corrupt officials. As the police close in and his past comes to light, his two lives start to collide. Joshiy's vigilante thriller, written by S. N. Swamy, stars Mohanlal, Kavya Madhavan and Meera Nandan.
main-krishna-hoon-2013: Krishna, an orphan boy found in floodwaters, grows up in a small orphanage and watches his friends being adopted one by one. Lonely and longing for a family, he finds a special friend in the god Krishna himself, who appears as an animated companion. Rajiv S. Ruia's family film stars Juhi Chawla and Namit Shah, with Hrithik Roshan and Katrina Kaif in guest roles.
mumbai-mirror-2013: A tough, honest Mumbai police officer, takes on a powerful and corrupt dance-bar owner whose empire runs on crime and political protection.
