As he closes in, the battle turns personal and dangerous. Ankush Bhatt's crime action film stars Sachiin J Joshi, Prakash Raj, Gihana Khan and Aditya Pancholi.
naiyaandi-2013: Chinna Vandu, the youngest of three brothers who run a lamp shop, falls for Vanaroja, a dental student visiting her grandmother's village. When the two marry, he has to keep it hidden from his family, since his much older brothers are still waiting to be married themselves. A. Sarkunam's romantic comedy stars Dhanush and Nazriya Nazim.
nautanki-saala-2013: RP, a theatre actor who plays Ravana on stage, rescues a heartbroken stranger, Mandar, from a desperate moment and takes him under his wing. He then decides to help Mandar win back his girlfriend, only to fall for her himself. Rohan Sippy's romantic comedy, inspired by a French film, stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Kunaal Roy Kapur.
phata-poster-nikhla-hero-2013: Shahid Kapoor plays a young man who wants to be a film hero, while his mother believes he is an honest police officer.
planes-2013: Dusty, a small crop-dusting plane who dreams of racing, enters a round-the-world air race despite his fear of heights. Coached by an old war plane, he takes on the world's best fliers. Klay Hall's animated film from the world of Cars features the voices of Dane Cook, Stacy Keach, Priyanka Chopra and Teri Hatcher.
prema-ishq-kaadhal-2013: Three young men in Hyderabad, each chasing a different dream, find love in very different ways, and each relationship faces its own test. Pavan Sadineni's Telugu romantic drama weaves their stories together, with Harshvardhan Rane, Sree Vishnu, Harish Varma, Ritu Varma, Vithika Sheru and Sri Mukhi.
rajjo-2013: Rajjo, a young courtesan in one of Mumbai's dying kothas, falls in love with Chandu, a young man who promises her a new life. Their romance runs into fierce opposition from powerful people around them. Vishwas Patil's drama stars Kangana Ranaut, Paras Arora, Prakash Raj and Mahesh Manjrekar.
raja-huli-2013: Raja Huli, the son of a rich landlord in Mandya, spends his time helping his friends. When he goes to carry a friend's proposal to Kaveri, his old flame, she falls for him all over again, and his loyalty to his friend is tested. Guru Deshpande's Kannada action comedy, a remake of the Tamil film Sundarapandian, stars Yash and Meghana Raj.
ramayya-vasthavayya-2013: Nandu, a cheerful college student in Hyderabad, falls for Akarsha and tries every trick to win her family over. But he has another purpose in her household, linked to a dark past with a ruthless village strongman. Harish Shankar's action comedy stars Jr NTR, Samantha and Shruti Haasan.
tadakha-2013: Siva, a timid man who inherits his late father's police job, is secretly helped by his fearless younger brother Karthik, who fights his battles for him. When Siva is posted to Vizag, the brothers take on two ruthless gangsters. Kishore Kumar Pardasani's remake of Vettai stars Naga Chaitanya, Sunil, Tamannaah and Andrea Jeremiah.
red-wine-2013: ACP Ratheesh investigates the murder of Anoop, a young political activist and part-time theatre actor. As he pieces together Anoop's life from those who knew him, he uncovers a web of land deals, politics and personal betrayals. Salam Bappu's thriller stars Mohanlal, Fahadh Faasil, Asif Ali and Meghana Raj.
theeya-velai-seiyyanum-kumaru: Kumar, a shy software engineer from a family proud of its love marriages, falls for Sanjana, a new colleague. Unable to speak up, he turns to Mokka, a self-styled love guru who teaches men how to win women. Sundar C's romantic comedy stars Siddharth, Hansika Motwani and Santhanam.
the-great-gatsby-2013: In 1922, Nick Carraway moves to Long Island and becomes neighbours with Jay Gatsby, a mysterious millionaire famous for his lavish parties. Nick soon learns that Gatsby is in love with Nick's cousin Daisy, now married to a wealthy man. Baz Luhrmann's adaptation of F. Scott Fitzgerald's novel stars Leonardo DiCaprio, Tobey Maguire, Carey Mulligan and Amitabh Bachchan.
tu-mera-22-main-tera-22-2013: Amrinder Gill and Yo Yo Honey Singh play two spoiled rich friends in a Punjabi comedy that did well on release.
thulli-vilayadu-2013: Three men working for two rival politicians decide to steal a fortune meant for bribing voters before an election. They flee to Rajasthan with the money, where they meet a young woman, and soon both politicians and their men are on their trail. Vincent Selva's comedy thriller stars Yuvaraj, Deepthi Nambiar and Prakash Raj.
yamla-pagla-deewana-2-2013: Dharam and his son Gajodhar run a fake baba scam in Banaras and target a businessman visiting from England, hoping to marry Gajodhar into his money. Gajodhar's elder brother Paramveer, a respectable man, arrives to set things straight. Sangeeth Sivan's comedy sequel stars Dharmendra, Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol.
zanjeer-2013: Ram Charan plays an angry, honest police officer who takes on an oil mafia, in a remake of the 1973 classic Zanjeer, shot in Hindi and Telugu.
bol-bachchan-2012: Abbas and his sister move to a small town to work for Prithviraj, a local strongman who cannot stand liars. One small lie about Abbas's name snowballs into a web of fake identities, twin brothers and cover stories. Rohit Shetty's action comedy, inspired by Golmaal (1979), stars Ajay Devgn, Abhishek Bachchan, Asin and Prachi Desai.
casanovva-2012: Casanovva is a wealthy playboy who runs a global chain of flower boutiques and is surrounded by admiring women. When a gang of young thieves slips into a wedding posing as his guests, he lets them in with a plan of his own. Rosshan Andrrews's stylish Malayalam action romance stars Mohanlal, Shriya Saran and Lakshmi Rai.
dhoni-2012: Subramaniam, a widowed clerk who makes pickles on the side, wants his son to study hard and become an MBA. But the boy only cares about cricket and dreams of being the next MS Dhoni, and the clash of ambitions puts the family under strain. Prakash Raj directs and stars in this Tamil-Telugu family drama.
devudu-chesina-manushulu-2012: To cheer up Lakshmi on her birthday, Lord Vishnu tells her a love story of two orphans, a settlement broker in Hyderabad and a taxi driver in Bangkok. With a little divine meddling, their paths begin to cross. Puri Jagannadh's fantasy action comedy stars Ravi Teja, Ileana D'Cruz and Prakash Raj.
drama-2012: Yash and Radhika Pandit lead Yogaraj Bhat's Kannada romantic drama about a group of young friends in a small town, whose lives and romances take some dramatic turns. Sathish Ninasam and Sindhu Lokanath co-star, and veteran actor Ambareesh appears in an extended role.
ekk-deewana-tha-2012: An aspiring filmmaker falls for his Christian neighbour, who is torn between him and her family, in Gautham Vasudev Menon's remake of Vinnaithaandi Varuvaayaa.
endukante-premanta-2012: In 1980s Vizag, Krishna has silently loved Srinidhi for three years. Decades later, Ram, a young man in Paris, finds himself haunted by Sravanthi, a woman only he can see, and must uncover how she is linked to the past. A. Karunakaran's romantic fantasy, inspired by Just Like Heaven, stars Ram Pothineni and Tamannaah.
gali-gali-chor-hai-2012: Bharat, an honest bank cashier in Bhopal who plays Hanuman in the local Ramleela, is framed by a corrupt police officer who plants a stolen fridge in his house. His fight to get rid of it drags him through the system's red tape and bribery. Rumi Jaffery's satire stars Akshaye Khanna, Shriya Saran and Mugdha Godse.
jaanu-2012: Yash leads Preetham Gubbi's Kannada romantic action film, opposite Deepa Sannidhi, produced by Jayanna Combines. Rangayana Raghu, Sadhu Kokila and Shobaraj play key supporting roles, and V. Harikrishna composed the songs and background score.
grandmaster-2012: IG Chandrasekhar, a chess-loving police officer who heads Kochi's new crime-stopper cell, has grown weary since his divorce. When a serial killer starts targeting women in alphabetical order and sends him taunting clues, he is pulled into a deadly game. B. Unnikrishnan's thriller stars Mohanlal, Priyamani and Narain.
joker-2012: A scientist (Akshay Kumar) returns to his forgotten village and fakes an alien landing to get the government's attention.
khiladi-786-2012: Mansukh, a bumbling matchmaker thrown out by his father, sets out to arrange a match for Indu, a gangster's sister nobody wants to marry. He finds Bahattar Singh, a Punjabi strongman who poses as a cop, and keeps both families in the dark. Ashish R. Mohan's action comedy stars Akshay Kumar, Asin, Himesh Reshammiya and Mithun Chakraborty.
karmayodha-2012: Madhavan Menon, a tough Mumbai encounter specialist known as Mad Maddy, tracks a missing schoolgirl to Kerala. When another girl is kidnapped there, he uncovers a trafficking racket and goes after it his own way. Major Ravi's action thriller stars Mohanlal, Murali Sharma, Mukesh and Asha Sarath.
lucky-2012: Lucky, a carefree graduate, is in love with Gowri, a television anchor who wants nothing to do with him and has a pet pug to help keep him away. When she becomes creative head of an advertising agency, Lucky takes on a new identity to get a job there and win her over.
krishnam-vande-jagadgurum-2012: Babu, a talented stage actor in his grandfather's Surabhi theatre troupe, wants to leave for America. On a journey to Bellary to fulfil his grandfather's last wish, he discovers a powerful illegal mining mafia and decides to take it on. Krish's action drama stars Rana Daggubati and Nayanthara.
mr-bhatti-on-chutti-2012: Mr. Bhatti, a cheerful Indian tourist on holiday in England, finds his trip turning into a comedy of errors when he gets mixed up with the local police and is suspected of being far more dangerous than he is. Anupam Kher plays the title role, with Bhairavi Goswami, Shakti Kapoor and Abid Ali.
neethaane-en-ponvasantham-2012: Childhood sweethearts Varun and Nithya break up and reunite over the years, in Gautham Vasudev Menon's romance with Jiiva and Samantha.
players-2012: Charlie, a master con man, plans a heist to steal gold being transported by train from Russia to Romania. He assembles a crew of specialists, but after a betrayal, the gang must regroup to get back what was taken. Abbas–Mustan's remake of The Italian Job stars Abhishek Bachchan, Bipasha Basu, Sonam Kapoor, Neil Nitin Mukesh and Bobby Deol.
les-miserables-2012: In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, a former convict, breaks parole to start a new life and is hunted for years by the relentless Inspector Javert. He promises a dying factory worker, Fantine, that he will raise her daughter Cosette, as revolution brews in Paris. Tom Hooper's film of the stage musical stars Hugh Jackman, Russell Crowe, Anne Hathaway and Amanda Seyfried.
rebel-2012: Rishi, a young man with a fearsome temper, arrives in Hyderabad and sets his sights on two powerful crime lords. His mission takes him to Bangkok, where he romances a young woman while closing in on the men who wronged his family. Raghava Lawrence's action comedy stars Prabhas, Tamannaah, Deeksha Seth and Krishnam Raju.
prarthane-2012: Prarthane, whose title means 'prayer', is a Kannada drama directed by Sadashiva Shenoy and released in 2012. Veteran actors Anant Nag and Prakash Raj lead the cast, with Pavitra Lokesh in an important supporting role.
racha-2012: Raj, a smooth gambler in Hyderabad, desperately needs money for his adoptive father's surgery. A rival bets him a fortune that he cannot make Chaitra, the daughter of a powerful Bellary businessman, fall in love with him, and the challenge leads Raj to a truth about his own past. Sampath Nandi's action comedy stars Ram Charan and Tamannaah.
run-baby-run-2012: Venu, a top news cameraman, and Renuka, a TV editor and his former love, are on the trail of a political scandal. When they get hold of explosive footage, they are hunted by powerful people and must run to stay alive. Joshiy's action thriller stars Mohanlal, Amala Paul and Biju Menon.
shirdi-sai-2012: Sai Baba arrives in the village of Shirdi as a young man, disappears, and returns years later to make a crumbling mosque his home. Through his kindness and miracles, he wins over Hindus and Muslims alike while facing suspicion from some. K. Raghavendra Rao's devotional biopic stars Nagarjuna, with Srikanth and Kamalini Mukherjee.
spirit-2012: Raghunandan, a celebrated TV host and writer, is a heavy drinker who believes he is in control. When he sees how alcohol is destroying a plumber's family, he takes a hard look at his own habits. Ranjith's satire on drinking in Kerala stars Mohanlal, Kaniha and Shankar Ramakrishnan.
student-of-the-year-2012: Three students at an elite school compete for a coveted trophy that tests their friendships, launching Sidharth Malhotra, Alia Bhatt and Varun Dhawan.
teri-meri-kahaani-2012: Shahid Kapoor and Priyanka Chopra play three couples in three eras, 1910, 1960 and 2012, whose love stories mirror one another.
tukaram-2012: In 17th-century Maharashtra, Tukaram, a grocer's son in the village of Dehu, loses his family's prosperity in a famine and turns to devotion to Vitthala. His abhangs, devotional poems in plain Marathi, win over ordinary people and anger the orthodox priests. Chandrakant Kulkarni's biopic stars Jitendra Joshi as the saint-poet.
the-dark-knight-rises-2012: Eight years after Batman vanished, taking the blame for Harvey Dent's crimes, Gotham faces a new threat in Bane, a masked terrorist with a ruthless plan. Bruce Wayne comes out of retirement, while Selina Kyle, a cat burglar, plays her own game. Christopher Nolan's conclusion to his trilogy stars Christian Bale, Tom Hardy, Anne Hathaway and Gary Oldman.
yeto-vellipoyindhi-manasu-2012: Nani and Samantha play childhood sweethearts who break up and reunite over the years, in the Telugu version of Gautham Vasudev Menon's romance.
vicky-donor-2012: A young Delhi man becomes a sperm donor for a fertility doctor, and his secret threatens his marriage, in Shoojit Sircar's comedy.
100-love-2011: Balu is a brilliant, slightly arrogant student who always tops his college. When his cross-cousin Mahalakshmi moves in with his family to study, their friendly rivalry turns into a battle of egos, and their love-hate relationship stretches all the way to the eve of a wedding.
always-kabhi-kabhi-2011: Four students at St. Mark's School navigate their final year, love, friendship and the pressure of exams and parents. When a school production of Romeo and Juliet brings them together, each of them must find the courage to follow their own dreams instead of their parents' plans.
chillar-party-2011: A gang of eight boys in a Mumbai housing colony befriend Fatka, an orphan who washes cars, and his dog Bhidu. When a politician launches a campaign to remove stray dogs and Bhidu is taken, the children take on the system to save him. Nitesh Tiwari and Vikas Bahl's family comedy won the National Award for Best Children's Film.
ye-maaya-chesave-2010: Karthik, an engineering graduate who wants to make films, falls in love with Jessie, his older neighbour from a strict Malayali Christian family. Their romance faces her family's opposition and her own doubts, as they keep drifting together and apart. Gautham Vasudev Menon's romantic drama stars Naga Chaitanya and Samantha in her lead debut.
veer-2010: Salman Khan plays a Pindari warrior in 19th-century India who studies in London to understand the British and avenge his people.
ajab-prem-ki-ghazab-kahani-200: A small-town troublemaker (Ranbir Kapoor) falls for a woman (Katrina Kaif) who loves someone else, and keeps helping her anyway.
aladin-2009: A shy young man (Riteish Deshmukh) rubs an old lamp and releases a retiring genie (Amitabh Bachchan), in Sujoy Ghosh's fantasy comedy.
aadhavan-2009: Aadhavan, a skilled contract killer, is hired to eliminate a judge investigating a child kidnapping and organ trafficking racket in Kolkata. After a failed first attempt, he poses as a servant in the judge's household to finish the job, until he discovers a personal connection to the family.
ananda-thandavam-2009: Raghu, a serious young engineer, falls in love with Madhu, the cheerful daughter of his father's new boss, and her family welcomes the match. When Raghu goes to America for work, Madhu's parents arrange her marriage to a wealthy NRI instead, and both their lives take tragic turns.
all-the-best-fun-begins-2009: Veer, a struggling musician, has lied to his wealthy stepbrother Dharam that he is married so he can keep receiving a monthly allowance. When Dharam arrives unannounced in Goa, Veer and his best friend Prem must keep up a growing tangle of lies about who is married to whom.
anjaneyulu-2009: Anjaneyulu, a reporter with a Hyderabad TV channel, falls for Anjali and stumbles on evidence against corrupt politicians while working undercover in a gangster's crew. When his parents are killed in a bus set on fire by rioters, he sets out to find the men truly responsible.
bhramaram-2009: Unni, a share broker in Coimbatore, lives a quiet life with his wife and daughter until a stranger named Jose turns up claiming to be an old schoolmate. The eccentric, hard-drinking visitor overstays his welcome, and Unni grows uneasy about who he really is and what he wants. Blessy's road thriller stars Mohanlal and Bhumika Chawla.
billu-2009: Billu, a poor village barber, lives quietly with his wife and children until a Bollywood superstar arrives to shoot a film nearby. When word spreads that Billu once knew the star, the whole village suddenly wants his favour. Priyadarshan directs Irrfan Khan, Lara Dutta and Shah Rukh Khan in this warm comedy about friendship and dignity.
blue-2009: In the Bahamas, diver Sagar works for Aarav, a fishing businessman with a past tied to a sunken ship called the Lady in Blue. When Sagar's younger brother Sam crosses a Bangkok gangster and flees to them, the three are pulled into a hunt for treasure under the sea. Anthony D'Souza directs Sanjay Dutt, Akshay Kumar and Lara Dutta.
bride-wars-2009: Best friends Emma and Liv have dreamed since childhood of June weddings at New York's Plaza Hotel. When a booking error schedules both ceremonies on the same day, neither will give way, and their friendship turns into an all-out war of sabotage. Gary Winick's romantic comedy stars Kate Hudson and Anne Hathaway.
ayan-2009: Deva, a computer science graduate in Chennai, works for a smuggler, sneaking pirated films and contraband through airports, much to his mother's dismay. When a rival smuggler's schemes cost the life of someone close to him, Deva turns against the gang and works with customs officials to bring the operation down.
chandni-chowk-to-china-2009: Sidhu, a vegetable cutter at a Delhi food stall, trusts every astrologer and fortune-teller he meets. When two villagers from China claim he is the reincarnation of a legendary warrior, he flies off expecting a hero's welcome, unaware they want him to take on a brutal smuggler. Nikkhil Advani's martial arts comedy stars Akshay Kumar and Deepika Padukone.
jogwa-2009: Tayappa and Suli are dedicated to the goddess Yellamma by their families and forced to live as a jogta and jogtin, begging for alms and serving the deity. Bound by custom, the two find each other and must decide whether to break free. Rajiv Patil's Marathi drama, which won several National Awards, stars Upendra Limaye and Mukta Barve.
josh-2009: Satya leaves college in Vizag and moves to Hyderabad, where he falls for Vidhya, a young teacher whose brother keeps her away from college. When Satya becomes a witness in a case involving student gangs, he takes on a powerful man who controls them. Vasu Varma's debut drama introduced Naga Chaitanya and Karthika Nair.
kambakkht-ishq-2009: A Hollywood stuntman who scorns marriage clashes with a woman who hates men, in a remake of the Tamil Pammal K. Sambandam with Akshay Kumar and Kareena Kapoor.
de-dana-dan-2009: In Singapore, Nitin works as a put-upon driver for a rich woman and her pampered dog, while his friend Ram struggles as a courier. Desperate to marry their wealthy girlfriends, the two plot a kidnapping that collides with a dozen other schemes at one hotel. Priyadarshan's farce stars Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, Katrina Kaif and Paresh Rawal.
kanden-kadhalai-2009: Shakthi, a heartbroken young businessman, boards a train with no destination in mind. There he meets Anjali, a chatty, cheerful girl heading home to Theni, and her company slowly brings him back to life. R. Kannan's Tamil remake of Jab We Met stars Bharath and Tamannaah.
london-dreams-2009: Arjun has dreamed of rock stardom in London since childhood and has worked relentlessly to build a band. When his gifted, carefree village friend Mannu joins him and quickly becomes the star, Arjun's jealousy begins to take over. Vipul Amrutlal Shah's musical drama stars Ajay Devgn, Salman Khan and Asin.
kaminey-2009: Charlie and Guddu are estranged twin brothers in Mumbai: one lisps and wants to be a bookie, the other stutters and wants to marry his pregnant girlfriend. Over one wild day, a bag of cocaine drags both into a war between gangsters, corrupt cops and a politician. Vishal Bhardwaj's crime thriller stars Shahid Kapoor and Priyanka Chopra.
luck-2009: Karim Musa, a gambling kingpin who has survived every disaster, runs a deadly game where people with extraordinary luck bet their lives for money. Desperate young Ram is drawn in, along with others who have nothing left to lose. Soham Shah's action thriller stars Sanjay Dutt, Imran Khan, Shruti Haasan, Mithun Chakraborty and Danny Denzongpa.
love-aaj-kal-2009: A modern couple's breezy breakup is set against an older man's story of how he fought for love in his youth, in Imtiaz Ali's romance.
luck-by-chance-2009: Vikram, a struggling actor in Mumbai, gets a lucky break when a big film's star walks out. As fame comes his way, his relationship with Sona, a struggling actress who stood by him, starts to suffer. Zoya Akhtar's debut drama about the Hindi film industry stars Farhan Akhtar, Konkona Sen Sharma, Rishi Kapoor and Dimple Kapadia.
main-aurr-mrs-khanna-2009: Samir and Raina marry against his family's wishes and settle in Melbourne. When his business crashes and he leaves for work in Singapore, Raina is left alone, and she befriends Akash, a kind-hearted stranger. Prem Soni's romantic drama stars Salman Khan, Kareena Kapoor and Sohail Khan.
malai-malai-2009: Vetrivel, a minivan driver from a village near Palani, follows the radio jockey he has fallen for to Chennai. There he lands a job and gets into trouble with a powerful local don, putting himself and his devoted elder brother in danger. A. Venkatesh's action entertainer stars Arun Vijay, Prabhu, Vedhika and Prakash Raj.
mathiya-chennai-2009: Saravanan, a young man who dreams of directing films, gets into a fight with a gangster, unaware that he is in love with the gangster's daughter Maha. With her help, he makes his movie, but her father will stop at nothing to block its release. Vivekanand and Veerasingam's drama stars Jaivanth, Ramya Barna and Prakash Raj, with music by Ilaiyaraaja.
padikkadavan-2009: Rocky, a school dropout looked down on by his educated family, spends his days at a mechanic shop. Advised to marry an educated girl to gain respect, he falls for Gayathri, but her family's enemies and his own past drag him into fights with gangsters. Suraj's action comedy stars Dhanush and Tamannaah, with Vivek and Atul Kulkarni.
red-chillies-2009: When OMR, a Singapore-based oil tycoon, buys a large stake in a state-owned arms manufacturer, workers led by a veteran communist leader go on strike over national security. As the deal stirs protests and political intrigue, a shocking crime pulls OMR into a deadly investigation of his own. Shaji Kailas's crime thriller stars Mohanlal.
rocket-singh-salesman-of-the-y: Harpreet, an honest young graduate, joins a computer sales company where corruption is routine. Sidelined for refusing to pay a bribe, he secretly starts his own company from inside the office, using the firm's resources and colleagues who believe in his way of working. Shimit Amin's satire stars Ranbir Kapoor.
sagar-alias-jacky-reloaded-200: Sagar Alias Jacky, a suave international crime boss, is called to Kerala by an old friend whose husband, the chief minister's son-in-law, has been kidnapped. His hunt leads him into a dangerous political conspiracy. Amal Neerad's stylish gangster film stars Mohanlal, a spin-off of the 1987 classic Irupatham Noottandu.
solla-solla-inikkum-2009: Sathya, a young graduate, falls for three women one after another, and each relationship ends in disappointment. Through his experiences, he learns what love really means. G. Muraliappas's romantic comedy stars Navdeep, Madhumitha and Mallika Kapoor, with Prakash Raj.
thoranai-2009: Murugan, a young man from Madurai, comes to Chennai to find his elder brother, who ran away from home two decades ago. He gets caught in a war between two gangsters, and discovers that one of them is the brother he has been looking for. Sabha Ayyappan's action film stars Vishal, Shriya Saran and Prakash Raj.
the-pink-panther-2-2009: When a master thief steals famous artefacts around the world, Inspector Clouseau is drafted into an international team of detectives to catch him. Bumbling as ever, Clouseau leaves a trail of chaos from Paris to Rome. Harald Zwart's comedy sequel stars Steve Martin, Jean Reno, Emily Mortimer, Andy García and Aishwarya Rai.
wake-up-sid-2009: Sid, a spoilt, aimless college student in Mumbai, falls out with his father and moves in with Aisha, a young writer from Kolkata who has just come to the city. Living with her, he slowly finds his direction and grows up. Ayan Mukerji's debut coming-of-age comedy stars Ranbir Kapoor and Konkona Sen Sharma.
alibhabha-2008: Velu and his father Subramaniam are seasoned thieves who will steal anything from pins to cars. When a string of young women are murdered across the city, Velu befriends the police commissioner and falls for a bank employee, and he finds himself drawn into the hunt for the killer.
what-s-your-raashee-2009: Yogesh, a young man in Mumbai, must marry within ten days to save his family from financial ruin. He decides to meet twelve women, one from each zodiac sign, to find his match. Ashutosh Gowariker's romantic comedy stars Harman Baweja and Priyanka Chopra, who plays all twelve women.
bachna-ae-haseeno-2008: Raj Sharma is a charming playboy who, over the years, wins and then walks away from the hearts of three very different women: a dreamy romantic he meets on a European holiday, an ambitious model he lives with in Mumbai, and a fiercely independent student in Sydney. Eventually he sets out to make amends.
arai-en-305-il-kadavul-2008: Raasu and Mokkai are two struggling young men sharing a hostel room with a band of eccentric tenants in Chennai. When God himself turns up in their room after their prayers, he gives them divine powers for a short while, with chaotic and comic results. Inspired by Bruce Almighty.
chamku-2008: Chamku was raised by a Naxal leader in rural Bihar after his family was killed. He is later recruited into a secret government programme to carry out targeted killings, but when he falls in love with a schoolteacher, he tries to leave that life behind. Kabeer Kaushik's action thriller stars Bobby Deol, Priyanka Chopra and Irrfan Khan.
drona-2008: A young man learns he is the protector of a secret elixir and must fight a sorcerer, in an Indian superhero film with Abhishek Bachchan.
fashion-2008: A small-town girl (Priyanka Chopra) rises to the top of Mumbai's fashion world and then falls hard, in Madhur Bhandarkar's drama.
ghajini-2008: Sanjay Singhania, a telecom tycoon with short-term memory loss, forgets everything every fifteen minutes. Relying on photos, notes and tattoos, he hunts down Ghajini, the gangster who killed his beloved Kalpana, while a medical student starts investigating his case. A. R. Murugadoss's Hindi remake of his Tamil hit stars Aamir Khan, Asin and Jiah Khan.
dostana-2008: Two straight men pretend to be a gay couple to rent a Miami flat and then fall for their flatmate, with Abhishek Bachchan, John Abraham and Priyanka Chopra.
golmaal-returns-2008: Gopal, whose suspicious wife is hooked on TV soaps, spends a night on a yacht after rescuing a woman from goons. His lies to cover it up keep growing, and soon collide with a murder case that his police inspector brother-in-law is investigating. Rohit Shetty's comedy stars Ajay Devgn, Kareena Kapoor, Arshad Warsi and Tusshar Kapoor.
get-smart-2008: Maxwell Smart, a gifted but clumsy analyst at a secret US spy agency, finally gets his chance in the field after enemy agents expose his colleagues. Teamed with the sharp Agent 99, he sets out to stop a criminal network's nuclear plot. Peter Segal's spy comedy, based on the 1960s TV series, stars Steve Carell and Anne Hathaway.
innathe-chintha-vishayam-2008: Gopakumar, a businessman, helps a group of women whose marriages are falling apart, including a wife whose husband is a serial philanderer. As he gets involved, he tries to bring the couples back together. Sathyan Anthikad's family drama stars Mohanlal, Meera Jasmine, Sukanya and Mohini, with music by Ilaiyaraaja.
heroes-2008: Two film students travel across India to deliver letters written by soldiers who died in war, meeting their families, in Samir Karnik's drama.
jaane-tu-ya-jaane-na-2008: Best friends Jai and Aditi (Imran Khan and Genelia) help each other find love, not realising they are meant for each other.
jalsa-2008: Pawan Kalyan plays a former Naxal who now works for a gangster but has his own reasons for being there, in Trivikram's action comedy.
kalidasu-2008: Kalidasu, the son of an honest police officer killed by a factionist, flees his hometown and is raised by a kind woman alongside her own son. To pay for his foster brother's studies, he becomes a car thief, and one day finds a girl hiding in a car he steals. G. Ravicharan Reddy's action film stars Sushanth and Tamannaah.
hello-2008: Six call-centre workers get a call from God on one dramatic night, based on Chetan Bhagat's One Night @ the Call Center.
kantri-2008: Kranthi, a young man who loves to fight, is raised as an orphan and grows up with a grudge. When he learns that a powerful businessman once betrayed and killed his family, he sets out to take him on. Meher Ramesh's action comedy stars Jr NTR, Hansika Motwani, Tanishaa and Prakash Raj.
king-2008: Nagarjuna plays a double role, a gangster king and a singer who looks just like him, in Srinu Vaitla's action comedy with Trisha.
krazzy-4-2008: Four patients at a mental hospital set out with their doctor for a cricket match. When she is kidnapped on the way, the four, each with his own quirk, must find their way through Mumbai on their own and rescue her. Jaideep Sen's comedy stars Arshad Warsi, Irrfan Khan, Rajpal Yadav, Suresh Menon and Juhi Chawla.
kurukshetra-2008: During the 1999 Kargil War, Colonel Mahadevan leads his men against Pakistani troops dug into the heights of Tololing. The battle turns fierce and personal as he faces a ruthless enemy commander. Major Ravi's war film, the second in the Major Mahadevan series after Keerthi Chakra, stars Mohanlal.
krishnarjuna-2008: Arjun, born inside a Krishna temple and shunned as a bad omen, grows up and works as a bodyguard for a landlord's sister. When he gets into trouble, Lord Krishna himself appears to guide and help him. P. Vasu's fantasy comedy stars Nagarjuna as Krishna, Manchu Vishnu and Mamta Mohandas.
love-story-2050-2008: Karan, a carefree young man, falls in love with Sana, who dreams of seeing Mumbai in the year 2050. When he loses her in an accident, he uses her uncle's time machine to travel to the future, hoping to find her again. Harry Baweja's science fiction romance stars Harman Baweja and Priyanka Chopra.
madampi-2008: Gopalakrishna Pillai, a wealthy village moneylender, is seen as cold and heartless, even by his own mother. When his younger brother's marriage plans and a ruthless rival threaten his family, his hidden goodness comes to the surface. B. Unnikrishnan's family drama stars Mohanlal, Ajmal Ameer, Kavya Madhavan and Siddique.
moggina-manasu-2008: On her way to a college reunion, Chanchala looks back on her years at college and the friendships that shaped her. The film follows four young women as they navigate first love, heartbreak and growing up, and how their choices affect the rest of their lives.
my-name-is-anthony-gonsalves-2: Anthony, a kind young man who grew up on the streets under the wing of a gangster, dreams of becoming a film star and falls for a sweet young woman. But the ruthless gangster from his past returns and threatens to drag him back into crime. Eeshwar Nivas's drama stars Nikhil Dwivedi, Amrita Rao and Mithun Chakraborty.
netru-indru-naalai-2008: Vetri, a dejected young man, finds a dead man's phone on a railway track. The calls he answers start bringing him money and luck, and a young woman who knew the dead man enters his life, but the phone also leads trouble to his door. Lakshmikanth Chenna's thriller, made in Tamil and Telugu, stars Ravi Krishna and Rekha Vedavyas.
parugu-2008: Allu Arjun plays a young man who helps a friend elope with a girl, only to face the wrath of her father (Prakash Raj).
panchamirtham-2008: In the age of the Ramayana, Mareesan, Ravana's uncle, is forced to become the golden deer and is turned to stone. Reborn in modern times, he and others tied to that ancient story meet again, with comic results. Raju Eswaran's fantasy comedy stars Jayaram, Prakash Raj and Raju Eswaran, with Nassar and Samiksha.
pandhayam-2008: Shakthi, a college student and devoted fan of actor Vijay, falls for Thulasi, the sister of Masanam, a thug who has risen to become a minister. When Shakthi openly challenges Masanam, a tense cat-and-mouse game begins. S. A. Chandrasekhar's action thriller stars Nithin Sathya, Sindhu Tolani and Prakash Raj, with Vijay in a guest role.
race-2008: Two rich half-brothers who run a horse-racing business plot against each other over money and a woman, in Abbas-Mustan's thriller.
rachel-getting-married-2008: Kym, a young woman out of rehab for a few days, comes home for her older sister Rachel's wedding. Over a weekend of celebrations, old wounds and family tensions come to the surface. Jonathan Demme's drama stars Anne Hathaway, Rosemarie DeWitt, Bill Irwin and Debra Winger.
ready-2008: Chandu, ousted by his family for helping a cousin elope, accidentally kidnaps the wrong bride, Pooja, who is fleeing a forced marriage. To protect her from her powerful uncles, he hides her inside his own family's house in disguise. Srinu Vaitla's action comedy stars Ram Pothineni and Genelia D'Souza.
singh-is-kinng-2008: A clumsy villager from Punjab (Akshay Kumar) travels to Australia and accidentally becomes a crime boss.
tashan-2008: A call-centre trainer, a con woman and a goon chase a stolen fortune across India, with Saif Ali Khan, Kareena Kapoor and Akshay Kumar.
twenty-20-2008: When the grandson of a retired chief justice is accused of murder, his family is torn apart, and an old enemy of the judge's sons sees a chance to destroy them. Several powerful men, a lawyer, a police officer and a crime boss among them, are drawn into the case. Joshiy's multi-starrer stars Mohanlal, Mammootty, Suresh Gopi, Jayaram and Dileep.
saroja-2008: Four friends on a road trip to watch a cricket match take a detour and get stranded in the middle of nowhere. They stumble into the kidnapping of Saroja, a rich man's daughter, and end up fighting her captors at an abandoned factory. Venkat Prabhu's comedy thriller stars Shiva, Premji, Vaibhav, S. P. Charan, Jayaram and Prakash Raj.
u-me-aur-hum-2008: A man falls in love with a woman he meets on a cruise, and after they marry she develops Alzheimer's, with Ajay Devgn and Kajol.
vaaranam-aayiram-2008: Suriya plays both a father and son, as the son looks back on his life, love and loss after his father's death, in Gautham Vasudev Menon's drama.
velli-thirai-2008: Saravanan, a struggling assistant director, has his script stolen by his roommate Kanniah, who gets it made with himself in the lead and becomes a star overnight. Saravanan refuses to give up and plots a clever comeback. Viji's debut satire, a remake of Udayananu Tharam, stars Prithviraj Sukumaran, Prakash Raj and Gopika.
yaar-meri-zindagi-2008: Amitabh Bachchan and Shatrughan Sinha lead Ashok Gupta's Hindi action drama, with Sharada and Sudha Chandran. Shot many years earlier and long delayed, the film finally reached a limited number of screens in Mumbai and Maharashtra in 2008.
yuvvraaj-2008: Three brothers try to outwit each other for their late father's fortune, in Subhash Ghai's musical drama with Salman Khan and Anil Kapoor.
yaaradi-nee-mohini-2008: Dhanush plays a jobless young man who falls for his colleague (Nayanthara), a remake of the Telugu Aadavari Matalaku Arthale Verule.
aarya-2007: R. Madhavan plays a medical student who stands up to a gangster in his neighbourhood, with Bhavana and Prakash Raj.
apne-2007: Baldev, a former boxing champion disgraced by false doping charges, dreams that one of his sons will restore the family's honour. His elder son Angad reluctantly returns to the ring to fight for the world heavyweight title, while his younger son Karan struggles to find his own path.
athidhi-2007: Mahesh Babu plays a man who was taken in by a family as a child and comes back years later to find who killed them.
bhool-bhulaiyaa-2007: A psychiatrist (Akshay Kumar) investigates the strange events in an old haveli where his friend's wife seems possessed, in Priyadarshan's remake of Manichitrathazhu.
becoming-jane-2007: A young Jane Austen (Anne Hathaway) falls for the charming but poor Tom Lefroy, in a biographical drama about the author's early life.
big-brother-2007: A man (Sunny Deol) secretly fights criminals the law cannot touch, while posing as an ordinary family man, with Priyanka Chopra.
dhamaal-2007: Four broke, lazy friends witness a dying thief reveal where he buried a huge stash of money. Each sets off on his own to grab it, while a determined cop chases them all in a race across the country. Indra Kumar's comedy stars Sanjay Dutt, Riteish Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi, Aashish Chaudhary and Javed Jaffrey.
billa-2007: David Billa is an elusive underworld don wanted by Interpol in Malaysia. When he dies in a police chase, a DSP keeps it secret and recruits Velu, a small-time crook who looks exactly like him, to infiltrate the gang. Vishnuvardhan's stylish remake of the 1980 Rajinikanth film stars Ajith Kumar in a dual role, with Nayanthara.
chotta-mumbai-2007: Vasco da Gama, known as Thala, leads a harmless gang of friends in Fort Kochi who spend their days pulling small scams. Their easygoing life is upset when they lose their savings to a visa fraud and later cross a violent local cop. Anwar Rasheed's action comedy stars Mohanlal, with Kalabhavan Mani, Siddique and Indrajith.
gandhi-my-father-2007: Harilal, Mahatma Gandhi's eldest son, dreams of studying law in England like his father, but Gandhi wants him to serve the cause in India. Their clash of hopes grows into a painful lifelong rift between father and son. Feroz Abbas Khan's biographical drama stars Akshaye Khanna, Darshan Jariwala, Shefali Shah and Bhumika Chawla.
gangotri-2007: Gangotri is a 2007 Bhojpuri family drama directed by Abhishek Chhadha, a sequel to the earlier hit Ganga. Amitabh Bachchan and Hema Malini lead the cast alongside Bhojpuri star Manoj Tiwari, with Bhumika Chawla and Sambhavna Seth in key roles.
guru-2007: A village man from Gujarat (Abhishek Bachchan) builds a business empire in Bombay, bending rules along the way, in Mani Ratnam's drama inspired by Dhirubhai Ambani.
don-2007: As a young man, Suri avenges his parents' murder and takes a group of street boys under his wing. Twenty years later he is a big-hearted don who quietly controls Andhra Pradesh's underworld, until a ruthless gangster from Mumbai moves in to expand his empire.
hallo-2007: Sivaraman, a once-brilliant lawyer now drowning in drink, befriends three local rowdies after a brawl. When he learns that a young woman is in danger, the unlikely crew sets out to protect her. Rafi Mecartin's comedy thriller stars Mohanlal, Parvathy Melton, Jagathy Sreekumar and Siddique.
happy-days-2007: Eight friends go through four years of engineering college, sharing first love, rivalry and growing up, in Sekhar Kammula's musical hit.
jhoom-barabar-jhoom-2007: Two strangers waiting at a London train station invent stories about their perfect partners, with Abhishek Bachchan and Preity Zinta.
heyy-babyy-2007: Three bachelor flatmates in Sydney find a baby left at their door and must learn to look after her, with Akshay Kumar, Fardeen Khan and Riteish Deshmukh.
kalloori-2007: A group of friends from a small town, together since school, join the local government college. Their close-knit circle is tested when a new student, Shobana, joins and one of them falls for her. Balaji Sakthivel's coming-of-age drama stars Akhil and Tamannaah.
lee-2007: Lee and his friends spend their days playing football and doing odd jobs, until a young woman sees them attempt to assassinate a politician. The reason lies in their college days, when their dedicated football coach was wronged by a corrupt and powerful principal.
marigold-2007: Marigold, a spoilt American B-movie actress, is stranded in Goa when her film is cancelled. Offered a small part in a Bollywood musical, she ends up learning to dance from its choreographer Prem, and falls for him and for India, despite family obstacles. Willard Carroll's romantic musical comedy stars Ali Larter and Salman Khan.
naqaab-2007: A young woman is caught between two men in a game where nothing is what it seems, with Bobby Deol and Akshaye Khanna.
nishabd-2007: Vijay, a 60-year-old photographer living quietly in Kerala with his wife, finds his life upturned when his daughter's free-spirited 18-year-old friend Jia comes to stay. An unspoken attraction between them threatens his family. Ram Gopal Varma's drama stars Amitabh Bachchan, Jiah Khan in her debut and Revathi.
namastey-london-2007: A London-raised girl (Katrina Kaif) is tricked into marrying a Punjabi villager (Akshay Kumar), who then sets out to win her love.
parattai-engira-azhagu-sundara: Azhagu Sundaram, a simple village man, comes to Chennai to earn money for gold bangles for his mother, but gets caught up in the city's gangs and cannot return. His mother comes looking for him, not knowing where he is, and a kind journalism student takes her in. Suresh Krissna's remake of Jogi stars Dhanush, Meera Jasmine and Archana.
partner-2007: A love guru (Salman Khan) helps a shy man (Govinda) win over his wealthy boss, while having his own romance, inspired by Hitch.
polladhavan-2007: Prabhu, an aimless young man in Chennai, buys a motorcycle with money from his father, and his life starts to turn around: he finds a job, respect and love. Then his bike is stolen, and his search for it drags him into conflict with a violent local gang.
provoked-2007: Kiranjit Ahluwalia, an Indian woman in Britain, endures years of violence in her marriage before she kills her husband. Sentenced to life, she finds support from women's rights campaigners who fight to have her case reopened. Jag Mundhra's drama, based on a true story, stars Aishwarya Rai, Naveen Andrews, Miranda Richardson and Nandita Das.
shootout-at-lokhandwala-2007: A retired judge questions the officers of Mumbai's Anti-Terrorism Squad about the 1991 shootout at Lokhandwala Complex. Their account traces how they hunted Maya Dolas, a young gangster rising fast in the underworld. Apoorva Lakhia's action thriller, based on the real event, stars Sanjay Dutt, Vivek Oberoi, Suniel Shetty and Amitabh Bachchan.
saawariya-2007: A singer falls for a mysterious woman waiting for her lost love, in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's take on Dostoevsky's White Nights.
salaam-e-ishq-2007: Six couples in Mumbai and London face love at different stages: a fading actress and her fake fiancé, a long-married couple drifting apart, a man fleeing his wedding, and others. Their stories cross in surprising ways. Nikkhil Advani's ensemble romance, inspired by Love Actually, stars Salman Khan, Priyanka Chopra, Anil Kapoor, Juhi Chawla, Akshaye Khanna and John Abraham.
sivaji-the-boss-2007: Sivaji, a software architect, returns from the US to build free hospitals and colleges for the poor. A corrupt minister and a crooked system block him at every turn, so he decides to fight black money with his own clever tactics. Shankar's vigilante film stars Rajinikanth, Shriya Saran, Vivek and Suman.
the-last-lear-2007: Harry, a retired Shakespearean stage actor, is persuaded by a young filmmaker to act in his first film. On the eve of the film's premiere, the women in his life gather to tell the story of how the shoot unfolded. Rituparno Ghosh's English-language drama stars Amitabh Bachchan, Preity Zinta, Arjun Rampal and Shefali Shah.
the-last-legion-2007: As the Roman Empire falls, young emperor Romulus Augustulus is captured by Goths. His tutor and a loyal Roman commander rescue him and set out for Britain with a legendary sword, hoping to find the last loyal legion. Doug Lefler's historical adventure stars Colin Firth, Ben Kingsley and Aishwarya Rai.
tulasi-2007: Tulasi Ram, an architect in Hyderabad, takes his pregnant wife to his home village in Rayalaseema, where his family is caught in a violent faction feud. When the violence drives his wife away with their son, Tulasi must fight to win them back and protect them. Boyapati Srinu's action drama stars Venkatesh and Nayanthara.
veerappu-2007: A strict headmaster wants his son to become a brilliant mathematician, but the boy rebels and grows up into a feared local rowdy. The bitter rift between father and son drives the story. Badri's debut action drama, a Tamil remake of the Malayalam film Spadikam, stars Sundar C and Gopika.
vel-2007: Twins separated at birth grow up in very different worlds: Vel, raised by a big landlord family in a village, and Vasu, a private detective in Chennai. When Vasu meets Vel, he discovers his brother is caught up in a violent feud. Hari's action drama stars Suriya in a dual role, with Asin and Kalabhavan Mani.
welcome-2007: A man falls in love with a gangster's sister and has to win over her underworld brothers, played by Nana Patekar and Anil Kapoor.
36-china-town-2006: A struggling actor and a runaway girl find a lost boy who turns out to be the son of a wealthy casino owner in Goa. Lured by the reward, they set off to return him, but when a murder takes place at her mansion, everyone who has arrived there becomes a suspect.
yogi-2007: Prabhas plays a village man who comes to the city looking for his mother and becomes a feared figure, in a remake of the Kannada Jogi.
aap-ki-khatir-2006: A woman hires a man (Akshaye Khanna) to pose as her boyfriend at her sister's wedding in London, with Priyanka Chopra.
ajay-2006: Ajay, a kabaddi player from Bangalore, travels to Hubli for a tournament and rescues Padma from Veerabhadra, a powerful faction leader determined to marry her by force. He hides her in his own home, putting himself and his police officer father in the path of the enraged strongman.
aishwarya-2006: Upendra plays a man who distrusts women after a heartbreak and his new colleague (Deepika Padukone) tries to change his mind, in a remake of Manmadhudu.
ashok-2006: Jr NTR plays a young man who has to fight a gangster to marry the woman he loves, in Surender Reddy's action drama.
alag-2006: When a reclusive widower dies in Mahabaleshwar, police discover his son Tejas, who has spent his whole life in a basement because of his extreme sensitivity to sunlight. Taken in by a rehabilitation institute, Tejas, who has no body hair and remarkable intelligence, reveals astonishing telekinetic powers that make others fear and exploit him.
baba-kalyani-2006: Baba Kalyani, an officer with the Anti-Terrorism Squad, follows clues from a raid on a lodge in Mumbai to Kochi, where counterfeit currency is traced to a respected businessman's charity. As he digs deeper, he uncovers a terror plot and clashes with an old flame and her lawyer father.
bhagam-bhag-2006: Champak runs a theatre troupe touring Britain, and his two squabbling actors, Bunty and Babla, are desperate to find a new leading lady. When they pick up a mysterious young woman, they become caught up in a murder and find themselves on the run from killers and the police.
boss-2006: Gopala Krishna, a powerful construction tycoon, hires Anuradha as his personal secretary, and the two grow close on a business trip to Malaysia. Before she can confess her feelings, a misunderstanding and a ruthless rival builder complicate their lives. V. N. Aditya's Telugu romantic action film stars Nagarjuna, Nayanthara and Poonam Bajwa.
darna-zaroori-hai-2006: Five children lost in a forest find shelter in a lonely house, where an old woman offers to tell them six scary stories. Whoever can sit through all of them without getting frightened wins. Ram Gopal Varma's horror anthology stars Amitabh Bachchan, Anil Kapoor, Suniel Shetty, Riteish Deshmukh and Bipasha Basu.
golmaal-fun-unlimited-2006: Four college pranksters, Gopal, Madhav, Lucky and Laxman, are broke and on the run from a local goon. They con their way into the home of a blind old couple by pretending to be their long-lost grandson. Rohit Shetty's buddy comedy stars Ajay Devgn, Arshad Warsi, Sharman Joshi, Tusshar Kapoor, Rimi Sen and Paresh Rawal.
ganga-2006: Ganga is an educated young woman from a modest village family. When the arrogant son of a local landlord accuses her of infidelity on their wedding day, she instead marries Shankar, the man who once protected her, and the couple face hostility from his family and the jilted groom.
fanaa-2006: Zooni, a blind young woman from Kashmir, visits Delhi to perform at the Republic Day celebrations and falls for her charming tour guide, Rehan. Their romance is shattered by a terror attack in the city, and years later a chance meeting in snowbound Kashmir reveals secrets that change everything.
i-see-you-2006: A London TV host (Arjun Rampal) begins to see and talk to the spirit of a woman in a coma, in Vivek Agrawal's romantic comedy.
kabhi-alvida-naa-kehna-2006: Two people in unhappy marriages in New York fall in love with each other, in Karan Johar's drama with Shah Rukh Khan and Rani Mukerji.
kabul-express-2006: Two Indian journalists reporting from Afghanistan after the fall of the Taliban travel the country with a local taxi driver and an American photographer. Their journey takes a tense turn when a former Taliban fighter hijacks their vehicle and forces them to drive him to the Pakistan border.
keerthi-chakra-2006: Major Mahadevan leads an elite team of NSG commandos fighting militants in Kashmir. When terrorists take civilians hostage, the major and his men, including his close friend Havildar Jaikumar, go in to end the siege. Major Ravi's war film stars Mohanlal, Jiiva, Biju Menon and Gopika.
kedi-2006: Raghu, a carefree college student, clashes with Priyanka, a new classmate who is the arrogant sister of a gangster turned minister. When romance enters the picture, Raghu faces her powerful brother and a jealous rival. A. M. Jyothi Krishna's romantic thriller marks the Tamil debuts of Tamannaah and Ileana D'Cruz, with Ravi Krishna.
khatarnak-2006: Dasu, the son of a counterfeiter, has grown up drifting since his father went to jail. When an honest police officer sends informers into a smuggling gang, Dasu gets swept into the operation. Amma Rajasekhar's action comedy stars Ravi Teja, Biju Menon, Ileana D'Cruz and Prakash Raj.
omkara-2006: Vishal Bhardwaj's version of Othello set in the badlands of Uttar Pradesh, where a political enforcer (Ajay Devgn) is poisoned by his lieutenant's lies.
lakshmi-2006: Venkatesh plays a man who runs a big company and protects his family from a rival, in V. V. Vinayak's action drama with Nayanthara.
paramasivan-2006: Siva is on death row for killing the corrupt policemen who murdered his father and sister. An honest senior officer secretly frees him, gives him a new identity as Paramasivan and sends him to hunt down the terrorists behind the Coimbatore bombings, while a CBI officer tries to track him down.
parijatham-2006: Sumathi, a young woman whose family has lost its fortune, takes a job as a maid in a wealthy woman's house to keep her family going. When the employer's son returns home, a romance blossoms, but she keeps her true background hidden. K. Bhagyaraj's romantic comedy stars Prithviraj Sukumaran and Saranya Bhagyaraj.
perarasu-2006: Perarasu is a 2006 Tamil vigilante action film and the directorial debut of Udhayan, with Vijayakanth in a dual role alongside Debina Bonnerjee and Prakash Raj. A CBI officer investigating a judge's mysterious disappearance traces the city's crimes to a state minister and his corrupt policemen, but when those officers start turning up dead, suspicion falls on him.
poi-2006: Kamban, the son of an honest politician, leaves for Sri Lanka after a scandal embarrasses his father. There he falls in love with a young woman, and the story of their love is narrated with the help of a playful god. K. Balachander's final film as director stars Uday Kiran, Vimala Raman and Prakash Raj.
phir-hera-pheri-2006: Raju, Shyam and Baburao are now rich and living in luxury. When Raju falls for a con and convinces the others to invest in a get-rich-quick scheme, they lose everything to a crook and end up owing money to a dangerous gangster. Neeraj Vora's comedy sequel stars Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, Paresh Rawal and Bipasha Basu.
rakhi-2006: Jr NTR plays a man who becomes a vigilante against men who prey on women, in Krishna Vamsi's action drama.
pudhupettai-2006: Kumar, a schoolboy from a Chennai slum, runs away from home after a family tragedy and ends up on the streets. Taken in by a gang, he rises through its ranks with cold ambition to become a feared gangster and enters politics. Selvaraghavan's crime drama stars Dhanush, Sonia Agarwal and Sneha.
rasathanthram-2006: Premachandran, a carpenter, is working on a house when he discovers Kanmani, a young servant girl, running away from abuse. He takes her in, disguised as a boy, as part of his work crew, and their bond slowly grows into love. Sathyan Anthikad's family drama stars Mohanlal and Meera Jasmine.
saawan-the-love-season-2006: Raj and Kajal, newlyweds, return from their honeymoon to meet a mysterious man who predicts the future, and he tells Kajal she will die in two days. Shattered, the couple try to fight fate. Saawan Kumar's romance stars Saloni Aswani and Kapil Jhaveri, with Salman Khan in a special appearance.
saravana-2006: Silambarasan plays a young man who protects a woman and her family from a gangster, in K. S. Ravikumar's action romance.
shaadi-karke-phas-gaya-yaar-20: Ayaan, a wealthy young man from a traditional family, wins over Ahana, a successful model, by reading her lost diary. Once married, Ahana struggles with his conservative household, and when she becomes pregnant the clash between her ambitions and his family's expectations threatens the marriage.
sillunu-oru-kaadhal-2006: Gowtham and Kundavi, married by arrangement, now live happily in Mumbai with their young daughter. When Kundavi finds Gowtham's old college diary, she learns about Aishwarya, the woman he once loved, and decides to bring them together again. Krishna's romantic drama stars Suriya, Jyothika and Bhumika Chawla.
style-2006: Choreographers Raghava Lawrence and Prabhu Deva star in a Telugu dance drama about a young dancer who wants to make it big.
sri-ramadasu-2006: This devotional biopic tells the story of the 17th-century saint-poet Kancharla Gopanna, a revenue official whose devotion to Lord Rama led him to use government funds to build the famous temple at Bhadrachalam. Nagarjuna plays Ramadasu, with Akkineni Nageswara Rao and Sneha, in K. Raghavendra Rao's film.
stalin-2006: Chiranjeevi plays an ex-army man who urges everyone he helps to help three others, in A. R. Murugadoss's action drama.
taxi-no-9211-2006: A rich young man (John Abraham) and a hot-headed taxi driver (Nana Patekar) turn each other's lives upside down after one cab ride.
thalainagaram-2006: Right, a rowdy in North Chennai, works as a hitman for a powerful don while running his own gang. When he falls for Divya, a student, and wants to leave crime behind, he finds that both his boss and a tough police officer stand in the way. Suraj's gangster film stars Sundar C in his first lead role, with Jyothirmayi and Vadivelu.
the-devil-wears-prada-2006: Andy, an aspiring journalist with no interest in fashion, lands a job as assistant to Miranda Priestly, the formidable editor of a top fashion magazine. As she learns to meet Miranda's impossible demands, her personal life starts to slip away. David Frankel's comedy drama stars Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci.
suyetchai-mla-2006: Suyetchai MLA is a 2006 Tamil political satire directed by Guru Dhanapal, starring Sathyaraj and Goundamani, released after many delays. Nambirajan and Visky, lorry-driving best friends who run errands for the local MLA, are stung when a rich man insults Nambirajan's poverty at his sister's engagement, and Nambirajan decides to enter politics himself.
vadakkumnadhan-2006: Bharathan, a brilliant Sanskrit professor and scholar, hides a secret from his family: he has bipolar disorder. Before his wedding to Meera, his cousin and student, he vanishes, and years later his family's search for him reveals what he has been through. Shajoon Kariyal's drama stars Mohanlal, Padmapriya and Kavya Madhavan.
umrao-jaan-2006: Aishwarya Rai plays the famous 19th-century Lucknow courtesan and poet Umrao Jaan, in J. P. Dutta's adaptation of the Urdu novel.
vallavan-2006: Vallavan, a carefree college student, falls for Swapna, a lecturer three years older than him. To win her, he disguises himself as an awkward boy, but an old flame from his school days returns with a dangerous obsession. Silambarasan directs and stars in this romantic thriller, with Nayanthara and Reema Sen.
veerabhadra-2006: Murali, a kind young man, wins the support of a village after standing up to the brothers of a greedy landlord who want to grab land meant for the poor. His deeper story and hidden past come to light as the battle escalates. A. S. Ravi Kumar Chowdary's action film stars Nandamuri Balakrishna, Tanushree Dutta and Sadha.
vathiyar-2006: Dorai, a man who rids his neighbourhood of a notorious gangster, finds himself hunted by both the police and a disgraced former chief minister bent on revenge. As the pressure mounts, his own past comes to light and he takes on the corrupt system. A. Venkatesh's action film, from a story by Arjun, stars Arjun, Mallika Kapoor and Prakash Raj.
aaru-2005: Aaru, a loyal henchman raised by a Chennai gangster's family, fights his master's battles without question. When his close friends are killed in a plot hatched by the man he served, Aaru realises he has been betrayed and turns against the gangster.
zinda-2006: A man released after 14 years of mysterious captivity hunts for the person who locked him up, with Sanjay Dutt and John Abraham.
adhu-oru-kana-kaalam-2005: Srinivasan, a convict, escapes from prison to find his love Thulasi. On the way he tells a truck driver how he fell for her, the daughter of the family's maid, against his father's wishes, and how a fight in a police lock-up landed him in jail.
andarivaadu-2005: Govindarajulu is a carefree, hard-drinking construction worker, while his son Siddhu is a disciplined television host who is his complete opposite. When Siddhu falls for the daughter of a rich contractor who looks down on Govindu, the father must decide how far he will go for his son's happiness.
amrithadhare-2005: Puru and Amrutha are a young married couple who still behave like lovers, though they constantly argue over money: she spends freely while he saves every rupee. She longs for a child, he wants to build a house first, and their marriage is tested by the choices ahead of them.
apaharan-2005: Ajay, an unemployed graduate in Bihar, dreams of joining the police, but his upright father refuses to let him pay a bribe. After a failed kidnapping lands him in trouble, Ajay joins the gang of a powerful politician who runs the state's kidnapping trade, and his rise in crime deepens the rift with his father.
arinthum-ariyamalum-2005: Sathya, a naive student who moves to Chennai for engineering, crosses paths with Kutty, a reckless young rogue who accidentally shoots the girl Sathya loves. Kutty is the adopted son of a powerful businessman, and a hidden family connection between the two young men soon comes to light.
barsaat-2005: A young Indian man in America marries his rich girlfriend but is pulled back to his first love in Punjab, with Bobby Deol, Priyanka Chopra and Bipasha Basu.
bewafaa-2005: A woman is forced to marry her late sister's husband and later meets her old love, with Kareena Kapoor, Akshay Kumar and Anil Kapoor.
ayya-2005: In a drought-hit corner of southern Tamil Nadu in the early 1970s, two landlords from different communities are close friends who help their people survive. When a corrupt local MLA is caught smuggling government rice, a violent confrontation sets off a feud that will shape the next generation.
bhageeratha-2005: Ravi Teja and Shriya Saran star in this Telugu action drama directed by Rasool Ellore. The film did average business at the box office and was later dubbed into Hindi as The Return of Sikander, which introduced it to a wider audience beyond Telugu-speaking viewers.
blackmail-2005: Abhay Rathod, an honest Mumbai police officer, puts the gangster Shekhar Mohan behind bars. Years later, Shekhar walks free and goes after Abhay's family, kidnapping his young son to settle the score. Anil Devgan's action thriller, inspired by the Hollywood film Ransom, stars Ajay Devgn, Suniel Shetty and Priyanka Chopra.
bluffmaster-2005: A smooth con man (Abhishek Bachchan) learns he has a terminal illness and teams up with a young hustler (Riteish Deshmukh) for one last game.
chakram-2005: Chakram, a young doctor back from abroad who dreams of building a hospital in his hometown, vanishes from his own wedding. Settling in a poor Hyderabad colony, he quietly helps the people around him solve their problems, while a local girl falls in love with him. Krishna Vamsi's emotional drama stars Prabhas, Asin and Charmy Kaur.
chand-sa-roshan-chehra-2005: Raj and Jiya have loved each other since childhood, but her ambitious father disapproves and takes her to live abroad. Years later, Raj gets the chance to travel to the same city, determined to win her back as he promised his family. Shabah Shamsi's teen romance marked Tamannaah Bhatia's film debut, opposite Samir Aftab.
brokeback-mountain-2005: In 1963 Wyoming, two young ranch hands, Ennis and Jack, are hired to herd sheep for a summer on Brokeback Mountain and fall into an intense, secret relationship. Over the following decades, marriages and the times they live in keep them apart. Ang Lee's drama stars Heath Ledger, Jake Gyllenhaal, Anne Hathaway and Michelle Williams.
devathaiyai-kanden-2005: Babu, a struggling tea vendor in Chennai who sells tea from his bicycle, falls in love with Uma, a rich college student. She returns his feelings, but when her parents propose a wealthy groom, Uma has to choose between love and security. Boopathy Pandian's romantic drama stars Dhanush and Sridevi Vijaykumar.
chandrolsavam-2005: Sreehari returns to his village after years away, following a prison term and a long stay in Paris. Back home, he faces memories of Indu, the woman he loved, whose mother broke them up, and of a friend who married her instead. Ranjith's Malayalam drama stars Mohanlal and Meena, with music by Vidyasagar.
dosti-friends-forever-2005: Karan, a lonely rich boy, and Raj, a poor orphan who saves his life, become inseparable friends and grow up as brothers. Years later, as both fall in love and Raj builds a career, a misunderstanding threatens their bond. Suneel Darshan's drama stars Akshay Kumar, Bobby Deol, Kareena Kapoor and Lara Dutta.
dil-jo-bhi-kahey-2005: An interracial romance between an Indian man and a Mauritian-French woman faces family opposition, with Amitabh Bachchan as the boy's father.
dus-2005: The head of an anti-terror squad learns of an attack planned for 10 May that could kill thousands. With the mastermind hiding abroad, his team of officers sets off on a tense chase across Canada to stop it in time. Anubhav Sinha's action thriller stars Sanjay Dutt, Abhishek Bachchan, Suniel Shetty, Zayed Khan and Shilpa Shetty.
ek-ajnabee-2005: Surya, a bitter ex-army officer who drinks too much, takes a job in Bangkok guarding Anamika, a young Indian girl. She slowly wins him over, but when she is kidnapped in front of him, Surya sets out to hunt down everyone responsible. Apoorva Lakhia's remake of Man on Fire stars Amitabh Bachchan and Arjun Rampal.
garam-masala-2005: Mac, a smooth-talking photographer in Mumbai, juggles three air-hostess girlfriends, timing their flights so they never meet. When a change in schedules brings them all to town at once, he and his friend Sam scramble to keep the lie going. Priyadarshan's farce stars Akshay Kumar, John Abraham and Paresh Rawal.
kaal-2005: Tourists in Corbett National Park are stalked by something far worse than a man-eating tiger, in a horror film produced by Shah Rukh Khan and Karan Johar.
ghajini-2005: Sanjay, a wealthy businessman with short-term memory loss, forgets everything every fifteen minutes. Using photos, notes and tattoos, he hunts the man who killed his beloved, while a curious medical student starts digging into his case. A. R. Murugadoss's psychological thriller stars Suriya, Asin, Nayanthara and Pradeep Rawat.
kyon-ki-2005: Tanvi, a doctor at a strict mental hospital run by her father, takes on a new patient, Anand, whose troubled past has left him deeply disturbed. Her gentle care begins to bring him back to himself, but her father's harsh ways stand in their way. Priyadarshan's romantic drama stars Salman Khan, Kareena Kapoor, Jackie Shroff and Om Puri.
karam-2005: A professional assassin (John Abraham) tries to leave his old life for his wife (Priyanka Chopra), but one last job goes wrong.
kuchh-meetha-ho-jaye-2005: A group of passengers is stranded at a small airport in rural Rajasthan when their plane develops a fault. Over one night, the airport's drunken manager, an old flame, a squabbling family and others find their lives tangling together. Samar Khan's romantic comedy stars Arshad Warsi, Mahima Chaudhry and Parvin Dabas, with Shah Rukh Khan in a cameo.
lucky-no-time-for-love-2005: Lucky, the daughter of an Indian diplomat's aide in Russia, is rescued from an attack by Aditya, a young man who soon falls for her. When war breaks out and Lucky is separated from her family, Aditya risks everything to keep her safe. Radhika Rao and Vinay Sapru's romantic drama stars Salman Khan and Sneha Ullal.
maayavi-2005: Balayya, a small-time con man, and his sidekick break into a beach villa that turns out to belong to a famous film actress. She has them arrested, and Balayya plans to get even by kidnapping her, but the time they spend together changes how she sees him.
maine-pyaar-kyun-kiya-2005: Sameer, a flirtatious doctor, avoids commitment by telling women he is already married. When he falls for Sonia and she insists on meeting his wife, he persuades his loyal nurse Naina to pose as his spouse, and the lie keeps growing. David Dhawan's comedy, inspired by Cactus Flower, stars Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif and Sushmita Sen.
mumbai-xpress-2005: Three small-time crooks plan to kidnap a rich man's young son, and hire Avinash, a deaf stunt biker known as Mumbai Xpress, as a last-minute replacement. When the plan goes wrong, Avinash is left with the boy and a ransom game he barely understands. Singeetam Srinivasa Rao's black comedy stars Kamal Haasan and Manisha Koirala.
mangal-pandey-the-rising-2005: In 1857, Mangal Pandey, a sepoy in the East India Company's army, shares a friendship with his British officer, Captain Gordon. When rumours spread that new rifle cartridges are greased with animal fat, Pandey's anger helps ignite a rebellion. Ketan Mehta's historical drama stars Aamir Khan, Toby Stephens, Rani Mukerji and Amisha Patel.
nuvvostanante-nenoddantana-200: A rich city boy falls for a village girl and must prove himself to her brother by working the land, in Prabhu Deva's debut as director.
no-entry-2005: A man's lies to his suspicious wife spiral when he and his friends get entangled with a woman named Bobby, with Anil Kapoor, Salman Khan and Fardeen Khan.
parineeta-2005: In 1960s Calcutta, a young woman (Vidya Balan) and her childhood friend (Saif Ali Khan) are pulled apart by money and misunderstanding, based on Sarat Chandra's novel.
political-rowdy-2005: Vithal, a feared 45-year-old gangster with no interest in women, falls for Kaveri, a college student who flirts with him for fun. When he proposes, she accepts out of fear, though she loves another man. Adi Narayana's remake of a Tamil film stars Mohan Babu, Charmme Kaur, Abbas and Prakash Raj.
naran-2005: Velayudhan, an orphan who washed up in a flood as a baby, grows into a feared but kind-hearted strongman in the Wayanad village of Mullankolly. He enforces his own code of justice, which puts him at odds with the village's scheming moneylender and its powerful families. Joshiy's action drama stars Mohanlal, Madhu, Bhavana and Devayani.
ramji-londonwaley-2005: Ramji, a simple cook from Bihar, goes to London to earn money for his sister's dowry. Stranded after his job falls through, he lives illegally among the city's Indian community and finds friendship and love. Sanjay Dayma's comedy drama, written with R. Madhavan, stars Madhavan and Samita Bangargi, with Amitabh Bachchan and Kamal Haasan in cameos.
ponniyin-selvan-2005: Radha Mohan's Tamil family drama with Ravi Krishna, Gopika and Revathi, unrelated to the Kalki novel of the same name.
rama-shama-bhama-2005: Ram, a happily married cartoonist, gets drawn into a flirtation with Priya, an ambitious young woman looking for a rich husband. To cover his tracks, he drags his friend into a web of lies that keeps getting more complicated. Ramesh Aravind's directorial debut, a remake of Sathi Leelavathi, stars Aravind, Kamal Haasan, Urvashi and Daisy Bopanna.
sehar-2005: In 1990s Lucknow, Ajay Kumar, an idealistic IPS officer, sets up a special task force with a professor's help to take on the organised crime gripping Uttar Pradesh, led by the ruthless Gajraj Singh. Kabeer Kaushik's crime drama stars Arshad Warsi, Pankaj Kapur, Mahima Chaudhry and Sushant Singh.
shabd-2005: Shaukat, a once-celebrated novelist struggling with writer's block, decides to base his new book on his wife Antara. He pushes her into an affair with a younger colleague to fuel his story, blurring the line between fiction and life. Leena Yadav's psychological drama stars Sanjay Dutt, Aishwarya Rai and Zayed Khan.
silsiilay-2005: Three women at different stages of life face love and betrayal: a rising film star whose partner will not commit, a receptionist searching for real tenderness, and a married woman drawn to her husband's friend. Khalid Mohamed's romantic anthology stars Tabu, Bhumika Chawla, Riya Sen, Rahul Bose and Jimmy Sheirgill, with Shah Rukh Khan as narrator.
sivakasi-2005: Sivakasi, a welder in Chennai, falls in love with Hema, but her brothers look down on him. He reveals a painful past: he was thrown out of his village as a boy after being falsely blamed for a crime, and must now return to face his family. Perarasu's action drama stars Vijay, Asin and Prakash Raj.
sree-2005: Sree is a young man raised by his widowed mother in Bhubaneswar, where he falls in love with Sandhya. When the henchmen of a cruel Rayalaseema landlord come hunting for her family, Sree protects them and discovers a link between the landlord and his own late father, which draws him back to Rayalaseema.
super-2005: Akhil, who runs a call-taxi service, falls in love with Siri, a doctor. Siri's adoptive brother Sonu, a high-tech thief, wants her to give up Akhil, but Akhil has a secret plan of his own involving a big heist. Puri Jagannadh's action thriller stars Nagarjuna, Sonu Sood, Anushka Shetty in her debut and Ayesha Takia.
the-mistress-of-spices-2005: Tilo, a mystical young woman, runs a spice shop in San Francisco and uses her magical spices to help her customers. Bound by strict rules, she must never fall in love, but when she meets Doug, an American architect, her powers are put to the test. Paul Mayeda Berges's romance stars Aishwarya Rai and Dylan McDermott.
udayananu-tharam-2005: Udayan, an assistant director devoted to cinema, is set to direct his first film from his own script. Then his friend Rajappan, a failed actor, steals the script, makes the film himself and becomes a star, leaving Udayan to plot his comeback. Rosshan Andrrews's satire, written by Sreenivasan, stars Mohanlal, Sreenivasan and Meena.
thanmathra-2005: Ramesan, a sincere government employee in Kerala, dreams of seeing his son become an IAS officer. When he starts showing early signs of Alzheimer's disease, his family must learn to cope as his memory slowly slips away. Blessy's drama, based on Padmarajan's story, won the National Award for Best Malayalam Film and stars Mohanlal, Meera Vasudevan and Arjun Lal.
viruddh-2005: Vidyadhar and Sumitra, a gentle retired couple in Mumbai, live for their son Amar, who works in London. When Amar is killed after witnessing a crime by a powerful man's son, the old father takes on the system to get justice. Mahesh Manjrekar's drama stars Amitabh Bachchan, Sharmila Tagore, John Abraham and Sanjay Dutt.
aayutha-ezhuthu-2004: On a Chennai bridge, a hitman shoots a student leader, and a young man driving by witnesses it. The film then tells the stories of the three men: a violent thug working for a politician, an idealistic student who wants young people in politics, and a carefree youth who finds a cause.
yakeen-2005: A woman's husband loses his memory after an accident, and she starts to doubt who he really is, with Arjun Rampal and Priyanka Chopra.
asambhav-2004: Captain Adit, an Indian Army special agent, is sent undercover to Switzerland to rescue the Indian president and his daughter, who have been kidnapped by terrorists. Posing as a journalist, he meets Alisha, a singer who has been unwittingly drawn into a gang of drug smugglers.
arjun-2004: Arjun is fiercely protective of his twin sister Meenakshi. When she marries Uday, a young man from Madurai, Arjun discovers that Uday's parents have sinister plans for her, and he moves to Madurai to save his sister from the scheming family.
aetbaar-2004: Dr Ranveer, a protective father still grieving his son's death, grows alarmed when his college-going daughter Ria falls for Aryan, a charming but volatile young man. As Aryan's possessiveness turns dangerous, Ranveer struggles to convince his daughter of the threat.
athade-oka-sainyam-2004: Jagapati Babu leads this Telugu action comedy, whose title means 'He alone is an army', directed by S. V. Krishna Reddy, who also composed its music. Neha co-stars in the film, which blends action, family drama and the director's trademark brand of comedy.
bimba-2004: A young child star is pushed hard by the film industry and by her own family, who come to depend on her earnings. Kavitha Lankesh's Kannada drama, starring Raksha Holla, looks at what fame and money do to a childhood, and at the adults who decide a child's life for her.
bride-and-prejudice-2004: Lalita Bakshi, the sharp-tongued second of four sisters in Amritsar, meets Will Darcy, a wealthy American who seems to look down on India. As her mother hunts for suitable grooms, Lalita must sort out pride, prejudice and attraction. Gurinder Chadha's Bollywood-style take on Jane Austen stars Aishwarya Rai and Martin Henderson.
dhoom-2004: A Mumbai cop (Abhishek Bachchan) teams up with a motorbike dealer (Uday Chopra) to stop a gang of bike-riding robbers led by John Abraham.
dev-2004: Two police officers in Mumbai, played by Amitabh Bachchan and Om Puri, are torn apart by communal riots, in Govind Nihalani's drama.
ella-enchanted-2004: At birth, Ella is given an unusual fairy gift: she must obey any command she is given. Growing up under a cruel stepmother and scheming stepsisters, she sets out on a quest to break the curse, and crosses paths with a handsome prince. Tommy O'Haver's musical fantasy comedy stars Anne Hathaway and Hugh Dancy.
dil-ne-jise-apna-kahaa-2004: Rishabh loses his beloved wife Pari, a doctor, in an accident, and her heart is donated to a young patient. Grieving, he later meets Dhani, a cheerful woman he begins to fall for, unaware of the bond they already share. Atul Agnihotri's romantic drama, inspired by Return to Me, stars Salman Khan, Preity Zinta and Bhumika Chawla.
garv-pride-and-honour-2004: ACP Arjun Ranawat stands accused of killing eighteen men and asks the court for nothing but a death sentence. Flashbacks show how he and his friend, a fellow officer, took on Mumbai's underworld and its political protectors. Puneet Issar's action thriller stars Salman Khan, Shilpa Shetty, Arbaaz Khan and Amrish Puri.
giri-2004: Arjun plays a man who takes a job at a bakery and falls for his boss's daughter, in Sundar C's action comedy.
hum-kaun-hai-2004: Sandra lives with her two children in a huge, gloomy mansion while her husband is away at war. The children's sensitivity to light keeps the curtains drawn, and when three new servants arrive, strange events begin to disturb the house. Ravi Shankar Sharma's remake of The Others stars Dimple Kapadia, Amitabh Bachchan and Dharmendra.
hulchul-2004: Two feuding families are thrown into chaos when a son of one falls for a daughter of the other, in Priyadarshan's remake of the Malayalam Godfather.
kismat-2004: A street fighter (Bobby Deol) is caught between rival gangsters, with Priyanka Chopra, a remake of the Bengali film Deva.
aa-ab-laut-chalen-1999: A young man who moves to America to make money is reminded by his family of the values he left behind, in Rishi Kapoor's only film as director.
aadhya-paadam-1977: A Malayalam drama from Adoor Bhasi with Kamal Haasan, Sheela, Sridevi and Jayan, remade from a Telugu film.
aadu-puli-attam-1977: Kamal Haasan and Rajinikanth star in S. P. Muthuraman's Tamil action film, with Sangeetha and Sripriya.
aaina-1974: A young woman sacrifices herself to support her large, struggling family, in K. Balachander's Hindi remake of Arangetram with Mumtaz.
aakhari-poratam-1988: Nagarjuna and Sridevi star in K. Raghavendra Rao's romantic action film, based on a novel by Yandamuri Veerendranath.
aame-katha-1977: Jayasudha plays a woman battling the hardships of her life, in a Telugu drama that won her a Filmfare award. Rajinikanth appears in a guest role.
aaj-ka-arjun-1990: Amitabh Bachchan plays a village man who fights the powerful landlord who wronged his sister, with Jaya Prada.
aakhree-raasta-1986: An old man released after years in prison sets out to take revenge on those who framed him, while his son is a police officer on the case. Amitabh Bachchan plays both roles.
aanandham-paramaanandham-1977: I. V. Sasi's Malayalam comedy with Kamal Haasan, Unni Mary and Chandrakala, a remake of the Tamil Anubavi Raja Anubavi.
