aap-mujhe-achche-lagne-lage-20: Sapna, the sheltered daughter of a feared underworld don, is attacked by rival gangsters and rescued by Rohit, a college student. They fall in love at once, but her violent father and brother will stop at nothing to keep them apart.
aaraam-thampuran-1997: Mohanlal plays a man who buys an old manor in a village and wins over its people, in Shaji Kailas's action drama with Manju Warrier.
aarilirunthu-arubathu-varai-19: Rajinikanth plays a man who spends his life sacrificing for his ungrateful siblings, from age six to sixty.
aasai-1995: A man becomes obsessed with his sister-in-law's younger sister, in Vasanth's romantic thriller with Ajith Kumar and Prakash Raj.
aasheervaadam-1977: I. V. Sasi's Malayalam film with Kamal Haasan, Sridevi and Sheela.
aaru-pushpangal-1977: Rajinikanth, Vijayakumar and Srividya star in K. M. Balakrishnan's Tamil family drama.
aatank-hi-aatank-1995: Two friends rise in the underworld, in a Hindi crime film inspired by The Godfather, with Rajinikanth and Aamir Khan.
aavida-maa-aavide-1998: Nagarjuna plays a man who ends up with two wives, Tabu and Heera, in E. V. V. Satyanarayana's comedy drama.
aatish-feel-the-fire-1994: Two brothers on opposite sides of the law are torn apart by the underworld, in Sanjay Gupta's debut with Sanjay Dutt.
aavide-syamala-1999: Prakash Raj plays a lazy husband who leaves his family for spiritual pursuits, a Telugu remake of Chinthavishtayaya Shyamala.
abhimanyu-1991: An innocent young man is drawn into the Bombay underworld and turns into a feared gangster, in Priyadarshan's crime drama with Mohanlal.
aayiram-jenmangal-1978: A Tamil horror film with Latha, Vijayakumar and Rajinikanth, a remake of the Malayalam Yakshagaanam.
aayirathil-oruthi-1975: A Tamil drama with K. R. Vijaya and K. Balaji, in which Kamal Haasan appears in a key role.
achanak-1998: Govinda and Manisha Koirala star in Naresh Malhotra's Hindi action thriller.
adimakal-udamakal-1987: Workers in a factory strike against a ruthless owner, in I. V. Sasi's social drama with Mohanlal and Mammootty.
adrustam-2002: Tarun is an unemployed orphan behind on his rent. When he attends a televised swayamvaram held by a wealthy family for their daughter Keerthi, he impulsively kisses her on live television, shocking viewers and setting off a chain of trouble. Tarun, Gajala and Reema Sen star in this Telugu film, the debut of director Sekhar Suri.
adhipathi-2001: In this Telugu remake of the Malayalam hit Narasimham, a young man returns home after years in prison for a crime he did not commit and takes on the powerful men who framed him. Mohan Babu and Nagarjuna star, with Preeti Jhangiani and Soundarya, in Ravi Raja Pinisetty's action drama.
adutha-varisu-1983: A con man poses as the lost heir of a rich family, in a Tamil remake of Raja Jani with Rajinikanth and Sridevi.
agni-putrudu-1987: Akkineni Nageswara Rao and his son Nagarjuna star together in K. Raghavendra Rao's Telugu action film, with Sivaji Ganesan.
agni-1989: Nagarjuna stars in K. Raghavendra Rao's Telugu action film, with music by Hamsalekha.
agni-sakshi-1982: A woman with schizophrenia struggles to tell fiction from reality, and her husband tries to help her, in K. Balachander's psychological drama.
agni-pushpam-1976: A Malayalam film from Jesey with Kamal Haasan, Jayabharathi and Jayan.
agnidevan-1995: Mohanlal plays a man caught in a power struggle over his family's newspaper, in Venu Nagavalli's drama with Revathi.
agni-varsha-2002: In a drought-stricken ancient kingdom, a priest leads a seven-year fire sacrifice to bring rain, while his younger brother loves a tribal girl and dreams of acting. Rivalries, a broken love and old curses collide in this adaptation of Girish Karnad's play The Fire and the Rain.
ajnabee-2001: A young couple befriend their charming new neighbours in Switzerland and are pulled into a deadly plot, with Akshay Kumar, Bobby Deol and Kareena Kapoor.
akayla-1991: A police officer (Amitabh Bachchan) hunts a serial killer while battling his own department, in Ramesh Sippy's thriller with Jackie Shroff.
akasa-veedhilo-2001: Nagarjuna plays a gifted singer whose dazzling rise to fame and success comes at a heavy personal cost, straining his relationships with the people closest to him. Singeetam Srinivasa Rao directs this Telugu musical drama, produced by Ramoji Rao, with Raveena Tandon, Rajendra Prasad and Kasthuri, and music by M. M. Keeravani.
akele-hum-akele-tum-1995: A struggling singer and his wife split when she chases her own career, leaving him to raise their young son, with Aamir Khan and Manisha Koirala.
aks-2001: A police officer (Amitabh Bachchan) finds that the spirit of a dead assassin (Manoj Bajpayee) has taken over his body, in Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra's debut.
akkare-akkare-akkare-1990: Two bumbling Kerala policemen (Mohanlal and Sreenivasan) are sent to America to recover a stolen golden crown, in Priyadarshan's comedy.
albela-2001: A tour guide (Govinda) falls for a famous film actress (Aishwarya Rai) who comes to Mauritius, in Deepak Sareen's romantic comedy.
alaap-1977: A young man (Amitabh Bachchan) gives up his father's wishes to pursue classical music, in Hrishikesh Mukherjee's musical drama with Rekha.
album-2002: Jeeva and Viji grow up in two neighbouring families whose lives are closely intertwined. When Viji falls in love with Jeeva, the warmth between the households is tested as the young couple try to overcome the obstacles that stand between them and a life together.
alexander-1996: Vijayakanth stars in Keyaar's Tamil action film, written by Panchu Arunachalam.
allari-alludu-1993: Nagarjuna plays a mischievous son-in-law who sets out to tame his proud mother-in-law, in A. Kodandarami Reddy's comedy.
allauddinum-albhutha-vilakkum: I. V. Sasi's fantasy retelling of Aladdin and the magic lamp, with Kamal Haasan and Rajinikanth.
amaanat-1994: Sanjay Dutt and Akshay Kumar lead Raj N. Sippy's Hindi action film, a remake of a Bengali film of the same name.
alli-thandha-vaanam-2001: Sathyam, the spoilt son of a rich mill owner, returns from New York and is challenged by his father to survive three months alone on the streets of Chennai without money or his family name. Living among ordinary people, he finds friendship, love and a new sense of responsibility.
amma-nanna-o-tamila-ammayi-200: Chandu, a kickboxer who lives with his beloved mother in Hyderabad, is devastated when she dies. On her deathbed she asks him to go to Visakhapatnam to meet the father who left them, a six-time kickboxing champion, and Chandu must confront the man he has resented all his life.
anandha-jodhi-1963: M. G. Ramachandran and Devika star in this Tamil drama, which features a young Kamal Haasan as a child actor.
amrutham-gamaya-1987: A young doctor (Mohanlal) is haunted by guilt after a student he once ragged dies, in Hariharan's drama written by M. T. Vasudevan Nair.
anbu-thangai-1974: A Tamil drama from S. P. Muthuraman with R. Muthuraman, Srikanth and Jayalalithaa.
anbulla-rajinikanth-1984: A sick, bitter little girl at an orphanage softens after a friendship with Rajinikanth, who plays himself.
anbukku-naan-adimai-1980: Rajinikanth stars in R. Thyagarajan's Tamil action drama from Devar Films, with Rati and Sujatha.
andaaz-2003: A pilot (Akshay Kumar) is caught between the woman he meets on a trip (Lara Dutta) and his childhood friend (Priyanka Chopra).
andha-oru-nimidam-1985: Kamal Haasan and Urvashi star in Major Sundarrajan's Tamil thriller.
andharangam-1975: A Tamil romantic drama from Muktha Srinivasan with Kamal Haasan and Deepa.
anna-thammudu-1990: Krishna directs and stars with his son Mahesh Babu in a Telugu action drama.

angaaray-1998: Akshay Kumar and Nagarjuna lead Mahesh Bhatt's Hindi action film, with Pooja Bhatt and Sonali Bendre.
annaamalai-1992: A milkman (Rajinikanth) and his rich childhood friend fall out bitterly, in Suresh Krissna's remake of Khudgarz.

annai-velankanni-1971: A Tamil devotional film about the miracles of Our Lady of Velankanni, with Gemini Ganesan and Jayalalithaa.
annamayya-1997: Nagarjuna plays the 15th-century composer Annamacharya, devotee of Lord Venkateswara, in K. Raghavendra Rao's devotional film.
annadammula-savaal-1978: Krishna and Rajinikanth star in K. S. R. Das's Telugu drama, with Jayachitra and Chandrakala.
antham-1992: A hitman (Nagarjuna) who wants out of crime falls for a young woman, in Ram Gopal Varma's crime film made in Telugu and Hindi.
anthuleni-katha-1976: A young woman (Jaya Prada) supports her family while hiding her own struggles, in K. Balachander's Telugu drama with Rajinikanth.
anthiveyilile-ponnu-1982: A Malayalam film with Kamal Haasan, Lakshmi and Jagathy Sreekumar.
anukoolakkobba-ganda-1990: Raghavendra Rajkumar and Vidhyashree lead M. S. Rajashekar's Kannada film.

aranyakanda-1986: Nagarjuna stars in Kranthi Kumar's Telugu action thriller, with Rajendra Prasad.
arangetram-1973: A Brahmin girl from a poor, large family turns to sex work to support them, in K. Balachander's bold drama.
aram-aram-kinnaram-1985: A Priyadarshan slapstick comedy with Shankar, Mohanlal and Lissy.
aravindhan-1997: Sarathkumar plays a man caught in a political conspiracy, in T. Nagarajan's thriller with Parthiban and Nagma.
arhatha-1990: I. V. Sasi's Malayalam film with Mohanlal, Urvashi, Rekha and Suresh Gopi.
arjun-1985: An unemployed young man in Bombay (Sunny Deol) takes on a local gangster and is used by politicians in the fight that follows.
arjun-pandit-1999: A gentle student turns into a feared gangster after the woman he loves is torn from him, in a remake of the Kannada Om with Sunny Deol.
armaan-2003: A dedicated doctor (Anil Kapoor) tries to keep his late father's hospital running, and a wealthy, troubled woman (Preity Zinta) enters his life.
army-1996: A widow (Sridevi) recruits a team of convicts to take revenge on the gangster who killed her husband (Shah Rukh Khan).
arunachalam-1997: A man (Rajinikanth) is told he must spend a fortune in 30 days to inherit an even bigger one, in Sundar C's comedy.
aryan-1988: A Brahmin youth turns to crime in Bombay after being denied a job, in Priyadarshan's action film with Mohanlal.
aruthu-1976: A Malayalam film from Ravi with Kamal Haasan and Sumithra.
ashtamangalyam-1977: A Malayalam film from P. Gopikumar with Kamal Haasan and Vidhubala.
asli-naqli-1986: Shatrughan Sinha and Rajinikanth star in Sudarsan Nag's Hindi action film, which was a box office hit.
athisaya-piravi-1990: A man killed by mistake is sent back to earth in another body by the god of death, in a Tamil remake of Yamudiki Mogudu with Rajinikanth.

auto-driver-1998: Nagarjuna plays an auto-rickshaw driver who wins the heart of a rich girl, with Simran and Deepti Bhatnagar.
aval-oru-thodar-kathai-1974: A working woman supports her large, ungrateful family at the cost of her own happiness, in K. Balachander's landmark drama.
avalude-ravukal-1978: The life of a teenage girl forced into prostitution and the people around her, in I. V. Sasi's controversial drama.
aval-viswasthayayirunnu-1978: A Malayalam film from Jeassy with M. G. Soman and Jayabharathi, and a guest role for Kamal Haasan.
awwal-number-1990: A cricket star (Aamir Khan) and a police chief (Dev Anand) race to stop a terrorist plot during a match.
awara-paagal-deewana-2002: A mob accountant hiding in America becomes the target of hitmen, in Vikram Bhatt's comedy with Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty and Paresh Rawal.
aye-auto-1990: An auto-rickshaw driver (Mohanlal) falls in love with a rich girl, in Venu Nagavalli's romantic comedy.
azad-2000: Nagarjuna plays a patriotic man who fights terrorists while trying to protect the people he loves, with Shilpa Shetty and Soundarya.
azhiyatha-kolangal-1979: Three teenage boys in a village have a crush on their new schoolteacher, in Balu Mahendra's coming-of-age film.

baazigar-1993: A young man (Shah Rukh Khan) sets out to avenge his family by seducing the daughters of the man who ruined them.

The music is composed by Chakri, and the film was released in November 2000.
badri-2000: Badri, an ad film director, is challenged by his fiancée Vennela to make another girl fall for him. He approaches Sarayu, who falls in love with him, and he finds himself falling for her too, but her fiercely protective brother Nanda is determined to keep them apart.
bade-miyan-chote-miyan-1998: Two police officers (Amitabh Bachchan and Govinda) swap places with two lookalike crooks, in David Dhawan's comedy.
bairavi-1978: Rajinikanth plays his first lead role as a man who takes revenge on the rich man who ruined his sister.
balachandrudu-1990: A young Mahesh Babu plays the title role in Krishna's Telugu action drama.

bandhe-haath-1973: Amitabh Bachchan plays a double role, a thief and a lookalike, with Mumtaz.
bandhan-1998: A man lives for his sister and her husband, until a family feud tests his loyalty, with Salman Khan and Jackie Shroff.
barood-1998: Akshay Kumar and Raveena Tandon lead Pramod Chakravorty's Hindi action film.
bava-nachadu-2001: Ajay, an advertising filmmaker, marries Meenakshi, a village girl chosen by his mother. When she is injured and her family moves in to help, her glamorous younger sister Lahari becomes a model for Ajay's ads and falls for him, testing the marriage.
bazaar-rowdy-1988: Ramesh Babu stars in A. Kodandarami Reddy's Telugu action drama, with a young Mahesh Babu.
benaam-1974: A man (Amitabh Bachchan) who witnesses a murder is hunted by a nameless gang that kidnaps his son.
bemisal-1982: Two friends, both doctors, love the same woman, in Hrishikesh Mukherjee's drama with Amitabh Bachchan.
besharam-1978: A poor man (Amitabh Bachchan) reinvents himself as a rich gentleman to take revenge, in Deven Verma's drama.
betaab-1983: A rich girl and a poor farm boy fall in love despite her mother's hatred of his family, launching Sunny Deol and Amrita Singh.
benkiyalli-aralida-hoovu-1983: A young woman (Suhasini) supports her family through hard work and sacrifice, in K. Balachander's Kannada drama.
bhagwaan-dada-1986: A criminal (Rajinikanth) is redeemed by his love for a child, with Rakesh Roshan and Sridevi.
bewafai-1985: Rajesh Khanna and Rajinikanth star in R. Thyagarajan's Hindi drama.
bhagya-debata-1995: Mithun Chakraborty leads a Bengali action film from choreographer Raghuram.

bhoot-2003: A couple move into a Mumbai flat where the previous tenant died, and the wife starts to act possessed, in Ram Gopal Varma's horror film.
bharatham-1991: A Carnatic singer (Mohanlal) hides his elder brother's death so their sister's wedding can go ahead, in Sibi Malayil's musical drama that won him a National Award.
bhrashtachar-1989: Ramesh Sippy's Hindi drama about corruption, with Mithun Chakraborty, Rekha and Anupam Kher, and a special appearance by Rajinikanth.
billa-1980: A police officer replaces a dead gangster with his simple lookalike to bring down the gang, in a Tamil remake of Don with Rajinikanth in a dual role.
biwi-ho-to-aisi-1988: A good-natured daughter-in-law (Rekha) stands up to her domineering mother-in-law, in the film that marked Salman Khan's screen debut.
bhuvana-oru-kelvi-kuri-1977: S. P. Muthuraman's Tamil drama, based on Maharishi's novel, with Sivakumar and Rajinikanth playing against type.
biwi-no-1-1999: A married man's affair with a model turns his life upside down when his wife sets out to win him back, a remake of Sathi Leelavathi with Salman Khan and Karisma Kapoor.
bobby-2002: Mahesh Babu plays a young man who falls for the daughter of a powerful family, in Sobhan's Telugu romance with Aarthi Agarwal.
boeing-boeing-1985: A playboy (Mohanlal) juggles three air hostess girlfriends on different schedules, until their flights change, in Priyadarshan's comedy.
bloodstone-1988: An American couple honeymooning in India get caught up in the hunt for a stolen gem, helped by a taxi driver played by Rajinikanth.
bombay-to-goa-1972: A bus ride from Bombay to Goa turns chaotic when a runaway heiress hides on board, chased by killers, with Amitabh Bachchan.
bulandi-2000: Dada Thakur is the respected head of his village, and his word is law for everyone, including his own younger brothers. When one of them is accused of a serious crime, the whole household waits to see how he will judge his own blood. T. Rama Rao's remake of Nattamai stars Anil Kapoor in a dual role, with Rekha and Raveena Tandon.
boom-2003: Three top models get into a catwalk scuffle at a fashion show, and a stash of smuggled diamonds spills onto the runway. Kaizad Gustad's black comedy stars Amitabh Bachchan, Jackie Shroff, Gulshan Grover and Katrina Kaif in her debut.
butterflies-1993: Rajiv Anchal's Malayalam comedy drama, with Mohanlal in the lead.
captain-nagarjun-1986: Nagarjuna, Khushboo and Rajendra Prasad star in V. B. Rajendra Prasad's Telugu romance.
chaand-kaa-tukdaa-1994: Sridevi, Salman Khan and Shatrughan Sinha star in Saawan Kumar Tak's Hindi film.
chaahat-1996: A singer from Rajasthan (Shah Rukh Khan) comes to Bombay to pay for his father's treatment and falls foul of a rich, possessive woman.
chaitanya-1991: Nagarjuna plays a young man on a road journey in Pratap Pothen's only Telugu film as director, with Gautami.
chal-mere-bhai-2000: Vicky, a busy business tycoon, and his younger brother Prem, an aspiring actor, both fall for Sapna, the cheerful new secretary their father has hired. As Sapna slips into their lives, misunderstandings and sibling rivalry pile up. David Dhawan's comedy stars Sanjay Dutt, Salman Khan and Karisma Kapoor.
chalte-chalte-2003: A truck company owner (Shah Rukh Khan) and a fashion designer (Rani Mukerji) fall in love, but marriage brings strain.
chala-murari-hero-banne-1977: Asrani directs and stars as a small-town man who goes to Bombay dreaming of becoming a film hero.
chamatkar-1992: A con man's ghost (Naseeruddin Shah) helps a small-town teacher (Shah Rukh Khan) in Bombay, and asks him for revenge in return.
chandra-mukhi-1993: A princess from a fantasy kingdom (Sridevi) comes down to earth and meets a young man (Salman Khan).
chanakyan-1989: A man (Kamal Haasan) uses his talent for mimicry to take revenge on a powerful politician.
chandralekha-1997: A man impersonates a comatose woman's husband to help her family, and gets drawn into their lives, in Priyadarshan's comedy with Mohanlal.
chandralekha-1998: Nagarjuna plays a man who poses as the husband of a woman in a coma, in Krishna Vamsi's Telugu version of the story.

chashme-buddoor-1981: Three Delhi roommates compete for the attention of the pretty girl next door, in Sai Paranjpye's comedy.

chenkol-1993: Sethumadhavan (Mohanlal) is out of prison but cannot escape his violent reputation, in the sequel to Kireedam.
chhoti-si-baat-1976: A shy office clerk (Amol Palekar) gets lessons in confidence from a retired colonel to win over a colleague, in Basu Chatterjee's comedy.
chilakamma-cheppindi-1977: A Telugu drama that gave Rajinikanth his first lead role, with Sangeeta and Sripriya.
chiru-navvutho-2000: Venu, an orphaned chef who believes in staying cheerful, is rejected by his cousin on their wedding day because of his job. chinababu-1988: Nagarjuna and Amala star in A. Mohan Gandhi's Telugu family drama.

Prakash Raj, Khushbu and Nassar star in this Tamil heist thriller by Ameerjan.

Rituparno Ghosh adapts Tagore's novel, with Aishwarya Rai and Prosenjit.
chithram-1988: A man (Mohanlal) is hired to pose as a woman's husband for a few days to fool her visiting father, in Priyadarshan's comedy.

Abbas–Mustan's drama stars Salman Khan, Rani Mukerji and Preity Zinta.
choodalani-vundi-1998: Chiranjeevi plays a man who travels to Calcutta to rescue his son from a powerful gangster, in Gunasekhar's action thriller.
collector-gari-abbai-1987: Akkineni Nageswara Rao and Nagarjuna play father and son in B. Gopal's Telugu action drama.
cinema-cinema-1979: A documentary-style look at Hindi cinema through the years, from Krishna Shah.
coolie-1983: A railway porter (Amitabh Bachchan) fights the man who tore his family apart years earlier, in Manmohan Desai's action comedy.
commander-1981: Amjad Khan leads Rakesh Kumar's Hindi action drama.
criminal-1994: A surgeon (Nagarjuna) is framed for murder and hunts the real killer, in Mahesh Bhatt's thriller made in Telugu and Hindi.

daisy-1988: A boarding school romance in Ooty between two teenagers, and their separation and longing, in Prathap Pothen's musical drama.
daku-hasina-1987: Zeenat Aman plays a woman who turns dacoit for revenge, with Rakesh Roshan and an extended appearance by Rajinikanth.
damini-1993: A woman (Meenakshi Seshadri) witnesses her brother-in-law's crime and fights her rich in-laws to see justice done, with Sunny Deol as her lawyer.
darr-1993: An obsessed young man (Shah Rukh Khan) stalks a woman (Juhi Chawla) and her naval officer fiancé, in Yash Chopra's thriller.
daud-1997: A small-time crook and a feisty young woman go on the run with a deadly secret, in Ram Gopal Varma's comic chase film.
daulat-ki-jung-1992: Aamir Khan and Juhi Chawla play children of two rival rich families who fall in love.
dasharatham-1989: A rich, lonely man (Mohanlal) hires a surrogate mother and then can't bear to give up the child, in Sibi Malayil's drama.
deewana-1992: A widow (Divya Bharti) finds love again with a young man (Shah Rukh Khan in his debut), while her husband's enemies close in.
deewana-mastana-1997: Two rival men (Govinda and Anil Kapoor) chase the same woman (Juhi Chawla), in David Dhawan's comedy.
deewana-mujh-sa-nahin-1990: A poor young man (Aamir Khan) falls for a rich girl (Madhuri Dixit) and tries to win her love.
dekha-pyar-tumhara-1985: Kamal Haasan and Rati Agnihotri star in Veerendra Sharma's Hindi film.
deewangee-2002: Raj, a star criminal lawyer who has never lost a case, agrees to defend Tarang, a gentle music composer caught at a murder scene, at the request of singer Sargam. desh-premee-1982: Amitabh Bachchan plays a freedom fighter and his son, fighting crime in a divided neighbourhood, in Manmohan Desai's drama.
devaasuram-1993: A wealthy, arrogant feudal heir (Mohanlal) is brought low by his enemies and his own pride, in I. V. Sasi's classic.
devadoothan-2000: Vishal, a struggling musician, is invited back to the college that once expelled him to stage a music festival. There, a strange old instrument begins playing a haunting tune on its own, drawing him into a long-buried love story and a mystery he must solve. Sibi Malayil's Malayalam mystery stars Mohanlal and Jaya Prada.
dhai-akshar-prem-ke-2000: Sahiba, a college student from a traditional Rajput family, invents a husband to escape an arranged marriage. Raj Kanwar's romantic drama, inspired by A Walk in the Clouds, stars Abhishek Bachchan and Aishwarya Rai.
dharma-yuddham-1979: Rajinikanth and Sridevi star in R. C. Sakthi's Tamil action film.
dharmathin-thalaivan-1988: Rajinikanth plays a double role, a professor and his lookalike, in S. P. Muthuraman's action drama.
dhaya-2002: Dhaya is a feared rowdy in Chennai whose political connections keep the police off his back. Senthil Kumar's action drama stars Prakash Raj, who won a National Film Award (Special Jury) for the role, with Meena.
dharma-durai-1991: A man (Rajinikanth) takes the blame for his brothers and goes to prison, only to find them ungrateful when he is released.
dil-1990: Two rich, warring fathers try to stop their children (Aamir Khan and Madhuri Dixit) from marrying, in Indra Kumar's debut.
dil-aashna-hai-1992: A dancer sets out to find her real mother, in Hema Malini's debut as director with Shah Rukh Khan and Divya Bharti.
dhinamum-ennai-gavani-1997: A Tamil crime film with Ramki, Sanghavi and Prakash Raj.
dil-hai-ke-manta-nahin-1991: A runaway heiress (Pooja Bhatt) and a cynical reporter (Aamir Khan) fall in love on a road trip, inspired by It Happened One Night.
dil-ka-rishta-2003: A man (Arjun Rampal) obsessed with a woman (Aishwarya Rai) tries to win her back after she loses her memory and her husband.
dil-ki-baazi-1993: Akshay Kumar and Ayesha Jhulka lead Anil Ganguly's Hindi action film.
diljale-1996: A young man is drawn into militancy and has to choose between the cause and love, with Ajay Devgn and Sonali Bendre.
dil-tera-aashiq-1993: Salman Khan and Madhuri Dixit star in Lawrence D'Souza's romantic comedy.
dilwale-1994: A man escapes from a mental asylum to find the woman he loves, now with a police officer, with Ajay Devgn, Suniel Shetty and Raveena Tandon.
dil-to-pagal-hai-1997: A love triangle among members of a dance troupe, with Shah Rukh Khan, Madhuri Dixit and Karisma Kapoor, in Yash Chopra's musical.
divya-shakti-1993: Ajay Devgn and Raveena Tandon lead Sameer Malkan's Hindi action film.
do-aur-do-paanch-1980: Two rival con men (Amitabh Bachchan and Shashi Kapoor) are hired to kidnap the same boy.
do-anjaane-1976: A man (Amitabh Bachchan) loses his memory after a betrayal and returns years later under a new name.
doli-saja-ke-rakhna-1998: A young couple elope against their families' wishes, then return to win their blessings, a remake of Aniyathipraavu with Akshaye Khanna.

dosti-dushmani-1986: Jeetendra, Rajinikanth and Rishi Kapoor star in T. Rama Rao's Hindi action drama about friendship and enmity.
dost-1974: A good-natured young man befriends a thief and tries to change him, with Dharmendra and Shatrughan Sinha.
duet-1994: Two brothers, both musicians, love the same woman, in K. Balachander's musical drama with Prabhu.
dulhan-hum-le-jayenge-2000: A young man (Salman Khan) has to win over a bride's three eccentric uncles, in David Dhawan's comedy.
duplicate-1998: A mild-mannered chef and his lookalike, a violent escaped convict, are mistaken for each other, with Shah Rukh Khan in a dual role.
dushman-1998: A woman (Kajol) trains with a blind army officer to take revenge on the man who killed her twin sister.
dushman-duniya-ka-1996: A troubled son turns violent and destroys his family, in Mehmood's psychological drama with a cameo by Shah Rukh Khan.
earth-1998: In Lahore during Partition, a Parsi girl watches her nanny and her nanny's suitors torn apart by religious violence.
ek-ladka-ek-ladki-1992: A rich heiress loses her memory and is taken in by a poor man who claims she is his wife, with Salman Khan and Neelam.
eduruleni-manishi-2001: Surya Murthy is the respected head of his village, living with his grandparents and a little girl named Rani, while his lookalike younger brother Sathya studies engineering in Hyderabad. ek-nazar-1972: A poet falls for a courtesan's daughter, and his family opposes the match, with Amitabh Bachchan and Jaya Bhaduri.
ek-nai-paheli-1984: A tangled love story in which a mother and daughter fall for a father and son, a Hindi remake of Apoorva Raagangal with Kamal Haasan.
ek-rishtaa-the-bond-of-love-20: Vijay Kapoor, a successful businessman, clashes with his son Ajay over how to run the family company, and the rift splits the family apart. ekangi-2002: Raja lives a contented life guided by his father's principles until he meets Shilpa at a bar and falls in love with her. When he brings her home, his peaceful world begins to unravel. V. Ravichandran writes, directs, scores and stars in this Kannada drama, with Ramya Krishna and Prakash Raj.
elaan-1994: Akshay Kumar and Madhoo lead Guddu Dhanoa's Hindi action film, with Amrish Puri.
ellam-inba-mayyam-1981: Kamal Haasan stars in G. N. Rangarajan's Tamil film, with Jaishankar and Maadhavi.
ellam-un-kairasi-1980: Rajinikanth stars in M. A. Thirumugam's Tamil film, which took two years to reach cinemas.
enakkul-oruvan-1984: A man (Kamal Haasan) is haunted by visions of a past life as a dancer who was murdered, in S. P. Muthuraman's musical thriller, his 125th film.

Farhan Akhtar's slick remake of the 1978 classic stars Shah Rukh Khan, Priyanka Chopra, Arjun Rampal and Boman Irani.
eenadu-2009: A common man plants bombs across Hyderabad and calls the police commissioner, demanding the release of four terrorists. As the deadline ticks closer, the city's police race to find him. Chakri Toleti's thriller, a remake of A Wednesday made alongside the Tamil Unnaipol Oruvan, stars Kamal Haasan and Venkatesh.
en-swaasa-kaatrae-1999: Arvind Swamy and Isha Koppikar star in K. S. Ravi's Tamil romantic drama.
epic: Aditya, a middle-class boy from Wanaparthy in Telangana, moves to London for his higher studies. There he meets Kadali, a strong-willed, independent young woman, and the two navigate love, friendship and growing up far from home. Anand Deverakonda and Vaishnavi Chaitanya star in Aditya Haasan's coming-of-age romance.
f3-fun-and-frustration-2022: Venky, an RTO agent in Hyderabad who secretly suffers from night blindness, and his friend Varun, a stammering orphan, are both desperate to get rich quick. After a string of failed schemes, a dubious loan and a chance at a fortune draw them, their partners and their families into a chaotic hunt for easy money.
galwakdi-2022: Jagteshwar is a librarian with obsessive-compulsive habits that everyone around him has learnt to live with. His orderly world is turned upside down when Amberdeep, a lively, free-spirited young woman, ends up living under the same roof. Tarsem Jassar and Wamiqa Gabbi star in this Punjabi romantic comedy.
ganga-devi-2012: Ganga Devi is a Bhojpuri drama directed by Abhishek Chadha, with Ravi Kishan in a leading role. The film drew wide attention for a special appearance by Amitabh Bachchan, who features in a key part, alongside a cast of well-known Bhojpuri actors, in a story centred on family and duty.
garjanam-1981: Rajinikanth and Madhavi star in the Malayalam version of C. V. Rajendran's action film.
garjane-1981: Rajinikanth and Madhavi star in the Kannada version of C. V. Rajendran's action film.
gdn: This biopic of the inventor and engineer G. D. Naidu opens in the late 1950s, as he battles the income tax department. It then traces his life from a village boy fascinated by a motorcycle to a pioneering businessman who built a bus company and India's first indigenous electric motor.
geetanjali-1989: Two young people with terminal illnesses fall in love in the hills, in Mani Ratnam's Telugu romance with Nagarjuna and Girija.
guppedu-manasu-1979: K. Balachander's Telugu drama with Kamal Haasan.
idhaya-thirudan-2006: A young woman posts her photos online and emails them to an address she believes is made up, only to find that it belongs to a real man. They meet and fall in love, but a police officer who wants her for himself stands in their way. Ravi Mohan and Kamna Jethmalani star in this Tamil romantic action film by Saran.
ishqan-de-lekhe: Two young lovers find their relationship tested when family expectations and their own choices pull them in different directions. As feelings deepen and conflicts mount, staying together demands painful sacrifices. Manvir Brar directs this Punjabi romantic drama, released in March 2026.
ishqnama: Set on the India–Pakistan border in 1982 and inspired by real events, the film tells the love story of Nimma and Nasima, who are separated by two nations but refuse to give up on each other. Jayy Randhawa and Shehnaaz Gill star in Arvindr Khaira's Punjabi period romance.
ividam-swargamanu-2009: Mathews, a hard-working dairy farmer, lives contentedly on his land with his family. When a powerful land-mafia boss wants the farm for a big project, Mathews refuses to sell and takes on both the mafia and the officials it controls. Rosshan Andrrews's drama stars Mohanlal, Lalu Alex, Thilakan, Sreenivasan and Lakshmi Rai.
jadi-the-untold-side-of: A petty quarrel between a reckless young man and his former friend turns them into bitter enemies and sets off a chain of events that shakes their whole village. As hidden truths come to light, one impulsive moment threatens to change everything. Dibyajyoti Udayasingh directs this Odia crime drama.
kaala-patthar-1979: A disgraced former naval officer (Amitabh Bachchan) works in a coal mine and faces a disaster when the mine floods, in Yash Chopra's drama.
kabhi-haan-kabhi-naa-1994: A lovable failure (Shah Rukh Khan) schemes to win the girl who loves his friend, in Kundan Shah's comedy.
kadhal-kondein-2003: Vinod, a brilliant but withdrawn young man with a troubled past, joins college and grows attached to Divya, the first person to show him kindness. As his feelings turn into a dangerous obsession, her life is put in peril. Selvaraghavan's psychological thriller stars Dhanush and Sonia Agarwal.
kalavadiya-pozhudugal-2017: Thangar Bachan's Tamil romantic drama, long delayed before its 2017 release, follows a man whose lost love re-enters his life years after they parted, stirring old memories and questions about the choices they made. Prabhu Deva, Bhumika Chawla and Prakash Raj star.
kirai-dada-1987: Nagarjuna, Amala and Khushbu star in A. Kodandarami Reddy's Telugu action film.
kirathaka-2011: Two neighbouring villages have rival gangs who compete in everything. Nandisha, a carefree young man with no direction in life, falls for Nethra, a college student from the rival village, and their romance sets off fresh trouble. Yash and Oviya star in this Kannada romantic comedy, a remake of the Tamil film Kalavani.
koka-deuta-nati-aru-hati: After years in America, Prasanta returns to Assam carrying memories of the elephant who was his childhood friend. His grandson Ankur, raised abroad, begins to discover his roots, and the visit bridges three generations through village life and a search for belonging. Biswajeet Bora directs this Assamese family drama.
lik-love-insurance-kompa: In a near future, a young man (Pradeep Ranganathan) deals with a company that sells insurance for love, in Vignesh Shivan's sci-fi romantic comedy.
mana-oori-ramayanam-2016: During the Rama Navami festival, Bhujanga, a hot-tempered businessman back from the Gulf and a respected man in his town, ends up stuck overnight in his own empty shop with a stranger. The long night tests his pride and his image. Prakash Raj directs and stars in this Telugu version of Idolle Ramayana, with Priyamani.
marty-supreme: In 1950s New York, Marty Mauser is a brash young shoe salesman who is also a gifted table tennis player with dreams of becoming world champion. Desperate to get to the British Open and prove himself, he hustles, lies and gambles his way through a string of risky schemes. Timothée Chalamet stars.
mirapakaay-2011: Rishi, an intelligence officer, goes undercover as a Hindi lecturer at a Hyderabad college to get close to the family of a dangerous crime boss. His double life gets complicated when he falls for a student. Harish Shankar's action comedy stars Ravi Teja, Richa Gangopadhyay, Deeksha Seth and Prakash Raj.
mr-and-mrs-ramachari-2014: Ramachari, a hot-headed college student and die-hard fan of actor Vishnuvardhan, is constantly at odds with his father. When he falls for Divya, a classmate, love begins to change him, but family pressures put their relationship to the test. Santhosh Ananddram's romantic drama stars Yash and Radhika Pandit.
mr-x: Gautham Karthik, Manju Warrier and R. Sarathkumar star in Manu Anand's action thriller.
mrityudata-1997: Amitabh Bachchan, Karisma Kapoor and Dimple Kapadia star in Mehul Kumar's action film.
naan-mahan-alla-1984: A man (Rajinikanth) seeks revenge on those who killed his father, in S. P. Muthuraman's action film.
naaradan-2022: Chandraprakash is a popular television news anchor in Kerala who is under constant pressure to boost ratings. When a rival threatens his top spot, he abandons his principles and launches his own sensationalist channel, Narada News, turning himself into a powerful kingmaker who will distort any story for attention.
nanbenda-2015: Sathya, a carefree young man, falls for Ramya the moment he sees her and, with his loyal friend tagging along, tries every trick he can think of to win her over, landing both of them in a string of comic scrapes. A. Jagadish's romantic comedy stars Udhayanidhi Stalin, Nayanthara and Santhanam.
nandha-2001: A young man (Suriya) jailed as a boy for killing his abusive father returns and becomes a feared protector of his town, in Bala's drama.
needa-1979: Dasari Narayana Rao's Telugu drama with Ramesh Babu and a young Mahesh Babu.
nerukku-ner-1997: Two cousins (Vijay and Suriya) become enemies after a family feud, in Vasanth's action drama.
nine-2019: A scientist (Prithviraj) and his son face strange events when a comet passes over Earth, in a Malayalam science-fiction thriller.
ninna-nedu-repu-2008: Ninna Nedu Repu, a title that translates to Yesterday, Today, Tomorrow, is a 2008 Telugu drama directed by Ravi Babu. Ravi Krishna and Tamannaah lead the cast, with comedian Brahmanandam in a supporting role, in a film whose story is framed around the passage of time in its characters' lives.
nishkarsha-1994: A commando (Vishnuvardhan) races to rescue hostages held by robbers in a Bangalore bank.
nrc-nalparar-ramchandra: When a flood separates Satyabati from the man she loves, their son Koshlendra grows up never knowing his father. Years later, his search for the truth becomes entangled with a forbidden romance and a family's buried prejudices. Nanan Pachani directs this Assamese family drama.
olympiyan-anthony-adam-1999: A former athlete (Mohanlal) becomes a teacher at a boarding school and turns it around, while a secret from his past catches up.
once-upon-a-time-in-mumbai-dob: Shoaib Khan, now the king of Mumbai's underworld, returns to the city from abroad. He falls for Jasmine, an aspiring actress, unaware that his loyal young protégé Aslam is in love with her too, and the triangle threatens his empire. Milan Luthria's gangster sequel stars Akshay Kumar, Imran Khan and Sonakshi Sinha.
ongole-githa-2013: White, an orphan who arrived at the Ongole market as a boy, has grown into one of its leading merchants under the patronage of the respected market chairman. When he falls for the chairman's daughter and a politician tries to seize the market, the chairman's true character begins to surface.
paan-khaye-saiyaan-hamaar-1984: A Bhojpuri drama with Sujit Kumar and Amitabh Bachchan.
pavithra-bandham-1996: Venkatesh and Soundarya star in a romantic drama about a marriage begun as a contract.
pet-pyaar-aur-paap-1984: Lekh Tandon's Hindi drama with a guest appearance by Amitabh Bachchan.
poikkal-kuthirai-2022: Kathiravan, a single father who lost a leg and his wife in an accident, devotes himself to his young daughter. When she is diagnosed with a serious illness that needs costly treatment, the desperate father is drawn into a dangerous plan to raise the money.
prahaar-the-ujjwal-nikam: Inspired by public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam, the legal drama follows his work after the 2006 verdicts in the 1993 Mumbai bombings case. When terrorists attack Mumbai in November 2008, Nikam takes on the prosecution of the surviving gunman, a case that tests him professionally and personally.
priya-1978: A detective (Rajinikanth) travels to Singapore to find a missing actress, based on Sujatha's novel.
priya-1978-kannada: A detective (Rajinikanth) travels to Singapore to find a missing actress, the Kannada version of Priya.
rabb-da-radio-3: The third film in the Punjabi family drama series brings back Tarsem Jassar and Nimrat Khaira for another story of love, tradition and close-knit rural life. Directed by Harry Bhatti, it also features Sardar Sohi, Sunita Dhir and Nirmal Rishi, set against the nostalgic village backdrop of the earlier films.
rakkasapuradol: In 1999, Shiva, a police officer struggling with alcoholism after his wife's death, is transferred to the remote village of Rakkasapura, where crime is said to be rare. Soon a series of mysterious deaths begins, which the villagers blame on a feared spirit, while Shiva hunts for a human culprit.
rakta-charitra-ii-2010: Pratap Ravi, now a powerful minister after avenging his family, faces a new enemy: Surya, a man whose family was destroyed by Pratap's violence and who wants revenge. Their war plays out across the factional politics of Andhra Pradesh. Ram Gopal Varma's sequel stars Vivek Oberoi and Suriya, with Priyamani.
ramachaari-1990: Ravichandran and Malashri star in his Kannada action drama.
rock-and-roll-2007: Chandramouli, a gifted but carefree music director, joins a young band and falls for its lead singer. His charm and talent shake up the group, while old rivalries and new feelings complicate things. Ranjith's musical drama stars Mohanlal, Lakshmi Rai and Mukesh, with music by Vidyasagar.
roti-kapda-aur-makaan-1974: A young man (Manoj Kumar) struggles to provide for his family in hard times, in a drama about food, clothing and shelter.
sankranthi-2005: Raghavendra, the eldest of four brothers, has kept his joint family together through hard times. When the brothers' marriages bring new tensions into the house, a misunderstanding threatens to split the family apart. Muppalaneni Shiva's family drama, a remake of Aanandham, stars Venkatesh, Srikanth, Sneha and Sangeetha.
sema-2018: G. V. Prakash Kumar plays a vegetable seller searching for a bride.
shankarabharanna: Shankarabharanna is a 2026 Kannada mystery horror comedy directed by Sumanth Bhat from a story by Shine Shetty, who plays the lead opposite Tanvi Ram in her Kannada debut. Shankara, a bus driver's son from Udupi who always dreamed of driving one himself, pawns his mother's jewellery to buy an old bus that has sat unused for years.
shraddha-2000: Shraddha is a 2000 Malayalam action thriller directed by the veteran filmmaker I. V. Sasi, starring Mohanlal and Shobana in the lead roles. The film brings together one of Malayalam cinema's biggest stars and one of its most prolific directors for a tense story of crime, duty and confrontation.
sollividava-2018: Sanjay and Madhu, journalists from rival news channels who cannot stand each other, are both sent to cover the Kargil War. The danger they face together draws them closer. Arjun Sarja's romantic drama, the Tamil version of Prema Baraha, stars his daughter Aishwarya Arjun and Chandan Kumar.
sreedharante-onnam-thirumurivu: Mohanlal and Parvathy star in Sathyan Anthikad's Malayalam comedy drama.
star-wars-the-mandaloria: The Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu now work for the New Republic, hunting down warlords left over from the fallen Empire. Their next mission takes them to the moon of Shakari to rescue Rotta, the son of the late crime lord Jabba the Hutt, in exchange for vital information.
street-fighter: Years after a deadly fight drove him into hiding, the martial artist Ryu is drawn back into the world of combat when the dictator M. Bison organises a new World Warrior tournament. Interpol agent Chun-Li, seeking revenge for her father's murder, recruits Ryu, his estranged brother Ken and fighters from around the world.
subhash-chandra-bose-2005: In the 1940s, Chandra Bose, a fearless freedom fighter, takes on the British in his village. Decades later, his look-alike descendant finds himself fighting a different kind of injustice. K. Raghavendra Rao's period action film stars Venkatesh in a dual role, with Shriya Saran and Genelia D'Souza.
suswagatham-1997: A young man (Pawan Kalyan) loves a woman who doesn't notice him, in a romantic drama with Devayani.
tarazu-1997: Akshay Kumar stars in Rajiv Kumar's action thriller.
thandavam-2002: Thandavam is a 2002 Malayalam action drama directed by Shaji Kailas and written by S. Suresh Babu, starring Mohanlal with Kiran Rathod, Nedumudi Venu and Sai Kumar. Kasinathan, a playful but pragmatic businessman and younger brother of the head of a once-feudal village family, wields real power, and finds himself drawn into a clash with ruthless rivals.
the-eken-kerala-e-kuruks: Ekenbabu, the bumbling but sharp Bengali detective played by Anirban Chakrabarti, travels to Kerala with his companions and stumbles into a new mystery. The latest film in Joydeep Mukherjee's comedy thriller series mixes laughs and suspense against a South Indian backdrop.
the-kerala-story-2-goes: A sequel to The Kerala Story from Kamakhya Narayan Singh, with Ulka Gupta and Aditi Bhatia.
thella-kaagitham: Inspired by a true incident, this Telugu musical romance follows two young people in a pure, innocent relationship whose love is tested as the complications of real life close in on them. Ramesh Bandreddi directs Harsh Roshan and Nakshatra, with Ajay in a key role.
thoofan-2013: Vijay Khanna is an honest police officer haunted by the murder of his parents when he was a child. Assigned to the killing of a district collector, he takes on a powerful oil mafia led by Teja and protects Mala, the key witness. Ram Charan stars in this Telugu version of Zanjeer, with Priyanka Chopra and Srihari.
thooya-ullam-1961: Akkineni Nageswara Rao and Savitri star in Adurthi Subba Rao's Tamil drama.
tutak-tutak-tutiya-2016: A man marries a village woman who becomes possessed by the ghost of a would-be film star, with Prabhu Deva and Tamannaah.
untitled-dhanush-mari-selvaraj: Dhanush and Sai Pallavi star in Mari Selvaraj's upcoming Tamil drama.
usthad-1999: Mohanlal plays a loving brother who leads a secret life as a feared gangster, in Sibi Malayil's action drama.
vaazha-2-biopic-of-a-bil: A sequel to the Malayalam hit Vaazha, about a group of young friends trying to make something of their lives.
valathu-vasathe-kallan: On a day when everything spirals out of control, veteran Circle Inspector Antony Xavier is pulled into the most important case of his career and must race against time to solve it. Jeethu Joseph directs this Malayalam crime thriller, starring Biju Menon and Joju George.
vanchinathan-2001: Vanchinathan, a fearless police officer, takes on a network of powerful criminals and the politicians who protect them. His fight for justice puts him and his family in danger. Shaji Kailas's Tamil action film stars Vijayakanth, Ramya Krishnan, Sakshi Shivanand and Prakash Raj.
vayasu-pilichindi-1978: Two close friends (Kamal Haasan and Rajinikanth) fall out over a love triangle, the Telugu version of Ilamai Oonjal Aadukirathu.
vazhvey-maayam-1982: A man (Kamal Haasan) who discovers he is dying pushes away the woman he loves (Sridevi) so she will not suffer.
velaiyilla-pattathari-2014: Raghuvaran, a civil engineering graduate, has been unemployed for four years and is constantly compared with his successful younger brother. When he finally lands a job, he finds himself up against a powerful builder's son. Velraj's action comedy stars Dhanush, Amala Paul, Saranya Ponvannan and Samuthirakani.
vetri-vizha-1989: A man (Kamal Haasan) loses his memory and is hunted by people from a past he can't recall, inspired by The Bourne Identity.
vvan-force-of-the-forres: Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah star in a fantasy thriller set in a forest.
yaadgar-1984: Dasari Narayana Rao's Hindi film with Kamal Haasan.
bandit-queen-1994: Shekhar Kapur's harrowing account of Phoolan Devi, from child bride and victim of caste violence to feared dacoit, with Seema Biswas in the title role.
umrao-jaan-1981: Rekha plays Umrao Jaan, a girl kidnapped and sold to a Lucknow courtesan house who grows into a celebrated poet and dancer, in Muzaffar Ali's classic.
zubeidaa-2001: A filmmaker pieces together the life of his mother Zubeidaa (Karisma Kapoor), an actress who married a Rajput prince and died young, in Shyam Benegal's drama.
bobby-1973: A rich boy (Rishi Kapoor) and the daughter of a Goan fisherman (Dimple Kapadia) fall in love against their families' wishes, in Raj Kapoor's blockbuster romance.
disco-dancer-1982: A street singer from Bombay (Mithun Chakraborty) rises to become a disco star while seeking revenge on the rich man who humiliated his mother.
mr-india-1987: A kind-hearted violinist who looks after orphans (Anil Kapoor) finds a gadget that makes him invisible and uses it against the villain Mogambo.
roja-1992: A young village woman (Madhoo) fights to free her husband (Arvind Swamy) after he is kidnapped by militants in Kashmir, in Mani Ratnam's breakthrough film.
seeta-aur-geeta-1972: Twin sisters separated at birth, one timid and one fiery, swap places and turn their lives upside down, with Hema Malini in a double role.
vivah-2006: Poonam, a gentle young woman raised by her uncle in a small town, is engaged to Prem, the son of a well-off Delhi family. During their engagement, the two fall deeply in love, but a sudden crisis on the eve of the wedding tests their bond. Sooraj Barjatya's romantic drama stars Shahid Kapoor and Amrita Rao.
hero-1983: A young gangster (Jackie Shroff) kidnaps a police officer's daughter and falls in love with her, in Subhash Ghai's hit that launched Jackie Shroff.
kahaani-2012: During the Durga Puja festival, Vidya Bagchi, a pregnant software engineer from London, arrives in Kolkata to find her missing husband. Helped by a young police officer, she finds that no one remembers him, and her search draws her into a dangerous web of secrets. Sujoy Ghosh's thriller stars Vidya Balan, Parambrata Chatterjee and Nawazuddin Siddiqui.
a-wednesday-2008: On the day before he retires, Mumbai's police commissioner recalls his most challenging case: an anonymous man who called to say he had planted five bombs across the city and would set them off unless four terrorists were released. What follows is a tense battle of wits over a single afternoon.
magadheera-2009: In 1609, a royal warrior dies with the princess he loves before he can tell her his feelings. Four hundred years later, Harsha, a bike stuntman in Hyderabad, touches the hand of a young woman and begins to remember their past. S. S. Rajamouli's epic fantasy stars Ram Charan, Kajal Aggarwal, Dev Gill and Srihari.
adventures-of-ali-baba-and-the-forty-thi: An Indo-Soviet take on the Arabian Nights tale of Ali Baba and the forty thieves, with Dharmendra, Hema Malini and Zeenat Aman.
the-dirty-picture-2011: In the 1980s, Reshma runs away from her village to Madras to become a film star. Renamed Silk, she rises to fame through bold roles and becomes the industry's biggest sensation, but success brings loneliness and exploitation. Milan Luthria's drama, inspired by Silk Smitha's life, stars Vidya Balan, who won the National Award for Best Actress.
aashiqui-2-2013: Rahul, a famous singer whose career is fading because of his drinking, discovers Aarohi, a talented bar singer in Goa, and promises to make her a star. As her career soars and they fall in love, Rahul's addiction pulls him further down.
queen-2014: Dumped days before her wedding, a shy Delhi girl (Kangana Ranaut) goes on her honeymoon to Paris and Amsterdam alone, and finds herself.
haider-2014: Kashmir, 1995. Haider, a young student, returns home to find his doctor father missing after an army raid and his mother growing close to his uncle. When a stranger brings him news of his father's fate, Haider sets out for revenge. Vishal Bhardwaj's adaptation of Hamlet stars Shahid Kapoor, Tabu, Kay Kay Menon, Shraddha Kapoor and Irrfan Khan.
neerja-2016: The true story of flight attendant Neerja Bhanot (Sonam Kapoor), who saved hundreds of passengers when Pan Am Flight 73 was hijacked in 1986.
all-we-imagine-as-light-2024: Two Malayali nurses in Mumbai, one waiting on an absent husband and one in a secret romance, take a trip to a coastal village with a friend, in Payal Kapadia's Cannes winner.
bhumika-1977: A gifted actress (Smita Patil) moves from one troubled relationship to another in search of independence, based on the life of Hansa Wadkar.
mera-naam-joker-1970: A circus clown (Raj Kapoor) looks back on three women he loved and lost, in Raj Kapoor's ambitious epic.
salaam-namaste-2005: Two young Indians in Melbourne (Saif Ali Khan and Preity Zinta) move in together and face an unplanned pregnancy, in Yash Raj's romantic comedy.
lamhe-1991: A man (Anil Kapoor) loves an older woman who marries another, and years later her daughter falls in love with him, with Sridevi in a double role.
pakeezah-1972: A Lucknow courtesan (Meena Kumari) finds love with a forest ranger (Raaj Kumar) who first saw her feet on a train, in Kamal Amrohi's musical classic.
ankur-1974: A landlord's son (Anant Nag) has an affair with a married servant (Shabana Azmi) in rural Telangana, in Shyam Benegal's debut about caste and power.
aashiqui-1990: Two young people (Rahul Roy and Anu Aggarwal) fall in love while chasing their dreams, in Mahesh Bhatt's musical with its hugely popular songs.
raaz-2002: A couple's marriage is threatened when a vengeful spirit haunts their hill-station house, with Dino Morea and Bipasha Basu, in Vikram Bhatt's horror hit.
parinda-1989: A young man (Anil Kapoor) returns to Bombay to find his older brother (Jackie Shroff) working for a ruthless gangster (Nana Patekar), in Vidhu Vinod Chopra's crime classic.
aaja-nachle-2007: A dancer (Madhuri Dixit) returns to her hometown to save the old theatre where she learned to dance by staging one last show.
anna-bond-2012: Bond Ravi is a karate trainer and reflexologist who falls for Meera after meeting her on a bus. When he crosses paths with a retired army major and the ruthless crime boss Charlie, who is hunting for the daughter the major adopted, Ravi is drawn into a violent fight to protect the woman he loves.
mardaani-2014: Shivani Shivaji Roy is a fearless senior inspector with the Mumbai Crime Branch. When a teenage girl she has looked after like her own daughter goes missing, Shivani tracks her to a powerful child trafficking network run by a young kingpin in Delhi.
margarita-with-a-straw-2014: A young woman with cerebral palsy (Kalki Koechlin) moves from Delhi to New York to study and discovers love and her own sexuality.
baaghi-2016: A martial artist (Tiger Shroff) fights to rescue the woman he loves from a powerful man in Bangkok, a remake of the Telugu Varsham.
baaghi-2-2018: An army officer (Tiger Shroff) goes to Goa to find his ex-girlfriend's kidnapped daughter, whom everyone else says never existed.
hindi-medium-2017: Raj and Mita, a wealthy couple from Chandni Chowk, are desperate to get their daughter into Delhi's top English-medium school. When their money and status fail to help, they move into a poor neighbourhood to apply under the quota for low-income families. Saket Chaudhary's comedy drama stars Irrfan Khan and Saba Qamar.
arjun-reddy-2017: Arjun Reddy is a brilliant but short-tempered medical student who falls passionately in love with Preethi, a shy junior at his college. When her family refuses to let them marry, Arjun spirals into self-destruction, turning to drink and drugs while trying to continue his career as a surgeon.
uri-the-surgical-strike-2019: Major Vihaan Shergill (Vicky Kaushal) leads a covert strike across the Line of Control after the 2016 Uri attack, based on real events.
saaho-2019: An undercover officer (Prabhas) chases a huge stolen fortune in a city of rival crime gangs, in a big-budget action thriller.
12th-fail-2023: The true story of Manoj Kumar Sharma, who fails Class 12 in a Chambal village and fights poverty to become an IPS officer, with Vikrant Massey.
chameli-2003: Aman, a lonely investment banker still grieving his wife, gets stranded on a flooded Mumbai street one stormy night. Sheltering under an arch, he meets Chameli, a street-smart sex worker, and over the course of one long night the two strangers open up to each other. Sudhir Mishra directs Kareena Kapoor and Rahul Bose.
tezaab-1988: A young man (Anil Kapoor) turns to crime to protect the woman he loves (Madhuri Dixit) from her greedy father, in N. Chandra's hit.
lajja-2001: Vaidehi, trapped in an abusive marriage in New York, runs away to India while pregnant. On the run from her husband, she meets several women, each fighting her own battle against injustice and social pressure. Rajkumar Santoshi's drama stars Manisha Koirala, Madhuri Dixit, Rekha, Mahima Chaudhry, Anil Kapoor and Ajay Devgn.
aandhi-1975: A powerful woman politician (Suchitra Sen) meets her estranged husband (Sanjeev Kumar) at a hotel during an election campaign, in Gulzar's drama.
page-3-2005: Madhavi, a young journalist, writes the celebrity column of a Mumbai newspaper and spends her nights at glamorous parties. As she sees the hypocrisy behind the glitter, she tries to move to crime reporting and uncovers uncomfortable truths. Madhur Bhandarkar's drama stars Konkona Sen Sharma, Atul Kulkarni and Sandhya Mridul.
ta-ra-rum-pum-2007: A NASCAR-style racing driver (Saif Ali Khan) and his family fall on hard times in New York after a crash, with Rani Mukerji.
daag-1973: A man (Rajesh Khanna) presumed dead after a crime starts a new life and remarries, until his first wife reappears, Yash Chopra's first production.
dev-d-2009: Dev, a spoilt rich boy from Punjab, takes his childhood sweetheart Paro for granted. When a jealous misunderstanding ends their romance, he spirals into drink and drugs in Delhi, where he meets Chanda, a young woman with troubles of her own. Anurag Kashyap's modern take on Devdas stars Abhay Deol, Mahie Gill and Kalki Koechlin.
jism-2-2012: Intelligence officers recruit Izna, a former adult-film actress, to act as a honey trap against her ex-lover Kabir, a former agent turned dangerous assassin. As she gets close to him again, old feelings make the mission complicated. Pooja Bhatt's erotic thriller stars Sunny Leone, Randeep Hooda and Arunoday Singh.
i-2015: Lingesan, a bodybuilder from Chennai, gets a break as a model opposite his crush Diya and becomes a successful face in advertising. When his success makes powerful enemies, his life is suddenly torn apart. Shankar's romantic action thriller stars Vikram, Amy Jackson and Suresh Gopi.
ek-villain-2014: Guru, a hitman who gave up crime for Aisha, the cheerful woman who changed his life, sees his happiness shattered when she is murdered by a masked man. He sets out to hunt down the killer, a seemingly ordinary man hiding a dark secret. Mohit Suri's thriller stars Sidharth Malhotra, Shraddha Kapoor and Riteish Deshmukh.
m-s-dhoni-the-untold-story-2016: Sushant Singh Rajput plays Mahendra Singh Dhoni, from his days as a ticket collector in Kharagpur to captaining India to the 2011 World Cup.
masaan-2015: In Varanasi, Devi, a young teacher, faces shame and blackmail after a police raid on her private meeting with a boyfriend ends in tragedy. Deepak, a boy from a family of cremation workers at the ghats, falls in love with a girl from a higher caste. Neeraj Ghaywan's debut drama stars Richa Chadha, Vicky Kaushal, Sanjay Mishra and Shweta Tripathi.
hichki-2018: A teacher with Tourette syndrome (Rani Mukerji) takes on a class of unruly students from a slum at an elite school.
manikarnika-the-queen-of-jhansi-2018: Manikarnika, a brave young woman raised in Bithoor, marries the Maharaja of Jhansi and becomes Rani Lakshmibai. When the British try to annex her kingdom after her husband's death, she refuses to give it up and leads her people into battle. Krish and Kangana Ranaut's historical drama stars Kangana Ranaut.
chhichhore-2019: When his son attempts suicide after failing an entrance exam, a father (Sushant Singh Rajput) tells him the story of his own hostel friends and their campus days.
thappad-2020: A woman (Taapsee Pannu) decides to divorce her husband after he slaps her once at a party, and faces everyone's disbelief.
master-2021: An alcoholic professor (Vijay) is sent to teach at a juvenile home run by a gangster (Vijay Sethupathi) who uses the boys for crime.
the-kashmir-files-2022: A student learns about his family's past and the exodus of Kashmiri Hindus in 1990, in Vivek Agnihotri's drama.
murder-2004: A neglected wife (Mallika Sherawat) begins an affair with an old flame (Emraan Hashmi), and it ends in murder, inspired by Unfaithful.
1942-a-love-story-1993: In 1942, as the freedom movement grows, the son of a British loyalist (Anil Kapoor) falls for the daughter of a revolutionary (Manisha Koirala).
henna-1991: An Indian man (Rishi Kapoor) loses his memory and is swept across the border, where a Pakistani woman (Zeba Bakhtiyar) nurses him and falls in love with him.
chandni-1989: A woman (Sridevi) is torn between her fiancé, who is paralysed in an accident, and her kind new boss, in Yash Chopra's romance.
hare-rama-hare-krishna-1971: A man (Dev Anand) searches for his long-lost sister (Zeenat Aman) among hippies in Kathmandu, in a film known for its song Dum Maro Dum.
dor-2006: Zeenat, a strong-willed young woman in Himachal, learns her husband faces execution in Saudi Arabia for the death of his co-worker. Her only hope is a pardon from the widow, Meera, a gentle woman living under strict tradition in Rajasthan, and she sets out to find her. Nagesh Kukunoor's drama stars Gul Panag, Ayesha Takia and Shreyas Talpade.
rudaali-1993: A lonely, hardened village woman (Dimple Kapadia) who cannot cry becomes a professional mourner in Rajasthan.
khubsoorat-1980: A cheerful young woman (Rekha) brings joy into a strict household run by its stern matriarch, in Hrishikesh Mukherjee's comedy.
khandhar-1984: A photographer (Naseeruddin Shah) visits a ruined mansion and meets a young woman (Shabana Azmi) waiting for a fiancé who will never come, in Mrinal Sen's drama.
paar-1984: A poor rural couple (Naseeruddin Shah and Shabana Azmi) flee violence in their village and take a gruelling job herding pigs across a river.
kismat-konnection-2008: An unlucky architect (Shahid Kapoor) believes his fortunes change when a social worker (Vidya Balan) is around, in Aziz Mirza's romantic comedy.
no-one-killed-jessica-2011: Jessica, a bartender, is shot at a crowded Delhi party for refusing to serve drinks after closing time. When witnesses turn hostile and the accused walks free, her sister Sabrina and a fiery TV journalist, Meera, launch a public campaign for justice. Raj Kumar Gupta's drama, based on the Jessica Lal case, stars Vidya Balan and Rani Mukerji.
agent-vinod-2012: Agent Vinod, a RAW operative, escapes a Taliban camp in Afghanistan and is put on the trail of a mysterious code word linked to a nuclear terror plot. The chase takes him from Russia and Morocco to Latvia and Pakistan, where he crosses paths with Iram, a woman whose loyalties are unclear.
band-baaja-baaraat-2010: Shruti, a determined Delhi graduate, dreams of becoming a wedding planner, while Bittoo is a carefree young man trying to avoid going back to his family's sugarcane farm. The two team up to start a wedding planning business, setting one firm rule: never mix business with love.
yevadu-2014: A man (Ram Charan) gets a new face after surgery and sets out to avenge his girlfriend's death, with Allu Arjun in a key role.
khoobsurat-2014: A free-spirited physiotherapist (Sonam Kapoor) is hired to treat a Rajasthani royal and falls for his son (Fawad Khan), loosely based on the 1980 Khubsoorat.
rana-vikrama-2015: Vikrama, a police officer, is sent to Vikramatheertha, a village tormented by a ruthless outsider who controls its resources. Taking on the villain and his men, he uncovers a link between his own past and the village. Pavan Wadeyar's Kannada action drama stars Puneeth Rajkumar, Anjali and Adah Sharma.
sairat-2016: A low-caste boy and an upper-caste girl in rural Maharashtra fall in love and run away, only to face their families' rage, in Nagraj Manjule's hit.
tumbbad-2018: In early 20th-century Maharashtra, Vinayak, the son of a poor family, is obsessed with finding the legendary treasure hidden in his ancestral mansion in the village of Tumbbad. He discovers it is guarded by Hastar, a cursed god born of greed, and returns again and again to steal from him. Rahi Anil Barve's folk horror film stars Sohum Shah.
kantara-2022: A village rebel (Rishab Shetty) clashes with a forest officer over land, while an ancient deity's ritual shapes their fate, in a Kannada blockbuster.
life-in-a-metro-2007: In Mumbai, the lives of several people intersect: an ambitious call-centre employee who lends his flat to his boss for affairs, the boss's lonely wife, a young woman looking for a husband, and an elderly couple reunited after forty years. Each searches for love and connection in the crowded city.
gupt-the-hidden-truth-1997: A young man (Bobby Deol) is jailed for his stepfather's murder and escapes to find the real killer, in Rajiv Rai's thriller.
neal-n-nikki-2005: A man about to marry (Uday Chopra) wants one last wild trip in Canada and meets a free-spirited woman (Tanishaa).
gangster-a-love-story-2006: Simran, a former bar dancer, lives in Seoul, haunted by her past with Daya, a Mumbai gangster who fled India with her. She finds comfort and love with Aakash, a singer at an Indian restaurant, until Daya returns. Anurag Basu's romantic thriller stars Kangana Ranaut in her debut, Shiney Ahuja and Emraan Hashmi.
kati-patang-1971: A woman (Asha Parekh) poses as a widow to start over, and falls for a kind neighbour (Rajesh Khanna), in Shakti Samanta's musical drama.
chup-chup-ke-2006: Jeetu, drowning in debt, jumps into the sea hoping his insurance will rescue his father, only to be pulled out by two fishermen who think he is deaf and mute. Playing along to stay hidden, he ends up working in a rich household, where the act gets him into a mess of romance and mix-ups. Priyadarshan directs Shahid Kapoor and Kareena Kapoor.
astitva-2000: A housewife (Tabu) inherits a fortune from her late music teacher, and her suspicious husband turns against her, in Mahesh Manjrekar's drama.
caravan-1971: A rich woman (Asha Parekh) escapes her scheming husband and joins a travelling caravan of performers, with Jeetendra.
khoon-bhari-maang-1988: A widow (Rekha) is almost killed by her new husband for her money, survives, and returns transformed to take revenge.
junoon-1978: During the 1857 uprising, a Pathan feudal lord (Shashi Kapoor) becomes obsessed with an English girl sheltering in his household, based on Ruskin Bond's novella.
nishant-1975: A schoolteacher's wife is abducted by a landlord's brothers, and the village rises in revolt, in Shyam Benegal's drama.
urumi-2011: Krishna Das, a young man in modern Goa, is offered a fortune for his ancestral land in Kerala by a mining company. A strange encounter takes him back to the 16th century, when his ancestor Chirakkal Kelu Nayanar fought Vasco da Gama's Portuguese forces. Santosh Sivan's historical epic stars Prithviraj Sukumaran, Prabhu Deva, Genelia D'Souza and Arya.
thuppakki-2012: Jagadish, an army intelligence officer home in Mumbai on leave, witnesses a bus bombing and uncovers a network of sleeper cells planning attacks across the city. He sets out to stop them while also dealing with a romance his family has arranged. A. R. Murugadoss's action thriller stars Vijay, Kajal Aggarwal and Vidyut Jammwal.
a-flying-jatt-2016: Aman Dhillon is a timid martial arts teacher who lives with his feisty mother and brother beside a sacred tree that stands in the way of a polluting industrialist's plans. When the businessman's hired giant Raka attacks the tree, Aman discovers he has superpowers and must learn to become a reluctant hero.
angry-indian-goddesses-2015: A group of women friends gather in Goa for a wedding and share their struggles, until a tragedy changes everything.
baaghi-3-2020: A man (Tiger Shroff) goes to war in Syria to rescue his older brother (Riteish Deshmukh) from a terror group.
bhool-bhulaiyaa-2-2022: A carefree young man (Kartik Aaryan) poses as a ghost-buster when a family's old haveli is said to be haunted by the spirit Manjulika.
liger-2022: A young MMA fighter with a stammer (Vijay Deverakonda) and his mother move to Mumbai so he can fight for a world title.
salaar-part-1-ceasefire-2023: A violent loner (Prabhas) returns to the city-state of Khansaar to help his childhood friend (Prithviraj) claim the throne.
adipurush-2023: A large-scale retelling of the Ramayana, with Prabhas as Raghava and Saif Ali Khan as Lankesh.
maqbool-2003: Vishal Bhardwaj's Macbeth, set in Mumbai's underworld, where the don's right-hand man (Irrfan Khan) is pushed to murder by the don's mistress (Tabu).
beta-1992: A devoted son (Anil Kapoor) worships his stepmother (Aruna Irani), not knowing she is scheming to take his family's fortune, with Madhuri Dixit.
ram-teri-ganga-maili-1985: A city boy (Rajiv Kapoor) marries a pure-hearted girl from Gangotri (Mandakini), who is exploited and abused while searching for him.
jism-2003: A lonely lawyer (John Abraham) is seduced by a married woman (Bipasha Basu) into a plot to kill her husband, inspired by Body Heat.
ishq-vishk-2003: College student Rajiv just wants to be popular and needs a girlfriend to join his friends on a trip. He asks his childhood friend Payal out, not knowing she has been in love with him for years, and his casual attitude soon threatens the relationship that really matters.
piravi-1989: An old father in Kerala waits for his son, a student taken by the police during the Emergency, in Shaji N. Karun's acclaimed drama.
karma-1986: A jailer (Dilip Kumar) recruits three convicts to take revenge on a terrorist (Anupam Kher) who killed his family.
pinjar-2003: During Partition, Puro, a young Hindu woman engaged to a kind man, is abducted by Rashid, a Muslim man acting on an old family feud. Forced into a new life, she is rejected by her own family, and must decide where she belongs. Chandraprakash Dwivedi's drama, based on Amrita Pritam's novel, stars Urmila Matondkar, Manoj Bajpayee and Sanjay Suri.
ardh-satya-1983: An honest police inspector (Om Puri) is torn apart by corrupt politicians and the violence of his job, in Govind Nihalani's classic.
the-warrior-2001: A warrior in feudal Rajasthan (Irrfan Khan) tries to give up violence, and is hunted by the lord he once served, in Asif Kapadia's Hindi-language debut.
chakra-1981: Life in a Bombay slum through the eyes of a mother (Smita Patil) and the men around her, with Naseeruddin Shah and Kulbhushan Kharbanda.
thoda-pyaar-thoda-magic-2008: A tycoon (Saif Ali Khan) who must look after four orphans gets help from an angel sent from heaven (Rani Mukerji).
mammo-1994: An elderly widow (Farida Jalal) from Pakistan stays with her sister and grand-nephew in Bombay and fights to remain in India, in Shyam Benegal's drama.
aakrosh-1980: A young lawyer (Naseeruddin Shah) defends a silent tribal man (Om Puri) accused of killing his wife, and uncovers the powerful men behind the crime.
i-hate-luv-storys-2010: Jay, an assistant director who scoffs at love, works for a filmmaker known for big romances. Simran, the film's art director, has a perfect fiancé and lives a life straight out of a Bollywood love story, until Jay comes along. Punit Malhotra's romantic comedy stars Imran Khan and Sonam Kapoor.
tanu-weds-manu-2011: Manu, a shy doctor based in London, comes to India to find a bride and is instantly smitten with Tanu, a rebellious, spirited woman from Kanpur. She turns him down because she loves someone else, but their paths keep crossing. Aanand L. Rai's romantic comedy stars R. Madhavan and Kangana Ranaut.
ladies-vs-ricky-bahl-2012: Three women swindled by the same con man (Ranveer Singh) team up with a sales girl (Anushka Sharma) to con him back.
adaminte-makan-abu-2011: Abu, an elderly perfume seller in Kerala's Malabar region, and his wife Aishumma have spent years saving to make the Hajj pilgrimage. Their son has abandoned them, and as they sell their livestock and possessions to raise the money, they face one obstacle after another on their way to Mecca.
sohni-mahiwal-1984: The Punjabi folk tale of Sohni and Mahiwal, two lovers torn apart by their families, with Sunny Deol and Poonam Dhillon.
mirch-masala-1985: A village woman (Smita Patil) refuses a tax collector's advances and takes refuge in a chilli factory, in Ketan Mehta's classic.
manthan-1976: A veterinary doctor (Girish Karnad) arrives in a Gujarat village to set up a milk cooperative, against the interests of the local middlemen, inspired by Verghese Kurien.
saaransh-1984: A retired schoolteacher (Anupam Kher) and his wife grieve their only son, killed in New York, and fight a corrupt system to get his ashes.
mausam-1975: A doctor (Sanjeev Kumar) returns to a hill town years later to find the woman he abandoned, and meets her daughter, played by Sharmila Tagore in a double role.
100-days-1991: A woman with visions (Madhuri Dixit) sees her sister's murder before it happens and tries to uncover the killer, a remake of the Tamil Nooravathu Naal.
virasat-1997: A young man (Anil Kapoor) returns from London to his village and is forced to take on his father's role as village head, a remake of Thevar Magan.
ram-lakhan-1989: Two brothers, one an honest police officer (Jackie Shroff) and one a hustler (Anil Kapoor), avenge their father's murder, in Subhash Ghai's hit.
nagin-1976: A shape-shifting serpent woman (Reena Roy) takes revenge on the men who killed her mate, with a big ensemble cast.
sparsh-1980: A blind principal of a school for the blind (Naseeruddin Shah) falls in love with a sighted teacher (Shabana Azmi), but his pride gets in the way.
uphaar-1971: A young bride (Jaya Bhaduri) is still a carefree girl at heart, and her husband patiently waits for her to grow into the marriage, based on Tagore's Samapti.
nagina-1986: A woman (Sridevi) marries into a rich family, and her mother-in-law fears she is a serpent woman, while a snake charmer (Amrish Puri) hunts her.
kai-po-che-2013: Three friends in Ahmedabad start a cricket academy and sports shop, until politics and riots tear their friendship apart, based on Chetan Bhagat's novel.
r-rajkumar-2013: A drifter (Shahid Kapoor) working for a drug lord falls for a girl the rival boss wants to marry (Sonakshi Sinha).
hasee-toh-phasee-2014: Nikhil, a struggling businessman, is about to marry his long-time girlfriend Karishma when he runs into her younger sister Meeta, a brilliant but eccentric chemical engineer who ran away from home seven years earlier. As he helps Meeta make peace with her family, he finds himself falling for her.
shuddh-desi-romance-2013: A young man in Jaipur (Sushant Singh Rajput) runs from his own wedding, and keeps getting cold feet in his relationships.
kasba-1991: Kumar Shahani's take on Chekhov's In the Ravine, about a family of merchants in a Himalayan town.
puli-2015: Marudheeran, the brave adopted son of a village chief, protects his people from the tyrannical Vedhalams, demons who serve an evil queen. When his beloved is taken by them, he sets out for the Vedhalam kingdom to rescue her and free the villagers. Chimbu Deven's fantasy adventure stars Vijay in a dual role, Sridevi, Sudeep and Shruti Haasan.
akira-2016: A young woman (Sonakshi Sinha) with a strong sense of justice is framed by corrupt police after witnessing a crime, a remake of Mouna Guru.
shershaah-2021: The life of Captain Vikram Batra (Sidharth Malhotra), who was killed in the Kargil War and awarded the Param Vir Chakra.
kill-2023: An army commando (Lakshya) fights a gang of bandits who take over the overnight train carrying the woman he loves.
kisna-the-warrior-poet-2005: In the 1940s, as India's freedom struggle peaks, Kisna, a young Indian man in the hills of Garhwal, has been close to Catherine, the daughter of a British officer, since childhood. When violence breaks out, he risks everything to escort her safely across the country. Subhash Ghai's period romance stars Vivek Oberoi, Antonia Bernath and Isha Sharvani.
alaipayuthey-2000: A young couple (R. Madhavan and Shalini) marry secretly against their families' wishes and then struggle with married life, in Mani Ratnam's romance.
kya-kehna-2000: A college girl (Preity Zinta) becomes pregnant and decides to keep the baby after her boyfriend leaves her, facing society's judgement.
deewane-huye-paagal-2005: Shy Karan finally wins the attention of his crush Tanya, but she witnesses a murder by a gangster and flees to Dubai. Karan follows her there, only to find two other men, a smooth conman and a gang member, competing for her too. Vikram Bhatt's comedy stars Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, Shahid Kapoor and Rimi Sen.
aashiq-banaya-aapne-2005: Two best friends (Emraan Hashmi and Sonu Sood) fall for the same woman (Tanushree Dutta), which tears their friendship apart.
nayak-the-real-hero-2001: Shivaji Rao, an ambitious TV cameraman, grills the state's chief minister in a live interview and is dared to run the state himself for one day. He accepts, and in 24 hours his bold reforms shake up the system and make him a powerful enemy. Shankar's political thriller stars Anil Kapoor, Rani Mukerji and Amrish Puri.
maine-gandhi-ko-nahin-mara-2005: Uttam Chaudhary, a retired Hindi professor, is slipping into dementia and becomes convinced he is responsible for Mahatma Gandhi's death, after a childhood game with a toy gun. His daughter Trisha does everything she can to help him find peace. Jahnu Barua's drama stars Anupam Kher and Urmila Matondkar.
laaga-chunari-mein-daag-2007: A young woman from Varanasi (Rani Mukerji) moves to Mumbai to support her family and is forced into sex work.
halla-bol-2008: Ashfaque, a small-town boy, becomes film star Sameer Khan, but success makes him vain and careless. When he witnesses a murder at a party and stays silent, his old mentor, a street-theatre activist, pushes him to take a stand. Rajkumar Santoshi's drama stars Ajay Devgn, Vidya Balan and Pankaj Kapur.
dil-kya-kare-1999: A married man (Ajay Devgn) realises the woman he once spent a night with years ago (Kajol) is now raising his child.
shool-1999: An honest police officer (Manoj Bajpayee) is posted to a Bihar town ruled by a criminal politician, in a film produced by Ram Gopal Varma.
dil-bole-hadippa-2009: A woman (Rani Mukerji) disguises herself as a man to play in a cricket team led by a former county player (Shahid Kapoor).
oye-lucky-lucky-oye-2008: The story of a charming Delhi thief (Abhay Deol) who steals anything that catches his eye, in Dibakar Banerjee's comedy.
paan-singh-tomar-2010: Paan Singh Tomar, a soldier, becomes a national steeplechase champion and represents India abroad. After retiring to his village in Madhya Pradesh, a land dispute and an indifferent system push him into becoming one of the Chambal Valley's most feared rebels. Tigmanshu Dhulia's biopic stars Irrfan Khan and Mahie Gill.
harishchandrachi-factory-2009: In 1911 Bombay, printer and photographer Dadasaheb Phalke watches a foreign silent film and decides to make one in India. With his wife's support and almost no resources, he sets out to create Raja Harishchandra, India's first feature film. Paresh Mokashi's Marathi biopic stars Nandu Madhav and Vibhavari Deshpande.
i-am-2010: Four short films based on real stories, all about fear: a woman who wants a child on her own, a Kashmiri Pandit visiting the home she fled, a man haunted by childhood abuse, and a gay man in Mumbai facing police harassment. Onir's crowd-funded anthology stars Juhi Chawla, Manisha Koirala, Nandita Das, Rahul Bose and Sanjay Suri.
mere-brother-ki-dulhan-2011: Kush, an assistant film director, is asked by his elder brother Luv to find him a bride. The search leads him to Dimple, a wild, free-spirited woman he once met at college, and she seems perfect for Luv, until Kush realises he has fallen for her himself.
dear-friend-hitler-2011: During the Second World War, the film follows Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun in his final days, alongside the letters Mahatma Gandhi wrote to him urging peace. A young Indian couple's story runs in parallel, contrasting non-violence with Nazism. Rakesh Ranjan Kumar's war drama stars Raghubir Yadav as Hitler, with Neha Dhupia and Avijit Dutt.
ishaqzaade-2012: Two young people from rival political families in a small town (Arjun Kapoor and Parineeti Chopra) fall in love amid violence and betrayal.
ustad-hotel-2012: Faizi, a young man trained as a chef abroad, returns to Kerala and clashes with his father over his career.
