Sent to work at his grandfather Kareem's old seaside restaurant in Kozhikode, he learns that cooking is about feeding people's hearts too. Anwar Rasheed's drama, written by Anjali Menon, stars Dulquer Salmaan, Thilakan and Nithya Menen.
qissa-2013: During Partition, Umber Singh, a Sikh man desperate for a son, raises his fourth daughter Kanwar as a boy. As Kanwar grows up and is married off to a young woman, the lie at the heart of the family begins to haunt them. Anup Singh's Punjabi drama stars Irrfan Khan, Tillotama Shome, Tisca Chopra and Rasika Dugal.
bangalore-days-2014: Three cousins who grew up together in Kerala find themselves living in Bangalore at the same time. Kunju is newly married to a distant workaholic, Kuttan is a homesick software engineer, and Aju is a free-spirited bike mechanic, and their new lives in the city test their bonds and dreams.
nh10-2015: A couple (Anushka Sharma and Neil Bhoopalam) on a road trip in Haryana witness an honour killing and are hunted by the killers.
badlapur-2015: After his wife and young son are killed during a bank robbery in Pune, Raghu is left consumed by grief. One robber, Liaq, is caught and jailed while his partner escapes. Raghu withdraws from the world and waits fifteen years for the chance to take his revenge.
sanam-re-2016: Akash, a Mumbai office worker, returns to his hometown in Uttarakhand to sell his ailing grandfather's old photo studio. Visiting it one last time, he recalls his grandfather's prediction about the girl he would love but never live with, and his first love, Shruti.
baar-baar-dekho-2016: Childhood sweethearts Jai and Diya are about to marry, but Jai, a maths professor focused on his career, is filled with doubts. After a fight on the eve of the wedding he begins waking up years into his future, and must face how his choices are shaping his life and marriage.
munna-michael-2017: Munna, a Mumbai street dancer raised by a former backup dancer who found him abandoned as a baby, idolises Michael Jackson. Blacklisted by Mumbai's clubs, he moves to Delhi, where a gangster hires him to teach him to dance so that he can impress the woman he loves.
vikram-vedha-2017: Vikram, an upright police inspector who leads an encounter squad, sets out to catch Vedha, a notorious gangster. When Vedha surrenders and starts telling Vikram stories, each one makes the officer question what is right and wrong. Pushkar–Gayathri's neo-noir thriller, inspired by the Vikram and Betaal folk tale, stars R. Madhavan and Vijay Sethupathi.
simmba-2018: Simmba, an orphan from Shivgad who became a policeman for the money, enjoys life as a cheerfully corrupt officer in Goa. When a young woman he considers a sister is brutally attacked by a gangster's brothers, he finally decides to use his badge to fight for justice.
dil-bechara-2020: Two young people with cancer (Sushant Singh Rajput and Sanjana Sanghi) fall in love, based on The Fault in Our Stars.
luka-chuppi-2019: A TV reporter (Kartik Aaryan) and his girlfriend (Kriti Sanon) try a live-in relationship in a conservative town and have to pretend to be married.
afsar-2018: Tarsem Jassar and Nimrat Khaira lead a Punjabi comedy about a land officer who wants the respect a village patwari gets.
the-girl-on-the-train-2020: An alcoholic divorcee (Parineeti Chopra) in London becomes caught up in the disappearance of a woman she watched from her train.
shakuntala-devi-2020: Vidya Balan plays the mathematical genius Shakuntala Devi, known as the human computer, and her complicated bond with her daughter.
heropanti-2-2022: A hacker (Tiger Shroff) is pulled into a fight with a cyber criminal (Nawazuddin Siddiqui).
beast-2022: A former spy (Vijay) is trapped in a Chennai mall taken over by terrorists.
hanu-man-2024: A petty thief in a small village (Teja Sajja) gains the powers of Hanuman from a mystical gem and must protect it from a villain.
manjummel-boys-2024: A group of friends on a trip to Kodaikanal must rescue one of them who falls into the deep Guna Caves, based on a true story.
girls-will-be-girls-2024: A teenage girl at a Himalayan boarding school experiences first love while her mother struggles with her own feelings.
maharaja-2024: A barber (Vijay Sethupathi) reports the theft of a dustbin to the police, and his strange complaint hides a darker story.
rajnigandha-1974: A young woman (Vidya Sinha) is torn between her current boyfriend (Amol Palekar) and an old flame she meets again, in Basu Chatterjee's drama.
koshish-1972: A deaf and mute couple (Sanjeev Kumar and Jaya Bhaduri) build a life together and struggle to raise their son, in Gulzar's drama.
masoom-1983: A man's happy family life is shaken when the son he never knew about comes to live with them, in Shekhar Kapur's debut.
johny-mera-naam-1970: Two brothers separated as children end up on opposite sides of the law, with Dev Anand and Pran.
prem-rog-1982: An orphan (Rishi Kapoor) loves a rich girl (Padmini Kolhapure) who is widowed soon after her marriage, and fights for her right to love again.
kalyug-1981: A modern Mahabharata about rival branches of a business family whose feud becomes deadly, in Shyam Benegal's drama.
main-tulsi-tere-aangan-ki-1978: A wealthy man's mother rejects the woman he loves, and her son by him grows up an outsider, with Nutan.
satyam-shivam-sundaram-1978: An engineer (Shashi Kapoor) falls in love with a village woman's voice (Zeenat Aman), but cannot accept her scarred face.
aa-gale-lag-jaa-1973: A brief love affair leaves a woman pregnant, and years later the father meets the son he never knew, with Shashi Kapoor and Sharmila Tagore.
arth-1982: A woman (Shabana Azmi) is abandoned by her filmmaker husband for an actress and learns to stand on her own, in Mahesh Bhatt's drama.
swami-1977: A young woman (Shabana Azmi) married against her wishes slowly comes to respect her patient husband (Girish Karnad).
mashaal-1984: A journalist (Dilip Kumar) reforms a street tough (Anil Kapoor), then loses everything and turns to crime himself.
nikaah-1982: A woman (Salma Agha) divorced by her first husband faces pressure to return to him after marrying again, in B. R. Chopra's drama.
ek-doctor-ki-maut-1991: A doctor (Pankaj Kapur) develops a leprosy vaccine and is met with jealousy and neglect instead of recognition, in Tapan Sinha's drama.
razia-sultan-1983: The story of Razia Sultan (Hema Malini), the only woman to rule the Delhi Sultanate, and her love for an Abyssinian slave (Dharmendra).
utsav-1984: An adaptation of the Sanskrit play Mrichakatika, about a courtesan (Rekha) and a poor Brahmin, directed by Girish Karnad.
sawaal-1982: A drama of family and justice with an ensemble cast, produced by Yash Chopra.
dastak-1970: A newly married couple move into a Bombay flat that once belonged to a courtesan, and are harassed by men who think she still lives there.
kishen-kanhaiya-1990: Twins separated at birth, one meek and one bold (Anil Kapoor), feel each other's pain and unite to fight the man who wronged them.
adi-shankaracharya-1981: The life of the philosopher Adi Shankaracharya, made entirely in Sanskrit by G. V. Iyer.
maachis-1996: After police brutality, a young man (Chandrachur Singh) joins the Sikh militancy in 1980s Punjab, in Gulzar's political drama with Tabu.
dil-hai-tumhaara-2002: A young woman born out of wedlock (Preity Zinta) grows up unloved by her stepmother (Rekha) and falls for the man her sister loves.
daraar-1996: A woman (Juhi Chawla) escapes her violent, possessive husband (Arbaaz Khan) and finds love again, until he tracks her down.
judaai-1997: A greedy wife (Sridevi) agrees to let a rich woman marry her husband (Anil Kapoor) for money, and regrets it.
kadhalar-dhinam-1999: Two young people fall in love over the internet, with Kunal and Sonali Bendre, known for A. R. Rahman's songs.
gardish-1993: A police constable's son (Jackie Shroff) is forced into violence and loses his future, a remake of the Malayalam Kireedam.
simhadri-2003: A kind man (Jr NTR) living with a family in Visakhapatnam hides a violent past in Kerala, in S. S. Rajamouli's action drama.
fida-2004: A young man (Shahid Kapoor) is drawn into a dangerous game by the woman he loves (Kareena Kapoor) and a criminal (Fardeen Khan).
china-gate-1998: A group of retired army officers defend a village from a ruthless bandit, inspired by Seven Samurai.
raja-1995: A young man (Sanjay Kapoor) and his childhood love (Madhuri Dixit) are separated by her greedy brothers.
agni-sakshi-1996: A woman (Manisha Koirala) escapes an abusive husband (Nana Patekar) and remarries, but he returns to claim her.
suraj-ka-satvan-ghoda-1992: A storyteller tells his friends about the women in his life, in Shyam Benegal's adaptation of Dharamvir Bharati's novel.
sardari-begum-1996: A journalist investigates the life of a famous singer (Kiron Kher) killed in a riot, in Shyam Benegal's musical drama.
hulchul-1995: Ajay Devgn and Kajol star in Anees Bazmee's action thriller with Vinod Khanna and Amrish Puri.
gundaraj-1995: Ajay Devgn and Kajol star in Guddu Dhanoa's action crime film with Amrish Puri.
godmother-1999: A widow (Shabana Azmi) takes over her husband's gang in Gujarat and becomes a feared politician, inspired by Santokben Jadeja.
thakshak-1999: A man (Ajay Devgn) with a violent past tries to stay out of his father's crime empire, in Govind Nihalani's drama with Tabu.
drishti-1990: An urban couple (Dimple Kapadia and Shekhar Kapur) face infidelity and the slow breakdown of their marriage.
masti-2004: Three bored husbands try to have affairs, and the women they chase turn the tables on them, in Indra Kumar's adult comedy.
ek-hasina-thi-2004: Sarika, a gentle travel agent living alone in Mumbai, falls for the charming Karan. When she unknowingly gets mixed up in his crimes, she is arrested and sent to prison. Behind bars, the quiet woman grows hard and plans her revenge. Sriram Raghavan's debut thriller stars Urmila Matondkar and Saif Ali Khan.
netaji-subhas-chandra-bose-the-forgotten: After a split with Gandhi, Subhas Chandra Bose escapes house arrest in Calcutta in 1941 and travels in disguise to Germany. He goes on to Japan and Southeast Asia, where he builds the Indian National Army to fight for India's freedom. Shyam Benegal's biographical epic stars Sachin Khedekar as Bose, with Kulbhushan Kharbanda, Rajit Kapur and Divya Dutta.
my-brother-nikhil-2005: In Goa in the late 1980s, Nikhil, a state swimming champion, is diagnosed as HIV-positive at a time when there was little awareness. He is shunned and isolated, but his sister and partner stand by him as he fights for dignity. Onir's drama, based on Dominic D'Souza's life, stars Sanjay Suri, Juhi Chawla and Purab Kohli.
humko-deewana-kar-gaye-2006: Aditya, a car engineer engaged to a fashion designer he does not quite connect with, meets Jiya in Canada. She too is engaged to a rich businessman, but the two strangers fall in love. Raj Kanwar's romantic drama stars Akshay Kumar, Katrina Kaif, Bipasha Basu and Anil Kapoor.
vaah-life-ho-toh-aisi-2005: A man (Shahid Kapoor) dies suddenly and is allowed to return as a ghost to fix things for his family, with Sanjay Dutt as Yama.
fool-and-final-2007: A priceless diamond stolen in Mumbai is headed for Dubai, and everyone wants it, from a local gangster to a broke junk-shop owner, his niece and her boyfriend. A chaotic chase across the city follows. Ahmed Khan's heist comedy stars Sunny Deol, Shahid Kapoor, Vivek Oberoi, Ayesha Takia, Sameera Reddy and Paresh Rawal.
woh-lamhe-2006: Aditya, a filmmaker, rushes to the hospital when he hears that Sana, a famous actress who vanished from his life three years earlier, has tried to kill herself. As he waits, he recalls their intense romance and her struggle with a mental illness that slowly pulled them apart.
khosla-ka-ghosla-2006: A retired Delhi man's plot of land is grabbed by a builder, and his family pull off a sting to get it back.
shikhar-2005: Gaurav, a ruthless businessman, plans to build a new town on the site of an abandoned village. When the honest landowner refuses to sell, Gaurav lures the man's ambitious son Jaidev into his schemes, using wealth and temptation to turn the son against his father.
desamuduru-2007: Bala, a TV programme director with a habit of fighting for justice, beats up a smuggler's son and is sent to Manali to shoot a travel show while things cool down. There he falls for Vaishali, a young woman living as a sanyasini, whose past soon catches up with them. Puri Jagannadh's action romance stars Allu Arjun and Hansika Motwani.
no-smoking-2007: An arrogant chain-smoker (John Abraham) signs up at a mysterious clinic that will do anything to make him quit, based on a Stephen King story.
delhi-safari-2012: When bulldozers tear through their forest home near Mumbai, a leopard cub, his mother and a group of animal friends set off for Delhi to plead their case before Parliament. A talkative parrot who can speak to humans joins their journey across India. Nikkhil Advani's animated film features the voices of Govinda, Suniel Shetty, Akshaye Khanna and Boman Irani.
kidnap-2008: A millionaire's daughter is kidnapped, and the kidnapper (Imran Khan) forces her father (Sanjay Dutt) to commit crimes to get her back.
arya-2-2009: Arya and Ajay grow up in the same orphanage, but while Arya forces his friendship on Ajay, Ajay secretly resents him. Years later, Ajay is a successful executive and Arya is an unpredictable troublemaker, and when both fall for the same woman, their twisted friendship is tested.
aisha-2010: Aisha, a rich young woman in Delhi, fancies herself a gifted matchmaker and meddles in her friends' love lives, ignoring the warnings of her neighbour Arjun. Her schemes to pair up her small-town friend Shefali go wrong, and she has to face her own feelings. An adaptation of Jane Austen's Emma.
badmaash-company-2010: Four friends in 1990s Bombay start a business smuggling goods and then running cons, with Shahid Kapoor and Anushka Sharma.
udaan-2010: Rohan, expelled from his boarding school, returns home to Jamshedpur to live with his stern, controlling father and a young half-brother he never knew. Forced to study engineering and work in his father's factory, he dreams of becoming a writer. Vikramaditya Motwane's coming-of-age drama stars Rajat Barmecha, Ronit Roy and Ram Kapoor.
22-female-kottayam-2012: Tessa, a young nurse from Kerala working in Bengaluru and hoping to move to Canada, falls in love with Cyril, a travel agent. When she is brutally betrayed and assaulted, she is left broken, but sets out to take her own revenge on the men who wronged her.
valley-of-flowers-2006: In the Himalayas, Jalan, the leader of a band of robbers on the Silk Route, meets Ushna, a mysterious woman who seems to know him. Their passionate love story is followed by a curse that stretches across two centuries, into modern Tokyo. Pan Nalin's mystical romance stars Milind Soman, Mylène Jampanoï and Naseeruddin Shah.
iddarammayilatho-2013: In Barcelona, Akanksha, a psychology student, finds an old diary in her flat telling the love story of Sanju, a guitarist, and Komali. As she reads on, she is drawn into the mystery of what happened to them. Puri Jagannadh's romantic action comedy stars Allu Arjun, Amala Paul and Catherine Tresa.
madras-cafe-2013: In the late 1980s, Indian intelligence officer Vikram is sent to Sri Lanka's civil war to undermine a rebel group. As he digs deeper, he uncovers a conspiracy that threatens a former Indian prime minister. Shoojit Sircar's political thriller stars John Abraham, Nargis Fakhri and Raashii Khanna.
gulaab-gang-2014: Rajjo leads the Gulaab Gang, a band of women in pink saris who teach girls to read and fight back against abuse in rural Bundelkhand. When she enters politics, she comes up against Sumitra Devi, a cunning and powerful politician. Soumik Sen's action drama stars Madhuri Dixit and Juhi Chawla.
ferrari-ki-sawaari-2012: Rusy, an honest RTO clerk in Mumbai, will do almost anything for his cricket-mad son Kayo, who has a shot at training at Lord's. Short of money, the father finds himself borrowing a famous cricketer's Ferrari, setting off a madcap chain of events. Rajesh Mapuskar's comedy drama stars Sharman Joshi, Boman Irani and Ritvik Sahore.
go-goa-gone-2013: Three friends head to a rave on a Goa island and find the partygoers turned into zombies, with Saif Ali Khan as a Russian mobster.
phantom-2015: A disgraced former soldier (Saif Ali Khan) is sent on a covert mission to kill the masterminds behind the 2008 Mumbai attacks.
hamari-adhuri-kahani-2014: Vasudha is a single mother who has stayed loyal to her husband Hari, missing for five years. When she meets Aarav, a wealthy hotelier who falls deeply in love with her, she is torn between tradition and a chance at happiness, and then Hari returns.
gopala-gopala-2015: Gopala Rao, an atheist who sells idols of gods, loses his shop in an earthquake, and his insurer refuses to pay, calling it an act of God. So he takes God to court, and a mysterious stranger turns up to help him. Kishore Kumar Pardasani's remake of OMG – Oh My God! stars Venkatesh and Pawan Kalyan.
abcd-2-2015: A disgraced dance crew from Mumbai fights to win a world hip-hop championship in Las Vegas, with Varun Dhawan and Shraddha Kapoor.
alone-2015: Sanjana returns to her family home in Bangalore with her husband after her mother's accident. There she begins to sense the presence of Anjana, her conjoined twin who died during their separation surgery, and becomes convinced her sister's spirit is jealous and wants revenge.
manjhi-the-mountain-man-2015: Dashrath Manjhi, a poor labourer in a Bihar village, loses his beloved wife after she falls on the mountain that cuts the village off from the nearest town. Grief-stricken, he picks up a hammer and chisel and spends over twenty years carving a road through the rock. Ketan Mehta's biopic stars Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Radhika Apte.
ghazi-2017: In November 1971, with India and Pakistan on the brink of war, the Indian submarine S21 is sent on a secret mission in the Bay of Bengal. Its crew must track down PNS Ghazi, a Pakistani submarine believed to be hunting the aircraft carrier INS Vikrant. Sankalp Reddy's war film stars Rana Daggubati, Kay Kay Menon, Atul Kulkarni and Taapsee Pannu.
maanagaram-2017: In one night in Chennai, a small-town graduate who has just landed a job, a young man with a temper, a cab driver and a gang of kidnappers find their lives colliding after a case of mistaken identity. Lokesh Kanagaraj's debut crime thriller stars Shri, Sundeep Kishan and Regina Cassandra.
veere-di-wedding-2018: Four childhood friends reunite for one of their weddings and deal with their own messy lives, with Kareena Kapoor and Sonam Kapoor.
loev-2015: Sahil, a young Mumbai musician, plans a weekend road trip to the Western Ghats with Jai, a childhood friend who now works in New York. Over two days in the hills, their unspoken feelings and differences come to the surface. Sudhanshu Saria's quiet romantic drama stars Dhruv Ganesh and Shiv Panditt.
sarkar-2018: Sundar Ramasamy, a ruthless corporate executive based in the US, flies home to Chennai to vote, only to find someone has already cast a vote in his name. His fight for his right to vote turns into a battle against the state's corrupt political machinery. A. R. Murugadoss's political action film stars Vijay, Keerthy Suresh and Varalaxmi Sarathkumar.
sonu-ke-titu-ki-sweety-2018: A man (Kartik Aaryan) is convinced his best friend's fiancée is too good to be true and sets out to stop the wedding.
sui-dhaaga-2018: Mauji is a cheerful errand boy in a small town who is constantly humiliated by his boss, and his wife Mamta can barely find a moment alone with him. Encouraged by her, Mauji, a gifted tailor like his grandfather, quits his job and the couple set out to build their own clothing business from scratch.
kabir-singh-2019: A brilliant, short-tempered surgeon (Shahid Kapoor) spirals into self-destruction after his girlfriend is married off, a Hindi remake of Arjun Reddy.
kaithi-2019: A just-released prisoner (Karthi) agrees to drive a lorry of poisoned police officers to a hospital overnight while a gang hunts them.
pati-patni-aur-woh-2019: A married civil engineer (Kartik Aaryan) begins an affair with a stylish woman and lies to cover it up, a remake of the 1978 film.
shehzada-2023: A man raised by a petty clerk (Kartik Aaryan) discovers he was swapped at birth with the son of a rich family, a remake of Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo.
chitchor-1976: A village girl (Zarina Wahab) falls for a man she believes is a wealthy engineer, in a case of mistaken identity, in Basu Chatterjee's musical.
haathi-mere-saathi-1971: A young man (Rajesh Khanna) raised by elephants builds a zoo, and his bond with his elephants is tested by marriage.
qurbani-1980: A safecracker (Feroz Khan) and his friend (Vinod Khanna) fall for the same nightclub singer (Zeenat Aman), in Feroz Khan's stylish thriller.
amar-prem-1972: A courtesan (Sharmila Tagore) forms a deep bond with a lonely businessman (Rajesh Khanna) and a neglected boy next door.
hum-kisise-kum-naheen-1977: Two young men chase a fortune in hidden diamonds while competing in love and music, in Nasir Hussain's musical with Rishi Kapoor.
elippathayam-1981: The head of a fading feudal family in Kerala refuses to face the changing world, in Adoor Gopalakrishnan's acclaimed drama.
be-imaan-1972: An honest police officer (Manoj Kumar) takes on corruption that reaches into his own family, in a drama that won several Filmfare awards.
julie-1975: A young Anglo-Indian woman (Lakshmi) becomes pregnant by her Hindu boyfriend and faces her family's anger.
dharam-veer-1977: Twin princes separated at birth grow up as a warrior and a gypsy and become friends, unaware of their bond, in Manmohan Desai's costume drama.
bazaar-1982: A young girl in Hyderabad is married off to a rich older man from the Gulf, while her poor sweetheart tries to save her, in Sagar Sarhadi's drama.
ankhiyon-ke-jharokhon-se-1978: Two college rivals (Sachin and Ranjeeta) fall in love, but illness threatens their happiness.
dharmatma-1975: The son of a respected gambling boss (Feroz Khan) tries to break from his father's world, inspired by The Godfather.
raja-jani-1972: A con man (Dharmendra) helps a dancer (Hema Malini) pose as a lost princess to claim a royal fortune.
anuraag-1972: A blind girl (Moushumi Chatterjee) falls in love with a young man, but his mother opposes the match, with Rajesh Khanna in a special role.
laila-majnu-1976: The legendary tragic romance of Laila and Majnu, with Rishi Kapoor and Ranjeeta.
insaf-ka-tarazu-1980: A model (Zeenat Aman) is raped by a wealthy man and fights for justice in court, in B. R. Chopra's drama.
mandi-1983: Politicians try to clear a brothel from the city centre, and its madam (Shabana Azmi) fights to keep it, in Shyam Benegal's satire.
radhe-shyam-2022: A palmist (Prabhas) who believes fate can't be changed falls for a doctor (Pooja Hegde), in a period romance set in 1970s Europe.
game-changer-2025: An honest IAS officer (Ram Charan) takes on a corrupt politician, and a story of his father's past unfolds, in Shankar's Telugu political drama.
crew-2024: Three flight attendants at a failing airline (Tabu, Kareena Kapoor and Kriti Sanon) get drawn into smuggling gold.
kaadhalan-1994: A college student (Prabhu Deva) falls for the governor's daughter (Nagma) and gets caught in a terror plot, in Shankar's musical hit.
barsaat-1995: A young man from the village (Bobby Deol) falls for a rich girl (Twinkle Khanna) and must protect her from her family's enemies.
hu-tu-tu-1999: A politician mother and her estranged daughter are caught up in corruption and violence, in Gulzar's political drama with Tabu.
kasoor-2001: A lawyer (Lisa Ray) defends a man (Aftab Shivdasani) accused of killing his wife and falls in love with him.
soldier-1998: A young man (Bobby Deol) seeks revenge for his father, who was framed as a traitor, with Preity Zinta in her debut year.
hadh-kar-di-aapne-2000: Raj, a detective, is hired by his friend to prove his wife's infidelity, while the wife hires her friend Anjali to do the same. Raj and Anjali follow their targets to Europe, where they fall for each other, and Raj's courtship takes some outrageous turns. Manoj Agrawal's comedy stars Govinda and Rani Mukerji.
kathapurushan-1995: The life of a boy born into a feudal family in Kerala as it changes with the country, in Adoor Gopalakrishnan's drama.
moksha-2001: Vikram, an idealistic young law graduate, wants to fight injustice and set up free legal aid for the poor. As corruption and frustration close in, he is drawn into crime, while Hritika, the woman who loves him, stands by him. Ashok Mehta's directorial debut stars Arjun Rampal and Manisha Koirala, and won National Awards for its cinematography and sound.
saudagar-1991: Two childhood friends (Dilip Kumar and Raaj Kumar) become bitter enemies, and their grandchildren fall in love.
dayavan-1988: A slum boy grows into a feared but loved gang leader in Bombay (Vinod Khanna), a remake of Nayakan.
bhavna-1984: A woman (Shabana Azmi) abandoned by her husband raises her son alone, in a drama that won her a Filmfare award.
hum-aapke-dil-mein-rehte-hain-1999: A rich man (Anil Kapoor) marries a woman (Kajol) on a contract, but they fall in love for real.
udhaar-ki-zindagi-1994: A girl (Kajol) brings her lonely grandfather back into the family he was cast out from, with Jeetendra.
hote-hote-pyar-ho-gaya-1999: Kajol and Jackie Shroff star in Firoz Irani's romantic action film.
pyaar-tune-kya-kiya-2001: Ria, the headstrong and possessive daughter of a wealthy businessman, falls in love with Jai, a fashion photographer who published pictures of her without asking. Jai is happily married, and when he rejects her, Ria's obsession turns dangerous for him and his wife.
tamanna-1997: A eunuch (Paresh Rawal) raises an abandoned girl as his own daughter, and she later learns the truth about her birth.
tawaif-1985: A man (Rishi Kapoor) is forced to shelter a courtesan (Rati Agnihotri) and comes to love her.
chidambaram-1985: A love triangle on a farm leads to guilt and tragedy, in G. Aravindan's Malayalam drama.
teen-murti-1984: A Bengali-Hindi action adventure from Pramod Chakravorty.
shiva-ka-insaaf-1985: A masked hero (Jackie Shroff) fights crime in India's first 3D film.
yeh-raaste-hain-pyaar-ke-2001: A con man (Ajay Devgn) on the run falls for a woman (Preity Zinta), and an old love (Madhuri Dixit) complicates things.
khamosh-pani-2003: In 1979, in a Pakistani Punjab village, Ayesha, a widow, lives quietly with her teenage son Saleem. As Zia-ul-Haq's military rule brings in religious radicalism, Saleem is drawn into a hardline group, and a group of Sikh pilgrims arrives, unsettling Ayesha's carefully hidden past. Sabiha Sumar's drama stars Kirron Kher and Aamir Malik.
being-cyrus-2005: Cyrus, a young drifter, becomes the apprentice of Dinshaw, an eccentric Parsi sculptor living with his wife Katy in Panchgani. As he is drawn into the dysfunctional family, including Dinshaw's brother and their elderly father in Mumbai, it becomes clear that Cyrus has an agenda of his own.
bas-itna-sa-khwaab-hai-2001: Suraj, a simple young man from Benaras, comes to Mumbai to study and falls for a girl named Pooja. He dreams big and wants to follow in the footsteps of his mentor, a shrewd media baron, but success comes with a price. Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji, Sushmita Sen and Jackie Shroff star in this Hindi romantic drama by Goldie Behl.
pyaar-diwana-hota-hai-2002: Sunder, a naive village man in the city, befriends Payal, a young NRI woman who mistakes him for a mute and sets out to help him speak again. Enjoying her attention, he keeps up the pretence, even as he falls deeply in love with her. Kirti Kumar's remake of the Tamil film Sollamale stars Govinda and Rani Mukerji.
chori-chori-2003: A woman (Rani Mukerji) pretends to be married to a man (Ajay Devgn) she barely knows, inspired by Housesitter.
3-deewarein-2003: Three men on death row, a poet convicted of killing his wife, an angry young man and a cheerful robber, become the subjects of a documentary made by Chandrika, a filmmaker visiting the prison. As she films them, she finds her own troubled marriage reflected in their stories.
devadasu-2006: Devadas, a poor student, falls in love with Bhanumati, the daughter of a powerful American senator of Indian origin, when she comes to India to learn Carnatic music. Her father secretly takes her back to New York, and Devadas sets off to the United States to win her back.
rehnaa-hai-terre-dil-mein-2001: A rough-edged young man (R. Madhavan) pretends to be a woman's fiancé (Saif Ali Khan) to win her, a remake of Minnale.
mere-yaar-ki-shaadi-hai-2002: Sanjay, a charming flirt from Mumbai, learns that his childhood friend Anjali is getting married and realises he has loved her all along. He travels to her family home and, with the help of his friend Riya, sets out to sabotage the wedding preparations.
kuch-khatti-kuch-meethi-2001: Raj and Archana separated after a misunderstanding created by a scheming relative, and each took one of their newborn twin daughters. Years later, the girls, Sweety and Tina, meet by chance in London, swap places and set out to bring their parents back together.
shwaas-2004: An old villager brings his eight-year-old grandson to a Pune hospital for an eye problem and learns the boy has a rare cancer. To save his life, the child must undergo surgery that will leave him blind, and the grandfather struggles to tell him. Sandeep Sawant's Marathi drama won the National Award for Best Feature Film.
rakht-2004: Drishti, a young widow with the gift of seeing the future, moves to a remote village after a painful break-up. Her visions draw her into a disturbing murder case, and the people around her start to seem dangerous. Mahesh Manjrekar's supernatural thriller, a remake of The Gift, stars Bipasha Basu, Sanjay Dutt, Suniel Shetty and Dino Morea.
rudraksh-2004: Gayatri, a paranormal researcher from the US, comes to India and meets Varun, a man with mysterious healing powers. Together they face Bhuria, a demonic man who has gained dark powers from an ancient bead linked to the Ramayana. Mani Shankar's fantasy action film stars Sanjay Dutt, Bipasha Basu and Suniel Shetty.
apna-sapna-money-money-2006: A group of people race to get rich by any means in a comedy of cons, with Riteish Deshmukh and Shreyas Talpade.
fight-club-members-only-2006: Four friends in Mumbai start an underground fight club where people can settle their differences with their fists. When one of them gets into trouble with gangsters back home in Delhi, the club members take on the mob. Vikram Chopra's action thriller stars Suniel Shetty, Sohail Khan, Zayed Khan, Dino Morea and Riteish Deshmukh.
kaalpurush-2005: A gentle, unassuming man whose marriage is falling apart longs for the father who left the family long ago. Across two timelines, the film moves between father and son, memory and the present. Buddhadeb Dasgupta's Bengali drama stars Mithun Chakraborty, Rahul Bose and Sameera Reddy, and won the National Award for Best Feature Film.
anwar-2007: Anwar, a young researcher in Lucknow who studies ancient temples, falls in love with Mehru, the daughter of a widow renting a room in his home. She dreams of a life in America and turns to another man, and a heartbroken Anwar's flight from home sets off a chain of events that puts his life in danger.
kalyug-2005: Kunal, a Kashmiri migrant in Mumbai, marries Renuka and takes her on a honeymoon. A hidden camera in their hotel room films them, and the clip ends up on a porn website, destroying their lives. Kunal sets out to find those responsible. Mohit Suri's thriller stars Kunal Khemu, Smilie Suri, Emraan Hashmi and Amrita Singh.
welcome-to-sajjanpur-2008: Mahadev, an unemployed graduate who dreams of being a novelist, earns a living writing letters for villagers who cannot write. Through the letters he writes for them, he becomes entangled in their loves, fears and feuds. Shyam Benegal's comedy stars Shreyas Talpade and Amrita Rao.
mission-istaanbul-2008: Vikas, an ambitious Indian TV journalist going through a divorce, accepts a job at a controversial news channel based in Istanbul. Once there, he discovers the channel has secret links to terrorists, and must fight his way out with the help of a commando. Apoorva Lakhia's action thriller stars Vivek Oberoi, Zayed Khan and Shriya Saran.
rock-on-2008: In 1998, four friends in Mumbai form a rock band called Magik and win a contest that promises a record deal, but creative differences tear them apart. Ten years later, living very different lives, they are brought together again and get a second chance at their old dream.
anaganaga-o-dheerudu-2011: Yodha, a carefree swordsman, falls for Priya, a gypsy girl descended from sorceresses. When an evil sorceress trapped in a locket threatens to return and a young girl is caught in her plans, Yodha must embark on a perilous quest to stop her. A Disney co-production.
tezz-2012: Aakash, an Indian engineer deported from the UK as an illegal immigrant, returns years later with revenge on his mind. He plants a bomb on a high-speed train that will explode if it drops below a certain speed, and officials race to stop it. Priyadarshan's action thriller stars Ajay Devgn, Anil Kapoor, Zayed Khan and Kangana Ranaut.
ramayana-the-epic-2010: Prince Rama is sent into exile with his wife Sita and brother Lakshmana. When the demon king Ravana kidnaps Sita, Rama raises an army of monkeys led by Hanuman to bring her home. Chetan Desai's computer-animated retelling of the Ramayana features the voices of Manoj Bajpayee, Juhi Chawla and Ashutosh Rana.
gabbar-singh-2012: Venkataratnam grows up resenting his stepfather and half-brother, and renames himself after the famous villain Gabbar Singh. Years later he returns to his hometown as a swaggering police inspector, where he crosses swords with a local goon with political ambitions and falls for a potter's daughter. Harish Shankar's remake of Dabangg stars Pawan Kalyan and Shruti Haasan.
ek-main-aur-ekk-tu-2012: Rahul, a buttoned-up architect who has lost his job in Las Vegas, wakes up after a wild night married to Riana, a free-spirited woman he barely knows. As they work to undo the mistake, an unlikely friendship grows. Shakun Batra's debut romantic comedy stars Imran Khan and Kareena Kapoor.
stanley-ka-dabba-2011: Stanley, a bright and popular fourth-grader in Mumbai, never brings a lunchbox to school. His friends happily share theirs, but a greedy teacher who keeps stealing the children's food bans him from eating with them unless he brings his own. Amole Gupte's gentle drama stars Partho Gupte, Divya Dutta and Amole Gupte.
kanchana-2011: Raghava, a grown man so scared of ghosts that he will not go out after dark, starts behaving strangely after playing cricket on an abandoned ground. His family realises he has been possessed by Kanchana, a spirit with a score to settle. Raghava Lawrence's horror comedy stars Lawrence, Sarathkumar, Lakshmi Rai and Kovai Sarala.
abcd-any-body-can-dance-2013: Vishnu, a talented choreographer, quits a top dance company after a falling-out with its owner. In a Mumbai slum he discovers a group of raw young dancers split into rival gangs, and trains them to compete in a national dance competition against his old company.
ghanchakkar-2013: Sanju, a skilled safecracker, joins two crooks for a bank heist and agrees to hide the loot. When they return for their share three months later, Sanju has lost his memory and cannot remember where he hid the cash, and his partners do not believe him. Raj Kumar Gupta's black comedy stars Emraan Hashmi and Vidya Balan.
ramaiya-vastavaiya-2013: Ram, a rich young man raised in Australia, falls for Sona, a simple village girl from Punjab, while visiting India for a wedding. Her protective brother, who raised her after their family was ruined, sets him a challenge: work on the family farm and prove he can do better than him.
roy-2015: Kabir, a playboy filmmaker shooting a trilogy about a master thief named Roy, falls for Ayesha, another filmmaker he meets in Malaysia. Meanwhile, Roy himself pulls off a daring art heist, and the two stories mirror each other. Vikramjit Singh's romantic drama stars Arjun Rampal, Jacqueline Fernandez and Ranbir Kapoor.
titli-2014: Titli is the youngest member of a violent car-jacking gang run by his older brothers in Delhi, and he desperately wants out. After his escape plan fails, his brothers marry him off to Neelu, hoping she will help the gang, but she has an agenda of her own.
katti-batti-2015: After an apparent suicide attempt, Maddy is still unable to get over Payal, the spirited girlfriend he lived with for five years until she suddenly walked out. Through flashbacks of their time together, he sets out to understand why she left and to win her back.
tanu-weds-manu-returns-2015: Tanu and Manu's marriage falls apart, and Manu meets a lookalike of Tanu, a Haryanvi athlete (Kangana Ranaut in a double role).
rangoon-2017: During the Second World War, Julia, a fearless action star of Hindi cinema, is sent to entertain troops at the Indo-Burma front. Accompanied by Nawab Malik, a soldier assigned to protect her, she is caught up in war, rebellion and a love triangle with her producer.
parched-2015: In a desert village in Rajasthan, three women share a bond of friendship: Rani, a widow raising a rebellious son; Lajjo, trapped in an abusive marriage; and Bijli, a dancer and sex worker. Weighed down by patriarchy and tradition, they begin to question the lives they have been handed.
sanam-teri-kasam-2016: Saru, a shy, bespectacled librarian, keeps being rejected by suitors for being too old-fashioned, and her sister's wedding cannot happen until she marries. When Inder, a brooding ex-convict, moves into her building, he becomes her unlikely helper and the two grow close, to her family's horror.
azhar-2016: Inspired by the life of Indian cricket captain Mohammad Azharuddin, the film opens with him facing match-fixing allegations and a life ban. As he fights the case in court, it looks back at his rise from a middle-class home in Hyderabad, his career and his personal life.
raman-raghav-2-0-2016: In Mumbai, a serial killer named Ramanna, inspired by the notorious 1960s murderer Raman Raghav, confesses to his crimes and then escapes custody. Raghavan, a drug-addicted police officer investigating the murders, pursues him, and the two men turn out to be more alike than either expects.
maheshinte-prathikaaram-2016: A gentle photographer in Idukki (Fahadh Faasil) is humiliated in a street fight and vows not to wear slippers until he takes revenge.
commando-2-the-black-money-trail-2017: Commando Karan is sent on a mission to recover black money stashed abroad by a crooked businessman. Joined by two police officers, he heads to Malaysia, where a chain of deceptions turns the hunt into a cat-and-mouse chase. Deven Bhojani's action sequel stars Vidyut Jammwal, Adah Sharma, Esha Gupta and Freddy Daruwala.
begum-jaan-2017: In 1947, as Partition divides India, Begum Jaan runs a brothel on land through which the new border between India and Pakistan is to be drawn. When officials order her to leave, she and the women who live with her refuse to give up their home.
wajah-tum-ho-2016: A corrupt police officer is murdered on live television after a hacker breaks into a channel's broadcast. As a police officer investigates the shocking crime and the channel's owner falls under suspicion, a sharp lawyer and her prosecutor boyfriend are drawn into a tangled web of secrets and revenge.
lipstick-under-my-burkha-2016: In a small Bhopal neighbourhood, four women of different ages secretly chase their desires and dreams: a college girl who longs for a modern life, a young bride, a married mother of three and a 55-year-old widow. Konkona Sen Sharma, Ratna Pathak Shah, Aahana Kumra and Plabita Borthakur star in this Hindi dark comedy by Alankrita Shrivastava.
mukkabaaz-2018: A lower-caste boxer from Uttar Pradesh (Vineet Kumar Singh) fights the system and a powerful coach whose niece he loves.
dhadak-2018: In Udaipur, Madhu, the son of a restaurant owner, falls for Parthavi, the daughter of a powerful upper-caste politician. When their secret romance is discovered, her family's fury forces the young couple to run away and try to build a new life far from home.
oru-adaar-love-2019: A high school romance among students in Kerala, known for its viral wink scene.
marjaavaan-2019: A henchman (Sidharth Malhotra) falls for a mute girl (Tara Sutaria) and is forced into conflict with a dwarf villain (Riteish Deshmukh).
coolie-no-1-2020: A railway porter (Varun Dhawan) pretends to be a rich man to marry a girl (Sara Ali Khan), a remake of the 1995 Coolie No. 1.
ala-vaikunthapurramuloo-2020: A clerk's son (Allu Arjun) discovers he was swapped at birth with a rich man's son and works his way into his real family's home.
roohi-2020: Two small-town kidnappers hold a bride captive, but she is possessed by a ghost who targets brides.
jallikattu-2019: A buffalo escapes from a slaughterhouse in a Kerala village and the hunt for it turns the men into beasts, in Lijo Jose Pellissery's thriller.
haseen-dillruba-2020: A woman (Taapsee Pannu) is a suspect in her husband's death, and her love affair comes under scrutiny.
777-charlie-2021: A lonely, grumpy man (Rakshit Shetty) adopts a stray Labrador and takes it on a road trip across India.
ek-villain-returns-2022: A serial killer targets women who break hearts, and his path crosses with four lovers.
santosh-2024: A young widow (Shahana Goswami) takes over her late husband's police job and investigates the murder of a Dalit girl.
bhool-bhulaiyaa-3-2024: Ghost-buster Rooh Baba (Kartik Aaryan) arrives at a royal palace in Bengal haunted by Manjulika.
jaane-bhi-do-yaaro-1983: Two naive photographers stumble onto a murder and expose corruption among builders, politicians and the press, in Kundan Shah's satire.
angoor-1982: Gulzar's comedy of errors about two pairs of identical twins, separated as babies, who land in the same town and set off a chain of mistaken identities. Sanjeev Kumar and Deven Verma each play two roles.
parichay-1972: A young man takes a job tutoring a houseful of unruly children who resent their stern grandfather, and slowly wins over the whole family. Gulzar directs Jeetendra and Jaya Bhaduri.
ghulami-1985: J. P. Dutta's drama about a man who returns to his Rajasthan village and stands up to the landlords who keep poor farmers in bondage. Dharmendra, Mithun Chakraborty and Naseeruddin Shah lead.
khilona-1970: After a heartbroken young man loses his sanity, his family brings in a dancing girl to pose as his wife, hoping her care will heal him. Sanjeev Kumar and Mumtaz lead this L. V. Prasad production.
bawarchi-1972: A cheerful cook joins a squabbling joint family and, with food, music and quiet kindness, brings them back together. Rajesh Khanna stars for Hrishikesh Mukherjee.
kora-kagaz-1974: A young couple's marriage frays under the weight of pride and the wife's meddling mother, until both must decide what they really want. Jaya Bhaduri and Vijay Anand star.
chor-machaye-shor-1974: A man wrongly sent to jail breaks out to clear his name and win back the woman he loves. Shashi Kapoor and Mumtaz lead, with songs by Ravindra Jain.
pati-patni-aur-woh-1978: A contented husband begins an affair with his secretary and spins ever more lies to hide it from his wife, with comic results. B. R. Chopra directs Sanjeev Kumar, Vidya Sinha and Ranjeeta.
kal-aaj-aur-kal-1971: Three generations of one household clash over tradition and modern ways, played by three generations of the Kapoors: Prithviraj, Raj and Randhir, who also directs.
doosara-aadmi-1977: A widowed career woman is drawn to a young married man who reminds her of her late lover, unsettling his marriage. Raakhee, Rishi Kapoor and Neetu Singh star; Yash Chopra produces.
noorie-1979: In a Kashmir valley, a shepherd and a village girl fall in love, until a predatory man brings tragedy. Farooq Shaikh and Poonam Dhillon star, with Khayyam's music.
kudrat-1981: A young woman visiting Shimla is haunted by memories of an earlier life, and a doctor tries to unravel the mystery. Chetan Anand directs Rajesh Khanna, Hema Malini and Raaj Kumar.
jeevan-dhaara-1982: A working woman gives up her own happiness to support a large, struggling family. Rekha leads this remake of the Tamil film Aval Oru Thodar Kathai.
yudh-1985: An action thriller with Jackie Shroff and Anil Kapoor that marked Rajiv Rai's debut as a director.
my-dear-kuttichathan-1984: Children befriend a mischievous little genie and help free him from a cruel sorcerer. Known as India's first 3D film.
zindagi-zindagi-1972: Tapan Sinha's drama set around a village hospital, touching on caste prejudice. Sunil Dutt and Waheeda Rehman lead.
ghar-1978: A newly married couple's life is shattered when the wife is attacked one night, and they struggle to rebuild their marriage. Vinod Mehra and Rekha star, with a celebrated R. D. Burman score.
teri-meherbaniyan-1985: A loyal dog sets out to avenge its master's murder. Jackie Shroff and Poonam Dhillon lead.
himmatwala-1983: A brave young man returns to his village to take on the tyrant landlord who wronged his family, and falls for the landlord's spoilt daughter. Jeetendra and Sridevi star.
aaina-1993: Two very different sisters are bound up with the same man, and a broken wedding leaves him married to the gentler one. Jackie Shroff, Amrita Singh and Juhi Chawla star.
drohkaal-1994: Govind Nihalani's thriller about honest police officers fighting a terror network, and the mental toll it takes on them and their families.
bekhudi-1992: Young lovers Rohit and Radhika fight her parents' disapproval. Kamal Sadanah stars opposite Kajol in her debut.
kala-bazaar-1989: Rakesh Roshan's action drama about corruption and the black market, starring Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff and Kader Khan.
lekin-1991: A government officer visiting a ruined Rajasthan palace keeps meeting a mysterious woman tied to its past. Gulzar adapts a Tagore story, with Vinod Khanna and Dimple Kapadia.
dharavi-1992: A Mumbai taxi driver dreams of escaping the slum by starting his own small business. Sudhir Mishra directs Om Puri and Shabana Azmi.
bambai-ka-babu-1995: An action drama directed by Vikram Bhatt, starring Saif Ali Khan, Atul Agnihotri and Kajol.
aa-gale-lag-jaa-1994: A romantic thriller with Jugal Hansraj and Urmila Matondkar.
sangram-1993: A romantic action drama with Ajay Devgn, Ayesha Jhulka and Karisma Kapoor.
kaash-1987: A fading actor and his estranged wife come back together when they learn their young son is seriously ill. Mahesh Bhatt directs Jackie Shroff and Dimple Kapadia.
idiot-1992: Mani Kaul's adaptation of Dostoevsky's novel The Idiot, with Shah Rukh Khan in an early role.
veerana-1988: A young woman is possessed by the spirit of a dead witch and lures men to their doom. A Ramsay Brothers horror film.
coolie-no-1-1995: A railway porter poses as a rich man to marry a wealthy girl, then keeps the lie going with ever wilder tricks. David Dhawan directs Govinda and Karisma Kapoor.
sir-1993: A grieving college professor tries to end a gang war in Mumbai, putting one of his students in danger. Naseeruddin Shah plays the title role.
batwara-1989: J. P. Dutta's saga of feudal Rajasthan, where a family is torn apart by greed and a fight over land. Dharmendra and Vinod Khanna lead.
manzil-manzil-1984: Nasir Hussain's romantic drama starring Sunny Deol and Dimple Kapadia.
eeshwar-1989: A simple-minded man marries a young widow and wins over her and the village with his innocence. Anil Kapoor stars in K. Viswanath's Hindi remake of Swathi Muthyam.
narsimha-1991: A street tough who works for a feared local strongman turns against him. Sunny Deol leads N. Chandra's action drama.
zulm-ki-hukumat-1992: A crime drama with Dharmendra and Govinda, produced by Sajid Nadiadwala.
dil-hi-to-hai-1992: A romantic drama directed by Asrani, with Jackie Shroff in a double role alongside Shilpa Shirodkar and Divya Bharti.
road-2002: Arvind and Lakshmi elope from Delhi and drive across the Rajasthan desert to get married. When they give a lift to Babu, a charming hitchhiker, the journey turns into a terrifying cat-and-mouse game. Rajat Mukherjee's road thriller, produced by Ram Gopal Varma, stars Vivek Oberoi, Antara Mali and Manoj Bajpayee.
love-ke-liye-kuch-bhi-karega-2000: Prakash, tired of his rich father-in-law's insults, hires two broke strugglers, Rahul and Harry, to fake his wife's kidnapping. But the kidnapping goes off the rails when it turns out Prakash has plans of his own. Eeshwar Nivas's crime comedy stars Saif Ali Khan, Fardeen Khan, Sonali Bendre, Twinkle Khanna and Aftab Shivdasani.
hazaaron-khwaishein-aisi-2003: In 1970s India, three college friends, an idealist drawn to revolution, an ambitious fixer and a young woman torn between them, follow very different paths through politics and the Emergency. Their lives keep crossing over the years. Sudhir Mishra's political drama stars Kay Kay Menon, Shiney Ahuja and Chitrangada Singh.
boys-2003: Five teenage friends chase love and music, and their rebellious choices bring hard lessons. Shankar directs, with music by A. R. Rahman.
mudhalvan-1999: A TV journalist challenges the chief minister on air and is dared to run the state for one day, and he takes the job. Arjun stars for Shankar.
bichhoo-2000: Jeeva, a hardened contract killer living alone in Mumbai, is drawn into a young woman's life when her family, his neighbours, is wiped out by a corrupt police officer. She begs him to teach her his trade so she can take revenge. Guddu Dhanoa's action thriller, inspired by Léon: The Professional, stars Bobby Deol and Rani Mukerji.
badal-2000: As a boy, Badal watched a sadistic police officer massacre his family. Raised by his father's friend, he grows up to become a feared militant whose only goal is revenge on the officer. His plans are complicated when a kind police officer takes him under his wing and he falls in love.
raja-ki-aayegi-baaraat-1997: After a young woman is attacked by a rich man, a court orders him to marry her, and she must fight for respect in his household. Rani Mukerji's Hindi debut.
samar-1999: Shyam Benegal's film about a crew shooting a film on caste discrimination in a village, where the real tensions mirror the story.
paap-2003: In the mountains of Spiti, a young woman chosen for a spiritual life falls for a wounded policeman she shelters. Pooja Bhatt's directing debut, with John Abraham and Udita Goswami.
khushi-2003: Two proud young people fall in love but keep clashing over ego. Fardeen Khan and Kareena Kapoor star in this remake of the Tamil hit Kushi.
mast-1999: A small-town young man obsessed with a film star finally gets to meet her. Ram Gopal Varma directs Aftab Shivdasani and Urmila Matondkar.
kaun-1999: A woman alone at home on a rainy night lets in strangers while a serial killer is at large. Urmila Matondkar and Manoj Bajpayee star.
tera-jadoo-chal-gayaa-2000: Tera Jadoo Chal Gayaa is a 2000 Hindi musical romance directed by A. Muthu, inspired by Picture Perfect and starring Abhishek Bachchan and Keerthi Reddy. On a trip to Agra, Pooja meets a renowned artist who believes she is drawn to him, but back home she falls for her boss's son, and a convenient lie at work soon spins out of control.
tera-mera-saath-rahen-2001: Raj, a kind young man, has devoted his life to caring for his younger brother Rahul, who has cerebral palsy. When Raj falls in love, he must find a partner who will accept Rahul too, while Rahul struggles with his dependence on him. Mahesh Manjrekar's drama stars Ajay Devgn, Sonali Bendre, Namrata Shirodkar and Dushyant Wagh.
pukar-2000: Major Jaidev, a decorated army officer, is falsely accused of betraying his country after classified documents go missing. Disgraced and rejected by the woman who loved him, he sets out to clear his name and stop a terrorist leader. Rajkumar Santoshi's action thriller stars Anil Kapoor, Madhuri Dixit, Namrata Shirodkar and Danny Denzongpa.
khel-no-ordinary-game-2003: Dev Maliya, a corrupt multimillionaire, sets his sights on Sanjh, an interior designer he hires to redo his mansion. When he learns that she has feelings for his friend Rohan, he begins a dangerous game of manipulation. Sunny Deol, Suniel Shetty and Celina Jaitly star in this Hindi action thriller directed by Yusuf Khan and produced by Suniel Shetty.
champion-2000: Rajveer, a cop from a Punjab village who dreams of becoming a supercop, gets his first assignment in Mumbai and is disappointed to find it is protecting a nine-year-old boy, the heir to a vast fortune. The job turns out to be far more dangerous than he thought. Sunny Deol, Manisha Koirala and Rahul Dev star in this Hindi action film.
dastak-1996: A Miss Universe is stalked by an obsessive admirer while a police officer tries to protect her. Sushmita Sen plays a version of herself.
ghulam-e-musthafa-1997: A loyal enforcer for a powerful man looks for a way out of his violent life. Nana Patekar and Raveena Tandon star.
ek-aur-ek-gyarah-2003: Tara and Sitara are lovable small-town con men who are always in trouble with the law. While fleeing the police, they accidentally shoot a dreaded criminal, and hide out at the home of an army major whose testimony put the criminal's brother behind bars. Sanjay Dutt and Govinda star in this Hindi action comedy by David Dhawan.
dil-maange-more-2004: Nikhil, a football-loving young man from a small hill town, is desperate to find true love. His girlfriend leaves to become a flight attendant in Mumbai, and soon he finds himself juggling three very different women, each ready to swear love for him. Anant Mahadevan's romantic comedy stars Shahid Kapoor, Ayesha Takia, Tulip Joshi and Soha Ali Khan.
aag-2007: Two young men who flee to Mumbai after assaulting a police officer are recruited by a crippled police inspector to capture Babban, a ruthless gangster who once destroyed his family. They join the inspector in a remote town terrorised by the gang. This is Ram Gopal Varma's reimagining of Sholay.
chatrapathi-2005: Sivaji, a Sri Lankan refugee boy, is separated from his stepmother when his jealous half-brother lies that he is dead. He grows up among refugees working in harsh conditions at Visakhapatnam port and rises to fight the gangsters who exploit them, while still searching for his mother. S. S. Rajamouli directs Prabhas, Shriya Saran and Bhanupriya.
tango-charlie-2005: Tarun, a young Border Security Force recruit nicknamed Tango Charlie, is sent from one conflict zone to another, from the northeast to Kashmir and riot-hit Gujarat. Through his eyes, the film shows the human cost of violence. Mani Shankar's war drama stars Bobby Deol, Ajay Devgn, Sanjay Dutt, Suniel Shetty and Tanishaa.
malamaal-weekly-2006: In a poor village where the lottery is the only hope, a man wins a fortune but dies of shock before he can claim it. Lilaram, the lottery agent, plots to collect the ticket himself, but soon the whole village wants a share. Priyadarshan's comedy, inspired by Waking Ned Devine, stars Paresh Rawal, Om Puri, Riteish Deshmukh and Rajpal Yadav.
darna-mana-hai-2003: When their car breaks down in a forest at night, a group of friends take shelter in an abandoned house and pass the time telling each other spooky stories, each one turning into its own short tale of horror. Saif Ali Khan, Shilpa Shetty and Vivek Oberoi lead the ensemble in this Hindi horror anthology directed by Prawaal Raman.
iqbal-2005: A deaf and mute village boy dreams of playing cricket for India, helped by a former player. Nagesh Kukunoor directs Shreyas Talpade.
cash-2007: On a flight, a smooth-talking thief tells a stranger the story of a legendary diamond that was found, lost and finally split into three pieces. Years later, a gang of stylish con artists sets out to steal all three pieces, and finds that others are after the stones too.
aan-men-at-work-2004: Mumbai's underworld is carved up between a ruthless businessman, a corrupt Home Minister and a gangster. An honest new police commissioner and a team of tough officers from the crime branch decide to break the nexus, whatever it costs them.
nehlle-pe-dehlla-2007: Nehlle Pe Dehlla is a Hindi action comedy starring Sanjay Dutt, Saif Ali Khan and Bipasha Basu, completed in 2002 but released only in 2007. Two small-time crooks who keep landing in jail take jobs as hotel waiters to blackmail a manager who has embezzled a fortune, only to find a dangerous gang after the same money.
rishtey-2002: Suraj, a poor amateur fighter, marries Komal against her rich father's wishes. When the couple are torn apart, Suraj raises their son on his own, until his father-in-law fights for custody and Suraj must win both in the ring and in his son's heart. Indra Kumar's drama, based on Over the Top, stars Anil Kapoor, Karisma Kapoor and Shilpa Shetty.
awarapan-2007: A gangster's trusted man is ordered to watch over his boss's mistress, and one act of mercy sets off violence. Emraan Hashmi stars.
goal-2007: Southall United, an Asian football club in London, is about to lose its ground. Sunny, a gifted young player who has long avoided the club, is persuaded to join, and the team fights to win a tournament and save its home. Vivek Agnihotri's sports drama stars John Abraham, Arshad Warsi, Bipasha Basu and Boman Irani.
home-delivery-2005: Sunny Chopra is a popular agony uncle with a newspaper column and a big screenwriting job for Karan Johar. But over the course of a single day, a series of unexpected encounters changes his outlook on life. Vivek Oberoi, Ayesha Takia, Mahima Chaudhry and Boman Irani star in this Hindi romantic comedy written and directed by Sujoy Ghosh.
ab-tak-chhappan-2004: Sadhu Agashe is a senior inspector in Mumbai's encounter squad with 56 kills to his name and an unshakeable sense of duty. When a new commissioner arrives and a jealous junior officer conspires against him, Sadhu finds himself hunted by the very system he served.
zameen-2003: Colonel Ranvir and ACP Jaideep, bitter rivals since a mission went wrong, are forced to work together when terrorists hijack an Indian plane to free their captured leader. They must enter Pakistan to rescue the passengers. Rohit Shetty's debut action thriller stars Ajay Devgn, Abhishek Bachchan and Bipasha Basu.
insan-2005: In Mumbai, an honest police officer, a hot-headed autorickshaw driver searching for his missing brother, and a struggling actor have their lives tangled together. When terrorism strikes the city, their paths converge. K. Subash's action thriller, a remake of Khadgam, stars Akshay Kumar, Ajay Devgn, Tusshar Kapoor, Esha Deol and Lara Dutta.
shararat-2002: A spoilt rich young man is ordered to do community service at a home for the elderly. Abhishek Bachchan stars.
pitaah-2002: Rudra, a poor labourer in a rural town, seeks justice when his young daughter is brutally assaulted by the sons of a cruel and powerful landlord. When the law fails him, he takes matters into his own hands, and the case divides the town. Mahesh Manjrekar's drama, inspired by A Time to Kill, stars Sanjay Dutt, Jackie Shroff and Nandita Das.
shakalaka-boom-boom-2007: AJ, a top music star with writer's block, is jealous when Reggie, a talented newcomer, wins over Ruhi, the woman AJ loves. He sets out to manipulate and destroy Reggie's career while stealing his music. Suneel Darshan's musical drama stars Bobby Deol, Upen Patel, Kangana Ranaut and Celina Jaitly.
paathshaala-2010: Rahul, a new English and music teacher at a respected Mumbai school, is popular with students and staff. When the management starts turning the school into a profit-making business and pushes the children into reality TV, he decides to fight back. Milind Ukey's drama stars Shahid Kapoor, Ayesha Takia and Nana Patekar.
1920-2008: In 1920, a newly married couple move into an old mansion, and the wife falls under an evil presence. Vikram Bhatt directs.
firaaq-2008: A month after the 2002 riots in Gujarat, several ordinary lives play out over a single day: an old musician, a housewife haunted by guilt, a mixed-faith couple, angry young men and a lost little boy. Nandita Das's directorial debut looks at fear and its aftermath, with Naseeruddin Shah, Deepti Naval, Paresh Rawal and Nawazuddin Siddiqui.
chance-pe-dance-2010: Sameer comes to Mumbai with Bollywood dreams, working as a courier and failing audition after audition. When a director finally spots his dancing and casts him as a lead, his luck seems to turn, until setbacks leave him homeless and doubting himself. His choreographer friend Tina helps him keep going. Ken Ghosh directs Shahid Kapoor and Genelia D'Souza.
maryada-ramanna-2010: Ramu, a gentle young man raised in the city, travels to his ancestral village to sell some land. He unknowingly enters the home of a family that has sworn to kill him over an old feud, and discovers they cannot harm him as long as he stays a guest under their roof. S. S. Rajamouli's action comedy stars Sunil and Saloni.
we-are-family-2010: Maya, a devoted single mother, shares custody of her three children with her ex-husband, who has a new girlfriend, Shreya. When Maya falls seriously ill, she must teach Shreya to take her place in the children's lives. Siddharth P. Malhotra's remake of Stepmom stars Kajol, Kareena Kapoor and Arjun Rampal.
mausam-2011: A Punjabi villager and a Kashmiri girl fall in love but are kept apart by events for years. Pankaj Kapur directs Shahid Kapoor and Sonam Kapoor.
nanban-2012: Venkat and Sevarkodi set out to find their old college friend Pari, who vanished after graduation. Flashbacks recall how Pari's free-thinking ways shook up their strict engineering college and its rigid principal. Shankar's Tamil remake of 3 Idiots stars Vijay, Jiiva, Srikanth, Sathyaraj and Ileana D'Cruz.
murder-2-2011: Arjun, a disillusioned ex-cop who now works for criminals, is hired to find a string of missing call girls. As the trail leads to a psychotic killer, Arjun risks everything to stop him and save a young woman. Mohit Suri's psychological thriller stars Emraan Hashmi, Jacqueline Fernandez and Prashant Narayanan.
chalo-dilli-2011: Mihika, a polished Mumbai investment banker, misses her flight to Delhi and is stuck travelling with Manu, a loud, cheerful shopkeeper from Chandni Chowk. By road, rail and on foot, the mismatched pair cross small-town India, and her patience gets tested at every turn. Shashant Shah's road comedy stars Lara Dutta and Vinay Pathak.
pyaar-ka-punchnama-2011: Rajat, Nishant and Vikrant, three roommates in Noida, each fall in love, and each relationship slowly turns into a frustrating struggle that leaves them feeling used. Luv Ranjan's debut buddy comedy stars Kartik Aaryan, Divyenndu, Raayo S. Bakhirta, Nushrat Bharucha, Sonnalli Seygall and Ishita Raj Sharma.
deool-2011: Keshya, a simple cowherd in a sleepy Maharashtra village, claims he saw the god Datta under a tree. Local politicians and opportunists seize on the story, build a grand temple, and the village turns into a booming pilgrimage business. Umesh Kulkarni's Marathi satire stars Girish Kulkarni, Nana Patekar and Dilip Prabhavalkar.
lootera-2013: In 1950s Bengal, Pakhi, the daughter of a zamindar, falls for Varun, a young archaeologist who comes to dig near her family estate. Their romance is intense, but Varun is not quite who he seems. Vikramaditya Motwane's period drama, partly inspired by O. Henry's The Last Leaf, stars Ranveer Singh and Sonakshi Sinha.
julayi-2012: Ravi, a smart but lazy young man who wants easy money, accidentally helps a gang pull off a huge bank robbery. Realising what he has done, he teams up with the police to bring down the gang's mastermind, Bittu. Trivikram Srinivas's action comedy stars Allu Arjun, Ileana D'Cruz, Sonu Sood and Rajendra Prasad.
gangs-of-wasseypur-2-2012: After Sardar Khan's death, his sons carry on the family's long feud with Ramadhir Singh and the Qureshi clan. The reluctant Faizal, a stoner raised on Hindi films, takes charge and builds a coal-and-scrap empire in Dhanbad as the violence spreads to a new generation. Anurag Kashyap's crime saga stars Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Huma Qureshi and Richa Chadha.
pizza-2012: Michael, a pizza delivery boy in Chennai who is terrified of the supernatural, lives with his girlfriend Anu, a horror-novel enthusiast. One night he is sent to deliver a pizza to an old bungalow, and finds himself trapped in a nightmare. Karthik Subbaraj's horror thriller stars Vijay Sethupathi and Remya Nambeesan.
akaash-vani-2013: Akaash, a carefree young man, and Vani, a shy girl from a traditional family, fall in love at college in Delhi and stay together for four years. After graduation, Vani's family arranges her marriage to someone else, and she is trapped in an unhappy home until Akaash re-enters her life.
kanchana-2-2015: Raghava, a cameraman terrified of ghosts, goes with his colleague Nandini to shoot a horror show at a seaside house near Mahabalipuram. The house turns out to be truly haunted, and the spirits there have unfinished business. Raghava Lawrence's horror comedy stars Lawrence, Taapsee Pannu and Nithya Menen.
detective-byomkesh-bakshy-2015: In 1940s Calcutta, young detective Byomkesh looks for a missing chemist and uncovers a wartime plot. Dibakar Banerjee directs Sushant Singh Rajput.
shaadi-ke-side-effects-2014: Sid and Trisha are happily married until a baby arrives and turns their lives upside down. Feeling lost, Sid secretly rents a flat to get some time for himself, and the lies that follow test their marriage. Saket Chaudhary's romantic comedy, a sequel to Pyaar Ke Side Effects, stars Farhan Akhtar and Vidya Balan.
aaha-kalyanam-2014: Shakthi, a street-smart young man, meets Shruti, who dreams of starting her own wedding planning business. Eager to avoid going back to his village, he talks her into making him her partner, and the two agree never to mix business with romance. A Tamil remake of Band Baaja Baaraat.
daawat-e-ishq-2014: Fed up with dowry demands, a young woman plans to con a groom's family, and a Lucknow cook falls for her along the way. Parineeti Chopra and Aditya Roy Kapur star.
rocky-handsome-2016: A quiet loner with a violent past takes on a drug gang to rescue a young girl. John Abraham stars.
mastizaade-2016: Sunny and Aditya are best friends obsessed with improving their love lives. When they land jobs at a sex addiction clinic, they meet twin sisters Laila and Lily and try every trick to win them over. Sunny Leone plays the twins, with Tusshar Kapoor and Vir Das, in this Hindi adult comedy directed by Milap Zaveri.
kyaa-kool-hain-hum-3-2016: Kanhaiya, an innocent man looking for true love, and his best friend Rocky, who is anything but innocent, find themselves working in the adult film business. When Kanhaiya falls for a woman from a conservative family, the two must hide their jobs. Tusshar Kapoor and Aftab Shivdasani star in this third Hindi adult comedy in the series.
hate-story-3-2015: An erotic thriller in which a businessman is targeted by a stranger with a grudge. Sharman Joshi and Zareen Khan star.
vedalam-2015: Ganesh, a mild-mannered cab driver, moves to Kolkata with his younger sister. When he gets mixed up with a gang of human traffickers, his calm exterior falls away and a violent past comes to light. Siva's action film stars Ajith Kumar, Shruti Haasan and Lakshmi Menon.
sarrainodu-2016: Sarrainodu is a 2016 Telugu action comedy directed by Boyapati Srinu, starring Allu Arjun with Aadhi Pinisetty, Rakul Preet Singh and Catherine Tresa. Gana, a former army major scolded by his father for drifting through life, is sent to meet a prospective bride but falls for a young MLA, and is soon drawn into a fight against a ruthless political family.
chakravyuha-2016: Sadashivayya, a former gangster turned state law minister, stirs up violence at a government law college to get rid of a principal who refused him an illegal admissions quota. A young man who witnesses the fallout decides to take him on. Puneeth Rajkumar and Arun Vijay star in this Kannada vigilante thriller by M. Saravanan.
julie-2-2016: Julie, an aspiring actress, finds that a film career comes with dark compromises. As she rises to stardom, a series of powerful men use her and move on, and her links to the underworld land her in danger. Deepak Shivdasani's erotic thriller, a sequel to his 2004 film Julie, stars Raai Laxmi in her Hindi debut, with Ravi Kishan.
phobia-2016: An artist with severe agoraphobia moves into a new flat and grows convinced something sinister is going on. Radhika Apte stars.
ratsasan-2017: Arun, an aspiring filmmaker fascinated by the psychology of serial killers, gives up his dreams and joins the Tamil Nadu police as a sub-inspector. He is soon investigating a string of brutal murders of schoolgirls and becomes convinced they are the work of one killer.
naa-peru-surya-2018: Surya, a fiercely angry soldier who dreams of a posting at the border, is suspended after a violent incident. To be reinstated, he must get a certificate from a respected psychologist he has long been estranged from, his own father, and learn to control his temper. Vakkantham Vamsi's action drama stars Allu Arjun, Anu Emmanuel and Arjun Sarja.
october-2018: A hotel trainee devotes himself to a colleague left in a coma after a fall. Shoojit Sircar directs Varun Dhawan and Banita Sandhu.
the-tashkent-files-2019: Vivek Agnihotri's drama about a young journalist who reopens questions around the death of former prime minister Lal Bahadur Shastri in Tashkent.
judgementall-hai-kya-2019: Bobby, an eccentric dubbing artist in Mumbai with a troubled past and a vivid imagination, becomes fixated on the young couple renting her house. When the wife dies in a kitchen fire, Bobby is convinced the husband killed her, but nobody believes her.
vinaya-vidheya-rama-2019: A man devoted to his brothers takes on a ruthless warlord. Ram Charan stars for Boyapati Srinu.
pm-narendra-modi-2019: This biographical drama dramatises the life of Narendra Modi, from his childhood selling tea and his time with the RSS to his years as Chief Minister of Gujarat and his campaign to become Prime Minister. Vivek Oberoi plays the lead role, with Omung Kumar directing.
junglee-2019: Raj, a veterinarian in Mumbai, returns to his father's elephant sanctuary for the anniversary of his mother's death. When ivory poachers kill his father and his beloved elephant, Raj uses his martial arts skills and his bond with the herd to fight back.
prem-pujari-1970: A peace-loving young man from a military family is pulled into an espionage mission. Dev Anand directs and stars with Waheeda Rehman.
mere-apne-1971: An elderly widow brought to the city gets caught between rival gangs of jobless young men. Gulzar's directing debut, with Meena Kumari and Vinod Khanna.
anubhav-1971: A busy newspaper editor and his wife try to rekindle their marriage, until someone from her past turns up. Sanjeev Kumar and Tanuja star.
manto-2018: In 1946 Bombay, Saadat Hasan Manto is an acclaimed Urdu writer and screenwriter enjoying life in the film world. Partition forces him to move to Lahore, where he faces obscenity trials over his stories, financial hardship and declining health, while continuing to write about the truths others avoid.
sandeep-aur-pinky-faraar-2021: A banker and a suspended policeman go on the run and hide out in a Himalayan town. Parineeti Chopra and Arjun Kapoor star.
satyameva-jayate-2018: A mysterious vigilante is killing corrupt police officers in Mumbai by setting them on fire, winning the public's support. DCP Shivansh Rathod is assigned to catch him, and the cat-and-mouse chase between them reveals a deep personal connection.
chhalaang-2020: A lazy PE teacher at a small-town school has to prove himself when a qualified rival arrives. Rajkummar Rao and Nushrat Bharucha star.
kumbalangi-nights-2019: Four estranged brothers in a Kerala fishing village slowly learn to be a family. Fahadh Faasil and Shane Nigam star.
ismart-shankar-2019: Shankar, a reckless contract killer from Hyderabad, is arrested after his girlfriend is killed in a police shootout. When a scientist's memory-transfer experiment implants a dead officer's memories into his brain, Shankar finds himself carrying the secrets of a murder investigation.
jersey-2022: A failed cricketer in his late thirties returns to the game to buy his son a jersey. Shahid Kapoor stars.
bunty-aur-babli-2-2020: The original con couple come out of retirement when a new pair starts pulling scams in their name. Saif Ali Khan and Rani Mukerji star.
tribhanga-2021: Three generations of women, a writer, her actress daughter and a granddaughter, confront the past they share. Kajol stars.
choked-2020: A bank cashier finds bundles of cash coming up through her kitchen drain, just before demonetisation. Anurag Kashyap directs Saiyami Kher.
jugjugg-jeeyo-2022: A couple heading for divorce discover that the groom's father plans to leave his wife too. Anil Kapoor, Neetu Kapoor, Varun Dhawan and Kiara Advani star.
badhaai-do-2022: A gay policeman and a lesbian PE teacher enter a marriage of convenience. Rajkummar Rao and Bhumi Pednekar star.
cobalt-blue-2022: A brother and sister both fall for the same paying guest. Sachin Kundalkar adapts his own novel.
satyaprem-ki-katha-2023: A carefree young man marries a woman who is hiding a painful secret. Kartik Aaryan and Kiara Advani star.
bramayugam-2024: In 17th-century Kerala, a singer on the run takes shelter in a crumbling mansion and becomes trapped by its sinister master. Mammootty stars.
homebound-2025: Two childhood friends from a north Indian village chase police jobs in search of dignity. Neeraj Ghaywan directs.
lokah-chapter-1-chandra-2025: A mysterious young woman with hidden powers lives quietly in Bengaluru until danger draws her out. Kalyani Priyadarshan and Naslen star.
mera-gaon-mera-desh-1971: A small-time thief, reformed by a retired army officer, helps a village fight a feared dacoit. Dharmendra and Vinod Khanna star.
kranti-1981: Manoj Kumar's period epic about Indians rising against colonial rule in the 1800s, with Dilip Kumar in the title role and a large ensemble cast. Written by Salim–Javed.
shor-1972: A widowed father whose son lost his voice in an accident works himself to the bone to pay for the boy's treatment, hoping to hear him speak again. Manoj Kumar writes, directs and stars.
karz-1980: A young singer begins to recall a past life in which he was murdered by his wife, and sets out to confront her. Subhash Ghai directs Rishi Kapoor, Tina Munim and Simi Garewal.
naram-garam-1981: Hrishikesh Mukherjee's comedy about a mild-mannered man, the woman he loves and the scheming landlord who stands in their way. Amol Palekar stars, with music by R. D. Burman.
andaz-1971: A widower and a young widow, each raising a child, find love again despite social disapproval. Ramesh Sippy's debut, with Shammi Kapoor and Hema Malini, and Rajesh Khanna in a memorable cameo.
do-jasoos-1975: Two bumbling private detectives stumble through a case far bigger than they can handle. Raj Kapoor and Rajendra Kumar star.
vijeta-1982: A troubled young man finds purpose and discipline after joining the Indian Air Force. Govind Nihalani directs Kunal Kapoor, with Shashi Kapoor and Rekha.
dharam-karam-1975: A small-time crook wants his son to grow up honest and gives him away, but fate keeps pulling the two together. Raj Kapoor and Randhir Kapoor play father and son.
baseraa-1981: A woman who loses her mind after a family tragedy recovers years later to find her sister has married her husband, and the family hides the truth to protect her. Shashi Kapoor, Raakhee and Rekha star.
heera-panna-1973: A photographer gets caught up with a gang of jewel smugglers and a woman who may be working for them. Dev Anand directs and stars with Zeenat Aman and Raakhee.
sagina-1974: A fearless factory worker becomes a leader of his fellow labourers, then finds himself used by party politics. Dilip Kumar stars in Tapan Sinha's Hindi remake of his Bengali film Sagina Mahato.
thodisi-bewafaii-1980: A proud husband and wife separate over a misunderstanding and live apart for years while raising their children. Rajesh Khanna and Shabana Azmi star.
arohan-1982: A poor sharecropper in Bengal fights a long battle for his rights against a powerful landlord. Shyam Benegal directs Om Puri.
meera-1979: Gulzar's film on the life of the poet-saint Meera, who gave up royal comforts for her devotion to Krishna. Hema Malini plays Meera.
avtaar-1983: An ageing mechanic is pushed out by the sons he raised, and with his wife rebuilds his life from scratch. Rajesh Khanna and Shabana Azmi star.
naukri-1978: A young graduate goes from one job interview to another in search of work, a comic look at unemployment. Hrishikesh Mukherjee directs Rajesh Khanna.
nirmalyam-1973: An oracle at a village temple watches his faith and his family fall apart as poverty bites. M. T. Vasudevan Nair's debut; P. J. Antony won the National Award for Best Actor.
balika-badhu-1976: A boy and a girl married as children grow up and slowly discover love for each other. Based on a Bengali novel by Bimal Kar; Tarun Majumdar directs.
sankarabharanam-1979: A revered classical singer falls on hard times as tastes change, and finds an unlikely disciple in a young boy. K. Viswanath's musical drama with J. V. Somayajulu.
woh-saat-din-1983: On their wedding night, a bride tells her husband she loves another man, and he sets out to reunite them. Anil Kapoor's first lead role in Hindi, with Padmini Kolhapure and Naseeruddin Shah.
sultanat-1986: An action adventure set in a desert kingdom, with Dharmendra, Sunny Deol, Sridevi and Juhi Chawla. Mukul S. Anand directs.
trikal-1985: A man returns to his family home in Goa and recalls the final days of Portuguese rule and the secrets of the household. Shyam Benegal directs Leela Naidu.
faasle-1985: A widowed father's overbearing love strains his relationship with his grown-up children. Yash Chopra directs Sunil Dutt and Rekha.
meri-jung-1985: A boy who watched his father wrongly hanged grows up to become a ruthless lawyer, out to beat the man responsible. Subhash Ghai directs Anil Kapoor and Nutan.
dance-dance-1987: A dance musical with Mithun Chakraborty, Smita Patil and Mandakini, directed by Babbar Subhash.
mohan-joshi-hazir-ho-1984: An elderly couple sue their landlord over a crumbling building and spend years trapped in the slow courts. Saeed Akhtar Mirza's satire.
prem-qaidi-1990: A rich girl and a poor young man fall in love, to her father's fury. Karisma Kapoor's debut.
teri-kasam-1982: A romantic drama with Kumar Gaurav and Poonam Dhillon, remade from the Tamil film Puguntha Veedu.
1921-1988: I. V. Sasi's war drama set during the Malabar rebellion of 1921, with Mammootty leading a large cast.
loha-1987: A tough police officer takes on a dangerous gang with help from convicts. Dharmendra and Shatrughan Sinha star.
new-delhi-times-1986: A newspaper editor investigating a political murder uncovers a web of power and corruption. Shashi Kapoor stars; Gulzar writes.
abodh-1984: A naive young bride struggles to adjust to married life. Madhuri Dixit's debut film.
swati-1986: A family drama built around a spirited young woman, with Meenakshi Sheshadri in the title role alongside Shashi Kapoor, Sharmila Tagore and Madhuri Dixit.
watan-ke-rakhwale-1987: An ensemble action thriller about defenders of the nation, with Sunil Dutt, Dharmendra, Mithun Chakraborty and Sridevi.
