jaag-utha-insan-1984: A young man in love with a temple priest's daughter faces caste prejudice in their village. K. Viswanath directs Mithun Chakraborty and Sridevi.
samundar-1986: A romantic action film set by the sea, directed by Rahul Rawail, with Sunny Deol and Poonam Dhillon.
jeevan-ek-sanghursh-1990: A Rahul Rawail drama with Anil Kapoor, Madhuri Dixit and Raakhee.
kanoon-apna-apna-1989: An upright district collector clashes with his hot-headed son, who believes in taking the law into his own hands. Dilip Kumar and Sanjay Dutt star.
palay-khan-1986: A Pathan outlaw on the frontier fights against oppression. Jackie Shroff plays the title role.
dillagi-1999: Two brothers fall for the same woman. Sunny Deol's directing debut, with Bobby Deol and Urmila Matondkar.
mrityudand-1997: In a feudal village in Bihar, women stand up to injustice and violence at home and in society. Prakash Jha directs Madhuri Dixit and Shabana Azmi.
aankhen-1993: Two lazy brothers get caught in a plot involving a lookalike of one of them. David Dhawan directs Govinda and Chunky Pandey.
hameshaa-1997: A love triangle spanning lifetimes, with reincarnation and a doomed romance. Saif Ali Khan, Kajol and Aditya Pancholi star.
bobbili-raja-1990: A young man raised in the forest falls in love with a girl and clashes with her family. Venkatesh and Divya Bharti star.
yaraana-1995: A woman escapes an abusive, controlling husband and finds love with a kind man, but her past follows her. Madhuri Dixit and Rishi Kapoor star.
saat-rang-ke-sapne-1997: Priyadarshan's Hindi remake of Thenmavin Kombath, a village romance with Arvind Swamy and Juhi Chawla.
aar-ya-paar-1997: A mystery thriller from Ketan Mehta in which a man is drawn into a dangerous web of crime. Jackie Shroff stars.
saajan-chale-sasural-1996: A singer who believes his village wife is dead marries again in the city, then discovers she is alive. Govinda, Karisma Kapoor and Tabu star.
taaqat-1995: Two powerful gangsters working for rival political parties clash. Dharmendra, Shatrughan Sinha and Kajol star.
rakshak-1996: A police officer takes on a dangerous criminal who threatens his family. Suniel Shetty and Karisma Kapoor star.
daag-the-fire-1999: An action thriller with Sanjay Dutt, Chandrachur Singh and Mahima Chaudhry, directed by Raj Kanwar.
anari-no-1-1995: A good-natured man is mistaken for a rich lookalike. Govinda plays a double role in this comedy.
taqdeerwala-1995: A man who dies too early is sent back to Earth with a magic book to put things right. Venkatesh and Raveena Tandon star.
azaad-desh-ke-gulam-1990: A family drama with Rishi Kapoor, Rekha and Jackie Shroff, remade from a Tamil film.
laadla-1994: A proud, domineering factory owner marries a gentle employee, and must learn humility. Sridevi and Anil Kapoor star.
angaar-1992: A former soldier is drawn into Mumbai's underworld as rival gangs fight for land. Jackie Shroff, Dimple Kapadia and Nana Patekar star.
baap-numbri-beta-dus-numbri-1990: A father and son, both small-time con men, try to outdo each other. Kader Khan and Shakti Kapoor star.
adhisaya-manithan-1990: A Tamil science-fiction slasher, sequel to Naalai Manithan.
20va-sathabdam-1990: A young man fights back against a corrupt and violent system. Suman stars.
baaghi-2000: Raja loves Rani, a nightclub dancer who finds him work as a security guard at a hotel. When tragedy strikes, he becomes a hired gun in a crime boss's gang, and a young boy grows up idolising him. Sanjay Dutt, Manisha Koirala and Aditya Pancholi star in this Hindi action drama, described as a remake of A Bronx Tale.
minnale-2001: A young man pretends to be his rival to win the woman they both love. Gautham Vasudev Menon's debut, with Madhavan.
muthu-1998: A loyal servant to a rich landlord falls for a stage actress, then learns his own true heritage. Rajinikanth and Meena star.
12b-2001: One morning, Shakthi chases a beautiful stranger, Jo, and misses his bus. The film then splits his life in two: in one version he catches the bus, lands a bank job and is pursued by a colleague, while in the other he misses it, and both paths keep leading back to Jo.
calcutta-mail-2003: Avinash arrives in Calcutta to search for his missing son, armed with only a single phone number. While he hunts through the city's underworld, he rooms with Bulbul, a chirpy novelist who falls for him, as flashbacks reveal how he lost his child. Sudhir Mishra's thriller, a remake of Choodalani Vundi, stars Anil Kapoor, Rani Mukerji and Manisha Koirala.
saaya-2003: Akash and Maya are doctors and a devoted married couple. When the pregnant Maya goes to help during an epidemic near the Burmese border, she is killed in a bus accident, but her body is never found. Unable to accept her death, Akash begins to sense that she is trying to reach him from beyond.
mujhe-kucch-kehna-hai-2001: A shy young man falls for a woman but can't find the courage to say so. Tusshar Kapoor's debut, with Kareena Kapoor.
janasheen-2003: Lucky, a carefree young man living in Australia, returns home after his father dies in what looks like an accident. As a powerful businessman eyes his father's land, Lucky is drawn into danger and a romance with Jessica, who knows the truth. Feroz Khan directs and stars with his son Fardeen Khan, and Celina Jaitly in her debut.
filhaal-2002: Rewa and Sia are best friends with very different dreams: Rewa longs for a family, while Sia guards her freedom. When Rewa learns she cannot carry a child, Sia offers to be her surrogate, a choice that tests both their friendship and their relationships. Meghna Gulzar's debut drama stars Tabu, Sushmita Sen, Sanjay Suri and Palash Sen.
dulhe-raja-1998: A street-food seller sets up a stall outside a hotel, sparking a feud with its owner and a romance with his daughter. Govinda and Raveena Tandon star.
shikari-2000: Vijayendra, the richest tycoon in Cape Town, takes on a new business partner, a spice magnate from India. The man is really Om Srivastav, who is hiding his true identity and has a far darker agenda in mind. Govinda plays against type in this crime thriller with Karisma Kapoor and Tabu.
vinashak-1998: An action film with Suniel Shetty and Raveena Tandon.
jungle-2000: Anu, her family and friends go on a safari in a forest, while her boyfriend Siddhu secretly tags along. When the bandit Durga Narayan Chaudhary and his gang take the group hostage, Siddhu, the only one left free, sets out to rescue them. Ram Gopal Varma's survival thriller stars Fardeen Khan, Urmila Matondkar and Sushant Singh.
bhopal-express-1999: A newly married couple's lives are upended by the gas leak in Bhopal in 1984. Kay Kay Menon and Nethra Raghuraman star.
gharwali-baharwali-1998: A man secretly takes a second wife, and chaos follows. Anil Kapoor, Raveena Tandon and Rambha star.
aapko-pehle-bhi-kahin-dekha-hai-2003: Sam, a successful businessman, is so devoted to his daughter Paakhi that he cannot bear the thought of her marrying and leaving home. When she falls for Samar, a suspended police officer chasing a criminal in Calgary, Sam is far from ready to accept him. Priyanshu Chatterjee and Sakshi Shivanand star in this Hindi comedy drama by Anubhav Sinha.
tarkieb-2000: Parts of a young woman's body are found in a creek, and after the local police mysteriously drop the case, it is handed to a sharp, unconventional CBI officer and his assistant. As they piece together the life of the victim, a girl from a poor family with big dreams, powerful people start to get nervous.
ghaath-2000: Krishna Patil dreams of becoming a police officer, but a local gangster and a corrupt cop wreck his chances and his faith in the system. With the support of a young lawyer who shares his disillusionment, he decides to fight back against the men who control the city.
kudrat-1998: A romantic action film with Akshaye Khanna and Urmila Matondkar.
naina-2005: Naina lost her sight as a child in an accident that killed her parents. Years later, a corneal transplant restores her vision, but she starts seeing terrifying visions of people about to die, and her search for the donor leads her to a village in Gujarat.
taj-mahal-an-eternal-love-story-2005: Prince Khurram, the future emperor Shah Jahan, falls in love with Arjumand Banu at a royal bazaar. Their romance must survive palace intrigue and power struggles, and after her death he builds the Taj Mahal in her memory. Akbar Khan's historical drama stars Kabir Bedi, Sonya Jehan, Manisha Koirala, Arbaaz Khan and Pooja Batra.
main-aisa-hi-hoon-2005: Neel, a man with an intellectual disability, works as a waiter in Shimla and lovingly raises his young daughter Gungun on his own. When her wealthy grandfather fights for custody, a lawyer agrees to help Neel prove he is a fit father. Harry Baweja's drama, inspired by I Am Sam, stars Ajay Devgn, Sushmita Sen and Esha Deol.
7-g-rainbow-colony-2004: Kadhir is an aimless young man from a lower-middle-class family who lives in a Chennai housing colony. He falls passionately in love with Anitha, a girl from a more well-off family who moves in nearby, and his obsessive pursuit slowly turns into a love that changes them both.
happy-2006: A young man rescues a girl from a forced marriage and is drawn into her troubles. Allu Arjun and Genelia star.
maine-dil-tujhko-diya-2002: Ajay, the leader of a college gang, falls for Ayesha, the daughter of a wealthy man. Her father disapproves of the poor young man and plots with his business partner to separate them, forcing Ajay to fight for his love. Sohail Khan directs and stars in this romantic action film, with Sameera Reddy in her debut and Sanjay Dutt.
tumsa-nahin-dekha-a-love-story-2004: Daksh, a wealthy young heir who is always drunk, falls in love with Jiya, a dancer who looks after her disabled brother. To inherit a fortune he is expected to marry another woman, and his loyal butler is the only one who encourages him to follow his heart.
elaan-2005: An overseas crime lord runs a ruthless extortion racket in India, and those who refuse to pay are killed. Five people, each hurt by his gang in a different way, band together with a daring plan to bring him down. Vikram Bhatt's action thriller stars Mithun Chakraborty, Arjun Rampal, Rahul Khanna, John Abraham, Ameesha Patel and Lara Dutta.
yamadonga-2007: Raja, a street-smart thief in Hyderabad, dies at the hands of a gang and finds himself in Yamaloka, the realm of the god of death. Instead of accepting his fate, he outwits Yama himself and tries to get back to Earth to save the girl he loves. S. S. Rajamouli's fantasy comedy stars Jr NTR, Mohan Babu, Priyamani and Mamta Mohandas.
humko-tumse-pyaar-hai-2006: Durga, a blind village girl with a gift for pottery, falls in love with Rohit, the young man who saves her life. After her mother is killed by a local goon, Rohit promises to help her see again, and fate takes their love story in unexpected directions. Bunty Soorma's romantic drama, a remake of Anuraga Sangama, stars Ameesha Patel, Bobby Deol and Arjun Rampal.
madhoshi-2004: Anupama never recovered after losing her sister in the September 11 attacks in New York. Years later, happily engaged to Arpit, who is away on business in America, she is wooed by a charming stranger named Aman, and is drawn into a dangerous web. Bipasha Basu, John Abraham and Priyanshu Chatterjee star in this Hindi psychological thriller.
banaras-2006: Shwetambari, the daughter of a wealthy Brahmin family in Varanasi, falls in love with Soham, a low-caste mystic singer. Their relationship scandalises the city and her orthodox family, and Shwetambari's search for answers after a devastating loss turns into a spiritual journey.
taarzan-the-wonder-car-2004: Deven, an automobile engineer, builds a futuristic car, but his design is stolen by a group of greedy businessmen who then kill him. Years later, his son Raj, now a mechanic, restores an old car that turns out to be possessed by his father's spirit, and the car seeks revenge. Abbas–Mustan's thriller stars Vatsal Sheth, Ayesha Takia and Ajay Devgn.
raqeeb-2007: Raqeeb is a 2007 Hindi romantic thriller directed by Anurag Singh, starring Sharman Joshi, Jimmy Shergill, Rahul Khanna and Tanushree Dutta. Remo, a simple-hearted multi-millionaire, meets Sophie through his mischievous half-brother and quickly marries her, but when her former boyfriend Sunny reappears, a dangerous scheme takes shape around Remo and his fortune.
1971-2007: Six years after the 1971 India–Pakistan war, a group of Indian prisoners of war are still held in a camp inside Pakistan, forgotten by both governments. Led by Major Suraj Singh, six of them plan a daring escape and attempt to cross hostile territory back to the Indian border.
main-madhuri-dixit-banna-chahti-hoon-200: Chutki, a small-town girl, worships Madhuri Dixit and dreams of becoming a film star like her. Her friend Raja marries her so she can chase that dream, and the two head to Mumbai, where they learn how hard the film industry can be. Chandan Arora's comedy drama stars Antara Mali and Rajpal Yadav.
sullan-2004: Sullan is a 2004 Tamil action film written and directed by Ramana, starring Dhanush with Sindhu Tolani, Manivannan and Pasupathy. Subramani, known as Sullan, is the fun-loving son of a garbage truck driver whose only aim in college is to have a good time, until a ruthless local moneylender starts targeting his family and friends.
life-mein-kabhie-kabhiee-2007: Five friends fresh out of college make a bet: in five years, whoever has found the most happiness wins. As they chase money, fame, love and ideals, their lives take very different turns. Vikram Bhatt's drama stars Aftab Shivdasani, Dino Morea, Sameer Dattani, Anjori Alagh and Nauheed Cyrusi.
supari-2003: Aryan, a small-town college student in Mumbai with big dreams, gambles away borrowed money and ends up in debt to a gangster. To pay it back, he and his friends start taking contract killing jobs, and soon they are in too deep to get out. Padam Kumar's crime drama stars Uday Chopra, Nandita Das, Rahul Dev and Irrfan Khan.
aksar-2006: A rich man hires a photographer to seduce his wife so he can divorce her. Dino Morea and Emraan Hashmi star.
unakkum-enakkum-2006: A city boy falls for a village girl and must prove himself to her brother. Ravi Mohan and Trisha star.
kanthaswamy-2009: Kanthaswamy, an officer in the CBI's economic offences wing, leads a secret double life: with his friends he grants the wishes of the needy, written as letters at a Murugan temple, dressed as a masked rooster-like vigilante. A raid that uncovers a tycoon's black money puts him on a collision course with powerful men. Vikram and Shriya Saran star.
mumbai-meri-jaan-2008: In the days after the 11 July 2006 train bombings in Mumbai, five very different people try to cope: a TV reporter, a commuter who survived, an angry unemployed man, a street coffee seller and two policemen. Nishikant Kamat's drama stars R. Madhavan, Irrfan Khan, Soha Ali Khan, Paresh Rawal and Kay Kay Menon.
sunday-2008: A woman who has lost a day of memory is caught up in a murder case. Ajay Devgn and Ayesha Takia star.
13b-2009: Manohar moves into a new flat, 13B, on the 13th floor with his large family. Strange things begin to happen: milk keeps curdling, his face appears distorted in photos, and the lift works for everyone but him. Then he discovers that a TV serial seems to be mirroring his family's life.
jannat-2008: Arjun is a street-smart young man obsessed with making quick money. To win over Zoya, the woman he loves, he becomes a cricket bookie and then gets drawn into match-fixing, but his wealth comes at the cost of his principles and the people closest to him.
mere-baap-pehle-aap-2008: Gaurav, a busy young businessman, treats his widowed father Janardhan almost like a child. When Janardhan meets his old college sweetheart again, Gaurav decides it is time for his father to find love, while finding his own with a spirited young woman. Priyadarshan's comedy drama stars Akshaye Khanna, Paresh Rawal, Genelia D'Souza and Shobana.
haal-e-dil-2008: On a train journey to Shimla, Shekhar, a painter, tries to woo Sanjana, only to learn that her heart still belongs to her former love, Rohit, whom she has lost. After a series of misadventures, Shekhar declares his love anyway. Nakuul Mehta, Adhyayan Suman and Amita Pathak star in this Hindi romance directed by Anil Devgan.
aa-dekhen-zara-2009: Ray Acharya is a down-on-his-luck photographer who inherits a camera from his scientist grandfather and finds that its pictures show the future. He uses it to win lotteries and bets, falls for a spirited DJ named Simi, and soon has a gangster and the security services chasing him for the device.
kal-kissne-dekha-2009: Nihal, a gadget-loving teenager from Chandigarh, gets into his dream science college in Mumbai and falls for Meesha, a proud classmate. Then he discovers that he can see glimpses of the future, a gift that soon draws him into danger. Jackky Bhagnani and Vaishali Desai make their debuts in this Hindi science fiction romance by Vivek Sharma.
raaz-the-mystery-continues-2009: Nandita, a model, is warned by a struggling artist whose paintings seem to predict her future. As the strange visions come true, she and the artist uncover a dark secret linked to a powerful figure. Mohit Suri's supernatural thriller stars Kangana Ranaut, Emraan Hashmi, Adhyayan Suman and Jackie Shroff.
arundhati-2009: Arundhati, a young woman from a royal family, returns to her ancestral home in Gadwal ahead of her wedding. Strange events lead her to a sealed tomb in an abandoned mansion, where she learns that she is the reincarnation of a queen who once defeated a depraved sorcerer, whose spirit now wants revenge.
kurbaan-2009: Avantika, a psychology professor, falls in love with Ehsaan, a charming fellow academic, and they marry and settle in the United States. Living in their new neighbourhood, she begins to suspect her husband's past is not what it seemed. Rensil D'Silva's romantic thriller stars Saif Ali Khan, Kareena Kapoor and Vivek Oberoi.
jhootha-hi-sahi-2010: Sid, a shy bookshop owner in London, accidentally becomes a helpline for depressed callers when his number is wrongly printed. He falls for Mishka, one of the callers, but must keep his identity secret since she knows him only as a voice. Abbas Tyrewala's romantic comedy stars John Abraham and Pakhi Tyrewala, with R. Madhavan.
toonpur-ka-superrhero-2010: Aditya, an action star who tells his son that cartoons are fake, is pulled into the animated world of Toonpur, where good toons are fighting evil ones. To save them and prove himself a real hero to his son, he must take on the villains. Kireet Khurana's live-action and animation film stars Ajay Devgn and Kajol.
love-sex-aur-dhokha-2010: Three linked stories, told through handheld cameras, CCTV and hidden lenses: a film student who elopes with a rich girl, a shop worker who plans to film his co-worker in secret, and a journalist trying to expose a pop star. Dibakar Banerjee's found-footage anthology stars Rajkummar Rao, Nushrat Bharucha, Anshuman Jha and Neha Chauhan.
mankatha-2011: Vinayak, a corrupt police officer suspended from the Maharashtra Police, learns that a huge sum of cricket betting money is being moved through Mumbai, and joins a gang of four men planning to steal it. Ajith Kumar stars in his 50th film, with Arjun Sarja, Trisha and Lakshmi Rai, in this Tamil heist thriller directed by Venkat Prabhu.
mujhse-fraaandship-karoge-2011: University students Vishal and Preity cannot stand each other, while their good-looking best friends, singer Rahul and fashion student Malvika, are the stars of the campus. A string of mistaken identities on social media gets all four tangled up in an unexpected romance. Saqib Saleem and Saba Azad make their debuts in this Hindi comedy by Nupur Asthana.
shaitan-2011: Amy, a troubled young woman, falls in with a gang of rich, reckless friends in Mumbai. One night of drunken driving leads to a fatal accident, and to cover it up, the friends stage a fake kidnapping that spirals out of control. Bejoy Nambiar's debut thriller stars Kalki Koechlin, Gulshan Devaiah, Rajeev Khandelwal and Rajkummar Rao.
varudu-2010: Sandy, a modern young man with traditional ideas about marriage, agrees to wed a girl chosen by his parents in a grand five-day ceremony, without seeing her beforehand. When the bride is kidnapped on the wedding day by a ruthless man obsessed with her, Sandy sets out to rescue her. Gunasekhar's action drama stars Allu Arjun, Arya and Bhanu Sri Mehra.
rakthacharithram-2010: Pratap Ravi, a young man in a violent rural district of Andhra Pradesh, sees his father and brother killed in a factional feud. He takes up arms for revenge and rises to become a feared leader and politician. Ram Gopal Varma's political thriller, based on the life of Paritala Ravi, stars Vivek Oberoi, Abhimanyu Singh and Radhika Apte.
tere-bin-laden-2010: Ali, a Karachi TV reporter desperate to emigrate to the US, finds a poultry farmer who looks exactly like Osama bin Laden. He decides to make a fake Osama video to sell to TV channels, setting off a chain of chaos. Abhishek Sharma's satirical comedy stars Ali Zafar in his Indian debut, with Pradhuman Singh.
zokkomon-2011: Kunal, an orphaned boy, is mistreated by his greedy uncle, who abandons him to grab his inheritance. Kunal returns disguised as Zokkomon, a mysterious superhero, to take on his uncle and help his village. Satyajit Bhatkal's Disney superhero film stars Darsheel Safary and Anupam Kher.
ameerin-aadhi-bhagavan-2013: Aadhi is a Bangkok-based gangster, rejected by his mother and sister for his life of crime. After pulling off a daring robbery in Hyderabad while posing as a CBI officer, he rescues a waitress named Karishma, and his dangerous world begins to close in. Ravi Mohan plays a dual role in this Tamil action film written and directed by Ameer.
sakthi-2011: Sakthi, a tour guide in Jaipur, meets Aishwarya, the daughter of a minister who is secretly the custodian of a powerful ancient gem. When enemies from Egypt come after the gem, Sakthi learns he has a role to play in its protection. Meher Ramesh's fantasy action film stars Jr NTR, Ileana D'Cruz and Jackie Shroff.
heroine-2012: Mahi Arora is a famous film actress whose career is slipping as she struggles with loneliness and a volatile temperament. Her stormy affair with a married superstar falls apart, and she tries desperate ways to stay at the top in an unforgiving film industry.
bhaiaji-superhit-2013: Bhaiaji is a feared crime lord in Varanasi with one weakness: his love for his fiery, jealous wife Sapna, who leaves him until he changes his ways. To win her back, he decides to make a film starring himself. Sunny Deol and Preity Zinta star, with Ameesha Patel and Arshad Warsi, in this Hindi action comedy by Neerraj Pathak.
anhe-ghore-da-daan-2011: In a village near Bathinda in Punjab, Dalit families who work the fields of an upper-caste landlord live with simmering anger and helplessness. When an old farmer's house is demolished to make way for industry, his son, a rickshaw puller in the city, faces his own struggle to survive.
miss-lovely-2012: In 1980s Mumbai, two brothers, Vicky and Sonu, make cheap, sleazy horror films for the underground circuit. When the younger brother falls for Pinky, a mysterious aspiring actress, he dreams of making a respectable film of his own. Ashim Ahluwalia's debut drama, which premiered at Cannes, stars Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Anil George.
shirin-farhad-ki-toh-nikal-padi-2012: Farhad, a 45-year-old Parsi bachelor who sells lingerie, still lives with his overbearing mother and grandmother. He finally meets Shirin, the woman of his dreams, but his mother turns against her when she discovers that Shirin is the official who had their illegal water tank demolished.
murder-3-2013: Vikram, a successful fashion photographer, is heartbroken when his girlfriend Roshni vanishes, leaving only a video saying she is leaving him. He soon falls for Nisha, who moves into his house, but strange things begin to happen there, and the police start to suspect Vikram.
bhoot-returns-2012: Tarun, an architect, moves into a luxurious bungalow with his wife and two children. Soon his six-year-old daughter Nimmi begins playing with an invisible friend she calls Shabbu, and strange events start to frighten the family. Ram Gopal Varma directs this Hindi 3D horror film starring Manisha Koirala and J. D. Chakravarthy.
aurangzeb-2013: A police officer discovers that his late father had a secret second family, and that a young man named Vishal is the identical twin of Ajay, the son of a powerful Gurgaon real estate baron. The police plant Vishal inside the family to bring down the empire, but loyalties soon blur.
fukrey-2013: Hunny and Choocha, two Delhi slackers, need money for college admission. Choocha has a gift for dreaming of lottery numbers, so they team up with two other friends and borrow from Bholi Punjaban, a fearsome local don, a plan that quickly goes off the rails. Mrighdeep Singh Lamba's comedy stars Pulkit Samrat, Varun Sharma, Ali Fazal and Richa Chadha.
ungli-2014: Four friends in Mumbai form the Ungli gang, a group of vigilantes who teach corrupt officials a lesson in unconventional and humiliating ways. As the media celebrates them, a senior police officer recruits a young rookie cop to infiltrate the gang.
kill-dil-2014: Two hitmen raised by a gangster want to leave crime when one falls in love. Ranveer Singh and Parineeti Chopra star.
monsoon-shootout-2013: A rookie cop faces a split-second choice that could change his life in three ways. Vijay Varma and Nawazuddin Siddiqui star.
creature-3d-2014: Ahana opens a boutique hotel deep in the forests of Himachal Pradesh, hoping for a fresh start. But a terrifying creature lurks in the woods around it, and soon her guests and staff are in grave danger. Bipasha Basu and Imran Abbas star in this Hindi 3D monster film directed by Vikram Bhatt.
hate-story-2-2014: A young woman, left for dead after crossing a powerful politician, survives and sets out to take revenge on him and everyone who helped him, while a police officer tries to understand what happened. Surveen Chawla, Jay Bhanushali and Sushant Singh star in this Hindi erotic thriller directed by Vishal Pandya, the sequel to Hate Story.
unfreedom-2014: Two parallel stories, one in New York and one in New Delhi: a man drawn into religious extremism takes a liberal scholar hostage, and a young woman in love with another woman faces the wrath of her conservative father, a police officer. Raj Amit Kumar's drama stars Victor Banerjee, Adil Hussain, Preeti Gupta and Bhavani Lee.
jigarthanda-2014: Karthik, an aspiring filmmaker, is told to make a realistic gangster movie to land a producer. He heads to Madurai to research the life of Assault Sethu, a feared local gangster, but things get dangerous when Sethu finds out. Karthik Subbaraj's gangster comedy stars Siddharth, Bobby Simha and Lakshmi Menon.
irudhi-suttru-2016: Prabhu, a gifted boxer whose career was wrecked by politics, is now a bitter coach at a national women's boxing academy. When he spots raw talent in Madhi, a fiery young fisherwoman, he sets out to turn her into a champion. Madhavan and Ritika Singh star in this sports drama by Sudha Kongara, shot in Tamil and Hindi.
main-meri-patni-aur-woh-2005: Mithilesh, a short, insecure man, cannot believe his luck when the beautiful Veena agrees to marry him. As their marriage goes on, his jealousy of every man around her keeps growing, and he becomes convinced she wants to leave him. Chandan Arora's comedy, inspired by Vadakkunokkiyantram, stars Rajpal Yadav, Rituparna Sengupta and Kay Kay Menon.
gauri-the-unborn-2007: Sudeep and Roshni live happily in suburban Mumbai with their young daughter Shivani. After a strange fall at school, the girl starts behaving oddly, and the family slowly realises an unseen presence connected to their past is trying to reach her. Akku Akbar's horror drama stars Atul Kulkarni and Rituparna Sengupta.
ek-se-badhkar-ek-2004: A lawyer reading The Godfather mistakenly writes a client's will so that the heir must be a criminal don to inherit billions. The heir, Rahul, wants nothing to do with crime, and his girlfriend is a police inspector. Suniel Shetty and Raveena Tandon star in this Hindi comedy directed by Kundan Shah.
arasu-2007: Arasu, the spoilt NRI heir of a business empire, falls for Shruthi, the daughter of his manager. She rejects him and challenges him to earn even 5,000 rupees a month on his own, so Arasu walks away from his wealth and starts from scratch to prove himself. Puneeth Rajkumar stars.
athisayan-2007: Devan, a gifted orphan raised by a television reporter, accidentally drinks a scientist's experimental potion and gains the ability to become invisible and transform into a powerful creature. Using his powers, the boy takes on a group of criminals who threaten the people he loves.
shock-2006: Sekhar and Madhu are a happily married couple expecting their first child. When two trigger-happy encounter cops mistake Sekhar for a Maoist, shoot him and frame him to cover their error, Sekhar sets out to clear his name and get even. Harish Shankar's debut action film stars Ravi Teja and Jyothika.
kerala-varma-pazhassi-raja-2009: In the late 1700s, Pazhassi Raja, a king of north Malabar, leads a guerrilla war against the East India Company when it takes over his land. With the help of tribal warriors and loyal followers, he holds out against the British. Hariharan's historical epic, written by M. T. Vasudevan Nair, stars Mammootty, Sarathkumar, Manoj K. Jayan and Kaniha.
peraanmai-2009: Duruvan, an NCC trainer looked down on by his superior because of his caste, takes five women cadets on a forest expedition. Deep in the jungle, they stumble on a foreign-backed plot to destroy an Indian satellite launch, and the small team must stop it themselves. S. P. Jhananathan's action adventure stars Jayam Ravi, Vasundhara and Dhansika.
hari-puttar-a-comedy-of-terrors-2008: Hari, a ten-year-old who has just moved from India to England, is accidentally left home alone with his cousin when his family goes on holiday. Two bumbling burglars break in to steal a secret formula created by Hari's father, and the kids fight back. Lucky Kohli and Rajesh Bajaj's family comedy stars Zain Khan, Saurabh Shukla and Vijay Raaz.
money-hai-toh-honey-hai-2008: Six struggling strangers, including a runaway, a bankrupt businessman, a fired copywriter and a would-be model, each receive a message saying they now jointly own a billionaire's company. Their joy is short-lived when they learn the company is drowning in debt.
ashta-chamma-2008: Lavanya, an obsessive fan of actor Mahesh Babu, insists that she will marry only a man named Mahesh. Her neighbour Anand finds her a suitable Mahesh, but a series of mistaken identities and lies spirals into chaos. An adaptation of Oscar Wilde's The Importance of Being Earnest.
little-zizou-2008: Xerxes, an eleven-year-old Parsi boy in Mumbai, is obsessed with football and dreams of meeting Zinedine Zidane. His father is a self-styled guardian of the faith, feuding with a free-thinking newspaper publisher, and the children of both families get caught in the middle. Sooni Taraporevala's comedy stars Boman Irani and Sohrab Ardeshir, and won a National Award.
sorry-bhai-2008: Siddharth, a shy scientist, travels to Mauritius with his parents for his elder brother's wedding. As he spends time with his brother's fiancée Aaliyah, the two fall in love, creating a tangle no one expected. Onir's romantic comedy stars Sharman Joshi, Chitrangada Singh, Sanjay Suri, Shabana Azmi and Boman Irani.
saleem-2009: Saleem is a 2009 Telugu romantic action comedy directed by Y. V. S. Chowdary, starring Vishnu Manchu, Ileana D'Cruz and Mohan Babu. Saleem turns up in a village fighting off thugs to protect Satya, the woman he loves, and his past as one of the world's most wanted gangsters, from Mexico to Switzerland to Miami, slowly comes to light.
barah-aana-2009: Shukla, a driver, Yadav, a watchman, and Aman, a waiter, share a cramped room in Mumbai and live on the margins of the city. When Yadav cannot raise money for his son's treatment, a desperate act sets the three friends on a path into crime.
aagey-se-right-2009: Dinkar, a timid Mumbai police sub-inspector who has never solved a case, loses his gun and is desperate to find it before anyone notices. Meanwhile, a terrorist sent to bomb the city falls in love with Mumbai and a bar dancer, and their paths cross in a comedy of errors.
maharathi-2008: Subhash, a down-on-his-luck man, saves a drunken millionaire from a car crash and is hired as his chauffeur. Soon he is caught in the middle of a deadly game between the millionaire, his scheming young wife and his lawyer, each with an eye on the fortune. Shivam Nair's thriller stars Paresh Rawal, Naseeruddin Shah, Neha Dhupia and Boman Irani.
99-2009: Set in 1999, two small-time Mumbai crooks who clone SIM cards crash a car belonging to a bookie and are forced to work for him to pay off the damage. Their job of recovering a debt in Delhi drags them into the world of cricket betting and a lot of trouble.
kick-2009: Kalyan is a brilliant, happy-go-lucky young man who does strange and dangerous things just for the thrill, or kick. He falls for Naina, who thinks he is crazy, while a determined police officer is hunting a mysterious thief. Ravi Teja, Ileana D'Cruz and Shaam star in this Telugu vigilante action comedy directed by Surender Reddy.
jail-2009: Parag, a young man with a happy life and a loving girlfriend, is falsely implicated in a drugs case and a police shooting. Thrown into an overcrowded prison while his bail is repeatedly denied, he must survive its harsh world and hold on to hope. Madhur Bhandarkar's prison drama stars Neil Nitin Mukesh, Mugdha Godse and Manoj Bajpayee.
sankat-city-2009: Sankat City is a 2009 Hindi black comedy directed by Pankaj Advani, starring Kay Kay Menon with Anupam Kher, Rimi Sen and Chunky Pandey. Two small-time car thieves steal a Mercedes without realising that it belongs to a vicious loan shark, or that a fortune in cash is inside, and they are soon forced to find a way to pay him back.
do-knot-disturb-2009: Raj, a wealthy businessman, is cheating on his wife Kiran with a supermodel. When a photo of them surfaces, he pays a hapless hotel bellboy to pretend he is the model's boyfriend, and the lie snowballs as Kiran hires a detective. David Dhawan's comedy stars Govinda, Riteish Deshmukh, Lara Dutta and Sushmita Sen.
vihir-2009: Vihir is a Marathi film directed by Umesh Vinayak Kulkarni, Amitabh Bachchan Corporation's first Marathi production, screened at the Berlin and Rotterdam film festivals. Cousins and best friends Sameer and Nachiket, two thoughtful teenagers who share their lives through letters, finally meet again at a family wedding in Nachiket's village.
chintu-ji-2009: Rishi Kapoor plays himself as an actor who decides to enter politics and returns to his neglected birth village to win support. The excited villagers believe he will bring them development, but they soon discover that the star's grand promises hide a very different plan.
do-paise-ki-dhoop-chaar-aane-ki-baarish-: Juhi, an ageing sex worker, struggles to care for her son Kaku, who uses a wheelchair. When Debu, a struggling lyricist thrown out by his boyfriend, stumbles into their lives, the three form an unlikely bond that slowly changes them all. Deepti Naval's directorial debut stars Manisha Koirala, Rajit Kapur and Sanaj Naval.
kutty-srank-2010: When an unidentified body washes ashore near Kodungallur, three women each claim to know the dead man, a boat captain called Kutty Srank. Their very different memories piece together a picture of who he was. Shaji N. Karun's art-house drama, which won the National Award for Best Feature Film, stars Mammootty.
kajraare-2010: Rajiv, haunted by his past, has moved to Jordan to work as a bartender when the eyes of a beautiful woman catch his attention. Soon a small-time singer's life collides with a bar dancer's, and they are caught up in a dangerous world of crime. Himesh Reshammiya and Sara Loren star in this Hindi romance directed by Pooja Bhatt.
goa-2010: Three restless young men from the conservative village of Pannaipuram keep trying to run away and see the world, and keep getting caught. When they finally escape, they head for Goa, hoping to find love and fortune with a foreign woman. Jai, Vaibhav and Premji star in this Tamil comedy written and directed by Venkat Prabhu, with Sneha and Piaa Bajpai.
vedam-2010: Five strangers from different walks of life, a slum cable operator, a rock musician, a sex worker, a poor weaver and a Muslim man facing prejudice, find their stories converging at a hospital in Hyderabad. Krish's hyperlink drama stars Allu Arjun, Manchu Manoj, Anushka Shetty and Manoj Bajpayee.
tum-mile-2009: On a flight to Mumbai, Akshay and Sanjana, former lovers who met in Cape Town, are thrown together again just as the city is hit by the devastating floods of July 2005. As they fight to survive the deluge, memories of their failed relationship come back. Kunal Deshmukh's romantic drama stars Emraan Hashmi and Soha Ali Khan.
radio-2009: Vivan, a popular radio jockey in Mumbai, is going through a divorce he does not want. When Shanaya, a cheerful new colleague, joins his show, she brings light back into his life, and his late-night radio show becomes a hit with listeners. Isshaan Trivedi's romantic comedy drama stars Himesh Reshammiya, Shenaz Treasurywala and Sonal Sehgal.
game-2011: A reclusive billionaire invites four strangers to his private Greek island, each lured by a personal offer. Once there, he accuses them all of a link to his daughter's death, and a game of revenge and suspicion begins. Abhinay Deo's thriller stars Abhishek Bachchan, Kangana Ranaut, Anupam Kher, Jimmy Sheirgill and Boman Irani.
aptharakshaka-2010: A cursed painting of the dancer Nagavalli finds its way into the home of a family preparing for celebrations, and strange, deadly events begin. Psychiatrist Dr Vijay is called in to investigate, and uncovers a story of revenge linked to the spirit he once confronted. Vishnuvardhan's 200th film and a sequel to Apthamitra.
no-problem-2010: No Problem is a 2010 Hindi action comedy directed by Anees Bazmee, with a large cast led by Anil Kapoor, Sanjay Dutt, Akshaye Khanna, Sushmita Sen and Paresh Rawal. Two bumbling crooks rob a bank and flee to Durban, leaving an innocent bank manager to take the blame, while a police officer follows them to South Africa.
jackie-2010: Jackie is a talkative school dropout who runs a flour mill with his mother in a village and dreams of making it big without hard work. Then he gets caught up with dangerous people and must stand up to those who wronged his family. Puneeth Rajkumar and Bhavana star in this Kannada action film directed by Duniya Soori.
well-done-abba-2009: Armaan, a driver in Mumbai, returns to his village near Hyderabad to find a groom for his daughter Muskaan. When he tries to get a well dug under a government scheme, he runs into a tangle of corruption and decides to fight back. Shyam Benegal's political satire stars Boman Irani, Minissha Lamba and Sameer Dattani.
the-hangman-2010: Shiva, an ageing executioner who was forced into his family's profession, wants a better life for his son Ganesh. When Ganesh moves to the city with the help of a jailor friend, father and son face a moral crossroads. Vishal Bhandari's drama stars Om Puri, Shreyas Talpade and Gulshan Grover.
dil-toh-baccha-hai-ji-2011: Three men in Mumbai look for the perfect love life: Naren, a bank manager in the middle of a divorce; Abhay, a smooth-talking gym trainer; and Milind, a hopeless romantic. Sharing a flat, each gets tangled in a messy romance. Madhur Bhandarkar's romantic comedy stars Ajay Devgn, Emraan Hashmi, Omi Vaidya and Shazahn Padamsee.
gaayam-2-2010: Ram runs a food court in Bangkok with his wife and son, far from his old life. When an attack on his restaurant makes the news in India, a gangster notices that Ram looks just like his old rival Durga, who was declared dead, and sets out to expose him. Jagapathi Babu stars in this Telugu crime sequel to Gaayam, presented by Ram Gopal Varma.
knock-out-2010: Bachubhai steps into a Mumbai phone booth and answers a ringing phone, only to find a sniper on the line threatening to kill him if he hangs up. The caller wants him to confess his crimes, and a tense standoff with the police follows. Mani Shankar's thriller, inspired by Phone Booth, stars Irrfan Khan, Sanjay Dutt and Kangana Ranaut.
cocktail-2010: Ravi Abraham, a successful executive, lives happily with his wife and daughter. One morning the couple give a lift to a stranger who soon turns menacing and begins to blackmail them, keeping them on edge through a long day. Arun Kumar Aravind's Malayalam thriller stars Anoop Menon, Samvrutha Sunil and Jayasurya.
ragini-mms-2011: Uday takes his girlfriend Ragini to a remote farmhouse for a weekend, secretly planning to film them with hidden cameras. But the house has a presence of its own, and the cameras capture far more than he intended. Pawan Kripalani's found-footage horror film stars Rajkummar Rao and Kainaz Motivala.
404-2011: At a medical college, room 404 is said to be haunted by a student who killed himself there. Abhimanyu, a rational new student, moves in, and after being pushed by seniors to learn about the dead boy, starts seeing visions, while his professor insists everything has a scientific explanation.
indian-rupee-2011: Jayaprakash, a school dropout and small-time property broker in Kozhikode, dreams of becoming rich fast. A chance deal involving an old man draws him into the world of quick money, and he learns what it can cost. Ranjith's satire on easy money stars Prithviraj Sukumaran, Thilakan, Rima Kallingal and Tini Tom.
my-friend-pinto-2011: Michael Pinto, a kind-hearted simpleton from a Goan village, decides to become a priest after his mother's death. Before joining the seminary, he visits a childhood friend in Mumbai on New Year's Eve, and gets swept into a wild night of misadventures. Prateik Babbar and Kalki Koechlin star in this Hindi musical comedy by Raaghav Dar.
aayirathil-oruvan-2010: In 1279, as the Pandyas drive out the Cholas, the Chola heir and his people vanish into hiding. Centuries later, when an archaeologist searching for them disappears, an expedition sets out to find him, joined by a porter named Muthu. Karthi, Reema Sen and Andrea Jeremiah star in Selvaraghavan's Tamil adventure.
toh-baat-pakki-2010: Toh Baat Pakki! is a 2010 Hindi romantic comedy directed by Kedar Shinde, starring Tabu, Sharman Joshi, Vatsal Sheth and Yuvika Chaudhary. Rajeshwari, a shrewd middle-class woman determined to find a rich, successful husband for her younger sister, offers a room in her house to a promising engineering student, only to change her mind when a better catch appears.
bumm-bumm-bole-2010: Pinu, a boy from a poor family, loses his little sister Rimzim's only pair of school shoes. Afraid to tell their struggling parents, the siblings secretly share his shoes, racing to swap them between classes, and Pinu pins his hopes on a race that offers shoes as a prize. Priyadarshan's family film, inspired by Children of Heaven, stars Darsheel Safary.
dunno-y-na-jaane-kyon-2010: Dunno Y... Na Jaane Kyon tells the love story of two men and the pressures of family and society that stand between them. Written by and starring Kapil Sharma, and directed by Sanjay Sharma, it premiered at India's first mainstream LGBTQ film festival, Kashish, with Zeenat Aman, Kabir Bedi and Helen in the cast.
ramaa-the-saviour-2010: Ramaa: The Saviour is a 2010 Hindi fantasy action adventure directed by Hadi Ali Abrar, starring Sahil Khan, Dalip Singh Rana (The Great Khali) and Tanushree Dutta. A group of youngsters win a new video game in a dance contest, and as soon as they start playing, they are pulled into the game and stranded on a dangerous prehistoric island.
yeh-saali-zindagi-2011: Arun, a chartered accountant working for a shady businessman in Delhi, is in love with Priti, a singer who loves someone else. When her fiancé is kidnapped in a gang feud, Arun gets pulled into a chaotic web of gangsters, politicians and betrayal to save them. Sudhir Mishra's crime thriller stars Irrfan Khan, Chitrangada Singh, Arunoday Singh and Aditi Rao Hydari.
oh-my-friend-2011: Oh My Friend is a 2011 Telugu drama marking Venu Sriram's debut as director, produced by Dil Raju and starring Siddharth, Shruti Haasan, Hansika and Navdeep. Chandu and Siri have been inseparable since childhood, and as he chases a music career against his father's wishes, the arrival of love starts to test their friendship.
khuda-kasam-2010: Hussain, an honest truck driver working for the state home minister, discovers that his boss is using the business to smuggle weapons. When he threatens to expose him, he is framed and jailed, while a CBI officer is assigned to investigate a related murder. Sunny Deol and Tabu star in this Hindi action drama directed by K. C. Bokadia.
ala-modalaindi-2011: Gautam, a heartbroken young man, meets Nithya at the wedding of the girl he loved, and the two become friends after a drunken night. When Nithya is about to marry a doctor, Gautam realises he loves her, and the story is told as he narrates it to a stranger who has kidnapped him.
shanghai-2012: In a small town being transformed by a huge business park project, a social activist is hit by a truck during a rally. A bureaucrat appointed to investigate, a local videographer and the activist's former student uncover a political conspiracy. Dibakar Banerjee's thriller, inspired by Z, stars Abhay Deol, Emraan Hashmi, Kalki Koechlin and Prosenjit Chatterjee.
osthe-2011: Velan, who has grown up resenting his stepfather and half-brother, becomes a swaggering police officer known as Osthe Velan. He clashes with a corrupt politician over a stash of bribe money and falls for a potter's daughter. Dharani's Tamil remake of Dabangg stars Silambarasan, Richa Gangopadhyay and Sonu Sood.
deiva-thirumagal-2011: Krishna, a man with an intellectual disability, raises his young daughter Nila alone after his wife dies in childbirth. When her wealthy maternal family takes the girl away, a young lawyer helps Krishna fight in court to bring her home. A. L. Vijay's moving legal drama stars Vikram, Sara Arjun and Anushka Shetty.
aazaan-2011: After a terror attack in Germany injures India's Home Minister with an unknown virus, army officer Aazaan Khan is brought in for questioning because his brother is a suspect. Sent undercover, Aazaan travels from country to country, joining the terrorists to track down the mastermind behind a biological attack.
panjaa-2011: Panjaa is a 2011 Telugu action thriller directed by Vishnuvardhan, starring Pawan Kalyan with Jackie Shroff, Sarah-Jane Dias and Adivi Sesh. Jai, a Kolkata hitman loyal to the don Bhagavan, also quietly runs a plant nursery, and his world is shaken when Bhagavan's volatile son returns to India after eight years away.
shadow-2013: Shadow is a 2013 Telugu action comedy thriller directed by Meher Ramesh, starring Venkatesh with Srikanth, Aditya Pancholi and Taapsee, and music by S. Thaman. Rajaram's father, an investigative journalist who infiltrated a crime lord's gang to collect evidence, is found out and killed, and his family destroyed, leaving Rajaram with a long-held score to settle.
maximum-2012: In 2003 Mumbai, two of the police force's top encounter specialists, Pundit and Inamdar, fight for control, killing each other's informers and dividing the force through a maze of politics, land deals and dirty money. Sonu Sood and Naseeruddin Shah star in this Hindi crime thriller written and directed by Kabeer Kaushik.
baadshah-2013: Baadshah is the son of Dhanraj, who runs casinos in Macau for a powerful crime lord who controls the Southeast Asian underworld. When a rival drug lord's son tries to seize the casino money, Baadshah steps in, and his path through the underworld begins. N. T. Rama Rao Jr. and Kajal Aggarwal star in this Telugu action comedy by Srinu Vaitla.
naayak-2013: Cherry, a carefree software engineer in Hyderabad, discovers he has a lookalike, Siddharth Naayak, a man hunted for killing a powerful Kolkata gangster's brother. As the two lives collide, Cherry learns about Naayak's fight against corruption. V. V. Vinayak's action comedy stars Ram Charan in a dual role, with Kajal Aggarwal and Amala Paul.
ethir-neechal-2013: Kunjithapadham has spent his life being mocked for his old-fashioned name. Desperate for a fresh start, he renames himself Harish, but the change brings new troubles, and he resolves to earn respect by running the Chennai Marathon with the help of an unlikely coach.
filmistaan-2012: Sunny, a film-crazy assistant director in Mumbai, joins an American crew shooting a documentary near the India-Pakistan border. When he is kidnapped by militants and held in a Pakistani village, he bonds with his captors over a shared love of Hindi films. Nitin Kakkar's comedy drama stars Sharib Hashmi and Inaamulhaq.
the-king-and-the-commissioner-2012: When a plot against the Prime Minister is uncovered, two legendary figures from earlier films team up: Joseph Alex, the fiery collector, and Bharathchandran, the tough police commissioner. Together they hunt for the conspirators in Delhi. Shaji Kailas's action thriller, written by Renji Panicker, stars Mammootty and Suresh Gopi.
irandam-ulagam-2013: Two love stories unfold at the same time in two different worlds: on Earth, medical student Ramya falls for Madhu, a mathematician caring for his father; and on a distant planet, a rough warrior meets a fierce young woman. Arya and Anushka Shetty play both couples in this Tamil fantasy romance by Selvaraghavan.
jannat-2-2012: Sonu, a street-smart small-time arms dealer in Delhi, is caught by a tough police officer and forced to become his informer on illegal arms rackets. When Sonu falls in love, he wants out, but the danger only grows. Emraan Hashmi, Randeep Hooda and Esha Gupta star in this Hindi crime thriller directed by Kunal Deshmukh.
raaz-3-the-third-dimension-2012: Shanaya, a fading film star, becomes consumed with jealousy of Sanjana, a new actress taking her place. She turns to black magic to destroy her rival, drawing her filmmaker boyfriend Aditya into a dark plan. Vikram Bhatt's 3D horror film stars Bipasha Basu, Emraan Hashmi and Esha Gupta.
samar-2013: Samar is a 2013 Tamil mystery action thriller written and directed by Thiru, starring Vishal, Trisha and Sunaina, with Manoj Bajpayee and J. D. Chakravarthy. Shakthi, a forest ranger, flies to Bangkok after his former girlfriend writes asking to reconcile, but soon after landing he is drawn into a baffling and dangerous game.
matru-ki-bijlee-ka-mandola-2013: Harry Mandola, a rich industrialist who turns into a kind man only when drunk, plans to turn his village's farms into a factory zone. His daughter Bijlee is set to marry a politician's son, while Matru, Harry's driver, secretly leads the farmers' resistance. Vishal Bhardwaj's satire stars Imran Khan, Anushka Sharma, Pankaj Kapur and Shabana Azmi.
hate-story-2012: Kavya, a journalist, and her friend pull off a sting operation exposing a company owned by the arrogant tycoon Siddharth. Bent on revenge, he offers her a job with a huge raise, and what follows is a dangerous game of betrayal and retaliation. Paoli Dam, Gulshan Devaiah and Nikhil Dwivedi star in this Hindi erotic thriller directed by Vivek Agnihotri.
chashme-baddoor-2013: Three carefree roommates in Goa all fall for Seema, a girl who has run away from yet another marriage her father arranged. While two of them brag and scheme, shy Sid quietly wins her heart, and his friends are not happy about it. David Dhawan's remake of the 1981 comedy stars Ali Zafar, Taapsee Pannu and Divyenndu.
jatt-and-juliet-2012: Fateh, a village boy desperate to settle in Canada, and Pooja, a modern city girl heading there to study fashion, meet at the passport office and keep clashing. Thrown together in Vancouver, the bickering pair slowly grow fond of each other. Anurag Singh's Punjabi romantic comedy stars Diljit Dosanjh and Neeru Bajwa.
ayalum-njanum-thammil-2012: Dr Ravi Tharakan is a renowned heart surgeon. When a young girl dies on his operating table, her family and local politicians turn on him, and as he flees the hospital he is hurt in an accident. Looking back, he recalls the mentor who shaped him. Prithviraj Sukumaran and Pratap Pothen star in this Malayalam medical drama by Lal Jose.
saheb-biwi-aur-gangster-returns-2013: Saheb, Biwi Aur Gangster Returns is a 2013 Hindi thriller written and directed by Tigmanshu Dhulia, the sequel to the 2011 film, starring Jimmy Shergill, Mahie Gill, Irrfan Khan and Soha Ali Khan. A crippled Aditya Pratap Singh fights to regain his power and pride after his wife's betrayal, as a proud prince with a grudge enters the game.
ragini-mms-2-2014: Ragini MMS 2 is a 2014 Hindi erotic horror thriller directed by Bhushan Patel and produced by Ekta Kapoor, starring Sunny Leone. A sleazy filmmaker cashes in on rumours about the haunted house from the first film by shooting a movie there, and as his cast and crew move in, the presence that haunted the house begins to stir again.
aatma-2013: Maya, a divorced mother, has hidden from her young daughter Nia that her abusive father is dead. When Nia starts talking to her father and people who upset her begin dying, Maya realises that her husband's spirit has returned and wants to take their daughter away.
b-a-pass-2013: After his parents die, Mukesh, a teenager who has just finished school, is sent to live with an unwelcoming aunt in Delhi while his sisters are placed in an orphanage. Short of money and lonely, he is drawn into a dangerous relationship with an older woman. Shadab Kamal and Shilpa Shukla star in this Hindi noir thriller by Ajay Bahl.
issaq-2013: In Varanasi, two powerful land-mafia families, the Kashyaps and the Mishras, are locked in a bloody feud. When a young man and woman from the rival families fall in love, they are caught in the crossfire. Prateik Babbar and Amyra Dastur star in this Hindi romance directed by Manish Tiwary, inspired by Romeo and Juliet.
lucia-2013: Nikki, a lonely cinema usher in Bangalore who suffers from insomnia, starts taking a mysterious pill that lets him dream the life he wants, in which he is a famous film star. As his dreams and reality begin to blur, a detective investigates why he has ended up in a coma.
mythri-2015: Siddarama, a clever ten-year-old living in a slum with his mother, lands in a juvenile lockup after a prank, and the local criminal who helps free him has dangerous designs on his mother. The boy's story becomes entwined with his film-star idol. Puneeth Rajkumar and Mohanlal appear in this Kannada and Malayalam social drama directed by B. M. Giriraj.
thira-2013: Thira is a 2013 Malayalam neo-noir action thriller directed by Vineeth Sreenivasan, starring Shobana and debutant Dhyan Sreenivasan. Dr. Rohini, a cardiac surgeon who shelters rescued girls in a home she runs, is framed for trafficking after the girls are abducted by a ring operating across Karnataka and Goa, and she teams up with a young man searching for his own sister.
yennai-arindhaal-2015: Sathyadev, a police officer with a violent past, meets Thenmozhi on a flight and saves her from a gang that is after her. The case brings him face to face with Victor, a ruthless gangster from his past, and memories of the life he lost. Gautham Vasudev Menon's action thriller stars Ajith Kumar, Trisha, Anushka Shetty and Arun Vijay.
dirty-politics-2015: Inspired by a real case from Rajasthan, this Hindi political thriller follows the relationship between a powerful politician and a young auxiliary nurse, and the scandal, power games and cover-ups that follow when she suddenly disappears. Mallika Sherawat, Om Puri and Ashutosh Rana lead the ensemble in the film written and directed by K. C. Bokadia.
legend-2014: Krishna comes home from Dubai to get married and clashes with Jitendra, a ruthless man with political ambitions. As the feud turns violent and threatens his family, a fearless elder of the family, Jaidev, steps in to protect them. Boyapati Srinu's action drama stars Nandamuri Balakrishna in a dual role, with Jagapathi Babu, Sonal Chauhan and Radhika Apte.
1-by-two-2014: Hari and Ravi are identical twins who share an unusually deep emotional bond. When Hari dies in an accident, Ravi slips into a disturbing state of psychosis, and Yusuf, a police officer, sets out to unravel the mystery behind what really happened in this Malayalam psychological thriller.
zid-2014: Ronnie, a crime reporter in Goa still nursing a break-up, rents a lonely outhouse on a remote property owned by a paralysed old man. The owner's daughter Maya falls obsessively in love with him, and her fixation soon takes a dangerous turn.
iraivi-2016: Three men, a director whose film has been shelved, his loyal friend, and a hot-headed sculptor, let their anger and ego shape the lives of the women around them. When a plan to steal and sell old idols goes wrong, everyone pays a price. Karthik Subbaraj's crime drama stars S. J. Suryah, Vijay Sethupathi, Bobby Simha, Kamalinee Mukherjee and Anjali.
phir-se-2015: A man and a woman, both separated from their spouses and living in London, are each trying to come to terms with the end of their marriages. As they find comfort in each other's company, they wonder whether they are ready to love again. Kunal Kohli and Jennifer Winget star in this romantic drama.
bruce-lee-the-fighter-2015: Karthik gives up his own education so his sister Kavya can study to become a collector. Years later he works as a stuntman, but to keep up appearances and help his family, he pretends to be a police officer, which drags him into real danger. Ram Charan and Rakul Preet Singh star in this Telugu action comedy by Srinu Vaitla.
rani-padmini-2015: Padmini, a traditional young wife, travels to Manali to resolve a crisis with her husband, a car rally driver. On the way she meets Rani, a tomboyish woman on the run from a dangerous criminal, and the two set off on an eventful journey through the Himalayas together.
aranmanai-2-2016: When a temple's protective idol is moved during renovations, a group of tantric practitioners accidentally release a powerful evil spirit, which settles in a village palace and its family. Directed by Sundar C, this second film in the Aranmanai horror comedy series stars Sundar C, Siddharth, Trisha Krishnan, Hansika Motwani and Poonam Bajwa.
do-lafzon-ki-kahani-2016: Suraj, a former boxer haunted by his past, lives a lonely life in Kuala Lumpur taking any job he can. While working as a parking attendant he meets Jenny, a cheerful blind woman, and as they fall in love he resolves to help her regain her sight.
great-grand-masti-2016: Amar, Meet and Prem are unhappily married, each frustrated by his in-laws. Hoping for a break, they head to Amar's old family house in a village, only to find it is haunted by a ghost with plans of her own. Riteish Deshmukh, Vivek Oberoi, Aftab Shivdasani and Urvashi Rautela star in the third Masti film, directed by Indra Kumar.
kadhalum-kadandhu-pogum-2016: Yazhini, an engineering graduate who moved to Chennai against her parents' wishes, loses her job and moves into a cheap housing colony. Her neighbour Kathir, a small-time gangster who dreams of owning a bar, becomes an unlikely friend. Nalan Kumarasamy's romantic comedy, a remake of the Korean film My Dear Desperado, stars Vijay Sethupathi and Madonna Sebastian.
teraa-surroor-2016: Teraa Surroor is a 2016 Hindi romantic action thriller directed by Shawn Arranha, the sequel to Aap Kaa Surroor, starring Himesh Reshammiya and Farah Karimaee with Naseeruddin Shah and Shekhar Kapur. Raghu, a businessman with a gangster's reputation, learns that Tara, the singer he loves, has been jailed in Ireland, and sets out to get her free.
bogan-2016: Vikram, an honest police officer in Chennai, is assigned to track down Aadhithya, the son of a former royal who has grown mysteriously rich through a string of daring jewel thefts. What Vikram does not know is the strange secret behind those crimes. Ravi Mohan and Arvind Swamy star in this Tamil supernatural thriller by Lakshman.
ism-2016: Javed, a gangster whose scams have been exposed in India, is hiding on Tenerife with his daughter Alia. A mysterious young man falls for her and befriends Javed, though neither reveals who he really is. Kalyan Ram, Aditi Arya and Jagapati Babu star in this Telugu vigilante action film directed by Puri Jagannadh.
freaky-ali-2016: Ali, a poor young man who sells clothes and collects debts in Mumbai, turns out to have an unexpected natural gift for golf. With his friend Maqsood's help, he enters the posh world of the sport, where the rich players are not keen to welcome him. Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Arbaaz Khan and Amy Jackson star in this Hindi sports comedy by Sohail Khan.
pal-pal-dil-ke-paas-2019: A young woman falls for her mountain guide. Karan Deol's debut, directed by his father Sunny Deol.
middle-class-abbayi-2017: A young man protects his sister-in-law from a corrupt politician. Nani stars.
hello-2017: As children, Seenu, a street musician, and Junnu, a quirky girl, become close friends in Hyderabad, until they are separated. Years later, Seenu, now grown up, has never stopped hoping to find her again. Akhil Akkineni and Kalyani Priyadarshan, in her debut, star in this Telugu romantic action film directed by Vikram Kumar.
blackmail-2018: Dev, a toilet-paper salesman stuck in a dull job and a cold marriage, comes home early one day and finds his wife with another man. Instead of confronting them, he decides to blackmail her lover, setting off a chain of blackmail that keeps spiralling. Abhinay Deo's black comedy stars Irrfan Khan, Kirti Kulhari and Divya Dutta.
pataakha-2018: Badki and Chhutki are two sisters in a Rajasthani village who have fought bitterly with each other since childhood, over everything from stolen beedis to torn clothes. A meddling neighbour keeps stoking their battles while their long-suffering father tries to keep the peace, even after marriage.
bhavesh-joshi-superhero-2018: Bhavesh, Siku and Rajat are friends who start an online show exposing small-scale corruption in Mumbai, wearing paper-bag masks as amateur vigilantes. As the others drift away, Bhavesh becomes consumed by the mission, and his discovery of a racket stealing the city's water puts his life in danger.
1945-2022: A war drama set in 1945 with Rana Daggubati.
my-birthday-song-2018: Rajiv, a married man, spends his 40th birthday with a stranger who dies in an accident at his home. He wakes the next morning to find it was a dream, but the day starts repeating eerily, and he cannot tell what is real. Samir Soni's psychological thriller stars Sanjay Suri and Nora Fatehi.
bucket-list-2018: Madhura is a devoted housewife whose whole life revolves around her family. After a heart transplant, she tracks down the family of her donor, a lively 20-year-old named Sai, and decides to complete the list of things Sai never got to do, changing her own life along the way.
aravinda-sametha-veera-raghava-2018: Veera Raghava returns from London to his village in Rayalaseema, which has been locked in a bloody 30-year feud with a neighbouring village. After his father is killed in an ambush, he decides to end the violence instead of avenging it, guided by Aravinda, a woman researching the factional wars.
qismat-2018: Shiva, a carefree village boy who has failed his exams twice, moves to Chandigarh for college and becomes close to his confident neighbour Bani when she asks him to pose as her fake boyfriend. Their friendship deepens into love, but her strict father and fate have other plans.
kaadan-2018: Veera, a man of the forest, has spent his life protecting the elephants and the woodland of his home. When a powerful minister plans a township that will cut off the elephants' path, he takes on the might of the state to save them. Prabhu Solomon's adventure drama, made in Tamil, Telugu and Hindi, stars Rana Daggubati, Vishnu Vishal and Pulkit Samrat.
gayatri-2018: A Telugu action drama with Mohan Babu.
comali-2019: A man wakes from a coma after 16 years and struggles to adapt. Ravi Mohan stars.
mr-majnu-2019: A playboy falls for a woman who wants loyalty. Akhil Akkineni stars.
khaali-peeli-2020: A taxi driver picks up a woman with a bag of money. Ishaan Khatter and Ananya Panday star.
attack-part-1-2020: An injured soldier becomes a super-soldier with an AI chip. John Abraham stars.
sufna-2020: A farmhand falls for a girl working the cotton fields. Ammy Virk stars.
ayyappanum-koshiyum-2020: A police officer and a retired soldier clash over a minor arrest. Prithviraj and Biju Menon star.
ponmagal-vandhal-2020: A lawyer reopens a case about a serial killer. Jyothika stars.
viduthalai-part-1-2023: A police constable is drawn into a manhunt for a rebel leader. Vetrimaaran directs Soori and Vijay Sethupathi.

shabaash-mithu-2022: A biopic of cricketer Mithali Raj. Taapsee Pannu stars.

72-hoorain-2023: A drama about two men who carry out a terror attack after being promised a reward in paradise.

vikrant-rona-2022: A police inspector investigates mysterious deaths in a village. Kichcha Sudeepa stars.
hridayam-2022: A young man grows up through college love, heartbreak and adulthood. Pranav Mohanlal stars.
dobaaraa-2022: A woman connects across time with a boy who died 25 years ago. Taapsee Pannu stars.
jaadugar-2022: A small-town magician joins a football team to win a girl. Jitendra Kumar stars.
monica-o-my-darling-2022: A robotics engineer is drawn into a murder plot. Rajkummar Rao and Huma Qureshi star.
chandramukhi-2-2023: A family moves into a haunted palace. Raghava Lawrence and Kangana Ranaut star.
qala-2022: A young singer struggles for her mother's love and approval. Tripti Dimri stars.
japan-2023: A notorious thief is hunted by police. Karthi stars.
yaariyan-2-2023: Three cousins navigate love and family. Divya Khosla Kumar stars.
baipan-bhari-deva-2023: Six estranged sisters reunite for a folk-dance competition. Kedar Shinde directs.
bawaal-2023: A schoolteacher takes his wife on a trip to Europe to retrace the Second World War. Varun Dhawan and Janhvi Kapoor star.
aankh-micholi-2023: A family hides each member's flaws to arrange a wedding. Paresh Rawal stars.
dhak-dhak-2023: Four women ride bikes to Khardung La. Fatima Sana Shaikh and Ratna Pathak Shah star.
pippa-2023: Captain Balram Singh Mehta's role in the 1971 war. Ishaan Khatter stars.
lucky-baskhar-2024: A bank cashier in 1980s Bombay takes a dangerous gamble. Dulquer Salmaan stars.
dhadak-2-2025: A Dalit law student and an upper-caste classmate fall in love. Siddhant Chaturvedi and Triptii Dimri star.
mrs-2025: A newly married woman is worn down by the endless kitchen work her husband's family expects. Sanya Malhotra stars.
the-diplomat-2025: A diplomat helps an Indian woman escape from Pakistan. John Abraham stars.
mirai-2025: A young man must protect ancient scriptures from a dark force. Teja Sajja stars.
sachaa-jhutha-1970: A village simpleton is mistaken for his lookalike, a jewel thief. Rajesh Khanna plays both.
humjoli-1970: A romantic drama with Jeetendra and Leena Chandavarkar.
jahan-pyar-miley-1970: A romance with Shashi Kapoor and Hema Malini.
tum-haseen-main-jawaan-1970: A romance with Dharmendra and Hema Malini.
gopi-1970: A simple servant devoted to his brother faces hard choices. Dilip Kumar and Saira Banu star.
tere-mere-sapne-1971: A young doctor and his wife are tested by the lure of wealth. Dev Anand and Mumtaz star.

pardesi-1970: A drama with Biswajeet and Mumtaz.
pehchan-1970: A simple-hearted man arrives in the city and must adapt. Manoj Kumar and Babita star.
insaan-aur-shaitan-1970: An action film with Sanjeev Kumar.
jaane-anjaane-1971: A drama with Shammi Kapoor and Vinod Khanna.
hungama-1971: A comedy with Kishore Kumar, Vinod Khanna and Zeenat Aman.
gambler-1971: A gambler is drawn into crime. Dev Anand stars.
hulchul-1971: A comedy thriller with O. P. Ralhan and Zeenat Aman.
anubhavangal-paalichakal-1971: A factory worker's rise in a trade union in Kerala. Sathyan stars.

love-insurance-kompany-2025: A science-fiction romantic comedy directed by Vignesh Shivan.
bangaarada-manushya-1972: A man devotes his life to his family and village. Rajkumar stars.
khote-sikkay-1973: A group of misfits defend a village from bandits. Feroz Khan stars.
manchali-1973: A spirited woman marries for convenience and falls in love. Sanjeev Kumar and Leena Chandavarkar star.
prem-parbat-1973: A love story in the hills. Rehana Sultan stars.
aankhon-aankhon-mein-1972: A romance with Rakesh Roshan and Raakhee.
