haasil-2003: At Allahabad University, Aniruddh falls for Niharika, but student politics pulls him in. As he grows close to Ranvijay, a ruthless student leader, he is drawn into violence that threatens his romance and his future. Tigmanshu Dhulia's crime drama stars Jimmy Sheirgill, Hrishitaa Bhatt, Ashutosh Rana and Irrfan Khan, who won a Filmfare award for the role.
aaghaaz-2000: Govind, an honest and chivalrous man from a small village in Punjab, loves Sudha but marries his mentor's daughter to save her from public shame. The marriage brings him nothing but trouble. Sunil Shetty and Sushmita Sen star in this Hindi action thriller directed by Yogesh Ishwar, a remake of the Telugu film Sivayya.
police-force-an-inside-story-2004: Police Force: An Inside Story is a 2004 Hindi action film directed by Dilip Shukla, starring Akshay Kumar, Raveena Tandon and Amrish Puri. A police academy trainer prepares a batch of promising recruits for senior roles, but nothing in their training readies them for the corrupt officers and politicians with gangster links they meet once they join the force.
khwahish-2003: Amar, a rich and stubborn young man, meets Lekha, the cheerful, frank daughter of a poultry farmer, and the two fall in love at college. Her father happily accepts the match, but Amar's wealthy politician father has other plans. Himanshu Malik and Mallika Sherawat star in this Hindi romance directed by Govind Menon.
aamdani-atthanni-kharcha-rupaiya-2001: Three bickering couples in a Mumbai neighbourhood are running out of money. When their wives secretly take jobs to pay the rent, the proud husbands throw them out, and the men soon discover how little they can manage on their own, with a wise neighbour couple caught in between.
samay-when-time-strikes-2003: Samay: When Time Strikes is a 2003 Hindi thriller directed by Robbie Grewal, starring Sushmita Sen and Sushant Singh. ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed police officer raising a young daughter, takes on the murder of a businessman that leaves no clues, and when a famous actress is killed soon after, she suspects a serial killer is at work.
baaz-a-bird-in-danger-2003: A child is born with a strange disorder that makes him want to destroy whatever fascinates him. Seventeen years later in Nainital, Neha, an interior designer from Delhi, takes on a job for the town's mayor, and finds herself in danger. Suniel Shetty, Karisma Kapoor, Jackie Shroff and Dino Morea star in this Hindi psychological thriller by Tinnu Verma.
pyaar-mein-twist-2005: Yash, a widowed auto tycoon who has just retired, falls for a widowed fashion designer. Their late-life romance runs into trouble when their grown children, who are not keen on the match, find themselves caught up in their own love lives. Hriday Shetty's romantic comedy stars Rishi Kapoor and Dimple Kapadia.
julie-2004: Tara, a well-known news anchor, interviews a woman named Julie who claims a prominent businessman wants to marry her. Julie tells her story: once a simple girl from Goa working in her father's bakery, she was let down by the man she loved, and her life took a very different path. Neha Dhupia stars in this Hindi drama by Deepak Shivdasani.
dum-2003: A young man who wants to join the police takes on a corrupt officer. Vivek Oberoi and Diya Mirza star.
hawa-2003: Sanjana, a divorcee who runs her stepfather's antique shop, moves into a house in the hills because she cannot afford one in the city. Soon after she sells an old locket given to her by a stranger, strange occurrences begin, and she is tormented by an invisible force. Tabu stars in this Hindi horror film directed by Guddu Dhanoa.
akhiyon-se-goli-maare-2002: Bhangari Dada, who runs an illegal shop in Chor Bazaar, is determined to marry his daughter Kiran to a real gangster. Kiran loves Raj, a wealthy man with no links to crime, so she convinces him to pretend to be a hoodlum. Govinda and Raveena Tandon star in this Hindi comedy directed by Harmesh Malhotra.
kehtaa-hai-dil-baar-baar-2002: Roger Patel is a self-made, arrogant Gujarati real estate magnate in New York who started out cleaning toilets and now thinks he owns the world. When his daughter falls in love with a young man he does not approve of, the clash of wills begins. Paresh Rawal, Jimmy Sheirgill and Kim Sharma star in this Hindi romance directed by Rahul Dholakia.
rog-2005: Uday Rathod, a brilliant but troubled police officer, is assigned to solve the murder of a famous model, Maya Solomon, within a week. As he questions the suspects and pores over her life, he finds himself becoming obsessed with the dead woman.
vaada-2005: A blind man regains his sight but his best friend has married his love. Arjun Rampal and Amisha Patel star.
zeher-2005: Siddharth, the police chief of a small town in Goa, is going through a divorce from the wife he still loves when he gets involved with Anna, a married woman with an abusive husband. When Anna and her husband are found dead, Siddharth has to solve the case before the evidence points to him.
pyare-mohan-2006: Pyare, who is blind, and Mohan, who is deaf, are best friends and former stuntmen. When they fall for two sisters and become the only witnesses to a crime, they find themselves hunted by a gang. Indra Kumar's comedy, inspired by See No Evil, Hear No Evil, stars Fardeen Khan, Vivek Oberoi, Esha Deol and Amrita Rao.
good-boy-bad-boy-2007: Rajan is a brilliant but shy student and Raju is a carefree slacker who excels at everything except studies. When a strict new principal sorts the college's students by marks, the two swap sections, and each has to survive in the other's world.
corporate-2006: Two rival food-and-beverage empires fight to win a lucrative deal. Nishi, a sharp vice-president at one firm, is drawn into the boardroom battle along with her partner, and finds that corporate loyalty can come at a heavy personal price. Madhur Bhandarkar's drama stars Bipasha Basu, Kay Kay Menon and Raj Babbar.
chingaari-2006: Based on Bhupen Hazarika's novel The Prostitute and the Postman, the film is set in a village where Basanti, a sex worker with a young daughter, longs for a better life. A kind new postman falls in love with her, but the village's cruel and powerful priest has other plans.
dil-diya-hai-2006: Desperate for money for his mother's treatment, a young man betrays the woman who loves him and lets her fall into the hands of traffickers. Later, overcome with guilt, he sets out to rescue her. Emraan Hashmi, Geeta Basra, Ashmit Patel and Mithun Chakraborty star in this Hindi romantic thriller directed by Aditya Datt.
aadavari-matalaku-arthale-verule-2007: Ganesh, a jobless young man constantly criticised by his father, falls in love at first sight with Keerthi and manages to get a job at her company. She is short-tempered and seems uninterested, but a business trip brings them closer and reveals a reason for her coldness.
deadline-sirf-24-ghante-2006: Heart surgeon Viren and his wife Sanjana live happily in Mumbai with their young daughter. While Viren travels to Delhi to receive an award, the girl is kidnapped and Sanjana is held hostage at home, with only 24 hours to save her. Tanveer Khan's thriller, adapted from Trapped, stars Konkona Sen Sharma, Irrfan Khan and Rajit Kapur.
lakeer-forbidden-lines-2004: Karan and Bindiya grew up together in the home of Karan's adoptive brother Arjun, now a powerful and wealthy gangster. When love and loyalty start pulling the three in different directions, a dangerous rivalry is born. Sunny Deol, Suniel Shetty, John Abraham and Nauheed Cyrusi star in this Hindi action thriller, Ahmed Khan's directing debut.
kyaa-kool-hain-hum-2005: Rahul and Karan, two best friends who think they are irresistible, are evicted from their flat and land in a string of misadventures while trying to find girlfriends. A mix-up with a murder case and a crime boss makes things worse. Sangeeth Sivan's adult comedy stars Tusshar Kapoor, Riteish Deshmukh, Neha Dhupia and Isha Koppikar.
hattrick-2007: Three intertwined stories play out around the cricket World Cup: a cricket-mad husband whose obsession tests his marriage, a gruff hospital doctor who has no time for the game, and a patient whose love for cricket runs deep. Milan Luthria's comedy drama stars Nana Patekar, Paresh Rawal, Kunal Kapoor, Rimi Sen and Danny Denzongpa.
dhol-2007: Four lazy friends in Pune keep looking for a shortcut to riches. When they try to woo a young woman they think is wealthy, they stumble onto a murder mystery tied to her missing brother, and must dodge the killers. Priyadarshan's comedy thriller stars Rajpal Yadav, Tusshar Kapoor, Sharman Joshi and Kunal Khemu.
chocolate-2005: After a boat explosion and a daring armoured-van robbery in London, two Indian men are arrested on suspicion of terror links. A crime journalist persuades a top lawyer to defend them, and as he digs into their story, the truth turns out to be far from simple. Vivek Agnihotri's thriller stars Anil Kapoor, Suniel Shetty, Irrfan Khan and Emraan Hashmi.
aa-naluguru-2004: After his death, Raghuram, a selfless newspaper editor who always put others first, watches his own funeral and is shocked by his family's indifference. Looking back on his life, he recalls how his generosity frustrated his children, and how the people he helped now come to honour him.
my-wife-s-murder-2005: Ravi, a film editor under pressure, accidentally kills his wife Sheela during a heated argument. In panic, he hides her body, and a sharp police inspector begins investigating her disappearance. Jijy Philip's thriller, a remake of Madhyanam Hathya, stars Anil Kapoor, Boman Irani, Suchitra Krishnamurthi and Nandana Sen.
vaastu-shastra-2004: Jhilmil and Virag, a busy doctor couple, move with their young son into a house on the outskirts of Mumbai. Soon the boy starts talking to imaginary friends, and the family finds the house and an old tree beside it hold a dark presence. Saurabh Usha Narang's horror film stars Sushmita Sen and J. D. Chakravarthy.
jaago-2004: A young girl is assaulted, and her father and a police officer seek justice. Manoj Bajpayee and Raveena Tandon star.
hatya-2004: Ravi, the son of a wealthy man, is badly injured when a greedy businessman's men murder his father in front of him. After he recovers, his new wife Kavita notices that he has changed and begins to suspect that something strange has taken hold of him. Kader Kashmiri's fantasy thriller stars Akshay Kumar and Varsha Usgaonkar.
zindaggi-rocks-2006: Suraj, a quiet doctor, falls for Kriya, a lively pop star who has an adopted son. When the boy falls seriously ill, their love and Kriya's strength are put to the test. Tanuja Chandra's musical romance stars Sushmita Sen and Shiney Ahuja.
the-killer-2006: Nikhil, a taxi driver in Dubai, unknowingly picks up a hitman who forces him to drive around the city while he kills witnesses against a gangster. As the police mistake Nikhil for the killer, he must find a way to stop the night's murders. Hasnain Hyderabadwala and Raksha Mistry's thriller, inspired by Collateral, stars Irrfan Khan and Emraan Hashmi.
pournami-2006: In a village in Andhra Pradesh, a girl from one family must perform a sacred dance in the temple every twelve years to bring rain. In 1963, as the festival approaches, the chosen dancer Pournami disappears, and a mysterious young man named Siva arrives to teach her younger sister.
yun-hota-toh-kya-hota-2006: Four intertwining stories follow people from different walks of life who all end up linked to the flights hijacked on 11 September 2001. Their journeys, from India to the United States, bring them closer to that fateful day. Naseeruddin Shah's directorial debut stars Konkona Sen Sharma, Irrfan Khan, Ayesha Takia, Jimmy Sheirgill and Paresh Rawal.
de-taali-2008: Abhi, Paglu and Amu have been best friends since childhood. When Abhi falls for a scheming woman who wants to cut him off from his friends, the other two try to break them up. Eeshwar Nivas's comedy, adapted from Saving Silverman, stars Riteish Deshmukh, Aftab Shivdasani, Ayesha Takia and Rimi Sen.
speed-2007: In London, an MI5 agent who works undercover as a chef is racing to decode a message warning of a terror attack. When his wife, a schoolteacher, is kidnapped, a chance phone call drags a young man visiting from India into the frantic effort to save her and stop the attack.
dus-kahaniyaan-2007: Dus Kahaniyaan is a Hindi anthology of ten short stories made by six directors: Sanjay Gupta, Apoorva Lakhia, Meghna Gulzar, Rohit Roy, Hansal Mehta and Jasmeet Dhodhi. The tales range from romance and infidelity to crime, each ending with a twist. The ensemble cast includes Sanjay Dutt, Dia Mirza and Anupam Kher.
muni-2007: Ganesh, a man terrified of ghosts who never goes out after dark, moves into a new house with his family. He is soon possessed by the spirit of Muni, a poor man murdered with his daughter by a corrupt politician, who wants to use Ganesh's body to take revenge.
mungaru-male-2006: Preetham, a carefree young man from Bangalore, is smitten when he meets Nandini during a storm. When he discovers she is about to marry another man, he vows to win her, and their story plays out against the monsoon rains of Coorg.
paruthiveeran-2007: Paruthiveeran, a brash young rogue in a village near Madurai, is loved by his cousin Muthazhagu, who has been devoted to him since childhood. Her family, bitter enemies of his, refuse to let them marry. Ameer's rural drama marks Karthi's acting debut, opposite Priyamani, who won the National Award for Best Actress.
waris-shah-ishq-daa-waaris-2006: Waris Shah: Ishq Daa Waaris is a 2006 Punjabi film directed by Manoj Punj, starring Gurdas Maan as the legendary poet Waris Shah, with Juhi Chawla and Divya Dutta. At a time when a long-standing Mughal ban has driven music underground, young Waris joins a Sufi master near Kasur, and the experiences that follow shape his immortal telling of Heer Ranjha.
frozen-2007: Lasya, a spirited teenager, lives with her father, an apricot-jam maker, and her young brother in a remote Ladakh village. When the army sets up camp right outside their home, their quiet world begins to change. Shivajee Chandrabhushan's black-and-white drama stars Danny Denzongpa and Gauri.
milana-2007: Aakash, a popular radio jockey in Bangalore, agrees to an arranged marriage with Anjali, who asks for a divorce on their wedding night because she loves someone else. He calmly agrees on the condition that she keeps it secret from his parents, and while helping her, an unexpected bond begins to grow.
bombay-to-bangkok-2008: Shankar, a cook in need of cash, steals from a Mumbai don and escapes by joining a team of doctors flying to Bangkok, losing the loot on the way. There he falls for Jasmine, a Thai woman who speaks no Hindi, and must play doctor while the gang closes in. Nagesh Kukunoor's crime comedy stars Shreyas Talpade.
sandwich-2006: Sandwich is a Hindi comedy directed by Anees Bazmee, completed in 2003 but released in 2006, with Govinda in a dual role opposite Raveena Tandon and Mahima Chaudhry. Shekhar, a struggling scriptwriter in love with Nisha, is told by a holy man that he will soon marry two women, and before long his life spirals into exactly that mess.
bhale-dongalu-2008: Two restless young people from small towns, each dreaming of a bigger life, team up as con artists and pull off one daring scam after another, with a determined police officer on their trail. Tarun, Ileana D'Cruz and Jagapati Babu star in this Telugu comedy by K. Vijaya Bhaskar, a remake of the Hindi hit Bunty Aur Babli.
mehbooba-2008: Shravan, a rich playboy businessman, woos and gets engaged to the beautiful Varsha, then cruelly tells her it was all a game. Heartbroken, Varsha starts a new life, where she meets Karan, a kind and gentle man, setting up a painful love triangle. Sanjay Dutt, Manisha Koirala and Ajay Devgn star in this Hindi romance by Afzal Khan.
phoonk-2008: Rajiv, a hard-headed atheist engineer in Mumbai, fires two dishonest colleagues. Soon after, his young daughter begins behaving strangely and falls seriously ill, and as doctors fail to help, Rajiv starts to wonder whether black magic is at work. Ram Gopal Varma's horror film stars Sudeep, Amruta Khanvilkar and Ahsaas Channa.
dasvidaniya-2008: Amar Kaul is a meek, overlooked 37-year-old accounts manager in Mumbai who lives with his mother. When a doctor tells him he has only three months to live, Amar writes a list of ten things he wants to do before he dies and sets out to tick them off.
ek-niranjan-2009: Chotu, kidnapped as a boy by a gangster who runs a child-begging racket, grows up to work as a bounty hunter for the police, while still searching for his real parents. On a job he meets Sameera, a guitar teacher whose brother works for a gangster. Prabhas and Kangana Ranaut star in this Telugu action comedy by Puri Jagannadh.
koochie-koochie-hota-hai-2011: Koochie Koochie Hota Hai is an animated retelling of Dharma Productions' hit romance Kuch Kuch Hota Hai, with its story of friendship, love and lost chances reimagined with animal characters. Directed by Tarun Mansukhani, it features the voices of Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol and Rani Mukerji.
naan-kadavul-2009: A father who abandoned his son in Varanasi years ago returns to find he has become a fierce Aghori ascetic. Brought back to Tamil Nadu, Rudhran comes face to face with Thandavan, a cruel man who exploits disabled beggars, and a blind singer under his control. Bala's drama, based on Jeyamohan's novel, stars Arya and Pooja.
woodstock-villa-2008: Sameer, a young man short of money, is persuaded by Zara, a woman he meets at a pub, to fake her kidnapping to test her husband's love. The ransom plan quickly spins out of control at a villa called Woodstock. Hansal Mehta's thriller, inspired by the Japanese film Chaos, stars Sikandar Kher, Neha Oberoi and Arbaaz Khan.
karzzzz-2008: Ravi Verma wins a fortune in vineyards in Kenya and marries Kamini, unaware that she is secretly working with his rival and plans to kill him. Twenty-five years later, Monty, a rock star in Cape Town, is plagued by visions that lead him to uncover the truth about a past life.
aashayein-2010: Rahul, a compulsive gambler, wins a fortune and proposes to his girlfriend on the same night, only to learn that he has terminal cancer. He walks out on his old life and checks into a hospice, where the other patients, including a spirited teenage girl and a young boy, change how he sees his remaining days.
striker-2010: Striker is a 2010 Hindi action drama written and directed by Chandan Arora, starring Siddharth with Padmapriya, Aditya Pancholi and Anupam Kher. Surya, a boy from a poor Mumbai family, becomes a junior carrom champion at twelve, but as a young man his dreams of a job in Dubai fall apart, and he is drawn into the world of high-stakes carrom hustling.
shaurya-2008: Major Siddhant, a carefree army lawyer, is assigned to defend a soldier who shot his commanding officer during a counter-insurgency operation in Kashmir. As the court-martial goes on, he uncovers uncomfortable truths about prejudice inside the army. Samar Khan's legal drama stars Rahul Bose, Kay Kay Menon, Javed Jaffrey and Minissha Lamba.
one-two-three-2008: Three men who share the same name, Laxmi Narayan, travel to Pondicherry for very different reasons: a would-be hitman sent to kill a gangster, an obedient secretary sent to buy a vintage car, and a lingerie seller meeting a new supplier. Staying in neighbouring hotel rooms, their identities get hopelessly mixed up.
billa-2009: Billa, an underworld don hiding out in Malaysia, dies during a police chase. An Interpol-linked ACP keeps the death quiet and trains Ranga, a petty thief who looks just like Billa, to take his place inside the gang. Meher Ramesh's Telugu remake stars Prabhas in a dual role, with Anushka Shetty, Namitha and Krishnam Raju.
short-kut-2009: Shekhar, an assistant director, has written a film script he dreams of directing. His friend Raju, a struggling actor, steals it, makes the film himself and becomes a star overnight. Heartbroken, Shekhar plots to make Raju pay. Neeraj Vora's comedy, a remake of Udayananu Tharam, stars Akshaye Khanna, Arshad Warsi and Amrita Rao.
hello-darling-2010: Three women working at a fashion firm are fed up with their lecherous boss who steals their work. When one of them accidentally puts rat poison in his coffee, they think they have killed him and land in a series of comic mishaps. Manoj Tiwari's comedy, inspired by Nine to Five, stars Gul Panag, Celina Jaitly, Isha Koppikar and Javed Jaffrey.
chittagong-2012: In 1930s East Bengal, schoolteacher Surya Sen leads a band of schoolboys and young women in a daring uprising against the British Empire. Jhunku, a hesitant 14-year-old, is swept into the mission and must overcome his self-doubt. Bedabrata Pain's historical drama, based on the Chittagong armoury raid, stars Manoj Bajpayee.
crook-2010: Jai, a small-time hustler from Mumbai, is sent by his uncle to Melbourne to start a new life under a new name. There he falls for Suhani, but he soon finds himself caught in the middle of rising tension between Indian students and local Australians.
paramathma-2011: Paramathma is a 2011 Kannada romantic comedy written and directed by Yogaraj Bhat, starring Puneeth Rajkumar with Deepa Sannidhi and Aindrita Ray. Param, the restless son of a heart specialist, keeps drifting from place to place in search of meaning, and finds himself caught between two women, one he loves and one who loves him.
force-2011: Yash, a tough, lonely narcotics officer, has never let anyone into his life until he meets Maya. Just as they settle into a life together, a ruthless drug lord whose gang Yash has hit sets out on a vicious revenge. Nishikant Kamat's remake of Kaakha Kaakha stars John Abraham, Genelia D'Souza and Vidyut Jammwal.
haunted-3d-2011: Rehan travels to a remote mansion in the hills to finalise its sale, but finds it haunted by the spirit of Meera, a young woman trapped there by a cruel ghost from 1936. To free her, Rehan must go back in time to that night. Vikram Bhatt's 3D horror film stars Mahaakshay Chakraborty and Tia Bajpai.
saheb-biwi-aur-gangster-2011: In a crumbling royal estate in Uttar Pradesh, a debt-ridden Saheb, his lonely and neglected Biwi, and Babloo, a young driver with hidden motives, are drawn into a web of desire, ambition and betrayal. Tigmanshu Dhulia's thriller stars Jimmy Sheirgill, Mahie Gill and Randeep Hooda.
d-day-2013: Wali Khan, an Indian agent, has lived undercover in Karachi for nine years as a barber. When India's most wanted fugitive, Goldman, is due to attend his son's wedding, a small team is sent to capture him alive, but the plan goes wrong and they are left stranded. Nikkhil Advani's spy thriller stars Irrfan Khan, Arjun Rampal and Rishi Kapoor.
krishna-aur-kans-2012: The tyrant king Kans rules Mathura and dreams of conquering the world. To end his reign, Vishnu is born on earth as Krishna, son of Kans's sister Devaki, and grows up in the village of Vrindavan, full of mischief and courage, until he must face his uncle. This Hindi animated mythological film is directed by Vikram Veturi.
kyaa-super-kool-hain-hum-2012: Adi, a struggling actor, and Sid, a struggling DJ, make ends meet by renting out Sid's pet dog for breeding. When Adi falls for Simran, a rich girl, and Sid falls for an unlikely match, the pair resort to bizarre schemes to win them over. Sachin Yardi's adult comedy stars Tusshar Kapoor, Riteish Deshmukh, Neha Sharma and Sarah Jane Dias.
dangerous-ishhq-2012: Sanjana, a supermodel, and Rohan, the son of a business tycoon, are a celebrated couple. When Rohan is kidnapped, Sanjana discovers that the key to saving him lies in her past lives, and her search spans four centuries. Karisma Kapoor stars in this Hindi supernatural thriller directed by Vikram Bhatt, with Rajneesh Duggal and Jimmy Shergill.
aiyyaa-2012: Meenakshi, a Marathi librarian from an eccentric family, escapes her humdrum life through daydreams in which she dances like her favourite film heroines. Her parents are desperate to get her married, but she becomes obsessed with Surya, a brooding Tamil art student whose scent she cannot resist.
zila-ghaziabad-2013: Zila Ghaziabad is a 2013 Hindi political action thriller directed by Anand Kumar, starring Sanjay Dutt, Vivek Oberoi, Arshad Warsi and Paresh Rawal. In Ghaziabad, a corrupt municipal chairman falls out with his gangster enforcer over money, and as he takes a mild-mannered teacher under his wing, the town slides into a violent battle for power.
kadhalil-sodhappuvadhu-yeppadi-2012: Arun and Parvathi, college mates, are giving an interview about their love story when they start fighting. The film rewinds five months to show how they met, became friends and kept breaking up and making up over the smallest things. Siddharth and Amala Paul star in this romantic comedy by Balaji Mohan, made in Tamil and Telugu.
i-me-aur-main-2013: Ishaan, a charming but self-centred music producer in Mumbai, has always been protected by his mother and sister and takes his girlfriend for granted. When she throws him out, he moves next door to Gauri, and slowly begins to learn about responsibility. John Abraham, Chitrangada Singh and Prachi Desai star in this Hindi romantic comedy.
mirchi-2013: In Milan, Jai, a calm young man who prefers words to fists, meets Manasa and the two grow close, until she asks him to stay away because of her family's violent feud. Jai travels to her village in India to win over her family, hiding a connection of his own to the conflict. Prabhas and Anushka Shetty star in Koratala Siva's Telugu action drama.
paradesi-2013: In the 1930s, Raasa, a carefree orphan in a drought-hit village, is lured with his fellow villagers to work on a tea estate in the hills, believing they will escape poverty. Instead, they find themselves trapped in brutal bonded labour. Bala's historical drama, based on the novel Red Tea, stars Atharvaa, Vedhika and Dhansika.
carry-on-jatta-2012: Jass falls for Mahie at a friend's wedding, but she only wants to marry a man with no family to interfere. So he pretends to be an orphan, and after a rushed wedding must hide his new wife from his own family, setting off a chain of lies. Smeep Kang's Punjabi comedy stars Gippy Grewal and Mahie Gill.
chakravyuh-2012: Adil Khan, a decorated police officer, takes charge of a district controlled by Maoist insurgents after a deadly attack on security forces. His idealistic friend Kabir offers to infiltrate the rebels as an informer, but life inside the movement begins to change Kabir's loyalties.
916-2012: Dr Harikrishnan, a single father who sees medicine as service, shares a close bond with his daughter Meera, who is in her final year of school. As a new romance draws Meera into a world of malls, phones and the internet, two close families begin to lose their balance. Anoop Menon and Malavika Menon star in this Malayalam drama.
grand-masti-2013: Three friends, Meet, Prem and Amar, are bored in their marriages and convinced their wives have lost interest. When an invitation arrives to a reunion at their old college, they go hoping for some fun, and find more trouble than they bargained for. Riteish Deshmukh, Vivek Oberoi and Aftab Shivdasani star in this Hindi adult comedy, a sequel to Masti.
ek-thi-daayan-2013: Bobo is India's top magician, but he is haunted by visions of his younger sister, who died when he was a child, and he cannot remember how. Under hypnosis he relives his childhood and his conviction that a witch entered his family's life, and the past begins to bleed into the present.
bullett-raja-2013: Raja Mishra, an ordinary man on the run from a brawl, gatecrashes a wedding in Uttar Pradesh and befriends the bride's cousin Rudra. When Raja overhears a plot to kill the guests, the two friends are drawn into the region's violent world of politics and crime. Saif Ali Khan, Sonakshi Sinha and Jimmy Shergill star in Tigmanshu Dhulia's Hindi action film.
i-love-new-year-2013: On New Year's Eve, Randhir, a commitment-shy investment banker in Chicago, gets drunk and boards the wrong flight to New York. He ends up in Tikku's apartment, which looks exactly like his own, and the two strangers spend an eventful night together. Radhika Rao and Vinay Sapru's romantic comedy, inspired by a Soviet classic, stars Sunny Deol and Kangana Ranaut.
pandavulu-pandavulu-tummeda-2014: Pandavulu Pandavulu Tummeda is a 2014 Telugu comedy drama directed by Sriwass, with an ensemble cast led by Mohan Babu, Vishnu Manchu, Manoj Manchu, Raveena Tandon, Hansika Motwani and Pranitha Subhash. On the Andhra Pradesh–Karnataka border, two rival villages are led by men seen as heirs of the Pandavas and the Kauravas, and their feud echoes the Mahabharata.
bhaag-johnny-2015: Johnny, a Bangkok-based employee, is told by his scheming boss that he can save his job only by killing a young woman named Tanya. The moment he meets her, he faces a choice that splits his life into two possible paths. Kunal Khemu, Mandana Karimi and Zoa Morani star in this Hindi thriller directed by Shivam Nair.
citylights-2014: Deepak, a former army driver from Rajasthan, loses his small shop to debt and moves to Mumbai with his wife and young daughter. Cheated on arrival and struggling to survive, he takes a job with a security firm that moves cash, where a senior colleague draws him into a dangerous plan.
mr-x-2015: Raghu and Siya are ATS officers and lovers about to marry. When a corrupt senior officer forces Raghu into a crime and then tries to kill him, Raghu survives with a side effect: he becomes invisible, and he sets out for revenge. Vikram Bhatt's 3D science fiction thriller stars Emraan Hashmi and Amyra Dastur.

imtihaan-1994: A love triangle with Sunny Deol, Saif Ali Khan and Raveena Tandon.
shola-aur-shabnam-1992: A cadet falls for a girl whose brother is a feared gangster. David Dhawan directs Govinda and Divya Bharti.
dhanwan-1993: A romance with Ajay Devgn, Manisha Koirala and Karisma Kapoor.
gopi-kishan-1994: Lookalikes switch places in an action comedy with Suniel Shetty in a double role.
jawab-1995: An action film with Raaj Kumar and Karisma Kapoor.
khuddar-1994: A self-respecting young man takes on a powerful family. Govinda and Karisma Kapoor star.
andaz-1994: A teacher is torn between his wife and a student who loves him. Anil Kapoor, Juhi Chawla and Karisma Kapoor star.
tadipaar-1993: A romantic comedy with Mithun Chakraborty and Pooja Bhatt.
aayushkalam-1992: A man who gets a heart transplant is visited by the ghost of the donor, who wants to expose his own murder. Kamal directs.
om-1995: A gangster changes his ways when he falls for a woman, but his past catches up. Upendra directs Shiva Rajkumar.
shatranj-1993: A drama with Mithun Chakraborty, Jackie Shroff and Juhi Chawla.
gunehgar-1995: An action film directed by Vikram Bhatt, with Mithun Chakraborty.
sarphira-1992: A drama with Sanjay Dutt and Vinod Mehra.
humlaa-1992: An action film with Dharmendra and Anil Kapoor.
maha-shaktishaali-1994: An action drama directed by K. Pappu.
gaddaar-1995: An action drama with Suniel Shetty and Sonali Bendre.
saajan-ki-baahon-mein-1995: A romantic drama with Rishi Kapoor and Raveena Tandon.
god-and-gun-1995: An action drama with Raaj Kumar and Raj Babbar.
eena-meena-deeka-1994: Three small-time crooks stumble into a world of crime. Vinod Khanna and Rishi Kapoor star.
loha-1997: An action film with Dharmendra and Mithun Chakraborty, directed by Kanti Shah.
udaan-1997: An action film directed by Asrani, with Rekha and Saif Ali Khan.
papi-gudia-1996: A killer's spirit enters a doll and haunts a little girl. Karisma Kapoor stars.
prem-granth-1996: A priest's son stands by a woman shunned by society after she is assaulted. Rishi Kapoor and Madhuri Dixit star.
thacholi-varghese-chekavar-1995: A Malayalam martial-arts thriller with Mohanlal.
mohabbat-1997: A love triangle with Madhuri Dixit, Sanjay Kapoor and Akshaye Khanna.
rajkumar-1996: A prince seeks revenge on the man who killed his father. Anil Kapoor and Madhuri Dixit star.
prithvi-1997: A mystery with Suniel Shetty and Shilpa Shetty.
yaar-gaddar-1994: An action thriller with Mithun Chakraborty and Saif Ali Khan.
naaraaz-1994: An action drama directed by Mahesh Bhatt, with Mithun Chakraborty.
return-of-jewel-thief-1996: A sequel to Jewel Thief, about a famous thief's return. Dev Anand and Dharmendra star.
zakhmi-dil-1994: An action film with Akshay Kumar.
milan-1994: An action romance with Jackie Shroff and Manisha Koirala.
angrakshak-1995: A bodyguard falls for the daughter of the man he protects. Sunny Deol and Pooja Bhatt star.
paappi-devataa-1995: An action crime film directed by Harmesh Malhotra.
mahaanta-1997: An action drama with Jeetendra and Sanjay Dutt.
janam-kundli-1995: An action drama directed by Tariq Shah.
naseem-1995: A young girl and her grandfather watch the rising tension before the demolition of the Babri Masjid. Saeed Akhtar Mirza directs Kaifi Azmi.
chupp-1997: A thriller directed by Ambrish Sangal.
sethu-1999: A rowdy college student falls for a shy girl, and a violent attack changes his life. Bala directs Vikram.
premante-idera-1998: A romantic drama with Venkatesh and Preity Zinta.
gunda-1998: A tough guy takes on a gang that killed his family. Mithun Chakraborty stars.
laawaris-1999: An action drama with Jackie Shroff and Akshaye Khanna.
banarasi-babu-1997: A comedy with Govinda and Ramya.
keemat-they-are-back-1998: An action film with Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan.
aaag-hi-aag-1999: An action film with Mithun Chakraborty and Jackie Shroff.
silsila-hai-pyar-ka-1999: A romance with Karisma Kapoor and Chandrachur Singh.
lahu-ke-do-rang-1997: A suspense action film with Akshay Kumar and Karisma Kapoor.
ankhon-mein-tum-ho-1997: A romantic thriller produced by Shakti Samanta.
yeh-hai-mumbai-meri-jaan-1999: A romantic comedy with Saif Ali Khan and Twinkle Khanna.
yamraaj-1998: An action film with Mithun Chakraborty and Jackie Shroff.
aastha-in-the-prison-of-spring-1997: A middle-class housewife is drawn into sex work to support her family. Basu Bhattacharya directs Rekha and Om Puri.
papa-kahte-hain-1996: A young woman who knows her father only through his letters falls for a man in her town. Mahesh Bhatt directs Jugal Hansraj and Mayuri Kango.
sanam-1997: A romantic action drama with Sanjay Dutt and Manisha Koirala.
jung-1996: An action drama with Mithun Chakraborty and Ajay Devgn.
phool-aur-aag-1999: An action film with Mithun Chakraborty and Jackie Shroff.
dil-tera-diwana-1996: A romantic thriller with Saif Ali Khan and Twinkle Khanna.
vijeta-1996: An action thriller with Sanjay Dutt.
yahaan-2000: Aman, an army officer posted to Kashmir, falls in love with Adaa, a young local woman whose brother has joined the militants. When Aman captures the militants' leader, the conflict tests their love and loyalties. Shoojit Sircar's debut romantic drama stars Jimmy Sheirgill and Minissha Lamba.
pyaar-mein-kabhi-kabhi-1999: A college romance with Dino Morea and Rinke Khanna in their debuts.
gang-2000: Four inseparable friends, Gangu, Abdul, Nihal and Gary, form a criminal crew built on trust. As greed pulls one of them towards a ruthless boss, a big heist leaves them rich but hunted, and their friendship is put to the test. Mazhar Khan's long-delayed gangster drama stars Jackie Shroff, Nana Patekar, Kumar Gaurav, Javed Jaffrey and Juhi Chawla.
student-no-1-2001: Aditya, a mysterious student, joins a law college in Vizag and brings its unruly students into line. Then the college learns he is a convict serving a life sentence for murder, attending classes with special permission, and the story of how he ended up in prison unfolds. S. S. Rajamouli's debut film stars Jr NTR and Gajala.
saaz-1998: Two singer sisters with a long rivalry. Sai Paranjpye directs Shabana Azmi and Aruna Irani.
deewaanapan-2001: Suraj, who lives with his family in a remote hill station, meets Kiran when she comes on holiday with a group of friends. He shows her around and the two fall in love, but a family emergency keeps him from seeing her off, and her powerful family stands in their way. Arjun Rampal and Dia Mirza star in this Hindi romantic action film.
123-2002: Three men with physical disabilities lead dull, unchanging lives until a young woman named Narmada befriends them and helps them start making positive changes. Real-life brothers Prabhu Deva, Raju Sundaram and Nagendra Prasad star with Jyothika in this Tamil romantic comedy by K. Subash, based on the Marathi play All The Best.
kyo-kii-main-jhuth-nahin-bolta-2001: Raj, a small-town lawyer, moves to Mumbai and charms his way into marrying the daughter of the city's top lawyer, built on a string of lies. Then a curse forces him to tell nothing but the truth, right when he needs to lie most. Govinda, Sushmita Sen and Rambha star in this Hindi fantasy comedy directed by David Dhawan.
pyaar-ishq-aur-mohabbat-2001: Pyaar Ishq Aur Mohabbat is a 2001 Hindi romance written and directed by Rajiv Rai, starring Arjun Rampal, Suniel Shetty, Aftab Shivdasani and Keerthi Reddy. A billionaire smitten with an idealistic medical student sends her to Scotland on a scholarship, and quietly hires a charming magician to go along and win her heart for him.
hari-bhari-2000: Ghazala, a Muslim woman sent back to her parents' home by her husband because she has not borne a son, joins the other women of the household, each facing her own struggle over marriage and family. Shyam Benegal's drama explores reproductive rights and choice, with Shabana Azmi, Rajit Kapur, Nandita Das and Surekha Sikri.
shaheed-e-mohabbat-boota-singh-1999: The real love story of Boota Singh, a Sikh soldier, and Zainab, during Partition. Gurdas Maan stars.
hero-hindustani-1998: A romantic comedy with Arshad Warsi and Namrata Shirodkar.
priyamaina-neeku-2001: Priyamaina Neeku is a 2001 Telugu romantic comedy written and directed by Balasekaran, starring Tarun, Sneha and Sivaji. Ganesh, a carefree Hyderabad college student, comes across a red diary in his father's auction shop and realises it belongs to Sandhya, his former neighbour, and through its pages he learns how she really felt.
snegithiye-2000: Vani and Radhika, best friends and pranksters at a women's college, fake a kidnapping to escape an arranged marriage. The joke turns into a nightmare when someone really is taken and the friends are framed for a crime. Priyadarshan's mystery thriller, with an all-female cast, stars Jyothika, Sharbani Mukherjee and Tabu.
hatyara-1998: Mithun Chakraborty plays a double role in this crime film.
karobaar-2000: Childhood friends Rajiv, who is rich, and Amar, who is middle class, both fall for Seema. Amar marries her, but when he learns Rajiv tried to keep them apart, the two become bitter enemies, and Rajiv later makes the couple an offer that tests their marriage. Rakesh Roshan's thriller, inspired by Indecent Proposal, stars Rishi Kapoor, Anil Kapoor and Juhi Chawla.
kunwara-2000: Raju and Urmila meet in New Zealand, fall in love and promise to meet again in India. On the way home, Raju meets Sharmila, a heartbroken pregnant woman let down by her boyfriend, and to protect her honour he pretends to be her husband in front of her family. Govinda and Urmila Matondkar star in this Hindi comedy by David Dhawan.
officer-2000: Officer is a Hindi action thriller directed by Naeem Sha, starring Suniel Shetty, Raveena Tandon and Danny Denzongpa. A witness protection officer is hired by an industrialist to guard his troubled wife, but he soon realises that the people around him are hiding their true motives and that he has walked into a web of deception.
humse-badhkar-kaun-1998: An action film with Suniel Shetty and Saif Ali Khan.
rajaji-1999: A comedy with Govinda and Raveena Tandon.
koi-mere-dil-se-poochhe-2002: Aman, a design student and the only son of a wealthy family, refuses to marry until he finds the girl of his dreams. When he meets Esha at college and she rejects him, his father steps in to help, but Esha is hiding a dangerous secret. Aftab Shivdasani, Esha Deol and Jaya Bachchan star in this Hindi romantic thriller.
waisa-bhi-hota-hai-part-ii-2003: Puneet, a Mumbai copywriter, is thrown out by his girlfriend after learning of his estranged brother's death. Drunk on a park bench, he witnesses a gangland killing, and soon he is caught between rival gangsters and the police. Shashanka Ghosh's debut black comedy stars Arshad Warsi, Sandhya Mridul and Prashant Narayanan.
red-2002: Red is a 2002 Tamil action film directed by Singampuli, starring Ajith Kumar in the title role with Priya Gill and Raghuvaran. Aathi, an orphan known across Madurai as Red, is a feared enforcer with a soft heart who makes schools admit students without donations and looks after orphans, while a bitter rival waits for a chance to strike.
kaise-kahoon-ke-pyaar-hai-2003: Karan is the son of a professional burglar whose mother left to raise her children with dignity. When Karan grows up, he joins his father's night-time work, and becomes a skilled thief. In college he falls for Priya, the daughter of a wealthy man, but cannot tell her the truth. Amit Hingorani, Sharbani Mukherjee and Dharmendra star.
dhool-2003: Arumugam, a kind-hearted villager, travels to Chennai with his childhood friend Eswari to ask their minister to close a chemical factory poisoning their river. When the minister turns out to be the factory's protector, Arumugam takes him on. Dharani's action entertainer stars Vikram, Jyothika and Reema Sen.
gemini-2002: Gemini, an ambitious young gangster in Chennai, rises to the top of the city's underworld while battling his bitter rival Teja. When a police officer gives him a chance to leave crime behind, he tries to change, but his enemies will not let him go. Vikram and Kiran Rathod star in this Tamil crime action film directed by Saran for AVM Productions.
raghu-romeo-2003: Raghu, a gentle, naive waiter at a Mumbai dance bar, is hopelessly devoted to the heroine of a TV soap and cannot tell fiction from life. When he gets mixed up with a hitman and a bar dancer who likes him, his innocence lands him in trouble. Rajat Kapoor's comedy, which won a National Award, stars Vijay Raaz, Sadiya Siddiqui and Maria Goretti.
chennakesava-reddy-2002: In Rayalaseema, the followers of the legendary faction leader Chennakesava Reddy await his return after 22 years away. In his absence, a ruthless man and his corrupt brothers have taken control of the region and made his family suffer. Nandamuri Balakrishna, Tabu and Shriya Saran star in this Telugu revenge drama by V. V. Vinayak.
chor-machaaye-shor-2002: Shyam, a small-time thief, steals a precious diamond and hides it in an old building just before he is caught. Two years later he walks out of prison to find a police station built on the spot, so he joins the force in disguise to get the gem back. David Dhawan's comedy stars Bobby Deol, Shilpa Shetty and Bipasha Basu.
kucch-to-hai-2003: To impress Tanya, Karan and his college friends plan to steal an exam paper from their strict professor's house. The heist goes wrong, and soon after, the friends start dying one by one at the hands of a mysterious killer. Anurag Basu and Anil V. Kumar's slasher stars Tusshar Kapoor, Esha Deol, Anita Hassanandani and Rishi Kapoor.
makdee-2002: Chunni, a mischievous village girl, loves to play pranks by pretending to be her twin sister Munni. One day Munni wanders into a haunted mansion said to be home to Makdee, a witch who turns people into animals, and Chunni must set out to save her. Vishal Bhardwaj's children's film stars Shweta Basu Prasad and Shabana Azmi.
waah-tera-kya-kehna-2002: Waah! Tera Kya Kehna is a 2002 Hindi comedy directed by Manoj Agrawal, starring Govinda, Raveena Tandon and Preeti Jhangiani. A wealthy businessman who distrusts his greedy sons plans to leave his fortune to his devoted grandson Raj, but an accident leaves Raj with a childlike mind, his engagement falls through, and the family's schemers circle the estate.
julie-ganapathi-2003: Julie Ganapathi is an obsessive fan of a popular TV serial. When its writer, Bala, crashes his car near her home, she rescues him and nurses him, but grows alarmed by how he plans to end the story, and he becomes her prisoner. Balu Mahendra's psychological thriller, based on Stephen King's Misery, stars Saritha, Jayaram and Ramya Krishnan.
badhaai-ho-badhaai-2002: The Chaddha and D'Souza families were friends for generations until their children eloped across religious lines and the two families became bitter enemies. Twenty-seven years later, the couple's son Raja arrives to win them back. Anil Kapoor, Shilpa Shetty and Keerthi Reddy star in this Hindi remake of the Tamil film Poove Unakkaga, directed by Satish Kaushik.
yeh-dil-2003: Ravi, the son of a wealthy businessman, and Vasundhara, the daughter of a wrestler from a middle-class family, are college classmates who are both neglected by their fathers. They fall in love while studying together, and when their families object, the young couple must fight to stay together.
annarth-2002: Sameer, back in the city after completing his naval training, reunites with his childhood friend Jimmy, a gangster loyal to his elder brother Raghav, who runs one of the city's most dangerous gangs. Soon the friends are drawn into a violent world. Sanjay Dutt, Sunil Shetty and Preeti Jhangiani star in this Hindi action thriller, which marked Gautam Rode's debut.
abhi-2003: Abhi, a college student in Bangalore, falls in love with Bhanu, a Muslim girl whose relatives are staying in his rented house. When her father finds out about the romance, he is furious, and the couple's love meets fierce opposition. Puneeth Rajkumar and Ramya, in her Kannada debut, star in this romantic action comedy by Dinesh Baboo.
raja-bhaiya-2003: Raja Bhaiya is a 2003 Hindi comedy directed by Raman Kumar, starring Govinda and Aarti Chhabria. Raja and his mother take in a childlike young woman found near the railway tracks with no memory of who she is, and while his mother sees her as the perfect bride, Raja has vowed to stay unmarried.
dhund-2003: Simran, who lives with her wealthy uncle, wins a college beauty contest, angering a jealous rival and her threatening brother. After a deadly accident during a confrontation, Simran and her friends hide what happened, but soon a killer begins stalking them. Amar Upadhyay, Aditi Govitrikar and Irrfan Khan star in this Hindi horror film by Shyam Ramsay.
kali-salwar-2002: Sultana, a sex worker from a small town, moves to Bombay with her pimp, full of hopes for a better life. The city bewilders and changes her as she meets its strange and lonely people. Fareeda Mehta's drama, based on Saadat Hasan Manto's short story, stars Sadiya Siddiqui, Irrfan Khan and Kay Kay Menon.
albhutha-dweep-2005: On a hidden island where all the men are tiny and the women are of normal height, any tall man is believed to be a demon. When a group of Indian Navy officers are stranded there during the king's celebrations, chaos follows. Prithviraj Sukumaran and Guinness Pakru star in this Malayalam fantasy comedy by Vinayan.
autograph-2004: Senthil, who runs an advertising agency, sets off on a journey to personally invite people from his past to his wedding. As he travels, he relives his first love at school, a romance in Kerala, and a friendship that helped him through the hardest time in his life.
arya-2004: Arya is a cheerful, free-spirited young man who falls for Geetha, a college student who is already with Ajay, the spoilt son of a local politician. Undeterred, Arya openly declares his one-sided love and sets about winning her heart, turning a straightforward rivalry into a tangled triangle.
jo-bole-so-nihaal-2005: Nihaal Singh, an honest and much-loved constable in Punjab, unwittingly helps a ruthless international terrorist escape. Branded a traitor, suspended and mocked by his village, he follows the man all the way to New York to clear his name. Sunny Deol stars in this Hindi action comedy directed by Rahul Rawail.
sandakozhi-2005: Sandakozhi is a 2005 Tamil action drama directed by N. Lingusamy, starring Vishal, Meera Jasmine, Rajkiran and Lal. Balu, an engineering student visiting a friend's home in Chidambaram after exams, falls for his friend's sister, and then steps in to stop the town's most feared gangster in the middle of an attack, making a dangerous enemy.
ek-khiladi-ek-haseena-2005: Arjun and his best friend Rohit make a living conning people, and their latest job, swindling a don's accountant out of millions, goes badly wrong. With the gangsters on his trail, Arjun flees to another city, where a beautiful woman and a bigger con await. Fardeen Khan, Feroz Khan, Kay Kay Menon and Koena Mitra star in this Hindi thriller.
hava-aney-dey-2004: Arjun, an 18-year-old living in the northern suburbs of Mumbai, dreams of a better life abroad, while India's new global economy and tensions over war reshape the world around him. Aniket Vishwasrao, Tannishtha Chatterjee and Nishikant Kamat star in this Hindi drama written and directed by Partho Sen-Gupta.
socha-na-tha-2005: Viren and Aditi meet when their families try to arrange their marriage, but Viren calls it off because he loves someone else. Then the two become friends, and on a trip to Goa realise they may be meant for each other. Imtiaz Ali's debut romantic comedy stars Abhay Deol and Ayesha Takia.
pehchaan-2005: Pehchaan: The Face of Truth is a 2005 Hindi drama directed by Shrabani Deodhar, starring Vinod Khanna, Rati Agnihotri and Raveena Tandon, who also produced it. Two inseparable college friends marry into powerful families, one into a top lawyer's household and the other into a senior politician's, and years later their lives cross again in a courtroom.
bachke-rehna-re-baba-2005: Rukmini, unmarried and in her forties, and her orphaned niece Padmini make a living conning wealthy men with clever disguises and false names, then vanishing with their money. Their scheme works until Padmini falls for one of their targets. Rekha, Mallika Sherawat and Paresh Rawal star in this Hindi adult comedy.
ssukh-2005: Ssukh is a 2005 Hindi comedy directed by Kirti Kumar and produced by his brother Govinda, who also stars alongside Preeti Jhangiani, Chunky Pandey, Aarti Chhabria and Jackie Shroff. The film is a remake of the 1990 Marathi comedy Shejari Shejari, built around the misadventures of neighbours and families who share far more than a wall.
the-blue-umbrella-2005: Biniya, a young girl in a Himalayan village, trades her lucky necklace for a beautiful blue umbrella that becomes the envy of everyone. Nandu, the miserly village shopkeeper, desperately wants it for himself, and when it goes missing, suspicion falls on him. Vishal Bhardwaj's adaptation of Ruskin Bond's story stars Pankaj Kapur and Shreya Sharma.
sssshhh-2003: Six months after her sister was murdered by a killer in a clown mask, Mahek starts getting calls from the same person. As her college friends are targeted one by one, she must find out who is behind the mask. Pavan S. Kaul's slasher film stars Tanishaa and Dino Morea.
zameer-2005: Zameer: The Fire Within is a 2005 Hindi romantic drama directed by Kamal, a remake of his Malayalam film Mazhayethum Munpe, starring Ajay Devgn, Ameesha Patel and Mahima Chaudhry. Suraj, living anonymously in Kolkata, is persuaded by a friend to return home, and his story turns back to his days as a chemistry professor at a women's college.
akale-2004: Inspired by Tennessee Williams' The Glass Menagerie, the film follows Neil, a writer who looks back on his youth in an Anglo-Indian family in Kerala. He recalls his domineering mother, his fragile, withdrawn sister Rose, and the visit of a young man who briefly brought hope into their lives.
dobara-2004: Ranveer and Anjali are a happily married couple whose peaceful life is turned upside down when Riya, a woman who has escaped from a mental hospital, arrives with a claim on Ranveer's past. Jackie Shroff, Mahima Chaudhry and Raveena Tandon star in this Hindi drama, the debut of director Shashi Ranjan.
kis-kis-ki-kismat-2004: A wealthy old man's comfortable life is turned upside down when a young woman enters it, setting off a chain of comic schemes and complications among his family and associates. Govind Menon's black comedy stars Dharmendra and Mallika Sherawat, with Satish Shah, Tinnu Anand and Jagdeep.
rok-sako-to-rok-lo-2004: Rok Sako To Rok Lo is a 2004 Hindi sports comedy and the directorial debut of Arindam Chaudhuri, starring Sunny Deol, Yash Pandit and Manjari, with music by Jatin–Lalit. Students at a middle-class school, tormented and beaten every year by their rich neighbours from Valley High, finally decide to fight back in the annual inter-school contest.
zindagi-khoobsoorat-hai-2002: Zindagi Khoobsoorat Hai is a 2002 Hindi romantic drama directed by Manoj Punj, starring Gurdas Maan, Tabu, Divya Dutta, Ashish Vidyarthi, Sonu Sood and Rajit Kapur. The film reunites singer-actor Gurdas Maan with director Manoj Punj in a story about love, relationships and finding beauty in life despite its hardships.
remo-2005: Remo is a Tamil romantic comedy marking Bakkiyaraj Kannan's debut as writer and director, starring Sivakarthikeyan and Keerthy Suresh. SK, a theatre actor who dreams of becoming a superstar, falls for a young doctor who is already engaged, and goes to extreme lengths to win her, disguising himself as a woman to get close to her.
aryan-2006: Aryan is a gifted college boxer whose dream of winning the national championship is derailed by events in his personal life. Years later, after his career and marriage start to fall apart, he decides to return to the ring with the help of his old coach to reclaim his self-respect.
shaadi-se-pehle-2006: Ashish works hard to win the approval of his girlfriend Rani's wealthy parents and finally gets engaged to her. Then he hears that he has cancer and, believing he will soon die, sets out to make Rani fall out of love with him, triggering a chain of comic misunderstandings.
tom-dick-and-harry-2006: Tom, who is deaf, Dick, who is blind, and Harry, who cannot speak, share a house and compete for the attention of their beautiful new neighbour. Their clumsy attempts to woo her, and the trouble that follows, land the three friends in a string of comic adventures. This comedy stars Dino Morea, Jimmy Sheirgill, Anuj Sawhney and Celina Jaitly.
ahista-ahista-2006: Ankush scrapes a living in Delhi by acting as a witness at the marriage registrar's office. When Megha, who has run away from Nainital to marry her lover, is stood up on her wedding day, Ankush helps her find work and a home, and slowly falls in love with her.
jaane-hoga-kya-2006: Siddharth, a scientist working on human cloning, refuses to give up on his research even after an experiment kills his colleague. Supported by his girlfriend Aditi, he goes ahead, and creates a clone of himself with dangerous results. Aftab Shivdasani, Bipasha Basu and Rahul Dev star in this Hindi science fiction film.
bas-ek-pal-2006: Nikhil returns from the US to Mumbai and falls for a mysterious woman he meets at a nightclub, who turns out to be Anamika. A single moment of violence soon changes several lives forever. Juhi Chawla, Sanjay Suri, Urmila Matondkar and Jimmy Sheirgill star in this Hindi thriller by Onir, adapted from Pedro Almodovar's Live Flesh.
anthony-kaun-hai-2006: A con man impersonates a dead man, who turns out to be a hitman. Sanjay Dutt and Arshad Warsi star.
risk-2007: Risk is a 2007 Hindi action thriller directed by Vishram Sawant, set in the Mumbai underworld and starring Randeep Hooda, Vinod Khanna and Tanushree Dutta. Khalid Bin Jamal runs Mumbai's crime world from Bangkok, out of the police's reach for years, until a determined inspector makes it his mission to bring him down.
khoya-khoya-chand-2007: In 1950s Bombay, Zafar, a young and rebellious writer, arrives hoping to make his name in the film industry. He falls in love with Nikhat, a rising starlet entangled with a powerful star, and is swept into the intoxicating, ruthless world of the golden age of Hindi cinema.
shukriya-till-death-do-us-apart-2004: Shukriya: Till Death Do Us Apart is a 2004 Hindi romantic drama directed by Anupam Sinha and adapted from the American film Meet Joe Black, starring Anupam Kher, Aftab Shivdasani and Shriya Saran. As London tycoon Karam Jindal's 60th birthday approaches and his younger daughter looks for love, a mysterious stranger enters the family's life.
just-married-2007: Abhay and Ritika, two modern young professionals who both dislike the idea of arranged marriage, end up married to each other at their parents' insistence. On their honeymoon in Ooty they share a lodge with other couples, and slowly start to discover each other.
aap-kaa-surroor-2007: Indian singer HR is arrested after a concert in Germany and charged with the murder of a TV journalist found dead in a remote spot. From custody, he looks back on the tour, his romance with event planner Riya and the people around him. Himesh Reshammiya makes his acting debut opposite Hansika Motwani in this Hindi musical thriller.
nanhe-jaisalmer-2007: Nanhe, a ten-year-old camel-cart boy in Jaisalmer who charms tourists in many languages, idolises actor Bobby Deol, who held him as a baby during a film shoot. He writes letters to his hero and dreams of meeting him again. Bobby Deol plays himself opposite child actor Dwij Yadav in this Hindi drama directed by Samir Karnik.
aggar-2007: Aryan, a young man with violent anger issues, is taken out of an asylum by psychiatrist Aditya, who promises to rebuild his life. Aditya gives him a job and a home, but when Aryan grows close to Aditya's wife, a dangerous game of manipulation and suspicion begins.
dharm-2007: Pandit Chaturvedi is a highly respected Brahmin priest in Varanasi.
