But at the airport Raju is robbed of his luggage and identity by two con men, Raja and Kanhaiya, who decide to take his place. Govinda and Twinkle Khanna star in this Hindi comedy directed by Shakeel Noorani.
cover-story-2000: Jasmine, a computer engineer, is close to her neighbour Chandrashekar Menon, a retired judge with a troubled past. When Menon is killed on Christmas night by a man she sees but cannot identify, she is drawn into the case with Vijay, a crusading TV reporter. Suresh Gopi, Tabu and Biju Menon star in this Malayalam revenge thriller.
kalisundam-raa-2000: Raghavayya and Ram Mohan Rao are brothers-in-law locked in a long family feud. When Raghavayya invites his estranged grandchildren from Bombay for his sixtieth birthday celebrations, his grandson Raghu arrives and sets out to bring the divided family back together. Venkatesh, Simran and K. Viswanath star in this Telugu family drama by Udayasankar.
vasanthiyum-lakshmiyum-pinne-njaanum-199: A blind singer loves a girl but sacrifices himself for others. Vinayan directs Kalabhavan Mani.
censor-2001: A film producer finds his new movie blocked by an unsympathetic censor board. He defies them by gathering audience support and sending his film abroad, landing himself in court, where he takes on the board's hypocrisy. Dev Anand directs and stars in this satire of Indian film censorship, with Hema Malini, Jackie Shroff, Rekha and Shammi Kapoor.
krodh-2000: Karan, nicknamed Hitler for his fierce temper, has devoted his life to looking after his five younger sisters. When the time comes to arrange their marriages one by one, things start going wrong and bitterness creeps into the family. Suniel Shetty and Rambha star in this Hindi action drama by Ashok Honda, a remake of the Malayalam film Hitler.
9-nelalu-2001: Savitri, a gentle orphan, marries Surendra, a bright computer programmer who saves her from a bad match. When Surendra is badly injured in an accident and needs a costly operation, Savitri finds that everyone she counted on has deserted her. Soundarya and Vikram star in this Telugu drama directed by Kranthi Kumar.
naseeb-1998: A romantic drama with Govinda and Mamta Kulkarni.
samaantharangal-1998: A schoolteacher's family drama. Balachandra Menon directs and stars.
kasam-2001: Seeking revenge for his father's death at the hands of a dreaded bandit, truck driver Shankar teams up with a police inspector and an escaped convict to protect a village from the bandit's gang. Sunny Deol, Naseeruddin Shah, Chunky Pandey and Neelam star in this Hindi action film directed by Shibu Mitra.
bade-dilwala-1999: A cop's promise to share a lottery win with a waitress. Suniel Shetty stars.
badmaash-1998: An action film with Jackie Shroff.
papa-the-great-2000: Papa The Great is a 2000 Hindi film directed by K. Bhagyaraj, shot alongside the Tamil film Vaettiya Madichu Kattu and starring Krishan Kumar and Nagma. Jai Prakash, a mild-mannered engineer whose young son believes he is a fearless hero, witnesses a murder by a dreaded gangster and must find the courage to testify in court.
saamy-2003: Saamy is a 2003 Tamil action thriller written and directed by Hari and presented by K. Balachander, starring Vikram as DCP Aarusaamy with Trisha and Vivek. Saamy arrives in Tirunelveli disguised as a drunk ruffian to size up the city before revealing himself as its new police chief, and soon sets himself against the powerful don who runs it.
enakku-20-unakku-18-2003: Sridhar, a final-year management student headed for further studies in the US, meets Preeti on a train journey back from Mumbai and falls for her. Both are cricket fans, and as their paths keep crossing at college, a playful romance and a tennis tournament complicate things. Tarun, Trisha and Shriya Saran star in this romantic comedy shot in Tamil and Telugu.
johnny-2003: Johnny, who ran away from an abusive father as a boy, becomes a martial arts coach and marries Geetha. When he learns she has leukaemia, he moves to Mumbai and enters brutal fighting competitions to raise money for her treatment.
c-i-d-moosa-2003: Sahadevan, the son of a police constable who works with the dog squad, dreams of joining the Kerala Police. When that plan falls through, he sets himself up as a private detective, with the squad's clever German Shepherd, Arjun, as his partner. Dileep stars in this Malayalam action comedy directed by Johny Antony.
allari-ramudu-2002: Ramu, a servant in the home of Chamundeswari, a powerful business tycoon, falls for her beautiful daughter. When Chamundeswari discovers his feelings, she sets out to keep the two apart at any cost. N. T. Rama Rao Jr. stars with Aarthi Agarwal, Gajala and Nagma in this Telugu action comedy directed by B. Gopal.
virumbukiren-2002: Virumbukiren is a 2002 Tamil romantic drama directed by Susi Ganesan, adapted from his own novel and starring Prashanth and Sneha, with music by Deva. Sivan, an aspiring designer, must take over his late father's job as a fireman to support his family, and on a posting to a village he falls for Thavamani, a spirited local girl whose father opposes the match.
gunaah-2002: Prabha, a police inspector, is haunted by a troubled childhood and a dark incident from her past. Believing she can find peace by reforming a criminal, she takes an interest in Aditya, a dangerous young man, and her life is turned upside down. Bipasha Basu, Dino Morea and Irrfan Khan star in this Hindi crime drama written by Mahesh Bhatt.
nizhalkuthu-2002: In 1940s Travancore, Kaliyappan, the kingdom's ageing hangman, lives in guilt over a man he executed who may have been innocent. When he is summoned for one more execution, his conscience and duty come to a head. Adoor Gopalakrishnan's drama stars Oduvil Unnikrishnan, with Sukumari, Narain and Murali.
chura-liyaa-hai-tumne-2003: Tina learns that her beloved uncle has died, only to discover he was a master thief wanted for a huge gold robbery from the Reserve Bank. With investigators hounding her, she is drawn into a dangerous search for the missing gold, and into a romance. Zayed Khan makes his debut opposite Esha Deol in this Hindi thriller by Sangeeth Sivan.
alli-arjuna-2002: Arivu, a spoilt and neglected young man from Chennai, offers to marry Savitri at a Bangalore wedding when her groom disappears, only for the bride to run away too. Months later she turns up at his door asking for help. Manoj Bharathiraja and Richa Pallod star in this Tamil comedy drama by Saran, with music by A. R. Rahman.
thennavan-2003: Thennavan is a 2003 Tamil political action film written and directed by A. M. Nandakumar and produced by Vijayakanth, who plays the title role. Thennavan, an upright IAS officer handpicked as India's Chief Election Commissioner, proposes five laws to clean up the electoral system before a Tamil Nadu election, putting him on a collision course with the Chief Minister.
ezhumalai-2002: Two neighbouring villages are locked in a long feud. To protect his village and its temple lands from a ruthless rival, peace-loving Venkatachalam dedicates his younger son Ezhumalai to the cause. Years later, Ezhumalai meets Anjali, the spoilt daughter of a rich family. Arjun directs and stars in this Tamil remake of the Telugu film Narasimha Naidu.
dhoop-2003: Captain Rohit Kapoor, a young officer, is killed in action during the Kargil war. His grieving parents are offered a petrol pump licence as compensation, but bureaucratic red tape turns their attempt to honour his memory into a long struggle. Ashwini Chaudhary's drama, inspired by Captain Anuj Nayyar's family, stars Om Puri, Revathi and Gul Panag.
sanam-teri-kasam-2000: Sanam Teri Kasam is a Hindi romantic drama directed by Lawrence D'Souza, starring Saif Ali Khan, Pooja Bhatt and Atul Agnihotri, completed in the mid-1990s and long held up by a legal battle. Vijay, a playboy who has toyed with many women, finally falls in love with Seema, only to see her tricked into marrying his best friend.
kranti-2002: Abhay Pratap Singh, an honest police officer who breaks the rules to catch criminals, keeps clashing with his principled father. Sanjana, a student writing a thesis on honest cops, falls for him and follows him everywhere, putting herself in danger. Bobby Deol, Vinod Khanna and Ameesha Patel star in this Hindi action drama directed by Naresh Malhotra.
raja-ko-rani-se-pyar-ho-gaya-2000: Raja Ko Rani Se Pyar Ho Gaya is a 2000 Hindi film directed by T. K. Rajeev Kumar, starring Arvind Swamy and Manisha Koirala, with music by Jatin–Lalit. It was Arvind Swamy's second Hindi film after Saat Rang Ke Sapne, and its title, which translates to The King Fell in Love with the Queen, hints at its romance.
mulaqaat-2002: Archana marries Javed, the man she loves, but shortly after the wedding he is killed during a fight with goons, and she withdraws into a widow's life, living only with his memory. Then someone from that night re-enters her life. Jackie Shroff and Madhoo star in this Hindi drama directed by K. Ravi Shankar.
encounter-the-killing-2002: Sam Bharucha, a senior inspector in the Mumbai Crime Branch, believes in reforming criminals rather than just punishing them. When four college boys turn to contract killing for easy money, he takes on the case, while political pressure mounts for quick encounter killings. Ajay Phansekar's crime drama stars Naseeruddin Shah and Dilip Prabhavalkar.
karz-the-burden-of-truth-2002: Suraj, an orphan abandoned by his mother, has always wondered how any mother could do that. He becomes close friends with Raja, whose mother Savitri welcomes him like a son, until Suraj discovers that he and Raja love the same woman, and a secret from the past emerges. Sunny Deol, Suniel Shetty and Shilpa Shetty star in this Hindi action drama.
hariharan-pilla-happy-aanu-2003: Hariharan Pillai runs a construction company with his uncle. When a rich moneylender refuses to pay for the house he has built, he has to find a way to recover his money, while also looking out for his sister and falling for Kavya, who at first dislikes him. Mohanlal and Jyothirmayi star in this Malayalam comedy.
kyaa-dil-ne-kahaa-2002: Esha, an Indian girl living in New Zealand, falls in love with her fellow student Rahul, who seems to feel the same. Her family happily visits his parents to arrange the wedding, but Rahul shocks everyone by refusing to marry her, and Esha is left looking for the reason.
anahat-2003: In 10th-century Shravasti, the childless king of Malla must produce an heir. Following the ancient custom of niyoga, his queen Sheelavati is asked to spend one night with a man of her choosing, an experience that awakens her to what has been missing from her life. Amol Palekar directs.
sachein-2005: Sachein, a carefree student, joins a college in Ooty and falls for the proud and short-tempered Shalini. She refuses to admit she likes him, so he makes her a bet: if she does not fall for him within 30 days, he will leave her alone. John Mahendran's romantic comedy stars Vijay, Genelia and Bipasha Basu.
chellamae-2004: Mythili has always doted on her neighbour Vishwa, the son of a business tycoon, treating him like a younger brother. When she falls in love with Ragunandan, an income tax officer, and marries him, Vishwa's feelings turn into a dangerous obsession. Vishal and Reema Sen star in this Tamil romantic thriller directed by Gandhi Krishna.
allari-bullodu-2005: When businessman Madhava Rao is injured in an accident, his daughter takes charge of his company, threatened by a crooked rival. Raju appears out of nowhere to help her, and a run of disguises and lookalikes, including a Mumbai gangster's right-hand man, soon leads to confusion. Nithiin and Trisha star in this Telugu comedy by K. Raghavendra Rao.
allari-pidugu-2005: Twin brothers Ranjith and Giri grow up on very different paths after their honest army officer father is falsely jailed for 14 years by a corrupt mafia don. Ranjith becomes a disciplined police officer, while Giri stays a carefree village youth. Nandamuri Balakrishna plays both, with Katrina Kaif and Charmy Kaur, in this Telugu action film.
eeswar-2002: Eeswar is a Telugu action drama directed by Jayanth C. Paranjee, about a young man from a poor neighbourhood who stands up for its people and falls in love along the way. It marked the screen debut of Prabhas, nephew of actor Krishnam Raju, with Sridevi Vijaykumar as the female lead and Revathi in a key role.
palanati-brahmanaidu-2003: Palanati Brahmanaidu is a 2003 Telugu action drama directed by B. Gopal, starring Nandamuri Balakrishna with Aarthi Agarwal and Sonali Bendre. Bhavani Prasad, a respected leader of Karempudi village whose people would do anything for him, meets his sister's friend, a young woman engaged to an American-born man, at the wedding, and their clash over tradition sets the story in motion.
dweepa-2002: Sita Parvata, a low-lying island in the backwaters of a dam, is slowly going under in the monsoon. Most residents take compensation and leave, but the temple priest's family refuses to abandon their home, and Nagi, his daughter-in-law, holds them together. Girish Kasaravalli's Kannada film stars Soundarya, who also produced it, and won the National Award for Best Film.
market-2003: Muskaan, a lively young woman from a small village in Andhra Pradesh, is married off by greedy parents to a wealthy man who abandons her within a week, and she is pushed into the sex trade. Years later, she sets out to fight back against the people who wronged her. Manisha Koirala stars in this Hindi crime drama directed by Jay Prakash.
chaahat-ek-nasha-2005: Mallika, a pop star, is in love with Rahul, the owner of the music company she works with. When he proposes marriage, she turns him down, saying she does not believe in it, and their relationship takes a dangerous turn. Manisha Koirala, Aryan Vaid and Preeti Jhangiani star in this Hindi romantic drama.
aasai-aasaiyai-2003: Vinod, a young graduate who dreams of running his own business, takes part-time work as a private detective. Hired to follow a rich gold merchant's daughter, Brinda, and find out whether she is in love, he ends up falling for her himself. Jiiva makes his debut in this Tamil romance directed by Ravi Mariya.
kadhal-virus-2002: Deepak, an aspiring filmmaker, goes to Coonoor to write a script and falls in love with Geetha. She wins her father's approval, and they agree to marry once his first film is made. Deepak returns to Chennai promising to write, but the letters do not reach her. Richard Rishi and Sridevi Vijaykumar star in this Tamil romance with music by A. R. Rahman.
out-of-control-2003: Out of Control is a 2003 Hindi romantic comedy starring Riteish Deshmukh, Hrishitaa Bhatt and American actress Brande Roderick. Jaswinder leaves for the United States promising his parents he will be back soon, but marries an American woman to secure his visa, while the family at home has already chosen a bride for him.
appu-2002: Appu is a carefree young man whose father, a head constable, wants him to join the police. After a fight leaves him in hospital, a young woman named Suchi pays his bills and donates her blood, then disappears, and Appu sets out to find her. Puneeth Rajkumar and Rakshita make their debuts in this Kannada romantic action film by Puri Jagannadh.
charas-2004: Set around Kasol in Himachal Pradesh, this crime thriller from Tigmanshu Dhulia explores the illegal trade in hashish in the Himalayan hills. An undercover police officer goes to investigate the drug racket. Jimmy Sheirgill, Uday Chopra and Irrfan Khan lead the cast, with Namrata Shirodkar and Hrishita Bhatt.
love-in-nepal-2004: Love in Nepal is a Hindi romantic thriller set against the hills and streets of Nepal, where a young man's romance gets tangled up in mystery and danger. Singer Sonu Nigam plays the lead, with Asha Saini and Jharana Bajracharya, in the film directed by Rajat Mukherjee.
maseeha-2002: Krishna lives in Shantinagar, a town terrorised by Surajbhan, a powerful thug with friends in the police. After suffering at Surajbhan's hands himself, Krishna vows to end his reign of terror. Suniel Shetty and Namrata Shirodkar star in this Hindi action drama directed by Partho Ghosh.
koi-mere-dil-mein-hai-2005: Raj, the son of a wealthy family, is expected to marry Simran, the US-based daughter of family friends, but he wants to find his own soulmate and falls for Asha, his sister's tutor from a poor family. Simran, meanwhile, has her own reasons for refusing. Priyanshu Chatterjee, Dia Mirza and Raqesh Bapat star in this Hindi romance.
koi-aap-sa-2005: Rohan and Simi are childhood friends. When Rohan falls for Preeti, a college mate, Simi helps bring them together, but Preeti grows jealous of their closeness. Then Simi's fiance Vicky and his friend Ranjit arrive, and things get more complicated. Aftab Shivdasani, Dipannita Sharma and Anita Hassanandani star in this Hindi romance directed by Partho Mitra.
hanuman-2005: This animated Hindi film tells the story of Hanuman from his birth to Anjani and Kesari, blessed by Vayu, the wind god. It follows the mischievous young Hanuman, gifted with great strength and divine powers, as he grows into the devoted hero of legend. Actor Mukesh Khanna narrates, and V. G. Samant directs.
perumazhakkalam-2004: Perumazhakkalam is a 2004 Malayalam drama directed by Kamal and written by T. A. Razzaq, starring Meera Jasmine, Kavya Madhavan, Dileep and Biju Menon. Working in Saudi Arabia, Akbar accidentally causes the death of a friend during a quarrel over a stolen loan, and the lives of two women back home, his wife and his friend's widow, become bound together.
priyasakhi-2005: Priyasakhi is a 2005 Tamil romance directed by K. S. Adhiyaman, starring Madhavan and Sadha. Sakhi, an automobile company employee from a big joint family, falls for a model named Priya and wins her over by using her diary to pose as her ideal man, but their marriage soon brings clashes over family life and expectations.
aethirree-2004: Mani is thrown out of the home of his sister and brother-in-law after he cancels his planned marriage to their daughter, who loves someone else. Jobless and alone, he finds himself in Chennai's Triplicane, where new troubles and romance await. Madhavan and Sadha star in this Tamil action comedy directed by K. S. Ravikumar.
ullam-ketkumae-2005: Ullam Ketkumae is a 2005 Tamil musical coming-of-age film written, shot and directed by Jeeva, with dialogue by Sujatha, starring Shaam, Arya, Laila, Asin and Pooja. Five college friends who drifted apart reunite years later for the wedding of one of them, now a cricketer, and their memories of campus life and old loves come flooding back.
attahasam-2004: Jeeva, a cheerful driving instructor, lives happily with his mother and falls for a girl named Swapna. What he does not know is that his father was murdered by a local rowdy, and that his twin brother Guru, sent away as a child, grew up very differently. Ajith Kumar plays both brothers in this Tamil action film by Saran.
majaa-2005: Govindan, a thief, has raised two sons, Aadhi and Mathi, who decide to give up stealing and live honestly. They move to a new village, where they befriend a retired officer drowning in debt to a ruthless landlord, and decide to help him. Vikram, Asin and Pasupathy star in this Tamil action comedy by Shafi, a remake of his Malayalam film Thommanum Makkalum.
balu-2005: Balu sets up a flower stall in a busy city market ruled by a gangster's henchman, and his clever handling of the thugs gives the traders new hope. He has come to the city with his mother and family, and his past is about to catch up with him. Pawan Kalyan and Shriya Saran star in this Telugu action comedy by A. Karunakaran.
gharshana-2004: Ram, a fearless and honest police officer in Hyderabad with no family to worry about, joins a special unit set up to fight organised crime. His work makes him powerful enemies, and his growing bond with a young woman named Maya puts more than his life at risk. Venkatesh and Asin star in Gautham Vasudev Menon's Telugu remake of Kaakha Kaakha.
malliswari-2004: Malliswari, the heiress to a royal estate, is hidden away as an ordinary girl to protect her from a relative who wants her fortune. Prasad, a poor bank clerk, is sent to escort her and falls for her without knowing who she is. K. Vijaya Bhaskar's romantic comedy stars Venkatesh and Katrina Kaif.
sye-2004: Students from the arts and science streams of a Hyderabad college are bitter rivals who settle their scores through rough games of rugby. When a powerful mafia don seizes the college's land, the two factions must unite and play a rugby match against his team to win it back.
narasimhudu-2005: Narasimhudu, orphaned as a child, is raised by the whole village of Kondaveedu and grows up to be its protector. When a horrific crime against a young girl shatters the village's peace, he sets out to bring those responsible to justice. N. T. Rama Rao Jr., Ameesha Patel and Sameera Reddy star in this Telugu action film directed by B. Gopal.
bardaasht-2004: Aditya, a court-martialled army officer, is told that his younger brother was shot dead by police while running away with drugs. Refusing to believe it, he starts digging and finds that a corrupt police officer is behind it. Bobby Deol, Lara Dutta, Riteish Deshmukh and Rahul Dev star in this Hindi vigilante thriller written by Vikram Bhatt.
fareb-2005: Aditya, a creative director at an ad agency, is happily married to Neha, a doctor. When he meets Riya, the wife of a wealthy client, she becomes infatuated with him and keeps trying to seduce him. He refuses her, and her obsession turns dangerous. Manoj Bajpayee, Shilpa Shetty and Shamita Shetty star in this Hindi thriller by Deepak Tijori.
oru-naal-oru-kanavu-2005: Oru Naal Oru Kanavu is a 2005 Tamil romantic drama directed by Fazil, starring Srikanth and Sonia Agarwal, with music by Ilaiyaraaja. Maya, a college student who hates to lose, gets into a war of words with Cheenu, a hardworking young man saving to see his sisters married, and dares herself to make him fall in love with her.
manmadhan-2004: Madhan, an auditor in Chennai who studies music part-time, befriends Mythili, a gentle fellow student. Secretly, he is a serial killer called Manmadhan, who targets women he believes have betrayed the men who loved them. Silambarasan and Jyothika star in this Tamil romantic crime thriller, directed by A. J. Murugan from a story by Silambarasan.
mr-prime-minister-2005: Johnny Master is a cheerful old man who sells newspapers in a village in Gujarat that survived the Kutch earthquake. When post-quake elections are announced, the villagers form their own political party and make Johnny their candidate, setting him on an unlikely path. Dev Anand writes, directs and stars in this Hindi political satire.
143-2004: Siddu is a carefree young man who is almost part of the family in Sanjana's home, where she is the beloved sister of four elder brothers. When the two run away together, fate tears them apart and each believes the other is gone. Puri Jagannadh writes and directs this Telugu romance starring Sairam Shankar and Samiksha.
mahanandi-2005: Swamy fled Rayalaseema as a child after rivals killed his parents, and later took his revenge to become a powerful don. Shankar, an orphan he raised, is now his loyal bodyguard, while a rival faction leader plots from jail to kill Swamy. Sumanth, Anushka Shetty and Srihari star in this Telugu action drama directed by V. Samudra.
a-film-by-aravind-2005: Filmmaker Aravind and his childhood friend Rishi, now a movie star, find a gripping script by a new writer, but its pages are smudged after page 60. Hoping to finish the story themselves, they head on a road trip to a remote guesthouse. Sekhar Suri writes and directs this Telugu horror thriller with Rajeev Kanakala and Rishi.
varalaru-2006: Varalaru is a 2006 Tamil action drama co-written and directed by K. S. Ravikumar, with Ajith Kumar in three roles alongside Asin and Kanika. Shivashankar, a wheelchair-using multimillionaire, sends his spoilt son Vishnu to a village to help the poor and learn responsibility, but a prank sends Vishnu there with the wrong idea, and the trip reopens the family's past.
ankahee-2006: Sheena reluctantly visits her dying father, who abandoned her and her mother sixteen years earlier, and he hands her his diary. Through it she learns how Shekhar, a happily married doctor, fell into an obsessive affair with a troubled film star, and why he left his family.
aalwar-2007: Aalwar is a temple priest in Madurai, devoted to his mother and sister. When the powerful brothers who control the temple kill his family over an old dispute, he becomes a vigilante who strikes at the corrupt in the guise of gods. Ajith Kumar and Asin star in this Tamil action film directed by Chella.
naksha-2006: Vicky discovers a hidden copy of a treasure map made by his late father, who was killed while trying to unlock an ancient mystery. Determined to follow the trail, he sets out on a dangerous adventure, and crosses paths with his estranged half-brother. Vivek Oberoi, Sunny Deol, Sameera Reddy and Jackie Shroff star in this Hindi action adventure.
june-r-2006: June R, an orphan who works at an advertising agency, comes across an injured middle-aged woman and admits her to hospital by pretending to be her daughter. The woman turns out to be a widow who has struggled to raise her only son, and an unusual bond begins. Jyothika stars in this Tamil drama directed by Revathy S. Varmha.
unnale-unnale-2007: Unnale Unnale is a 2007 Tamil musical romantic comedy written, shot and directed by Jeeva, starring Vinay, Sadha and Tanishaa. Karthik, a carefree flirt, and Jhansi, who wants a dependable partner, break up over his ways, and when work takes him to Melbourne, he meets a woman who makes him rethink everything he believed about love.
ore-kadal-2007: Dr Nathan is a brilliant, reclusive economist who drinks heavily and keeps the world at a distance. When Deepthi, a housewife from his apartment complex, approaches him for help finding her unemployed husband a job, a chance encounter grows into an intense relationship that changes both their lives.
traffic-signal-2007: Traffic Signal is a 2007 Hindi drama co-written and directed by Madhur Bhandarkar, who won the National Film Award for Best Director for it, starring Kunal Khemu, Neetu Chandra, Ranvir Shorey and Konkona Sen Sharma. The film follows the beggars, hawkers and hustlers who make their living at a busy Mumbai traffic signal, and the man who manages it.
azhagiya-tamil-magan-2007: Guru, an athlete and MBA student, falls in love with Abhinaya, the daughter of a business magnate, and their families agree to the match. Then Guru starts seeing disturbing visions of the future that come true, and one of them threatens everything. Vijay plays a dual role with Shriya Saran and Namitha in this Tamil action thriller by Bharathan.
chandamama-2007: Ranga Rao, a widowed and respected landlord, adores his daughter Mahalakshmi and his lively niece Rani, who is like a second daughter to him. When Mahalakshmi returns home, plans for her marriage set off a chain of romantic complications. Navdeep, Kajal Aggarwal and Siva Balaji star in this Telugu romantic drama by Krishna Vamsi.
swami-2007: Swami is a 2007 Hindi family drama directed by choreographer Ganesh Acharya, with a screenplay by Bhavani Iyer and Muazzam Beg, starring Manoj Bajpayee and Juhi Chawla. Swami, a poor man who barely earns a living at a jewellery shop, moves to Mumbai with his wife Radha after their marriage and pins all his hopes on giving their son a better life.
balram-vs-tharadas-2006: When a big cache of weapons is dug up on a businessman's land, the police trail leads to a dangerous gang, and two legends meet: the tough police officer Balram and the outlaw Tharadas. Mammootty plays both, with Katrina Kaif, in this Malayalam action film by I. V. Sasi, a crossover sequel to Athirathram and Inspector Balram.
kaafila-2007: Around 200 people from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh are lured by an unscrupulous agent who promises to smuggle them into Western countries for a better life. The caravan sets off on a long and dangerous journey. Sunny Deol stars in this Hindi action drama about illegal immigration, directed by Amitoj Maan.
karutha-pakshikal-2006: Murugan, a widower, moves to Kerala with his three children and makes a living ironing clothes, saving every rupee for an operation that could restore his young daughter's sight. Along the way, the family befriends Suvarna, a woman from a wealthy home who is very ill. Mammootty, Meena and Padmapriya star in this Malayalam family drama by Kamal.
anasuya-2007: Anasuya, an orphan with a degree in criminal psychology, starts work as a television reporter and takes on a story exposing child labour in a local politician's home. Soon she finds herself drawn into the investigation of a series of chilling murders. Bhumika Chawla stars in this Telugu thriller directed by Ravi Babu.
teesri-aankh-the-hidden-camera-2006: Teesri Aankh: The Hidden Camera is a 2006 Hindi action thriller directed by Harry Baweja, starring Sunny Deol with Ameesha Patel, Neha Dhupia and Aarti Chhabria. A London-based criminal runs a global racket of secretly filming women in hotel rooms, changing rooms and hostels and blackmailing them, until a determined police officer takes up the case.
iqraar-by-chance-2006: Rashmi, a carefree young woman of Indian descent living a wealthy life in England, spends money freely. When her father questions her, she bets him that she can earn 5,000 pounds in a single month, only to find that getting any job is far harder than she thought. Shilpa Anand stars in this Hindi romance directed by K. Ravi Shankar.
kachchi-sadak-2006: Kachchi Sadak is a Hindi action film directed by Sanjay D. Singh. It follows a young man named Randhir who is drawn into a world of politics and power, and the violence that comes with it. Rahul Singh and Parmita Katkar lead a cast that includes Mithun Chakraborty, Amrish Puri, Rahul Dev and Mukesh Tiwari.
aakash-2005: Aakash, a practical young man who has worked many jobs, becomes friends with Nandini, a woman from a rich family. Her brothers wrongly believe he is in love with her and set out to wreck his life. Puneeth Rajkumar and Ramya star in this Kannada romantic drama directed by Mahesh Babu and produced by Parvathamma Rajkumar.
detective-2007: When a politician's wife is found dead and her death is ruled a suicide, suspicion falls on her husband, who loses his seat in parliament. His twin brother, a respected police detective, is put in charge of the investigation and sets out to uncover what really happened.
anamika-2008: Vikram, a wealthy industrialist from Rajasthan, hires Jia for a day through an escort service to act as his secretary, and by evening has proposed marriage. She moves into his grand home, where a caretaker named Malini and the memory of the past loom large. Dino Morea and Minissha Lamba star in this Hindi thriller based on Daphne du Maurier's Rebecca.
aata-2007: Srikrishna, a village youth who wants to live like the heroes in the films at his father's theatre, meets Satya at a fair and falls for her. She is on the run from a forced marriage to Vicky, the dangerous son of a politician. Siddharth and Ileana D'Cruz star in this Telugu romantic action comedy by V. N. Aditya.
okkadunnadu-2007: Okkadunnadu is a 2007 Telugu action thriller directed by Chandra Sekhar Yeleti, starring Gopichand and Neha Jhulka with Mahesh Manjrekar in a key role. Kiran, who has the rare Bombay blood group, arrives in Mumbai to sell a property and agrees to give blood to a gangster who shares it, only to be warned that his life is in danger.
achanurangatha-veedu-2006: After his wife's death, Samuel struggles to raise his three daughters on his own. When his youngest daughter suddenly disappears, he is drawn into a painful search for the truth. Salim Kumar won a Kerala State Film Award for his role in this Malayalam drama directed by Lal Jose, with Prithviraj Sukumaran and Samvrutha Sunil.
ek-chalis-ki-last-local-2007: Nilesh, a call-centre worker, misses the last train home at 1:40 am in Mumbai. With autorickshaws on strike, he walks the night with Madhu, a stranger in trouble, and wanders into a gangster's den, a card game and a string of misadventures before dawn. Sanjay Khanduri's comedy thriller stars Abhay Deol and Neha Dhupia.
kuruvi-2008: Velu, a car racer in Chennai, learns that a crime boss in Malaysia owes his long-missing father a fortune. He travels there as a small-time courier, falls for a young woman trapped in the boss's household, and uncovers what really happened to his father. Dharani's action comedy stars Vijay, Trisha and Suman.
victory-2009: Victory is a 2009 Hindi sports film written and directed by Ajit Pal Mangat, starring Harman Baweja, Amrita Rao and Anupam Kher. Vijay, a young cricketer from a small town backed by his devoted father and his childhood friend Nandini, defies the odds to earn a place in the Indian team, and then has to deal with what sudden fame does to him.
black-and-white-2008: Rajan Mathur, an Urdu professor in Delhi's Chandni Chowk, and his activist wife take in Numair, a young man who says he is a victim of communal riots. In truth, Numair has been sent by a fundamentalist group to carry out an attack in the city. Anil Kapoor and Anurag Sinha star in this Hindi thriller directed by Subhash Ghai.
paying-guests-2009: Paying Guests is a 2009 Hindi comedy directed by Paritosh Painter and remade from the 1955 Bengali film Jay Maa Kali Boarding, starring Shreyas Talpade, Javed Jaffrey, Ashish Chaudhary and Vatsal Seth. Friends living as paying guests in Pattaya get caught up in a restaurant feud involving a debt-ridden younger brother and the gangster he owes money to.
sirf-2008: Sirf is a 2008 Hindi drama directed by Rajaatesh Nayar, starring Manisha Koirala, Kay Kay Menon, Ranvir Shorey and Sonali Kulkarni. In fast-paced Mumbai, four couples from very different walks of life wrestle with their own problems, each convinced that someone else's life looks greener on the other side, as their stories quietly overlap.
dil-kabaddi-2008: In Mumbai, two married couples, Samit and Mita and Rishi and Simi, are bored with each other. When one couple decides to separate, both marriages start to wobble as temptation and new romances enter the picture. Irrfan Khan, Rahul Bose, Konkona Sen Sharma and Soha Ali Khan star in this Hindi comedy directed by Anil Sharma.
tahaan-2008: Tahaan – A Boy With a Grenade is a 2008 Hindi drama written and directed by Santosh Sivan, set in Kashmir with Rahul Bose, Anupam Kher and Sarika. Young Tahaan scrapes together money to win back his beloved donkey Birbal, only to learn it has been sold to an old man heading across the mountains, where Tahaan's father went missing.
acid-factory-2009: Five men wake up locked inside an abandoned factory with no memory of who they are. Some of them are kidnappers and the rest are their hostages, but nobody knows which is which. As the gang's boss heads their way, they must piece together their identities before it is too late.
2-harihar-nagar-2009: Four childhood friends, Mahadevan, Govindan Kutty, Appukuttan and Thomas Kutty, return to their old neighbourhood of Harihar Nagar for a reunion, and soon find themselves tangled in a fresh mystery. Written and directed by Lal, this Malayalam comedy thriller is the sequel to In Harihar Nagar, starring Mukesh, Siddique, Jagadish and Ashokan.
gulaal-2009: Dilip, a mild law student, arrives in Rajpur and falls in with Ransa, a rebellious young prince. He is drawn into student politics and into the plans of Dukey Bana, a leader who dreams of a separate Rajputana. Anurag Kashyap's political drama stars Raj Singh Chaudhary, Kay Kay Menon, Abhimanyu Singh and Piyush Mishra.
quick-gun-murugun-2009: Quick Gun Murugun: Misadventures of an Indian Cowboy is a 2009 English-language comedy western directed by Shashanka Ghosh, starring Rajendra Prasad in the title role with Nassar and Rambha. A vegetarian Tamil cowboy takes on the villain Rice Plate Reddy, a restaurant owner scheming to create the ultimate non-vegetarian dosa.
ek-vivaah-aisa-bhi-2008: Chandni, a young woman in Bhopal, falls in love with Prem, a ghazal singer, and their families agree to the match. But when her father dies on the day of the engagement, she chooses to raise her younger siblings, and Prem promises to wait. Kaushik Ghatak's Rajshri family drama stars Isha Koppikar and Sonu Sood.
jodi-breakers-2009: Sid, recently divorced and bitter about it, starts a business breaking up couples for a fee. He teams up with Sonali, and the pair are hugely successful until one job in Greece goes wrong and makes Sid question what he is doing. Ashwini Chaudhary's romantic comedy stars R. Madhavan and Bipasha Basu.
love-ke-chakkar-mein-2006: Love Ke Chakkar Mein is a Hindi comedy about a tangle of romantic mix-ups, mistaken intentions and family chaos, as several couples' love lives go hilariously wrong. Namitha and Satish Shah are part of the ensemble cast in the film directed by B. H. Tharun Kumar.
julie-2006: Julie, a devout young Christian woman raised in a conservative home, has known Shashi, a Hindu man from her neighbourhood, since childhood. As they fall in love, their different faiths stand between them and their families. Ramya and Dino Morea star in this Kannada remake of the 1975 Hindi film Julie, directed by Poornima Mohan.
bujjigadu-2008: Bujji and Chitti are inseparable childhood friends in Vizag. After a quarrel, Chitti tells him to stay away for twelve years to prove his love, promising to marry him if he does. Bujji moves to Chennai and grows up there, counting the years. Prabhas, Trisha and Mohan Babu star in this Telugu action comedy by Puri Jagannadh.
pandurangadu-2008: Pandurangadu is a 2008 Telugu devotional film directed by K. Raghavendra Rao, based on the life of the saint Pundarika and starring Nandamuri Balakrishna with Tabu and Sneha. Pundarika, a wayward young man who copies Krishna's mischief rather than his devotion and ignores his parents, runs from marriage and home before his path slowly begins to change.
pankh-2010: Pankh is a 2010 Hindi drama written and directed by Sudipto Chattopadhyaya, starring Bipasha Basu, Lillete Dubey, Ronit Roy and newcomer Maradona Rebello. As a child, Jerry was made to play girls' roles in films as Baby Kusum, and as a young man hoping to become a hero, he struggles with the identity forced on him and a strained bond with his mother.
subramaniapuram-2008: In 1980s Madurai, a group of jobless young friends hang around the house of a former councillor. Desperate for respect, they agree to commit a crime for his family, setting off a chain of betrayal and violence. Sasikumar's debut period drama stars Jai, Swathi, Sasikumar and Samuthirakani.
ugly-aur-pagli-2008: Kabir, a carefree engineering student who has failed for ten years, meets Kuhu, a wild, drunk young woman, at a Mumbai railway station. She bosses him around and puts him through humiliating tests, yet he keeps coming back. Sachin Khot's romantic comedy, a remake of the Korean film My Sassy Girl, stars Ranvir Shorey and Mallika Sherawat.
c-kkompany-2008: A struggling crime reporter, a retired accountant and a mall mascot, each fed up with ordinary life, invent a fake underworld gang to scare people into doing the right thing. The prank works too well, and soon the real mafia wants a piece of them. Sachin Yardi's black comedy stars Tusshar Kapoor, Anupam Kher, Rajpal Yadav and Mithun Chakraborty.
mukhbiir-2008: Kailash, a young man with a troubled past, is recruited to work as an undercover police informer, infiltrating dangerous criminal gangs. The biggest threat to his life is not the criminals but corrupt police officers who could sell his identity. Sameer Dattani stars with Suniel Shetty, Om Puri and Jackie Shroff in this Hindi spy thriller directed by Mani Shankar.
mirch-2010: Maanav, a struggling filmmaker who refuses to compromise on his script, pitches a different idea to a producer: four stories, drawn from ancient tales like the Panchatantra, about clever women and infidelity, retold across different times. Konkona Sen Sharma, Raima Sen, Shahana Goswami and Arunoday Singh star in this Hindi anthology by Vinay Shukla.
tera-mera-ki-rishta-2009: Tera Mera Ki Rishta is a 2009 Punjabi romantic drama directed by Navaniat Singh, starring Jimmy Sheirgill and Kulraj Randhawa with Anupam Kher, Raj Babbar and Archana Puran Singh. On a trip for a family wedding, Meet, a young man hungry for adventure, falls for Raijo despite their different upbringings, while his mother is busy arranging his marriage back home.
namo-venkatesa-2010: Venky, a kind-hearted ventriloquist, is told by an astrologer that if he does not marry within a month he will stay single forever. On a performing trip to Paris, he meets a group of con men and a young woman who needs his help. Venkatesh and Trisha star in this Telugu action comedy directed by Srinu Vaitla.
boni-2009: DD and Chinna are close friends raised in an orphanage by a kind woman known for her tamarind rice. To earn money to open a shop in her memory, DD takes odd jobs for a mafia gang, and soon meets Pragati, the daughter of a millionaire. Sumanth and Kriti Kharbanda star in this Telugu action film directed by Raj Pippalla.
city-of-gold-2010: In 1980s Mumbai, a family of textile-mill workers struggles to survive as a long strike drags on and the mills begin to close. As politics and greed reshape the city, three brothers each take a different path to keep the family afloat. Mahesh Manjrekar adapts Jayant Pawar's Marathi play Adhantar, made in Hindi and Marathi versions.
phas-gaye-re-obama-2010: Om Shastri, an Indian-American businessman ruined by the recession, returns to his ancestral village to sell his property. He is kidnapped by a small-time gang who think he is rich, and his captors soon learn he is just as broke as they are. Subhash Kapoor's satire stars Rajat Kapoor, Neha Dhupia, Sanjay Mishra and Manu Rishi.
mynaa-2010: Suruli has loved Mynaa since they were children in a hill village, where he helped her and her widowed mother find a home. As they grow up, her mother opposes the match, and events lead to Suruli being jailed, setting off a tense journey across the hills with two policemen.
chal-chala-chal-2009: Deepak, an honest simpleton, keeps changing jobs to avoid the corrupt system while helping his father with a long legal fight. When he becomes the owner of a private bus, his life changes, and not always for the better. Govinda and Reema Sen star in this Hindi comedy, a remake of the Malayalam film Varavelpu.
rathinirvedam-2011: Rathinirvedam is a 2011 Malayalam drama directed by T. K. Rajeev Kumar, starring Shwetha Menon and Sreejith Vijay, and a remake of the 1978 film based on P. Padmarajan's novel. Waiting for his exam results at his mother's village home, teenage Pappu becomes infatuated with Rathi, an older neighbour who has always treated him like a younger brother.
bombay-march-12-2011: Based around the 1993 Bombay bomb blasts, this Malayalam drama follows a man whose life is turned upside down after he is wrongly linked to the attacks, and the long shadow that suspicion casts over him and those around him. Mammootty and Unni Mukundan star in the film, written and directed by Babu Janardhanan in his debut.
naughty-40-2011: Harvinder, a 40-year-old man living in London with his parents, has never had a girlfriend and has a habit of sleepwalking into trouble. His worried father enlists a friend's help to find him a wife, setting off a string of comic misadventures. Govinda and Yuvika Chaudhary star, with Anupam Kher and Shakti Kapoor, in this Hindi adult comedy.
pilla-zamindar-2011: Pilla Zamindar is a 2011 Telugu coming-of-age comedy drama written and directed by G. Ashok, starring Nani, Haripriya and Bindu Madhavi. Praveen, the spoilt, arrogant grandson of a wealthy zamindar, learns on his 18th birthday that he will inherit the family fortune only if he meets the conditions of his grandfather's will, including finishing his degree at a village college.
nagaram-2008: Right, a rowdy known for his good deeds, works as a hired gun for mafia boss Qaasim Bhai. When Navya, a PhD student researching criminals, enters his life, he begins to change, while a police officer who believes in eliminating criminals is closing in. Srikanth and Jagapati Babu star in this Telugu action film by C. C. Srinivas.
malik-ek-2010: Malik Ek is a Hindi devotional film about the life and teachings of Sai Baba of Shirdi, the saint revered by people of all faiths. Jackie Shroff plays Sai Baba, with Manoj Kumar and Divya Dutta, in the film directed by Deepak Balraj Vij, with music by Anup Jalota, who also appears in it.
angadi-theru-2010: Jyothi, a bright village boy forced to give up his studies after his father's death, takes a job at a huge textile showroom on Chennai's busy Ranganathan Street. Working long hours under cruel supervisors, he falls in love with his colleague Kani as they fight for dignity amid exploitation.
madrasapattinam-2010: In 1947 Madras, Amy, the daughter of the British governor, falls in love with Parithi, a young washerman, just as India is about to win its freedom. Decades later, an elderly Amy returns to Chennai to look for him. Vijay's period romance stars Arya and Amy Jackson.
aasal-2010: Jeevanandham, a powerful arms dealer and negotiator based in Paris, has three sons, but only the bold and righteous Shiva earns his trust. The other two, led by a scheming uncle, want to deal in drugs and weapons. Ajith Kumar plays a dual role with Sameera Reddy and Bhavana in this Tamil action thriller by Saran.
aakhari-decision-2010: Aakhari Decision is a 2010 Hindi action film directed by Deepak Bandhu. Amar Sidhu and Sumona Chakravarti play the leads, with Anant Jog and Nagesh Bhonsle in important supporting roles, in a story of crime and confrontation that builds towards the final decision of its title.
prithvi-2010: Prithvi is a 2010 Kannada action thriller directed by Jacob Verghese, starring Puneeth Rajkumar and Parvathy Thiruvothu. A young IAS officer newly posted as Deputy Commissioner of Bellary arrives with his wife and soon learns of the illegal mining and water pollution ravaging the district, setting him against powerful interests.
velayudham-2011: Velayudham is a 2011 Tamil superhero film directed by M. Raja, starring Vijay in the title role with Genelia, Hansika Motwani and Santhanam. A journalist investigating a string of terror attacks in Chennai narrowly escapes from the men behind them, and a chain of chance events turns Velayudham, a simple village milkman newly arrived in the city, into a masked hero.
love-u-mr-kalakaar-2011: Sahil, a talented painter, falls in love with Ritu, the daughter of a successful businessman. Her father does not think an artist can make a good husband, so Sahil sets out to prove himself on the businessman's own terms. Tusshar Kapoor and Amrita Rao star in this Hindi romance directed by S. Manasvi.
that-girl-in-yellow-boots-2010: Ruth, a young British woman, comes to Mumbai looking for the father who abandoned her family years ago. With little money and no documents, she works at a massage parlour while chasing every lead, and is drawn into a dangerous web. Anurag Kashyap's thriller stars Kalki Koechlin, Naseeruddin Shah and Gulshan Devaiah.
azhagarsamiyin-kuthirai-2011: In a village near Theni, the wooden horse that carries the deity during the annual temple festival goes missing, and the villagers fear the rains will never come. In a nearby village, Azhagarsami, who earns a living with his horse, finds that his animal has also disappeared, and his wedding is put on hold.
traffic-2011: On one day in Kochi, a young journalist is fatally injured in a road accident, and his heart must reach a sick child in Palakkad within hours. A disgraced traffic constable volunteers to drive it through crowded roads against the clock. Rajesh Pillai's road thriller, which reshaped Malayalam cinema, stars Sreenivasan, Kunchacko Boban, Rahman and Anoop Menon.
arjunan-saakshi-2011: A reporter receives a letter from a man calling himself Arjunan, who claims to be the only witness to the murder of a former district collector. When Roy, an architect new to Kochi, is mistaken for the mysterious witness, he finds himself hunted and decides to uncover the truth himself.
f-a-l-t-u-2011: Three friends who fail their exams, plus a fourth who passes, invent a fake university to fool their parents. When the parents want to visit, they turn an empty building into a real campus, and hundreds of other rejected students show up. Remo D'Souza's comedy stars Jackky Bhagnani, Puja Gupta, Angad Bedi and Arshad Warsi.
pranchiyettan-and-the-saint-2010: Pranchiyettan, a rich but lonely rice merchant in Thrissur, has spent his life chasing respect and recognition. One night in church, Saint Francis of Assisi appears before him, and Pranchi pours out the story of his many failed attempts to be admired. Ranjith's satirical comedy stars Mammootty, Priyamani and Khushbu.
rajapattai-2011: Rajapattai is a 2011 Tamil masala film co-written and directed by Suseenthiran, starring Vikram and Deeksha Seth, with music by Yuvan Shankar Raja. Murugan, a gym-trained young man who dreams of playing villains in films, befriends an old man being pressured to sell his orphanage to a land-grabbing politician, and decides to stand up for him.
doctor-love-2011: Vinayachandran, a failed romance novelist, has a gift for solving other people's love problems. He takes a job in a college canteen, and when he helps a student win over the girl he loves, he becomes the campus's go-to love doctor. Kunchacko Boban, Bhavana and Ananya star in this Malayalam romantic comedy by K. Biju.
dandupalya-2012: Based on real events, this Kannada crime film tells the story of the Dandupalya gang, a band of criminals who carried out a string of robberies and brutal murders in and around Bangalore, terrorising the city, and the police effort to stop them. Pooja Gandhi and Makarand Deshpande star, directed by Srinivas Raju.
celluloid-2013: This Malayalam biographical drama tells the story of J. C. Daniel, the man who made the first Malayalam film. Driven by his love of cinema, he gathers equipment, meets Dadasaheb Phalke and struggles to find an actress willing to appear on screen. Prithviraj Sukumaran and Mamta Mohandas star, directed by Kamal.
3g-2013: While on holiday in Fiji, Sam loses his phone and buys a new one with a 3G connection. Soon he starts getting calls from an unknown number that show a video of a woman being killed, and he and his girlfriend Sheena are pulled into a terrifying mystery. Neil Nitin Mukesh and Sonal Chauhan star.
kili-poyi-2013: Chacko and Hari, two young advertising professionals fed up with their boss, take a break in Goa. On the way back they end up with a mysterious bag, and their lives spin into chaos. Asif Ali and Aju Varghese star in this Malayalam stoner comedy directed by Vinay Govind.
sunglass-2013: Sunglass is a bilingual satirical comedy written and directed by Rituparno Ghosh, with Jaya Bachchan, Naseeruddin Shah, R. Madhavan and Konkona Sen Sharma in the cast. A married couple caught in the seven-year itch see their lives turned upside down by a mysterious pair of sunglasses that seems to let the wearer hear other people's thoughts.
billa-ii-2012: A prequel to Billa, this Tamil action film follows David Billa, a refugee from the coast of Sri Lanka who arrives at a camp in Rameswaram. After clashing with a corrupt police officer, he is drawn into crime and begins his rise to become a feared underworld don. Ajith Kumar stars, directed by Chakri Toleti.
ishq-2012: Rahul, a cheerful young man, meets Priya on a flight and falls for her. But her overprotective brother Siva, who has his own painful history with love, stands between them. Nithiin and Nithya Menen star, with Ajay, in this Telugu romantic action comedy written and directed by Vikram Kumar.
thiruvambadi-thamban-2012: Thiruvambadi Thamban is a 2012 Malayalam action thriller directed by M. Padmakumar and written by S. Suresh Babu, starring Jayaram and marking actor Kishore's Malayalam debut. Thamban, a Thrissur businessman whose family has supplied elephants for temple festivals for generations, makes a dangerous enemy when a trip home leads to a clash with a ruthless Madurai politician.
moondru-per-moondru-kadal-2013: Three love stories unfold in three very different landscapes: Varun and Anjana in the mountains of Ooty, Guna, a big-hearted man on the Tuticorin seashore, and a young couple in the city. As the stories connect, each lover learns something about sacrifice. Arjun, Cheran, Vimal and Surveen Chawla star in this Tamil romance directed by Vasanth.
alex-pandian-2013: Alex Pandian and Divya leap from a train to escape goons who want them dead. Days later, Alex turns up at the house of Kaalayan, whose three sisters he quickly charms, much to their brother's annoyance. Karthi and Anushka Shetty star in this Tamil action comedy written and directed by Suraj, with Santhanam.
nuvva-nena-2012: Nuvva Nena is a 2012 Telugu romantic comedy and the debut of director Pendyala Veera Venkata Sathya Narayana, starring Allari Naresh, Sharwanand and Shriya Saran. A small-time thief newly arrived in Hyderabad and a rich, confident young man fall for the same doctor, setting off a comic rivalry between the two.
chaarulatha-2012: Charu and Latha are conjoined twins in Vizag who share everything, until both fall for the same man, Ravi, and he chooses Charu. When their mother decides to have them surgically separated, the sisters' lives take a terrifying turn. Priyamani plays both in this horror film made in Kannada and Tamil, directed by Pon Kumaran.
kanna-laddu-thinna-aasaiya-2013: KK, Power Kumar and Shiva are three unemployed friends who spend their days drinking and chasing girls. When Sowmiya moves in across the street, all three fall for her and agree to let her choose, then try every trick to win her over. Santhanam, Srinivasan and Sethu star in this Tamil romantic comedy by K. S. Manikandan.
life-is-beautiful-2012: Srinu and his sisters move to a middle-class Hyderabad colony and soon make friends with the young people there, sharing crushes, rivalries and dreams. Their neighbourhood is fighting a legal battle with a wealthy rival colony over a shared lake. Sekhar Kammula writes and directs this Telugu coming-of-age drama with a cast of newcomers, with Shriya Saran and Amala Akkineni.
soodhu-kavvum-2013: Das, a small-time kidnapper with five strict rules and an imaginary girlfriend, takes on three unemployed young men as assistants. When they break his first rule and kidnap a minister's son, the bumbling gang ends up in way over their heads. Nalan Kumarasamy's black comedy stars Vijay Sethupathi, Bobby Simha and Ashok Selvan.
mumbai-police-2013: ACP Antony Moses loses his memory in an accident just after telling his superior that he has solved the murder of a fellow officer. He must now reinvestigate the case from scratch, piecing together who he was and what he knew. Rosshan Andrrews's neo-noir thriller stars Prithviraj Sukumaran, Jayasurya and Rahman.
david-2013: Two men named David live in different parts of India in different years. One, in 1999 Mumbai, is a cheerful young guitarist from a poor Christian family who dreams of a music career; the other is a fisherman in Goa. Their lives are about to take dramatic turns. Vikram and Jiiva star in this Tamil drama directed by Bejoy Nambiar.
kalyana-samayal-saadham-2013: Raghu, a software engineer in Chennai, is engaged to Meera in a traditional arranged match, and both large families are eagerly preparing for the wedding. Then Raghu discovers he has erectile dysfunction, and his attempts to fix the problem quietly, with plenty of advice from friends and quacks, lead to comic chaos.
hotel-california-2013: A city police commissioner, a small-time crook and a don named Jimmy are among the colourful characters whose paths cross in a chaotic night of schemes, affairs and double-crosses. Jayasurya, Anoop Menon and Honey Rose star in this Malayalam crime caper directed by Aji John and written by Anoop Menon.
d-for-dopidi-2013: Four friends, Vicky, Raju, Harish and Bannu, each desperately need money to fix their problems. After trying everything else, they decide to rob a bank, only to find another gang has picked the same day. Varun Sandesh, Sundeep Kishan and Naveen Polishetty star in this Telugu heist comedy directed by Siraj Kalla.
gunde-jaari-gallanthayyinde-2013: Karthik, a software engineer, falls for Sruthi at a friend's wedding reception. When a mix-up over her phone number leads him to call another woman, Sravani, by mistake, he begins a romance on the phone with the wrong person. Nithiin, Nithya Menen and Isha Talwar star in this Telugu romantic comedy directed by Vijay Kumar Konda.
jackpot-2013: A gang of swindlers in Goa devises an elaborate plan to con rich gamblers at a casino card game, and risks everything, only to get caught in a web of their own making. Naseeruddin Shah, Sunny Leone, Sachiin J Joshi and Bharath star in this Hindi comedy thriller directed by Kaizad Gustad.
bhajarangi-2013: Jeeva, a young man plagued by bad luck, is told by a priest to visit the village of Ramadurga to learn the secret of his birth. There he clashes with the henchmen of a dark sorcerer and begins to discover his own past. Shiva Rajkumar and Aindrita Ray star in this Kannada fantasy action film directed by A. Harsha.
ankhon-dekhi-2013: Bauji, a man in his late fifties living with his extended family in a cramped old Delhi house, suddenly decides he will believe only what he sees with his own eyes. His radical new outlook bewilders his family and neighbours, and turns his ordinary life into a philosophical journey.
rush-2012: Rush is a 2012 Hindi crime thriller directed by Shamin Desai, starring Emraan Hashmi, Aditya Pancholi, Neha Dhupia and Sagarika Ghatge. Samar Grover, a struggling news reporter whose marriage is falling apart, accepts a lucrative assignment from a powerful media tycoon, a decision that pulls him into a dangerous world of money, politics and crime.
krantiveera-sangolli-rayanna-2012: This Kannada historical drama tells the story of Sangolli Rayanna, the fearless warrior and senior commander in the army of Rani Chennamma of Kittur, who led an uprising against the British East India Company in the early 19th century. Darshan plays Rayanna, with Jaya Prada and Nikita Thukral, directed by Naganna.
endrendrum-punnagai-2013: Gautham, raised by his father to believe that women cannot be trusted, grows up with two inseparable friends and runs an advertising agency with them. When the friends start to marry and drift away, and Gautham meets Priya, he must face his old beliefs. Jiiva, Trisha, Vinay and Santhanam star in this Tamil romantic comedy by I. Ahmed.
isai-2015: Vetriselvan is an old-school music director, loved and respected. When his assistant Shiva starts composing on his own and his modern synthesiser sound makes him the new favourite, the jealous older man plots his downfall. S. J. Suryah writes, directs, scores and stars with Sathyaraj in this Tamil musical thriller.
janda-pai-kapiraju-2015: Aravind, raised in an ashram with strong moral values, finds those values challenged by the corrupt society he meets when he leaves home. He decides to fight corrupt officials and soon finds his path crossing with a lookalike who lives very differently. Nani plays both, with Amala Paul, in this Telugu political drama written and directed by Samuthirakani.
saptapadii-2013: Saptapadii is a 2013 Gujarati drama produced by Amitabh Bachchan Corporation, starring Swaroop Sampat and Manav Gohil. Swati, a woman settled in a comfortable 20-year marriage and an expert in treating traumatised children, meets a deeply troubled nine-year-old during an anniversary trip to Saputara, and resolves to help him, whatever it costs her.
bajatey-raho-2013: When a fraudulent banker cheats their family, Sukhi and his relatives decide to fight back the only way they can: by conning the con man. Their schemes involve stings, disguises and plenty of chaos. Tusshar Kapoor, Dolly Ahluwalia, Ranvir Shorey and Vinay Pathak star in this Hindi comedy directed by Shashant Shah.
vai-raja-vai-2015: Vai Raja Vai is a 2015 Tamil black comedy crime thriller written and directed by Aishwarya R. Dhanush, starring Gautham Karthik, Priya Anand and Vivek. Karthik, a middle-class IT worker who has a gift for sensing things before they happen and has long kept it hidden, is coaxed by a gambler colleague into using it for money.
memories-2013: Sam Alex, once a brilliant police officer, has turned to alcohol after losing his wife and daughter to a terrorist's revenge. When a serial killer starts targeting young men across the city, Sam is pulled back to lead the hunt. Prithviraj Sukumaran stars in this Malayalam crime thriller written and directed by Jeethu Joseph.
bhaji-in-problem-2013: Sundeep Cheema is secretly married to two women, each unaware of the other, and has kept up the double life by claiming his work keeps him away. His careful balance is threatened when a young man named Jeeta enters the picture. Gurpreet Ghuggi and Gippy Grewal star in this Punjabi comedy directed by Smeep Kang.
oru-indian-pranayakadha-2013: Sidharthan, a scheming young politician, is passed over for a party seat and takes a job as a guide for Irene, a Canadian woman of Indian origin who has come to Kerala to find her roots. As they travel together, his outlook begins to change. Sathyan Anthikad's romantic comedy stars Fahadh Faasil and Amala Paul.
jatt-james-bond-2014: Shinda, mistreated by his relatives, is desperate to find a way to marry his love Laali. With two friends, he comes up with a plan to solve all their problems at once: rob the local bank. Gippy Grewal and Zareen Khan star in this Punjabi film directed by Rohit Jugraj, with Gurpreet Ghuggi and Yashpal Sharma.
tevar-2015: Pintoo, a kabaddi player from Agra, rescues Radhika in Mathura from a powerful politician's brother who wants to marry her by force after killing her brother. He hides her in his own home in Agra, unaware that his police officer father has been ordered to find her.
ente-2013: Based on a real story, this film follows Durga, a bright young student who is active in protests against violence towards women. When she moves to Hyderabad for further studies against her father's wishes, she is drawn into the dark world of trafficking. Anjali Patil stars in this social drama by Rajesh Touchriver, co-produced by activist Sunitha Krishnan.
roar-tigers-of-the-sundarbans-2014: Roar: Tigers of the Sundarbans is a 2014 Hindi adventure thriller written and directed by Kamal Sadanah. After his photojournalist brother is killed by a white tigress in the Sundarbans, Pandit leads a team of commandos into the forest's prohibited core area to hunt her down, and the jungle soon turns the hunters into the hunted.
current-theega-2014: In Parvatipuram, Siva Rama Raju has vowed that none of his three daughters will marry for love, and that any man who elopes with one of them will pay dearly. Then a young man sets his sights on Kavita, his third daughter. Manchu Manoj, Rakul Preet Singh and Jagapathi Babu star in this Telugu action comedy by G. Nageswara Reddy.
aadu-2015: In the hills of Idukki, Shaji Pappan and his ragtag friends win a goat named Pinky in a tug-of-war contest. Meanwhile, a Bangkok gangster is sent to Kerala to find a rare and valuable herb, and the two stories are about to collide. Jayasurya stars in this Malayalam action comedy by Midhun Manuel Thomas.
dharam-sankat-mein-2015: Dharampal, a Hindu caterer in Ahmedabad with a strong dislike of Muslims, is stunned to learn that he was adopted and born to a Muslim family. As he tries to find his birth father, his son's engagement to the daughter of a strict religious leader hangs in the balance. Paresh Rawal stars with Naseeruddin Shah and Annu Kapoor in this Hindi comedy.
second-hand-husband-2015: Second Hand Husband is a 2015 Hindi romantic comedy directed by Smeep Kang, starring Gippy Grewal and Dharmendra and marking the film debut of Govinda's daughter Tina Ahuja. Rajbir and Gurpreet want to marry, but his monthly alimony to his ex-wife stands in the way, so lawyer Gurpreet comes up with a plan to find the ex-wife a new husband.
daha-balunga-2013: Daha Balunga is an Odia drama directed by Sudhakar Vasanth, starring Babushaan and Sanjana Mitra in the lead roles, with Bollywood actor Jackie Shroff making his debut in Odia cinema. The film blends action, romance and family emotion, with music by Abhijit Majumdar.
one-by-two-2014: One by Two is a 2014 Hindi romantic comedy directed by Devika Bhagat, starring Abhay Deol and Preeti Desai. In Mumbai, Amit is stuck in a dull job and still hung up on the girlfriend who left him, while Samara, an aspiring dancer, wrestles with her own ambitions, and their separate lives run side by side.
100-degree-celsius-2014: Five women share a flat in the city: a housewife, a banker, an IT professional, a TV reporter and a college student. When they get caught up in a crime, their ordinary lives are turned upside down. Based on a real incident, this Malayalam thriller by Rakesh Gopan stars Shwetha Menon, Meghna Raj, Bhama and Ananya.
7th-day-2014: On Christmas night, police officer David Abraham's jeep hits a motorcycle carrying two young men, Shan and Vinu. When Vinu slips away from the hospital, David senses something is wrong, and Shan begins to tell him the story of his group of friends. Prithviraj Sukumaran stars in this Malayalam crime thriller directed by Syamdhar.
kuch-kuch-locha-hai-2015: Praveen Patel, a 45-year-old Gujarati shop owner in Kuala Lumpur, is secretly infatuated with Bollywood star Shanaya Khanna, while his son Jigar is in love with their neighbour. When a chance comes to spend time with his dream girl, a comedy of lies and mix-ups follows. Sunny Leone, Ram Kapoor and Evelyn Sharma star.
rajinimurugan-2016: Rajinimurugan is a 2016 Tamil masala comedy written and directed by Ponram, starring Sivakarthikeyan with Keerthy Suresh, Soori and Rajkiran. Rajini Murugan, an unemployed young man in Madurai who spends his days with his best friend and looking after his respected grandfather, sees a way out when the old man decides to divide his property.
super-nani-2014: Super Nani is a 2014 Hindi comedy drama directed and produced by Indra Kumar, based on the Gujarati play Baa Ae Maari Boundary, starring Rekha, Sharman Joshi, Randhir Kapoor and Anupam Kher. A grandmother who has spent her life serving an ungrateful family gets an unlikely ally in her grandson, who sets out to transform her life and make her family see her worth.
kis-kisko-pyaar-karoon-2015: Kumar Shiv Ram Kishan accidentally ends up married to three different women, Juhi, Simran and Anjali, each unaware of the others. He juggles all three by inventing excuses, but when he falls in love with a fourth woman, keeping the secret becomes almost impossible. Comedian Kapil Sharma makes his film debut in this Hindi comedy by Abbas–Mustan.
fraud-saiyaan-2015: Bhola Prasad Tripathi is a con man who marries rich women and lives off them. He seems settled with his wife Sunita in Lucknow, but when her uncle comes to visit and the goons he owes money to come after him, his many marriages start to unravel. Arshad Warsi, Saurabh Shukla and Sara Loren star in this Hindi dark comedy.
yevade-subramanyam-2015: Yevade Subramanyam? is a 2015 Telugu coming-of-age drama and the directorial debut of Nag Ashwin, starring Nani, Malvika Nair, Vijay Deverakonda and Ritu Varma. Subbu, a ruthless young corporate climber engaged to his boss's daughter, ends up on a trek to the Himalayas to fulfil the wish of a carefree childhood friend, a journey that makes him rethink his life.
umrika-2015: In a small Indian village, a family lives for letters from their son Udai, who left for America years ago. When his younger brother Rama discovers the letters were fake, he sets out for Mumbai to find out what happened to Udai. Prashant Nair's comedy drama stars Suraj Sharma, Tony Revolori and Smita Tambe.
bhale-bhale-magadivoy-2015: Lucky, an absent-minded botanist who constantly forgets what he is doing, falls in love with Nandana, a Kuchipudi dance teacher. He manages to hide his forgetfulness from her, but keeping up the act becomes harder when her father turns out to be the man who once rejected him.
jyothi-lakshmi-2015: Satya, a young man, searches for a particular woman he has seen and finds her: Jyothi Lakshmi, a sex worker. He insists on marrying her, and she sets out to build a new life, but leaving her past behind proves far from easy. Charmy Kaur stars in this Telugu drama directed by Puri Jagannadh.
doddmane-hudga-2016: Surya, a short-tempered young cook who makes biryani at a local market, saves a young woman from goons and falls for her. When a local thug with political ambitions clashes with the respected Doddmane family, Surya is drawn into the fight. Puneeth Rajkumar and Radhika Pandit star with Ambareesh in this Kannada action drama by Duniya Soori.
jadoogadu-2015: Jadoogadu is a Telugu action comedy directed by Yogie, with Naga Shourya and Sonarika Bhadoria in the lead roles and Ashish Vidyarthi and Ajay in supporting parts. The film mixes action, romance and comedy in a story built around its quick-witted, fast-talking young hero.
paayum-puli-2015: Paayum Puli is a 2015 Tamil action thriller written and directed by Suseenthiran, starring Vishal and Kajal Aggarwal with Soori and Samuthirakani. In Madurai, a gang kidnaps leading businessmen for ransom and kills those who refuse to pay, and after an officer on the case is murdered, a new policeman is brought in to bring them down.
kavalai-vendam-2016: Aravind is a carefree, flirtatious chef running a restaurant in the hill town of Coonoor, living by the motto 'don't worry'. Beneath the jokes lies a past involving his ex-wife Divya, the woman he truly loved, and she is about to walk back into his life. Jiiva and Kajal Aggarwal star in this Tamil romantic comedy written and directed by Deekay.
pichaikkaran-2016: Arul, a wealthy businessman, is told by a holy man that his comatose mother may recover if he lives as a beggar for 48 days without revealing who he is. He takes the vow and lives on the streets, while a greedy relative plots to seize his fortune. Sasi's action drama stars Vijay Antony and Satna Titus.
anuraga-karikkin-vellam-2016: Abhi, a young architect looking for work, breaks up with his devoted girlfriend Eli on a friend's advice. His father Raghu, a strict police officer, has a romantic past of his own that suddenly resurfaces. Biju Menon, Asif Ali, Asha Sarath and Rajisha Vijayan star in this Malayalam romantic comedy, the debut of director Khalid Rahman.
garam-2016: Varala Babu, who never did well at studies and is criticised by his father, leaves home for Hyderabad to prove himself. Instead of finding a job, he falls in love with Sameera, and trying to win her lands him in trouble. Aadi and Adah Sharma star in this Telugu action romantic comedy written and directed by Madan.
hebbuli-2017: Ram, an army para commando, rushes home to Bangalore when he learns that his brother, an IAS officer, has died in what police are calling a suicide. Refusing to accept that, he starts his own investigation. Sudeep stars with Amala Paul, and V. Ravichandran in an extended cameo, in this Kannada action thriller directed by S. Krishna.
ek-thi-rani-aisi-bhi-2017: This Hindi biographical film tells the story of Vijaya Raje Scindia, the Rajmata of Gwalior, tracing her journey from royal life to public service and politics as the princely states merged into independent India. Based on Mridula Sinha's book, it stars Hema Malini as the Rajmata, with Vinod Khanna, directed by Gul Bahar Singh.
one-night-stand-2016: One Night Stand is a 2016 Hindi romantic drama written by Bhavani Iyer and directed by Jasmine D'Souza, starring Sunny Leone and Tanuj Virwani. After a work event in Phuket, Urvil spends a night with a stranger he meets while celebrating, and back home he finds he cannot let go of the encounter, which begins to unsettle his life.
kanchana-3-2018: A businessman's family seeks help when their daughter seems possessed, and exorcists trap a violent spirit inside a tree. When a young man and his family later visit the area, the spirits find a new host. Raghava Lawrence writes, directs and stars in this fourth instalment of the Muni–Kanchana Tamil horror comedy series, with Oviya and Vedhika.
dhruva-2016: Dhruva, a determined young police officer, decides to go after the man behind the biggest crimes in the system rather than small-time criminals. His target turns out to be Siddharth Abhimanyu, a brilliant scientist with powerful connections. Ram Charan, Arvind Swamy and Rakul Preet Singh star in this Telugu remake of Thani Oruvan, directed by Surender Reddy.
aadupuliyattam-2016: Legend says that anyone who enters an old palace once home to a woman named Chempakam is killed by a supernatural force. The story then turns to Sathyajith, a wealthy businessman, his wife Amala and their daughter Aami. Jayaram, Om Puri and Ramya Krishnan star in this Malayalam horror film by Kannan Thamarakkulam.
aksar-2-2017: Sheena is hired as a governess for Dolly Khambata, a wealthy old woman, even though she is far younger than the job requires. Dolly's scheming financial adviser has his own designs on Sheena and on the old lady's fortune, and a dangerous game begins. Zareen Khan and Gautam Rode star in this Hindi erotic thriller, the sequel to Aksar.
vivegam-2017: Vivegam is a 2017 Tamil action thriller directed by Siva, starring Ajith Kumar with Vivek Oberoi, Kajal Aggarwal and Akshara Haasan. AK, a counter-terror field commander officially listed as dead, resurfaces in a Serbian forest to intercept an arms deal, and as his old agency realises he is alive, he finds himself hunted by the very people he once trusted.
annmariya-kalippilaanu-2016: Annmaria, a spirited ten-year-old, dreams of winning a long jump medal and of meeting the angel her father says once blessed him. When a bully makes her life miserable, she seeks help from an unlikely source: a small-time crook. Sara Arjun and Sunny Wayne star in this Malayalam children's film by Midhun Manuel Thomas, with a cameo by Dulquer Salmaan.
wrong-side-raju-2016: Wrong Side Raju is a 2016 Gujarati thriller drama directed by Mikhil Musale, inspired by a 2013 hit-and-run case in Ahmedabad, starring Pratik Gandhi, and winner of the National Film Award for Best Gujarati Film. Raju, a driver by day and bootlegger by night who dreams of starting a travel agency, is pulled into the aftermath of a deadly crash.
magalir-mattum-2017: Prabha, a feisty documentary filmmaker, moves in with her future mother-in-law, a retired teacher who misses her two school friends she lost touch with decades ago. Prabha decides to reunite the three women and take them on a road trip. Jyothika, Urvashi, Bhanupriya and Saranya Ponvannan star in this Tamil comedy drama by Bramma.
mister-2017: Chai, a carefree young man living in Spain, falls for Meera, a girl visiting from India, and follows her back home. There he is pulled into a village power struggle on the Andhra–Karnataka border involving his own family and a smuggler. Varun Tej, Lavanya Tripathi and Hebah Patel star in this Telugu action comedy by Srinu Vaitla.
machine-2017: Machine is a Hindi romantic thriller directed by Abbas–Mustan, introducing Mustafa Burmawalla as a young man whose whirlwind romance with a young woman, played by Kiara Advani, plunges both of them into a twisting world of secrets, deceit and danger, with Ronit Roy and Johnny Lever in supporting roles.
indu-sarkar-2017: During the Emergency of 1975 to 1977, Indu, a shy young poet who stammers, is married to an ambitious government official eager to use the political climate to advance his career. As she witnesses the abuses around her, her conscience sets her on a very different path.
paisa-vasool-2017: Theda Singh, a brash, short-tempered tough guy in Hyderabad, is recruited by a special police unit to bring down a dreaded international gangster. The hunt takes him all the way to Portugal, where his unpredictable methods are put to the test. Puri Jagannadh's action comedy stars Nandamuri Balakrishna, Shriya Saran and Musskan Sethi.
vekh-baraatan-challiyan-2017: Vekh Baraatan Challiyan is a 2017 Punjabi romantic comedy directed by Ksshitij Chaudhary and written by Naresh Kathooria, with Binnu Dhillon, Ranjit Bawa and Kavita Kaushik. Jaggi, a Sikh Jat from Punjab working as a bus conductor, falls for a Haryanvi girl, but when a priest declares him manglik and warns the match is doomed, both families set out to fix the stars.
hey-jude-2018: Jude, a maths genius who loves the ocean but struggles with people, lives awkwardly with his antique-dealer father in Kochi. A trip to Goa throws him together with Crystal, a free-spirited young woman with troubles of her own, and the unlikely friendship changes both of them. Shyamaprasad's romantic comedy stars Nivin Pauly and Trisha in her Malayalam debut.
aami-2018: A biopic of the writer Kamala Das. Manju Warrier stars.
