dakuaan-da-munda-2018: A young man's struggle with drug addiction. Based on a true story.
mumbai-saga-2021: The rise of a gangster in 1980s and 90s Bombay. John Abraham stars.
tagaru-2018: A cop hunts a gang of killers. Shiva Rajkumar stars.
agnyaathavaasi-2018: When a powerful businessman and his son are murdered by trusted partners plotting to seize his company, his widow calls on a secret heir to set things right. Abhishikth, raised in hiding, joins the firm under a false identity and sets out to expose the killers and protect his family's empire.
paltan-2018: The 1967 clashes at Nathu La and Cho La. J. P. Dutta directs.
aapla-manus-2018: Late one night, Aaba, the elderly father of a young lawyer, falls from the balcony of the family flat. Inspector Nagargoje, who looks strikingly like Aaba, starts questioning the son and his wife, and their tense relationship with the old man starts to look suspicious. Nana Patekar plays both roles.
trance-2019: A motivational speaker is turned into a fake faith healer. Fahadh Faasil stars.
rajma-chawal-2018: After his wife's death, Raj moves with his son Kabir back to their old house in Chandni Chowk. Desperate to reconnect with his withdrawn son, Raj creates a fake social media profile as a young woman to talk to him, and the plan quickly spirals. Leena Yadav's comedy drama stars Rishi Kapoor, Anirudh Tanwar and Amyra Dastur.
kala-shah-kala-2019: A dark-skinned man is rejected by marriage prospects. Binnu Dhillon stars.
bhonsle-2018: Bhonsle, a lonely police constable, has just retired and lives in a run-down Mumbai chawl. As a local politician stirs up hatred against migrants from North India ahead of the Ganesh festival, he befriends a young woman from Bihar and her brother, and is forced to take a stand. Manoj Bajpayee stars in this Hindi drama by Devashish Makhija.
antariksham-9000-kmph-2018: When an Indian satellite loses contact and starts drifting towards a collision that could black out communications worldwide, only one person knows the codes to fix it: Dev, a brilliant scientist who quit the space programme five years ago. Varun Tej, Aditi Rao Hydari and Lavanya Tripathi star in this Telugu space adventure by Sankalp Reddy.
unda-2019: A unit of Kerala policemen is sent on election duty to a Maoist-affected area of Chhattisgarh. Short of ammunition and poorly prepared, they face danger, boredom and their own fears in a hostile place. Khalid Rahman's black comedy drama stars Mammootty, Shine Tom Chacko and Jacob Gregory.
game-over-2019: A woman with a fear of the dark must survive a killer. Taapsee Pannu stars.
music-teacher-2019: Beni, a middle-aged music teacher in the hill town of Solan, lives with his mother and sister and nurses regrets about Jyotsna, a gifted former pupil who left for fame in Mumbai. When she returns for a concert, old wounds and unspoken feelings resurface.
laabam-2021: A man fights for farmers' rights. Vijay Sethupathi stars.

sheer-qorma-2021: In this short romantic drama, a non-binary person and the woman they love return home in search of acceptance, only to face a disapproving mother and the weight of family expectations. Shabana Azmi, Divya Dutta and Swara Bhasker star in Faraz Arif Ansari's film.
suraj-pe-mangal-bhari-2020: A wedding detective clashes with a groom. Manoj Bajpayee and Diljit Dosanjh star.
virgin-bhanupriya-2020: Bhanupriya is a studious, sheltered young woman who has never been in a relationship. Prodded by her friends, she decides she wants to lose her virginity, and her clumsy attempts set off a series of comic misadventures with her family and suitors. Urvashi Rautela stars, with Gautam Gulati and Archana Puran Singh.

daddy-2001: Raj, a wealthy music company owner whose passion is dance, marries Shanti and dotes on their young daughter Akshaya. Chiranjeevi and Simran star in this Telugu family drama directed by Suresh Krissna and produced by Allu Aravind.
poovellam-un-vaasam-2001: Chinna and Chella have grown up as best friends in neighbouring houses, and their families have been friends for decades. When they fall in love, a misunderstanding and a family quarrel threaten both the romance and the friendship. Ezhil's drama stars Ajith Kumar and Jyothika, with Sivakumar, Nagesh and Vivek.
annayya-2000: Rajaram, who owns a fleet of lorries, has raised his younger brothers with love and indulgence. When garment factory owner Devi complains that the boys have been teasing her sisters, the two families' lives start to become entwined. Chiranjeevi and Soundarya star, with Ravi Teja and Venkat, in this Telugu family drama directed by Muthyala Subbaiah.
citizen-2001: Abdullah, a mild motorcycle mechanic, leads a secret life as Citizen, a master of disguise who kidnaps a judge, a collector and other officials. Each abduction points back to Attipatti, a village whose fate holds the key to his mission. Saravana Subbiah's political thriller stars Ajith Kumar in multiple guises, with Meena, Vasundhara Das and Nagma.
narendran-makan-jayakanthan-vaka-2001: Jayakanthan returns from Kumbakonam to the Kerala village where his late father was born, to claim his inheritance. There he clashes with Vinodini, the strict village council president, and with a family that fears he is after their daughter and estate. Kunchacko Boban and Samyuktha Varma star in this Malayalam satire by Sathyan Anthikad, written by Sreenivasan.
rhythm-2000: Rhythm is a 2000 Tamil romantic drama written and directed by Vasanth, starring Arjun and Meena with Jyothika and Ramesh Aravind. Karthikeyan, a photo editor at a Mumbai newspaper, keeps running into Chitra, a reserved bank employee, on his daily commute, and as they slowly grow closer, both carry quiet losses from their past.
shahjahan-2001: Shahjahan is a 2001 Tamil romantic drama written and directed by Ravi and produced by R. B. Choudary, starring Vijay and Richa Pallod with Vivek. Ashok makes a habit of helping couples elope against their families' wishes, but when he falls for an engineering student named Mahee, a painful memory involving a close friend keeps him from saying a word.
vinnukum-mannukum-2001: Vinnukum Mannukum is a 2001 Tamil romance written and directed by Rajakumaran, starring Sarathkumar, Vikram and Khushbu, with Devayani playing a fictional version of herself. Sakthivel, the adored head of his Coimbatore village, wants his younger brother Selvam to marry, but Selvam insists on finding the girl he saw in a dream, who turns out to be a film star.
aanandham-2001: Thirupathisamy is the respected eldest of four brothers who all live under one roof with their parents and run the family's provision store. He has pulled them through hard times, but new marriages bring new tensions. Mammootty leads an ensemble cast in this Tamil family drama, the directorial debut of N. Lingusamy.
grahan-2001: When a woman named Parvati files a police complaint of sexual assault against the son of the chief minister, she sets out on a long fight for justice, only to find that the system is stacked against her. Manisha Koirala and Jackie Shroff star in this Hindi crime drama directed by Shashilal K. Nair.
narasimha-naidu-2001: Narasimha Naidu, a quiet dance teacher in Visakhapatnam, wins the heart of Anjali, the daughter of a violent factionist. When her family discovers his hidden past as a protector of his ancestral village in a long, bloody feud, the old rivalries return. B. Gopal's action drama stars Nandamuri Balakrishna, Simran and Preeti Jhangiani.
pennin-manathai-thottu-2000: Pennin Manathai Thottu is a 2000 Tamil romantic drama written and directed by S. Ezhil, starring Prabhu Deva and Jaya Seal, with R. Sarathkumar in a guest role. When a young woman brings a child with a heart condition to a hospital in Trichy, she is shaken to find that the surgeon is a man from her past, and their story unfolds in flashback.
samudhiram-2001: Samudhiram is a 2001 Tamil family drama directed by K. S. Ravikumar, with an ensemble cast led by Sarathkumar, Murali, Manoj Bharathiraja, Kaveri, Abhirami and Sindhu Menon. Three devoted brothers dote on their only sister, and when a proud rich man from a nearby village feels insulted by them at a temple festival, he arrives with a marriage proposal for her.
mujhe-meri-biwi-se-bachaao-2001: Anand, a pleasure-loving middle-class man, marries Kamini, the overbearing daughter of a rich man, for her money. When she inherits everything and keeps him on a tight leash, he starts an affair and begins scheming to get rid of her. Harry Baweja's comedy, inspired by Ruthless People, stars Naseeruddin Shah, Rekha and Arshad Warsi.
style-2001: Style is a 2001 Hindi buddy comedy thriller directed by N. Chandra, starring Sharman Joshi, Sahil Khan, Riya Sen and Shilpi Sharma, which became a sleeper hit. Bantu and Chantu, two college pranksters famous for outfoxing everyone, realise as graduation nears that they are not cut out for hard work, and hatch a plan to marry rich, which lands them in serious trouble.
valliettan-2000: Valliettan is a 2000 Malayalam action drama directed by Shaji Kailas and written by Ranjith, starring Mammootty, Shobana and Sai Kumar. When a feuding relative loses a long court battle and must give up the ancestral Arackal house, his son vows revenge, and Madhavanunni, the eldest brother of his family, stands firm to protect the home and his siblings.
rahul-2001: Rahul is a 2001 Hindi drama directed by Prakash Jha and produced by Subhash Ghai, starring Yash Pathak, Neha Bajpai, Jatin Grewal and Rajeshwari Sachdev. Mira marries Akash against her wealthy family's wishes, and years later their young son Rahul is left caught in the middle as his parents' marriage falls apart.
manasantha-nuvve-2001: As children in Araku Valley, Anu, the daughter of a wealthy officer, and Chanti, the son of a poor widow, become close friends, until her father's transfer separates them. Years later, both are still searching for each other. Uday Kiran and Reema Sen star in this Telugu romantic drama directed by V. N. Aditya.
meghamalhar-2001: Rajeevan, a married lawyer, and Nandita, a married writer, meet by chance after a mix-up over birthday cakes. They discover shared tastes and memories, and a deep but unspoken bond forms between them, testing the limits of friendship. Kamal's romantic drama stars Biju Menon and Samyuktha Varma.
aadhi-2002: A young man returns to his family's ancestral village in Rayalaseema to avenge the murder of his parents, setting himself against the ruthless faction leader who has terrorised the region for years. N. T. Rama Rao Jr. stars with Keerthi Chawla in this Telugu action drama, the debut of director V. V. Vinayak.
pudhiya-geethai-2003: Pudhiya Geethai is a 2003 Tamil supernatural action drama written and directed by K. P. Jagan, starring Vijay with Meera Jasmine and Ameesha Patel. At his birth, an astrologer foresees that Sarathy will grow up brilliant and responsible but will live only 27 years, a prediction kept from him as he grows into a young man in Chennai.
raghavendra-2003: Raghavendra is a 2003 Telugu action film directed by Suresh Krishna and written by Posani Krishna Murali, starring Prabhas, Anshu and Shweta Agarwal. In the temple town of Mantralayam, Raghava, a devotee of Sri Raghavendra Swamy, has sworn off violence, and a spirited relative who loves him mistakes his calm restraint for cowardice.
sri-manjunatha-2001: Sri Manjunatha is a 2001 Kannada and Telugu devotional film directed by K. Raghavendra Rao, based on the life of the Shiva devotee Bhakta Manjunatha and starring Chiranjeevi, Arjun Sarja, Soundarya and Meena. Manjunatha, a kind-hearted atheist who openly scorns Lord Shiva, marries a woman about to be dedicated to temple service, unaware the god is watching over him.
thamizh-2002: Thamizh is a 2002 Tamil action drama and the directorial debut of Hari, starring Prashanth and Simran with Vadivelu, Urvashi and Ashish Vidyarthi. Anbazhagan returns home from three years of work in Kuwait to his wife, children and mother, but when he asks about his younger brother Thamizh, nobody will give him a straight answer.
three-roses-2003: Three Roses is a 2003 Tamil action adventure directed by Parameswar, starring Rambha, Jyothika and Laila, with Vivek and Urvashi, and music by Karthik Raja. Three friends return from studying music abroad and are drawn into the case of a friend jailed for travelling from Dubai on a false passport, who faces execution if she is sent back.
devan-2002: A photographer is murdered in his home, and though he tries to record his killer on camera, the man's identity stays hidden. As police hunt the murderer, he moves on to his next target, and an investigation begins. Arun Pandian makes his directing debut and stars in this Tamil action thriller, his 50th film as an actor, with Meena and Vijayakanth.
aadanthe-ado-type-2003: Surya is a young man who claims to hate love, yet he is charmed by Brunda, who admires him as a friend. A few coincidences convince him that she loves him back, until she introduces him to her fiance. Aryan Rajesh and Anita Hassanandani star in this Telugu remake of the Tamil film Mounam Pesiyadhe, directed by E. V. V. Satyanarayana.
meesa-madhavan-2002: Madhavan is a clever village thief who steals only to clear his family's debts and is oddly respected by the villagers. When he is wrongly accused of stealing the idol of the village goddess, he escapes from police custody to find the real culprit. Dileep and Kavya Madhavan star in this Malayalam action comedy by Lal Jose.
kash-aap-hamare-hote-2003: Amrita, the adopted daughter of the wealthy Yashwant Raj, is meant to marry his son Randeep, who runs a business in Canada and has no wish to come home. To bring him back, Yashwant pretends to have heart trouble, setting off a chain of romantic complications. Sonu Nigam and Juhi Babbar star in this Hindi romantic drama by Ravindra Peepat.
harivillu-2003: Ravi, the son of a rich businessman, is a brilliant student, a gifted painter and a talented musician. He also has cancer and knows his time is short. What he wants most is a kind of love his caring parents do not quite know how to give. B. Narsing Rao writes and directs this sensitive Telugu drama produced by D. Rama Naidu.
kuch-tum-kaho-kuch-hum-kahein-2002: Abhay is invited with his mother and sister to his grandfather's village for the old man's 60th anniversary, ending years of estrangement. Though first met with hostility, he wins the family over, and falls for a girl from a rival family. Fardeen Khan and Richa Pallod star in this Hindi romantic drama directed by K. Ravi Shankar.
oomappenninu-uriyadappayyan-2002: Oomappenninu Uriyadappayyan is a 2002 Malayalam romantic comedy directed by Vinayan and written by Kaloor Dennis, starring Jayasurya, Kavya Madhavan and Indrajith Sukumaran. A poor, talkative young man who paints billboards for a living falls for a wealthy young woman who cannot hear or speak, and pretends to be mute himself to win her heart.
aithe-2003: Four young men in Hyderabad, each desperate for money and none with a criminal record, are recruited by a wanted Mumbai gangster for a job that promises to change their lives. The plan is to hijack a flight, but the scheme turns out to be far more dangerous than they were told.
preethse-2000: Preethse is a 2000 Kannada psychological thriller directed by D. Rajendra Babu and produced by Rockline Venkatesh, starring Upendra, Shiva Rajkumar and Sonali Bendre. Kiran, a college student heading home for Holi, is obsessively pursued by a classmate, while her boyfriend, a special forces commander, is away on a hostage rescue mission at sea.
kalyana-ramudu-2003: Kalyana Ramudu is a Telugu family comedy directed by G. Ram Prasad, a remake of the Malayalam hit Kalyanaraman. Venu Thottempudi and Prabhu Deva lead the cast with Nikita Thukral, in a light-hearted story of family, romance and the comic chaos that surrounds a wedding.
missamma-2003: Nanda Gopal, an efficient young professional, tries to impress his boss Meghana to win a promotion but ends up losing his job instead. Meghana offers to take him back if he passes a few unusual tests, and he soon learns there is more to her request than it seems. Bhumika Chawla, Sivaji and Laya star in this Telugu drama by Neelakanta.
yuvakudu-2000: Yuvakudu is a 2000 Telugu romantic drama directed by A. Karunakaran and produced by Nagarjuna, starring Sumanth and Bhumika Chawla in her film debut, with Jayasudha. Siva, a free-spirited college student and the son of an army officer killed on duty, secretly wants to join the army despite his mother's fears, and falls for a girl who does not return his love.
pyaar-kiya-nahin-jaatha-2003: Pyaar Kiya Nahin Jaatha is a 2003 Hindi romance directed by Mahesh Manjrekar, starring Diwakar Pundir and Sonali Bendre in the lead roles, with Om Puri in the supporting cast. The film is a musical love story that follows its young couple through the ups and downs of falling in love.
ammo-okato-tareekhu-2000: On the first day of the month, salary day, the residents of a middle-class neighbourhood juggle bills, debts, demands and dreams, as everyone waits for the pay packet to arrive. Written and directed by E. V. V. Satyanarayana, this Telugu black comedy has an ensemble cast including Srikanth, Raasi and Prema.
vasu-2002: Vasu is a 2002 Telugu musical romantic comedy co-written and directed by A. Karunakaran, starring Venkatesh and Bhumika Chawla, with music by Harris Jayaraj. Vasu has spent seven years running a college canteen and teaching music while his father, a senior IPS officer, pushes him toward the civil services, but all Vasu wants is to make it as a singer.
vaseegara-2003: Vaseegara is a 2003 Tamil romantic comedy written and directed by K. Selva Bharathy, a remake of the Telugu film Nuvvu Naaku Nachav, starring Vijay and Sneha with Vadivelu. Bhoopathy, a carefree youth from Pollachi, is sent to stay with his father's best friend in Chennai, whose daughter is engaged to an NRI, and the two bicker endlessly before falling for each other.
satyam-2003: Satyam is a 2003 Telugu romantic drama and the debut of director Surya Kiran, produced by Nagarjuna and starring his nephew Sumanth, with Genelia in her first Telugu film. Satyam, an aspiring songwriter who ghostwrites for a selfish, famous lyricist, is misunderstood by both his father and the girl he loves, and sets out to make his own name before confessing his feelings.
ela-cheppanu-2003: Sekhar, a successful young businessman, is involved in a road accident that kills Amar, a businessman from Germany who had come to India to marry his childhood sweetheart, Priya. Haunted by guilt, Sekhar sets out to help her rebuild her life without telling her the truth. Tarun and Shriya Saran star in this Telugu remake of Tum Bin.
april-maadhathil-2002: Kathir, a bright student from a poor family, becomes close friends with Shwetha at college, and the two fall in love without ever admitting it. In their final year, as their group of friends prepares to go their separate ways, Shwetha's father plans her marriage to someone else.
ramanaa-2002: Fifteen tahsildars are abducted across Tamil Nadu, and one is found dead. The killing is claimed by a secret group fighting corruption, led by Ramanaa, a professor whose own past turned him against a corrupt system. A. R. Murugadoss's vigilante thriller stars Vijayakanth, Simran and Ashima Bhalla.
chanthupottu-2005: Radhakrishnan was raised as a girl by a grandmother who longed for a granddaughter, and in his coastal village he is mocked for his gentle, feminine ways. He spends his days with the village girls, teaching dance, while his best friend Malu is courted by others. Dileep stars in this Malayalam drama directed by Lal Jose.
stop-violence-2002: Stop Violence is a 2002 Malayalam action film directed by A. K. Sajan, starring Prithviraj Sukumaran in his second released film, with Vijayaraghavan and Chandra Lakshman in her debut. A police inspector who heads the city's anti-goonda squad secretly runs its underworld himself, and a war with a rival gang sweeps up his young henchman Sathan.
yai-nee-romba-azhaga-irukey-2002: Yai! Nee Romba Azhaga Irukey! is a 2002 Tamil romantic musical written and directed by Vasanth, starring Shaam, Sneha, Rajiv Krishna and Jaya Re, about four young people coping with unrequited love. Hari moves to Chennai for a job, to the annoyance of his cousins, and soon runs into Swapna, a girl who keeps playing pranks on him.
solla-marandha-kathai-2002: Solla Marandha Kathai is a 2002 Tamil drama written and directed by Thankar Bachan, based on Nanjil Nadan's novel Thalaikeezh Vigithangal and starring Cheran and Rathi. Sivadhanu, an unemployed postgraduate who must support his poor family, is married into a rich businessman's household, and struggles to keep his self-respect as a dependent son-in-law.
banda-paramasivam-2003: Stepbrothers Pandiyan and Cheran have spent their lives competing, and their daughters Manju and Anju carry on the feud, each trying to prove she is better. When marriage proposals enter the picture, the rivalry turns comic. Prabhu, Kalabhavan Mani, Abbas and Rambha star in this Tamil comedy directed by T. P. Gajendran.
sur-the-melody-of-life-2002: Sur – The Melody of Life is a 2002 Hindi musical drama directed by Tanuja Chandra, starring Lucky Ali and Gauri Karnik, and loosely based on the Telugu film Swati Kiranam. Vikramaditya, a celebrated singer who teaches at a music school, longs to shape one truly special voice, and when he finds a gifted young student, admiration slowly turns to envy.
praan-jaye-par-shaan-na-jaye-2003: Praan Jaye Par Shaan Na Jaye is a 2003 Hindi black comedy directed by Sanjay Jha that captures life in a Mumbai chawl, with Raveena Tandon, Rinke Khanna and Aman Verma in the cast. When the landlord announces plans to demolish the crowded building for a commercial complex, its quarrelsome but close-knit residents band together to save their homes.
rain-2005: Rain is a 2005 Hindi erotic thriller directed by Amol Shetge, starring Meghna Naidu and Himanshu Malik. Sandhya, a blind novelist who lives alone with a troubled past and an intense fear of rain, is visited by an admiring reporter who poses as her psychiatrist to draw out her story, and the two are drawn into a risky relationship.
neythukaran-2002: Neythukaran is a 2002 Malayalam drama and the directorial debut of Priyanandanan. Murali plays Appa Mestry, an ageing weaver and lifelong communist who lives on memories of the movement's great days and cannot accept the news that his hero E. M. S. Namboodiripad has died. Murali won a National Film Award for the role.
malayali-mamanu-vanakkam-2002: Anandakuttan's mother wants her long-lost daughter at his wedding, so he travels to Tamil Nadu with his uncle to find his sister and her husband. His sister sends her own daughter back with him to escape an unwanted marriage, and the girl decides Anandakuttan is in love with her. Jayaram, Prabhu and Roja star in this Malayalam comedy by Rajasenan.
duplicate-sholay-2002: Duplicate Sholay is a Hindi spoof of the classic 1975 film Sholay, directed by Kanti Shah. It borrows the famous story of a village, a vengeful former officer and two hired heroes taking on a fearsome dacoit, and turns it into a low-budget parody. Joginder Shelly and Dhananjay Singh appear in the cast.
neetho-2002: Neetho is a 2002 Telugu romance directed by John Mahendran that marked the screen debut of Prakash Kovelamudi, son of filmmaker K. Raghavendra Rao. A calm new student at a Hyderabad college falls for a short-tempered classmate, and her clash with a powerful faction leader pulls him into a conflict tied to his family's past.
seetayya-2002: Seetayya is a Telugu action drama directed by Y. V. S. Chowdary and written by Posani Krishna Murali, starring Nandamuri Harikrishna with Soundarya and Simran, and with music by M. M. Keeravani. In Rayalaseema, two faction families are locked in a long blood feud, and the respected Seetayya, a man known for his sense of justice, is drawn into the conflict.
ek-hindustani-2003: Sunil, the son of a freedom fighter who taught him that it is better to die than live as a coward, moves from Allahabad to Bombay to study law so he can fight for justice. In the city he comes face to face with corruption and crime. Suniel Shetty and Raveena Tandon star in this Hindi action film directed by Tinnu Anand.
jurm-2005: Avinash, a wealthy businessman, is arrested for the murder of his wife Sanjana. The evidence points to him, yet he is not sure himself whether he did it, so he turns to his friend and lawyer Rohit for help. Bobby Deol, Lara Dutta and Milind Soman star in this Hindi thriller written and directed by Vikram Bhatt.
jai-chiranjeeva-2005: When an arms dealer brings a dangerous new gun to India, a stray bullet from it kills the young niece of a cheerful family man. Grief-stricken, he sets out to find the people responsible. Chiranjeevi stars with Sameera Reddy, Bhumika Chawla and Arbaaz Khan in this Telugu action comedy by K. Vijaya Bhaskar.
vishwa-thulasi-2004: Vishwa Thulasi is a 2004 Tamil drama directed by Sumathy Ram, starring Mammootty and Nandita Das, with music by M. S. Viswanathan and Ilaiyaraaja. Set between the 1940s and the 1960s, it follows Thulasi as she returns to her village to teach dance, still unable to forget Vishwa, the man she has loved for twenty years, until a chance meeting.
thirupaachi-2005: Thirupaachi is a 2005 Tamil action drama written and directed by Perarasu and produced by R. B. Choudary, starring Vijay with Trisha and Mallika. Giri, a village blacksmith devoted to his sister, follows her to Chennai after her marriage, and after saving a court witness from a feared gangster, he decides to take on the rowdies who rule the city.
arul-2004: Arul, a factory worker in Coimbatore who has broken away from his family of goldsmiths, clashes with a corrupt MLA, and the confrontation ends in the politician's death. Once out of prison, Arul faces the dead man's brother, a powerful kingmaker bent on revenge. Vikram and Jyothika star in this Tamil action drama directed by Hari.
andhrawala-2004: Munna, a slum dweller in Hyderabad, learns that his father was Shankar Pehalwan, a labourer who stood up for Telugu workers in Mumbai against a gangster called Bade Mia, and who was killed with his wife when Munna was a baby. N. T. Rama Rao Jr. plays a dual role in this Telugu action film by Puri Jagannadh.
naa-alludu-2005: Karthik, insulted during a job interview by a powerful industrialist named Bhanumati, vows to take revenge by marrying one of her daughters. Soon both daughters, Meghana and Gagana, are in love with him, while her nephew Rahul has plans of his own. N. T. Rama Rao Jr., Shriya and Genelia star in this Telugu action comedy by Vara Mullapudi.
andhrudu-2005: Surendra, an honest police sub-inspector, is framed by a corrupt colleague and clashes with his superior, the ACP. Meanwhile, the ACP's daughter Archana, an aspiring singer, is learning music from Surendra's father. Gopichand and Gowri Pandit star in this Telugu romantic action drama written and directed by Paruchuri Murali.
padmashree-laloo-prasad-yadav-2005: Padmashree Laloo Prasad Yadav is a 2005 Hindi comedy directed by Mahesh Manjrekar, whose title combines the names of its four lead characters. Laloo's long-suffering girlfriend Padma flies to Cape Town to recover jewels that rightfully belong to her family, only to find him already waiting there, eager to win her forgiveness.
adavi-ramudu-2004: As a child, Madhu tells a tribal boy, insulted by her uncle, to get an education so people will respect him. Ten years later Ramu turns up at her college, and the two fall in love, but her hot-headed, powerful mother is determined to keep them apart. Prabhas and Aarthi Agarwal star in this Telugu romantic action film by B. Gopal.
anjaane-2005: Aaditi and Aditya live a comfortable life in a mansion with their two children, until Aditya leaves the family for another woman and a bitter custody battle follows. Then strange, unsettling events begin in the house. Based on the film The Others, this Hindi horror film stars Manisha Koirala, Sanjay Kapoor and Helen.
achuvinte-amma-2005: Vanaja, a single mother, and her daughter Achu, a civil engineer, share a close bond and keep no secrets from each other, or so Achu believes. When Achu falls in love with Ijo, a young lawyer, and wants to marry him, questions about Vanaja's past resurface and test their relationship.
arasatchi-2004: Siddharth, the tough general manager of a five-star hotel, trains the owner's daughter Lara when she returns from abroad, and the two fall in love. Meanwhile, a campaign against a powerful minister's crimes pulls them into danger. Arjun stars with Lara Dutta, in her Tamil debut, in this vigilante action film directed by N. Maharajan.
thoda-tum-badlo-thoda-hum-2004: Thoda Tum Badlo Thoda Hum is a 2004 Hindi romance written and directed by Esmayeel Shroff, starring Aarya Babbar and Shriya Saran. Raju and Rani are neighbours and classmates whose families are close friends, but the two cannot stop fighting, and after one quarrel goes too far, their rivalry slowly starts turning into something else.
aga-bai-arrecha-2004: Ranga, a mid-level executive in Mumbai, feels that women control every part of his life, from his boss to his wife and family. During a village fair he mockingly prays to understand what women want, and suddenly gains the power to hear their thoughts. Sanjay Narvekar stars in this Marathi comedy by Kedar Shinde.
kuthu-2004: Guru, a friendly young man from a middle-class family, joins college and falls for Anjali, a fellow student who does not return his feelings at first. Her father, a rich and powerful gangster, is fiercely protective of her. Silambarasan and Ramya star in this Tamil romantic action comedy, a remake of the Telugu film Dil.
maurya-2004: Manu, a passionate kickboxer in Bangalore, lives for his mother Meena, a college lecturer who raised him after being separated from his father. He falls for Alamelu, a girl from Andhra Pradesh, but his happy life is shaken when tragedy strikes. Puneeth Rajkumar and Meera Jasmine star in this Kannada sports drama directed by S. Narayan.
insaaf-the-justice-2004: Vishwanath, an honest IAS officer in Mumbai, is outraged when his wife tells him she has been sexually assaulted by a man named Bunty. When the police back away from the case after learning who Bunty's family is, the fight for justice becomes personal. Dino Morea, Sanjay Suri and Namrata Shirodkar star in this Hindi drama.
the-tiger-2005: The Tiger is a 2005 Malayalam action crime thriller directed by Shaji Kailas and written by B. Unnikrishnan, starring Suresh Gopi and Siddique with Gopika and Sai Kumar. After an honest customs officer who intercepted a container of fake currency is gunned down by a corrupt police commissioner, a fearless officer is brought in to expose the network behind it.
bangaram-2006: Bangaram, a TV news reporter, dreams of working for the BBC, and for that he needs the signature of a powerful man named Peddi Reddy. Instead he gets caught up with Reddy's daughters, one of whom is being forced into a marriage while she loves someone else. Pawan Kalyan and Meera Chopra star in this Telugu action film by Dharani.
anbe-aaruyire-2005: Siva, an investigative journalist, and Madhu, a rich and spirited young woman, share a live-in relationship full of fiery fights and passionate make-ups. When Madhu opens a restaurant with a friend's brother, jealousy drives them apart, and their own alter egos join the argument. S. J. Suryah directs and stars with Nila, with music by A. R. Rahman.
chithiram-pesuthadi-2006: Thiru, a fearless karate fighter, saves the son of a local don and is hired as his henchman, to the dismay of his mother and sister. Then he clashes with Charu, a social worker who fights injustice, and the two slowly fall for each other. Narain and Bhavana make their Tamil debuts in this romantic drama, Mysskin's first film.
madhurey-2004: Madhuravel, a vegetable vendor in a city market, is a do-gooder who protects a widowed woman and her daughters and fights loan sharks and goons. When a briefcase dropped during one of his fights is opened, its contents set off a dangerous chain of events. Vijay stars with Sonia Agarwal and Rakshita in this Tamil action film directed by Ramana Madhesh.
venky-2004: Venky is a 2004 Telugu action comedy thriller directed by Srinu Vaitla, starring Ravi Teja, Sneha and Ashutosh Rana. Venky, a jobless youth from Vizag, unexpectedly clears a police recruitment test with his three friends, and on the train to Hyderabad for training he falls for a young woman who flatly turns him down, before trouble boards the train too.
mogudu-pellam-o-dongodu-2005: Murthy, an NRI, marries Satyabhama, a well-educated village girl. On their wedding night they are told to wait until midnight for an auspicious hour, and as they count the minutes, a first-time thief sneaks into the house. Raja, Shriya Saran and Brahmanandam star in this Telugu comedy, notable for having only three characters on screen.
godavari-2006: Ram, an idealistic young man who wants a career in politics, is heartbroken when his cousin chooses another man. He boards a cruise down the Godavari river to Bhadrachalam to attend her wedding, and on board meets Sita, an independent fashion designer running from her own family's pressures.
thaamirabharani-2007: Thaamirabharani is a 2007 Tamil action drama written and directed by Hari, starring Vishal and newcomer Bhanu, with Prabhu and Nadhiya, and music by Yuvan Shankar Raja. Bharani, the carefree nephew and heir of a rich Thoothukudi trader, is pursued by a lively college girl, and then discovers that she belongs to the rival Tirunelveli family his own has long feuded with.
udhaya-2004: Udhaya is a 2004 Tamil action film directed by Azhagam Perumal, starring Vijay and Simran with Vivek and Nassar, and music by A. R. Rahman. Udhaya, a brilliant physics student, turns down a research post at Princeton to teach at his college, where he falls for a woman who turns out to be engaged, and he moves to another city to forget her.
chennai-kadhal-2006: Gautham, a college dropout with no direction, falls in love with Narmada, who has moved into a hostel after learning that her father is a local don. When her father plans to marry her to his partner's brother, the young lovers run away to Mumbai, with danger close behind. Bharath and Genelia D'Souza star in this Tamil romance by Vikraman.
mayookham-2005: Unni and Indira are childhood friends. When Indira returns from the US years later, she is shocked to find Unni has become a rebel, far from his traditional upbringing. She tries to help him start afresh, and love slowly blossoms. Saiju Kurup and Mamta Mohandas make their debuts in this Malayalam romance directed by Hariharan.
delhii-heights-2007: In a high-rise apartment block in Delhi, the lives of several families intertwine. Abheer and his wife work for rival companies and find work spilling into their marriage, while their neighbours, including a fun-loving Sikh family, have dramas of their own. Jimmy Sheirgill, Neha Dhupia and Om Puri star in this Hindi drama by Anand Kumar.
alice-in-wonderland-2005: Alby dotes on his sister Alice, who has an intellectual disability. When a kind young magician named Victor enters their lives and Alice is drawn to him, the bond between brother and sister is strained, while Alby himself grows close to Sophia, a visiting researcher. Jayaram and Sandhya star in this Malayalam drama by Sibi Malayil.
auto-shankar-2005: Shankar, a cheerful middle-class autorickshaw driver, stands up for the poor against Maya, a ruthless moneylender who uses crude methods to recover loans and is the daughter of a powerful woman don. Their battles soon become personal. Upendra, Shilpa Shetty and Radhika Kumaraswamy star in this Kannada action film directed by D. Rajendra Babu.
chain-kulii-ki-main-kulii-2007: Karan is a 13-year-old boy in a run-down orphanage with two dreams: to find parents and to become a great cricketer like his hero Kapil Dev. Then he gets his hands on an old cricket bat that seems to bring him magical luck. Zain Khan and Rahul Bose star in this Hindi family sports comedy directed by Karanjeet Saluja.
sringaram-2007: Sringaram is a 2007 Tamil period drama and the directorial debut of cultural activist Sharada Ramanathan, co-written by novelist Indra Soundar Rajan, with Aditi Rao Hydari in her Tamil debut. On the eve of India becoming a republic, a young dancer is taken to meet an old temple dancer, and the story turns back to the 1920s and the devadasi tradition.
holiday-2006: Muskaan, a shy girl from a wealthy family, goes on holiday to a Goa resort with her parents and meets Dino, a dance performer there. When his dance partner can no longer perform, Muskaan steps in, and as he trains her, love blooms. Dino Morea and Onjolee Nair star in this Hindi dance romance by Pooja Bhatt, a remake of Dirty Dancing.
kamli-2006: Kamli, a young woman from a Lambada tribal community, is forced to sell her first-born daughter, a practice common in her community where girl children are unwelcome. Her story opens up the cruel trade in baby girls and the swapping of children. Nandita Das plays the title role in this Telugu drama directed by K. N. T. Sastry.
veera-kannadiga-2004: Veera Kannadiga is a 2004 Kannada masala film and the debut of director Meher Ramesh, from a story by Puri Jagannadh, who shot it simultaneously in Telugu as Andhrawala, starring Puneeth Rajkumar and Anita Hassanandani. Munna, who grew up in a Bangalore slum, learns that his father was a labour leader who fought a Mumbai gangster for the rights of Kannadigas.
aabra-ka-daabra-2004: Shanu is a 12-year-old boy whose father, a magician, disappeared during a daring escape act, leaving the family poor and Shanu mocked by others. When he wins a competition that lets him join any school he likes, he chooses Aabra Ka Daabra, a school of magic. Dheeraj Kumar directs this Hindi fantasy film.
dishyum-2006: Bhaskar is a stuntman who risks his life doing dangerous scenes for film heroes. He is smitten with Cynthia, a college student, and even when she rejects him, he keeps trying to win her over. Jiiva and Sandhya star in this Tamil action romance written and directed by Sasi, with Guinness Pakru and Nassar.
annavaram-2006: Annavaram, a blacksmith in a remote village, adores his sister Varam and wants her to marry and live a happy life in the city. When a match is found, he goes with the newlyweds to Hyderabad, where he falls in love and runs into trouble. Pawan Kalyan and Asin star in this Telugu remake of the Tamil film Thirupaachi.
ranam-2006: Ranam is a 2006 Telugu action comedy directed by Amma Rajasekhar, starring Gopichand, Kamna Jethmalani and Biju Menon, with music by Mani Sharma. Chinna, whose antics his father has long put up with, moves to the city to study, clashes with the men of a powerful gangster, and then falls in love with the gangster's sister.
em-magan-2006: Thirumalai runs a provision store in Karaikudi and rules his family with a short temper, so much so that relatives call him Emdan, the god of death. His son Krishna, who studies and helps in the shop, lives in fear of his father's outbursts. Bharath, Gopika and Nassar star in this Tamil family drama directed by Thirumurugan.
rocky-2006: Rocky – The Rebel is a 2006 Hindi action drama directed by Suresh Krissna, starring Zayed Khan, Isha Sharvani and Minissha Lamba. Rocky, a short-tempered Mumbai youth who cannot stand injustice, pays a terrible price for crossing a criminal, and moves to London with his parents to leave violence behind, until trouble finds him again.
kireedam-2007: Rajarajan, an honest police constable, dreams of seeing his son Sakthi become a sub-inspector. After he is transferred to a coastal town ruled by a violent don, a single act by Sakthi to protect his father sets off a chain of events that threatens to destroy the young man's future.
evano-oruvan-2007: Sridhar is an honest, principled bank employee in Chennai who is quietly enraged by the corruption and petty lawbreaking he sees around him every day. His wife urges him to bend the rules like everyone else, until one day his frustration boils over and he begins taking the law into his own hands.
madhumasam-2007: Hamsa, an emotional and trusting young woman, falls for Sanjay, a practical man who believes only in logic, and agrees to marry him. Just before their engagement he casually tells her he does not love her and is marrying her for convenience. Sumanth, Sneha and Parvati Melton star in this Telugu romantic drama by Chandra Siddhartha.
raam-2006: Raam is a 2006 Telugu action comedy written and directed by N. Shankar, starring Nithiin, Genelia D'Souza and Hrishitaa Bhatt, with Krishnam Raju in a key role. Raam, a happy-go-lucky Hyderabad cyclist, reaches the final of a competition in Mumbai, where his trip unexpectedly draws him into tangled family history involving his grandfather.
prajapathi-2006: Prajapathi is a 2006 Malayalam action drama written and directed by Ranjith, starring Mammootty with Sreenivasan, Nedumudi Venu and Thilakan, and marking Aditi Rao Hydari's film debut. Narayanan returns from a juvenile home after a childhood tragedy to become the undisputed leader of his village, driving out wrongdoers while bitter relatives plot against him.
rathri-mazha-2007: Rathri Mazha is a 2007 Malayalam film by Lenin Rajendran, starring Vineeth and Meera Jasmine, and one of the Indian entries in the Asian, African and Latin American competition at the 38th IFFI. Meera falls for Hari, a gifted dancer, but when he vanishes and reappears unable to walk after an illness, their love is put to a quiet test.
dubai-seenu-2007: Srinivas, known in his village as Dubai Seenu, dreams of making his fortune in Dubai. He and his friends reach Mumbai, only to be cheated by a fraudster, so they start a pav bhaji stall instead, and Seenu meets Madhumati. Ravi Teja and Nayanthara star in this Telugu action comedy directed by Srinu Vaitla.
manorama-six-feet-under-2007: Satyaveer, a junior engineer in a dusty Rajasthan town and a failed pulp novelist, is hired by a woman claiming to be the minister's wife to spy on her husband. When things take a deadly turn, he is pulled into a mystery he cannot resist. Navdeep Singh's neo-noir thriller, inspired by Chinatown, stars Abhay Deol, Gul Panag and Raima Sen.
arabikkatha-2007: Cuba Mukundan is a devoted communist activist in Kerala. When a corrupt politician pushes him out, he is forced to take a job in Dubai, where he finds migrant workers being exploited by the same people. Sreenivasan stars in this Malayalam satirical drama directed by Lal Jose and written by Ikbal Kuttipuram.
mee-sreyobhilashi-2007: A group of strangers, each weighed down by their own problems and disappointments, find themselves together on a bus journey. As they travel and share their stories, they begin to see life differently. Rajendra Prasad and Naresh star in this Telugu philosophical drama directed by V. Eshwar Reddy.
katha-parayumpol-2007: Balan, a struggling village barber in Kerala, has three children to raise and a new air-conditioned salon threatening his business. When a famous film star comes to the village to shoot a movie, rumours spread that the star was once Balan's close friend. Sreenivasan, Mammootty and Meena star in this Malayalam comedy drama written by Sreenivasan.
kangaroo-2007: Josekutty, a hard-working autorickshaw driver, falls for Jancy, but in an arranged meeting he mistakes her sister Nancy, an unwed mother, for her and agrees to marry. Things take a sudden, tragic turn before the wedding. Prithviraj Sukumaran, Jayasurya and Kavya Madhavan star in this Malayalam family action comedy directed by Raj Babu.
time-2007: Time is a 2007 Malayalam psychological crime thriller directed by Shaji Kailas and written by Rajesh Jayaraman, with Suresh Gopi in a dual role as father and son alongside Vimala Raman and Padmapriya. When a state minister forced out by an anti-corruption campaign is found murdered, a sharp, witty IPS officer is put on the case.
game-2006: Over one chaotic day in Hyderabad, two very different men who desperately need money cross paths: Raghava, a short-tempered cab driver who has lied to his family about his job, and Vijay, a spoilt rich young man racing to a court hearing over a huge inheritance. Mohan Babu and Vishnu Manchu star in this Telugu drama.
aakasha-gopuram-2008: Set among Indian immigrants in London, this Malayalam drama follows Albert Samson, an architect who has fought his way to the top and hardened himself in the process, damaging his marriage. Now he fears being overtaken by younger architects. Adapted from Henrik Ibsen's play The Master Builder, it stars Mohanlal and is directed by K. P. Kumaran.
lakshmi-kalyanam-2007: Ramu and Lakshmi are cousins from the same village who grow up loving each other, against the wishes of her father, the village head. When a powerful young man from a rival village sets his sights on Lakshmi, the feud between the villages flares up. Kalyan Ram and Kajal Aggarwal star in this Telugu romantic action film by Teja.
ek-the-power-of-one-2009: Nandu, a contract killer, is hired by a politician to stage a fake attempt on his life for sympathy votes. When the politician is actually shot dead, Nandu is framed and goes on the run, ending up in a village where he is mistaken for someone else. Bobby Deol, Nana Patekar and Shriya Saran star in this Hindi remake of Athadu.
pourudu-2008: Pourudu is a 2008 Telugu action thriller written and directed by Raj Aditya, starring Sumanth and Kajal Aggarwal with Suman and Nassar. Ajay is preparing for the civil services and dreams of a law-abiding career, but his father works as the right-hand man of a powerful mafia boss, and a rivalry between the city's gangs threatens to pull him in.
bindaas-2008: Shiva, a happy-go-lucky young man in Bangalore, is asked by a police officer to infiltrate the gang of a notorious crime boss as an informer. He agrees, but his girlfriend Preethi starts to believe he has become a real gangster. Puneeth Rajkumar and Hansika Motwani star in this Kannada action comedy directed by D. Rajendra Babu.
dhoondte-reh-jaaoge-2008: Raj, a film producer whose movies keep flopping and whose creditors are closing in, teams up with accountant Anand on a plan: make a guaranteed disaster of a film and pocket the money. Kunal Khemu, Paresh Rawal, Sonu Sood and Soha Ali Khan star in this Hindi spoof comedy written and directed by Umesh Shukla.
baladoor-2008: Chanti looks up to his uncle Ramakrishna more than his own father. His uncle has had a bitter enemy, Umapathi, for twenty years, and when a misunderstanding gets Chanti thrown out of the house, he secretly sets out to help his family. Ravi Teja, Krishna and Anushka Shetty star in this Telugu action comedy.
sasirekha-parinayam-2009: Sasirekha Parinayam is a 2009 Telugu romantic drama directed by Krishna Vamsi, starring Tarun and Genelia. Sasirekha, a spirited young woman who never wanted the arranged match her father fixed with an NRI, runs away on her wedding day when the groom's family demands dowry, and soon finds herself travelling with a stranger named Anand.
hero-2008: Nagendra Naidu, a powerful police officer, wants his son Radha to become a tough cop like him, while his wife dreams of seeing their son as a film star. When a new government order opens an unusual path, Radha finds himself caught between both dreams. Nithiin and Bhavana star in this Telugu action comedy directed by G. V. Sudhakar Naidu.
deshdrohi-2008: Raja Yadav leaves his village in Uttar Pradesh for Mumbai, looking for work as a watchman. In the city he falls in with a gangster and a woman tied to the drug trade, and is drawn into a world of crime, corruption and hostility towards migrants. Kamaal Rashid Khan writes, produces and stars in this Hindi action thriller.
aloo-chaat-2009: Nikhil returns to his conservative Punjabi family in Delhi after studying in America, secretly in love with Aamna, a Muslim girl. Knowing his family will never accept her, he hatches a plan with a family friend to introduce an American woman as his fiancée so that Aamna seems the better choice.
agyaat-2009: A Bollywood film crew shooting in a deep forest gets stuck for four days. When the actors and their guide head out to a remote beauty spot for the night, they find themselves stalked by an unseen creature. Ram Gopal Varma directs this Hindi horror film starring Nithiin, Gautam Rode and Priyanka Kothari.
bhram-2008: Antara is a supermodel who seems to have everything, yet hides a painful past. When Shantanu, the most eligible bachelor in town, falls in love with her, their relationship faces challenges that test his beliefs, his family ties and his friendships. Dino Morea and Milind Soman star in this Hindi thriller directed by Pavan Kaul.
sankham-2009: Sankham is a 2009 Telugu action comedy written and directed by Siva, starring Gopichand and Trisha with Sathyaraj and Kota Srinivasa Rao. Chandu, a rich, rough-edged young man raised by his uncle in Australia, longs to put his martial arts to real use, and after falling for Mahalakshmi he follows her home to India, into the middle of a bloody family feud.
daddy-cool-2009: Antony Simon is a crime branch officer who would rather spend his days playing cricket with his eight-year-old son Aadi than working, to the irritation of his bosses and his wife. Then a serious case puts father and son in danger. Mammootty stars in this Malayalam action film, the directorial debut of Aashiq Abu.
raaj-the-showman-2009: Raaj – The Showman is a 2009 Kannada action drama directed by Prem, starring Puneeth Rajkumar and Priyanka Kothari, with music by V. Harikrishna. Raj, a junior artist who dreams of becoming a star like Dr. Rajkumar, finally lands a lead role, but when the film's heroine walks out, he sets out to bring her back at any cost.
don-muthu-swami-2008: Muthu Swami is a feared don who has promised to give up crime and go straight. Keeping that promise proves far harder than he expected, as a day of mix-ups, family chaos and confused identities spins out of control. Mithun Chakraborty stars in this Hindi comedy directed by Ashim Samanta, a remake of the American film Oscar.
manasaare-2009: Manu, an orphaned and unemployed young man looked down on by his family, has his heart broken in an odd way. After a strange turn of events, he finds himself in a mental hospital, where he meets Devika and an unusual journey begins. Diganth and Aindrita Ray star in this Kannada romantic drama directed by Yogaraj Bhat.
shevri-2006: Shevri is a 2006 Marathi film directed by Gajendra Ahire and produced by Neena Kulkarni, who also stars, with Mukta Barve and Mohan Agashe. Vidya, a divorced working woman sharing a rented flat in Mumbai, is forced to spend a whole night on the city's streets, and as she wanders until morning she looks back on every relationship in her life.
sarhad-paar-2007: Sarhad Paar is a 2007 Hindi action drama directed by Raman Kumar, starring Sanjay Dutt, Tabu, Mahima Chaudhry and Chandrachur Singh. Major Ranjeet Singh crosses the border on a mission against militants who attacked the army, and he is the only survivor of a blast. Captured and interrogated, he refuses to talk, and in the process loses his memory.
okka-magaadu-2008: Okka Magaadu is a 2008 Telugu vigilante action comedy written, produced and directed by Y. V. S. Chowdary, starring Nandamuri Balakrishna with Anushka Shetty, Simran and Nisha Kothari. Balakrishna plays a man revered as a protector by the people of his region, who takes on powerful politicians and their henchmen on their behalf.
chintakayala-ravi-2008: Ravi works as a head waiter at a bar in New York, having gone to the US dreaming of a software career. Back home in his village, his proud mother tells everyone he is a successful software engineer, and the lie soon catches up with him. Venkatesh, Anushka Shetty and Mamta Mohandas star in this Telugu romantic comedy.
guru-en-aalu-2009: Guru is the ambitious assistant of Krishna, a playboy CEO who is married but has many affairs and relies on Guru to keep up his image as a devoted husband. Promised a company of his own, Guru goes along with it, until things get complicated. Madhavan, Abbas and Mamta Mohandas star in this Tamil romantic comedy directed by Selvaa.
neninthe-2008: Neninthe is a 2008 Telugu drama written and directed by Puri Jagannadh, starring Ravi Teja and Siya Gautam. Ravi, an assistant director chasing his first film, falls for a group dancer while trying to convince wary producers to back his script, and he soon runs into trouble with a wealthy local goon.
sikandar-2009: Sikandar, a 14-year-old orphan in Kashmir who dreams of playing football, finds a gun on his way to a match. Picking it up draws him and his friend Nasreen into the dangerous world of militancy and the politics around it. Piyush Jha's drama stars Parzan Dastur, Ayesha Kapur, R. Madhavan and Sanjay Suri.
thee-2009: Thee is a 2009 Tamil political action film co-written and directed by G. Kicha, starring Sundar C with Namitha and Ramya Raj. Sarathy, a tough, honest police officer who is constantly transferred for crossing powerful people, is happily married and unbothered by it all, until he arrests a corrupt MLA and his life takes a dangerous turn.
neelathamara-2009: Neelathamara is Lal Jose's 2009 Malayalam remake of the 1979 classic, written by M. T. Vasudevan Nair, who also scripted the original. A television producer returns to her ancestral village to see her ailing grandmother, and the visit stirs old stories of a young maid's love for the son of the household.
kisaan-2009: Dayal Singh, a widowed farmer near Chandigarh, sends his elder son Aman to the city to become a lawyer, while his younger son Jiggar stays to farm. Years later, a businessman wants to buy their land and turn it into an industrial zone, splitting the family. Sohail Khan, Arbaaz Khan, Jackie Shroff and Dia Mirza star in this Hindi action drama.
naadodigal-2009: Karuna and his two friends in Rajapalayam are inseparable. When an old friend asks for their help to elope with the woman he loves, they risk everything to make it happen, and pay a heavy price. Sasikumar stars with Ananya and Abhinaya, in their Tamil debuts, in this action drama written and directed by Samuthirakani.
shadow-2009: Shadow: The Dark Side of Truth is a 2009 Hindi thriller directed by Rohit Nayyar and written by Bobby Khan, with a cast that includes Nasser Khan, Milind Soman, Sonali Kulkarni and Hrishitaa Bhatt. As its title suggests, the film is built around secrets and the darker truths that lie behind what its characters show the world.
rechipo-2009: Rechipo is a 2009 Telugu romantic action comedy directed by Paruchuri Murali and produced by G. V. Ramana, starring Nithiin and Ileana D'Cruz. The film blends romance, comedy and action around its energetic young lead, with cinematography by T. Surendra Reddy, and was released in September 2009.
fox-2009: Arjun is a brilliant criminal defence lawyer who wins cases at any cost, even when his clients are guilty. When his conscience catches up with him and his life is turned upside down, he is drawn into a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a mysterious figure. Arjun Rampal and Sunny Deol star in this Hindi thriller directed by Deepak Tijori.
road-to-sangam-2009: Hashmatullah, a devout Muslim mechanic in Allahabad, is asked to repair an old Ford V8 engine, the one that once carried Mahatma Gandhi's ashes. When a bomb blast sets off communal tension and his community calls a strike, he must choose between his people and his duty. Amit Rai's drama stars Paresh Rawal, Om Puri and Pawan Malhotra.
superstar-2008: Superstar is a 2008 Hindi drama directed by Rohit Jugraj, starring Kunal Khemu and Tulip Joshi. Kunal, a middle-class young man from Borivali who has dreamed of acting since he was eight, keeps failing to land roles despite his supportive mother and journalist girlfriend, and his path crosses with a rich young man who looks exactly like him.
mulla-2008: Mulla, a gangster from a rough colony, finds an abandoned baby on a train and decides to raise the child himself. On the same journey he crosses paths with Lachi, a hard-working young woman supporting her family, and the two are drawn together. Dileep and Meera Nandan star in this Malayalam drama directed by Lal Jose.
karma-aur-holi-2009: An NRI couple, desperate to have a child of their own, host a Holi party for their Indian and American friends. As the colours fly and the day goes on, secrets, tensions and desires among the guests come to the surface. Randeep Hooda and Sushmita Sen star, with Naomi Campbell, in this drama written and directed by Manish Gupta.
siddharth-the-prisoner-2009: Siddharth: The Prisoner is a Hindi thriller written and directed by Pryas Gupta, starring Rajat Kapoor. Siddharth Roy, a once-famous writer just out of prison, hopes his new manuscript will restore his name and win back his estranged wife, until his briefcase is swapped at a cyber café with an identical one full of cash, and his only copy is gone.
aayudham-2008: When a bomb goes off in the Kerala beach town of Vilayam, a corrupt police commissioner quickly arrests the son of a local muezzin. The chief minister then hands the case to Hrishikesh, an honest officer, to find out who is really behind the blast. Suresh Gopi stars in this Malayalam crime thriller written and directed by M. A. Nishad.
vettaikaaran-2009: Vettaikaaran is a 2009 Tamil action film and the directorial debut of B. Babusivan, produced by AVM Productions and starring Vijay and Anushka Shetty. Ravi, a young man from Thoothukudi who idolises an encounter specialist and dreams of joining the police, studies in Chennai while driving an auto-rickshaw, and soon clashes with the city's most dangerous gangster.
gunde-jhallumandi-2008: Neelima, a college student determined to keep boys away after her sister was let down by a man, picks a random name, Rajesh, and announces to the whole college that she is in love with him. Then a real Rajesh turns up. Uday Kiran and Aditi Sharma star in this Telugu romance directed by Madan.
vambuchanda-2008: Vambuchanda is a 2008 Tamil film directed by Raj Kapoor and written by K. Selva Bharathy, starring Sathyaraj, Uday Kiran and Diya, with music by D. Imman. Prabhu, a college student who cannot stand any wrongdoing, keeps getting arrested for picking fights, and his life gets complicated when he crosses paths with the sister of the city's police commissioner.
vamshi-2008: Vamshi is a 2008 Kannada action drama directed by Prakash and produced by Parvathamma Rajkumar, starring Puneeth Rajkumar with Lakshmi and Nikita Thukral. Vamshi, a hot-headed police academy trainee and son of a recently murdered crime boss, sees his police career collapse, and is pushed into leading his father's gang against the rival who killed him.
ganesh-2009: Ganesh, an orphan who works at a software company, is always helping others. When his best friend falls for the companion of Divya, the daughter of a strict politician, Ganesh agrees to pretend to be in love with Divya so his friend can pursue his romance. Ram Pothineni and Kajal Aggarwal star in this Telugu romantic action film by M. Saravanan.
happy-husbands-2010: Three husbands lead very different lives: Mukundan, a journalist whose wife is possessive and suspicious; John, a playboy hiding his affairs; and another husband caught in the middle. When their lies and their wives' suspicions collide, chaos follows. Jayaram, Indrajith and Jayasurya star in this Malayalam remake of the Tamil comedy Charlie Chaplin.
darling-2010: Two college friends promise to stay in touch, but life takes one to Switzerland with his daughter Nandini and keeps the other in India with his son Prabha. Years later, when the old friends reunite, Prabha meets Nandini again and falls for her. Prabhas and Kajal Aggarwal star in this Telugu romantic comedy by A. Karunakaran.
yakshiyum-njanum-2010: Yakshiyum Njaanum is a 2010 Malayalam horror film written and directed by Vinayan, starring Goutham P. Krishna, Meghana Raj and Thilakan. On the run after committing a crime, Shyam hides out in a minister's estate bungalow said to be haunted, where people who enter are rumoured never to leave, and he falls for Aathira, the mysterious young woman he meets there.
fruit-and-nut-2009: Monica, who works for a heritage society, plans to restore Mumbai's old buildings, upsetting a pompous maharaja who has her kidnapped. She is rescued by Jolly Maker, a well-meaning but not very smart man, who becomes an unlikely hero. Cyrus Broacha, Boman Irani, Dia Mirza and Mahesh Manjrekar star in this Hindi comedy by Kunal Vijaykar.
kaavalan-2011: Bhoomi, who idolises a powerful landlord, agrees to work as his bodyguard. He is then assigned to protect the landlord's daughter Meera from her father's enemies, and an anonymous romance begins over the phone. Vijay and Asin star in this Tamil romantic action comedy by Siddique, a remake of his Malayalam film Body Guard.
kutti-pisasu-2010: Priya is the bright, adored daughter of loving parents, until she is possessed by the spirit of a young girl named Savithri who has a score to settle. The goddess Kaali watches over events. Ramya Krishnan stars in this fantasy film written and directed by Rama Narayanan, made in Tamil, Kannada and Telugu.
malarvaadi-arts-club-2010: Five friends in the village of Manissery spend their days at their beloved hangout, the Malarvadi Arts Club. As they try to keep it alive, they form a music band and find that growing up means facing hard choices. Vineeth Sreenivasan's debut comedy drama introduced Nivin Pauly, Aju Varghese and Bhagath Manuel.
180-2011: A young doctor arrives in Hyderabad calling himself Mano and moves in with an elderly couple. He fills his days helping others and sponsoring the education of street children, and Vidya, a photojournalist, falls for him. But he is hiding something. Siddharth, Nithya Menen and Priya Anand star in this romantic drama shot in Telugu and Tamil.
bheemili-kabaddi-jattu-2010: In Bheemili, a village near Vizag, a poor young man named Suri falls for a girl who has come to stay, while he and his childhood friends dream of winning a kabaddi tournament, something their team has never done. By chance they land in a state-level contest. Nani stars in this Telugu sports drama, a remake of Vennila Kabadi Kuzhu.
city-of-god-2011: A road accident in Kochi ties together the lives of four very different groups of people, among them Tamil migrant workers and a gang of land-mafia goons, each seeing the city in its own way. Prithviraj Sukumaran, Parvathy Thiruvothu and Indrajith star in this Malayalam crime thriller directed by Lijo Jose Pellissery.
bhakthajanangalude-sradhakku-2011: Bhakthajanangalude Sradhakku is a Malayalam drama about a woman who becomes a self-declared living goddess, attracting crowds of devotees, and her alcoholic husband, who lives in the shadow of her fame. Kavya Madhavan and Irshad star in the film, directed by Priyanandanan and written by Manoj from a story by Ranjith.
damadamm-2011: Sameer, a scriptwriter for Hindi films, is fed up with his girlfriend Shikha, who suspects him all the time, yet he cannot bring himself to leave her. When she goes away for a family wedding, he finally gets a taste of freedom. Himesh Reshammiya, Sonal Sehgal and Purbi Joshi star in this Hindi romantic comedy by Swapna Waghmare Joshi.
mod-2011: Ananya runs a watch-repair stall in a quiet Nilgiris hill town and cares for her father. A young man starts visiting her shop every day, and as they grow close, she slowly learns about his mysterious past. Nagesh Kukunoor's romantic drama, a remake of a Taiwanese film, stars Ayesha Takia and Rannvijay Singh.
money-money-more-money-2011: Four small-time crooks kidnap the daughter of a millionaire for a ransom, but are forced to hide out in the home of a large vegetarian family whose head turns out to be a retired don and old rival. J. D. Chakravarthy writes, directs and stars, with Brahmanandam, in this Telugu comedy remade from the Hindi film Darwaaza Bandh Rakho.
uliyin-osai-2008: Uliyin Osai is a 2008 Tamil historical romance and the directorial debut of Ilavenil, based on a short story by M. Karunanidhi and starring Vineeth and Keerthi Chawla, with music by Ilaiyaraaja. In 1005 AD, as the Chola king Raja Raja plans the great temple at Thanjavur, a gifted young sculptor and dancer clashes with the palace's celebrated dancer.
daggaraga-dooranga-2011: Gowtham, an ad filmmaker, creates a digital model for a campaign that turns out to look exactly like a real woman, Meenakshi, whose engagement is cancelled because of his provocative ad. Furious, she sets out to bring him down with the help of a journalist friend. Sumanth, Vedhika and Sindhu Tolani star in this Telugu romantic thriller.
bhindi-bazaar-2011: In Mumbai's Bhindi Bazaar, Mamu runs a gang of pickpockets who work the crowded streets and buses. When rivalries, jealousy and ambition start to tear the gang apart, the city's underworld closes in. Kay Kay Menon, Prashant Narayanan and Jackie Shroff star in this Hindi crime thriller directed by Ankush Bhatt.
bhavani-2011: Bhavani, an honest police officer from Hyderabad, is posted as an assistant commissioner in Tirunelveli, a town controlled by a ruthless gangster and aspiring politician. She sets out to end his reign, and the fight soon becomes personal. Sneha stars in this Tamil crime action film directed by G. Kitcha, a remake of the Telugu film Karthavyam.
the-desire-2010: The Desire: A Journey of a Woman is a 2010 India–China co-production directed by R. Sarath, starring Shilpa Shetty with Chinese actor Xia Yu, Jaya Prada and Anupam Kher. The film follows a woman's personal journey across two cultures, shaped by love, art and the choices she must make between her own desires and duty.
apartment-2010: Preeti, an air hostess in Mumbai, throws out her boyfriend Karan after wrongly suspecting him of cheating, and takes in a new flatmate. With a lonely poet as their neighbour, her new living arrangement slowly turns dangerous. Tanushree Dutta, Rohit Roy, Neetu Chandra and Anupam Kher star in this Hindi thriller directed by Jag Mundhra.
rama-rama-krishna-krishna-2010: Rama Rama Krishna Krishna is a 2010 Telugu action comedy directed by Sriwass and produced by Dil Raju, starring Ram Pothineni and Arjun with Priya Anand and Bindu Madhavi. A Mumbai mafia leader who loses his wife in a gang war promises her he will give up violence, and he moves away with his family to start a peaceful new life.
sambho-siva-sambho-2010: Sambho Siva Sambho is a 2010 Telugu action drama directed by Samuthirakani, a remake of his Tamil film Naadodigal, starring Ravi Teja, Allari Naresh, Siva Balaji and Priyamani. Three close friends, each with modest dreams of their own, agree to help an old friend elope with the woman he loves, and the decision changes their lives.
prince-2010: Prince is a 2010 Hindi science-fiction action thriller directed by Kookie V. Gulati, starring Vivek Oberoi with Nandana Sen and Aruna Shields. A slick burglar wakes up one morning with no memory of his past, and as more than one woman claims to be his girlfriend Maya, he races to work out who he is and who is after him.
prasthanam-2010: Prasthanam is a 2010 Telugu political thriller written and directed by Deva Katta, starring Sharwanand, Sai Kumar and Sundeep Kishan. Loki takes over a political party after its patriarch dies and marries the family's widowed daughter-in-law, and twenty-five years later, as he nears the Chief Minister's chair, ambition and old resentments begin tearing the family apart.
hello-hum-lallan-bol-rahe-hain-2010: Lallan is an honest, hard-working security guard in Mumbai who is always helping others. He loves Saroja, a girl back in his village, and calls her from a phone booth, but she only sees him as a friend. When a promotion comes his way, life gets complicated. Rajpal Yadav stars in this Hindi comedy directed by Dilip Shukla.
hum-tum-aur-ghost-2010: Armaan, a charming fashion photographer, has a perfect life with his girlfriend Gehna, a magazine editor. Then he starts seeing ghosts, who will not leave him alone until he helps them finish their business on earth. Arshad Warsi and Dia Mirza star in this Hindi supernatural comedy, filmed in England, an unofficial remake of Ghost Town.
apoorvaragam-2010: Roopesh has long been in love with his college friend Nancy but cannot find the words, so their friend Tommy plays Cupid to bring them together. Behind the scenes, though, Tommy's plans are not quite what they seem. Asif Ali, Nishan, Vinay Forrt and Nithya Menen star in this Malayalam thriller directed by Sibi Malayil.
pathinonnil-vyazham-2010: Pathinonnil Vyazham is a Malayalam comedy drama directed by Suresh Krishnan, starring Mukesh and Manya, shot in 2005 but released only in 2010. Appu, a bearer at a five-star hotel in Palakkad, gets tangled up with a wealthy Ooty businessman who has come to consult an astrologer, just as a pair of con artists set their sights on him.
nenu-naa-rakshasi-2011: Nenu Naa Rakshasi is a 2011 Telugu action drama written and directed by Puri Jagannadh, starring Rana Daggubati and Ileana D'Cruz. A professional assassin falls hard for a café worker he barely knows, while a police inspector hunts for the person behind an online channel that posts disturbing videos.
thenmerku-paruvakaatru-2010: Murugan, a goatherd in Theni raised by his fiercely protective widowed mother, falls for Pechi, a girl from a family of goat thieves. The clash between their families and his mother's love puts the romance to the test. Seenu Ramasamy's rural drama, which won the National Award for Best Tamil Film, stars Vijay Sethupathi, Vasundhara and Saranya Ponvannan.
parama-veera-chakra-2011: Parama Veera Chakra is a 2011 Telugu action film produced by C. Kalyan and directed by Dasari Narayana Rao as his 150th film. Nandamuri Balakrishna leads the cast alongside Ameesha Patel, Neha Dhupia, Sheela Kaur and Jayasudha, in a film that takes its title from India's highest military award for gallantry.
race-2011: Race is a 2011 Malayalam thriller directed by Kukku Surendran and based on Greg Iles's novel 24 Hours, starring Kunchacko Boban, Indrajith and Mamta Mohandas. While a successful cardiac surgeon is away at a conference in Bengaluru, a stranger tells him that her accomplices are holding his wife and young daughter captive at home.
satrangee-parachute-2011: Satrangee Parachute is a 2011 Hindi children's film directed by Vineet Khetrapal, with Jackie Shroff, Kay Kay Menon, Rajpal Yadav and Zakir Hussain in the cast. Eight-year-old Pappu, the leader of a gang of village kids from Nainital, sets off for Mumbai with four friends to find a parachute for their friend Kuhu, a girl who cannot see.
prince-2011: Prince is a 2011 Kannada action film written and directed by Om Prakash Rao, starring Darshan with Nikita Thukral and Jennifer Kotwal. Vishnu, an advertising professional, teams up with a journalist friend to go after three corrupt police officers who falsely branded him a Naxalite and cost him the family he loved.
soundtrack-2011: Raunak, a talented DJ in Mumbai, rises fast in the club scene, but a party lifestyle takes its toll. When he starts losing his hearing, he must find a new way to make music. Neerav Ghosh's drama, a remake of It's All Gone Pete Tong, stars Rajeev Khandelwal and Soha Ali Khan.
balgandharva-2011: This biopic traces the life of Narayan Shripad Rajhans, the Marathi stage legend renamed Balgandharva by Lokmanya Tilak. Famous for playing female roles in musical theatre, he rose from poverty to fame and started his own drama company, but the arrival of cinema changed his fortunes.
hero-hitler-in-love-2011: Hitler is a big-hearted man in the village of Ishkapur who loves his neighbours and helps young lovers get together. When he falls for Sahiban, a woman from Pakistan, he decides to bring her to his village. Babbu Maan, who wrote the film, stars with Mouni Roy and Bhagwant Mann in this Punjabi romantic action drama.
nagavalli-2010: Years after an old painting of Chandramukhi, also known as Nagavalli, comes into the home of a dancer's family, strange events begin to disturb them. A psychiatrist is called in to investigate. Venkatesh and Anushka Shetty star in this Telugu horror comedy written and directed by P. Vasu, a sequel to Chandramukhi.
aaranya-kaandam-2011: Over a single day in Chennai, an ageing gangster passes on a big cocaine deal, and his ambitious henchman goes ahead with it anyway. The deal sets off a violent chain of events involving a rival don, a young woman held by the gangster, and a father and son caught in the crossfire.
aayiram-vilakku-2011: A father tells his young son the story of Lingam, the feared don of Madurai who once adopted him. Ordered by the police to stay away from crime, Lingam turns to building a mill in Aayiram Vilakku Nagar, while the young Gopal falls in love with Megha. Sathyaraj and Shanthanu Bhagyaraj star in this Tamil action drama.
right-yaaa-wrong-2010: Ajay, a compassionate police officer left paralysed after a shooting, is suspected of murder when his wife and her lover are found dead. His closest friend Vinay, a by-the-book cop, is assigned the case and must decide what is right. Neeraj Pathak's thriller, based on Above Suspicion, stars Sunny Deol, Irrfan Khan and Konkona Sen Sharma.
aagathan-2010: Gautham, a software engineer, arrives at the home of a retired army general and his family. His past, though, goes back to Kashmir, where he lost his parents in a terrorist attack as a child. Dileep, Sathyaraj and Charmy Kaur star in this Malayalam revenge drama written and directed by Kamal.
tum-milo-toh-sahi-2010: Tum Milo Toh Sahi is a 2010 Hindi drama directed by Kabir Sadanand, starring Nana Patekar, Dimple Kapadia, Suniel Shetty, Vidya Malvade and Anjana Sukhani. A lonely retired law clerk, a spirited Parsi café owner and a few young people find their lives intersecting in Mumbai, especially when the beloved Lucky Cafe faces the threat of closure.
ringtone-2010: Ringtone is a 2010 Malayalam thriller directed by Ajmal, starring Suresh Gopi, Bala and newcomer Meghna Nair, and the final film of actor Rajan P. Dev. A young man on the run after clashing with police to protect his mother meets a woman on a truck journey, while an anti-terrorist squad officer is called in on a case with wider links.
panchakshari-2010: Panchakshari is a 2010 Telugu fantasy action film directed by V. Samudra, with Anushka Shetty in a double role. Born near a temple of Goddess Durga at an hour considered sacred to her, Panchakshari grows up revered by her village as a divine figure, and her life takes unexpected turns after she marries an orphan.
jhummandi-naadam-2010: Balu dreams of becoming a great playback singer and moves to Hyderabad, renting a room opposite a grumpy retired captain. He meets Sravya, an NRI girl staying with the captain while making a documentary on Telugu music, and the two fall in love. K. Raghavendra Rao's musical drama stars Manoj Manchu, Taapsee in her debut and Mohan Babu.
teen-maar-2011: Teen Maar is a 2011 Telugu romantic drama directed by Jayanth C. Paranjee and written by Trivikram Srinivas, a remake of Love Aaj Kal with Pawan Kalyan in a dual role opposite Trisha. Michael, a carefree chef abroad, calmly breaks up with his girlfriend when her job takes her to India, and soon hears a very different love story from an older man.
veppam-2011: Veppam is a 2011 Tamil crime drama and the directorial debut of Anjana, starring Nani, Nithya Menen, Karthik Kumar and Bindu Madhavi. Balaji, abandoned as a boy in a Chennai slum by his drunken father, works hard to give his younger brother Karthik a decent life, but as Karthik grows up, the pull of easy money and bad company threatens everything.
karayilekku-oru-kadal-dooram-2010: Anoop, a celebrated writer who sometimes sees future events before they happen, has a vision of his own death. He decides to write one final novel, torn between his wife Meera, who has never understood the writer in him, and Gatha, a dancer he loves. Indrajith and Mamta Mohandas star in this Malayalam fantasy drama directed by Vinod Mankara.
kanteerava-2011: Kanthi, a good-hearted orphan, is raised by a kind family in Bangalore and treated like a son. Once a week he secretly visits Indhira, a young woman with a mental illness, whose story is tied to a violent past he has left behind. Duniya Vijay and Shubha Poonja star in this Kannada remake of the Telugu film Simhadri.
violin-2011: Violin is a 2011 Malayalam musical romance directed by Sibi Malayil, starring Asif Ali and Nithya Menen with Vijayaraghavan and Nedumudi Venu. Angel, a reserved young violinist living with her two aunts in Fort Kochi, is at first cold to Aby, the cheerful musician who becomes their tenant, but his arrival slowly changes all three of their lives.
rokkk-2010: Rokkk is a 2010 Hindi supernatural horror film directed by Rajesh Ranshinge, starring Tanushree Dutta and Udita Goswami as sisters. Anushka marries Ravi, an older widower whose first wife died in unexplained circumstances, and soon after they move into their new home she begins seeing things her husband dismisses as hallucinations.
mee-sindhutai-sapkal-2010: Married off as a child and later thrown out by her husband, Sindhutai survives on the streets of Maharashtra with her baby daughter. Out of that hardship, she begins caring for orphaned children and becomes a mother to hundreds. Anant Mahadevan's Marathi biopic stars Tejaswini Pandit, Jyoti Chandekar and Upendra Limaye.
veettilekkulla-vazhi-2010: Veettilekkulla Vazhi is a 2010 Malayalam adventure drama written and directed by Dr. Biju, starring Prithviraj, Indrajith and Master Govardhan, about how militant groups recruit young people. A doctor who has lost his own family to a bomb attack agrees to take a young boy across India to find the boy's father, a journey that leads into dangerous territory.
chargesheet-2011: Chargesheet is a Hindi crime thriller written, directed by and starring Dev Anand, his final film. It centres on the mysterious death of a young film actress and the investigation into what really happened, while exploring the criminal side of ordinary lives. Jackie Shroff, Naseeruddin Shah and Divya Dutta co-star.
miley-naa-miley-hum-2011: Chirag, the son of divorced parents, dreams of becoming a professional tennis player, though his mother hates the sport. While his parents each try to find him a bride, he secretly practises and falls for Manjeet. Chirag Paswan makes his debut with Kangana Ranaut and Sagarika Ghatge in this Hindi romance directed by Tanveer Khan.
will-you-marry-me-2012: Will You Marry Me? is a 2012 Hindi romantic comedy directed by Aditya Datt, starring Shreyas Talpade, Rajeev Khandelwal, Muzammil Ibrahim, Mugdha Godse and Celina Jaitly. A group of college friends sign a pact to pool their shares and hand the lot to whoever stays single the longest, and as one after another falls for someone, only three bachelors remain.
hum-tum-shabana-2011: Two friends set out to woo the same young woman, Shabana, each sure he can win her over. When she turns out to be far more than either bargained for, their eager pursuit turns into a desperate attempt to get rid of her. Sagar Ballary's romantic comedy stars Tusshar Kapoor, Shreyas Talpade and Minissha Lamba.
