shortcut-romeo-2013: Shortcut Romeo is a 2013 Hindi crime thriller directed and produced by Susi Ganeshan, a remake of his Tamil film Thiruttu Payale, starring Neil Nitin Mukesh and Puja Gupta. Suraj, a hot-headed, aimless young man sent from Goa to live with his uncle in Mumbai, stumbles on a rich woman's secret and sees in it a shortcut to wealth through blackmail.
dammu-2012: Rama Chandra, an orphan in love with a rich girl who wants a man with a family name, agrees to be adopted as heir by a royal family. He soon learns the family is caught in a long, bloody feud with a rival clan and must take it on. Boyapati Srinu's action drama stars Jr NTR, Trisha and Karthika Nair.
1920-evil-returns-2012: In 1920, the poet Jaidev lives in seclusion after losing Smriti, a woman he loved through letters but never met. When he finds an unconscious girl by a lake who remembers nothing but his poems, he takes her in, and soon it becomes clear that something evil has come with her.
married-2-america-2012: Ravi Malhotra, an NRI engineer and architect, goes missing in Bihar while investigating the cause of a dam burst. His anxious wife Anjali travels to India to search for him, but her quest is full of danger. Jackie Shroff, Archana Joglekar, Shweta Tiwari and Raghubir Yadav star in this Hindi drama directed by Dilip Shankar.
father-s-day-2012: Seetha, a tutor at a government college who has never married, finds herself being followed by a young criminology student. When they meet, his research leads straight into a painful chapter of her past that she has kept hidden. Revathi, Lal and Shehin star in this Malayalam drama directed by Kalavoor Ravikumar.
myna-2013: Satya is arrested and charged in a serious criminal case. While being taken to Bangalore, he tells the police officer leading his transfer the story of how he met and fell in love with Myna, and why he is in this situation. Based on a real incident, this Kannada romance by Nagashekar stars Chetan Kumar and Nithya Menen.
daal-mein-kuch-kaala-hai-2012: Mr Dabu, a middle-aged loser left alone in life, suddenly becomes rich after winning a big prize, while a budding actress is determined to make it big in Bollywood. Their paths cross in a chaotic black comedy. Veena Malik, Jackie Shroff, Shakti Kapoor and Vijay Raaz star in this Hindi film directed by Anand Balraj.
kedi-billa-killadi-ranga-2013: Two unemployed friends from Trichy, Kesavan and Murugan, dream of becoming politicians. While chasing that goal, both fall in love, and Murugan's girlfriend even funds his campaign when he contests a local election. Vimal, Sivakarthikeyan, Bindu Madhavi and Regina Cassandra star in this Tamil political comedy written and directed by Pandiraj.
no-66-madhura-bus-2012: No. 66 Madhura Bus is a 2012 Malayalam road crime thriller directed by M. A. Nishad, with a screenplay by the author K. V. Anil. Pasupathy, Padmapriya, Mallika, Shwetha Menon and Makarand Deshpande lead the cast in a tense story built around a long bus journey and the people caught up in it.
6-2013: Ram, a software engineer in Chennai, loses his son Gautham at a crowded beach on the boy's sixth birthday. With the police doing little to help, Ram sets out to find him himself, a search that takes him across six states. V. Z. Durai writes and directs this Tamil crime thriller starring Shaam and Poonam Kaur.
romans-2013: Akash and Shibu, two escaped convicts, hide out in Poomala, a remote village, by posing as priests. The villagers, desperate to reopen their long-shut church, take them for real priests, and the pair find themselves trapped in their roles. Boban Samuel's comedy stars Kunchacko Boban, Biju Menon and Nivetha Thomas.
mere-genie-uncle-2013: Mere Genie Uncle is a Hindi 3D family fantasy film about a friendly genie who enters the lives of a family and children, bringing magic, wishes and plenty of comic trouble along with him. Tiku Talsania, Swati Kapoor and Shakti Kapoor star, directed by Ashish Bhavsar.
singh-vs-kaur-2013: Singh vs Kaur is a 2013 Punjabi romantic action comedy directed by Navaniat Singh, starring Gippy Grewal, Surveen Chawla and Binnu Dhillon. Nihal Singh, a carefree young man raised by his widowed mother, is considered such a nuisance in his village that the elders decide to send him away, setting him off on a journey that leads to love.
neelakasham-pachakadal-chuvanna-bhoomi-2: Kasi sets off from Kerala on a motorbike road trip, and his best friend Suni insists on joining him, even though Kasi is not sure where they are going. Their ride across India takes them through Odisha and on towards the northeast, and into Kasi's past. Dulquer Salmaan and Sunny Wayne star in this Malayalam road film by Sameer Thahir.
mai-2013: Mai, a widowed mother of four in her sixties, is showing signs of Alzheimer's disease. When her son plans to move abroad and put her in a home, her eldest daughter Madhu takes her in, despite resistance from her own family. Mahesh Kodiyal's family drama stars singer Asha Bhosle in her acting debut, with Padmini Kolhapure.
neram-2013: Mathew, a jobless young man in Chennai, owes money to a ruthless moneylender. On the day he elopes with his girlfriend, his money and her gold chain are stolen, and a chain of misfortunes closes in on him before a deadline. Alphonse Puthren's action comedy, made in Malayalam and Tamil, stars Nivin Pauly and Nazriya Nazim.
vanakkam-chennai-2013: Ajay, a young man from Theni, and Anjali, a photographer from London, are both tricked by a crooked broker into renting the same house in Chennai. Unable to find another place, the two strangers reluctantly share it, and Ajay slowly falls in love with Anjali.
simhasanam-2012: Simhasanam is a 2012 Malayalam action drama written and directed by Shaji Kailas, starring Prithviraj Sukumaran and Saikumar. Arjun, a student in Manipal and son of a wealthy Palakkad landlord, is called home amid a bitter conflict with a rival family of brothers, and he decides to fight back quietly, without his peace-loving father knowing.
leelai-2012: Three college friends, Malar, Mona and Gayathri, are tested when Mona falls for Karthik, a charming flirt Malar does not trust. When Karthik takes a dislike to Malar and a phone call puts the two of them in touch, an unexpected romance begins. Shiv Pandit and Manasi Parekh star in this Tamil romantic comedy directed by Andrew Louis.
ee-adutha-kaalathu-2012: A man who makes toys from scrap, a rich businessman who neglects his wife, a police officer and other city dwellers find their lives crossing during a wave of crimes in a Kerala city. Arun Kumar Aravind's black comedy thriller, written by Murali Gopy, stars Indrajith, Murali Gopy, Anoop Menon and Mythili.
idukki-gold-2013: Michael returns to Kerala after decades abroad and tracks down his old school friends. Together the five ageing men set off on a road trip into the Idukki hills, looking for the friendships and carefree days of their youth. Aashiq Abu's comedy drama stars Raveendran, Maniyanpilla Raju, Prathap Pothen and Babu Antony.
london-paris-new-york-2012: Nikhil and Lalitha meet when she misses a connecting flight in London and spend a day exploring the city together. Their paths cross again in Paris and later in New York, and each meeting tests whether they belong together. Anu Menon's romantic comedy stars Ali Zafar and Aditi Rao Hydari.
bachelor-party-2012: Tony, a former gangster, has left crime behind to live quietly with his wife and newborn child. When a vengeful gangster sends men to kill him, his old childhood friends arrive to protect him. Adapted from Johnnie To's film Exiled, this Malayalam black comedy by Amal Neerad stars Asif Ali, Rahman, Indrajith Sukumaran and Kalabhavan Mani.
topiwala-2013: Topiwala is a 2013 Kannada political satire written by Upendra and directed by M. G. Srinivas, starring Upendra and Bhavana. Basak plans to steal the black money corrupt politicians have stashed in a Swiss bank, but the secret code he needs lies with a man who has lost his memory in an accident and calls himself Mr. India.
lakshmi-2013: Lakshmi Narayan, a CBI officer, is investigating trafficking and fraud linked to a dreaded terrorist. His happy home life with his wife Priya is shattered when she discovers weapons hidden in their bedroom and disappears, and suspicion falls on her. Shiva Rajkumar and Priyamani star in this Kannada action film directed by Raghava Loki.
all-the-best-2012: All the Best is a Telugu comedy written and directed by J. D. Chakravarthy, a remake of the Malayalam film Gulumaal. Srikanth, J. D. Chakravarthy and Sidhika Sharma lead a story of schemes, mix-ups and misadventures, with Brahmanandam and Kota Srinivasa Rao adding to the comedy. It was later dubbed into Hindi as Risk.
yaare-koogadali-2012: Yaare Koogadali is a 2012 Kannada action thriller written and directed by Samuthirakani, a remake of his Tamil film Poraali, starring Puneeth Rajkumar and Bhavana. On a rainy night, Kumara and his friend arrive in Bangalore with a past they keep to themselves, find work at a petrol station, and win over the people around them, until that past begins to catch up.
sukumarudu-2013: Sukumarudu is a 2013 Telugu romantic drama directed by G. Ashok, starring Aadi with Nisha Agarwal, Bhavna Ruparel and Sarada, with Krishna in a guest role. Sukumar, a wealthy young man living abroad, returns to his family's village over an ancestral property dispute, where he meets a lively local girl and faces resistance from relatives.
tuneega-tuneega-2012: Tuneega Tuneega is a 2012 Telugu romantic drama written and directed by M. S. Raju, starring Sumanth Ashwin and Rhea Chakraborty. Karthik and Nidhi, the children of a businessman and his cook who are lifelong friends, grow up playing pranks on each other, and when Nidhi returns from studying abroad years later, their old hostility starts to soften.
andala-rakshasi-2012: In 1991, Gautham, a wealthy young man, falls for Mithuna and pays for her treatment after a serious accident. But when she wakes, she asks only for Surya, the man she loves, who she is told has died. Hanu Raghavapudi's Telugu romantic debut introduces Naveen Chandra and Lavanya Tripathi, with Rahul Ravindran.
amen-2013: In a picturesque village in Kuttanad, Kerala, Solomon, a timid clarinet player from a once-famous church band, is in love with Shoshanna, the daughter of a wealthy contractor. A new young priest arrives at the church and decides to help the star-crossed lovers, while the band prepares for a crucial competition.
proprietors-kammath-and-kammath-2013: Proprietors: Kammath & Kammath is a 2013 Malayalam action comedy directed by Thomson K. Thomas and written by Udayakrishna and Siby K. Thomas, with Mammootty and Dileep in the title roles. Brothers who grew a humble dosa stand into a restaurant chain across South India try to expand into a new town, where a rival restaurateur is determined to keep them out.
edegarike-2012: Sona is a hitman working for a crime boss in Mumbai. He falls in love with Rashmi, a social worker, while carrying out killings for his boss, then flees to Bangalore to lie low. Based on Agni Shridhar's novel, this Kannada crime drama directed by Sumana Kittur stars Aditya, with Atul Kulkarni.
inkaar-2013: Maya files a sexual harassment complaint against her mentor and former lover Rahul, the CEO of the advertising agency where they both work. As a committee hears both sides, their past relationship is laid bare and the truth turns out to be complicated. Sudhir Mishra's drama stars Arjun Rampal and Chitrangada Singh.
whistle-2013: Whistle is a 2013 Kannada horror thriller directed by Prashant Raj, a remake of the Tamil film Pizza, starring Chiranjeevi Sarja and Pranitha Subhash. Ram, a pizza delivery man who has just married his girlfriend, goes to deliver an order at a lonely bungalow, and finds himself trapped inside as frightening, unexplained things begin to happen.
mickey-virus-2013: When two hackers are murdered in Delhi, the police need a hacker to help crack the case. They find Mickey, a lazy but brilliant young man who runs a grocery shop by day and writes viruses at night, and soon he is caught in a dangerous web. Manish Paul and Elli Avram star in this Hindi comedy thriller by Saurabh Varma.
pullipulikalum-aattinkuttiyum-2013: Pullipulikalum Aattinkuttiyum is a 2013 Malayalam action comedy directed by Lal Jose, starring Kunchacko Boban and Namitha Pramod. Gopan, a houseboat owner and tourist guide in Kuttanad, is the sole earner in a family that includes three idle elder brothers who drink and do odd jobs as local muscle, and he longs for a more settled life.
sringaravelan-2013: Sringaravelan is a 2013 Malayalam action comedy directed by Jose Thomas and written by Udayakrishna and Siby K. Thomas, starring Dileep and Vedhika with Lal and Nedumudi Venu. Kannan, a smooth-talking con man and son of a traditional weaver, dreams of getting rich overnight by marrying into money, until a delivery to an old aristocratic household changes his plans.
ivan-megharoopan-2012: This Malayalam biographical film is about the poet P. Kunhiraman Nair, drawing on his autobiography, Kaviyude Kalpadukal. It follows a restless poet's wandering life, his love of nature and his relationships with the women in his life. Prakash Bare produces and plays the lead, with Shwetha Menon and Padmapriya, directed by P. Balachandran.
naan-2012: As a boy, Karthik sets fire to his home, killing his mother and her lover, and is sent to a juvenile home. On his release he heads to Chennai to start over, but when fate hands him another man's identity, he will go to dangerous lengths to keep it.
chaar-din-ki-chandni-2012: Chaar Din Ki Chandni is a Hindi romantic comedy set around a wedding in a royal Rajput family, where tradition, family pride and a young couple's love collide. Tusshar Kapoor and Kulraj Randhawa play the leads, with Anupam Kher, Om Puri and Anita Raj, in this film directed and produced by Samir Karnik.
daruvu-2012: Bullet Raja, a small-time crook with a good heart, falls for Swetha, who is engaged to a powerful local goon. When things go badly wrong, Raja finds himself bargaining with Yama, the god of death, for a second chance. Ravi Teja plays a dual role opposite Taapsee Pannu in this Telugu fantasy action comedy written and directed by Siva.
settai-2013: Settai is a 2013 Tamil action comedy directed by R. Kannan, a remake of the Hindi film Delhi Belly, starring Arya, Santhanam, Premji, Hansika Motwani and Anjali. Three broke, messy roommates in Mumbai end up with a mysterious package that one of their fiancées was asked to deliver, without realising it is meant for a dangerous crime boss.
hero-2012: Dharmarajan, an ageing action choreographer who runs a combat academy, needs money for his daughter's wedding and turns to a former student, now a top director, for a job. When his other students refuse to help, he seeks out his favourite, Tarzan Antony, who left him long ago. Prithviraj Sukumaran and Yami Gautam star in this Malayalam action film.
gramam-2012: Set in a traditional Brahmin agraharam village in the middle of the 20th century, this bilingual drama looks at the lives, customs and changing times of the families who live there. Written, directed and produced by Mohan Sharma, and made in both Malayalam and Tamil, it stars Nishan, Samvrutha Sunil, Nedumudi Venu and Sukumari.
attahasa-2013: Attahasa tells the story of Veerappan, the notorious forest brigand who ruled the jungles along the Karnataka–Tamil Nadu border for years, and of the long police hunt to catch him. Kishore plays Veerappan, with Arjun Sarja and Suresh Oberoi, in this Kannada biographical crime film directed by A. M. R. Ramesh.
kaddipudi-2013: Anand, nicknamed Kaddipudi, is a Bangalore rowdy used as a pawn by local politicians. After an attack shakes him, he decides to leave the underworld and live peacefully, supported by an honest cop, and meets Uma, a junior artist. Shiva Rajkumar and Radhika Pandit star in this Kannada crime drama directed by Duniya Soori.
saadi-love-story-2013: Saadi Love Story is a 2013 Punjabi romantic comedy and the directorial debut of Dheeraj Rattan, co-produced by Jimmy Shergill and starring Diljit Dosanjh, Amrinder Gill, Surveen Chawla and Neetu Singh. When Preeti's sister lands in hospital, two young men, both named Rajveer, turn up and each insists that he is her boyfriend.
david-and-goliath-2013: David, an orphan left outside a church on a tea estate, is raised by a kindly priest. Smart and devout but painfully nervous around people, he has to drop out of school, and grows up on the margins of the world. Jayasurya and Anoop Menon star in this Malayalam drama written by Anoop Menon and directed by Rajeev Nath.
sahasam-2013: Sahasam is a 2013 Telugu action adventure directed by Chandra Sekhar Yeleti, starring Gopichand and Taapsee Pannu. Goutham, a security guard in Hyderabad, learns that his family has a claim to a fortune left behind in Pakistan, and his journey across the border puts him on the trail of an ancient treasure that dangerous men are also hunting.
immanuel-2013: Immanuel, an honest family man, loses his job when the publishing company he works for shuts down. He finds work in a private insurance company, where he is pushed to put profits ahead of people, and must decide where his conscience stands. Lal Jose's drama stars Mammootty, Fahadh Faasil and Reenu Mathews.
balak-palak-2013: A group of curious teenagers, with no one willing to answer their questions, set out to learn about sex on their own, with comic and awkward results. Directed by Ravi Jadhav, this Marathi comedy drama about sex education was the first film produced by actor Riteish Deshmukh.
aravind-2-2013: Aravind, a struggling filmmaker desperate for a breakthrough, decides to make a documentary on haunted places. With his cameraman and production manager, he heads to a remote village to film inside a house said to be haunted. Sri, Kamal Kamaraju and Srinivas Avasarala star in this Telugu thriller by Sekhar Suri, a sequel to A Film by Aravind.
rangrezz-2013: Rangrezz is a 2013 Hindi action drama directed by Priyadarshan, an official remake of the Tamil film Naadodigal, starring Jackky Bhagnani, Priya Anand, Vijay Varma and Amitosh Nagpal. Rishi, a good-hearted young man in Mumbai about to settle down, agrees with his two closest friends to help an old friend elope with the woman he loves, at a steep cost to all of them.
5-sundarikal-2013: This Malayalam anthology brings together five short love stories, each about a different kind of woman and each made by a different director: Shyju Khalid, Sameer Thahir, Aashiq Abu, Amal Neerad and Anwar Rasheed. The ensemble cast includes Dulquer Salmaan, Fahadh Faasil and Isha Sharvani.
north-24-kaatham-2013: Harikrishnan, a socially awkward software engineer obsessed with order, gets stranded on a journey across Kerala during a sudden state-wide strike. Forced to travel with an elderly man and a young social worker, he learns to loosen up. Anil Radhakrishnan Menon's road drama, which won the National Award for Best Malayalam Film, stars Fahadh Faasil, Nedumudi Venu and Swathi Reddy.
investment-2012: Aashish, an ambitious young man about to join an American firm, and his wife Prachi are eager to climb the social ladder, pinning their hopes on their twelve-year-old son Sohel. When their son is involved in a serious incident, the family must decide what matters more: their values or their ambitions. Ratnakar Matkari writes and directs this Marathi drama.
cowboy-2013: Vinay runs a pub called Cowboy in Kuala Lumpur, to the disgust of his father and the disapproval of his sister and her husband. When his young nephew Pankaj arrives in Malaysia, Vinay is drawn into a dangerous situation. Asif Ali and Khushbu star in this Malayalam thriller directed by P. Balachandrakumar.
my-boss-2012: Manu takes a job in Mumbai as executive assistant to Priya, a demanding Australian-citizen boss whom everyone fears. When Priya faces deportation and needs a husband, she makes Manu an offer, and he takes her home to Kerala as his wife. Dileep and Mamta Mohandas star in this Malayalam romantic comedy written and directed by Jeethu Joseph.
gundello-godari-2013: In 1986, in a village near Rajahmundry, a newly married couple, Malli and Chitra, are caught in a devastating flood of the Godavari. Losing hope of being rescued, they cling to support and tell each other the darkest moments of their lives. Aadhi Pinisetty, Lakshmi Manchu, Taapsee Pannu and Sundeep Kishan star in this Telugu drama by Kumar Nagendra.
hum-hai-raahi-car-ke-2013: Two friends decide to drive from Mumbai to Pune on New Year's night. What should be a simple road trip quickly spirals into a string of bizarre and comic misadventures. Dev Goel makes his debut as the lead in this Hindi romantic comedy directed by his father Jyotin Goel, with Juhi Chawla, Sanjay Dutt and Anupam Kher.
paisa-2013: Paisa is a Telugu action comedy directed by Krishna Vamsi, starring Nani and Catherine Tresa. When a state minister is removed over links to a liquor mafia, the by-election for his seat turns into a contest of who can spend the most, and huge sums of cash begin moving through the constituency, drawing ordinary people into the chase.
sixteen-2013: Sixteen is a 2013 Hindi coming-of-age drama directed by Raj Purohit, with debutants Wamiqa Gabbi, Izabelle Leite and Mehak Manwani. Four teenage girls in Delhi, from an ambitious would-be model to a sheltered girl teased by her peers, face the pressures of growing up too fast in a world of constant exposure and peer pressure.
chor-chor-super-chor-2013: In Delhi, a fake photo studio is the front for a gang of young petty thieves. Satbir, one of them, wants to give up crime and falls in love with Neena, unaware that she is a TV reporter secretly recording the gang's activities. Deepak Dobriyal, Anshul Kataria and Priya Bathija star in this Hindi comedy directed by K. Rajesh.
horror-story-2013: Seven old friends reunite at a pub to say goodbye to one of them before he moves abroad. On a dare, they decide to spend the night in an abandoned hotel rumoured to be haunted, and soon discover the rumours are true. Written by Vikram Bhatt and directed by Ayush Raina, this Hindi horror film stars Karan Kundrra, Nishant Malkani and Ravish Desai.
karle-pyaar-karle-2014: Preet and Kabir have been daring each other with dangerous games since childhood. After an incident sends eight-year-old Kabir to a juvenile home, his mother leaves town to protect him. Years later, the two meet again, and their rebel love story begins. Shiv Darshan and Hasleen Kaur make their debuts in this Hindi romance produced by Suneel Darshan.
saivam-2014: When Kathiresan Chettiyar's large family gathers for a holiday, a string of bad luck is blamed on a forgotten ritual sacrifice, and a rooster is chosen for it. His young granddaughter, who has grown fond of the bird, decides to save it. Vijay's comedy drama stars Nassar and Sara Arjun.
raja-natwarlal-2014: Raja Natwarlal is a 2014 Hindi crime thriller directed by Kunal Deshmukh, starring Emraan Hashmi with Humaima Malik, Paresh Rawal and Kay Kay Menon. Raja, a small-time con man who works with his partner Raghav, falls for a bar dancer and decides to pull off one big score so she can leave the bar, but the job lands them in deep trouble.
rasam-2015: Rasam is a 2015 Malayalam film about food and the catering trade, directed and co-written by Rajeev Nath, with Mohanlal appearing as himself alongside Nedumudi Venu and Indrajith. When a Doha business tycoon wants a traditional Kerala feast for his daughter's wedding, a veteran caterer's team flies out, and circumstances push his son Balu to take charge.
drushyam-2014: Rambabu, a cable TV operator who loves films, lives contentedly with his wife and two daughters in a hill village. When a crisis involving a missing young man threatens his family, he uses everything he has learnt from cinema to protect them from a determined police officer. Sripriya's remake of Drishyam stars Venkatesh and Meena.
gangster-2014: Akbar Ali Khan is a powerful crime boss in Mangalore who shares the city's underworld with two other kingpins, keeping it calm. When one partner's grandson, a drug baron, plans to import contaminated vaccines, Akbar opposes him, setting off a violent war. Mammootty stars in this Malayalam action drama directed by Aashiq Abu.
vikramadithyan-2014: Vikramadithyan is a 2014 Malayalam action comedy directed by Lal Jose, starring Dulquer Salmaan and Unni Mukundan, with Namitha Pramod, Lena and Nivin Pauly in an extended cameo. Two boys born on the same day, the son of a petty thief and the son of a police officer, grow up as lifelong rivals who both set their sights on joining the police force.
iyobinte-pusthakam-2014: In 1900s Munnar under British rule, Iyob, a worker raised by a British planter, inherits power and land, and his three sons grow up with very different natures. As greed and cruelty tear the family apart, his youngest son Aloshy returns from the navy. Fahadh Faasil, Lal and Jayasurya star in this Malayalam period thriller by Amal Neerad.
picket-43-2014: Picket 43 is a Malayalam anti-war film written and directed by Major Ravi, starring Prithviraj Sukumaran and Javed Jaffrey. Havildar Harindran Nair is ordered to guard an isolated post on the Line of Control in Kashmir despite having been granted leave, with only a trained dog for company, until an unexpected bond forms across the border.
aa-gaye-munde-u-k-de-2014: Aa Gaye Munde U.K. De is the follow-up to the Punjabi hit Munde U.K. De, bringing back its mix of romance and family comedy. Jimmy Sheirgill and Neeru Bajwa lead a cast that also includes Gurpreet Ghuggi, Binnu Dhillon and Om Puri, in this romantic comedy directed by Manmohan Singh.
100-days-of-love-2015: Balan, a Bangalore newspaper columnist who feels like the failure of his family, shares a taxi by chance with a young woman named Sheela and falls for her instantly. When she leaves her bag behind, he sets out to find her. Dulquer Salmaan and Nithya Menen star in this Malayalam romantic comedy by Jenuse Mohamed.
ata-pata-laapata-2012: Manav Chaturvedi files a police complaint that his entire house has been stolen. Suspected of making it vanish himself for the insurance money, he becomes a media sensation, and the authorities are forced to take the case seriously. Rajpal Yadav makes his directing debut and stars in this Hindi musical satire about bureaucracy and power.
pathemari-2015: Pathemari is a 2015 Malayalam period drama written and directed by Salim Ahamed, starring Mammootty with Jewel Mary and Sreenivasan. In the 1960s, Narayanan and a friend make a risky sea crossing to Dubai on a smuggler's dhow, and he spends decades as a labourer in the Gulf, living in cramped camps and sending his earnings home to Kerala.
tamilselvanum-thaniyar-anjalum-2016: Tamilselvanum Thaniyar Anjalum is a 2016 Tamil action thriller directed by Premsai and produced by Gautham Vasudev Menon, starring Jai, Santhanam and Yami Gautam. Tamilselvan, a college dropout who drifts between odd jobs, moves to Chennai and becomes a courier boy just to see a woman he has fallen for, until a delivery pulls him into danger.
courier-boy-kalyan-2015: Kalyan, a jobless orphan who lives with his sister, takes a job as a courier boy. One delivery puts him on the trail of a corrupt doctor who has moved his illegal stem cell business from London to India, and suddenly Kalyan is in danger. Nithiin and Yami Gautam star in this Telugu action thriller produced by Gautham Vasudev Menon.
the-fourth-direction-2015: The Fourth Direction is a 2015 Punjabi drama directed by Gurvinder Singh, based on two short stories from Waryam Singh Sandhu's collection Chauthi Koot. Set in Punjab in the 1980s, after Operation Blue Star, it weaves together two tales of ordinary people caught between militants and security forces, where fear seeps into everyday life.
1983-2014: In Brahmamangalam, a Kerala village gripped by cricket fever after India's 1983 World Cup win, young Rameshan lives for the game while his father wants him to become an engineer. The film follows his passion across two generations. Nivin Pauly stars in this Malayalam coming-of-age sports drama directed by Abrid Shine.
malini-22-palayamkottai-2014: Malini, a nursing student in Bangalore planning a career abroad, falls in love with Varun from a travel agency and moves in with him. Then she is betrayed and brutally wronged by people she trusted, and sets out to make them pay. Nithya Menen stars in this Tamil thriller directed by Sripriya, a remake of the Malayalam film 22 Female Kottayam.
ajith-2014: Ajith, an unemployed graduate in Bangalore, falls for Charulatha, who asks him to drive her to her grandmother's home in Mumbai so she can escape a forced marriage. Along the way, two different gangs come after them. Chiranjeevi Sarja and Nikki Galrani star in this Kannada remake of the Tamil hit Paiyaa, directed by Mahesh Babu.
rowdy-2014: Rowdy is a 2014 Telugu action drama written and directed by Ram Gopal Varma, a remake of his Hindi film Sarkar, starring Mohan Babu, his son Vishnu Manchu and Jayasudha. In the Rayalaseema region, a powerful don called Anna is revered by the people he protects, and his sons find themselves on opposite sides as rivals plot against him.
praise-the-lord-2014: Praise the Lord is a 2014 Malayalam film directed by Shibu Gangadharan, starring Mammootty, Akanksha Puri and Mukesh. Adapted by T. P. Devarajan from Zacharia's novelette of the same name, it follows a devout, easy-going farmer in rural Kerala whose settled life is upended when a young couple who have run away together turn up at his home.
ekkees-toppon-ki-salaami-2014: Purushottam Joshi, an honest common man, never received respect for his years of service. His two sons, Shekhar and Subhash, decide to give him the ultimate honour he always dreamed of: a 21-gun salute, and go to absurd lengths to make it happen. Anupam Kher, Divyenndu and Manu Rishi star in this Hindi satire.
kick-2-2015: Kalyan's son Robin Hood is his opposite: a young man who wants comfort in everything. When he moves to Hyderabad to recover a plot of family land grabbed by a local strongman, he is drawn into a much bigger fight. Ravi Teja and Rakul Preet Singh star in this Telugu action comedy by Surender Reddy, the sequel to Kick.
khamoshiyan-2015: Kabir, a struggling novelist, travels to Kashmir in search of a story and stays at a remote guesthouse run by the beautiful, mysterious Meera, whose husband is bedridden. On his first night, he sees strange apparitions, and soon learns the house holds dark secrets. Ali Fazal, Sapna Pabbi and Gurmeet Choudhary star in this Hindi horror thriller.
lokmanya-ek-yugpurush-2014: This Marathi biographical film tells the story of Bal Gangadhar Tilak, the freedom fighter and social reformer called Lokmanya and the 'Father of Indian Unrest'. It follows his fiery newspapers, books and speeches against British rule, and the price he paid for them. Subodh Bhave stars as Tilak in Om Raut's directing debut.
fireman-2015: On the day a veteran fire officer retires, a desperate father reports that his young daughter, recently treated for a serious illness, has gone missing. The same night, a gas leak threatens the city, and a team of firefighters must race against time to prevent disaster. Mammootty, Unni Mukundan and Salim Kumar star in this Malayalam disaster thriller by Deepu Karunakaran.
crazy-cukkad-family-2015: When the wealthy Mr Beri slips into his third coma, his four estranged children rush home to his estate in the hills, each hoping he will finally pass and leave them his fortune, and each with troubles of their own. Swanand Kirkire, Shilpa Shukla and Nora Fatehi star in this Hindi comedy produced by Prakash Jha.
zoom-2015: Zoom is a Kannada romantic comedy directed by Prashant Raj, starring Ganesh and Radhika Pandit, with comedians Sadhu Kokila and Kashinath in support, music by S. Thaman and cinematography by Santhosh Rai Pathaje. It is a light-hearted love story that leans on the comic chemistry between its popular lead pair.
kanche-2015: In 1936, Haribabu, the grandson of a village barber, and Sitadevi, a princess from a powerful estate, meet at university in Madras and fall in love. Their romance sets off a bitter caste feud back home, and years later Haribabu fights as a soldier in the Second World War. Varun Tej and Pragya Jaiswal star in this Telugu war romance by Krish.
loafer-2015: After separating from his wife, Murali takes their young son Raja to Jodhpur, where they live as small-time crooks. Years later, Raja falls in love with Mouni, a young woman who has run away from an unwanted marriage, and her arrival stirs up the past. Varun Tej, Disha Patani and Revathi star in this Telugu action drama by Puri Jagannadh.
two-countries-2015: Two Countries is a 2015 Malayalam romantic comedy directed by Shafi and written by Rafi, starring Dileep and Mamta Mohandas. Ullas, a 35-year-old small-time con man in his hometown who will do anything for easy money, agrees to marry the sister of a man he owes money to, and follows his new wife to Canada with big plans.
kshanam-2016: Rishi, an investment banker in San Francisco, flies to Hyderabad when his ex-girlfriend Swetha asks for help finding her missing young daughter. But everyone around her insists the child never existed. Ravikanth Perepu's mystery thriller stars Adivi Sesh, Adah Sharma, Anasuya Bharadwaj and Satyadev.
terror-2016: Terror is a 2016 Telugu action thriller written and directed by Satish Kasetty, starring Srikanth with Nikita, Nassar and Kota Srinivasa Rao. Vijay, an honest police officer who sometimes has to bend to pressure from above, raids a club owned by a powerful MLA and seizes his cash, and the fallout pulls him into a far bigger and more dangerous conspiracy.
bank-chor-2017: Champak, a bumbling Marathi man, plans to rob a Mumbai bank with two equally inept friends wearing animal masks. The heist goes wrong almost at once, leaving them with a bank full of hostages, and soon the police and a far more dangerous criminal are closing in.
babumoshai-bandookbaaz-2017: In the badlands of Uttar Pradesh, Babu Bihari is a hired killer who works for two rival politicians and takes pride in clean, simple kills. While watching his next target, he meets Phulwa, a fiery cobbler, and falls for her. Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Bidita Bag star in this Hindi crime thriller directed by Kushan Nandy.
king-liar-2016: Sathyanarayan is a smooth-talking con man who fools his girlfriend Anjali into believing he runs a big firm, while really forging certificates with his friend. When a wealthy Dubai fashion tycoon on the verge of divorce enters his life, his lies are put to their biggest test. Dileep and Madonna Sebastian star in this Malayalam comedy directed by Lal.
haseena-parkar-2017: In 2007, Haseena Parkar, sister of the fugitive gangster Dawood Ibrahim, appears in a Mumbai court. As the case unfolds, the film looks back on her life, from a young woman in a large family to a figure feared in the city's underworld. Shraddha Kapoor stars, with her brother Siddhanth Kapoor as Dawood, in this Hindi biographical crime film by Apoorva Lakhia.
nenu-sailaja-2016: Nenu Sailaja is a 2016 Telugu romantic comedy directed by Kishore Tirumala, starring Ram Pothineni and Keerthy Suresh. Hari, a cheerful Vizag DJ who has been turned down by every girl he has ever proposed to, finally meets someone he falls for deeply, but winning her over proves far more complicated than he expects.
a-death-in-the-gunj-2016: In 1979, a family travels from Calcutta to the Anglo-Indian town of McCluskieganj for a holiday at the grandparents' home. Shutu, a shy, sensitive young cousin still grieving his father, is teased and bullied by the others over the course of a week that ends in tragedy.
krishnashtami-2016: Krishnashtami is a Telugu action comedy written and directed by Vasu Varma and produced by Dil Raju, with cinematography by Chota K. Naidu. Sunil plays the lead, with Nikki Galrani and Dimple Chopade, in a story that mixes family emotion, romance, comedy and action.
saithan-2016: Saithan is a 2016 Tamil psychological thriller and the directorial debut of Pradeep Krishnamoorthy, starring Vijay Antony with Arundhati Nair. Dinesh, a software professional, begins hearing a voice that he believes belongs to God, and as it grows more insistent and troubling, he turns to a psychiatrist to uncover where it is coming from.
maayavan-2017: A cop investigates a string of mysterious murders. Sundeep Kishan stars.
bambukat-2016: In rural Punjab of the past, Channan is a young farmer obsessed with machines who feels slighted when his in-laws fuss over his brother-in-law and his motorcycle. Desperate to earn the same respect, Channan sells his cattle to buy a motorcycle of his own, not knowing it is stolen.
oozham-2016: Oozham is a 2016 Malayalam action thriller written and directed by Jeethu Joseph, starring Prithviraj Sukumaran with Balachandra Menon and Pasupathy. Surya, a demolition expert working in the US, watches helplessly over a video call as his family is attacked at home, and he sets out with his adopted brother to track down those responsible.
khaidi-no-150-2017: Kaththi Seenu, a petty criminal who escapes police custody in Kolkata, is about to flee to Bangkok when he comes across his exact lookalike, Shankar, a man fighting for farmers against a powerful company. Seeing an opportunity, Seenu takes his place. Chiranjeevi plays both in his comeback film, with Kajal Aggarwal, directed by V. V. Vinayak.
katamarayudu-2017: Katamarayudu is a brave, selfless man in a village who has raised his four younger brothers and refuses to marry, fearing a wife might divide the family. His brothers, who are always getting into fights, secretly plan to find him a bride. Pawan Kalyan and Shruti Haasan star in this Telugu action comedy directed by Kishore Kumar Pardasani.
the-great-father-2017: The Great Father is a 2017 Malayalam neo-noir crime thriller directed by Haneef Adeni, starring Mammootty with Arya, Sneha and Malavika Mohanan. David Nainan, a busy Kochi businessman, comes home to find his ten-year-old daughter has been attacked, and when he learns the culprit is a notorious serial killer, he sets out to track the man down himself.
vangaveeti-2016: Vangaveeti is a 2016 Telugu biographical action film written and directed by Ram Gopal Varma, based on the life of the politician Vangaveeti Mohana Ranga and his elder brother Radha. In 1970s Vijayawada, a struggle for control of the city's transport business pits the brothers against powerful rivals, setting off years of bloody factional conflict.
nene-raju-nene-mantri-2017: Nene Raju Nene Mantri is a 2017 Telugu political drama written and directed by Teja, starring Rana Daggubati and Kajal Aggarwal. Jogendra, a village moneylender devoted to his wife Radha, is pushed into politics after she is slighted at the local temple, and he begins a ruthless climb toward power.
daddy-2017: As Mumbai's textile mills close in the 1970s, a young unemployed mill worker named Arun Gawli turns to gambling and crime with his friends, and slowly rises to become one of the city's most powerful gangsters and later a politician. Arjun Rampal, who also co-wrote the film, stars in this Hindi biographical crime drama directed by Ashim Ahluwalia.
rogue-2017: Rogue is a 2017 action drama directed by Puri Jagannadh, shot in Telugu and Kannada and starring Ishan, Mannara Chopra and Angela Krislinzki. Sanju, a reckless young man soured on women after being cheated by his girlfriend, injures a police constable in a fight and, out of guilt, starts working to support the man's family.
lahoriye-2017: Kikkar Singh, a Sikh man from an Indian village near the border, sees Ameeran, a Muslim woman from Lahore, across the fence while working in his fields and falls in love. Their love story unfolds against the long shadow of Partition. Amrinder Gill and Sargun Mehta star in this Punjabi drama written and directed by Amberdeep Singh.
ranveer-ching-returns-2016: Ranveer Ching Returns is a 2016 Hindi short action comedy directed by Rohit Shetty, made as an advertisement for the food brand Ching's Secret and starring Ranveer Singh and Tamannaah Bhatia. A hero arrives in a land gripped by food shortage and helps its people fight hunger, with plenty of Rohit Shetty-style action along the way.
bhaagamathie-2018: A jailed officer is kept in a haunted palace. Anushka Shetty stars.
saamy-square-2018: A sequel to Saamy. Vikram stars.
guntur-talkies-2016: Hari and Giri are low-paid salesmen at a medical shop in Guntur who secretly work as petty thieves, stealing small things nobody will miss. When they get their hands on a large sum of money and run off to Goa, they find themselves chased. Siddu Jonnalagadda, Rashmi Gautam and Shraddha Das star in this Telugu crime comedy by Praveen Sattaru.
dongri-ka-raja-2016: Raja is the adopted son and trusted sharpshooter of Mansoor Ali, the most famous don of Mumbai's Dongri, who is grooming him as his successor. Raja's life changes when he falls in love, and a police officer whose name he has been using is closing in. Gashmeer Mahajani, Ronit Roy and Ashmit Patel star in this Hindi action drama.
take-off-2017: Take Off is a 2017 Malayalam survival thriller directed by Mahesh Narayan, based on the ordeal of Indian nurses in Tikrit, Iraq, in 2014, starring Parvathy Thiruvothu, Kunchacko Boban and Fahadh Faasil. Sameera, a Kerala nurse struggling to repay her family's loans, takes a better-paying job in Iraq, unaware of how quickly the country around her hospital will fall apart.
manje-bistre-2017: While preparing for his sister's big Punjabi wedding, Sukhi meets Rano, his sister's friend, and falls for her at once. Rano is a hesitant lover, and their romance unfolds amid a crowd of colourful relatives and wedding chaos. Gippy Grewal and Sonam Bajwa star in this Punjabi romantic comedy.
kaasav-2016: Maanav, a deeply depressed young man, runs away from hospital and collapses by the road. Janaki, a divorcee coping with her own anxiety, takes him to her home in coastal Konkan, where an old friend is working to protect olive ridley turtles. Sumitra Bhave and Sunil Sukthankar's Marathi film won the National Award for Best Feature Film.
mission-china-2017: Mission China is an Assamese action drama directed by singer and actor Zubeen Garg, who also stars in the lead role and produced the film with Garima Saikia Garg. Deeplina Deka plays the female lead in this story of action, courage and a dangerous mission, made under the Eye Creation Productions banner.
dandupalya-2-2017: As members of the notorious Dandupalya gang await execution, a journalist named Abhi starts to re-investigate their case, questioning the lack of solid evidence behind their conviction and digging into what really happened. Pooja Gandhi and Sanjjana star in this Kannada crime thriller by Srinivas Raju, the sequel to Dandupalya.
qaidi-band-2017: Qaidi Band is a 2017 Hindi musical drama directed by Habib Faisal and produced by Aditya Chopra, introducing Aadar Jain and Anya Singh. A group of under-trial prisoners, stuck in jail for years while their cases drag on, are put together as a band for an official event, and they begin to see music as their way to be heard.
qarib-qarib-singlle-2017: Qarib Qarib Singlle is a 2017 Hindi romantic comedy co-written and directed by Tanuja Chandra, starring Irrfan Khan and Parvathy Thiruvothu. Jaya, a widow in her thirties tired of being nagged by friends and family, signs up on a dating site and meets Yogi, a carefree poet who talks her into a trip across India to visit his old flames.
annadurai-2017: Annadurai, a good-hearted man who has turned to drink since the death of the woman he loved, and his identical twin brother Thambidurai lead very different lives, until one fateful incident changes both their paths. Vijay Antony plays both brothers and composes the music for this Tamil action drama directed by G. Srinivasan.
thadam-2018: Two lookalikes are suspects in a murder. Arun Vijay stars.
saakshyam-2018: A man takes revenge for his family's murder. Bellamkonda Sreenivas stars.
sudani-from-nigeria-2018: Majeed, a struggling manager of a small-town football club in Malappuram, recruits three Nigerian players. When his star player, Samuel, is injured and cannot play, Majeed takes him home to recover, and an unlikely bond grows between them and Majeed's family. Zakariya Mohammed's drama stars Soubin Shahir and Samuel Abiola Robinson.
eeda-2018: A modern tale of Romeo and Juliet set in Kannur. Shane Nigam stars.
harjeeta-2018: A poor boy becomes a hockey star. Ammy Virk stars.
savyasachi-2018: A man shares his body with his dead twin. Naga Chaitanya stars.
kanaa-2018: Kowsalya, a farmer's daughter in a Tamil Nadu village, sets her heart on playing cricket for India after seeing her father heartbroken by a World Cup loss. Facing a doubtful village and a struggling family farm, she fights her way towards the national team. Arunraja Kamaraj's sports drama stars Aishwarya Rajesh, Sathyaraj and Sivakarthikeyan.
madhura-raja-2019: A sequel to Pokkiri Raja. Mammootty stars.
moothon-2018: Mulla, a 14-year-old from Lakshadweep, runs away to Mumbai to look for his elder brother Akbar, who left the islands years ago. His search takes him through the city's underworld and into the story of who his brother became. Geetu Mohandas's drama, made in Malayalam and Hindi, stars Nivin Pauly, Sanjana Dipu, Shashank Arora and Roshan Mathew.
aravindante-athidhikal-2018: A lodge owner in Kollur searches for his roots. Vineeth Sreenivasan stars.
bhayanakam-2018: A postman delivers wartime letters in a Kerala village. Jayaraj directs.
sammohanam-2018: A young artist falls for a film star. Sudheer Babu and Aditi Rao Hydari star.
natasaarvabhowma-2019: A Kannada action comedy with Puneeth Rajkumar.
mar-gaye-oye-loko-2018: Mar Gaye Oye Loko is a Punjabi comedy directed by Simerjit Singh, following Tittu, a simple young man, on an unusual journey that takes him beyond the world of the living. Gippy Grewal, Binnu Dhillon and Sapna Pabbi star in the film, which mixes romance and fantasy with broad comedy.
evening-shadows-2018: A son comes out to his mother in small-town India. Mona Ambegaonkar stars.
chaal-jeevi-laiye-2019: Aditya, a workaholic son, has no time for his father Bipin. When Bipin learns he is seriously ill, he asks Aditya to join him on a trip to Kedarnath and the Ganga, and the two set off on a journey that changes them both. Siddharth Randeria, Yash Soni and Aarohi Patel star in this Gujarati road comedy by Vipul Mehta.
ardaas-karaan-2019: A Punjabi social drama directed by Gippy Grewal.
albert-pinto-ko-gussa-kyoon-aata-hai-201: A man's father dies, and his anger leads him into crime. Manav Kaul stars.
mamangam-2019: Set against the medieval Mamankam festival on the banks of the Bharathappuzha in Kerala, the film follows the Chaver warriors who swore to fight the powerful Zamorin to the death. Twelve-year-old Chandroth Chanthunni becomes a legend after his brave stand at the fair.
chal-mera-putt-2019: Punjabi migrants in Britain struggle for residency. Amrinder Gill stars.
helen-2019: A young woman is accidentally locked in a freezer overnight. Anna Ben stars.
life-s-good-2022: An elderly man finds his quiet life transformed after a young child unexpectedly enters it. Anant Mahadevan's Hindi drama stars Jackie Shroff, with Rajit Kapur, Mohan Kapoor and Anannaya Vij, and explores companionship and finding new purpose late in life.
psycho-2020: A blind man hunts a serial killer who kidnapped a radio jockey. Mysskin directs.
uppena-2020: A fisherman falls for a rich man's daughter. Vaisshnav Tej stars.
hirkani-2019: Set in the 17th century near Raigad, the capital of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the film tells the story of Hirkani, a milkmaid from the village below the fort. When she is shut inside the fort for the night, away from her infant son, she attempts a daring climb down the cliffs to reach him.
indoo-ki-jawani-2020: A woman goes on a dating app and meets a man from Pakistan. Kiara Advani stars.
jathi-ratnalu-2020: Three bumbling friends get caught in a political crime. Naveen Polishetty stars.
kappela-2020: A village girl travels to Kozhikode to meet a man she knows only by phone. Anna Ben stars.
dia-2020: A shy young woman is torn between two men. A Kannada romance.
30-rojullo-preminchadam-ela-2020: Two people discover they were lovers in a past life. Pradeep Machiraju stars.
kurup-2021: The story of fugitive Sukumara Kurup. Dulquer Salmaan stars.
bheeshma-parvam-2022: The head of a powerful family faces internal rivalries. Mammootty stars.
ajeeb-daastaans-2021: Four stories about relationships. A Hindi anthology.
lalitham-sundaram-2022: Siblings reunite on a family holiday. Biju Menon and Manju Warrier star.
21mu-tiffin-2021: A housewife rediscovers herself. A Gujarati drama.
janhit-mein-jaari-2022: A woman takes a job selling condoms. Nushrratt Bharuccha stars.
saudi-vellakka-2022: A minor dispute drags on in the courts for years. Tharun Moorthy directs.
kutch-express-2023: A woman discovers her husband's affair. Ratna Pathak Shah stars.
vadh-2022: An old man commits a murder to protect himself. Sanjay Mishra and Neena Gupta star.
run-baby-run-2023: A man helps a stranger and is drawn into a conspiracy. RJ Balaji stars.
sapta-saagaradaache-ello-side-a-2023: A young man takes the blame for a crime and is separated from his love. Rakshit Shetty stars.
hey-sinamika-2022: A woman hires a psychologist to seduce her husband. Dulquer Salmaan stars.
the-warriorr-2022: A doctor turns police officer to fight a gangster. Ram Pothineni stars.
love-hostel-2022: A young couple are hunted by a killer hired by her family. Vikrant Massey stars.
cbi-5-the-brain-2022: A CBI officer investigates a series of murders. Mammootty stars.
pawankhind-2022: The battle of Pawan Khind in 1660. A Marathi historical action drama.
ardh-2022: A struggling actor performs as a transgender person to make a living. Rajpal Yadav stars.
kranti-2023: A Kannada action drama with Darshan.
jogi-2022: A Sikh man helps people escape the 1984 riots. Diljit Dosanjh stars.
maja-ma-2022: A mother's secret comes out just before her son's wedding. Madhuri Dixit stars.
mark-antony-2023: A mechanic finds a phone that can call the past. Vishal and S. J. Suryah star.
abraham-ozler-2024: A police officer investigates a series of murders. Jayaram stars.
kaatera-2023: A blacksmith fights for farmers' land rights. Darshan stars.
i-love-you-2023: A young woman working late at her office finds herself trapped in the deserted building at night with a dangerously obsessed man, and must find a way to survive until morning. Rakul Preet Singh, Pavail Gulati and Akshay Oberoi star in Nikhil Mahajan's thriller, loosely inspired by the American film P2.
mast-mein-rehne-ka-2023: An elderly man and an old woman form an unlikely friendship. Jackie Shroff and Neena Gupta star.
murder-mubarak-2024: A murder at an exclusive Delhi club. Pankaj Tripathi stars.
madgaon-express-2024: Three friends' trip to Goa goes very wrong. Kunal Khemu's directing debut.
marco-2024: A man seeks revenge for his brother's murder. Unni Mukundan stars.
sankranthiki-vasthunam-2025: A former cop is pulled back for a kidnapping case. Venkatesh stars.

This Hindi thriller series stars Shriya Pilgaonkar, Viraf Patel and Naveed Aslam.
2-mad-men-2021: Ananda and Kaiser, the heads of an advertising agency, come up with an unusual plan to bring discipline to their easygoing staff and cut down on overtime. But their scheme takes a creepy turn and spirals into a mysterious incident nobody expected. This Bengali comedy thriller series streams on Bongo.
21-sarfarosh-saragarhi-1897-2018: In 1897, on the North-West Frontier, a small outpost manned by 21 Sikh soldiers of the British Indian Army faces an attack by thousands of Afghan tribesmen. The series follows the men in the days leading up to one of history's most famous last stands. Mohit Raina and Mukul Dev star in this historical drama.
24-2013: Jai Singh Rathod, the head of an elite anti-terror unit, has just 24 hours to stop a plot to assassinate a political leader and a terror attack on the country, while protecting his own family. Each episode unfolds in real time. Anil Kapoor stars in this Indian adaptation of the American series 24, on Colors.
7-kadam-2021: A father who coaches his son dreams of making him the world's best footballer. But a generation gap and very different views of life put them at odds, and the son must decide whether his father's lessons will guide him to the right choices. This Hindi sports drama series streams on Eros Now.
a-big-little-murder-2021: In 2017, a young schoolboy was found murdered in the toilet of a private school near Delhi, a case that shocked the country. Through interviews with the people involved, this Netflix documentary series retraces the investigation and the twists that followed in the search for the truth.
a-i-sha-my-virtual-girlfriend-2016: Sam, a brilliant app developer at a tech start-up, is tormented by his power-hungry boss Sid. Determined to build his dream project anyway, he creates AISHA, an artificial-intelligence assistant, and soon finds himself drawn to the virtual companion he has made. This Hindi web series premiered on YouTube.
a-simple-murder-2020: Manish, a small-time man desperate to get rich quick, takes on a job as a contract killer. In a comic mix-up, he kills the wrong person, the girlfriend of a dangerous man, and soon everyone from gangsters to police is after him. This Hindi black comedy series on SonyLIV stars Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, Amit Sial and Priya Anand.
aahat-1996: Each episode of this long-running Hindi horror anthology tells a self-contained tale of the supernatural, from ghosts and possessed objects to witches, curses and revenge from beyond the grave. Created by B. P. Singh, Aahat aired across several seasons on Sony Entertainment Television and became one of Indian television's best-known horror shows.
aarya-2020: Aarya, a devoted wife and mother, has stayed far away from her husband's drug business. When he is murdered, she is pulled into the very world she hated, and to protect her three children she must take on the mafia herself. Sushmita Sen stars in this Hindi crime drama series, adapted from the Dutch series Penoza.
aashram-2020: Baba Nirala, a charismatic godman in the fictional town of Kashipur, is worshipped by thousands of poor followers who see him as their saviour. Behind the devotion lies an empire built on crime, politics and exploitation, which a reluctant police officer and a young doctor begin to uncover. Prakash Jha's crime drama series stars Bobby Deol.
abhay-2019: Abhay Pratap Singh, a sharp investigating officer who thinks like a criminal, will go to any lengths to crack his cases. Each story pits him against a twisted killer, while he battles his own personal demons. This ZEE5 crime thriller series, inspired by real cases, stars Kunal Khemu, Elnaaz Norouzi and Sandeepa Dhar.
adaalat-2010: K. D. Pathak, a stylish and unconventional defence lawyer, takes on cases that seem impossible to win. In each story he picks apart the prosecution's arguments, exposes the real culprit and wins justice for his client. Ronit Roy stars in this Hindi courtroom drama, one of the longest-running series on Sony Entertainment Television.
adarsh-baal-vidyalaya-2026: At a run-down government school in Delhi, a laid-back headmaster gets a shot at a fully paid trip to Cambridge, if he can show the school has improved. His ragtag team of teachers scrambles to fix a broken system, one lesson at a time. This Prime Video comedy series stars Kay Kay Menon and Archana Puran Singh.
adventures-of-akira-and-mowgli-2026: Akira, a brave girl from a village near the Seonee jungle, wanders into the forest and narrowly escapes the jaws of the tiger Shere Khan. Learning that a second human cub, Mowgli, lives among the animals, the furious tiger sets out after them both. This animated series offers new adventures from the world of The Jungle Book.
afsos-2020: Nakul, a depressed young writer, wants nothing more than to die, but every attempt fails. So he hires a professional assassin to do the job, and then has a change of heart, only to find the killer will not call off the contract. Gulshan Devaiah, Anjali Patil and Heeba Shah star in this Prime Video black comedy series.
agadam-bagdam-tigdam-2007: The Malhotras look like an ordinary family, but they are aliens from the planet Zoltar who have crash-landed on Earth. Living among humans, they must keep their powers hidden from curious neighbours and their adopted children, leading to plenty of comic chaos. Kiku Sharda stars in this Disney Channel sitcom, adapted from the British series My Parents Are Aliens.
agnifera-2017: Anurag, a highly qualified young man back from London, is caught between two marriage proposals in his Bihar hometown. Forced at gunpoint to marry Ragini, the fiery daughter of a local strongman, he sees his intended bride Srishti marry his younger brother instead, and the two very different women end up under one roof. This &TV family drama stars Yukti Kapoor and Simaran Kaur.
airlines-2014: Ananya Rawat dreams of becoming a top commercial pilot in an industry long dominated by men. As she fights for her place in the cockpit, the series follows the thrills, pressures and dangers of life in aviation. Tulip Joshi and VJ Yudhishtir star in this Hindi drama, Airlines – Har Udaan Ek Toofan, on StarPlus.
akka-2026: In the town of Pernuru, the matriarch Bhavani rules with an iron hand. When a rebel named Rudra rises to challenge her power, a fierce battle over revenge, loyalty and legacy begins. This Netflix drama series from Yash Raj Films explores what it takes to seize power and hold on to it.
aladdin-naam-toh-suna-hoga-2018: Aladdin, a kind-hearted thief from the streets of Baghdad, dreams big and spreads joy wherever he goes. He falls for Princess Yasmine and befriends a wish-granting genie, but a scheming sorcerer has dark plans of his own. Siddharth Nigam, Avneet Kaur and Ashi Singh star in this Sony SAB fantasy series based on the Arabian Nights tale.
alarm-2018: A police officer has just 12 hours to rescue a young girl who has been kidnapped. Her trail leads him into the dark underbelly of the city and a massive crackdown on a human trafficking racket. This action thriller series streams on ZEE5.
ali-baba-aur-40-bhoot-2026: Alisha, a young woman who believes only in logic and science, finds herself caught up in a strange experience that defies everything she trusts. anjaan-rural-myths-2018: This Hindi horror anthology series draws on folk tales and rural legends from across India. Each episode follows villagers who come face to face with malevolent spirits lurking in remote villages, dense jungles and abandoned buildings, bringing old superstitions terrifyingly to life. The series streams on Netflix.
apharan-2018: Rudra Srivastava, a senior police inspector in Uttarakhand who is short of money, agrees to a fake kidnapping of a young woman, at her own request, to extort a ransom. When the plan goes horribly wrong, he finds himself framed and caught in a deadly conspiracy. Arunoday Singh stars in this ALTBalaji crime thriller series, with Mahie Gill and Nidhi Singh.
arabia-kadali-2025: Fishermen from two rival coastal villages in Andhra Pradesh stray into international waters and are arrested and thrown into a foreign jail. Far from home, the old enemies must learn to stand together while their families fight to bring them back. Satyadev and Anandhi star in this Telugu survival drama series created by Krish Jagarlamudi, based on a real incident.
as-i-m-suffering-from-kadhal-2017: In urban Chennai, three very different young couples and a divorced father raising his eight-year-old daughter navigate the messy realities of modern love, from live-in relationships to a marriage on the rocks and a wedding in the making. Balaji Mohan created and directed this Tamil romantic comedy series.
athidhi-2023: A reclusive man living alone in an old house finds his quiet life upended when a string of unexpected guests turns up at his door. As horrifying events unfold inside, everyone in the house becomes both a suspect and a possible victim. Venu Thottempudi, Avantika Mishra and Aditi Gautam star in this Telugu horror thriller series on JioHotstar.
august-14-2020: Inspired by a real case from 2013 that shook Bangladesh, this crime thriller follows the investigation into the murder of a police officer and his wife in their Dhaka home, and the disturbing truth that emerges about their troubled teenage daughter. Tasnuva Tisha stars in Shihab Shaheen's Bengali series.
auto-shankar-2019: In 1980s Madras, Shankar, an ordinary auto-rickshaw driver, gets drawn into illegal liquor and the flesh trade. As his business grows, so do his ties with powerful businessmen and politicians, and his crimes turn more and more violent. Appani Sarath plays the real-life criminal in this ZEE5 crime thriller series.
avrodh-2020: In 2016, after a terror attack on an Indian army camp kills soldiers in their sleep, the government in New Delhi plans a daring response. The series follows the officers and leaders behind the surgical strikes across the border. Amit Sadh, Neeraj Kabi and Darshan Kumar star in this SonyLIV military drama, based on the book India's Most Fearless.
awkward-conversations-with-girlfriend-20: Ishaan and Ananya are a young couple who love each other, but their everyday conversations keep landing them in awkward, funny situations, from meeting the parents to arguing over little things. This light-hearted TVF romantic comedy series stars Ritvik Sahore and Rashmi Agdekar.
ayushman-bhava-2017: Krish, an eight-year-old boy in Mathura, is haunted by memories of a past life in which he was Avinash, a software engineer betrayed and killed by the people he trusted most. As he grows up, he sets out to find them and take revenge. Avinash Sachdev and Sumit Bhardwaj star in this Star Bharat drama.
b-and-b-bujji-and-bhairava-2024: In the year 2896, in the futuristic city of Kasi, Bhairava, a cocky bounty hunter, dreams of getting into the elite Complex. Bujji, an AI co-pilot of a cargo ship, is waiting for a promotion. At their lowest moment, the two find each other and form an unlikely partnership. This animated prequel to the film Kalki 2898 AD streams on Prime Video.
baahubali-the-lost-legends-2017: Long before the events of the Baahubali films, the young princes Baahubali and Bhallaladeva grow up in the kingdom of Mahishmati under the watchful eyes of Sivagami and Kattappa. The brothers compete to prove they are worthy of the throne in a series of epic adventures. This animated prequel series streams on Prime Video.
baarish-2019: Anuj, a wealthy Gujarati businessman who gave up his studies to raise his siblings and build a diamond empire, and Gauravi, a Marathi girl from a middle-class family who works at his company, are complete opposites. When their families become linked, they are pushed into each other's lives. Asha Negi and Sharman Joshi star in this romantic series.
baby-come-naa-2018: Aditya, a smooth talker, is happily juggling two women, Sophie and Sarah, each of whom believes she is his wife. Keeping them from finding out about each other lands him in one ridiculous situation after another, while his friend Yoyo's attempts to help only make things worse. Shreyas Talpade stars in this ALTBalaji comedy series.
bachelors-2017: Four bachelor flatmates share a home and a long list of everyday problems, from cooking and rent to landlords and dating. In each episode, they team up to tackle one more challenge of single life, usually with chaotic results. This Hindi comedy web series streams on Amazon miniTV.
bad-cop-2024: Two identical twin brothers stand on opposite sides of the law, one a police officer and the other a thief. When the cop is killed, his brother takes his place and goes after a powerful gangster, getting caught in a web of deceit and loyalty. Gulshan Devaiah and Anurag Kashyap star in this Hindi crime thriller, adapted from a German series.
bahu-begum-2019: Azaan finds his soulmate in Shayra, but his mother wants him to marry Noor, her best friend's daughter. Fate and misunderstandings bind all three of them in an unusual marriage, and love is put to a hard test. Arjit Taneja, Samiksha Jaiswal and Diana Khan star in this Colors romantic drama.
baked-2015: Three Delhi University flatmates who can barely make ends meet start a midnight food delivery service to earn extra money. Juggling classes, friendships and their shaky business, the odd trio keep landing themselves in trouble. Pranay Manchanda, Shantanu Anam and Manik Papneja star in this comedy web series.
balika-vadhu-2008: In rural Rajasthan, Anandi is married off as a little girl and has to adjust to a new family of strangers while still a child. The series follows her journey from childhood to womanhood as she grows into her roles as wife and daughter-in-law and finds her own voice. This Colors drama ran for eight years and tackled the issue of child marriage.
bambai-meri-jaan-2023: In 1960s Bombay, Ismail Kadri, an honest police officer, struggles to make ends meet while battling the city's powerful smuggling gangs. His son Dara grows up watching his father's honesty go unrewarded, and turns to crime himself, rising to become a feared gangster. Kay Kay Menon and Avinash Tiwary star in this Prime Video crime drama.
bandish-bandits-2020: Radhe, a young singer trained in Hindustani classical music by his strict grandfather in Jodhpur, meets Tamanna, a pop star who needs a hit. Despite their opposite worlds, they team up and fall in love, as Radhe hides their partnership from his family. Ritwik Bhowmik and Shreya Chaudhry star in this Prime Video musical drama, with Naseeruddin Shah.
bang-baaja-baaraat-2015: Pawan and Shahana come from very different families and decide to get married, but only with their parents' blessings. When the two families meet just three days before the wedding, culture clashes and quarrels threaten to call the whole thing off. This Hindi romantic comedy web series is from Y-Films, with Ali Fazal and Angira Dhar.
bar-code-2018: Sahil and Vicky are friends who run a successful nightclub in Mumbai together. When egos and differences drive them apart, they become bitter rivals with clubs of their own, and their feud spills dangerously into each other's personal lives. This Hindi drama series streams on Hungama Play.
bard-of-blood-2019: Kabir Anand, a former Indian intelligence agent now teaching Shakespeare in Panchgani, is called back into action when four Indian agents are captured in Balochistan. Disgraced after a failed mission years earlier, he must return to enemy territory to rescue them and face old enemies. Emraan Hashmi stars in this Netflix spy thriller with Sobhita Dhulipala and Jaideep Ahlawat.
barzakh-2024: Jafar, a 76-year-old man, invites his estranged sons to a remote, mystical valley for his third wedding. As the family gathers in this strange place, old wounds, buried memories and a lost love come back to haunt them. Fawad Khan, Sanam Saeed and Salman Shahid star in Asim Abbasi's Pakistani fantasy drama series, made for Zindagi.
basement-company-2020: Raj, Simran and Rahul are first-jobbers at a small start-up in Gurgaon who are suddenly moved into the office basement as the company revamps itself. While scheming to win back their place upstairs, the three friends juggle work, relationships and dreams beyond the office. Apoorva Arora and Gagan Arora star in this comedy series.
bc-baal-the-private-dick-2016: BC Baal is a private detective who drinks his way through the day, beer in the morning, vodka in the afternoon and whisky at night, and yet cracks the trickiest of cases. This Bengali comedy series, billed as the first Bengali detective story made for the web, streams on Addatimes.
beast-of-bangalore-indian-predator-2022: In the late 1990s, a serial predator who stalked and attacked women across Karnataka left a state in terror and a struggling police force on a long and frustrating hunt. Through interviews and reconstructions, this Netflix true-crime documentary series, part of the Indian Predator collection, retraces the case and the investigation behind it.
beauty-and-the-bullet-2019: An influential member of parliament collapses and dies after being poisoned while judging a reality cooking show on live television. Her strange death sets off a chain of puzzling events and nationwide chaos, as investigators try to find out who poisoned her and why. This Bengali mystery thriller series streams on Bioscope.
best-of-luck-nikki-2011: The Singh family in Delhi are still adjusting to the arrival of their fourth child, baby Nikki. With both parents back at work, the three older children have to help raise their little sister, and teenage Dolly records a video diary of advice for Nikki, ending each one with 'Best of luck, Nikki!' This Disney Channel sitcom adapts Good Luck Charlie.
bestseller-2022: Tahir, a celebrated novelist struggling with writer's block, meets Meetu, a young aspiring writer whose story he decides to use for his next book. Meanwhile, a film assistant is quietly plotting to destroy him and everyone close to him. Mithun Chakraborty, Shruti Haasan and Arjan Bajwa star in this Prime Video thriller, based on Ravi Subramanian's novel The Bestseller She Wrote.
beyhadh-2016: Maya, a wealthy and powerful businesswoman with a troubled past, falls for Arjun, a cheerful photographer at her magazine. They marry, but Maya's love turns into a dangerous obsession, and her possessive behaviour threatens everyone close to him. Jennifer Winget stars in this Sony Entertainment Television romantic thriller, with Kushal Tandon and Aneri Vajani.
bhabi-ji-ghar-par-hai-2015: In a Kanpur neighbourhood, Tiwari has a crush on Anita, his neighbour Vibhuti's modern and educated wife, while Vibhuti is smitten with Angoori, Tiwari's simple and innocent wife. Their constant efforts to impress each other's wives lead to endless comic mix-ups. Aasif Sheikh and Rohitashv Gour star in this long-running &TV sitcom.
bhaukaal-2020: When SSP Naveen Sikhera is posted to Muzaffarnagar, the city is ruled by two powerful gangs and its people live in fear. Determined to bring back law and order, the tough officer takes on the gangs head-on, often in his own way. Mohit Raina stars in this crime drama series, with Abhimanyu Singh and Bidita Bag.
bicchoo-ka-khel-2020: Akhil, a young man from a small town in Uttar Pradesh, walks into a police station and confesses to a murder, then dares the police to make the charge stick. As he tells his story, it emerges that his father's death was covered up, and he is playing a deadly game of revenge. Divyenndu stars in this ZEE5 crime thriller.
bigg-boss-2010: A group of celebrities move into a specially built house where they live together, cut off from the outside world and watched by cameras around the clock. Each week, the housemates nominate each other and viewers vote one out, until a winner is crowned. Salman Khan hosts this Hindi version of the Big Brother reality format on Colors.
bigg-boss-malayalam-2018: Contestants from different walks of life live together in a specially built house, cut off from the outside world and filmed around the clock. They take on tasks, form alliances and face weekly eliminations decided by viewers' votes, until one is crowned the winner. Mohanlal hosts this Malayalam version of the Big Brother format on Asianet.
bigg-boss-ott-2021: This digital spin-off of Bigg Boss runs around the clock on streaming, with housemates living under constant camera watch, competing in tasks and facing eliminations voted by viewers. The winner takes home prize money and the OTT trophy, and some finalists move on to the main show. Karan Johar, Salman Khan and Anil Kapoor have hosted its seasons.
bigg-boss-tamil-2017: Celebrities from film, television and social media move into a specially built house in Chennai, cut off from the outside world and filmed around the clock. They compete in tasks, form alliances and face weekly evictions decided by viewers' votes. Kamal Haasan hosted this Tamil version of the Big Brother format on Star Vijay for its early seasons.
bisaat-khel-shatranj-ka-2021: Kiyana Verma, a successful psychiatrist in Mumbai, has a habit of getting too involved in her patients' lives. Married to a talented doctor in a cold and distant relationship, she finds her urge to help her patients drawing her into a dangerous web of secrets. This Hindi mystery thriller series streams on Amazon MX Player.
black-coffee-2017: Dhruv Narang, a best-selling author known as the 'King of Romance', is desperately looking for a muse for his next love story. Fate brings him to Hemal Shah, a no-nonsense corporate professional who has no time for romance, and the two are forced to work together. This Hindi romantic comedy web series streams on YouTube.
black-widows-2020: Veera, Jayati and Kavita, three best friends trapped in unhappy marriages, plan to get rid of their husbands by staging a boating accident during a holiday. The plan seems to work perfectly, until a police investigation and an unexpected twist threaten to expose their secret. Mona Singh, Swastika Mukherjee and Shamita Shetty star in this ZEE5 dark comedy, adapted from a Finnish series.
bombay-begums-2021: Five women across generations try to own their ambition in modern Mumbai: Rani, the CEO of a bank, Fatima, her protégé, Lily, a former bar dancer scheming for a better life, Ayesha, a young newcomer to the city, and Rani's teenage stepdaughter. Alankrita Shrivastava's Netflix drama stars Pooja Bhatt, Shahana Goswami, Amruta Subhash and Plabita Borthakur.
bonyo-premer-golpo-2020: A mysterious killer is on the loose inside a mental asylum, and patients and staff alike are living in fear. Dr. Kanishka, a psychiatrist working there, sets out to uncover the dark secrets behind the killings and the disturbed mind responsible for them. This Bengali psychological thriller series streams on Hoichoi.
booo-sabki-phategi-2019: Manav invites his childhood friends, a gang of pranksters and a newly married couple, to his resort for a fun holiday. But their plans take a hilariously dangerous turn when the friends realise the place is haunted, and members of the group start disappearing. Tusshar Kapoor and Mallika Sherawat star in this ALTBalaji horror comedy series.
bose-dead-alive-2017: In 1945, Subhas Chandra Bose is reported killed in a plane crash in Taiwan, yet doubts about his death persist for decades. The series revisits his life as a freedom fighter and the mystery of whether he really died. Rajkummar Rao plays Bose in this ALTBalaji historical drama, based on Anuj Dhar's book India's Biggest Cover-up.
boss-baap-of-special-services-2019: Keshav Khatri, a cunning con man posing as an undercover detective, takes charge of Shimla's special task force under strange circumstances. With his peculiar ways and unconventional style, he teams up with ACP Sakshi Ranjan to solve a string of baffling criminal cases. Karan Singh Grover and Sagarika Ghatge star in this ALTBalaji action thriller series.
breathe-2018: Danny Mascarenhas, a kind and devoted father, learns that his young son will die without an urgent lung transplant. Desperate, he decides to move up the waiting list by any means necessary. Kabir, a troubled Mumbai crime branch officer, starts linking a string of strange deaths. R. Madhavan and Amit Sadh star in this Prime Video psychological thriller.
brinda-2024: Brinda, a socially awkward but principled young sub-inspector, stumbles upon a brutal murder with a chilling pattern. As she chases a killer who keeps slipping away, she faces bureaucratic hurdles and personal demons. Trisha Krishnan stars in her streaming debut in this SonyLIV Telugu crime thriller series, with Indrajith Sukumaran and Ravindra Vijay.
broken-but-beautiful-2018: Veer has never recovered from losing his girlfriend in an accident, and Sameera cannot get over the man who left her. When fate brings the two heartbroken strangers together as neighbours, they slowly help each other heal, wondering whether to give love a second chance. Vikrant Massey and Harleen Sethi star in this romantic series.
buddha-rajaon-ka-raja-2013: Prince Siddhartha grows up in luxury in the palace of Kapilavastu, shielded from all suffering. When he finally sees sickness, old age and death, he gives up his kingdom and family to seek the truth, and becomes the Buddha. This Zee TV historical series tells the story of the founder of Buddhism, with Himanshu Soni in the lead.
buddha-sutra-2015: A single man's quest to end human suffering changed the history of much of Asia. This series of animated short films on Epic TV explores the life and teachings of the Buddha, the spread of Buddhism, and its lasting influence on art, architecture, politics and history across the continent.
bullets-2021: Tina and Lolo, two bold and fearless young women, set out to stop an illegal arms deal between two countries. While gathering evidence, an accident pits them against a powerful politician, and soon they are being chased by his goons as well as the police. Sunny Leone and Karishma Tanna star in this action thriller series.
c-i-d-2001: ACP Pradyuman leads an elite team of the Mumbai Crime Investigation Department, including inspectors Abhijeet and Daya, in solving murders, kidnappings and baffling mysteries. Each case is cracked through forensic clues and sharp detective work. Shivaji Satam, Aditya Srivastava and Dayanand Shetty star in this long-running Sony Entertainment Television crime drama.
call-me-bae-2024: Bella 'Bae' Rajvansh, a pampered heiress raised to be a trophy wife, is married into wealth until her husband discovers her affair and throws her out. Disowned by her own family too, she lands in Mumbai with no money and must make it on her wits in a busy newsroom. Ananya Panday leads the Prime Video comedy.
call-my-agent-bollywood-2021: Netflix's Indian take on the French hit Call My Agent! follows four talent agents in Mumbai trying to keep their struggling agency alive. Between landing roles for their star clients and soothing celebrity egos, every day brings a new crisis. Shaad Ali directs, from a script by Hussain and Abbas Dalal.
campus-diaries-2022: Campus Diaries is an MX Player college drama about a group of students living away from home for the first time. Friendships, crushes, rivalries and exam pressure shape their days on campus. Harsh Beniwal, Ritvik Sahore and Saloni Gaur are among the young cast, with Prem Mistry and Abhishek Yadav directing.
chaar-yaar-2026: Four middle-class friends share big dreams and keep each other going through every setback. Then one fateful decision changes the course of their lives, leaving them caught between gangsters and the police. As the pressure builds, the friendship that once protected them begins to come apart in this Prime Video drama.
chacha-vidhayak-hain-humare-2018: Created by and starring Zakir Khan, this Prime Video comedy follows Ronny, a jobless young man with no big ambitions. He enjoys local fame by pretending that the area's MLA, who happens to share his surname, is his uncle. Keeping that lie alive while solving people's problems takes all his wit.
chadarangam-2020: Inspired by real events, this political thriller on ZEE5 follows a fierce contest for control of a state, as seasoned politicians face off against a hugely popular film star who enters the fray.
