Srikanth leads the cast. Raj Anantha writes and directs, and Vishnu Manchu produces through 24 Frames Factory.
chakravartin-ashoka-samrat-2015: This Colors historical drama tells the story of Ashoka, third emperor of the Maurya dynasty. Born to King Bindusara and Dharma, a Brahmin woman from Champa, young Ashoka must find his place amid palace conspiracies led by Bindusara's stepmother Helena, with Chanakya guiding the throne. Siddharth Nigam plays the young Ashoka.
chanakya-1991: Written and directed by Chandraprakash Dwivedi, this 47-part DD National epic is a dramatised account of the life of Chanakya, the ancient Indian strategist. It follows young Vishnugupta from his early years in Magadha, where his father suffers at the hands of King Dhana Nanda, through Alexander's invasion and his plan to reshape the kingdom.
chandra-nandini-2016: Produced by Ekta Kapoor for StarPlus, this historical drama is loosely based on the life of Chandragupta Maurya. After Nanda seizes the throne of Magadha and kills his father, Chandragupta grows up seeking revenge, only to cross paths with princess Nandni, the daughter of his enemy. Rajat Tokas and Shweta Basu Prasad lead.
channa-mereya-2022: Ginni Garewal is a lively young woman who runs her family's dhaba in Amritsar and holds the household together. Aditya Singh, an ambitious hotelier, wants the dhaba for a project of his own, but to Ginni it is a matter of love, not money. Niyati Fatnani and Karan Wahi lead this Star Bharat romance.
charitraheen-2018: Hoichoi's Bengali series draws on Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay's classic novel Charitraheen. It follows Kiran, whose life takes a new turn after her husband's death, and Satish, a young man still searching for true love. Their stories weave together into a drama about love, longing, desire and the lies people tell.
charmsukh-2019: Charmsukh is an adult anthology series on Ullu, with each story built around hidden desires, secrets and temptation inside ordinary homes and relationships. The episodes stand on their own, mixing drama with bold themes and twists, and the series is meant for adult viewers only. Different casts appear across its many stories.
chhal-kapat-the-deception-2025: When a famous influencer is found dead at her friend's wedding, a hardened police officer has to dig into the darkest secrets of everyone present to find the killer. Friendships, loyalties and family ties are all put to the test. Shriya Pilgaonkar, Kamya Ahlawat and Ragini Dwivedi star in this ZEE5 mystery.
chhanchhan-2013: Chhanchhan, played by Sanaya Irani, is a free-spirited young dog trainer in Ahmedabad with modern views and deep family roots. At a friend's wedding she clashes with the strong-willed Umaben, played by Supriya Pathak, and soon with Umaben's son Manav too, setting off a rivalry that slowly turns into something else on Sony TV.
chhatrasal-2021: This historical drama tells the story of Maharaja Chhatrasal, the warrior king who rose against the Mughal Empire under Aurangzeb and founded his own kingdom in Bundelkhand in the 17th century. Anadii Chaturvedi directs, with Neena Gupta, Ashutosh Rana and Jitin Gulati in the cast of the MX Player series.
chidiya-udd-2025: Seher, a determined 20-year-old from Rajasthan, wants a bigger life than the one she was born into. She heads to Mumbai, the city of dreams, but soon finds herself in Kamathipura, its notorious red-light district, where she must learn its rules to survive. Bhoomika Meena, Jackie Shroff and Sikandar Kher star.
choti-bahu-sawar-ke-rang-rachi-2011: Choti Bahu is a Zee TV love story about Dev and Radhika. Radhika, born a Brahmin, is raised by a family of weavers in the small town of Rawal, while Dev's family has served the Rajpurohits for generations. They first meet as children during Radhashtami. Rubina Dilaik and Avinash Sachdev play the leads.
choti-sarrdaarni-2019: Bubbly Meher Kaur Dhillon falls for Manav Sharma, a simple young man who dreams of joining the IAS, and becomes pregnant with his child. Her proud mother Kulwant, the village sarpanch, refuses to accept him and forces Meher to marry Sarabjit Singh Gill, a widower with a young son. Nimrit Kaur Ahluwalia leads this Colors drama.
chumbak-2026: Five quirky families live side by side in Chumbak Colony, where daily squabbles and odd antics keep the neighbourhood buzzing. Aatish Kapadia writes and directs this Netflix comedy drama, produced by Jamnadas Majethia, with an ensemble cast that includes Neena Gupta, Sumeet Vyas, Manasi Parekh, Helly Shah and Arjun Bijlani.
chupkotha-2-2019: In the second season of Hoichoi's Bengali thriller Chupkotha, journalist Shivangi finds both her personal life and her work tangled in a series of mysteries. As strange events keep piling up around her, she begins to wonder whether they are simply coincidences or connected in some unsettling, hidden way.
citadel-honey-bunny-2024: Bunny is a Bollywood stuntman who secretly works as a spy. When he recruits Honey, a struggling actress, for a side gig, they are pulled into a world of espionage and betrayal. Years later, estranged, they must reunite to protect their young daughter Nadia. Raj & DK direct this spin-off of Citadel.
city-of-dreams-2019: An assassination attempt on the head of Mumbai's powerful Gaikwad family sets off a ruthless struggle for control between his children. With political power at stake, the line between right and wrong blurs. Nagesh Kukunoor directs this Hotstar political drama, starring Atul Kulkarni, Priya Bapat and Sachin Pilgaonkar.
class-of-2017-2017: Created by Vikas Gupta for ALTBalaji, Class of 2017 follows a group of teenagers whose lives get tangled up with drugs, sex, peer pressure and anxiety. Loosely inspired by the old TV show Hip Hip Hurray, it is a coming-of-age drama about whether they crumble or find their way through.
class-of-2020-2020: A follow-up to Class of 2017 from creator Vikas Gupta, this ALTBalaji series follows a new batch of teenagers facing drugs, relationships, peer pressure and anxiety in their final school years. Mazhar Khan and Joyita Chatterjee lead the young cast in a story about the struggles that shape growing up.
code-m-2020: Army lawyer Major Monica Mehra is asked to close what looks like a simple case: an encounter in which an Indian Army officer and two militants were killed near Jodhpur. But as locals call the encounter fake, she begins to suspect the truth is very different. Jennifer Winget leads this ALTBalaji and ZEE5 crime drama.
coldd-lassi-aur-chicken-masala-2019: Fate brings former lovers Nitya, head chef at the struggling restaurant Indie Spice, and Vikram, a Michelin-star chef, back together after eight years, when he buys a stake in her business. Old memories and old bitterness return together. Divyanka Tripathi and Rajeev Khandelwal star in this romantic comedy directed by Pradeep Sarkar.
college-romance-2018: Created by The Viral Fever, College Romance follows three best friends, Karan, Naira and Trippy, as they look for love, laughs and lifelong memories during their college years. Keshav Sadhna, Apoorva Arora and Gagan Arora play the trio in this youth comedy about crushes, friendship and growing up.
comedy-nights-bachao-2015: Comedy Nights Bachao is a Colors comedy show that premiered in September 2015. In a format similar to Comedy Circus and made by many of the same team at Optimystix Entertainment, comedians poke fun at celebrity guests, who are expected to take every joke in good humour.
comedy-nights-live-2016: Comedy Nights Live took over the Sunday night comedy slot on Colors in January 2016, replacing Comedy Nights with Kapil. Krushna Abhishek hosts, with comedians including Bharti Singh and Sudesh Lehri performing sketches and chatting with celebrity guests, who usually drop in to promote their latest films.
comedy-nights-with-kapil-2013: Kapil Sharma hosts and produces this sketch comedy and celebrity talk show on Colors, which ran from 2013 to 2016. Each episode opens with Kapil and his comic on-screen family performing a skit, before film stars join them on stage, usually to promote a new release, for a light-hearted interview full of jokes.
comedy-premium-league-2021: Hosted by Prajakta Koli, Comedy Premium League brings sixteen of India's best-known comics to Netflix and splits them into four teams. Over a series of rounds of satirical sketches, cheeky debates and fierce roasts, the teams battle it out to be crowned the ultimate comedy champions. OML Entertainment produces.
comicstaan-2018: Comicstaan is a Prime Video stand-up competition from OML that sets out to find India's next big comedy star. Budding comedians perform new sets each round, mentored and judged by a panel of seven well-known comics including Tanmay Bhat, Biswa Kalyan Rath and Kenny Sebastian. Abish Mathew and Sumukhi Suresh host.
crime-patrol-2003: Crime Patrol is a long-running Sony TV anthology that recreates real crime cases from across India as short dramas. Each episode tells a full story of harassment, kidnapping, fraud or murder, while anchor Anup Soni explains how such crimes can be prevented and urges viewers to stay alert to the dangers around them.
criminal-justice-2019: Adapted from the BBC series, this Hotstar legal drama follows Aditya, a young Mumbai cab driver who spends a wild night with a passenger and wakes to find her dead, with no memory of what happened. With the evidence stacked against him, he needs a lawyer. Vikrant Massey and Pankaj Tripathi star.
criminal-justice-behind-closed-doors-202: One night Anuradha Chandra stabs her husband, a respected lawyer, and confesses. Yet the case is far from open and shut, and small-time advocate Madhav Mishra steps in to defend her. Pankaj Tripathi and Kirti Kulhari star in this Hotstar legal drama, written by Apurva Asrani and directed by Rohan Sippy and Arjun Mukerjee.
cubicles-2019: Created by The Viral Fever, Cubicles follows Piyush Prajapati as he starts his first job at an IT company, Synnotech Innovations. From new colleagues and office friendships to tough bosses and work-life balance, the show captures the everyday ups and downs of corporate life that many young Indian employees will recognise.
cybersquad-2017: When they are not in trouble with their school, four teenage friends, KD, Rocky, Uzi and Tia, secretly help the police catch notorious criminals and hackers from their own hidden cyber-den. Using high-tech skills and a stack of gadgets, they blur the line between the online and offline worlds in this ALTBalaji series.
daayan-2018: Produced by Ekta Kapoor for &TV, Daayan follows Janvi, a well-educated young woman from Ujjain, as strange and frightening events grip her hometown. To save her own life she must unmask a daayan, a witch, hiding as someone close to her, helped by her childhood love Aakarsh. Tina Datta and Mohit Malhotra lead.
dabba-cartel-2025: In Thane, five ordinary women running a home lunchbox delivery service are drawn by unusual circumstances into the drug trade, using their dabbas to move it. As their secret cartel grows, they must deal with criminals, the police and their own conflicts. Shabana Azmi, Jyothika and Shalini Pandey star in this Netflix crime drama.
dahaad-2023: In small-town Rajasthan, Sub-Inspector Anjali Bhaati looks into a string of missing women who are later found dead in public bathrooms. What seem like separate cases start to look like the work of one man, setting off a hunt for a serial killer. Sonakshi Sinha leads this Prime Video thriller from Reema Kagti and Zoya Akhtar.
dahan-raakan-ka-rahasya-2022: A disgraced IAS officer takes on a strange posting in Shilaspura, a remote place where villagers live in fear of an old legend and occult practices, hoping to clear her name. Tisca Chopra leads this Hotstar supernatural horror series directed by Vikranth Pawar, with Saurabh Shukla, Rajesh Tailang and Rohan Joshi in the cast.
dahleez-2016: Set in Delhi's world of power, law and bureaucracy, Dahleez follows Swadheenta, a principled young lawyer from Chennai, and Adarsh Sinha, an honest IAS officer from a powerful legal family. Their love gets caught up in a power struggle involving Adarsh's mother Suhasini, a senior advocate. Tridha Choudhury and Harshad Arora lead this StarPlus drama.
damaged-2018: When a famous painter goes missing, police discover he is one of many young men who have vanished without a trace. Suspicion falls on the alluring Lovina, and a tense game of cat and mouse begins with Abhay, a hot-headed cop. Amruta Khanvilkar and Amit Sial star in this Hungama Play psychological crime drama.
dance-deewane-2018: Dance Deewane is a Colors dance reality show that puts dancers of every age and style on one stage, split into three generations from the youngest to the oldest. Contestants perform with choreographers each week, with Madhuri Dixit on the judging panel, and the best of each generation meet in the finale.
dark-7-white-2020: Yudi, a young politician set to become Rajasthan's youngest chief minister, is shot dead in broad daylight. His seven closest friends all have a motive, and as a police officer investigates, dark secrets spill out. Sumeet Vyas leads this ALTBalaji and ZEE5 thriller, adapted from Shweta Brijpuria's novel Dark White.
dark-web-2018: While searching online for new video games, a young man named Indra unknowingly hacks his way into an anonymous portal. He soon realises he has stumbled into the dangerous world of the dark web, and that the people behind it now have him in their sights, in this Hoichoi Bengali thriller.
dekha-ek-khwaab-2011: Moniya, a 19-year-old girl, has always dreamed of being a princess. Then she discovers she really is one: Rajkumari Manyata, crown princess of Devgarh, taken as a three-year-old by a poor watchman seeking revenge on her father. Now she must find her place in a royal family she never knew. Sony TV drama.
delhi-crime-2019: Written and directed by Richie Mehta, Delhi Crime follows the Delhi Police as they take on high-profile cases. DCP Vartika Chaturvedi, played by Shefali Shah, leads her team through the investigation of the 2012 Delhi gang rape case in the first season, with later seasons drawing on other real and fictional crimes.
devon-ke-dev-mahadev-2011: This mythological epic tells the story of Lord Shiva, following his journey from ascetic to family man. It begins with Adi Shakti, separated from Shiva, being born as Sati, daughter of Prajapati Daksha, to reunite with him. Mohit Raina plays Mahadev in the 820-episode series, which first aired on Life OK.
dharavi-bank-2022: Thalaivan rules Dharavi, Mumbai's sprawling slum, through a criminal empire worth thousands of crores, with politicians in his pocket. When the chief minister orders police officer Jayant Gavaskar to bring him down, a bitter war begins. Suniel Shetty and Vivek Oberoi star in this crime drama directed by Samit Kakkad.
dhootha-2023: Sagar, an ambitious journalist, begins finding old newspaper clippings that seem to predict tragedies before they happen. As the events come true, he is pulled into a dark mystery and soon finds himself a murder suspect. Vikram Kumar creates and directs this Telugu Prime Video horror thriller starring Naga Chaitanya and Parvathy Thiruvothu.
dil-boley-oberoi-2017: A spin-off of Ishqbaaaz, Dil Boley Oberoi follows Omkara Singh Oberoi, who has come to despise the idea of love after painful experiences in his family and with women he trusted. Then Gauri Kumari Sharma, a caring, devout young woman he first misjudges, enters his life. Kunal Jaisingh and Shrenu Parikh lead.
dil-toh-happy-hai-ji-2019: Happy Mehra, a cheerful young woman from Amritsar, believes in spreading happiness wherever she goes. Her life gets complicated when two very different brothers, the kind-hearted Chintu and the arrogant Rocky, both come into her life. Jasmin Bhasin leads this StarPlus drama created by Gul Khan.
divya-drishti-2019: Twin sisters Divya and Drishti are born with special powers: Drishti can see the future and Divya can change it. Together they must protect three powerful gems of Lord Shiva from Pishaachini, an evil sorceress who wants them for herself. Sana Sayyad and Nyra Banerjee lead this StarPlus supernatural drama.
diya-aur-baati-hum-2011: In Pushkar, Rajasthan, ambitious and educated Sandhya dreams of becoming an IPS officer. Her brother arranges her marriage to Sooraj Rathi, a kind sweet-maker with little schooling, whose strict mother wants a simple homemaker, and the truth about Sandhya's education is kept hidden. Anas Rashid and Deepika Singh lead this long-running StarPlus drama.
do-you-wanna-partner-2025: Best friends Shikha and Anahita decide to start their own craft beer brand, diving head first into one of India's most male-dominated industries. When sceptical families, investors and officials stand in their way, they turn to some unconventional methods. Tamannaah Bhatia and Diana Penty star in this Prime Video comedy from Dharmatic Entertainment.
dude-2021: Dude follows a sharp, unconventional detective who relies on common sense and logic rather than force to outwit criminals. His latest case begins with a mysterious threat letter sent to a family, and as he digs into the people around them, the puzzle behind the threat slowly starts to take shape.
dupahiya-2025: A peaceful village is about to celebrate 25 years without a single crime when a motorbike meant as a wedding gift mysteriously disappears. With the jubilee trophy, an upcoming wedding and the village's pride at stake, everyone joins a frantic search. Gajraj Rao, Renuka Shahane and Sparsh Shrivastava star in this Prime Video comedy.
dupur-thakurpo-2017: Dupur Thakurpo is a Bengali adult comedy series on Hoichoi. Phulwa arrives in a sleepy neighbourhood as its newest boudi, or sister-in-law, and the local men cannot stop talking about her. Is she the simple village girl she seems, or someone far bolder hiding behind that innocent look?
ek-boond-ishq-2013: Ek Boond Ishq follows Tara, a lively young woman who would do anything to protect her family, and Mritunjay, a man with a very different outlook on life. When circumstances bring them into an unlikely marriage, both of their lives begin to change. Viraf Patel and Chhavi Pandey play the leads in this romantic drama.
ek-hazaaron-mein-meri-behna-hai-2011: In Rishikesh, two sisters share an unbreakable bond despite being opposites: Jeevika is a calm, mature teacher, while her younger sister Manvi is carefree and rebellious. When a marriage proposal arrives from the Vadhera family of Chandigarh, both sisters' lives become tied to the family's two sons. Krystle D'Souza, Nia Sharma and Karan Tacker star.
ek-vivah-aisa-bhi-2017: Suman, a young widow, is a devoted mother and daughter-in-law who works at a local beauty parlour to keep her family afloat. When her mother-in-law pushes her to study for an MBA, she meets the carefree Ranveer Mittal at university. Sonali Nikam and Abhishek Malik lead this &TV romance produced by Nivedita Basu.
ekam-2024: Ekam is a Kannada anthology series made up of separate stories, each by a different director, that slowly reveal how every path leads to the same point, where everything comes together as one. Sumanth Bhat is among the directors, and the ensemble cast includes Prakash Raj and Raj B. Shetty.
eken-babu-2018: Based on Sujan Dasgupta's detective stories, this Hoichoi Bengali series follows Ekenbabu, a plump, food-loving and endlessly curious investigator whose quirky ways hide a sharp mind. Anirban Chakrabarti plays the title role, solving one puzzling crime after another with his companions, played by Suhotro Mukhopadhyay and Somak Ghosh.
everest-2014: Created by filmmaker Ashutosh Gowariker, with music by A. R. Rahman, this StarPlus drama follows Anjali Singh Rawat, a young woman who feels neglected by her father. To win his love, she sets out to fulfil his dream of climbing Mount Everest, training at a mountaineering institute in Uttarkashi alongside other hopefuls.
fabulous-lives-of-bollywood-wives-2020: This Netflix reality series follows four friends from Bollywood's inner circle, Neelam Kothari, Maheep Kapoor, Bhavna Pandey and Seema Sajdeh, as they juggle careers, families and friendship. Cameras capture their banter, celebrations, trips and occasional fallouts, offering a look at life behind the glamour of the film world.
farzi-2023: Sunny, a gifted small-time artist frustrated by the struggles of his grandfather's failing printing press, teams up with his best friend Firoz to make counterfeit money and creates the perfect fake note. Michael, an unorthodox task force officer, is determined to stop such crime. Shahid Kapoor and Vijay Sethupathi star in Raj & DK's Prime Video thriller.
fauji-1988: Fauji follows a fresh batch of young recruits as they start their tough training to join an Indian Army commando regiment. Their friendships, pranks and punishments fill the days at the training school. The DD National series, directed by Raj Kumar Kapoor, marked Shah Rukh Khan's television debut.
feels-like-ishq-2021: Feels Like Ishq is a Netflix romantic comedy anthology of six stand-alone short stories about young adults finding love in unexpected places. Each episode has its own director, including Tahira Kashyap, Danish Aslam and Anand Tiwari, and its own cast, capturing the nervous thrill of a new romantic connection.
feluda-pherot-2020: Satyajit Ray's beloved detective Feluda returns in this Bengali series, joined as always by his cousin Topshe and the crime writer Jatayu. Together the trio take on fresh mysteries, with Feluda relying on his sharp observation and calm logic to crack each case. The series streams on Addatimes.
flames-2018: Set in a tuition centre in west Delhi, this TVF coming-of-age romance follows studious Rajat, who falls for Ishita, the new girl in class. Meanwhile his best friends Pandey and Anusha find their friendship turning into something more. Ritvik Sahore and Tanya Maniktala lead the series, named after the old school game.
flip-2019: Flip is an Eros Now anthology of four short thriller stories, each built around a moment that turns the lives, situations or beliefs of its characters completely around. Bejoy Nambiar and Aman Sachdeva direct, and the ensemble cast includes Ranvir Shorey and Jim Sarbh.
four-more-shots-please-2019: Four close friends in Mumbai, all unapologetically flawed, live, love and make plenty of mistakes as they figure out what really makes them tick, usually over drinks at their favourite bar. Sayani Gupta, Kirti Kulhari, Bani J and Maanvi Gagroo star in this Prime Video comedy drama directed by Anu Menon and Nupur Asthana.
fuh-se-fantasy-2019: Fuh se Fantasy is an anthology series about modern relationships, with each episode telling a separate story of a couple or person daring to explore their deepest and quirkiest desires. The stories mix romance, humour and surprise, looking at how people chase their fantasies in today's world. It is meant for adult audiences.
gandii-baat-2018: Gandii Baat is an ALTBalaji adult anthology series directed by Sachin Mohite. Each standalone story is set in rural India and explores complicated relationships, hidden desires, taboos and strange local beliefs between men and women, with plenty of twists along the way. The series is meant for adult audiences only.
gariahater-ganglords-2018: Buchku moves to Kolkata for higher studies and stays with his cousin Jonny and Jonny's friend Bunty, unaware that the pair fancy themselves as gangsters. What follows is a comedy of errors in the city's small-time underworld. Atreyee Sen directs this Hoichoi Bengali series for SVF.
garmi-2023: Arvind Shukla, a young man from a small town, moves to a university hoping to prepare for the civil services. Instead he is pulled into the violent world of college politics, power and crime. Tigmanshu Dhulia directs this SonyLIV political drama, with Vyom Yadav in the lead.
gathbandhan-2019: Dhanak Parekh, a principled young woman from Gujarat, dreams of joining the IPS. Raghu Jadhav is a feared Mumbai goon whose mother runs their gang and pushes him towards crime. When Raghu falls for Dhanak at first sight, unusual circumstances tie the two opposites together. Shruti Sharma and Abrar Qazi star in this Colors drama.
gehraiyaan-2017: Reyna Kapoor, a gifted surgeon turned researcher, moves to Mumbai to rebuild her life after a traumatic event in Bangalore. As she struggles to return to surgery at her new hospital, strange and frightening things begin happening around her. Sanjeeda Sheikh and Vatsal Sheth star in this horror series created by Vikram Bhatt.
ghoul-2018: In a dystopian India, Nida Rahim, a young and loyal interrogator, is posted to a secret military detention centre. When a newly arrived prisoner starts behaving in eerie, unsettling ways, her search for the truth turns into a fight for survival. Radhika Apte and Manav Kaul star in this Netflix horror miniseries.
ghum-hai-kisi-ke-pyaar-mein-2020: Virat, a young police officer, loves Pakhi and has promised to marry her. But a promise he made to his dying mentor ties his fate to the mentor's daughter Sai, and duty leads him to marry her even though his heart belongs elsewhere. This StarPlus drama follows the love triangle that results.
girls-hostel-2018: Girls Hostel is a SonyLIV comedy drama about life inside a building full of college girls. Following a group of roommates through their years together, it captures the friendships, fights, late-night chats, crushes and small dramas that come with sharing a hostel, a room and almost everything else.
glory-2026: Raghubir Singh, a formidable boxing coach obsessed with Olympic glory, is watching his family legacy fall apart. His estranged sons Dev and Ravi return to Shaktigarh to uncover the truth behind a brutal attack on their sister and the mysterious death of a rising boxing star. Suvinder Vicky, Divyenndu and Pulkit Samrat star in this Netflix drama.
gullak-2019: Narrated by the family's old piggy bank, Gullak follows the Mishras of a small Indian town. Santosh, who works in the electricity department, his wife Shanti and their sons Annu and Aman get through money worries, sibling squabbles and everyday ups and downs together. Jameel Khan and Geetanjali Kulkarni star in this warm TVF family comedy.
gustakh-dil-2019: Gustakh Dil follows Sitara and Faras, whose lives change completely after a single incident. Each holds the other responsible, though deep down they know the other is innocent. Sitara, a sensitive and introverted young woman still living with the pain of an earlier trauma, is already engaged to her cousin Saif.
hasmukh-2020: Hasmukh is a timid comedian from a small town who has always dreamed of making it big. When his chance finally comes, he discovers he can only be funny on stage after committing murder. Vir Das, who co-created the show with Nikkhil Advani, stars alongside Ranvir Shorey in this Netflix dark comedy.
hatim-2003: Inspired by the Arabian legend of Hatim al-Tai, this StarPlus fantasy adventure follows Hatim, a prince of Yemen destined to spread peace and goodness. Together with his loyal friend Hobo, he sets out on a perilous journey to find the answers to seven mysterious questions and break an evil curse linked to the sorcerer Dajjal.
heart-beat-2024: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a place of hope and healing, and its doctors stay resilient even as they face tough medical cases and messy personal lives. Deepa Balu leads this Tamil medical drama on JioHotstar, written by Deepak Sundarrajan, with Anumol, Karthik Kumar and Charukesh in the ensemble cast.
hello-mini-2019: Rivanah, a young woman who has just moved from Kolkata to Mumbai, discovers that a faceless stranger is stalking her, knows everything about her, and can control parts of her life. As her world is turned upside down, she wonders whether he is friend or foe. Anuja Joshi stars, adapted from Novoneel Chakraborty's novels.
high-2020: A new drug called Magic hits the streets and everyone gets hooked. Its makers, its users, a pharmaceutical company, doctors, a news reporter, a local gangster and a detective are all drawn into its orbit. With black money flowing and many people chasing the truth, this MX Player thriller asks who will come out on top.
hindmata-2021: Samaira, a fashion designer, starts a stitching workshop inside a prison, hoping to give its women inmates a new skill and a fresh start. But the inmates have no interest in cooperating, and she must find a way to win their trust while dealing with the harsh rules and rivalries of life behind bars.
his-storyy-2021: Kunal and Sakshi are a South Mumbai power couple who run a restaurant together, he managing the business and she in charge of the kitchen. After about two decades of what seems a perfect marriage, a startling revelation about Kunal shakes the family. Satyadeep Mishra and Priyamani star in this ALTBalaji and ZEE5 drama.
holy-faak-2017: Holy Faak is a Bengali comedy series on Hoichoi following Indra and Diya, a young couple whose lives are never short of chaos. Their world is turned upside down when they find out that their grandparents have decided to get married, setting off a string of family drama and comic mix-ups.
home-2018: The Sethis are an ordinary middle-class family who hold on to their values and find joy in small things. Their world comes crashing down when the authorities serve them an eviction notice for the home they have lived in for years. This ALTBalaji drama follows their fight to hold on to it, and to each other.
hostages-2019: Surgeon Dr Mira Anand is due to perform a routine operation on the chief minister. The night before, four masked men take her family hostage and order her to kill her patient on the operating table. Tisca Chopra and Ronit Roy star in this Hotstar thriller directed by Sudhir Mishra, remade from an Israeli series.
hostel-daze-2019: Four first-year students become wingmates in the hostel of an engineering college and quickly learn that hostel life has its own rules. Created by TVF for Prime Video, Hostel Daze stars Adarsh Gourav, Luv Vispute, Shubham Gaur and Nikhil Vijay, with Ahsaas Channa, in a comedy about friendship, ragging and survival.
house-of-secrets-the-burari-deaths-2021: This three-part Netflix docuseries examines the deaths of 11 members of one family in Burari, Delhi, in July 2018, a case that shocked the country. Created by Leena Yadav and Anubhav Chopra, it looks at the theories around what happened, speaking to relatives, police, journalists and experts.
hum-i-m-because-of-us-2018: Three sisters who share a deep bond move to Mumbai in pursuit of their dreams and ambitions. They have always had each other's backs, but the big city has other plans for them, testing that bond in ways they never expected. Kushal Tandon, Ridhima Pandit and Karishma Sharma star in this ALTBalaji drama.
hum-tum-and-them-2019: Shiva and Yudi are single parents who get a second chance at love. While they try to build a new relationship, their teenage children are dealing with the past and with the changes in their own lives. Shweta Tiwari and Akshay Oberoi star in this ALTBalaji romantic drama.
human-2022: Set in the murky world of human drug trials, this Hotstar medical thriller looks at how the race to make the next profitable medicine pushes saving lives into the background. It exposes ties between drug companies, private hospitals and officials who exploit poor people as test subjects. Shefali Shah and Kirti Kulhari star.
humorously-yours-2016: Created by TVF, Humorously Yours follows stand-up comedian Vipul Goyal, playing a version of himself, as he copes with growing fame and recognition. Between demanding shows, career decisions and the pressures of his personal life, he faces tough choices as he tries to establish himself in the comedy world.
hunkkaar-the-roar-2026: When 17-year-old Meenu Rawat accuses Baapji, a revered and politically connected spiritual leader, of sexual assault, her complaint sets off a national storm. Backed by a determined police officer, a lawyer and a journalist, she takes on a powerful man, a hostile media trial and a divided public in her fight for justice.
hunter-tootega-nahi-todega-2023: ACP Vikram Chauhan, a tough cop haunted by a tragic past, is accused of causing the death of an elderly woman named Leena Thomas. Determined to prove his innocence, he sets out to find the truth with the help of Divya. Suniel Shetty and Esha Deol star in this Amazon miniTV action series.
hush-hush-2022: After a dangerous encounter at a party, four friends from a privileged world find themselves caught in a web of lies, deceit and secrets. As things turn darker, those secrets become the only thing holding them together, while a sharp police officer closes in. Juhi Chawla, Soha Ali Khan and Shahana Goswami star in this Prime Video thriller.
illegal-2020: Set inside a high-end law firm where justice is measured against billable hours, this legal drama follows a young, idealistic lawyer who joins the firm and finds that her colleagues are seldom on the right side of the law. Neha Sharma and Piyush Mishra star in the series.
immature-2019: Dhruv is 16 and in a hurry to grow up. With help from his school friends, the wannabe bad boy Kabir and the colour-blind Susu, he sets out to win over his first crush, Chhavi, the feisty class topper who seems out of his league. TVF's coming-of-age comedy tackles one teenage adventure per episode.
india-s-got-latent-2024: Hosted by comedian Samay Raina, India's Got Latent is an irreverent talent show inspired by the Got Talent format and Kill Tony. Performers with unusual acts, from singing and dancing to magic and comedy, predict their own score before facing a panel of comedians and celebrity guests who judge them.
india-s-got-talent-2009: India's Got Talent is the Indian edition of the global Got Talent franchise. Singers, dancers, magicians, acrobats and other performers from across the country audition before a panel of celebrity judges, with the best acts advancing round by round towards the finale. The show aired on Colors before moving to Sony TV.
indian-idol-2010: Indian Idol is Sony TV's long-running singing competition and the Indian version of the British show Pop Idol. Hopefuls from across the country audition before celebrity judges, and the chosen contestants perform week after week, with the audience helping decide who goes on to become the next singing sensation.
indian-idol-junior-2013: A spin-off of Indian Idol, this Sony TV singing competition gives children from across India the chance to show off their voices and become the first Indian Idol Junior. Karan Wahi and Mandira Bedi host, while composer duo Vishal and Shekhar and singer Shreya Ghoshal judge the young contestants.
indian-police-force-2024: When a string of bomb blasts rocks Delhi, DCP Kabir Malik and his senior officer set out to track down Zarar, the terrorist behind them, in a chase that stretches across the country. Sidharth Malhotra, Shilpa Shetty and Vivek Oberoi star in this Prime Video action series from Rohit Shetty's cop universe.
indian-predator-murder-in-a-courtroom-20: In 2004, inside a district courtroom in Nagpur, Akku Yadav, a man accused of terrorising and assaulting women in the Kasturba Nagar area for years, was killed by a crowd of local women. This three-part Netflix docuseries tells the story of that community and the events that led to that day.
inmates-2017: InMates is a TVF comedy series about five friends, Madhav, Fooga, Rahul, Kay and Richa, who share one chaotic house. Between work, dating, money troubles and clashing personalities, every day brings a new mess to sort out, and their home slowly starts to feel more like a madhouse than a flat.
inside-edge-2017: Inside Edge follows the Mumbai Mavericks, a franchise in the fictional Powerplay T20 cricket league, where money, power and ego matter as much as runs. As the team battles ownership trouble and the shadow of match fixing, the real game is played off the field. Vivek Oberoi and Richa Chadha star in this Prime Video drama.
inspector-avinash-2023: In 1997 Uttar Pradesh, when a dreaded gangster threatens to have the chief minister killed, the state forms a special task force. Its leader is Avinash Mishra, a fearless police officer who must take on the state's crime networks and weapons trade. Randeep Hooda stars in this action thriller written and directed by Neerraj Pathak.
internet-wala-love-2018: Jai, a popular radio jockey, lives his whole life on social media, while Aadhya, who works at the same radio station, wants nothing to do with it. The two keep crossing paths and, without knowing who the other is, strike up an anonymous friendship online. Shivin Narang and Tunisha Sharma lead this Colors romance.
iru-dhuruvam-2019: Iru Dhuruvam is a Tamil crime thriller series made for SonyLIV, written and directed by M Kumaran. Nandha Durairaj leads as a police officer at the centre of a tense investigation, in a story built around detection, suspense and the hunt for a dangerous criminal. Applause Entertainment produces.
ishqbaaz-2016: Ishqbaaz follows the three Oberoi brothers of a wealthy family, each with a very different view of life and love. The eldest, Shivaay, is guided by his mind, Omkara by his soul and Rudra by his body. Nakuul Mehta, Kunal Jaisingh and Leenesh Mattoo play the brothers in this StarPlus romantic drama from Gul Khan.
iss-pyaar-ko-kya-naam-doon-2011: Arnav Singh Raizada is an arrogant Delhi business tycoon haunted by his past. Khushi Kumari Gupta is a spirited young woman from a humble family in Lucknow. When she accidentally disrupts one of his fashion events, their worlds collide. Barun Sobti and Sanaya Irani star in this StarPlus romance produced by Gul Khan.
iss-pyaar-ko-kya-naam-doon-3-2017: Advay and Chandni were childhood friends in Allahabad until a family tragedy tore them apart. Years later they meet again, but a dark past still hangs over their love. Chandni is willing to carry its weight, while Advay is driven by revenge. Barun Sobti and Shivani Tomar star in this StarPlus romantic drama.
iss-pyaar-ko-kya-naam-doon-ek-baar-phir-: Aastha is a cheerful, independent young woman who firmly believes in equality. Shlok Agnihotri is a cold, arrogant businessman who runs a chain of educational institutions and values status over people. When Aastha publicly challenges him, destiny ties their lives together. Avinash Sachdev and Shrenu Parikh lead this StarPlus drama.
jamai-raja-2014: Siddharth is a successful hotelier who, unlike the usual TV bahu, takes it upon himself as son-in-law to fix his wife's family. His wife Roshni has long been estranged from her mother Durga Devi, a wealthy jewellery designer, and he sets out to bring them back together. Ravi Dubey, Nia Sharma and Achint Kaur star.
japani-toy-2018: Japani Toy is a Bengali adult comedy on Hoichoi. A small-time businessman in Kolkata comes up with an unusual plan to cure the loneliness of the city's single men by offering them life-sized Japanese dolls, promising company with no commitment and no emotions. What could possibly go wrong?
jee-karda-2023: Seven childhood friends always believed that their lives would be sorted by the time they turned 30. When the milestone arrives, they find life is a glorious mess instead. Tamannaah Bhatia, Suhail Nayyar and Aashim Gulati star in this Prime Video romantic drama directed by Arunima Sharma for Maddock Films.
jhalak-dikhhla-jaa-2006: Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa is the Indian version of the BBC's Strictly Come Dancing. Celebrities are paired with professional dancers and perform a new routine each week, competing for scores from the judges and votes from viewers, until one pair is crowned champion. The show has aired on both Sony TV and Colors.
jodha-akbar-2013: This Zee TV historical drama tells the story of the Mughal emperor Jalaluddin Akbar, who comes to the throne young and rules through fear, and Jodha, the kind and intelligent princess of Amer. Their marriage begins as a political alliance between Mughals and Rajputs. Rajat Tokas and Paridhi Sharma star in this Balaji Telefilms series.
jubilee-2023: In Bombay on the eve of Partition, studio owner Shrikant Roy is searching for a new star to launch, while his actress wife has plans of her own. A loyal studio hand, a dancer and a refugee are soon caught up in the hunt for fame. Vikramaditya Motwane directs this Prime Video period drama with Prosenjit Chatterjee and Aditi Rao Hydari.
kaala-paani-2023: When a mysterious illness breaks out across the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, residents, tourists, doctors and officials are caught in a desperate fight for survival as authorities race to find a cure. Created by Sameer Saxena and written by a team including Biswapati Sarkar, this Netflix thriller stars Mona Singh and Ashutosh Gowariker.
kaiser-2022: Kaiser Chowdhury is a brilliant homicide detective with some odd quirks, including a fear of blood. When he takes on a double murder case, it turns out to be far more tangled than it first seems. Afran Nisho plays the title role in this Bangladeshi detective thriller on Hoichoi, directed by Tanim Noor.
kaisi-yeh-yaariyan-2014: Loosely based on the Korean drama Boys Over Flowers, this MTV youth series follows Nandini, a student at a college where the popular band FAB5, led by the arrogant Manik Malhotra, rules the campus. Parth Samthaan and Niti Taylor lead a story about friendship, music, romance and the bonds that hold young people together.
kaiyum-kalavum-2022: Chance plays matchmaker when a compulsive thief and an unlucky pickpocket cross paths, and with every theft they pull off together they grow closer. Written and directed by Roju and presented by Karthik Subbaraj's Stone Bench Films, this Tamil SonyLIV series stars Sanchana Natarajan and Rohit.
kamathipura-2021: When the abandoned body of a sex worker is found in Kamathipura, Mumbai's red-light district, police officer Aditi Acharya takes up the investigation. As she digs into the life of the victim and the area's hidden networks, she discovers that the case is far more complicated than it first appears.
kamini-2019: In a remote village, men are vanishing one by one in the dead of night. The frightened villagers whisper about a mysterious enchantress, but is there something supernatural at work, or a very human mystery hiding behind the legend? Barkha Bisht stars in this Hoichoi thriller.
karenjit-kaur-the-untold-story-of-sunny-: This ZEE5 biographical series tells the story of Sunny Leone, born Karenjit Kaur into a middle-class Sikh family. It traces her life from childhood, her family and her relationship with her husband Daniel Weber, through her years in the adult film industry to her rise as a Bollywood actress. Sunny Leone plays herself.
karrle-tu-bhi-mohabbat-2017: Karan Khanna is a superstar and recovering alcoholic who heads to Mahabaleshwar for a detox with his new counsellor, the strict Dr Tripurasundari Nagarajan, whom he can hardly stand. When he attends his estranged daughter's wedding, he begins to discover that opposites really do attract. Ram Kapoor and Sakshi Tanwar star in this ALTBalaji romance.
kasautii-zindagii-kay-2018: This StarPlus series from Ekta Kapoor reimagines the classic love story of Anurag and Prerna, two people who seem made for each other but come from very different worlds. As betrayal, revenge and family rivalries pull them apart, the star-crossed lovers must fight to stay together against all odds.
kaun-banega-crorepati-2000: Kaun Banega Crorepati is India's long-running general knowledge quiz show and the official Hindi version of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Contestants climb a ladder of questions, with lifelines to help them, for prize money of up to several crore. Amitabh Bachchan has hosted every season except the third.
kaun-who-did-it-2021: In this interactive Flipkart Video crime show, retired cop turned private detective Adi Bhagat and his protege, Inspector Malini, take on a new murder case in Mumbai every day. After going through the clues and suspects, viewers get to guess the killer before Adi reveals it. Sushant Singh and Samvedna Suwalka star.
kaushiki-2018: Why would Kaushiki accuse her new friends of her murder? As the authorities try to get to the bottom of a strange case, dark secrets surface about Kaushiki and the people closest to her, secrets that could change all their lives. Sayani Gupta and Namit Das star in this Viu mystery thriller.
khatron-ke-khiladi-2008: Based on the American series Fear Factor, Khatron Ke Khiladi sends celebrity contestants to exotic locations to face their worst fears through a series of daring stunts, with one eliminated at a time. The show began on Sony TV as Fear Factor India before moving to Colors, hosted over the years by Akshay Kumar and Rohit Shetty.
khatron-ke-khiladi-made-in-india-2020: Khatron Ke Khiladi – Made in India is a special spin-off of the Colors stunt show, filmed in India rather than abroad. Popular contestants from earlier seasons return to face a fresh set of daring stunts and fears, hosted by Rohit Shetty, competing once again for the title of the ultimate khiladi.
khauf-2025: Madhu moves from Gwalior to a women's hostel in Delhi, hoping to put a painful past behind her. But her room hides a sinister presence that grows stronger each day, and the other women on her floor know it. Monika Panwar and Rajat Kapoor star in this Prime Video horror series written by Smita Singh.
khwabon-ke-parindey-2021: Free-spirited Bindiya convinces her best friends Megha and Dixit to join her on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip across Australia, driving a caravan from Melbourne to Perth. The adventure gets more interesting when a witty, quirky hitchhiker named Akash joins them along the way, in this romantic travel drama.
koffee-with-karan-2004: Filmmaker Karan Johar hosts this long-running celebrity talk show, inviting Bollywood stars onto his couch in pairs for candid chats, gossip, confessions and his famous rapid-fire round. The show debuted in 2004 on Star World and has since run for several seasons, with recent ones streaming on Disney+ Hotstar.
kota-factory-2019: Sixteen-year-old Vaibhav moves from Itarsi to Kota, the Rajasthan city famous for its coaching centres, to prepare for the IIT entrance exam. Amid relentless competition, new friendships and first crushes, he finds guidance in a popular physics teacher. Created by Saurabh Khanna for TVF and shot in black and white, the series stars Mayur More.
kuch-rang-pyar-ke-aise-bhi-2016: Dev Dixit is a successful businessman who lost his father at the age of eight and is fiercely devoted to his mother Ishwari and his sisters. When he meets Sonakshi, a spirited young doctor, a slow-burning love story begins, but winning over his protective mother is another matter. Shaheer Sheikh and Erica Fernandes star on Sony TV.
kumari-srimathi-2023: Srimathi is a 30-year-old unmarried woman with a dead-end job, a complicated family and one goal: winning back her ancestral house. To do that she must raise a lot of money fast, so she decides to open a bar in her village. Nithya Menen stars in this Telugu Prime Video series created by Srinivas Avasarala.
kumkum-bhagya-2014: Pragya, a college lecturer, and Abhi, a wealthy rock star, are brought together by an arranged marriage that neither expected. Their relationship is tested by misunderstandings and the schemes of people close to Abhi. Produced by Ekta Kapoor, this Zee TV drama later follows new generations of their family. Sriti Jha and Shabir Ahluwalia lead.
kurukshetra-2025: This animated Netflix series retells the great war of the Mahabharata, the 18-day battle between the Pandavas and the Kauravas. Each episode tells the story through a different character, offering 18 perspectives on a legendary clash for power, honour and revenge between two branches of the same family.
laakhon-mein-ek-2017: Aakash, a teenager from Raipur, dreams of making mimicry videos and becoming an internet star. His father has other ideas and packs him off to a strict IIT coaching institute in Visakhapatnam, where he struggles to keep up. Created by comedian Biswa Kalyan Rath, this Prime Video series looks at the pressure of the coaching system.
ladies-and-gentlemen-2021: Sabila is an ordinary young woman working in an office in Bangladesh. When she speaks up about her experience at work, she becomes the voice of working women far beyond her own office. This Bengali drama explores power, hierarchy, misogyny and the complicated dynamics between men and women in the workplace.
ladies-room-2016: Ladies Room follows two best friends, Dingo and Khanna, who are fearless, chaotic and completely unapologetic. Each episode is set in a different washroom as the pair get through one wild adventure after another, struggling to grow up even as they grow older in this bold comedy about modern female friendship.
laughter-chefs-unlimited-enter: In this Colors comedy cooking show, popular TV stars team up in pairs in the kitchen and try to make proper dishes while the show throws silly tasks and distractions at them. Bharti Singh hosts, while celebrity chef Harpal Singh Sokhi judges the food and keeps the chaos in check.
lava-ka-dhaava-2021: Lava Ka Dhaava is the Hindi version of the Netflix game show Floor Is Lava, with actor Jaaved Jaaferi providing his trademark comic commentary. Teams of contestants try to cross rooms flooded with make-believe lava, climbing over furniture and obstacles without falling in, to reach the exit and win the prize.
leaked-2023: At Oakwood High, an elite school in Mumbai, rebellious rich teenagers hide plenty of secrets behind their seemingly perfect lives. When the school's IT girl is found dead, those secrets threaten to come out one by one, turning friends into suspects. This teen mystery drama streams on Amazon miniTV.
least-eligible-bachelor-2026: A young man has struggled for years to find a bride because of the way he looks. Hoping for a fresh start, he moves to Hyderabad, only to discover that the woman his family has lined up as a potential match is a colleague at his new workplace. This Netflix romantic comedy follows what happens next.
leila-2019: In a dystopian near-future India where communities are kept rigidly apart, Shalini searches for the daughter who was taken from her when she was arrested years earlier. Based on Prayaag Akbar's novel, this Netflix drama is directed by Deepa Mehta, Shanker Raman and Pawan Kumar, and stars Huma Qureshi, Siddharth and Rahul Khanna.
locked-2020: A man who is not who he claims to be, two robbers and some uninvited guests all find themselves trapped together inside a mansion. With a mastermind always one step ahead and sinister events piling up, survival becomes the only goal. Satyadev stars in this Telugu psychological thriller on aha.
love-and-affairs-2020: Love and Affairs is a Hoichoi Bengali drama about a marriage that turns into a battlefield of love and suspicion. As doubts creep in, it becomes hard to tell betrayal from mistrust. Indraneil Sengupta, Barkha Sengupta and Debapriyo Mukherjee play the leads in this story of relationships under strain.
love-jaction-2021: Against all odds, Jackson wins the girl of his dreams. But when she betrays him, his love turns into an obsession, and his plans for revenge grow so twisted that even he cannot predict how far he will go. This SonyLIV series is a dark story about love that chooses to stay blind.
lsd-love-scandal-and-doctors-2021: Five medical interns at KMRC, a leading teaching hospital, find themselves at the centre of a scandal when they become the prime suspects in a murder. Are they capable of such a crime, or are they being framed? Produced by Ekta Kapoor, this ALTBalaji and ZEE5 thriller follows their internship under a strict police investigation.
lukkhe-2026: In Chandigarh, Lucky, a promising hockey player, meets Sanober while recovering in rehab after a drug-related accident. Once out, he discovers her brother is the underground rapper MC Badnaam, and a police inspector asks Lucky to help her take down the city's drug trade. Lakshvir Singh Saran, King, Raashii Khanna and Palak Tiwari star.
maaya-2017: When Sonia suffers a nervous breakdown and loses all memory of the past six months, her husband Abhishek sets out to find what caused it. Digging into her recent life, he uncovers a secret world of intense desire and dark fantasies he knew nothing about, and realises that only he may be able to save her.
made-in-heaven-2019: Tara and Karan run Made in Heaven, a wedding planning agency in Delhi. As they organise one lavish wedding after another, tradition clashes with modern dreams, and plenty of secrets and lies come out, including their own. Sobhita Dhulipala and Arjun Mathur star in this Prime Video drama from Excel Entertainment.
made-in-india-a-titan-story-20: In 1978 Bombay, Xerxes Desai sets out to build a world-class Indian watch brand in a market dominated by foreign and smuggled watches. Facing red tape, money troubles and repeated setbacks, he and his team fight to make Titan a reality. Jim Sarbh and Naseeruddin Shah star, adapted from Vinay Kamath's book about the company.
mahabharat-1988: Produced by B. R. Chopra and directed by Ravi Chopra, this landmark Doordarshan series retells the ancient Sanskrit epic Mahabharata over 94 episodes. It follows the Kuru dynasty from Bhishma's vow, through the rivalry between the Pandavas and Kauravas, to the road to the great war. Nitish Bharadwaj plays Krishna.
mahabharat-2013: This StarPlus retelling of the Mahabharata begins with Bhishma's vow of lifelong celibacy and traces the struggle for the throne of Hastinapura between two branches of the Kuru family, the Kauravas and the Pandavas. Saurabh Raj Jain plays Krishna, with Shaheer Sheikh as Arjun and Pooja Sharma as Draupadi.
mahakali-anth-hi-aarambh-hai-2017: This Colors mythological series tells the story of Goddess Parvati and her fierce form, Mahakali. It explores why a goddess revered as a mother is also feared for her terrifying, untamed form, tracing Parvati's journey and her transformation to fight evil. Pooja Sharma plays Parvati, with Saurabh Raj Jain as Shiva.
maharakshak-devi-2015: Gauri is the most powerful girl in the world but does not know it. Found as a baby floating in a river and raised far from people by her guru for 17 years, she comes to modern-day Mumbai, where she must fight asuras, ancient demons that have taken new forms. Zee TV fantasy series.
maharani-2021: In 1990s Bihar, Rani Bharti is a homemaker who cares only about her family and her village life. When her husband, the chief minister, is forced to step down, he shocks his party by naming her as his successor. Created by Subhash Kapoor, this SonyLIV political drama stars Huma Qureshi as the unlikely chief minister.
main-kuch-bhi-kar-sakti-hoon-2014: Dr Sneha Mathur, a young doctor, gives up a well-paid career in Mumbai to work in her home village of Pratappur. There she takes on deep-rooted problems around health, gender and the rights of women and girls. Made by the Population Foundation of India, this DD National drama mixes entertainment with social messages.
mandala-murders-2025: In the fictional town of Charandaspur in Uttar Pradesh, CIB officer Rea Thomas and suspended cop Vikram Singh investigate a string of chilling ritualistic murders that seem linked to a century-old secret society. Vaani Kapoor and Vaibhav Raj Gupta star, with Surveen Chawla, in this Netflix thriller created by Gopi Puthran for YRF Entertainment.
maradonar-juto-2021: In a Kolkata neighbourhood, the Dutta and Chowdhury families have been locked in a long-running feud, and at its centre is a pair of football boots said to have belonged to Diego Maradona. This Hoichoi Bengali comedy follows the rivals as the battle over the precious shoes heats up again.
masaba-masaba-2020: Fashion designer Masaba Gupta and her mother, actor Neena Gupta, play fictionalised versions of themselves in this Netflix series inspired by Masaba's life. It follows her career, her love life and her family, from glamorous parties with celebrity friends to quieter, messier moments at home. Sonam Nair writes and directs.
masterchef-india-2010: MasterChef India is the Indian edition of the global cooking competition that began in Britain and grew famous through MasterChef Australia. Home cooks from across the country take on cooking challenges and mystery boxes, preparing dishes from many cuisines for a panel of top chefs, in the hunt for India's next MasterChef.
mastram-2020: In the 1980s, Rajaram is an aspiring writer living in a remote valley whose work is dismissed by publishers as boring. Frustrated, he starts writing racy stories inspired by the people and everyday life around him, and under a pen name his books become an instant hit. Anshuman Jha and Tara Alisha Berry star in this MX Player series.
matkiphod-2021: Matkiphod is a web series streaming on Gemplex that sets out to blend three moods at once: urban drama, crime thriller and comedy. Its story plays out against the rush of city life, moving between tense, suspenseful moments and lighter, humorous ones as its characters' plans unfold.
matsya-kaand-2021: Matsya Thada is a charming con artist who relies on brains rather than brawn, pulling off some of the country's most daring scams and always staying a step ahead of the police. Then ACP Tejraj Singh is put in charge of his case. Ravi Dubey and Ravi Kishan star in this MX Player crime caper.
may-i-come-in-madam-2016: Sajan is a timid office worker whose wife keeps him firmly under her thumb at home. At work, he is smitten with his glamorous new boss and keeps trying, without much success, to win her attention, which only lands him in more trouble on both fronts. Sandeep Anand and Nehha Pendse star in this sitcom.
meri-saasu-maa-2016: Pari longs to find a mother in her mother-in-law. But Bhavna Devi, known to all as Maa Saab, is a strict matriarch who believes daughters-in-law must be kept within firm limits and can never become daughters. When fate makes them saas and bahu, both must learn to accept each other. Hiba Nawab stars in this Zee TV drama.
mind-the-malhotras-2019: Rishabh and Shefali Malhotra are a married couple going through a mid-life crisis, bickering endlessly even as the marriages of their friends fall apart around them. With two teenage daughters, a mischievous son and a meddling mother-in-law, life is not getting any easier. Mini Mathur and Cyrus Sahukar star in this Prime Video comedy.
mirzapur-2018: Akhandanand Tripathi, known as Kaleen Bhaiya, is a carpet exporter who rules the town of Mirzapur as its mafia don, and his reckless son Munna is desperate to inherit his empire. An incident at a wedding draws lawyer Ramakant Pandit's sons, Guddu and Bablu, into their violent world. Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Vikrant Massey star.
mismatch-2018: Two couples, Nibedita and RK, and Sukanya and Imtiaj, are bored with their married lives and looking for a way to bring back the spark. Their search leads them all to the ashram of the mysterious Milan Baba, where things only get more complicated in this Hoichoi Bengali comedy.
mismatched-2020: After a disastrous set-up by their families, ambitious coder Dimple and hopeless romantic Rishi meet again at a summer programme in Jaipur and strike up a shaky friendship that may become something more. Based on Sandhya Menon's novel When Dimple Met Rishi, this Netflix series stars Prajakta Koli and Rohit Saraf.
miss-perfect-2024: A young professional who is obsessed with cleanliness and order is mistaken for a maid. Her fixation on tidiness leads her into a new job and plenty of chaos in a messy household next door. Lavanya Tripathi and Abijeet Duddala star in this Telugu romantic comedy on Disney+ Hotstar, produced by Annapurna Studios.
mission-over-mars-2019: Inspired by India's mission to Mars, this drama follows four women scientists at the national space agency who take on a seemingly impossible task after a failed lunar mission. Against tight deadlines, technical hurdles and doubting colleagues, they push to send an orbiter to Mars. Sakshi Tanwar, Mona Singh, Nidhi Singh and Palomi Ghosh star.
modern-love-mumbai-2022: Based on the New York Times column and the American series it inspired, this Prime Video anthology tells six stories of love in Mumbai: romantic, platonic, parental, marital and self-love among them. Each episode has its own director, including Vishal Bhardwaj, Hansal Mehta and Shonali Bose, and its own cast.
mohomaya-2021: Rishi is a young man whose past is full of secrets surrounding his late mother, Maya. When he meets Aruna, the mother of a classmate, he finds the affection he has longed for all his life. But the bond soon becomes an obsession that threatens an ordinary family. Swastika Mukherjee and Ananya Chatterjee star in this Hoichoi series.
montu-pilot-2019: Montu grew up in Neelkuthi, a red-light area, dreaming of becoming a pilot, while his mother tried everything to get him out. Years later, still trapped there, he makes his living as a middleman in the very trade he wanted to escape. Debaloy Bhattacharya directs this Hoichoi crime drama starring Saurav Das and Solanki Roy.
motu-patlu-2012: Adapted from the classic comic strip in Lotpot, this animated Nickelodeon series follows two best friends in the small town of Furfuri Nagar: the round, samosa-loving Motu and the skinny, clever Patlu. Their misadventures keep landing them in comic trouble, from which they usually escape more by luck than skill.
mtv-dark-scroll-2024: MTV Dark Scroll is a paranormal reality show filmed in Uttarakhand and hosted by actor Amit Sadh. Nine contestants explore seven locations said to be among the most haunted in the region, facing supernatural challenges and their own deepest fears, guided by paranormal experts as they compete to last the course.
mtv-roadies-2003: MTV Roadies is one of India's longest-running youth reality shows. After tough auditions, a group of young contestants sets off on a road journey across different destinations, taking on tasks that test their physical, social and mental strength, with eliminations along the way until one is crowned the winner.
mtv-splitsvilla-2008: MTV Splitsvilla is a dating reality show in which young men and women live together in a villa cut off from the outside world. They compete in tasks to stay in the game while forming connections with each other, hoping to find love and win as a couple. Hosts over the years have included Sunny Leone and Rannvijay Singha.
mumbai-diaries-2021: On the night of the 26 November 2008 attacks on Mumbai, the overstretched staff in the emergency room of Bombay General Hospital face a crisis of enormous scale as wounded people pour in. Created by Nikkhil Advani and Nikhil Gonsalves, this Prime Video medical drama stars Konkona Sen Sharma and Mohit Raina.
muskaan-2018: Muskaan, the daughter of a bar dancer, marries Raunak and enters a family that refuses to accept her because of where she comes from. As her in-laws do everything they can to humiliate her and push her out of the house, she struggles to hold on to her dignity and her place in this Star Bharat drama.
my-perfectt-husband-2024: Saraswathi has always believed she is the only woman in her husband Bharathi's life. But when a marriage alliance is being arranged for their son, a secret from the past comes back to shake the family. Sathyaraj and Seetha star in this Tamil family drama on Disney+ Hotstar, directed by Thamira.
nakaab-2021: When a famous actress named Vibha Dutta dies in mysterious circumstances, police officer Aditi Amre is made lead investigator and soon uncovers dark secrets hidden behind the star's public image. Was it murder or suicide? Mallika Sherawat, Esha Gupta and Gautam Rode star in this MX Player crime thriller.
naxalbari-2020: Raghav, an agent with the Special Task Force, is sent on a secret mission to stop the revival of a Naxal uprising in Gadchiroli, Maharashtra. As he digs deeper into the larger plan behind it, the fight becomes personal. Rajeev Khandelwal, Tina Datta and Aamir Ali star in this ZEE5 thriller directed by Partho Mitra.
nazar-2018: The Rathods look like an ordinary well-off family, but they live under the evil eye of Mohana, a centuries-old daayan who feeds on the life force of others. As her dark influence grows, the family must find a way to fight back. Monalisa, Niyati Fatnani and Harsh Rajput star in this StarPlus supernatural drama.
nimmi-s-pg-2021: Three single young women share a paying guest flat in Delhi run by the watchful Nimmi aunty. What should be a simple living arrangement turns into one long comedy of late-night parties, hopeless boyfriends, misunderstandings and secrets they must keep from their landlady. This Hungama Play series follows their everyday chaos.
november-story-2021: A celebrated crime novelist living with Alzheimer's is found at the scene of a murder with no memory of what happened. His daughter sets out to uncover the truth and clear his name, and the mystery begins to unravel layer by layer. Tamannaah Bhatia and Pasupathy star in this Tamil Hotstar thriller directed by Indhra Subramanian.
oh-mother-2018: Oh! Mother is a Bengali comedy series about Saurav, a young man who feels constantly hounded by the two women in his life: his mother Sipra and his girlfriend Diya. Caught between their demands, expectations and clashing personalities, he tries, mostly in vain, to keep both of them happy at once.
omg-yeh-mera-india-2024: OMG! Yeh Mera India is a History TV18 series that travels across the country in search of the incredible. From bizarre foods and unusual rituals to people with rare talents and phenomena nobody can quite explain, each episode showcases surprising true stories from different corners of India.
one-mic-stand-2019: In this Prime Video show from OML, hosted by comedian Sapan Verma, well-known personalities who have never done stand-up are paired with professional comics who coach them for their debut set. The first season featured Bhuvan Bam, Taapsee Pannu, Richa Chadha, Vishal Dadlani and Shashi Tharoor, mentored by comedians including Zakir Khan and Kunal Kamra.
oops-ab-kya-2025: Roohi has promised to wait until marriage, so her life is turned upside down when she is accidentally artificially inseminated during a routine check-up, and the biological father is her boss, Samar. Now she must juggle her pregnancy, her fiance Omkar and her family. Shweta Basu Prasad stars in this Indian adaptation of Jane the Virgin.
operation-cobra-2019: A terrorist group called the Radical Posture Group gets its hands on a powerful new technology developed through Dr Patel's joint research between India and the UK. Only one man can stop them: India's top secret agent, codenamed Condor and known to his friends as Karan. Gautam Gulati stars in this Eros Now spy thriller.
operation-safed-sagar-the-untold-story-o: As the Kargil War breaks out between India and Pakistan in 1999, the Indian Air Force launches Operation Safed Sagar. This Netflix drama follows the pilots of the Golden Arrows squadron as they take on dangerous missions in the high mountains of Kargil, telling a lesser-known side of the conflict.
out-of-love-2019: Meera, a doctor, seems to have a perfect marriage with her loving husband Akarsh. Then she finds a single strand of hair on his scarf, and suspicion takes hold. Determined to find out the truth, she starts quietly digging. Rasika Dugal and Purab Kohli star in this Hotstar adaptation of the BBC drama Doctor Foster, directed by Tigmanshu Dhulia.
p-i-meena-2023: Meena, a sharp young private investigator, witnesses a young man being hit by a speeding truck. It looks like an ordinary accident, the kind that happens every day, but her instinct tells her otherwise, and her search for answers draws her into a far more dangerous case. Tanya Maniktala stars, with Parambrata Chatterjee and Jisshu Sengupta, on Prime Video.
paanch-phoron-2019: Named after the Bengali five-spice blend, Paanch Phoron is a Hoichoi anthology of five romantic stories, each made by a different director. Every story offers its own distinct flavour of love, from sweet first romances to more complicated relationships, in a collection designed to make the heart flutter.
paap-2019: The wealthy Choudhury family is thrown into chaos when a murder in the household comes with a warning that four more will follow. No one is safe and everyone is a suspect, as the family seems to be paying for a sin from the past. Anupam Hari directs this Hoichoi Bengali murder mystery starring Puja Banerjee.
paatal-lok-2020: Hathiram Chaudhary, a jaded police inspector in outer Delhi, lands the case of his life when four suspects are caught for a plot to kill a famous prime-time journalist. The case drags him into a dark underworld where nothing is what it seems. Jaideep Ahlawat stars in this Prime Video thriller created by Sudip Sharma.
pakdam-pakdai-2019: In this animated Nickelodeon comedy, Doggy Don is a small pink dog whose home is overrun by three troublesome mice, Chhotu, Lambu and Motu, the self-styled Chuha Party. Helped by his hot-tempered older brother Colonel and their grumpy Great Dane neighbour Ballu, Don battles the mice in one chaotic chase after another.
parchhayee-ghost-stories-by-ruskin-bond-: Parchhayee is a ZEE5 anthology that brings to the screen the ghost stories of celebrated author Ruskin Bond. Each episode adapts a different tale, many of them set in the quiet hills he loved to write about, mixing eerie atmosphere, mystery and his gentle storytelling style.
paurashpur-2020: In the kingdom of Paurashpur, men rule and women are kept firmly under their control. As resentment builds, a battle of the sexes breaks out over power and equality, and every character has shades of grey. Annu Kapoor, Milind Soman, Shilpa Shinde and Shaheer Sheikh star in this ALTBalaji and ZEE5 period drama.
pearle-maaney-show-2018: The Pearle Maaney Show is a relaxed Malayalam celebrity chat show on YouTube. Actor and presenter Pearle Maaney sits down with guests from film and television for easy-going conversations, personal stories and light-hearted games, offering fans a more casual look at the stars they know from the screen.
pehla-pyaar-less-than-1-chance-2024: When his father is transferred, young Murli Sharma moves with his family from Ratlam to Patna. Struggling to fit in and feeling isolated from his new classmates, he meets Nandini, and their friendship soon turns into love on his side. But will she feel the same? This SonyLIV series follows his first romance.
perfect-pati-2018: Set in Rajasthan, Perfect Pati follows Vidhita, who marries Pushkar Rathod, the son of a wealthy family, only to find that he is far from the ideal husband she hoped for. When things go wrong, her progressive mother-in-law Rajyashree steps in on her side. Jaya Prada stars in this &TV drama that asks if an ideal son can also be an ideal husband.
perilloor-premier-league-2024: Malavika comes to the quirky village of Perilloor, where she has long had a crush on a childhood friend. When her uncle cannot contest the panchayat elections, he pushes her to run instead, and she reluctantly gets dragged into local politics. Nikhila Vimal and Sunny Wayne star in this Malayalam political comedy on Disney+ Hotstar.
permanent-roommates-2014: After three years in a long-distance relationship, Mikesh returns from the US to surprise his girlfriend Tanya with a marriage proposal. Not ready for marriage, she says no, and the two settle on a compromise: moving in together first. Sumeet Vyas and Nidhi Singh star in this pioneering TVF romantic comedy.
pinjara-khubsurti-ka-2020: Mayura is a young woman who dreams of becoming a doctor and resents that people only see her beauty, never her abilities. When Omkar, a powerful marble businessman, decides he wants to marry her, he pressures her family into agreeing, and her beauty begins to feel like a cage. Riya Sharma and Sahil Uppal star in this Colors drama.
piya-rangrezz-2015: Set in Uttar Pradesh, Piya Rangrezz follows Sher Singh, a powerful young man who falls madly in love with Shraddha, a shy and soft-spoken girl. To win her, he must stand up to his domineering mother, with whom he shares a fiercely close bond. Gaurav S Bajaj leads this family drama produced by Sphere Origins.
poacher-2024: In the forests of Kerala, a team of forest officers, police constables, NGO workers and ordinary citizens risk their lives to track down the people behind India's biggest elephant ivory poaching ring. Created by Richie Mehta, this Malayalam crime drama stars Nimisha Sajayan, Roshan Mathew and Dibyendu Bhattacharya.
police-diary-2-0-2019: Police Diary 2.0 is a Tamil crime series on ZEE5 following two special task force teams as they take on some of the most disturbing crimes in Tamil Nadu. Each case sees the officers identify, investigate and track down those responsible, often against the clock.
porus-2017: Alexander, who would become one of the world's greatest conquerors, and Porus, the spirited Indian king who would defend his land, were born on the same day on two different continents. This Sony TV historical drama follows both men's lives on the road to the Battle of the Hydaspes. Laksh Lalwani plays Porus.
project-9191-2021: In Mumbai, a special police team led by DCP Amitabh Sinha works with one goal: stopping crimes before they happen. As they race to piece together clues in time, each case tests their methods and their nerve. This SonyLIV crime series is directed by Subbu, with Satyajit Sharma and Vaibhav Tatwawaadi in the cast.
pushpavalli-2017: Pushpavalli was supposed to finish her food science degree and marry a man her mother approved of. Then she meets the charming Nikhil Rao and secretly follows him to Bangalore, where she takes a job at a children's library, deals with an unpredictable landlady, and insists it is not stalking if you know the person. Sumukhi Suresh created and stars.
qurbaan-hua-2020: Neel, a chef from a Hindu Brahmin family, blames Chahat's father, a Muslim doctor, for the death of his beloved sister on the operating table and swears revenge. Chahat, cheerful and devoted to her father, is drawn into the feud between the two families. Pratibha Ranta and Karan Jotwani lead this Zee TV romantic drama.
raakh-2026: In 1978, the disappearance of two teenage siblings shakes Delhi and devastates their close-knit family. As public fear grows, a determined police officer leads an intense manhunt that uncovers a chilling world of violence. Inspired by a real case, this Prime Video crime thriller stars Ali Fazal and Sonali Bendre.
raktanchal-2020: Inspired by real events in 1980s Purvanchal, eastern Uttar Pradesh, this crime drama follows the clash over government tenders between Waseem Khan, the region's feared tender mafia, and Vijay Singh, a young man who dreamed of the civil services until Khan's gang killed his father. Kranti Prakash Jha and Nikitin Dheer star on MX Player.
ram-siya-ke-luv-kush-2019: After Ram returns to Ayodhya and rumours about Sita spread through the kingdom, Sita goes to live in the ashram of sage Valmiki. There her sons Luv and Kush grow up unaware that they are princes of Ayodhya. Himanshu Soni and Shivya Pathania play Ram and Sita in this Colors mythological drama.
rana-naidu-2023: Rana Naidu is the man Mumbai's rich and famous call when scandal strikes, a fixer who will make any problem go away. His own biggest problem arrives when his estranged father Naga gets out of prison. Rana Daggubati and Venkatesh Daggubati star in this Netflix adaptation of the American series Ray Donovan.
rangbaaz-2018: In 1990s Gorakhpur, a young man named Shiv Prakash Shukla rises from student to the most feared gangster in Uttar Pradesh, working for powerful politicians and spreading terror. The state sets up a special task force to bring him down. Inspired by a true story, this ZEE5 crime drama stars Saqib Saleem.
rangeen-2025: Stuck in a stale marriage, an upright middle-aged man discovers that his wife has been secretly seeing a paid lover. Hurt and desperate to reclaim his pride, he plunges into the hidden world of paid intimacy himself, stumbling through awkward and absurd misadventures. Vineet Kumar Singh and Rajshri Deshpande star in this Prime Video series.
rasbhari-2020: Shanu, a new English teacher, arrives in Meerut and quickly becomes the object of every man's fantasy, including her student Nand, while the town's women brand her a home-wrecker. When Nand discovers her bold alter ego, Rasbhari, things take a new turn. Swara Bhaskar stars in this Prime Video comedy.
ray-2021: This Netflix anthology adapts four short stories by the celebrated filmmaker and writer Satyajit Ray, ranging from satire to psychological thriller. The episodes are directed by Srijit Mukherji, Vasan Bala and Abhishek Chaubey, and feature Manoj Bajpayee, Ali Fazal, Harshvardhan Kapoor and Kay Kay Menon.
razia-sultan-2015: This &TV historical drama tells the story of Razia Sultan, the only woman to rule the Delhi Sultanate in the 13th century. Chosen by her father, Sultan Iltutmish, over his sons as the most capable heir, she must face the struggles of power and of life as a woman ruler. Pankhuri Awasthy plays Razia.
rejctx-2019: RejctX follows a group of students at an elite international school who form a rap band to show off their talent and vent their frustrations. Along the way the series tackles issues like gender identity, body shaming and mental health. Sumeet Vyas and Kubbra Sait star in this ZEE5 coming-of-age drama.
rishton-ka-saudagar-baazigar-2016: Aarav Trivedi, cunning and charming, and Arundhati Bharadwaj, sweet and trusting, seem to fall deeply in love despite their very different personalities. But Aarav is hiding his real intentions, and their love story soon takes a twisted turn. Vatsal Sheth and Ishita Dutta star in this Life OK drama.
rising-star-2017: Rising Star is the Indian version of the international singing competition format, and the first reality show in India with live audience voting. As each contestant performs, viewers at home vote in real time through a mobile app to decide whether they move on, with a panel of celebrity experts adding a small share of votes.
rocket-boys-2022: Spanning the 1940s to the 1960s, this SonyLIV series tells the story of two visionary scientists who shaped modern India: Homi J. Bhabha, the architect of the country's nuclear programme, and Vikram Sarabhai, founder of its space programme. Jim Sarbh and Ishwak Singh play the two men, directed by Abhay Pannu.
runaway-lugaai-2021: Rajni, the only son of a powerful MLA, is nothing like his superstar namesake. A timid man who has lived his whole life under his father's thumb, he can neither stand up to him nor meet his expectations. Then his bride runs away, setting off a comic chain of events. Naveen Kasturia and Sanjay Mishra star on MX Player.
sa-re-ga-ma-pa-2016: Sa Re Ga Ma Pa is one of India's longest-running singing competitions, on air since 1995. Named after the first five notes of the Indian sargam, it brings talented singers from across the country to compete before celebrity music judges and mentors, round after round, for the title.
saas-bahu-aur-flamingo-2023: Savitri, known as Rani Ba, runs a women-led herbal products cooperative that is really the front for a powerful drug cartel in a lawless border region. When she sets off a battle to choose her heir, her daughters-in-law and daughter are pulled into a dangerous fight. Dimple Kapadia stars in this Hotstar crime drama from Homi Adajania.
saath-nibhaana-saathiya-2010: Gopi, an orphan, is treated as a servant by her aunt and cousin Rashi.
