When Kokila Modi, the strict matriarch of a wealthy Gujarati family in Rajkot, chooses Gopi as a bride for her son Ahem, both cousins end up married into the same family. Rupal Patel plays Kokila in this long-running StarPlus drama.
sacred-games-2018: Sartaj Singh, a troubled Mumbai police inspector, gets a call from Ganesh Gaitonde, a notorious crime lord who has been missing for 16 years, warning him that he has 25 days to save the city. Based on Vikram Chandra's novel, India's first Netflix original stars Saif Ali Khan and Nawazuddin Siddiqui.
salakaar-2025: When an undercover agent stumbles onto a plan involving a nuclear weapon, a battle-hardened spymaster must return to his secret past to stop a catastrophe. Created and directed by Faruk Kabir, this JioHotstar espionage thriller stars Naveen Kasturia, Mouni Roy and Mukesh Rishi.
santoshi-maa-sunayein-vrat-kathayein-202: This &TV devotional drama follows an ardent devotee of Goddess Santoshi as she shares the importance of fasting and the proper ways of worshipping the goddess. Meanwhile Goddess Poulomi, jealous of Santoshi Maa, does everything she can to bring trouble into the lives of her devotees.
sapne-vs-everyone-2023: Two young men selling real estate in Delhi chase impossible dreams. Prashant, driven by love, wants to become a great actor, while Jimmy, driven by revenge, wants to be the richest man in the city. Written and directed by Ambrish Verma, who also plays Jimmy, this TVF drama co-stars Paramvir Cheema.
sarabhai-vs-sarabhai-2004: In upmarket South Mumbai, the Sarabhais are a well-off Gujarati family ruled by snobbish Maya, who constantly despairs of her middle-class daughter-in-law Monisha. Her mischievous husband Indravadan loves teasing everyone, and their son Rosesh writes terrible poetry. Satish Shah and Ratna Pathak Shah star in this cult sitcom directed by Deven Bhojani.
scam-1992-the-harshad-mehta-story-2020: Set in 1980s and 1990s Bombay, this SonyLIV drama follows the rise of Harshad Mehta, a stockbroker from a modest background who became the biggest name on Dalal Street. Directed by Hansal Mehta and based on the book by journalists Sucheta Dalal and Debashish Basu, it stars Pratik Gandhi as Mehta.
scam-2003-the-telgi-story-2023: Based on true events, this SonyLIV drama traces how Abdul Karim Telgi rose from selling fruit on trains to running a vast fake stamp paper racket through bribery and connections, all while keeping a low profile. Gagan Dev Riar plays Telgi in this second instalment of the Scam series.
school-of-lies-2023: When 12-year-old Shakti goes missing from a prestigious boarding school in the hills, his disappearance sets off a chain of events that affects teachers, students and families alike. Created and directed by Avinash Arun, this Disney+ Hotstar mystery drama stars Nimrat Kaur and Aamir Bashir.
selection-day-2018: Brothers Radha and Manjunath have been trained since childhood by their obsessive father to become India's next great batting pair. When he moves them to Mumbai to chase selection, the boys must deal with his pressure, a tough system and their own dreams. Based on Aravind Adiga's novel, this Netflix drama stars Mohammad Samad and Yash Dholye.
shaadi-boys-2016: Three young friends get their first break in the wedding business and, by a stroke of luck, find the perfect place to show off their talent. They dream of making big money and impressing the girls, but their hilarious journey through the world of big Indian weddings rarely goes to plan.
shaitaan-haveli-2018: Hariman, a B-grade filmmaker, takes his crew to an old haveli to shoot a cheap horror film. But strange happenings soon convince them that they are not just making a horror movie, they are living in one. Created by Varun Thakur, who also stars, this horror comedy streams on Prime Video.
shaka-laka-boom-boom-2002: Sanju, a brave and kind-hearted boy, finds a magic pencil that brings anything he draws to life. He uses it to help his friends, but the pencil soon attracts the attention of a criminal named Tiger and a scheming magician who will do anything to get their hands on it. A much-loved children's fantasy series on StarPlus.
shake-it-up-2013: This Indian adaptation of the Disney Channel sitcom follows best friends Neel Walia and Yash Mehta, two confident and energetic 13-year-olds who are talented dancers. As they take their first steps into the world of professional dancing, they must balance school, family and their big dreams.
shaktimaan-1997: When evil grows strong in the world, a sect of saints called the Suryanshis choose one man to fight it. Through yoga, meditation and the power of the five elements he becomes Shaktimaan, while living in disguise as the clumsy photographer Gangadhar. Mukesh Khanna created and stars in this classic DD National superhero series.
shani-2016: No god in Hindu mythology is feared quite like Shani, the god of justice who keeps the balance of good and bad karma in the universe. This Colors mythological drama tells his story, from his difficult birth and childhood to his rise as the stern judge whose gaze everyone dreads.
shaque-trust-no-one-2026: When her child goes missing, a desperate mother returns to her hillside hometown to search for answers. As she digs deeper, she uncovers dark secrets kept by the people around her and learns that she can trust no one. Jennifer Winget and Sumeet Vyas star in this Netflix thriller.
shark-tank-india-2021: Shark Tank India is the Indian edition of the American business reality show. Aspiring entrepreneurs from across the country pitch their companies and products to a panel of successful business leaders, the Sharks, who grill them on their numbers and decide whether to invest their own money and mentor them.
she-2020: Bhumika Pardeshi is a timid junior police constable in Mumbai, weighed down by money troubles and an unhappy marriage. When the anti-narcotics squad picks her to go undercover as a sex worker to trap a drug cartel leader, she discovers a side of herself she never knew. Created by Imtiaz Ali, this Netflix drama stars Aaditi Pohankar.
shekhar-home-2024: Set in the small Bengal town of Lonpur in the 1990s, this adaptation of Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes stories follows the brilliant, eccentric Shekhar and his new housemate Jayavrat as they solve a string of baffling cases. Kay Kay Menon and Ranvir Shorey star, directed by Srijit Mukherji and Rohan Sippy.
shrimad-ramayan-2024: Produced by Swastik Productions, this Sony TV series retells the epic Ramayana, following Ram, the seventh avatar of Vishnu, from his birth in Ayodhya through the hardships and exile that shape him into the ideal man. Sujay Reu plays Ram in this lavish mythological drama.
sin-2020: The mysterious death of a young girl in the hills sets off an investigation that leads all the way to Kolkata, uncovering a high-profile organised crime network involved in drugs, trafficking and murder. As the investigators dig deeper, they find powerful people with plenty to hide in this ZEE5 thriller.
siya-ke-ram-2015: Siya Ke Ram retells the epic Ramayana through the eyes of Sita, showing her strength, courage and deep love for Ram. Drawing on Valmiki's Ramayana and other versions of the story, this StarPlus series stars Madirakshi Mundle as Sita and Ashish Sharma as Ram.
skyfire-2019: When a boy from a slum suddenly disappears, the search for him leads a historian and a journalist to a series of strange and seemingly unrelated events, including warnings of natural disasters. Directed by Soumik Sen, this ZEE5 sci-fi thriller stars Prateik Babbar, Sonal Chauhan and Jisshu Sengupta.
smoke-2018: Set in Goa, Smoke dives into a dark world of drugs, mafia and power, where rival cartels are at war and every player is fighting to survive. Jim Sarbh, Kalki Koechlin and Mandira Bedi star in this Eros Now crime drama.
snakes-and-ladders-2024: Set in the 2000s, this Tamil thriller follows four reckless schoolchildren who try to cover up a crime they committed by accident, only to land in ever worse trouble as police and dim-witted gangsters close in. Produced by Kalyan Subramanian for Stone Bench and curated by Karthik Subbaraj, it streams on Prime Video.
special-ops-1-5-2021: In 2001, after the attack on India's Parliament, a young and idealistic intelligence officer named Himmat Singh had a theory. By 2003, he had a mystery. This prequel to Special Ops tells the story of how Himmat became the officer he is. Neeraj Pandey directs, with Kay Kay Menon as Himmat.
special-ops-2020: Himmat Singh, a senior officer with India's external intelligence agency, is convinced that a series of terror attacks over nearly two decades are the work of one man. With a team of agents spread across the world, he races to end the long manhunt. Created by Neeraj Pandey, this Hotstar thriller stars Kay Kay Menon.
ssshhhh-koi-hai-2001: Ssshhhh... Koi Hai is a horror anthology series that first aired on StarPlus. Each episode brings a new spine-chilling story of haunted houses, ghosts, witches and evil spirits, and later episodes introduce Vikraal, a ghost hunter who takes on the forces of darkness.
state-of-siege-26-11-2020: This ZEE5 action thriller recounts the 2008 terror attacks on Mumbai from the perspective of the National Security Guard commandos sent in to end the siege. It is based on journalist Sandeep Unnithan's book Black Tornado: The Three Sieges of Mumbai 26/11, and directed by Matthew Leutwyler and Prashant Singh.
stories-by-rabindranath-tagore-2015: Directed by Anurag Basu, this anthology adapts the short stories of Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore, set in 1920s Bengal. Many of the episodes centre on strong women and complicated relationships in a conservative society. Radhika Apte is among the cast of the series, which aired on Epic.
student-of-the-year-after-dark-2026: The queen bee of St. Teresa's school is found dead in a frozen lake, and the news of her death goes viral. Her twin sister is determined to find out what really happened, whatever the cost, and starts digging into the secrets kept by the school's glamorous, privileged students in this JioHotstar mystery series.
subharambha-2021: Subhomita is a struggling musician trying to balance her life, her family and her passion for music. A chance meeting with Mainak, who has admired her since childhood, seems to bring her luck, but another challenge is always waiting around the corner. This is a Hoichoi Bengali drama.
sunaina-2008: Sunaina is a 15-year-old girl with a secret: she can see glimpses of the future in her dreams. Trying to act on her visions, or stop them from coming true, she and her friends keep landing in comic misadventures at school and at home in this children's comedy series.
sunflower-2021: When Mr Kapoor, a resident of the Sunflower housing society in Mumbai, is found dead, the police arrive to question his neighbours. In a society full of quirky characters, including the oddball Sonu, everyone could be a suspect. Sunil Grover stars in this ZEE5 comedy mystery created by Vikas Bahl.
super-dancer-2016: Super Dancer is a Sony TV dance reality show for children aged four to thirteen. Young dancers from across India are paired with choreographers and perform a new act each week, competing for the title before a panel of judges that has included Shilpa Shetty, Anurag Basu and Geeta Kapur.
superstar-singer-2019: Superstar Singer is a Sony TV singing competition for children from across India. Young contestants are mentored and judged by well-known playback singers from Hindi films, and compete round after round with songs old and new, hoping to win the title and the prize.
suraj-aur-saanjh-2021: Saanjh is struggling to put her life back together after her divorce. Then she is asked to host her younger sister's boss, Suraj, an unruly and ill-mannered man who walks into her already messy life and turns it upside down. Anjali Anand and Avinash Sachdev star in this romantic drama.
survivor-india-the-ultimate-battle-2012: Survivor India is the Indian version of the global Survivor franchise, which grew out of the Swedish show Expedition Robinson. Contestants are left on a remote island to fend for themselves, competing in challenges and voting each other out until one survivor remains. Sameer Kochhar hosts this StarPlus series.
suzhal-the-vortex-2022: In the small Tamil Nadu town of Sambaloor, during a ten-day festival for the goddess Angalamman, a fire at the local cement factory and the disappearance of a teenage girl set off an investigation that stirs up old secrets. Created by Pushkar and Gayathri, this Prime Video thriller stars Kathir and Aishwarya Rajesh.
swami-ramdev-ek-sangharsh-2018: Produced by Ajay Devgn's production house, this biographical series tells the story of Swami Ramdev's journey from a modest childhood in a village to becoming one of India's best-known yoga gurus. It follows the struggles and setbacks along the way. The series first aired on Discovery Jeet.
swaragini-2015: In Kolkata, two families have been bitter rivals since a rift twenty years ago. Swara and Ragini, a daughter from each family, grow up without knowing they are half-sisters. Once they find out, the two try to heal the wounds between the families. Helly Shah and Tejasswi Prakash lead this Colors drama.
sweet-kaaram-coffee-2023: Three women from three generations live under the same roof, a grandmother, her daughter-in-law and her granddaughter, and for once decide to put themselves first. What follows is a journey of fun, mistakes and self-discovery. Created by Reshma Ghatala, this Tamil Prime Video series stars Lakshmi, Madhoo and Santhy Balachandran.
taarak-mehta-ka-ooltah-chashmah-2008: Based on writer Tarak Mehta's magazine column, this long-running Sony SAB sitcom follows the residents of Gokuldham Society in Mumbai, families from many cultures who celebrate festivals together and help each other out of trouble. Much of the comedy revolves around the hapless businessman Jethalal, played by Dilip Joshi.
taj-divided-by-blood-2023: In his search for a worthy heir to his empire, Emperor Akbar sets off a bitter rivalry among his three sons, Salim, Murad and Daniyal. What follows is a fight for the throne full of politics, betrayal and bloodshed. Naseeruddin Shah plays Akbar, with Aditi Rao Hydari and Dharmendra, in this ZEE5 period drama.
tamil-rockerz-2022: An anonymous group of online pirates threatens to leak a hugely anticipated film starring a massively popular hero before its release. Police officer Rudra is put in charge of a special team to find them and stop the leak. Arun Vijay and Vani Bhojan star in this Tamil SonyLIV thriller directed by Arivazhagan.
tanaav-2022: In 2017 Kashmir, Kabir, a veteran of a special task group, is pulled out of retirement when he learns that a terrorist he thought was dead is still alive. He and his reassembled unit plan to strike at the man's brother's wedding. An Indian adaptation of the Israeli series Fauda, directed by Sudhir Mishra and starring Manav Vij.
tandav-2021: Samar Pratap Singh, a charismatic party leader, believes he is ready to become prime minister, but his father, the sitting PM, is not ready to step aside, and others are eyeing the top job too. Meanwhile, a young campus activist is drawn into politics. Saif Ali Khan and Dimple Kapadia star in this Prime Video series from Ali Abbas Zafar.
tashan-e-ishq-2015: Set in Punjab, Tashan-e-Ishq follows Twinkle Taneja, who is in love with Yuvraj Luthra, the son of her mother's rival. When her mother pushes for Twinkle's marriage to Kunj Sarna instead, a tangled love triangle begins. Jasmin Bhasin, Zain Imam and Sidhant Gupta star in this Zee TV romantic drama.
tech-conversations-with-my-dad-2014: Tech Conversations with My Dad is a TVF comedy series built on a problem almost every young Indian knows: trying to explain technology to a parent. Each short episode finds a patient son helping his curious, stubborn father with smartphones, apps, the internet and gadgets, with funny and familiar results.
temptation-island-india-2023: Based on the international Temptation Island format, this JioCinema reality show sends real couples to a resort in Alibaug, where they live apart alongside attractive singles. Over the weeks each partner must decide whether to stay faithful or give in to a new connection. Karan Kundrra and Mouni Roy host.
thalaivettiyaan-paalayam-2024: Siddharth, a city-bred graduate from Chennai, reluctantly takes a job as panchayat secretary in the quirky village of Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam. As he struggles to adjust to rural life and his not-so-exciting job, he faces one comic challenge after another. This Tamil remake of TVF's Panchayat stars Abishek Kumar on Prime Video.
the-aam-aadmi-family-2016: The Aam Aadmi Family follows the Sharmas, a typical middle-class family: a hardworking father, a traditional mother, a gossip-loving grandmother and two grown-up children, all coping with everyday middle-class life as best they can. Directed by Apoorv Singh Karki, it stars Brijendra Kala and Lubna Salim.
the-adventures-of-hatim-2013: Drawing on the folk tales of Hatim al-Tai, this fantasy series follows Hatim, a prince of Yemen gifted with unique powers. To destroy the evil sorcerer Zargam, he sets out on a quest to solve seven riddles, facing magical creatures and dangers along the way. Rajbeer Singh plays Hatim, with Pooja Banerjee.
the-broken-news-2022: Two Mumbai news channels stand on opposite sides: the principled but struggling Awaaz Bharati and the sensational, top-rated Josh 24/7. Their journalists compete fiercely for stories while trying to balance ambition, integrity and their own lives. Sonali Bendre, Jaideep Ahlawat and Shriya Pilgaonkar star in this ZEE5 remake of the BBC drama Press.
the-family-man-2019: Srikant Tiwari seems like an ordinary middle-class man, but he secretly works for a special cell of the National Investigation Agency, trying to stop terror attacks on the country. Balancing a dangerous job with a wife and two children who know nothing about it is its own battle. Manoj Bajpayee stars in Raj & DK's Prime Video series.
the-final-call-2019: On a night flight from Mumbai to Sydney, Captain Karan, in a dark state of mind, makes a decision that puts the lives of everyone on board at risk. On the ground and in the air, people race to save the passengers. Based on Priya Kumar's novel, this ZEE5 thriller stars Arjun Rampal, Javed Jaffrey and Neeraj Kabi.
the-freelancer-2023: Avinash Kamath, a former Mumbai police officer turned freelance mercenary, takes on a daunting mission: rescuing Aliya, his old friend's daughter, who is trapped in war-torn Syria after her marriage. Based on Shirish Thorat's book A Ticket to Syria and created by Neeraj Pandey, this Hotstar thriller stars Mohit Raina.
the-great-indian-murder-2022: When Vicky Rai, a notorious young industrialist, is shot dead at his own party, the suspects include guests both invited and uninvited, each with a reason to want him gone. Based on Vikas Swarup's novel Six Suspects, this Hotstar mystery is directed by Tigmanshu Dhulia and stars Richa Chadha and Pratik Gandhi.
the-hunt-for-veerappan-2023: This four-part Netflix docuseries looks at Veerappan, the bandit who ruled the forests of south India for decades and became the target of one of the country's longest manhunts. Directed by Selvamani Selvaraj, it draws on interviews with those who chased him and those who knew him.
the-investigation-2019: On what seems like a routine day, an officer with the Mumbai crime branch is handed a new murder case. He instinctively knows he was responsible for the death. As the investigation moves forward, he must decide whether to confess and go to jail, or find another way out, in this Eros Now thriller.
the-kapil-sharma-show-2016: Hosted by comedian Kapil Sharma, this Sony TV comedy show follows the format of his earlier hit. Each episode opens with a comic skit by Kapil and his team of comedians, including Sumona Chakravarti and Chandan Prabhakar, as quirky neighbours, followed by a light-hearted chat with celebrity guests.
the-last-hour-2021: Dev is a young shaman with a rare gift: he can speak to the dead and relive their final hour. On the run to protect that gift, he joins Arup, a seasoned police officer posted to the northeast, to hunt a dangerous figure from his past, and falls for Arup's daughter. Sanjay Kapoor and Karma Takapa star on Prime Video.
the-night-manager-2023: Shaan Sengupta, the night manager of a luxury hotel and a former naval officer, is recruited to bring down Shelly Rungta, a powerful and dangerous arms dealer, by working his way into his inner circle. Aditya Roy Kapur and Anil Kapoor star in this Hotstar adaptation of John le Carré's novel and the British series.
the-office-2019: This Indian adaptation of the British sitcom The Office is set at Wilkins Chawla, a paper company where downsizing and mediocrity are constant. Its clueless boss Jagdeep Chadda thinks he is everyone's favourite, while his staff just try to get through the day. Mukul Chadda stars in the Hotstar mockumentary.
the-raikar-case-2020: When tragedy strikes the respected Raikar family, the investigation that follows exposes the lies, resentments and secrets the family members have been keeping from each other, and asks whether trust can ever be absolute. Atul Kulkarni, Ashwini Bhave, Parul Gulati and Neil Bhoopalam star in this murder mystery directed by Aditya Sarpotdar.
the-romantics-2023: Created by Smriti Mundhra, this four-part Netflix docuseries celebrates the life and legacy of filmmaker Yash Chopra, his son Aditya Chopra and their studio Yash Raj Films. Using archival footage and interviews with many of Bollywood's biggest stars, it traces their impact on Hindi cinema.
the-royals-2025: A charming young prince from a royal family that has lost most of its fortune meets the driven founder of a luxury homestay startup. Their worlds, fading aristocracy and fast-moving business, collide in a whirlwind of ambition and romance. Ishaan Khatter and Bhumi Pednekar star, with Zeenat Aman and Sakshi Tanwar, in this Netflix romantic comedy.
the-secret-of-the-shiledars-2025: A secret society, the Shiledars, has spent centuries guarding a hidden treasure belonging to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. When Rajeev is drawn into the mystery, he must race to protect the treasure from falling into the wrong hands. Rajeev Khandelwal and Sai Tamhankar star in this JioHotstar thriller directed by Aditya Sarpotdar.
the-senapatis-2019: The Senapatis follows a refugee family as they try to build a new life in a foreign land. Facing hostility and hardship at every turn, the family makes great sacrifices and fights its way to hard-won victories, often at a bloody cost, in this Bengali drama on Addatimes.
the-silence-2023: The Silence is a Bengali drama on Binge about the pull of forbidden desire. Its characters are driven by an attraction to things they should not want, making them ambitious and careless of social rules alike, and pushing them towards consequences they never intended, echoing the old story of Adam, Eve and the serpent.
the-suite-life-of-karan-and-kabir-2012: Twin brothers Karan and Kabir live in the Raj Mahal Hotel in Mumbai, where their mother is assistant manager. Their constant schemes and mischief drive the strict hotel manager mad, while the owner's ditzy daughter Rani and candy-counter girl Vinny join the fun. This Disney Channel India sitcom adapts The Suite Life of Zack & Cody.
the-test-case-2017: Captain Shikha Sharma is the only woman in a group of Indian Army officers training to join the special forces, making her a test case for whether women can take on combat roles. She must overcome tough physical training, pressure at home and the bias of her colleagues. Nimrat Kaur stars in this ALTBalaji drama.
the-traitors-2025: Hosted by Karan Johar, the Indian edition of The Traitors brings 20 contestants to a royal palace to compete for a cash prize. Some are secretly chosen as traitors who must eliminate the innocents without being found out, while the rest try to unmask them through challenges, debates and votes.
the-traitors-telugu-2026: Hosted by actor Teja Sajja, the Telugu edition of The Traitors puts 20 contestants in a game of trust and deception for a grand prize. Hidden among the innocent players are traitors who secretly pick off a victim each night, while the others try to find and banish them before it is too late.
the-verdict-state-vs-nanavati-2019: Based on a famous 1959 case, this drama follows naval commander Kawas Nanavati, who returns home to learn that his wife Sylvia is having an affair with his friend Prem Ahuja. What follows is a shooting and a trial that divides the nation. Manav Kaul, Elli AvrRam and Sumeet Vyas star in this ALTBalaji and ZEE5 series.
the-village-2023: In the remote hinterland of Tamil Nadu, a man whose car breaks down at night must find his missing wife and daughter, believed taken by monstrous beings from a cursed village. He enlists three locals to help. At the same time, the reckless heir to a pharma empire sends mercenaries to the same village. Arya stars in this Prime Video horror series.
thinkistan-2019: Thinkistan is set inside a Mumbai advertising agency, where copywriters, art directors and bosses chase big ideas, ambition and power. As their creative and personal lives become tangled, rivalries, friendships and compromises shape who gets ahead. This MX Player drama offers a look at the world behind the ads.
trial-by-fire-2023: After the 1997 fire at Delhi's Uphaar cinema, two grieving parents who lost their children begin a long, determined fight for justice against powerful people. Based on the book by Neelam and Shekhar Krishnamoorthy, this Netflix drama by Prashant Nair stars Rajshri Deshpande and Abhay Deol as the couple.
triples-2020: Three best friends pour everything into opening their dream cafe, only to find it is anything but a piece of cake. Shifty staff, an angry politician, loan sharks and complicated exes keep getting in the way. Jai and Vani Bhojan star in this Tamil Hotstar romantic comedy produced by Karthik Subbaraj and directed by Charukesh Sekar.
tripling-2016: Three siblings, Chandan, Chanchal and Chitvan, each at a low point in life, set off on an unplanned road trip together. Along the way, old fights, family secrets and plenty of laughter bring them closer again. Sumeet Vyas, Maanvi Gagroo and Amol Parashar star in this much-loved TVF comedy drama.
tu-aashiqui-2017: Ahaan, a young musician, falls for Pankti, a kind-hearted girl who dreams of becoming a singer. But Pankti's desperate, debt-ridden mother has bound her to JD, a rich and manipulative man who turns out to be Ahaan's own uncle. Jannat Zubair Rahmani and Ritvik Arora star in this Colors musical romance produced by Mahesh Bhatt.
tu-sooraj-main-saanjh-piyaji-2017: A sequel to Diya Aur Baati Hum, set twenty years later, this StarPlus drama follows Kanak, daughter of Sooraj and Sandhya, who is blamed by her grandmother for her parents' deaths. Her life takes a new turn when she marries Uma Shankar, a gentle Ayurveda doctor who is her perfect opposite. Rhea Sharma and Avinesh Rekhi lead.
tvf-pitchers-2015: Fed up with his job, Naveen quits in a drunken moment just as his business plan makes it to the final round of a start-up contest. He and his friends Jitu, Yogi and Mandal decide to leave their safe careers and build a company of their own. Naveen Kasturia, Arunabh Kumar and Jitendra Kumar star in this landmark TVF series.
twisted-2017: Three years after the murder of Ranbir Raichand, Aryan Mathur, now a suspended police officer struggling with alcohol, is still obsessed with proving that Aliyah Mukherjee was behind it. Nia Sharma plays Aliyah in this erotic thriller series from Vikram Bhatt.
two-much-with-kajol-and-twinkle-2025: Actor Kajol and writer Twinkle Khanna team up to host this Prime Video talk show. Each episode brings celebrity guests to their couch for candid conversations, wild opinions, games and plenty of banter, mixing fun with surprisingly insightful moments, like the liveliest table at a party.
typewriter-2019: In Bardez, Goa, three curious children form a ghost club and plan to investigate an old villa said to be haunted. Before they can, a new family moves in, and the legend of the house, linked to a mysterious typewriter and an old ghost novel, returns with terrifying force. Sujoy Ghosh directs this Netflix horror series starring Purab Kohli.
uncommon-sense-with-saloni-2020: Comedian Saloni Gaur, known for her character Nazma Aapi, hosts this SonyLIV comedy variety show. Each themed episode looks at everyday life in a middle-class family through an unusual and funny lens, mixing sketches and characters with sharp commentary on current affairs. Prem Mistry and Sachin Negi direct.
undekhi-2020: Two wedding photographers travel to Manali to shoot a lavish Punjabi wedding at a resort. One of them accidentally captures the groom's father committing a cold-blooded murder, and is horrified to watch it being covered up. Meanwhile, a police officer from the Sunderbans is on the trail of two young women. Dibyendu Bhattacharya stars on SonyLIV.
unpaused-naya-safar-2022: A follow-up to the 2020 anthology Unpaused, this Prime Video collection brings together five short films by Nupur Asthana, Ayappa KM, Ruchir Arun, Shikha Makan and Nagraj Manjule. Set during the pandemic, the stories explore hope, love, connection and second chances in uncertain times.
unstoppable-2021: Unstoppable is a popular Telugu celebrity talk show on aha hosted by actor Nandamuri Balakrishna. In each episode he chats with film stars, directors and other well-known personalities, mixing candid conversation and personal stories with games and plenty of his trademark energy.
uttaran-2008: Ichcha, the daughter of a poor widow who works as a maid, and Tapasya, the daughter of the wealthy Jogi Thakur, grow up together in his house sharing a sisterly bond. But as Tapasya is turned against her, jealousy creeps into their friendship. Tina Datta and Rashami Desai star in this long-running Colors drama.
vadhandhi-the-fable-of-velonie-2022: Vivek, a dedicated police officer, takes on the investigation into the murder of Velonie, a young woman whose death becomes a media sensation. As a reckless media trial threatens to tarnish her memory, he must sift through rumours and half-truths to find out what happened. S. J. Suryah stars in this Tamil Prime Video series by Andrew Louis.
vella-raja-2018: Theresa, a determined police officer, is posted to Chennai with a vow to clean the city of drugs, and her hunt leads to Deva, who will stop at nothing, murder and politics included, to become the city's drug lord. Bobby Simha stars in this Tamil Prime Video thriller directed by Guhan Senniappan.
vikkatakavi-2024: In 1970s Telangana, the people of Amaragiri are terrified by a strange affliction: villagers who enter a nearby forest at night lose their memories, and locals blame a goddess's curse. A young detective, Ramakrishna, arrives to investigate. Naresh Agastya stars in this Telugu ZEE5 mystery thriller.
virgin-bhasskar-2019: Bhasskar Tripathi has become a famous writer of erotic fiction purely through his imagination, because at 26 he has never been with anyone. When he falls for Vidhi Pandey, a police officer's daughter, he is desperate to change that. Anant Joshi and Rutpanna Aishwarya star in this ALTBalaji and ZEE5 comedy.
vish-a-poisonous-story-2019: Sabrina looks like any beautiful young woman, but in truth she is Vishaili, a poison maiden from a secret, reclusive species born of humans and snakes. She and her lover are among the last of their kind. Debina Bonnerjee and Sana Makbul star in this Colors supernatural fantasy drama.
vishnu-puran-2003: Produced by B. R. Chopra, Vishnu Puran tells the stories of Lord Vishnu and his ten avatars, along with other legends drawn largely from the Bhagavata Purana, such as the tale of the young devotee Dhruva. Nitish Bharadwaj plays Vishnu in this mythological series.
wakaalat-from-home-2020: Sujin and Radhika are going through a bitter divorce full of claims and counterclaims. Because their case is not considered urgent, the judge moves their hearing online, and the courtroom battle plays out over video calls from their homes. Sumeet Vyas and Nidhi Singh star in this Prime Video lockdown comedy.
water-bottle-2019: Directed by Tathagata Mukherjee, Water Bottle is a psychological crime drama on ZEE5 that tells the story of a serial killer. Rather than focusing only on the hunt for him, it takes viewers inside his mind, exploring what drives him and how he sees the world around him.
wild-assassins-2023: Wild Assassins is an Animal Planet documentary series about some of the deadliest animals on Earth and the weapons they use to survive. From camouflaging cuttlefish and hidden hippos to great white sharks and venomous spiders and snakes, it shows how these hunters track, ambush and take down their prey.
xxx-uncensored-2018: XXX: Uncensored is an adult anthology series on ALTBalaji, directed by Ken Ghosh. Each episode tells a separate bold story about desire, relationships and secrets in modern urban India. The ensemble cast includes Kyra Dutt, Rithvik Dhanjani and Shantanu Maheshwari. It is meant for adult viewers only.
yeh-hai-chahatein-2019: Dr Preesha Srinivasan is a gynaecologist whose life revolves around Saaransh, the boy she has raised as her son. Rudraksh Khurana is an arrogant rock star. When an unexpected event ties them together, a new chapter begins for both. Sargun Kaur Luthra and Abrar Qazi star in this StarPlus spin-off of Yeh Hai Mohabbatein.
yeh-kaali-kaali-ankhein-2022: Vikrant, a small-town man with simple dreams and a girlfriend he loves, is relentlessly pursued by Purva, the daughter of a powerful local politician who will do anything to make him hers. Trying to win back his life, he slips down a dark and risky path. Tahir Raj Bhasin, Shweta Tripathi and Anchal Singh star on Netflix.
yeh-meri-family-2018: Set in Jaipur in the summer of 1998, this TVF series looks at family life through the eyes of 12-year-old Harshu Gupta, who has very mixed feelings about his parents and siblings. Created by Sameer Saxena and written by Saurabh Khanna, it stars Vishesh Bansal, with Mona Singh and Akarsh Khurana as his parents.
yeh-rishta-kya-kehlata-hai-2016: Set in Udaipur, this phase of StarPlus's long-running family drama follows Naira and Kartik, a young couple from two families, as they try to balance love with family values, personal beliefs and the circumstances life throws at them. Shivangi Joshi and Mohsin Khan play the couple in this Rajan Shahi production.
yeh-teri-galiyan-2018: Shantanu and Puchki grow up as inseparable best friends in a poor neighbourhood of Kolkata, but are separated as children when Shantanu is taken in by a wealthy family. Years later they meet again, only to find that society will not let them be together. Avinash Mishra and Vrushika Mehta star in this Zee TV romantic drama.
yehh-jadu-hai-jinn-ka-2019: Aman is a nawab who lives under the dark shadow of a djinn. Roshni, the daughter of a courtesan, has the heart of an angel. Fate and magic tie their lives together in an unusual love story. Vikram Singh Chauhan and Aditi Sharma star in this StarPlus fantasy drama produced by Gul Khan.
yes-boss-1999: Meera and Mohan Srivastava are married and work at the same advertising agency, but they keep their relationship hidden from their boss, Mr Verma, who never misses a chance to flirt with Meera. Mohan spends most of his time trying to protect her, often in comic disguises. Rakesh Bedi and Kavita Kapoor star in this long-running SAB sitcom.
your-honor-2020: In Ludhiana, Bishan Khosla is an honest and respected judge. When his teenage son Abeer is involved in a fatal hit-and-run, the judge abandons his principles and his relationships to protect him. Jimmy Shergill stars in this SonyLIV adaptation of the Israeli series Kvodo.
zeroes-2018: Already late to the start-up race, four ordinary young people with almost delusional ambition come together to try to build a great company. Can these four zeroes turn an idea into a success? This TVF comedy follows their scrappy, chaotic attempt to find their million-dollar idea.
zindagi-ki-mehek-2016: Mehek, a shy middle-class young woman in Delhi, finds joy in cooking, a passion inherited from her late mother. When she crosses paths with Shaurya Khanna, a wealthy, arrogant restaurateur and top chef, their very different styles clash before love slowly grows. Samiksha Jaiswal and Karan Vohra star in this Zee TV drama.
vinnaithaandi-varuvaayaa: Vinnaithaandi Varuvaayaa is a 2010 Tamil musical romantic drama written and directed by Gautham Vasudev Menon, starring Silambarasan and Trisha, with music by A. R. Rahman. Karthik, an engineering graduate in Chennai who dreams of making films, falls for Jessie, the daughter of his conservative Syrian Catholic landlord, who is a year older and wary of love.
